20.20      Java mediation: structural equations, intervention se-
           mantics, and portable diagrams
A bank drawing a channel-to-response-to-repayment diagram has two distinct requirements:
estimating a statistical structural equation model and evaluating an intervention justified by
that model. Java software offers substantial graph and structural-equation components, but
the existence of an arrow in a graphical editor does not establish the assignment mechanism,
mediator timing or absence of hidden common causes. The selected Tetrad and Onyx sources
support a concrete comparison of these components. The resulting proposal is to reuse narrowly
specified graph, estimation and export services, with separate effect and uncertainty contracts.
218                                                            Causal analysis for a universal bank


A bounded repository search that finds few dedicated mediation projects is not evidence
that the language lacks the capability.cmu-phil/tetrad contributors (2026c); brandmaier/onyx
contributors (2026); Causal banking proposal project (2026fo)


20.20.1     What a linear path product means

Let A be a servicing assignment, M an intermediate response, and Y the outcome over a fixed
horizon. A recursive linear structural model can be written as

                     A = εA ,      M = aA + εM ,        Y = cA + bM + εY .

If these equations are valid structural assignments, intervening on A changes the conditional
mean of Y with slope c + ab. The direct path has coefficient c, while the path through M
has product ab. This algebra does not itself identify the coefficients from observed data.
Interpreting regression estimates as structural coefficients needs restrictions on disturbances,
measured covariates, timing, selection and measurement. In particular, a model that fits
an observed covariance matrix is not automatically an identified intervention model.Causal
banking proposal project (2026fo)
   For an authored example, set (a, b, c) = (2, 4, 3) and disturbance variances to one. With
independent disturbances the indirect effect per unit of assignment is eight and the total
is eleven. If instead Cov(εM , εY ) = 1/2, while assignment remains independent of these
disturbances, regression of Y on A and M yields mediator slope 4.5 and direct coefficient two.
The regression path product is then nine, although the structural indirect effect remains eight.
The total remains eleven: a correct total can conceal an incorrect decomposition. A proposed
Java adapter must distinguish a supplied structural parameter from a regression estimate and
retain any correlated-error assumptions.Causal banking proposal project (2026fo)


20.20.2     Tetrad total effects and the covariance carried through an interven-
            tion

The selected Tetrad SemIm.getTotalEffect method temporarily zeros coefficient parameters
for directed edges entering the treatment node, recomputes an implied covariance matrix, and
returns the treatment–outcome covariance divided by treatment variance. Its helper computes
the usual linear-SEM expression

                                  Σ = (I − B)−1 Ω(I − B)−T ,

where B contains structural coefficients and Ω is the disturbance covariance. The inspected
method changes entering directed coefficients, but retains Ω. That distinction matters when
treatment shares a disturbance with another variable.cmu-phil/tetrad contributors (2026c)
   Keep the same coefficients (2, 4, 3) and set Cov(εA , εM ) = 1/4, Cov(εA , εY ) = 1/2, and
Cov(εM , εY ) = 0. The unit-diagonal disturbance covariance is positive definite: its determinant
is 11/16. The structural intervention derivative is still eleven, but the selected covariance-ratio
expression is
                            Cov(A, Y )
                                       = 11 + 4(1/4) + 1/2 = 12.5.
                              Var(A)
The treatment has no entering directed edge to remove in this example, so retaining its error
correlations retains the observational dependence that an exogenous intervention should break.
This is a precise condition on this source route, not a claim that all Tetrad effect methods are
invalid. A conditional integration could restrict this route to justified independent treatment
20.20. Java mediation and structural contracts                                                219


disturbances or derive the appropriate graph surgery and propagate its consequences.cmu-
phil/tetrad contributors (2026c); Causal banking proposal project (2026fo)
   State restoration is also part of the scientific contract. The selected method restores changed
parameters in a finally block around covariance evaluation. However, the initial parameter-
zeroing loop precedes that protected block. Its setter accepts free parameters and means,
while rejecting other parameters. A fixed entering coefficient can therefore cause a refusal
before the protected evaluation begins; if other coefficients were already changed, the wrapper
must establish that state is restored. The method additionally returns zero when treatment
variance is exactly zero, although a structural intervention derivative can remain nonzero in a
supplied model with degenerate observational assignment. That boundary should be a typed
qualification condition, not an automatic finding of no effect.cmu-phil/tetrad contributors
(2026c)
   Estimation paths must be kept separate. The inspected default estimator selects different
optimizers for models with fixed parameters, cycles, correlated errors or latent nodes; its local
regression optimizer is used for a more restricted case. Parameter standard errors may use
parent regression or a different covariance calculation, and missing or unsupported cases can
return undefined values. Neither a parameter standard error nor two marginal standard errors
automatically supply uncertainty for the indirect product. For estimated coefficients â, b̂, the
first-order variance is
                             b2 Var(â) + a2 Var(b̂) + 2ab Cov(â, b̂).
At a = 2, b = 4, variances 0.04 and 0.09, and covariance 0.02, the expression is 1.32 rather
than one when the covariance term is omitted. This is an authored delta-method illustration;
nonregularity near zero products, selection of a graph and dependent observations need separate
uncertainty analysis.cmu-phil/tetrad contributors (2026c); Causal banking proposal project
(2026fo)
   The earlier Tetrad comparison considered effect sets across alternative parent configurations.
The inspected IDA routine enumerates candidate sets and catches exceptions while computing
effects. Consequently, a returned effect list should be accompanied by attempted and failed
configurations; a shortened list is not automatically the full set implied by the graph class.
This is graph uncertainty, distinct from a probability distribution over mediation effects. The
proposal would preserve both the graph-class semantics and the computation denominator.cmu-
phil/tetrad contributors (2026c); Causal banking proposal project (2026fo)
   A related source helper demonstrates why computational limits must not become causal zeros.
The total-effect eligibility helper searches potentially directed paths up to a supplied maximum
length and labels an empty bounded search as no potentially directed paths. Its documentation
instructs callers to force a zero effect in that case. The path delegate explicitly stops when
the edge count exceeds the cutoff. In the chain A → M1 → M2 → Y with coefficients two,
three and four, a two-edge search returns no complete path even though the structural effect
is 24. An unbounded search or a separately proven reachability result is needed before turning
absence into zero. Otherwise the request should return search-incomplete.cmu-phil/tetrad
contributors (2026c); Causal banking proposal project (2026fo)

20.20.3     Onyx covariance fitting and failure propagation

Onyx offers a graphical structural-equation environment, a Java estimation backend and export
paths to several other systems. Its selected RAM representation uses an asymmetric path
matrix B, symmetric disturbance covariance Ω, mean vector m and observed-variable selection
matrix F . The ordinary branch evaluates
                   µ = F (I − B)−1 m,       Σ = F (I − B)−1 Ω(I − B)−T F T .
220                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


This is an appropriate statistical representation for a declared model. Its inversion and
covariance calculations do not establish whether an arrow is manipulable or whether correlated
disturbances permit a particular causal decomposition. The name isIndirectData in the
backend concerns covariance/summary-data input and must not be advertised as an indirect
causal-effect service.brandmaier/onyx contributors (2026); Causal banking proposal project
(2026fo)
   The selected covariance-evaluation branch catches an inversion exception, prints an
accelerating-cycle warning, and then continues matrix multiplication using the inverse
buffer. The inspected inversion delegate initializes that buffer to the identity before pivoting
and throws on an exactly singular pivot. Consider the scalar case B = 1, Ω = 1, m = 2:
I − B = 0 has no inverse and the structural equilibrium is not defined. Following the selected
expressions leaves a unit inverse buffer, after which the continued covariance and mean
expressions are one and two. These are not valid solutions to the singular model. This is a
static control-flow witness rather than an observed GUI output. A reusable backend must
propagate the invalid state, invalidate prior results and prevent a warning-only path from
supplying accepted estimates. Near-singular cases additionally need conditioning and residual
checks.brandmaier/onyx contributors (2026); Causal banking proposal project (2026fo)
   The presence of a cycle must be distinguished from singularity and from instability. Invert-
ibility of I − B supplies an algebraic equilibrium under the stated linear model; convergence
of an iterative dynamic interpretation requires further conditions. A warning that names an
accelerating cycle does not determine which condition failed. Conversely, a stable-looking
diagram is not evidence of causal identification. This distinction supports a proposed result
schema containing model validity, numerical status, structural assumptions and target identity
as separate fields.Causal banking proposal project (2026fo)


20.20.4    A diagram export is a scientific transformation

Cross-language reuse is valuable if it preserves variables, direction, parameters, constraints
and observation semantics. The inspected generic Onyx exporter dispatches an observed-
to-observed directed edge through an ON branch. For an internal edge A → M , its lavaan
formatter emits the regression orientation M ∼ A. The selected Julia formatter emits a right
arrow from target to source for the same branch, while its latent-to-observed branch emits
the opposite source-to-target orientation. The literal output for the first case is therefore
M → A. This source inconsistency requires a target-parser and semantic round-trip test before
claiming equivalence to a Julia model. No Julia runtime test is claimed here.brandmaier/onyx
contributors (2026); Causal banking proposal project (2026fo)
   The lavaan exporter also chooses concrete defaults, including estimation with fixed.x=FALSE
and full-information handling of missing data, and rejects definition-edge models through its
validity predicate. These choices need to be visible when moving a bank analyst’s diagram to
another runtime. The shared name mapper does attempt collision handling after sanitization,
so a superficial inspection of character replacement alone would be insufficient to conclude that
labels necessarily collide. An adequate round-trip fixture should include non-ASCII labels,
repeated parameter names, fixed edges, correlated errors, means, unsupported definitions and
missingness. It should compare the reconstructed graph and equations before comparing fitted
values.brandmaier/onyx contributors (2026)
  The same principle governs CLI or MCP integration. A request should carry the causal
query, versioned diagram, node identities, coefficient status, treatment contrast, graph-search
completeness and numerical status. A response should preserve failure denominators and
provide a refusal when an exported model changes direction or assumptions. Graph editing,
20.21. C++ mediation and numerical contracts                                                    221


statistical fitting and intervention evaluation are separate services that can be combined only
under a tested contract. No sibling-repository integration or operational service is inferred
from these proposed interfaces.Causal banking proposal project (2026fo)


20.20.5     Reuse decisions and public qualification

For Tetrad, conditional reuse of graph and SEM components is plausible, but the selected
total-effect helper needs the disturbance, fixed-parameter and zero-variance conditions just
described. The graph-search cutoff must remain an explicit computation limit. For Onyx,
the graphical editor and RAM representation are useful candidates, with backend failure
propagation and target-specific export parity as separate admission requirements. Equation-
level ports should be considered only when a measured workflow benefit justifies maintaining
the same model and uncertainty semantics. Selected GPL and Apache declarations and Onyx’s
separately listed dependencies require artifact-specific rights review; a top-level license does
not clear every bundled component.cmu-phil/tetrad contributors (2026c); brandmaier/onyx
contributors (2026); Causal banking proposal project (2026fo)
   Public qualification can proceed with generated linear systems before costly bank experiments.
Enumerate acyclic path products and correlated-disturbance laws; compare graph surgery
with covariance ratios; inject fixed-parameter failures and verify restoration; exercise zero
treatment variance and bounded path searches; and test singular and near-singular RAM
inputs. Round-trip each supported export and retain every rejected case. Then evaluate
estimation and uncertainty under independent customers, clusters and shared calendars as
distinct designs. A structural total of eleven mistaken for 12.5 across 10,000 customers at a
hypothetical USD10 per outcome unit would overstate value by USD150,000. This calculation
motivates semantic tests; it is not a bank ROI estimate.Causal banking proposal project
(2026fo)
   The reviewed sources support these bounded engineering and mathematical routes. They do
not resolve arbitrary hidden confounding, causal direction from covariance fit, nonlinear natural
effects, general longitudinal sensitivity or independent acceptance. A named Onyx scholarly
candidate remains an omission until its genuine original is retained; source-backed technical
statements do not substitute metadata for that paper. Complete search tails, additional
JVM implementations, installed-artifact trials and rights remain open. These local limits
should guide the next public tests while independent proposal work continues, preserving the
intervention and export qualification.Causal banking proposal project (2026fo)


20.21      C++ mediation: preserve the intervention through nu-
           merical and data interfaces
A bank evaluating a channel-to-engagement-to-repayment mechanism needs more than a
fast matrix library. Let A denote a channel assignment, M subsequent engagement and Y
repayment value. Under an explicitly justified linear structural model M = aA + UM and
Y = cA + bM + UY , with the required assignment and mediator–outcome restrictions, a unit
treatment contrast has indirect effect ab, direct effect c and total effect c + ab. The illustrative
values (a, b, c) = (2, 4, 3) give 8, 3 and 11. These are project derivations in a declared model.
A fitted structural-equation model, a differentiable solver or a posterior sample does not
establish the restrictions. The useful C++ question is which computation can be adopted
while preserving this meaning and its uncertainty, and which apparent reuse would silently
change the problem.
222                                                            Causal analysis for a universal bank


   Four bounded repository searches and selected primary-source inspection identify four
different component roles: OpenMx’s R-facing C++ structural-equation engine, Stan Math’s
C++ primitives, bsem’s R-to-Stan generated implementation, and gwsem’s genetic-data
interface to OpenMx. Forty-seven authentic originals are tied to complete selected repository
trees, revisions no later than 7 October 2026, retrieval receipts and byte hashes. The search
returns additional uninspected candidates and is not a saturation or absence result. In
particular, an R interface with a C++ backend must not be counted as an independent,
fully qualified C++ mediation system. No downloaded implementation was executed for this
comparison.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026fd)


20.21.1     OpenMx: joint algebra, row resampling and numerical failure

OpenMx’s RAM representation provides a natural computational home for a linear mediation
model. Writing x = Bx + ϵ, disturbance covariance S and an observation-selection matrix F ,
its mathematical covariance target is

                                Σ = F (I − B)−1 S(I − B)−T F T .

This covariance representation can include correlated disturbances; it does not make a coefficient
product causally identified. A proposed adapter should retain the graph, variable order, error
correlations, measurement model, fixed and shared parameters, and the intervention contrast
separately from the numerical RAM matrices. Natural-effect restrictions and the banking
information clock remain explicit inputs.(OpenMx/OpenMx contributors, 2026)
   The inspected path delegate uses a finite polynomial when its nilpotence logic permits
it and an inverse computation otherwise. In the dense inverse branch it forms a full-pivot
LU decomposition and solves against the identity. The nearby sparse branch checks the
factorization status, records an iteration error and sets its inverse buffer to missing values
on failure. This is a difference in the inspected local guards, not evidence that every dense
singular model is accepted by the whole package. Complete fit-function propagation and native
solver behavior remain to be qualified. A scalar feedback coefficient b = 1 − ε illustrates the
underlying numerical problem: the response (1 − b)−1 = ε−1 has derivative ε−2 with respect to
b. At ε = 10−3 these are 1000 and 1,000,000. Small residuals alone do not bound economically
useful effect error near singularity. At b = 1 the inverse does not exist; an adapter must return
an explicit failure, not a finite treatment effect.(OpenMx/OpenMx contributors, 2026; Causal
banking proposal project, 2026fd)
   The bootstrap implementation offers useful audit structure. Its C++ output retains each
replication’s seed, fit, parameter vector and status. The R accessor selects statuses declared
acceptable and warns when fewer than 95 percent pass. Consequently, uncertainty computed
from that accessor is conditional on retained fits unless the effects of failed fits are separately
justified. Report requested, attempted, failed and retained denominators. The expression
evaluator substitutes the entire retained parameter vector before evaluating an algebra, which
is the appropriate mechanism for preserving within-draw dependence of a product. For paired
illustrative draws (a, b) = (1, 2), (3, 6), the average product is 10; independent recombination
of the two marginal sets gives 8. The difference is not Monte Carlo noise: it is a changed joint
distribution. The displayed bias-corrected interval uses a normal-quantile bias correction and
empirical type-1 quantiles; its inspected formula has no acceleration term, so it should not be
advertised as BCa.(OpenMx/OpenMx contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project,
2026fd)
  Resampling semantics are equally important. The C++ loop draws frequency counts for
each dataset context; it does not by itself synchronize customer identities across separate
20.21. C++ mediation and numerical contracts                                                  223


data objects. A same-row multivariate record can preserve its cross-equation measurements,
whereas independently resampling linked tables requires an explicit justification or a different
joint sampler. The public R entry point states its independent-row assumption and rejects
detected multilevel and state-space models unless the user chooses an unsafe override. Such
an override changes execution permission, not the sampling theorem. The selected C++ loop
also contains an unimplemented-parallel marker despite carrying a parallel flag; this local
observation must not become a claim that all OpenMx parallelism is absent. Reuse should test
the exact entry point and report measured resources.(OpenMx/OpenMx contributors, 2026)
   The wrapper checks that a model has been freshly run, while the backend’s shown prior-
output compatibility test compares parameter and column counts. These guards motivate an
additional artifact identity over data, graph, parameter names/order, fit settings, sampling law
and seeds before bootstrap continuation. Equal dimensions do not establish equal scientific
requests. Seed replay, exception restoration of row weights and starts, an empty acceptable-fit
set, ties in interval correction, and dense/sparse singular cases are public qualification tasks.
The source declaration is Apache 2.0; complete distributed dependencies and any chosen
optimizer require their own rights and artifact review.(OpenMx/OpenMx contributors, 2026)


20.21.2     Stan Math: an auditable numerical layer with a narrow contract

Stan Math is a candidate numerical dependency rather than a mediation estimator. The
inspected arithmetic matrix solve checks square and compatible dimensions and delegates to LU.
The reverse-mode overload uses a Householder QR solve and a reverse callback. For AX = B,
a perturbation obeys dX = A−1 (dB − dA X); with output adjoint G, the corresponding inputs
are B̄ = A−T G and Ā = −B̄X T . These derivative identities explain the callback and also show
why an ill-conditioned A affects both the result and the gradient. Mathematical agreement does
not imply bitwise parity between the arithmetic and differentiated branches.(stan-dev/math
contributors, 2026)
  The positive-definite solve additionally checks symmetry, non-NaN values and positive
definiteness of the factorization. The inspected positive-definite inverse checks its LDLT status,
positivity and positive diagonal factors. Its opening comment mentions positive/negative
definiteness, but the operative checks require positivity. Select the routine by its executable
mathematical contract. A covariance factor may be positive definite; the nonsymmetric RAM
matrix I − B generally is not. Passing it to an SPD routine for convenience would change the
supported domain.(stan-dev/math contributors, 2026)
   Conditional adoption should prefer these maintained primitives over an unnecessary hand
port, subject to a pinned compiler, Eigen and Stan versions, float type, threading and license
inventory. Public qualification should cover zero-sized and incompatible matrices, singular and
near-singular systems, finite values, forward/reverse agreement, residual-based error bounds
and independent directional derivatives. A successful gradient is neither a hidden confounding
sensitivity interval nor a guarantee of global optimization. The selected BSD-3-Clause text is an
initial rights input, not clearance of every compiled dependency.(stan-dev/math contributors,
2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026fd)


20.21.3     bsem: inspect the translation from named paths to compiled density

The selected bsem 1.0.0 package exposes factor and structural models through rstan. Its
retained generated C++ identifies Stan 2.21.0; the separately pinned 2026 Stan Math tree is
not asserted to be bsem’s installed dependency. The model uses observed measurement entries,
Gaussian latent regressions with unit residual scale, loading priors and separate missing-value
224                                                             Causal analysis for a universal bank


variants. These are substantive modeling choices. Loading signs supplied to the R interface set
initial values; they do not by themselves constrain every posterior draw or identify a bank’s
manipulable treatment.(cran/bsem contributors, 2020)
  A named-path translation deserves an exact test before integration. The inspected handler
constructs dependent-variable indices in the order of the block names, but constructs parent
groups in the order of the path list. For block order (A, M, Y ) and path list Y ← M followed
by M ← A, these sequences pair as M ← M and Y ← A. The intended chain with coefficients
1/2 and 3/4 has product 3/8; the mispaired equations are a different model. This is an
authored trace of the selected indexing expressions, not a measured native frequency. An
adapter must canonicalize both targets and parents together, reject duplicate or self edges as
appropriate, and test every permutation of equivalent named input.(cran/bsem contributors,
2020; Causal banking proposal project, 2026fd)
   Cycles require more than reordering. Consider two simultaneous equations z1 = rz2 + e1 and
z2 = sz1 +e2 , with independent standard-normal errors. The product of the two residual normal
densities integrates over z to 1/|1 − rs| when 1 − rs ̸= 0. A normalized simultaneous-equation
density therefore needs the Jacobian multiplier |1 − rs| per observation. At r = s = 1/2 the
residual product integrates to 4/3 and the missing multiplier is 3/4. An acyclic triangular
system has determinant one. The selected Stan text writes the regression density product, so
a translator must establish the intended acyclic model or derive and implement the correct
cyclic density; merely obtaining posterior draws cannot resolve this distinction. No claim is
made that this static case was run through the package.(cran/bsem contributors, 2020; Causal
banking proposal project, 2026fd)
   Two smaller interface details can materially alter sensitivity analysis. The R handler forwards
the second parsed coefficient-prior parameter, while Stan uses its square root as the normal or
Cauchy scale. An input second value of 4 therefore gives normal standard deviation 2, rather
than 4 under a conventional standard-deviation reading. Also, the selected Stan data declare
coefficient-prior locations nonnegative, even though the coefficient itself is unrestricted. A
proposed negative prior location must be rejected or translated with an explicit schema change,
never silently reinterpreted. These observations concern this selected model, not Stan’s general
prior capabilities.(cran/bsem contributors, 2020)
   For missing data, the R interface records observed and missing positions and fills a working
matrix with row means. The missing-value Stan variant introduces separate unknown entries
and gives them the measurement density; the observed likelihood iterates the observed index
set. The temporary means should not be described as the final inferential imputation. A later R
handler applies conditional chain-sign transformations to extracted loadings, scores and selected
coefficients. Its index mapping must preserve the structural equations before any joint mediation
draw is admitted. No missingness indicator model in the selected density establishes an arbitrary
nonignorable mechanism. Preserve the target population and missingness assumptions, and
retain chains, diagnostics and joint draws for any mediation functional. Conditional equation-
level reuse is plausible after fixing translation contracts; direct admission as a banking mediation
engine is deferred. GPL-3, rstan and the complete compiled dependency chain must be reviewed
for the intended distribution.(cran/bsem contributors, 2020; Causal banking proposal project,
2026fd)


20.21.4     gwsem: useful workflow ideas do not justify a domain-mismatched
            loader

gwsem combines genetic-file loading with OpenMx models. The selected compute plan loads
a variant, resets starts, runs optimization inside a try/catch plan and writes checkpoints
20.22. Remaining-language mediation contracts                                                   225


including covariance and sample-size information. This is a concrete example of preserving
per-request computation rather than reporting only a final coefficient. Its user documentation
also places statistical identification responsibility on the model author. These ideas can inform
a bank adapter, but genetic marker formats and allele semantics do not become customer-event
semantics by renaming fields.(jpritikin/gwsem contributors, 2023)
   The inspected BGEN callback gives a particularly useful public fixture. Its numeric
probability branch computes d = p1 + 2p0 and replaces an exact zero with a missing value.
The valid probability vector (0, 0, 1) has dosage zero under that very formula. For the three
deterministic vectors (0, 0, 1), (0, 1, 0) and (1, 0, 0), mathematical dosages are 0, 1, 2 with mean
1; retaining only the positive values changes the mean to 1.5. The explicit missing-value
callback instead throws an unimplemented exception. These are static branch witnesses.
The upstream parser and actual file-format path must be tested before asserting a native
defect or failure rate. A bank port must keep legitimate zero activity distinct from missing
telemetry regardless. The selected package declares GPL version 3 or later and includes
multiple third-party C/C++ components. Reject direct banking adoption of the domain

20.21.5     A public qualification route with explicit economic meaning

The practical proposal is a typed adapter over selected components. It receives the interven-
tion, units, graph and disturbance restrictions, named parameter mapping, sampling unit
and missingness contract. It returns the effect target, joint draws or covariance, numerical
diagnostics, complete attempt counts and typed refusal. CLI and MCP entry points should
serialize the same request and artifact hashes; neither may infer a causal estimand from a
successful fit. Large draws can remain in a versioned local artifact referenced by hash, while
the response carries bounded diagnostics. Replaying a seed without replaying the graph, row
mapping, solver and sampling law is insufficient.
   The first public fixtures should use known linear laws, permuted path names, correlated
disturbances, tied and failed bootstrap fits, independent and clustered sampling, near-singular
matrices, prior-scale changes and zero-versus- missing records. Then test target-language
interfaces, interrupts and recovery, resource use, and the full cost of all attempted requests.
No expensive bank experiment is needed to expose these translation errors. For a hypothetical
10,000 customers valued at USD10 per outcome unit, the illustrative joint-product difference
of two units changes the proposal value by USD200,000. This reproducible arithmetic is
a motivation for qualification, not observed ROI. The decision is conditional adoption of
appropriate numerical primitives, conditional OpenMx algebra reuse, deferred bsem admission
pending translation qualification, and rejection of a direct domain-loader port, while preserving
the public numerical and semantic qualification.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026fd)


20.22       MATLAB, Julia and Stata mediation: compare esti-
            mands and execution contracts
A bank comparing mediation packages across languages needs the same scientific request
in every environment: an intervention, its contrast, a mediator law, an outcome scale, a
target population and a sampling design. A mediation package can otherwise conceal a
coefficient product, a nested counterfactual mean, a modified treatment policy or a descriptive
path model. This comparison develops six concrete component choices: CANlab’s MATLAB
Mediation Toolbox; the Julia packages Paramed.jl, Mediation.jl and CausalMediation.jl;
226                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


CausalTargeted.jl’s compatibility interface; and the Stata cmed collection. Four bounded
repository searches and 55 authenticated original files establish selected source contracts, not
ecosystem saturation. The queries return irrelevant uses of the word mediation, uninspected
candidates and unreturned results. Revisions are pinned before the 7 October 2026 cutoff;
source descriptions are not native performance evidence.(Causal banking proposal project,
2026fs)
   Consider a bank’s reminder assignment A, account engagement M , and repayment Y . In
the declared linear system M = 2A + UM and Y = 3A + 4M + UY , the additional assumptions
needed for causal mediation yield direct and indirect unit effects of 3 and 8. The contrast 0 → 2
gives 6, 16 and total 22. These values make a useful portable oracle: language and numerical
routine may change, but the contrast must be applied exactly once. With nonlinear outcomes,
several mediators or intermediate confounding, the oracle must change to the specific identified
functional. A fitted path diagram cannot provide that functional by itself.(Causal banking
proposal project, 2026fs)


20.22.1    CANlab: distinguish levels, accepted resamples and interval proba-
           bility

CANlab’s inspected MATLAB path engine includes single-level and multilevel branches, or-
dinary and robust regressions, and bootstrap options. Its dispatch explicitly rejects some
combinations, including robust multilevel computation. The fast ordinary bootstrap path
constructs normal-equation inverses for the mediator and outcome regressions and returns
the product of the two relevant slopes. This is a concrete reusable path calculation, sub-
ject to matrix conditioning and the scientific assumptions attached to a coefficient product.
The main entry point removes missing observations jointly from the current variables. In
a bank panel, that complete-case set can be a different population from all eligible cus-
tomers. Selection and information timing must therefore be represented outside the regression
call.(canlab/MediationToolbox contributors, 2026)
   The resampling helper draws rows, deletes resamples with no predictor variation, and
replaces them until its iteration cap is reached. It also reseeds the random generator from the
clock. These are substantive reproducibility and sampling choices. With two predictor values
(0, 1), four equally likely size-two bootstrap samples contain two constant samples. Removing
them leaves only (0, 1) and (1, 0). The sample-mean variance is 1/8 under ordinary resampling
but zero conditional on acceptance. This exact example is not a claim about a measured
mediation coverage rate; it demonstrates why the replacement rule and every rejected attempt
belong in the reported experiment. A wrapper should capture the actual index matrix or
change seed handling through a reviewed port. (canlab/MediationToolbox contributors, 2026;
Causal banking proposal project, 2026fs)
   The confidence-interval call also needs branch-specific qualification. The inspected no-
covariate branch calls the local BCa helper with α = 0.025, while the covariate branch calls it
with α = 0.25. A nearby comment proposes MATLAB’s built-in routine, but that invocation
is commented out in the retained source. The helper computes bias correction, jackknife
acceleration and endpoints from α and 1 − α. In the unbiased symmetric limit, these two inputs
correspond to central probabilities 95 percent and 50 percent. The distinction must survive into
output labels and acceptance criteria. Zero jackknife variation, extreme bias correction, tied
resamples and the diagonal selection from multi-column percentile output are separate tests; a
BCa label alone does not establish correct multivariate intervals.(canlab/MediationToolbox
contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026fs)
  For multilevel data, the main program generally postpones bootstrap inference to the between-
20.22. Remaining-language mediation contracts                                                 227


subject summaries unless first-level bootstrapping is requested. This is potentially useful
for customer-level trajectories, but requires an explicit mapping from subjects to customers,
visits and shared calendar shocks. It does not establish valid arbitrary temporal dependence.
The complete-tree inspection finds a license-named file in a geometry subcomponent, not
a blanket toolbox license. Preserve that distinction and obtain the intended rights and
MATLAB/toolbox entitlement before direct adoption. Conditional equation-level reuse and
public tests can proceed without claiming that the dependency or statistical qualification
is complete.(canlab/MediationToolbox contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project,
2026fs)


20.22.2     Older Julia ports: preserve covariance and actually use the resample

Paramed.jl describes itself as a port of a Stata parametric-mediation program. The selected
source fits separate models, evaluates analytic contrasts and constructs delta-method uncer-
tainty using a block-diagonal combination of model covariance matrices. Even after software
repairs, that combination needs a justification for the relevant joint estimation law. Evaluating
covariates at a mean is also not automatically the same as averaging a nonlinear effect over
the bank’s customer population.(mwsohn/Paramed.jl contributors, 2018)
   An exact covariance permutation illustrates an immediate translation concern. The helper
assigns its output array to the input array and then overwrites entries while moving the
intercept to the last position. For the positive definite matrix

   The selected two-sided normal-tail calculation also uses the signed statistic without its abso-
lute value. At z = −1, 2{1 − Φ(z)} is approximately 1.683, whereas the usual two-sided normal
reference is approximately 0.317. An output outside [0, 1] is an elementary refusal fixture.
Formula construction, the typed logfile default, older Julia/DataFrames syntax and transitive

    Mediation.jl takes a simulation approach, fitting mediator and outcome models and perturb-
ing their parameters before simulating potential outcomes. Its selected bootstrap perturber
creates a sampled index vector but refits with the original index vector. For a deterministic
fit, that branch therefore does not create parameter resampling variation. With observations
(0, 2), ordinary bootstrap means are 0, 1, 1, 2, whose variance is 1/2; refitting the unchanged
observations always gives mean one. The subsequent outcome simulator can still generate
variation, so it would be wrong to claim that every returned interval has zero width. The
228                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


issue is that one source of uncertainty is absent while another remains.(kshedden/Mediation.jl

   The same implementation has distinct asymptotic parameter draws, predictive simulation
for normal, binomial and Poisson families, and substitutions of observed outcomes for some
simulated entries. A proposed adapter must state whether its interval concerns a sample
average, a population effect or a predictive quantity, preserve the treatment contrast and
justify cross-model dependence. Repairing the unused index is necessary but insufficient.
No license-named file was found in the selected complete tree; distribution rights remain
unresolved.(kshedden/Mediation.jl contributors, 2021; Causal banking proposal project, 2026fs)


20.22.3    CausalMediation and CausalTargeted: typed effects need matching
           laws

CausalMediation.jl provides useful architectural ideas: explicit effect families, mediator–
outcome confounder fields, refusal of natural effects with declared intermediate confounders,
and optional relation-kind checks for diagram edges. Its identification bridge requires re-
lation kinds when a supplied certificate has a semantic fingerprint, while a call without
relation kinds is otherwise allowed by the inspected helper. These are declaration checks,
not evidence that an imported graph or certificate is scientifically true. The CausalTargeted
mediation interface delegates through an extension to CausalMediation and errors when it is
unavailable. Counting the facade as a second independently verified estimator would exagger-
ate coverage.(SimonAB/CausalMediation.jl contributors, 2026; SimonAB/CausalTargeted.jl
contributors, 2026)
   The nested outcome helper exposes the mediator law more clearly than a package descrip-
tion. It fits separate mediator regressions and simulates independent Gaussian residuals for
the selected continuous-mediator path. With no intermediate confounder and at most one
requested Monte Carlo draw, it instead substitutes mediator means. Consider the exact
structural example Y = AM 2 , where M is standard normal and unaffected by A. The di-
rect unit contrast is E[M 2 ] = 1, but substitution of E[M ] = 0 gives zero. Similarly, with
Y = AM1 M2 , zero mediator means, unit variances and covariance 1/2, the contrast is 1/2;
independent Gaussian draws remove it. These examples identify the restrictions needed for
the inspected computation, rather than estimating its average error across unspecified appli-
cations.(SimonAB/CausalMediation.jl contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project,
2026fs)
  The source computes a mediator density ratio as a product of coordinate-wise Gaussian ratios,
each clamped between 1/5 and 5. The product is therefore bounded by 5p for p mediators, not
by five. For three mediators its upper bound is 125; multiplication by the selected exposure-
weight cap of ten permits a factor of 1250. Diagnostics must report the joint weight distribution
and effective sample size, not merely a per-coordinate threshold. The unweighted summary
                                               √
uses sample standard deviations divided by n; this formula does not automatically justify
customer clustering or shared calendar dependence.(SimonAB/CausalMediation.jl contributors,
2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026fs)
   The implementation also distinguishes binary-treatment and continuous modified-treatment-
policy calculations. In the continuous branch it omits the mediator-residual term from the dis-
played influence-function helper and uses the plugin plus outcome-residual contributions. That
source choice requires a separate derivation for the exact policy and nuisance law. References
in code comments are discovery leads; they cannot establish the omitted term is unnecessary
without inspected primary technical text. The selected natural effect helper delegates to the in-
terventional helper with an empty confounder list, so equality requires the stated compatibility
20.22. Remaining-language mediation contracts                                                  229


assumptions. Preserve the separate categorical-treatment implementation rather than attribut-
ing every continuous-path restriction to the whole package.(SimonAB/CausalMediation.jl
contributors, 2026)
   The conditional reuse route is to retain the typed request and refusal design, then qualify each
effect-family and treatment-support combination independently. Public fixtures should test
mean substitution, mediator correlation, intermediate confounding, weight truncation, influence-
function centering and numerical integration error. Selected MIT declarations are useful rights
inputs; the complete CausalDynamics, learner, solver and artifact chain remains to be examined.
Porting an interface without its identification and uncertainty contract is not a scientific
integration.(SimonAB/CausalMediation.jl contributors, 2026; SimonAB/CausalTargeted.jl
contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026fs)


20.22.4     Stata cmed: inspect the chosen estimator beneath the common
            command

The Stata cmed collection exposes linear-model, weighting, imputation, multiply-robust
and debiased-learning routes. Its linear wrapper delegates to Stata bootstrap or an op-
tional parallel bootstrap, with a survey branch. The inspected linear calculation multiplies
the treatment difference once when forming direct, indirect and total effects, and supports
treatment–mediator interaction terms. It reproduces the symbolic 0 → 2 oracle of direct
six, indirect sixteen and total twenty-two under the specified linear model; no Stata run is
claimed.(causalMedAnalysis/cmed contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026fs)
   The weighting delegate fits treatment probabilities with and without mediators, forms three
stabilized weighting schemes, optionally clips them at specified sample percentiles, multiplies
normalized sampling weights, and estimates three weighted outcome means. The resulting
decomposition is explicit, but propensity positivity, estimated-weight uncertainty and the
consequences of clipping must be evaluated for the same target population. The displayed
percentile censoring is a weight operation; it is not by itself a model for censored outcomes or
proof of mediator identification.(causalMedAnalysis/cmed contributors, 2026)
   The debiased-learning wrapper selects among named robust types and forest or lasso
delegates, checks some required external commands and restricts selected branches to binary
treatment and mediator coding. Inspecting this wrapper does not qualify the uninspected
learners, cross-fitting details or every advertised family. A comparison should retain the exact
Stata version, extension versions, survey/cluster settings, estimation sample and all failed
bootstrap replications. The selected complete tree has no license-named file; source availability
is not automatic permission to redistribute it, and Stata runtime entitlement remains separate.
Conditional equation-level comparison is useful now; direct product integration awaits those
explicit scientific and rights gates.(causalMedAnalysis/cmed contributors, 2026; Causal banking
proposal project, 2026fs)


20.22.5     A common public contract across languages

For the proposed CLI and MCP interface, effect family, contrast, mediator joint law, missingness,
units and sampling clusters should be typed request fields. The output should bind the exact
package revision and environment, return all failure and resampling counts, expose numerical
and scientific refusal, and reference large draw artifacts by identity. An agent translating a
business question may propose this request and the diagram; it must not fill in unobserved
assignment truth or hide an incompatible effect family. The same public known-law request
should be replayed through each admitted adapter.
230                                                            Causal analysis for a universal bank


   The public test plan is specific: index-use and covariance-permutation tests; positive and
negative normal-tail statistics; conditional resampling and confidence-level branches; nonlinear
mediator integration and correlated mediators; treatment contrasts, weights, missingness and
clustered inference; and artifact, license and failure-reporting checks. A hypothetical 10,000-
customer decision worth USD10 per unit loses USD50,000 of stated benefit when a half-unit
mediator-correlation contribution is omitted. This arithmetic explains the value of cheap public
tests before expensive bank trials. It is not measured ROI. The selected comparisons remain
conditional and incomplete, while preserving the common public mediation qualification.(Causal

20.23        R transport and missingness: preserve the population,
             the missingness law, and the analysis target
A bank moving a successful servicing experiment to a different customer population faces
two related but distinct questions. Which customers should the experimental effect describe,
and what can be learned when outcomes or adjustment variables are unavailable? A trans-
port estimator changes the population over which an identified response is averaged. An
imputation model supplies a distribution for unobserved values under declared restrictions.
Neither operation automatically supplies the assumptions needed by the other. This dis-
tinction governs the proposed R interface and its comparison with generalize, transportr,
causaltransportr, mice, smcfcs, and causalOT. The inspected releases are pinned before the
client cutoff, with precise identities and primary implementation anchors. The comparisons
concern those selected implementations, not every release. No downloaded package was exe-
cuted.(benjamin-ackerman/generalize contributors, 2025; nt-williams/transportr contributors,
2025; Netflix-Skunkworks/causaltransportr contributors, 2023; amices/mice contributors, 2026;
jwb133/smcfcs contributors, 2026; ericdunipace/causalOT contributors, 2026)


20.23.1      The population contract precedes the estimator

Let S = 1 identify the source trial and S = 0 the target sample, A be a binary treatment, X the
pre-treatment covariates, and Y the outcome in declared units. Write ρ(x) = P (S = 1 | X = x)
and e(x) = P (A = 1 | X = x, S = 1). Under consistency, source treatment exchangeability,
overlap, and equality of the relevant conditional potential-outcome means across populations,
the target contrast is

        τ0 = E{m1 (X) − m0 (X) | S = 0},          ma (x) = E(Y | A = a, X = x, S = 1).

These are restrictions on the causal and sampling problem, not consequences of fitting a
selection classifier. A corresponding augmented population functional is

                 1
                       
      τ0 =             E (1 − S){m1 (X) − m0 (X)}
             P (S = 0)
                              1 − ρ(X)     A                   1−A
                                                                                 
                          +S                  (Y − m1 (X)) −          (Y − m0 (X)) .
                                ρ(X)     e(X)                1 − e(X)

With the true selection and treatment probabilities, conditioning on X, S = 1 reduces the
residual term to the difference between the true and working response contrasts, multiplied by
the target covariate density. It therefore repairs a misspecified response model in this population
calculation. With the correct response model, that residual has conditional expectation zero.
These algebraic statements do not establish finite-sample coverage after nuisance fitting, cluster
20.23. R transport and missingness contracts                                                  231


sampling, or clipping. The authored finite-law reference checks the identity separately from
those extensions.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026gg)
  The generalize weighting delegate distinguishes disjoint source and target samples, using
(1−ρ)/ρ, from a nested-population mode using 1/ρ. It removes rows missing selection covariates,
normalizes target survey weights by their target mean, and optionally caps source weights at
an empirical percentile. Its random-forest path expands survey rows using rounded-up counts
and fixes a sampling-size argument at 454. An adapter must record the retained population,
sampling interpretation, and delegate arguments rather than treat all settings as equivalent
weighting.(benjamin-ackerman/generalize contributors, 2025)
   The package also illustrates why an output named TATE is insufficient to identify its scale.
The inspected weighting routine uses a Gaussian model when the outcome has more than two
observed values, but uses a quasibinomial fit and exponentiates its treatment coefficient when
there are exactly two. The latter quantity is an odds ratio in the applicable binary-logit model,
not a risk difference. For risks 0.1 and 0.2, the difference is 0.1, while the odds ratio is 9/4.
Multiplying the latter by customer counts and a per-event value would be dimensionally wrong.
The result envelope must carry the estimand, coding, link, contrast, and scale separately, and
reject ambiguous two-valued numeric outcomes.(benjamin-ackerman/generalize contributors,
2025; Causal banking proposal project, 2026gg)
   Population trimming is equally consequential. generalize forces its trimming option in the
selected TMLE dispatch. Its helper retains factor levels and numerical coordinate ranges
represented in the trial. This does not establish joint support: source points (0, 0) and (1, 1)
admit target point (0, 1) under both marginal ranges even though the joint point has no source
support. Conversely, excluding customers changes the target to its retained subset. Both
populations and the excluded mass must be reported; a smaller interval after restriction is not
improved evidence for every original customer.(benjamin-ackerman/generalize contributors,
2025; Causal banking proposal project, 2026gg)


20.23.2     Read the score and its complete delegate chain

transportr separates a task, nuisance fits, cross-fitting, and an influence-function object. Its
standard score uses source inverse odds and an average response difference over target ob-
servations. The task exposes population roles, observation indicators, and cluster identifiers.
Nevertheless, its default one-fold setting uses the same observations for training and validation.
More folds activate separate fold construction, with a cluster-aware branch when identifiers are
supplied. Cluster-aware splitting alone does not derive cluster-aware uncertainty. The selected
influence routine hands row contributions to the external ife package without a cluster identifier
in that call; the complete uncertainty delegate remains a qualification requirement. The docu-
mented sampling-weight argument is currently unused.(nt-williams/transportr contributors,
2025)
   The standard score also needs a bounded missing-outcome contract. Its outcome regression
is trained on observed source rows, whereas its residual helper replaces every missing product
with zero. The displayed standard influence function contains no explicit inverse observation-
probability factor. This requires a separately justified missingness argument; an observation-
indicator argument does not establish general censoring robustness. Zero times an unavailable
target outcome is a structural omission, while a missing source outcome or failed nuisance
prediction is a different event. The adapter must distinguish them instead of translating all
missing products into successful zeros.(nt-williams/transportr contributors, 2025)
   A separate iterated-outcome delegate gives another reason to qualify an exact branch. Both
its treatment-one and treatment-zero fits select the variable named .outcome_eps1, although
232                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


the task also carries .outcome_eps0. This source-level routing concern requires a public fixture
with distinct arm-specific pseudo-outcomes. It is not a measured failure rate and does not
invalidate an unrelated standard-ATE branch. Reuse must be specified by task, estimator and
delegate.(nt-williams/transportr contributors, 2025)
   causaltransportr supplies explicit generalize, transport and in-sample targets with augmented
weighting, unaugmented weighting, outcome modeling and calibration alternatives. Its nuisance
code fits S and constructs source-membership probabilities. In the inspected no-surrogate
transport branch, the augmented score uses Sρ/(1 − ρ), while the unaugmented branch uses
S(1 − ρ)/ρ. These are different weights under that definition of ρ. To expose the consequence
without a fitted package, take P (S = 1) = 4/5, independent randomized treatment with
probability 1/2, Y = A, and a working outcome regression identically zero. The target effect is
one. The expected augmented residual with the displayed reversed odds, divided by P (S = 0),
is 16; correct inverse odds give one. This is an exact population witness for the selected formula
under supplied nuisance values, not a claim that every estimator or native run produces
16.(Netflix-Skunkworks/causaltransportr contributors, 2023; Causal banking proposal project,
2026gg)
   The optional normalization needs its own contract. Selected branches divide the residual
matrix by the column sums of treatment probabilities, which are not sums of the displayed
inverse probability weights. With ten rows and probability 1/2 throughout, the divisor is
five. The native parity fixture must check matrix recycling, dimensions and the intended
normalized score. The summary delegate divides sums by a possibly substituted target
denominator while calculating standard deviations over the supplied contribution rows. Its
uncertainty formula must be derived for the same normalization and target-sample design.
Source inspection identifies the questions; it does not supply the variance theorem.(Netflix-
Skunkworks/causaltransportr contributors, 2023; Causal banking proposal project, 2026gg)


20.23.3     Imputation preserves a model, not missing causal information

mice offers chained equations, blocks, predictor matrices, passive transformations and multiple-
imputation analysis. Its selected sampler forms fitting rows from complete cases, observed
outcomes, and the complement of the ignore indicator. Its documentation states that some
multivariate delegates do not honor ignore and can require a complete predictor space incom-
patible with arbitrary where masks. A training/test boundary must therefore be verified for the
chosen imputer. A global flag cannot certify that validation outcomes have been withheld from
every delegate. Its monotone one-iteration shortcut also edits the predictor matrix without
checking that the data actually have the assumed pattern.(amices/mice contributors, 2026)
   Predictive mean matching returns observed donor values. That can preserve support and
avoid implausible draws, but it cannot generate an unobserved value outside donor support:
with donors zero and one, a missing value of two cannot be produced by that rule. This is a
limitation of the mechanism, not a claim that extrapolation is always desirable. The product
should expose donor count, exclusions, matching rule and missingness sensitivity, rather than
describe every filled table as recovered truth.(amices/mice contributors, 2026; Causal banking
proposal project, 2026gg)
   The selected MNAR normal imputer makes this boundary explicit by adding a user-specified
unidentifiable-model term to a normal draw. Those sensitivity coefficients are supplied
restrictions, not quantities learned from unobserved outcomes. In a simple mean calculation
with missing fraction 0.3, changing the missing-group mean by an elicited δ = 2 changes
the overall mean by 0.6. The output should be a sensitivity curve indexed by declared
coefficients and their interpretation. Its spread is not automatically a confidence interval for
20.23. R transport and missingness contracts                                                 233


an identified effect. A chosen coefficient cannot certify the bank’s reporting or assignment
mechanism.(amices/mice contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026gg)
   This distinction survives pooling. mice explicitly warns against pooling completed datasets
before fitting the scientific model. It combines parameter estimates and variances, preferring a
robust standard-error field when supplied by the model’s tidy method. For estimates (0, 2, 4)
with within-imputation variances all one, the between-imputation variance is four. Its missing-
data rule gives total variance 1 + (1 + 1/3)4 = 19/3, whereas its partially synthetic-data rule
gives 1 + 4/3 = 7/3. Neither validates an incompatible imputation model, a misspecified
causal target, or an unsupported complete-data variance. The interface must preserve pooling
rule, degrees of freedom, parameter identity, and covariance requirements. Scholarly references
in package comments are not newly cited here without genuine local originals.(amices/mice
contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026gg)
   smcfcs addresses compatibility with a declared substantive model. Its discrete covariate
update multiplies covariate-model probabilities by the substantive outcome likelihood and
normalizes the products. With prior P (X = 1) = 1/2, P (Y = 1 | X = 1) = 0.8, and
P (Y = 1 | X = 0) = 0.2, an observed Y = 1 changes the compatible imputation probability
to 0.8. Drawing from the marginal probability 1/2 would discard that information. Passive
transformations are updated within the procedure, so interactions and nonlinear terms must
remain consistent through the calculations. Compatibility with a chosen model still does
not establish its scientific truth.(jwb133/smcfcs contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal
project, 2026gg)
   For continuous proposals the inspected implementation first makes up to 24 vectorized
rejection attempts, then uses a finite per-subject batch. If every candidate is rejected, it
increments a failure counter; the previously stored value remains, and the routine later warns
while returning imputed datasets. Under an illustrative constant acceptance probability 0.1
and batch limit two, rejecting all 26 proposals has probability 0.926 . This is not an observed
package rate or a universal rejection law. It shows why suppressing warnings erases a scientific
failure condition. The wrapper must retain warnings, affected records, variables, iterations
and limits, and refuse clean completion until a qualified policy handles unresolved draws.
Increasing the limit is a possible computational remedy, not a proof of compatibility or
convergence.(jwb133/smcfcs contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026gg)


20.23.4     Optimal transport and adoption decisions

causalOT uses optimal-transport methods to construct causal weights; this mathematical
transport does not automatically transport experimental effects to a new population. The
selected API distinguishes ATT, ATC and ATE, carries initial sample weights, and forms
weighted contrasts with optional outcome-model augmentation. Its numeric effective-sample-
size method evaluates 1/ i wi2 under a documented sum-to-one convention. Raw weights
                            P

(1, 3) therefore give 0.1, while normalized weights (1/4, 3/4) give 1.6. Effective sample size
must carry its normalization convention and cannot certify joint support or valid effect
uncertainty.(ericdunipace/causalOT contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project,
2026gg)
   Reuse decisions are conditional and specific. generalize is a candidate for population
weighting and diagnostics after target, scale and trimming qualification. transportr offers
task and nuisance boundaries but needs branch-specific observation, routing and uncertainty
qualification. Direct admission of the selected causaltransportr score is deferred pending
correction or a justified interpretation of its odds and normalization, followed by public parity
tests. mice is a candidate imputation and pooling engine under a per-method contract; smcfcs
234                                                          Causal analysis for a universal bank


is a candidate where its substantive-model and rejection-failure conditions match the request.
causalOT is a candidate weighting component, not a substitute for a transportability argument.
A port must reproduce scientific decisions and failure states as well as successful arithmetic;
direct adoption must retain versioned runtime behavior.(Causal banking proposal project,
2026gg)
   Source declarations distinguish MIT for generalize and causaltransportr, GPL version three
or later for transportr, GPL version two or later for mice, and the selected GPL version-three
declarations for smcfcs and causalOT. These do not settle complete dependency, native-
library, service or redistribution rights. Pinned bundles retain identity, hashes, repository
blob checks and inspected anchors. Four bounded discovery queries preserve returned candi-
dates and omissions; no exhaustive ecosystem or saturation claim follows. Papers mentioned
by packages remain discovery leads until genuine originals and technical anchors are avail-
able.(benjamin-ackerman/generalize contributors, 2025; nt-williams/transportr contributors,
2025; Netflix-Skunkworks/causaltransportr contributors, 2023; amices/mice contributors, 2026;
jwb133/smcfcs contributors, 2026; ericdunipace/causalOT contributors, 2026; Causal banking
proposal project, 2026gg)
   Public qualification can precede expensive bank experiments. Fixtures should freeze selection
law, intervention, population weights, outcome scale, nuisance values, joint support, imputation
mask and sampling unit; compare exact scores before fitting learners; then test fitted nuisance
functions, dependence, failure propagation and costs separately. CLI and MCP requests
should serialize these fields and return typed refusals for unsupported combinations. In the
hypothetical odds witness, a discrepancy of 15 outcome units across 10,000 customers valued
at USD10 per unit changes the arithmetic by USD1.5 million. This motivates prototype tests,
not a measured loss or ROI claim. The immediate route is concrete while authentic bank
truth and adoption remain later gates: qualify the population and missingness contract before
interpreting a completed dataset as a completed causal argument.(Causal banking proposal
project, 2026gg)


20.24      Python transport and missingness: defaults, uncertainty,
           and the meaning of completion
A bank selecting a Python workflow for a partially observed target population must choose
more than an estimator name. It must preserve the population, treatment contrast, outcome
scale, observation mechanism, and uncertainty target through selection weighting, prediction,
imputation and discovery. The selected primary implementations are zEpid, causallib, micefor-
est, statsmodels and causal-learn, pinned at or before the client cutoff. They perform different
scientific jobs. A shared Python runtime makes composition possible, but does not establish
that their scientific contracts compose. The following comparison uses authenticated source
and exact authored laws; no downloaded package was executed.(pzivich/zEpid contributors,
2022; IBM/causallib contributors, 2026; AnotherSamWilson/miceforest contributors, 2025;
statsmodels/statsmodels contributors, 2026a; py-why/causal-learn contributors, 2026)


20.24.1    Transport requires the right score, not just the right odds

zEpid explicitly separates generalizability, where the trial belongs to the target population,
from transportability to a disjoint target. Its IPSW class fits selection models and uses
inverse probabilities or inverse odds as appropriate. The selected fit computes separately
normalized weighted means in the two treatment groups and reports a difference and ratio.
A constant stabilization factor cancels in such an arm-specific weighted mean. Its documen-
20.24. Python transport and missingness contracts                                           235


tation directs uncertainty estimation to a nonparametric bootstrap, and the selected source
contains a placeholder for a missingness model. The adapter must therefore specify who
is resampled, which models are refitted, and whether missing outcomes are supported by a
separate qualified mechanism. The presence of sampling weights is not a proof of censoring
adjustment.(pzivich/zEpid contributors, 2022)
   The same package’s GTransportFormula fits a source response model and averages coun-
terfactual predictions over either the combined population or only the target sample. This
makes a target-population choice visible. Its optional weighting must still be interpreted
consistently in source fitting and target averaging. The AIPSW class adds augmentation
and explicitly refuses its optional weights argument at construction. That refusal is valuable
product behavior: an adapter should preserve it rather than silently drop weights to obtain a
numerical answer.(pzivich/zEpid contributors, 2022)
   Augmentation changes the role of stabilization. Let S mark source membership, A treatment,
and write p = P (S = 1) and e = P (A = 1 | S = 1) in a simple randomized law. With p = 4/5,
e = 1/2, Y = A, and a working response regression set to zero, the target effect is one.
The selected AIPSW transport formula divides its residual sum by the target count. Its
default sampling stabilization multiplies inverse odds by p/(1 − p), while the default treatment
stabilization is one in this constant-probability example. Thus the supplied-nuisance population
value of that selected residual is pe/(1 − p) = 2. In generalize mode, the corresponding default
residual average is pe = 2/5. With unstabilized sampling and treatment factors, the transport
reference is
                                          pe 1 − p 1
                                                      = 1.
                                         1−p p e
These are authored population calculations for the displayed branches. They are not outputs
from fitted package runs, and a correct outcome model can remove the residual discrepancy in
this example. They show why cancellation in a normalized IPW mean cannot be assumed
in an augmented residual added to a different averaging term. The proposed qualification
compares all combinations of target mode, response misspecification, treatment weighting and
stabilization before admitting a claimed robustness property.(pzivich/zEpid contributors, 2022;
Causal banking proposal project, 2026fz)
  The economic implication is conditional but concrete. In that two-versus-one witness, 10,000
hypothetical customers valued at USD10 per outcome unit produce a USD100,000 discrepancy.
This is neither an observed loss nor an ROI estimate. It defines a public prototype test whose
cost can be compared with the risk of misinterpreting the result before any expensive bank
experiment.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026fz)


20.24.2    Treatment balancing is a component of a population argument

causallib supplies reusable treatment weighting, response standardization and doubly robust
components. Its selected IPW implementation predicts a probability matrix, clips entries
to requested bounds, and takes reciprocals. These are useful implementation boundaries,
but treatment assignment and source selection remain distinct variables with different iden-
tifying roles. Reusing a treatment-weight class for population transport requires an explicit
transformation and target derivation; the API alone does not provide them.(IBM/causallib
contributors, 2026)
   The exact shape of a weight matrix matters. In the selected stabilized branch, prevalence is
looked up using each row’s observed treatment and multiplied into every column of that row.
This produces the usual numerator on the observed-treatment diagonal. It is different from
a counterfactual matrix whose column a always uses P (A = a). With prevalences (1/4, 3/4)
236                                                            Causal analysis for a universal bank


and probabilities (1/2, 1/2), the selected rows are (1/2, 1/2) for an observed control and
(3/2, 3/2) for an observed treated subject; a column-stabilized reference would have (1/2, 3/2)
in both rows. The observed diagonal agrees, so this is not a claim that ordinary observed
IPW extraction is wrong. It is a warning to specify which entries a downstream consumer
interprets.(IBM/causallib contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026fz)
   Likewise, componentwise clipping need not preserve the probability simplex. Clipping
(0.98, 0.01, 0.01) to [0.1, 0.9] gives (0.9, 0.1, 0.1) with sum 1.1. Such values can be intentional
bounded denominators, but should not automatically be passed as a normalized categorical
distribution. The proposed result schema distinguishes original probabilities, bounded de-
nominators, normalized sampling probabilities and final weights. Qualification must retain
how many values were clipped, the changed estimand or approximation, and any downstream
normalization.(IBM/causallib contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026fz)


20.24.3     Completed datasets and valid uncertainty are separate deliverables

miceforest provides model-based chained imputation with several mean-matching choices. The
selected implementation can choose observed nearest-neighbor donors, sample categorical
values according to model probabilities, or skip mean matching. With zero candidates it uses
regression predictions or modal classes. These choices change the conditional imputation
law. For a fixed binary prediction P (Y = 1) = 1/4, a stochastic draw has mean 1/4 and
variance 3/16, whereas modal completion returns zero with zero conditional draw variance.
Other randomness from fitted models or initialization can remain; the claim is only about the
selected conditional completion step. Faster deterministic completion is not automatically a
valid multiple-imputation uncertainty mechanism.(AnotherSamWilson/miceforest contributors,
2025; Causal banking proposal project, 2026fz)
   The deployment contract is also concrete. Imputing new data requires stored models and
candidate values; the selected method refuses when iteration data were not saved. Script-level
random-state reproducibility is distinguished from record-level reproducibility, which has
additional seed and data conditions. The binary fast path with record seeds calls the global
NumPy seed function for each record. A CLI/MCP worker must therefore isolate and restore its
random-state boundary if other tasks share the process. This is a source-level interference risk to
test, not a measured concurrency failure. The neighbor query also requests all workers, making
resource limits part of an execution wrapper’s responsibilities.(AnotherSamWilson/miceforest
contributors, 2025)
   statsmodels offers a different MICE implementation with parametric perturbation, donor
matching and analysis-result pooling. It drops rows where all variables are missing and resets
the index. A bank pipeline must preserve a separate identifier and the dropped-row ledger
to avoid assigning completed values to the wrong customers. The imputer permits Gaussian
parameter draws or bootstrap perturbation and supplies a model contract for predictions and
covariance. The selected setter stores the donor-count setting on the common object rather
than in a per-variable dictionary, so a later setter can change the donor count used for other
variables. This must be made explicit in an adapter instead of promising an unsupported
per-variable setting.(statsmodels/statsmodels contributors, 2026a)
   The pooling implementation retains full covariance. With three two-parameter estimates
(0, 0), (2, 2) and (4, 4), and an identity within-imputation covariance, the pooled covariance is
                                                         !
                                             19/3 16/3
                                      T =              .
                                             16/3 19/3

The variance of the parameter difference is two. Discarding cross-covariance would instead give
20.24. Python transport and missingness contracts                                              237


38/3. This exact example shows why returning only marginal standard errors loses information
needed by a banking contrast. The selected code uses the empirical between-imputation covari-
ance and the factor 1 + 1/m; valid analysis still depends on the imputation and complete-data
models. Small numbers of imputations, inadequate donor support, singular fits and unsup-
ported degrees-of-freedom assumptions require explicit qualification.(statsmodels/statsmodels
contributors, 2026a; Causal banking proposal project, 2026fz)


20.24.4     Missingness-aware discovery has its own assumptions

causal-learn provides test-wise deletion and a missingness-correction path for conditional-
independence testing. The selected missing-value Fisher test chooses complete p     rows for each
tested variable set, inverts their correlation matrix, and uses the multiplier ntest − |Z| − 3. It
explicitly rejects zero overlap and singular inversion, but the displayed path has no preceding
positive-degrees-of-freedom guard. At three rows and no conditioning variables the multiplier
is zero, yielding a nominal value of one when the correlation calculation remains finite. This is
an exact formula boundary requiring a minimum-information refusal policy, not evidence that
a three-row dataset establishes independence.(py-why/causal-learn contributors, 2026; Causal
banking proposal project, 2026fz)
   The correction routine depends on a previously inferred skeleton and missingness-parent
information. It falls back to test-wise deletion when the correction condition or usable predictors
are absent. Otherwise it fits linear regressions, shuffles complete predictor rows, and adds
retained residual vectors to predicted values to form virtual data. The assumptions needed to
transfer those residuals to a new predictor distribution remain substantive. Heteroskedasticity,
nonlinear relationships, estimated missingness parents, and the randomness of the virtual
sample must be part of the qualification design. A graph learned from such a procedure
is not by itself a confidence set for the customer’s intervention effect.(py-why/causal-learn
contributors, 2026)
  One dispatch detail is particularly important for typed interfaces: both accepted correction
names, including the G-squared-named option, set the selected correction test to mc_fisherz.
The wrapper must not promise a categorical G-squared correction merely because the supplied
name was accepted. It should resolve the actual implementation and refuse an unsupported
semantic contract. Exact scientific type checking is more valuable than a superficially uniform
command name.(py-why/causal-learn contributors, 2026)


20.24.5     Conditional reuse and public qualification

The proposed adoption choices follow these boundaries. zEpid is a candidate for explicit
