on a finite hidden-state law with distinct event, availability and decision clocks. The third
checks conjugate posterior and predictive moments, including the dependence created by
shared parameter uncertainty. The fourth exercises missing diagnostics, empty outputs, partial
approximation failures, adaptation removal and sample-count conventions. The fifth checks
conditioned versus intervened graphs, factor permutations and deliberately incompatible or
trapped block updates. None requires authentic bank data merely to justify why the proposed
experiment is useful.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026fb)
   Every trial needs a scientific oracle and a refusal oracle, a declared backend version,
dependency and license record, full attempt denominator and total cost. The scientific
owner defines identification assumptions and state meaning; the numerical owner defines
supported model classes and diagnostics; the integration owner preserves types, graphs, clocks
and random-state lineage; the operator measures compilation, adaptation, sampling, prediction,
storage and recovery. These are proposed responsibilities to be assigned, not evidence that a
production team or service already exists. Direct adoption should preserve a library’s supported
native semantics. A process adapter is preferable when it can retain those semantics with
explicit conversion and custody. Porting is justified only by a concrete runtime requirement and
a credible parity budget. Unsupported causal claims and ambiguous observation/intervention
requests should be rejected with the missing assumptions stated.(Causal banking proposal
project, 2026fb)
   The selected license declarations support further review, not whole-distribution clearance:
Stan and NIMBLE have BSD-style declarations, RStan has GPL version 3 or later with a
distinct StanHeaders notice, and Keanu and Turing have MIT declarations. Numerical delegates,
compilers, optional components, complete installed artifacts and commercial alternatives retain
their separate obligations. The five language-cell decisions are consequently inconclusive
for complete coverage and native admission, while recording concrete conditional reuse and
public-test routes. Known source and adapter gaps can be addressed independently. Unknown
258                                                                    Causal analysis for a universal bank


assignment truth, unrestricted hidden-state identification, arbitrary cross-world dependence
and universal uncertainty calibration require information, restrictions or narrower claims. A
well-computed posterior remains conditional on a defensible model and information set.(stan-
dev/stan contributors, 2026; stan-dev/rstan contributors, 2026; nimble-dev/nimble contributors,
2026; improbable-research/keanu contributors, 2021; TuringLang/Turing.jl contributors, 2026;
Causal banking proposal project, 2026fb)


20.29      Observation data and computation workflows across five
           language ecosystems
A bank selecting an observation-data engine or computation workflow must preserve the mean-
ing of an observation before it optimizes its movement. A loan, a customer, a report about
that customer, a proposed linkage and an execution attempt are different objects. Conflating
them changes the population, information set or denominator of a causal analysis. This section
compares selected implementations of data.table and targets in R, Dask and Snakemake in
Python, Beam in Java, Arrow and Taskflow in C++, and DataFrames.jl and Dagger.jl in
Julia. Earlier inspected DuckDB, Polars, Feast, Pandera, Splink, OpenLineage, Ray and
Spark sources remain applicable under their original limits. R interfaces to C++ engines and
Python interfaces to shared engines must retain both identities; the interface language does not
identify the entire implementation.(Rdatatable/data.table contributors, 2026; ropensci/targets
contributors, 2026; dask/dask contributors, 2026; snakemake/snakemake contributors, 2026;
apache/beam contributors, 2026; apache/arrow contributors, 2026; taskflow/taskflow contribu-
tors, 2026; JuliaData/DataFrames.jl contributors, 2026; JuliaParallel/Dagger.jl contributors,
2026; DuckDB contributors, 2025; Polars Contributors, 2026; apache/spark contributors, 2026)
   The comparison is a proposal for integration and public qualification. The nine new
repository selections supply 83 authentic source files, including seven implementation delegates,
pinned at or before 7 October 2026. Five bounded discovery queries do not establish ecosystem
saturation. Unreturned search results, uninspected candidates, other languages, full dependency
graphs and installed artifacts remain outside the established coverage. No downloaded
implementation was executed. The finite examples below are project constructions whose
arithmetic reproduces; they are neither observed package incidents nor measured bank losses.
Package documentation’s scholarly references are leads unless their genuine originals have
separately been admitted.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026fl)

20.29.1     The observation is a versioned scientific object

Write an observation as
                                  o = (u, r, v, te , ta , td , m, π, ℓ),
where u is the proposed scientific unit, r the source record, v its version, te event time, ta
availability time, td the decision time, m the missingness or measurement state, π a justified
inclusion probability when available, and ℓ the linkage information. This is a proposed interface
contract, not a claim that a data frame contains all these fields. A historical replay for decision
t must use a declared information set, for example records with te ≤ t and ta ≤ t, together
with a specified rule for revisions. A source’s event timestamp alone does not prove that its
contents were knowable then. A schema validator can enforce field types; it cannot manufacture
assignment, inclusion or linkage truth. The earlier Feast, Pandera and Splink reviews supply
complementary feature, validation and uncertain-linkage contracts.(Feast contributors, 2026;
Causal banking proposal project, 2026af; Pandera contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal
project, 2026dy; Splink contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026ep,fl)
20.29. Observation data and computation workflows                                               259


   Consider a credit observation with event time 2, availability time 3 and value 20, followed
by a revision with event time 4, availability time 8 and value 200. At decision time 5 an
event-only backward lookup selects 200, whereas the two-clock replay selects 20. Both can be
perfectly sorted and computationally reproducible. Their 180-unit difference is an information
error, not a sampling standard error. The revision is useful for later decisions and retrospective
descriptive reporting, but it cannot silently enter a decision-time causal feature. A proposed
adapter therefore retains event time, first availability, revision lineage, clock units and timezone
conventions, and treats absence of availability history as an explicit limitation.(Causal banking
proposal project, 2026fl)
   Arrow’s selected as-of implementation illustrates why the sign of a tolerance is part of
the scientific request. For left time t and tolerance h > 0, the inspected predicate accepts
right times s with t ≤ s ≤ t + h. A nonpositive tolerance instead selects the backward
direction within its magnitude. Thus a left time 5, right time 7 and tolerance 2 can be a valid
forward match. Positive tolerance also changes memoization to retain future queues. The
selected advance method refuses decreasing on-key times; this ordering check does not enforce
availability time. We would adopt Arrow’s typed columnar representation and consider its
joins behind an adapter that rejects an unspecified clock/direction contract. We would not
port its optimized join merely to obtain a different language label.(apache/arrow contributors,
2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026fl)


20.29.2     Cardinality, missing identities and linkage uncertainty

Let a join map records from tables L and R through key k. The output count is
                                               X
                                     Njoin =       nL (k)nR (k).
                                               k

It counts matched pairs, not necessarily persons, loans or independent observations. With two
loan rows having the same key and exposures USD100 and USD200, and two contact rows
sharing that key, an all-match join produces four rows and a naive exposure sum of USD600
instead of USD300. Four equals nL + nR , so a guard rejecting only counts strictly greater than
that sum does not reject this example. The construction demonstrates a logical limit of an
expansion guard, not an assertion that the package promised unique financial units.(Causal
banking proposal project, 2026fl)
   In the inspected data.table development source, the ordinary join signature defaults to
all matches, retained unmatched rows and no rolling. The option defaults set the many-to-
many compatibility option true and the cartesian expansion permission false. In the selected
duplicate-match branch, the row limit is nrow(x) + nrow(i); the C delegate rejects strictly
above that limit and separately guards its integer-size limit. An explicit alternative many-
to-many policy exists in the inspected source. An adapter must record these options and
assert the scientific cardinality independently: one-to-one for a unique identity crosswalk,
many-to-one for a declared lookup, or weighted pair contributions for a probabilistic linkage.
Calling a table keyed or sorted is insufficient.(Rdatatable/data.table contributors, 2026)
   DataFrames.jl exposes a different useful contract: explicit left and right uniqueness validation
invokes duplicate-key checks. Its default missing-key error can be replaced by equality or
unequal treatment. The selected implementation filters missing keys differently for left, right
and inner joins under unequal treatment and refuses that mode for an outer join. Numeric
NaN and negative-zero keys are refused in the inspected branch. These choices cannot be
hidden inside a universal null conversion. Two unknown identities on each side can create four
pairs if all missing keys are treated as equal; none is thereby verified as a person match. A
260                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


reason code for absent identity is not a shared identity.(JuliaData/DataFrames.jl contributors,
2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026fl)
  Suppose a proposed linkage assigns probability p = 4/5 to a loss of USD100 and probability
1/5 to USD1,000. Conditional on this illustrative linkage model,

                 E[L] = 280,       Var(L) = p(1 − p)(1000 − 100)2 = 129600.

A top-match plug-in of USD100 loses USD180 of expected loss and all of this conditional
linkage variance. Across 10,000 hypothetical accounts the expected-loss understatement is
USD1.8 million; no independence assumption is needed for that expectation calculation, but
portfolio variance would require the dependence law. Splink-style match information should
therefore survive data extraction and reach downstream sensitivity or integration, rather
than becoming an unexplained hard join. Public qualification should include known finite
match assignments, uncertain matches, unmatched records and shared identifier collisions. The
underlying match probabilities themselves still need calibration evidence.(Splink contributors,
2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026ep,fl)
   The resulting R decision is conditional adoption of data.table for its bounded tabular
role through explicit cardinality, type and time checks. The Julia decision is analogous for
DataFrames.jl, with explicit uniqueness and missing-value modes. DuckDB remains a separately
audited SQL/embedded-engine alternative and Polars a separately audited expression/columnar
alternative. A wholesale rewrite would add conversion and maintenance risks without solving
identification or linkage calibration. A small portable reference for cardinality and clock checks
is more useful than an unqualified port of a mature engine.(DuckDB contributors, 2025; Causal
banking proposal project, 2026ab; Polars Contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project,
2026ca; pola-rs/polars contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026fl)


20.29.3     Task identity, cache identity and scientific identity

For a requested estimate, distinguish a scientific request identifier q, a logical task j, and its
physical attempts (j, a). A proposed cache identity includes the exact input snapshot and
schema, causal target and assumptions, transformations, numerical configuration, source/arti-
fact versions and relevant random-state policy. A job name or a checksum of only the function
body is not the complete identity. If an external table changes behind an unchanged filename,
a cache that does not bind the table snapshot can return a reproducible answer to an old
question. This is a general integration risk to be tested, not a measured defect in every
workflow engine.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026fl; OpenLineage contributors, 2026;
Causal banking proposal project, 2026dw)
   The targets source makes the distinction concrete. Its thorough cue includes command,
dependency, format, repository, iteration, file and seed comparisons. The builder first handles
missing or error metadata; it then treats the always and never modes before later change
comparisons. Consequently a selected never cue bypasses those later checks, but does not
simply erase the earlier missing/error checks. Error modes have distinct continue, abridge,
trim, stop, null and workspace branches; a null result must not be interpreted as a successful
numerical estimate merely because it is an R value. The metadata schema includes warnings,
errors, bytes and seconds. Those are valuable evidence fields, but they are not complete
procurement, engineering or failure-recovery costs.(ropensci/targets contributors, 2026)
   Target-specific seeds depend on the configured seed and target name, while an inner
command can override them and an NA setting disables automatic seeding. A name change
can thus be scientifically relevant. More generally, if two attempts reproduce the same 100
independent unit-variance draws, concatenating their outputs gives 200 stored values but only
20.29. Observation data and computation workflows                                               261


100 independent logical draws. The variance of their mean remains 1/100; treating  √ all stored
values as independent gives 1/200 and understates the standard error by a factor 2. Restart
reproducibility and new Monte Carlo replication need distinct policies. We would integrate
targets through a named R worker and preserve seeds, attempt identities, cue settings and error
classes in the proposed result envelope.(ropensci/targets contributors, 2026; Causal banking
proposal project, 2026fl)
   Dask offers a complementary Python task-graph role. The inspected tokenization code
supports custom normalization and pickle/cloudpickle paths. Depending on the deterministic
setting, some failures raise a tokenization error while fallback paths can return an object identity
or random UUID. A generated task token therefore cannot be presumed a portable scientific
provenance digest. The code also performs serialization round trips during tokenization, so
an integration should accept a constrained typed request rather than arbitrary serialized
objects from an untrusted caller. The inspected delayed-task guidance advises against input
mutation. Its local task executor distinguishes failed payloads; that local path does not establish
the behavior of every distributed scheduler, storage connector or retry plugin.(dask/dask
contributors, 2026)
  Array reduction introduces another independent contract. Dask’s selected sum forwards
dtype, chunk summation and reduction-tree control. For the finite terms 1016 , −1016 , 1, the
exact real sum is 1, while ordinary binary64 grouping can give

                      (1016 − 1016 ) + 1 = 1,      1016 + (−1016 + 1) = 0.

The authored scalar example demonstrates nonassociativity; it does not report a Dask bench-
mark. Deterministic scheduling, deterministic randomness and justified numerical error are
separate properties. Public trials should fix the dtype and reduction policy, compare against
exact or high-precision oracles, and record error as a function of cancellation, scaling and
partitioning. Bitwise equality alone would reject some harmless differences and accept some
consistently wrong computations.(dask/dask contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal
project, 2026fl)


20.29.4     Retrying computation and committing financial effects

An acknowledgement can be lost after an external effect commits. If a task sends a USD100
payment, loses the acknowledgement and repeats the payment, the logical instruction is one
payment while physical executions can create USD200 of effects. A durable idempotency key
checked atomically with the effect, or an equivalent transactional protocol, is required for this
particular guarantee. A local cache, a finished future or a retry counter does not independently
prove such a protocol. Conversely, suppressing every retry after an ambiguous failure can lose
legitimate work. The proposal should expose unknown outcome and reconciliation, not coerce
ambiguity into success or failure.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026fl)
   Snakemake’s selected persistence implementation records code, input names, parameters,
logs, software identity and stack hash when metadata retention is enabled. Its checksum
collection drops unavailable checksums and is subject to a file-size policy. With metadata
retention disabled, completion can remove incomplete markers and return without retaining
that evidence. Its inspected scheduler handles an error, frees resources, increments the attempt
and requeues while the restart budget remains; otherwise it marks failure. These mechanisms
are useful for reproducible batch workflows but do not justify treating all output files or
external effects as transactionally committed. We would adopt Snakemake for declared file-
oriented research jobs with explicit environment, artifact and output-validation contracts.
Dask remains the task/data-graph alternative; Ray’s earlier actor/task review retains its own
262                                                             Causal analysis for a universal bank


limits.(snakemake/snakemake contributors, 2026; Ray contributors, 2026; Causal banking
proposal project, 2026ek)
   The Java comparison must distinguish a dataflow model from a particular runner. Beam’s
selected Deduplicate transform is expressly bounded by time and window, compares encoded
bytes and does not preserve order. Its defaults use processing time and ten minutes. The
inspected stateful function emits an unseen value, sets a relative expiry, then clears its seen state
when the timer fires. The same logical request can therefore require a separate persistent identity
contract across windows and expiry. Beam’s WithTimestamps documentation also distinguishes
timestamps from windows: changing an element’s timestamp does not automatically recompute
its window, and permitted late timestamps can still be dropped downstream. Event time,
processing time, availability time, watermark and financial settlement time cannot be collapsed
into one field.(apache/beam contributors, 2026)
   We would consider Beam and the previously inspected Spark interfaces as conditional JVM
dataflow workers, with a named runner, connector and state-store configuration. The public
plan must test late/revised records, encoded identity, window changes, duplicate delivery
and sink acknowledgements. It must report whether the sink protocol was actually quali-
fied. We would reject the inference that a Java API or a successful DAG proves perpetual
deduplication or correct causal population construction. OpenLineage is useful as a sepa-
rate provenance interface; lineage events still require bindings to actual input and output
artifacts.(apache/spark contributors, 2026; OpenLineage contributors, 2026; Causal banking
proposal project, 2026dw,fl)
   Taskflow supplies a C++ task-graph alternative. Its inspected exception documentation
routes blocking failures to the calling context and asynchronous failures through a returned
future’s get method. The executor tracks anchored exception state and retains the first caught
exception in the selected path. Waiting for completion must therefore be distinguished from
consuming the returned error, and one reported exception must not be labelled a census of every
concurrently failing task. Cancellation also cannot reverse an already completed financial effect.
We would adopt Taskflow only for a bounded worker role with explicit result/error consumption,
per-attempt evidence and qualified external-effect behavior; we would not advertise distributed
persistence from this local executor evidence.(taskflow/taskflow contributors, 2026)
   Dagger’s selected worker-fault handler evicts results lost with a dead worker, clears cache
references and invokes dependency rescheduling. The inspected delegate guards dependency
registration, propagates an errored upstream, and increments running counts before exposing
replacement work for scheduling. The source’s own introductory caveat describes this as a
last-ditch recovery path with residual robustness limits, and the handler requires surviving
workers. These are reasons to qualify a particular pinned Julia deployment with worker loss,
cached-result loss and failure propagation; they are not grounds for claiming a measured hang
rate or rejecting every Dagger use. The comparison remains conditional because a static
branch review cannot establish the complete concurrent state space.(JuliaParallel/Dagger.jl
contributors, 2026)


20.29.5     Language-specific decisions and commercial comparators

The integration boundary should retain the mature engines and port only small contracts and

20.29. Observation data and computation workflows                                              263


without confusing them with a durable distributed workflow. Julia would combine explicit

earlier Spark and Polars evidence, and other relevant ecosystems remain uninspected rather
than absent. These are separate observation-data and computation-workflow decisions in each

   The previously inspected historical SAS preview job-execution example is a useful bounded
