20.29.6     A public qualification design before bank experiments

The first public suite should enumerate scientific units and join pairs, include known uncertain
links and missing identities, and generate event/availability revisions with an exact admissibility
oracle. Each language receives the same logical fixture and an explicit serialization/type
mapping. An adapter passes only for its declared cardinality, clock, null and linkage treatment;
refusal on unsupported combinations is a testable result. Arrow’s scanner batch and readahead
settings illustrate why memory limits must cover buffered and in-flight data rather than
only one batch. Performance comparisons must preserve the same scientific work and output
precision.(apache/arrow contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026fl)
   The second suite should separate logical requests from attempts and inject failures before an
effect, after the effect but before acknowledgement, during output materialization and during
recovery. For an illustrative two-request run, each request has a failed attempt costing three
cost units and a successful retry costing one. The completed-request denominator is two, total
cost is eight, and cost per completed request is four. Reporting only successful-attempt cost
gives one and discards three quarters of the incurred cost. Store requested, attempted, refused,
failed, retried, completed and unresolved counts separately; a workflow status alone cannot
264                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


supply this accounting. The units are authored accounting quantities, not measured CPU
dollars or a procurement quote.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026fl)
   A proposed CLI or MCP submission should bind a versioned request, immutable input
references and checksums, the scientific contract, worker/artifact profile and a caller-supplied
logical idempotency key. Submission returns an execution identity; status returns a documented
state, attempt count and unresolved-effect indicator; retrieval returns typed outputs, validation
and diagnostic records, with hashes for logs and artifacts. The design does not accept arbitrary
executable snippets or serialized language objects as scientific requests. A repository adapter
must declare its writable area, resource budget, cancellation behavior and result consumer.
No sibling repository has been modified or integrated by this comparison, and these contracts
are proposed rather than implemented protocol guarantees.(OpenLineage contributors, 2026;
Causal banking proposal project, 2026dw,fl)
   Scientific acceptance, numeric accuracy, runtime recovery, artifact custody and cost accep-
tance should have separate verdicts. A known route exists for the finite public fixtures, adapter
schemas, complete dependency inspection and named runner/sink trials. There is no universal
software repair for absent assignment truth, uncalibrated linkage probabilities, missing histori-
cal availability or arbitrary dependent-data uncertainty. Those require additional information
or defensible restrictions. The available engines can move and schedule evidence efficiently;
the proposed product must retain its scientific meaning through every transformation and
attempt.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026fl)


20.30      Agent evaluation beyond workflow completion: lessons
           from chemistry and software repair
An agent that completes a tool workflow has not necessarily answered the scientific question.
The distinction matters when a banking user asks whether a servicing action improves recoveries,
an agent proposes a diagram, a worker returns an estimate, and a natural-language report
describes a benefit. Each step can be locally plausible while the final answer addresses a
different population, information set or monetary target. Two independently retained preprints
provide complementary perspectives: Ramos, Collison and White organize scientific agents
around observation, decision modules and tools; Zhou and colleagues examine vulnerability
detection and repair, including data quality, evaluation and deployment limitations. These
sources motivate a proposal design, not measured banking performance.(Ramos et al., 2024;
Zhou et al., 2024)
   The selected chemistry original is arXiv version 3 submitted 14 November 2024, with 18
November 2024 also printed on its cover. The selected vulnerability survey is arXiv version
3 of 7 October 2024. Their journal identities are separately discoverable, but the retained
original journal bytes were not obtained through the recorded routes and exact equivalence has
not been established. Claims here refer to the inspected preprints. Their descriptions of earlier
papers and packages are secondary accounts; this section does not inherit those underlying
technical results without their own primary audit.(Ramos et al., 2024; Zhou et al., 2024)


20.30.1     From business language to a scientific request

The chemistry review defines a continuing observation/action loop, separates its trainable
decision components from environment/tools, and groups memory, planning, reasoning and
profiling as modules. The paper itself notes that agent nomenclature differs across frameworks.
This taxonomy is a useful design vocabulary rather than a proof that one architecture is correct.
20.30. Agent evaluation beyond workflow completion                                           265


For banking, we propose that every observation and action preserve an explicit scientific request

                               Q = (U, P, a, a0 , Y, h, It , G, A, C),

where U is the unit, P the population, a the contemplated action, a0 its comparator, Y the
outcome, h the horizon, It the available information, G the candidate causal graph or graph
family, A the assumptions, and C the costs or constraints. The notation is our proposed
contract. An LLM can elicit missing entries and propose alternatives; it cannot establish their
truth by filling every field.(Ramos et al., 2024; Causal banking proposal project, 2026fg)
   Suppose the business asks for net incremental value of a servicing action. In a stipulated
example, the action adds expected gross recoveries USD70 and costs USD80, so its net
increment is USD−10. Translating the question into gross recovery improvement gives a
positive answer to a different decision. The correct response need not invent a missing cost: it
can request a cost bound, return the threshold cost USD70, or refuse to recommend an action
until the missing input is supplied. This semantic error can survive a syntactically valid graph,
a numerically correct estimator and an articulate explanation. A public benchmark should
therefore test conservation of the business target independently of diagram syntax and tool
success.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026fg)
   Diagram construction should retain competing structures and reasons for each proposed edge.
Source-derived claims, temporal ordering, domain assumptions and statistical suggestions need
distinct provenance. Where observationally equivalent graphs imply different interventions,
fluent graph completion is not identification. The LLM may ask which variables were recorded
before assignment, whether policy changes affect observation, and whether linked customers
interfere. Those questions become inspectable inputs to a causal tool. A structural restriction
unsupported by the public fixture or a supplied domain premise should remain uncertain
rather than becoming a high-confidence edge.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026fg)


20.30.2    Surrogate rewards and scientific validation

The chemistry survey distinguishes predefined research assistance from hypothesis creation
and discusses computational feedback in hypothesis refinement. It also notes unvalidated
results in a cited generative example. Its own discussion of agent evaluation identifies unclear
success criteria and proposes Bloom’s taxonomy as one organizing approach. These are useful
warnings about evaluation design; neither the taxonomy nor a predictor’s score supplies a
calibrated intervention-value guarantee.(Ramos et al., 2024)
   For an exact counterexample, consider two proposed actions with proxy scores 0.9 and 0.8
and true stipulated net utilities USD−10andUSD20. Selecting the higher score chooses the
lower-utility action and incurs USD30 regret relative to the better action. This example does
not show that the survey’s systems incurred that regret. It establishes why a proposed bank
experiment must declare the mapping from proxy to target and measure its failure under
controlled shifts. A simulator, reward model or natural-language judge can be a useful oracle
only for the properties justified by its assumptions and validation.(Causal banking proposal
project, 2026fg)
   Adding judges is not automatically independent evidence. Let each judge have marginal
error q = 1/10. Three independent judges have majority error
                                                        7
                                3q 2 (1 − q) + q 3 =       = 0.028.
                                                       250
If all three copy the same mistaken premise, their common error probability remains 0.1.
Both constructions have the same marginal accuracy. A proposal should therefore qualify the
266                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


dependence, shared context and training overlap of its evaluation channels, and separate a
model critique from an externally specified causal oracle. These finite calculations are project
examples, not measured error rates for any model.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026fg)
  The chemistry review also cautions that sanity-checking tools do not make an answer
hallucination-proof. Its proposed narrative comparing lengthy laboratory exploration with
a one-week AI-assisted route is explicitly a scenario, not a controlled productivity estimate.
We should apply the same discipline to the banking investment case: separate an illustrative
workflow from observed time, scientific acceptance and actual cost. Public evidence can justify
an expensive prototype or bank experiment without pretending that its return has already
been measured.(Ramos et al., 2024; Causal banking proposal project, 2026fg)


20.30.3    What software-repair evidence contributes

Zhou and colleagues’ preprint reviews 58 primary studies within its stated search scope.
Its synthesis identifies heuristic vulnerability labels, repair datasets lacking tests, limited
input granularity and offline evaluation/deployment gaps. Those are findings of that dated
review, not current universal absence claims. Its threats-to-validity discussion acknowledges
terminology and search-selection limits. We use the review as primary evidence of its own
synthesis and proposed roadmap; individual model-performance results remain dependent on
their original studies.(Zhou et al., 2024)
   The connection to causal software is direct at the level of validation logic. A generated
adapter may compile and pass a sampled test while reversing an intervention flag, dropping
failed requests or joining future information. For a finite example, let the required function
be f (x) = x on {0, 1}. A constant-zero patch passes a test at 0 and fails the specification at
1. The number of passing tests cannot be interpreted without their coverage and oracle. For
a separate label example, predictions can agree with all four heuristic reference labels and
disagree with all four stipulated true labels. These are exact constructions, not allegations
about a particular benchmark. They motivate independent scientific oracles and adverse cases
for generated code.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026fg)
   The vulnerability survey’s discussion of training/evaluation overlap also matters to a public
causal-agent study. A proposal should bind task provenance, source versions, temporal or
structural splits, and known exposure limits. Public accessibility makes a benchmark useful
for reproducibility but does not establish that a model has never encountered it. A new
natural-language paraphrase need not create a new causal problem. Splitting by graph family,
mechanism, decision target or source document can address different leakage channels, but
each split requires a declared generalization question. This is an experiment design to test, not
a claim of contamination-free evaluation.(Zhou et al., 2024; Causal banking proposal project,
2026fg)


20.30.4    A staged public evaluation contract

The first stage evaluates translation and diagrams on finite public/generated worlds with known
units, clocks, assignments and outcomes. It scores the scientific target, allowed assumptions,
graph family, identification or identified-set answer, and correct refusal separately. The second
stage evaluates tool and code execution: typed requests, immutable inputs, output schemas,
numerical tolerances, fault injection and complete denominators. The third stage evaluates
decisions and costs under the same target law, followed by explicit transfer restrictions for a
later bank pilot. Progress in one stage does not automatically pass the others.(Causal banking
proposal project, 2026fg)
20.31. Independent causal and scoring oracles                                                  267


  For example, 100 requested tasks can produce 80 completed tool runs and 60 scientifically
accepted answers. Completion is80%, accepted answers per request 60%, and acceptance
conditional on completion 75%. With a stipulated total cost USD200, cost per completion is
USD2.50 but cost per accepted answer is USD10/3. Valid refusals and unresolved outcomes
should be reported separately rather than discarded. A scientific scoring rule must specify
whether an honest refusal is a success for the requested task. None of these denominators is a
measured value for a deployed agent.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026fg)
   At the CLI/MCP boundary, a proposed request includes the versioned Q, evidence references,
permitted worker operations, resource limits and logical attempt identity. A result retains
the original request alongside the graph/assumption decisions, estimator or refusal, scientific
diagnostics, code/artifact hashes and complete tool outcomes. Logs should support reconstruc-
tion of why a semantic choice changed; a narrative summary cannot replace the underlying
bindings. Generated code runs only in an explicitly qualified worker scope, and a successful
interface call grants no scientific acceptance. No repository integration is implemented by this
design discussion.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026fg)
   Known repair routes include explicit semantic fixtures, independently derived causal or-
acles, versioned source custody, reproducible numerical tests and complete cost accounting.
Unavailable journal originals, full underlying-study inspection and task-specific contamination
evidence remain bounded obligations. Unknown bank assignment truth, unrestricted latent
identification and universal transfer of agent accuracy cannot be settled by this public survey.
Modular tools make the process inspectable; scientific acceptance still depends on the target,
evidence and validation law.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026fg)


20.31      Independent causal and scoring oracles for public agent
           qualification
A public benchmark can justify a prototype only if its reference answer represents the scientific
decision we intend to test. An agent can reproduce a benchmark label while answering a
different causal question; it can also be penalized for a justified refusal when reference metadata
has lost its uncertainty. The retained CLadder and CausalDS papers motivate complementary
formal-question and data-science tasks. Their published results remain historical reports under
their original versions. Here we inspect two previously identified source issues and derive
independent finite witnesses. These specify qualification requirements for the proposed product;
they do not report execution of either benchmark or invalidate every item.(Jin et al., 2023;
Leban and Sun, 2026; causalNLP and andleb contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal
project, 2026fa)


20.31.1     An instrument does not by itself answer the population decision

In the retained CLadder source, the instrumental-variable graph has an unobserved variable
V1 affecting treatment X and outcome Y , an instrument V2 affecting X, and X affecting
Y . The corresponding average-treatment-effect metadata contains the ratio of the outcome
difference across instrument values to the treatment difference. The question generator
separately calls the structural model’s treatment-effect bounds. These are distinct parts of the
source path: the displayed ratio does not establish that every generated item is wrong, and a
structural-model calculation does not establish identification from the information supplied to
a respondent. Qualification must bind the graph, parameters, visible information, target and
answer-producing path for each admitted item.(causalNLP and andleb contributors, 2026)
268                                                              Causal analysis for a universal bank


   We can test the graph-level claim without executing the repository. Let Z = V2 be an
independent fair binary instrument and let the latent variable U = V1 satisfy Pr(U = 0) = 1/4.
Set treatment to X = (1 − U )Z. Thus the quarter of units with U = 0 comply with the
instrument and the remaining units are never treated. Treatment is monotone in Z, the
first stage is nonzero, and the instrument has no direct effect on the outcome. Consider two
outcome mechanisms:
                                 (                                  (
                                     x,     u = 0,                    x, u = 0,
                   YA (x, u) =                        YB (x, u) =
                                     1 − x, u = 1,                    1, u = 1.

These are stipulated binary structural models with the same graph restrictions. Both mecha-
nisms agree on every outcome observed under treatment assignment: never-treated units have
X = 0 and Y = 1, while compliers have Y = X = Z. The entire observed distribution of
(Z, X, Y ) is identical across the models, not merely one moment. The independent enumerator
verifies every joint probability exactly.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026fa)
  In either model, E[X | Z = 1] − E[X | Z = 0] = 1/4 and E[Y | Z = 1] − E[Y | Z = 0] = 1/4.
The ratio is consequently 1. The population effects nevertheless differ:

                     τA = 14 (1) + 34 (−1) = − 21 ,   τB = 41 (1) + 34 (0) = 14 .

The ratio equals the complier effect in these constructions. It does not equal either population
effect. Because the observed laws coincide while the population effects have opposite signs, no
rule based only on that law can determine the correct population-action sign for both models.
Randomization, exclusion, monotonicity and relevance do not remove the missing never-treated
counterfactual here. Additional effect restrictions, a different target, or further information
must be declared rather than silently supplied by a language model.(Causal banking proposal
project, 2026fa)
   For a stipulated banking translation, suppose an outcome unit represents USD100 incremen-
tal recovery and the decision covers 10,000 comparable accounts. Ignoring action costs only
for this illustration, the population increments are USD−500,000 and USD250,000. Identical
observed instrument data therefore support incompatible deployment decisions under compati-
ble structural models. This is a finite decision witness, not a bank estimate. A prototype can
return the ambiguity, offer a complier target, or identify additional counterfactual information
needed for the decision.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026fa)


20.31.2     Unknown reference truth is a separate state

The retained CausalDS identification helper represents an unavailable or failed backend with a
nullable identification value. Its population-ATE path also excludes an IV-only estimand from
accepted nonparametric methods. These are useful distinctions. The grading helpers do not
apply the nullable state uniformly: missing ATE identification metadata defaults through a
boolean test to not nonidentifiable, while an explicit null value in that same test is negated to
true; the inspected counterfactual helper tests whether the value is exactly false. Thus missing,
null and false require separate qualification cases. This concerns the inspected helper branches,
not a measured frequency in published results. The complete caller and data-validation path
still needs native verification.(causalNLP and andleb contributors, 2026)
   We propose an explicit oracle state I ∈ {identified, not identified, unknown}. Only literal
true and false decisions with their scientific evidence enter the first two states; missing values,
nulls, backend failures and malformed metadata remain unknown. Unknown tasks enter
a quarantine denominator and do not receive fabricated correctness labels. For a known
nonidentified target, an intentional refusal is correct and an unsupported estimate is not. A
20.31. Independent causal and scoring oracles                                                 269


malformed or missing response remains invalid rather than becoming an intentional refusal.
For an identified target, a valid estimate proceeds to numeric scoring and a refusal is recorded
separately. This prevents infrastructure failure from becoming scientific impossibility or
success.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026fa)
   The source already distinguishes intentional null-equivalent responses from invalid answers in
its abstention helper; our contract preserves that useful separation. It adds a distinct treatment
of uncertain reference truth. A CLI or MCP response should carry target, identification state,
reason, source evidence, backend status and response validity separately. Review may resolve an
unknown state, but a wrapper must not resolve it by replacing null with a boolean.(causalNLP
and andleb contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026fa)


20.31.3     Finite intervals and transparent losses

The inspected ATE interval branch converts endpoints to floating-point values and rejects
reversed endpoints. Its local ordering guard alone does not reject every nonfinite value. A
comparison of NaN with a finite upper endpoint does not report the lower endpoint as greater,
while subtracting NaN produces a nonfinite width. Infinite endpoints can cover a finite truth
with infinite width. These arithmetic facts do not establish that every full entry path accepts
such values; they establish why public qualification must test parser, validators and scorer
together.(causalNLP and andleb contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026fa)
  For a finite truth θ, endpoints l ≤ u, and 0 < α < 1, our independent reference uses
                                                   2
                        Sα (l, u; θ) = (u − l) +     {(l − θ)+ + (θ − u)+ },
                                                   α
where (a)+ = max(a, 0). Coverage, width and loss are distinct outputs. At α = 1/20 and
θ = 0, [−1, 1] has loss 2 and covers the truth; [1, 2] has loss 41 and misses it. The authored
validator rejects nonfinite endpoints or truth, invalid confidence levels, reversed endpoints,
boolean values masquerading as numbers, and nonfinite arithmetic after finite inputs. Two
finite large endpoints can overflow on subtraction. These fixtures are a proposed scientific
contract, not a calibration theorem or native conformance result.(Causal banking proposal
project, 2026fa)
   The retained CausalDS aggregator reports both uncapped and capped normalized interval-
loss means, with separate coverage and width summaries. We retain that distinction rather
than claiming the uncapped statistic is absent. Consider 100 stipulated losses for A: 99 zeros
and one loss of 1000. B has 100 losses of 1. The raw means are 10 and 1; capping each loss at
10 changes them to 0.1 and 1 and reverses the ranking. A capped mean is a different objective.
Neither a low capped score nor high coverage alone establishes useful bank precision or tail-risk
control.(causalNLP and andleb contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026fa)


20.31.4     A bounded public qualification program

The proposal can specify a concrete trial without expensive bank evidence. Freeze source,
dependency and task identities; construct independent causal oracles; retain separate identified,
nonidentified and oracle-unknown partitions. Include observationally identical IV worlds, zero
first stages, missing and nullable metadata, invalid responses, finite and nonfinite intervals,
arithmetic overflow and capped-loss ranking witnesses. Hold out structures and mechanisms
appropriate to the intended generalization claim. Record every submitted request, completed
attempt, refusal, invalid response, quarantined oracle and cost. Report conditional scientific
accuracy together with those denominators so exclusion of unknown tasks cannot silently
inflate apparent coverage.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026fa)
270                                                            Causal analysis for a universal bank


   Adoption remains conditional on matching the full native generator and scoring pipeline
to these fixtures, resolving per-item visible information, and reviewing exact artifact rights
and dependencies. The mathematical witnesses resolve whether these particular graph and
arithmetic pitfalls are possible. They do not close full benchmark qualification. Nor do
they supply a universal repair for unrestricted hidden-state identification: where admissible
models imply different decisions from identical observations, the proposed product must obtain
information, narrow assumptions or return the unresolved set.(Causal banking proposal project,
2026fa)


20.32      Linguistic measurement and executable interventions in
           banking
A language-assisted banking decision begins with an intervention that a bank can actually
implement. A complaint team may decide whether to rewrite an acknowledgement, request
clarification or escalate a case. An analyst may call the treatment politeness, yet this word
can denote the writer’s intention, the customer’s perception, a classifier score or a particular
editing procedure. These objects need not coincide. Their separation is necessary before an
agent translates the business question into a graph, proposes an adjustment set or calls an
estimator. A well-formed causal query about the wrong object remains the wrong business
answer.


20.32.1     Intent, perception, labels and actions

The inspected preprint of Pryzant et al. (2020) distinguishes writer intent T , reader perception
Te, a proxy label Tb and text W . Its first identification result assumes that W blocks the
relevant backdoor paths and that intent agrees with perception, T = Te. These are substantive
assumptions. A bank may intend reassurance while a distressed customer perceives evasion;
a classifier may score deferential wording highly even though the letter makes no useful
commitment. Neither a fluent explanation nor high predictive accuracy establishes agreement
between these variables.
   An operational treatment should identify an editing rule, the eligible message population, the
permissible information and the distribution of text versions produced by the rule. For example,
a rule might replace a discretionary closing paragraph with a fixed, reviewed clarification of the
next servicing step. It must specify whether facts, deadlines and promised remedies can change.
If these attributes vary together with tone, the resulting policy effect concerns the entire
rewriting procedure. Calling it an isolated effect of politeness requires further restrictions; the
proposed product should not silently impose them.
   The same distinction guides diagram construction. Pre-existing case severity can influence
both message selection and subsequent resolution. A customer response following the edited
message is downstream of that action, even if an agent can later extract it into a numerical
feature. Putting that response into a baseline adjustment set changes the question and can
invalidate identification. The assistant should retain a variable’s event time, observation time,
decision availability and semantic definition alongside its name. It can suggest candidate
arrows and competing explanations, while an explicit causal model states which claims are
assumed and what evidence could contradict them.
   The source’s linguistic formulation provides a conceptual foundation rather than a certificate
for an arbitrary embedding. Appendix A discusses the difficulty that a representation can
perfectly predict a proxy treatment, leaving no overlap for a within-representation comparison.
20.32. Linguistic measurement and executable interventions                                   271


Its consistency discussion assumes an outcome-sufficient component, appropriate support and
consistent regression. The preprint’s theorem and surrounding notation alternate perception
and proxy symbols; we retain its stated conditions without presenting a silently repaired
theorem. A compression method must justify both preservation of adjustment information and
usable treatment support. Reducing dimensionality alone proves neither.(Pryzant et al., 2020)


20.32.2     Why classifier accuracy is insufficient

Under the source’s assumptions, define the conditional error probabilities

                                ϵ0 (W ) = Pr(Te = 0 | Tb = 1, W ),                       (20.19)
                                ϵ1 (W ) = Pr(Te = 1 | Tb = 0, W ).                       (20.20)

Writing δ(W ) for the conditional perception contrast, its proxy expression has the form

                           ψ proxy = E[{1 − ϵ0 (W ) − ϵ1 (W )}δ(W )] .                   (20.21)

The accompanying discussion explicitly qualifies directional attenuation by a better-than-
chance classifier and a treatment-effect sign that is homogeneous across possible texts. This
qualification must survive translation into a product specification. An overall accuracy number
does not ensure that the factor multiplying the contrast is well behaved in each important
stratum, or that the underlying effects have a common sign.(Pryzant et al., 2020)
   A separate, fully stipulated measurement example makes the consequence concrete. Let
S ∈ {0, 1} denote two equally prevalent servicing populations. Within each population, let a
latent perception R be assigned with probability one half. Define potential monetary outcomes
by
                         Y (r) = 100 + δS r,    δ0 = 20, δ1 = −10,                     (20.22)
in USD per account. Generate an observed proxy Z by independently flipping R, conditional
on S, with probabilities q0 = 9/20 and q1 = 0. These are authored assumptions, not estimates
from complaints. The proxy is stochastic given the adjustment stratum; this is not the source’s
deterministic full-text proxy setting or an empirical replication of TextCause.
  The true average effect is (20 − 10)/2 = 5 dollars. Symmetry gives Pr(Z = 1 | S) = 1/2.
Bayes’ rule yields E[R | Z = 1, S = s] = 1 − qs and E[R | Z = 0, S = s] = qs . Consequently,

                   E[Y | Z = 1, S = s] − E[Y | Z = 0, S = s] = (1 − 2qs )δs .            (20.23)

The two proxy contrasts are 2 and −10 dollars, averaging −4 dollars. Overall classification
accuracy is
                             1              1            31
                             2 (1 − q0 ) + 2 (1 − q1 ) = 40 = 77.5%.                      (20.24)
Exact enumeration of all eight joint cells independently reproduces these conditional means and
the algebraic calculation. For a stipulated portfolio of 10,000 accounts, the true gross contrast
is USD 50,000 while the proxy comparison suggests minus USD 40,000, before implementation
costs.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026gs)
   This example violates the homogeneous-sign condition and therefore does not refute the
source’s conditional result. A high-accuracy semantic label may still give the wrong direction
for a heterogeneous business effect. Evaluation should examine conditional errors, effect
heterogeneity, population weighting and support rather than promote a single accuracy score
into causal assurance. If perception cannot be measured reliably, the product can report
sensitivity ranges or change the intervention to an observable, randomized editing policy. It
should not invent a validated perception variable.
272                                                                            Causal analysis for a universal bank


20.32.3     Public complaints as a prototype resource

The source supplies two distinct kinds of evaluation. Its Amazon setting constructs semi-
synthetic outcomes, permitting comparison within the stipulated outcome model. Its CFPB
application uses observational complaints and a fast-response indicator defined by a response
in fewer than 15 days. It matches complaints with opposite outcomes, selects 4,000 similar
pairs and retains the upper and lower quartiles of a politeness score, producing 4,000 se-
lected complaints. These choices define a selected study population, not the entire customer
population.(Pryzant et al., 2020)
  The reported effect estimates should not be relabelled as known causal truth. Matching on
outcomes and restricting to score extremes require an explicit account of selection and of the
population to which a result applies. An agent-generated summary must preserve those choices
rather than quote a favourable estimate as a verified benefit of adopting a rewriting service.
Generalization to unselected complaints, contemporary servicing and repeated interactions
requires additional justification.
   For a proposal-stage prototype, public or generated data can establish useful facts at much
lower cost than a bank experiment. A frozen public-data snapshot can exercise event-time
parsing, missing-text handling, semantic label provenance and the distinction between response
time and substantive resolution. A generated outcome construction can test whether an
estimator recovers an effect under an explicit assignment and measurement law. An observed
complaint archive provides realistic input structure, while a stipulated generator supplies
known potential outcomes only within its model. Neither supplies otherwise unobserved
counterfactual customer outcomes.
   A prospective comparison should freeze the unit, sample selection, source release, permitted
fields, intervention rule, estimator and all attempted requests before evaluating the candidate.
Customer, case and temporal overlap should be checked when defining training and evaluation
partitions. Prompts, retries, manual corrections, failed parses and excluded records contribute
to both the denominator and the cost. These are proposed design requirements, not claims
that an admitted runtime already satisfies them. A prototype can demonstrate the merit of a
later, narrower bank trial without claiming authentic bank validation.


20.32.4     From a one-message question to a longitudinal policy

Repeated servicing introduces feedback. Earlier messages affect later customer responses,
which influence subsequent messages and eventual outcomes. The retained CausalCollab work
studies sequences of human edits and language-model replies and an incremental stylistic
target. Its intervention definition, representations and generated evaluation design should be
compared with an executable bank editing policy, rather than treated as interchangeable with
a single-stage perception contrast.(Zhang et al., 2024a)
  For a separately specified finite-horizon policy, let Ht contain information available imme-
diately before decision t, At be the editing or escalation action and gt (a | Ht ) its prescribed
probability. Let Lt+1 contain the next observations. With a terminal monetary outcome Y , the
target is V (g) = E[Y g ]. Under consistency, sequential exchangeability, positivity for actions
used by g, and a correctly stated observation process, a finite discrete longitudinal g-formula is
                           X                            K
                                                        Y                     K−1
                                                                              Y
                 V (g) =           m(hK , aK ) p(l0 )         gt (at | ht )         p(lt+1 | ht , at ),    (20.25)
                           l̄,ā                        t=0                   t=0

where m(hK , aK ) = E[Y | HK = hK , AK = aK ] and histories are chronological. Continu-
ous variables require integration. This applies the longitudinal framework; it is not a new
20.32. Linguistic measurement and executable interventions                                     273


identification theorem for arbitrary language.(Hernán and Robins, 2020)
   The formula exposes the information the assistant must help specify. The action must
denote a procedure, not a classifier label that retrospectively describes a message. Each history
must contain the confounders claimed sufficient at that time; unobserved distress or operator
judgement cannot be removed merely by generating a diagram. A deterministic action outside
historical support invalidates positivity. Representation compression and estimated transition
models introduce further approximation and learning questions. The single-stage measurement
witness supplies no theorem resolving these longitudinal issues.
   The graph-building assistant can produce a reviewable intervention contract: decision times,
observable actions, eligible histories, competing graphs, proposed adjustment information,
support diagnostics and unresolved assumptions. A reviewer should be able to trace a request
to reduce avoidable repeat contact to a defined outcome and a contrast between implementable
policies. An unsupported direction, ambiguous treatment or unavailable history should remain
visible. This is more informative for prototype investment than a point estimate whose
interpretation changed during translation.


20.32.5     Adoption choices at the component boundary

Scientific relevance and executable reuse answer different questions. Three pinned implemen-
tations illustrate why component-specific decisions are necessary. The inspected LLM-CD
tree contains 2,899 entries and 2,745 files. Its nested BI-CaMML notice states redistribution
conditions for that component, while the complete pinned tree has no root notice. Require-
ments specify Gurobi and pygobnilp versions; compiled artifacts also require correspondence
to a reproducible source build. A nested notice and requirements file do not establish per-
mission or a complete installed environment for the whole pipeline. Direct reuse remains
deferred pending authoritative component terms, solver entitlement and artifact-to-source
provenance.(tyMadara, mas-takayama and kougioulis contributors, 2026)
  The inspected LLM-and-SCD snapshot has 15 entries and 12 files, without a root licence,
README or environment manifest in that tree. Notebook and data paths are discovery leads,
but do not establish execution order, full service identities or reproducibility against the paper.
The proposal can retain the scientific approach as a comparator while deferring direct reuse
until permissions, environment and source-to-result correspondence are available. A separately
specified implementation would need its own scope, evaluation and source review.(tyMadara,
mas-takayama and kougioulis contributors, 2026)
   LCM presents a different boundary. Its root code notice is Apache 2.0, while four named
pretrained-model links and three experiment-folder links point to external artifacts. Exact
model bytes, hashes, provenance and applicable terms have not been established by the
inspected code notice. Several dependency versions remain open, and vendored components
need their own inventory. The inspected loader sets weights_only=False and can return
None after missing-file or exceptional loads; a caller must distinguish those outcomes from
a valid model or a scientifically inconclusive result. An in-tree baseline checkpoint is not a
substitute for the advertised LCM weights. These are static source observations, not executed
failure rates or legal clearance.(tyMadara, mas-takayama and kougioulis contributors, 2026)
  For CLI and MCP integration, the proposed request should carry the target and intervention
contract, input schema and clock, selected model identity and artifact manifest. The response
should separate an unsupported scientific target, an unavailable artifact, an execution failure,
an inconclusive analysis and a successful result with declared assumptions. A fallback may be
proposed as an explicit new method choice; silently replacing the intended model changes the
comparison. A public fixture should test these branches and record all attempted requests
274                                                          Causal analysis for a universal bank


and costs. Where external artifacts remain unavailable, independent work on an authorized
estimator, public-data design or semantic contract can proceed. The proposed product must
preserve the distinction between a meaningful scientific question, a justified answer and an
executable method.


20.33      From business phrases to causal variables and defensible
           diagrams
A useful causal assistant must decide what the variables mean before it can reason about arrows.
In a servicing discussion, current borrower, delinquent borrower and financially distressed
borrower may denote values of different operational definitions, overlapping classifications or
measurements taken at different times. Automatically drawing one node for each phrase can
turn a vocabulary mistake into a scientific model. The first task is to propose a coherent
representation and preserve alternatives that cannot yet be resolved.


20.33.1    Two concrete language tasks

The inspected preprint of Razouk et al. (2024) evaluates two tasks directly relevant to this
problem. The first asks whether two textual entities represent different values of the same
variable, without supplying that variable’s name. The second asks whether an entity refers
simultaneously to values of several supplied variables. The source calls the second object an
interaction entity. These are useful semantic tasks, distinct from verifying a causal arrow,
identifying an effect or establishing an intervention’s feasibility.
   For a bank, consider whether payment within the grace period and payment after the grace
period are values of a common timing variable. The answer depends on the account, payment
obligation, time origin and grace-period definition. A phrase describing a mortgage customer
with a payment holiday combines product and servicing status. Detecting that combination
does not establish that these statuses interact in their causal effect on default. The assistant
should first return candidate variable definitions, value domains, unit identifiers, observation
clocks and textual evidence. A subsequent model specifies relationships among those variables.
  A proposed representation can be written as

                Vj = (unit, quantity, domain, time, measurement, availability),          (20.26)

where a phrase may map to a value, a predicate on a domain or an unresolved collection of
variables. This is a product design convention, not a theorem that language has a unique
causal decomposition. A high-risk label can denote a score category, a decision-maker’s belief
or an unobserved propensity. Treating them as interchangeable can make a score’s prediction
appear to be an intervention on underlying risk.
   Pairwise language answers also need consistency review. Suppose an assistant groups phrase
e0 with e1 , groups e1 with e2 , and rejects grouping e0 with e2 . Those answers cannot all
define an equivalence relation for a single partition. The proposed product should expose
the conflicting triangle and relevant definitions. Taking the transitive closure silently can
merge incompatible variables, while deleting one pair without a reason hides the conflict.
Multiple candidate representations are preferable when the language remains ambiguous. The
independent finite reference reproduces the contradiction.(Causal banking proposal project,
2026gn)
20.33. From business phrases to causal variables                                               275


20.33.2     What the evaluation actually establishes

The source uses a within-subjects design in which seven named language models generate
examples and evaluate examples from themselves and other models. It sets temperature to
zero and uses the same English prompts. Its domain tables contain eight domains, including
finance. Task 1 uses 560 positive and 560 negative examples; Task 2 uses 559 positive and 560
negative examples. These are reported evaluation denominators, not independently audited
bank expert labels.(Razouk et al., 2024)
   The results illustrate why a single model ranking is insufficient. In the source’s Task 1
table, GPT-4-turbo has reported precision 97%, recall 41% and kappa 40%; rankings differ for
the second task. These historical labels and reported numbers describe that generated-data
evaluation. They are not a recommendation for a current provider, a service guarantee or
evidence that 97% of suggested banking variables are correct. High precision with low recall
can leave important distinctions unresolved. The cost of an omitted variable may differ greatly
from that of a false proposed merge.(Razouk et al., 2024)
   The paper explicitly states that its numbers derive from generated data and need comparison
with domain-specific expertise. Agreement with generation-derived labels can reward shared
conventions or mistakes. Cross-model evaluation broadens the comparison but does not
produce independently established causal truth. Temperature zero supplies neither calibrated
uncertainty nor an immutable service implementation. Domain dependence is a reason to
stratify later assessment by banking journey, variable type, language and ambiguity rather
than transport an overall score to every workflow.
   A proposal-stage evaluation can retain inexpensive generated fixtures alongside a small,
independently adjudicated public set. Generated fixtures make intended variable/value rela-
tionships explicit and support controlled perturbations. Public documents provide realistic
ambiguity, missing definitions and conflicting timestamps. Their reference labels need docu-
mented provenance; disagreement should be preserved instead of resolved by asking the same
model to grade itself. The output includes an unresolved option, with performance reported
separately for accepted, rejected and deferred cases. Coverage, incorrect merges and splits,
unsupported certainty, human review effort and full workflow cost all matter.


20.33.3     A compound phrase does not establish causal interaction

Let A denote offering a payment holiday and B an outreach action. A phrase mentioning both
actions does not determine their additive interaction in a monetary outcome. That requires a
four-regime contrast,

                     I = E[Y (1, 1)] − E[Y (1, 0)] − E[Y (0, 1)] + E[Y (0, 0)].            (20.27)

In an authored example, set Y (a, b) = 100 + 10a + 20b dollars per account. The outcomes are
100, 110, 120 and 130, giving I = 0 despite the compound phrase. Changing the stipulated
law to 100 + 10a + 20b + 5ab changes the joint cell to 135 and gives I = 5 dollars. Exact
enumeration checks both contrasts. This is a scale-specific potential-outcome calculation, not
measured servicing interaction.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026gn)
   A deterministic compound node C = AB may be convenient, but the analyst must state
what an intervention on C means. Setting C = 1 without specifying A and B, or changing C
while holding its defining parents fixed, need not describe a feasible action. Multiple versions of
a compound label can have different consequences. The assistant should require an intervention
definition rather than infer it from a noun phrase.
  The source invokes causal transitivity as motivation. That terminology should not become
276                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


a numerical rule that every directed path has a nonzero total effect. Let U be uniform on
{0, 1, 2, 3}, define B = 1{U < 1 + 2A} and set Y = 100 + 20B − 10A. The model has
an A → B → Y path and a direct A → Y path. Under interventions on A, the mediator
probability changes from 1/4 to 3/4. This produces a mediated mean change of USD 10 and a
direct change of minus USD 10. Both intervention means are USD 105: the total mean effect
is zero through cancellation, although both mechanisms are present.(Causal banking proposal
project, 2026gn)
   This finite example distinguishes graph structure, mechanisms and a numerical contrast; it
does not assert that the source’s experiment is invalid. The proposed validator should check
stated graph semantics, temporal order and intervention definitions, rather than impose a
blanket effect-magnitude rule. Statistical dependence also cannot by itself endorse a causal
arrow. A graph, an observation law and an estimand serve different purposes.


20.33.4     An integration contract for semantic proposals

The proposed CLI or MCP interface can expose variable construction as a reviewable artifact.
Each variable should carry its source span, value domain, population, event clock, availability
clock, measurement rule and possible action semantics. A mapping can be accepted, disputed
or unresolved. Relations should distinguish source assertions, model-generated hypotheses,
statistical associations and approved modeling assumptions. A syntactically valid DAG must
not erase these distinctions.
  The retained source links to an anonymous code-and-data repository. The link is an
acquisition lead; it does not establish a pinned release, licence, model service identity or
executable package in this workspace. Direct runtime adoption is deferred. The tasks remain
useful leads for an independently specified prototype. Original prompts and reference labels are
separate artifacts whose rights and provenance require review. A prototype using separately
authorized fixtures can test representation quality without claiming to reproduce the source’s
runtime.
   Before estimation, the assistant should present competing variable definitions, an intervention
and outcome, unresolved timing or measurement issues, and the assumptions needed to compare
selected policies. The business owner can then see what information is missing and why it
matters. The result is a traceable scientific specification whose ambiguity remains visible,
rather than a diagram that merely looks complete.


20.34      Causal tasks and representation interventions: what the
           evidence actually supports
A causal assistant must preserve the distinction between answering a causal question and
changing a language model. The distinction is practical for a bank. An assistant might
extract covariates from a scanned credit file, propose a graph for a servicing decision, identify
an admissible adjustment set, or estimate the effect of a payment reminder. Better image
descriptions can improve the first step without establishing the assumptions needed by the
last three. Conversely, a correct identification formula cannot repair an incorrectly extracted
treatment date. Each part needs its own target, observation contract, evidence and failure
state.
20.34. Causal tasks and representation interventions                                          277


20.34.1     A task taxonomy that retains the information supplied

Ma’s selected September 2024 survey separates pairwise and full-graph discovery, effect
estimation, attribution, counterfactual reasoning and explanation. It discusses prompting, fine-
tuning, combinations with conventional causal algorithms, and knowledge or tool augmentation.
This is useful as a taxonomy, rather than a new common benchmark. The survey explicitly
notes that the evaluations collected in its comparison tables can use different prompts and
settings; its dataset table also distinguishes pairs, relations, samples and questions as units. A
percentage attached to one of these units must not silently become a percentage of successfully
completed banking analyses.(Ma, 2024)
   Consider a hypothetical collections analyst asking whether a reminder reduces thirty-day
arrears. A pairwise query about reminders and arrears may recover familiar domain associations.
A graph task also needs eligibility, prior delinquency, contactability, exposure opportunities
and the decision clock. An effect task needs an intervention policy and a population; a
counterfactual question about one borrower requires more than the marginal average effect.
These are different scientific requests even if the interface presents each as a sentence. The
proposed compiler should retain the supplied graph, assumptions, empirical information and
requested quantity as separate fields. A model that receives the correct graph and potential-
outcome table has solved a different problem from one asked to infer both from administrative
records.
   The survey’s discussion identifies prompt sensitivity, memorized knowledge, inconsistent
answers and scenario-dependent rankings; it does not establish a universally best model. Its
discussion of high-dimensional text also flags support problems. For a longitudinal bank
example, encoding all earlier messages does not by itself create treatment overlap at each
history, nor establish that every common cause was recorded before the action. Such omissions
should produce a restricted answer, an identified set or a refusal under the library’s existing
contracts. Additional prose from an agent does not supply the missing observation law.(Ma,
2024)
   For public prototype evaluation, separate three modes: supplied-structure symbolic queries
with known answers; discovery under a declared generative model; and interpretation of
genuinely observed documents with independently checked labels. Keep the data-generating
mechanism and test answers outside the evaluated agent’s context. Record rejected, unidentified,
timed-out and malformed requests in the denominator. A public corpus can test extraction
and workflow usability, while generated outcomes test a stipulated causal target. Neither alone
validates a bank’s assignment mechanism. This is a proposed evaluation design, not a claim
that all these tests have been executed.


20.34.2     Causality used inside a multimodal model

Hu and colleagues’ Causal-LLaVA preprint addresses object hallucination. It adds a projector
module and a module in the language model’s final transformer block, using visual and
textual dictionaries formed from category-averaged representations of 5,000 instruction samples.
Their proposed graph and approximate adjustment motivate the architecture; the reported
experiments evaluate image-language behavior. They do not evaluate identification of a
servicing or lending effect. The inspected version reports training on eight H20 GPUs and
an additional dictionary-estimation cost of approximately one hour. These are the authors’
experimental conditions, not a measured cost for this proposal.(Hu et al., 2025)
  The source’s tables support a qualified empirical comparison. Its LLaMA-2-7B comparison
reports CHAIR sentence hallucination 33.0 versus 30.9 and recall 65.6 versus 65.9; these are
278                                                             Causal analysis for a universal bank


distinct metrics. It also reports small regressions in particular general-comprehension entries:
the 13B ScienceQA entry changes from 65.1 to 65.0, and the Vicuna-v1.5-7B VizWiz entry
from 50.1 to 49.5. The blanket reading that every score improves is therefore unwarranted.
The table does not by itself establish significance, cross-bank transfer or an end-to-end error
rate. The source’s limitations mention computing demands and confounder sensitivity across
environments and datasets.(Hu et al., 2025)


20.34.3     Three mathematical distinctions behind the architecture

Under an appropriate adjustment set and the usual identification conditions, the target is an
arithmetic mixture                         X
                            p(y | do(x)) =    p(y | x, z)p(z).
                                                 z

Its weighting distribution is the target marginal, not automatically uniform. A uniform
weighting is an additional target choice. Nor does the formula license replacing the marginal
with input-dependent attention weights without proving that the result retains the same
intervention meaning. The Causal-LLaVA appendix explicitly conditions dictionary weights
on hidden states to preserve representational capacity. That may be a useful predictive
architecture, but predictive usefulness and identification of the displayed intervention target
require separate arguments.(Hu et al., 2025; Pearl, 2009)
   The normalized weighted geometric mean is likewise distinct from the arithmetic mixture.
Let the two conditional event probabilities be 1/10 and 9/10, with target weights 3/4, 1/4. The
arithmetic probability is 3/10. For a binary softmax representation, the corresponding logits are
− log 9, log 9; their weighted mean is − 21 log 9 = − log 3, whose logistic probability is 1/4. Thus
even a linear logit map does not make the arithmetic mixture equal to the normalized geometric
approximation. The difference is 1/20, or five percentage points. This finite construction tests
a mathematical equality, not the authors’ observed benchmark performance.(Causal banking
proposal project, 2026gr)
   The same stipulated event law illustrates the importance of weights. Uniform weights give
1/2; input-conditioned weight 4/5 on the high-risk category gives 37/50. If the event incurs a
stipulated USD 1,000 loss, the four calculations produce expected losses of USD 300, 250, 500
and 740, respectively. These amounts are exact consequences of the example’s assumptions.
They are not bank forecasts, a superiority result, or evidence that a particular implementation
actually uses these example weights.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026gr)
  A second distinction concerns joint confounders. In general, marginalizing visual and textual
confounders requires their joint law, conditional or interventional as appropriate. Replacing that
law by a product of marginals requires an independence condition. If two Bernoulli variables
are identical and each is one with probability 1/2, their joint-one probability is 1/2, whereas
multiplying the marginals gives 1/4. Equation (4) in the inspected source uses a product of
conditional marginals. The proposed product should require the corresponding independence
premise or preserve the joint distribution; the example establishes the consequence of omitting
that premise, not a measured failure of the trained network. Freezing an encoder also does
not by itself prove that contextual common causes disappear from its representations. That
causal claim needs a model of the data and the frozen transformation.(Hu et al., 2025; Causal
banking proposal project, 2026gr)
20.35. Structured outputs and scientific admission                                          279


20.34.4     A bounded adoption decision and interface consequence

The appropriate proposal disposition is to retain the architecture as a candidate measurement
component and defer direct adoption pending exact artifact, weight, data and dependency
rights and a reproducible matched evaluation. The source provides a repository lead; this review
has not pinned or executed that repository. A low-cost first prototype should compare against
the existing extractor on a public or generated document set with separately adjudicated object
labels, then assess how extraction errors propagate into a fixed causal query. A successful
vision score is neither an effect-identification certificate nor a substitute for an uncertainty
calculation.
   CLI and MCP requests should therefore distinguish measurement improvement, model-
mechanism intervention and a real-world policy intervention. Return the target population,
dictionary construction, weighting rule, approximation status, graph assumptions and un-
available artifacts explicitly. Report a source-derived method as source-derived, a proposed
adapter as proposed, and an executed test with its exact code and data identities. For the
banking analyst, the useful output is an auditable answer whose scientific target survives every
translation and approximation.


20.35      Structured outputs, response states and scientific admis-
           sion
A structured banking answer must preserve both the scientific target and the state of the
computation. Suppose a collections analyst requests the effect of a reminder on thirty-day
arrears. A response can have the required fields and a well-formed number while using a
post-treatment variable, an unjustified graph, or a different treatment population. It can also
be a syntactically valid fragment of an unfinished request. The proposed library therefore
needs separate tests for completion, representation and causal admission. This distinction
determines how a provider client can be reused without attributing scientific guarantees to it.


20.35.1     What the pinned official sources establish

The selected official OpenAI cookbook demonstrates a strict JSON-schema response format,
required fields, closed object properties and a Pydantic parsing helper. Its worked examples are
useful interface illustrations, not measurements of this proposal. The same notebook explicitly
describes a refusal field because a refused request need not follow the supplied answer schema.
Its opening description of constrained outputs must therefore be read together with this
exception. Schema adherence concerns representation; it does not assert that an adjustment
set is scientifically admissible or that a reported effect is identified.(OpenAI contributors,
2026a)
   The selected Python SDK source has version 3.26.0 and declares Python 3.10 or later. Its
parsing helper converts a Pydantic model to a schema and parses eligible content into that
model. In the inspected Chat Completions path, a length stop raises a dedicated error, as
does a content-filter stop. Refusal content is not parsed as an ordinary answer. Automatic
tool-argument parsing requires a strict function-tool contract. These are source-level client
rules at the selected revision, rather than a claim that every compatible server or model honors
them. The cookbook and SDK are pinned separately; their example calling surfaces must not
be silently combined into one version-independent executable recipe.(OpenAI contributors,
2026b,a)
280                                                          Causal analysis for a universal bank


   The Responses parsing path also makes the message phase significant. At this revision, final-
answer text and legacy messages without a phase are eligible for parsing; other explicit phases
retain their text with no parsed result. The helper documentation warns that concatenated
output text can include commentary, while the parsed output selects a structured result. An
adapter should retain the entire typed output sequence and the response status, not search
arbitrary text for a schema-shaped substring and promote it to the final answer. A declared
incomplete state remains incomplete even if part of its output can be decoded.(OpenAI
contributors, 2026b)
  For the banking request, a useful envelope contains the provider response identifier, endpoint
and selected model identifier; status and native stop reason; refusal or incomplete details; the
parsed payload, if any; tool-call identities and pending results; and the target, assumptions
and scientific disposition. These fields are proposed product requirements. A provider refusal,
a malformed object and a correctly identified failure of identification have different meanings.
The analyst should be able to tell which information is missing and which action, if any, could
change the result.


20.35.2    An admission rule that cannot be satisfied by JSON alone

Let C denote completed output, J successful representation validation and I admission of
the requested causal effect under its declared information and assumptions. A proposed
effect-admission predicate is
                                      A = C ∧ J ∧ I.
This is a software decision rule, not a theorem that the assumptions are true. It makes
the owner of each judgment visible. A source parser can help establish J, transport and
response-state handling contribute to C, and the causal library must justify I. The operator
and eventual bank reviewer still own the truth of substantive inputs. An unidentified effect
may legitimately produce a completed, well-formed scientific answer whose disposition is
nonidentification; it must not produce an admitted scalar effect by default.
   An exact authored four-case witness admits only the complete, schema-valid, identified case.
A complete but unidentified case retains its nonidentification result; an incomplete case with a
valid prefix remains pending; a refusal stays a refusal. These cases are finite constructions
used to specify the interface, not observations of OpenAI behavior or a measured refusal rate.
In particular, treating all valid objects as completed causal answers would merge scientifically
different outcomes.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026gu)


20.35.3    Retry layers and the cost of one business request

The pinned SDK documentation describes two retries by default for selected connection
and HTTP failures, subject to a resendable body, and a configurable request timeout. The
implementation distinguishes status classes, server retry hints and backoff. A workflow can
add another retry loop around this client. Consequently, neither the number of logical banking
requests nor one configured timeout determines the full attempt count or end-to-end latency.
A retry may also leave uncertainty about a remote effect; successful parsing alone cannot
provide exactly-once execution of a business action.(OpenAI contributors, 2026b)
   Consider a stipulated workflow with at most two outer attempts and three HTTP attempts
within each. Its maximum is six HTTP attempts, not the sum of the two limits. At a stipulated
USD 0.25 per attempt, the corresponding cost is USD 1.50. If each attempt takes four seconds,
inner waits are one and two seconds in each outer attempt, and the outer wait is three seconds,
the specified path takes 24 + 6 + 3 = 33 seconds. These values are exact bookkeeping under
20.36. Framework delegates and scientific completion                                             281


the stated assumptions, not vendor prices or a measured service guarantee.(Causal banking
proposal project, 2026gu)
   The proposed admission layer should reserve a workflow-wide attempt and cost budget
before issuing calls, debit actual attempts, retain response identifiers and unknown outcomes,
and distinguish cancellation requested from cancellation observed. Public prototype tests
should include an error after remote work may have begun, an incomplete stream, a refusal,
invalid tool arguments and a timeout during a tool result. The complete denominator includes
these cases. Financial value remains a separate assessment of decision quality and full workflow
costs; cheap valid JSON is not a monetary benefit by definition.


20.35.4     Comparison and a bounded reuse choice

The existing comparison treats Anthropic and Google client contracts, Ollama request and
stream behavior, and the parser, template and generation settings of vLLM and llama.cpp
separately. The newly inspected OpenAI originals add a sixth named provider/client family
with explicit parsing, refusal, phase and retry rules. Across these profiles, one adapter
should preserve native status and error information before mapping it into the common
scientific envelope. Compatibility in endpoint spelling cannot prove equivalence in parsing,
model behavior, cancellation or cost.(anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python contributors, 2026;
googleapis/python-genai contributors, 2026; ollama/ollama-python contributors, 2026; vllm-
project/vllm contributors, 2026; ggml-org/llama.cpp contributors, 2026; OpenAI contributors,
2026b)
  The bounded proposal choice is conditional adoption of the original client behind a thin,
versioned adapter, rather than a wholesale port. The inspected SDK and cookbook carry
Apache 2.0 and MIT notices respectively; these notices concern those source artifacts. They
do not establish service entitlement, model-weight rights, data permissions or approved bank
deployment. An implementation decision still requires the exact endpoint, model, dependencies,
configured retry policy and applicable service terms. The official live guide access failure also
remains an omission; the recovered repository originals establish their own narrower contracts.
No downloaded code or live model was executed in this review.(OpenAI contributors, 2026b,a)
   CLI and MCP should expose the same typed outcome, including nonidentification, scientific
rejection, refusal, incomplete output and transport uncertainty. Framework scheduling must
consume this outcome rather than infer success from text presence. This supplies a concrete
route for a low-cost public prototype: freeze the client and adapter identities, register adversarial
response-state fixtures, verify the scientific envelope against independent answers, and only
then compare live backends under a declared budget. The source comparison reduces an
architectural uncertainty while leaving native performance, service terms and bank effectiveness
open. The banking decision remains admissible only when its scientific meaning survives the
complete request lifecycle.


20.36       Framework delegates, schema conversion and scientific
            completion
A causal workflow can finish its control flow without producing an admissible causal answer.
For a collections analyst, the distinction is practical. A reminder-policy analysis may return
an object after its structured-output step failed, repeat a tool after an interrupted response,
or accept a treatment identifier under a weakened constraint. Each event changes what the
analyst can infer from the result. A framework comparison must therefore follow the delegated
282                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


implementation of validation, stopping, retry and recovery, rather than infer these properties
from a common API. The following comparison concerns selected, pinned original source
paths. It motivates product contracts and public qualification experiments; it does not report
executed vendor integrations.


20.36.1     Validation must survive the complete calling path

LangChain’s inspected tool base distinguishes a dictionary schema from a Pydantic model.
In the dictionary branch of the input parser, the supplied input is returned; the Pydantic
branch invokes model validation and handles an injected tool-call identifier. This local branch
difference does not prove that no other layer validates a dictionary-schema request. It does
show why the proposed adapter cannot treat the presence of a schema as evidence that
validation occurred at every entry point. The same source can convert a handled validation
or tool exception into an error-status tool message. The consumer must preserve that status
even when the returned content is readable text. (langchain project contributors, 2026b)
   DSPy’s inspected tool helper iterates over provided arguments, conditionally validates a field
against its schema when a qualifying type is present, then uses typed parsing for applicable
arguments. Its synchronous and asynchronous call paths also differ in coroutine handling.
Google GenAI’s function-declaration helper builds a schema from a callable signature and
type information, including required fields and definitions; an inspected Vertex conversion
branch supplies an object type for an otherwise untyped union. These are useful mechanisms
for translating interfaces. They do not establish that a variable precedes treatment, that a
graph encodes the business question, or that omitted information is scientifically harmless.
Conditional adoption should retain the original helper while placing a common causal-request
validator at the library boundary. (dspy project contributors, 2026b; google project contributors,
2026)
   Consider a request whose treatment identifier must contain a digit. Within the stipulated
domain D = {x, 7}, the intended accepted set is S = {7}. If a conversion relaxes the restriction
to any string, the accepted set becomes Se = D, so S ⊊ S.
                                                        e The extra value is a false admission
under the original contract. This finite authored witness establishes the logical consequence of
weakening; it is not an observed generation or a measured package failure.(Causal banking

   The distinction matters for llama.cpp’s inspected schema-to-grammar converter. An unsup-

an invalid pattern is recorded as an error. The converter subsequently raises recorded errors
