immediate deviations (1, 1/2)T . The next two liquidity responses are 3/4 and 5/8. Since both
eigenvalues of Φ1 are 1/2, the infinite-horizon sum is

                                  (I − Φ1 )−1 (1, 1/2)T = (2, 3)T .

If each liquidity unit is valued at a stipulated USD 100 and the one-time action costs USD
60, the immediate net is minus USD 10 whereas the undiscounted cumulative net is USD
240. These are conditional arithmetic examples. They do not estimate a bank return, and
changing the action to a sustained rate policy, adding discounting, or allowing feedback into the
decision rule changes the target. A reusable interface must therefore distinguish an innovation,
an equation replacement and a sustained policy, and retain the horizon and units. (Causal
banking proposal, 2026al)
   Sampling frequency is equally substantive. Consider two stationary Gaussian processes
Xt = ρXt−1 + ϵt , with independent innovations of variance 3/4 and ρ equal to either 1/2 or
−1/2. Both have marginal variance one. If the bank retains only every second day, both
satisfy an observed autoregression with coefficient 1/4 and innovation variance 15/16. Their
complete stationary observed laws agree, but their one-day impulse responses have opposite
638                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


signs. Recovering the original day-level response is therefore impossible from this coarsened
law alone within this two-world comparison. A daily timestamp declaration cannot repair
information that was discarded; the response must retain the observation frequency and the
unresolved finer-clock target. (Causal banking proposal, 2026al)


31.27.2     Tigramite: three distinct questions behind one ecosystem

Tigramite offers a useful primary family of proposed adapters because its documented graph
classes distinguish PCMCI, PCMCI+, LPCMCI, RPCMCI and J-PCMCI+. PCMCI+ com-
bines lagged and contemporaneous search under causal stationarity and sufficiency, while
LPCMCI retains the partial ancestral graph needed when latent confounding is admitted.
Neither endpoint ambiguity nor the restrictions of the chosen conditional-independence test
should disappear in a common wrapper. Earlier selected installed operations are separate evi-
dence from this static extension review. (Runge, 2020; Gerhardus and Runge, 2020; tigramite
contributors, 2026; jakobrunge/tigramite contributors, 2026)
   J-PCMCI+ addresses multiple datasets with system variables and temporal or spatial
contexts. Its primary paper requires a joint acyclic structural model, context exogeneity,
restrictions excluding context–system confounding, complete observation of system nodes, and
a particular context-determinism construction. A temporal context is shared across datasets; a
spatial context is constant within a dataset. This offers a route for common funding calendars
and bank-specific characteristics, but does not license arbitrary unobserved common causes.
Coding a bank identifier or calendar as a context is a scientific assertion about the model.
(Günther et al., 2023)
   The inspected implementation makes those assertions operational: it accepts five node classes,
orients context-to-system links as exogenous, and removes specified reverse and dummy links.
A generic graph adapter must preserve the effective constraints after these transformations,
the pooled datasets, time offsets, masks and conditioning choices. Before enabling this
candidate, generated comparisons should separately vary shared-calendar dependence, bank-
specific fixed contexts and hidden system-to-system confounding. The last case deliberately
violates this J-PCMCI+ model and should not be used to award it a latent-variable guarantee.
The raw conditional-test results and final endpoint graph should remain distinguishable.
(jakobrunge/tigramite contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal, 2026ak)
   RPCMCI answers a different question: it alternates regime learning and causal search
under a finite persistent regime structure, with stationarity within regimes. Its paper initially
develops lagged structural relations with independent stationary innovations. A recovered
regime can describe different behaviour without representing a randomized or externally
assigned intervention. In the inspected constructor, only one multivariate series with scalar
rather than vector-valued nodes is accepted and a supplied mask is replaced by an all-false
mask; missing values have a separate flag. The adapter must either reject an unsupported user
mask or require an explicit, reviewed transformation before calling this path. It must retain
the regime count, transition limit, annealing settings and convergence information. Regime
membership should not be exported as an observed experiment label. (Saggioro et al., 2020;
jakobrunge/tigramite contributors, 2026)
   Tigramite’s preserved root terms specify GPLv3 and its README declares version 3 or later.
That is useful source evidence for a reuse decision, but a process boundary or command-line
interface is not, by itself, a completed distribution-rights analysis. The proposal should compare
a versioned adapter with the cost of independently maintaining a port and qualifying its
numerical equivalence. The immediate recommendation is separate, explicitly scoped adapters
for the different temporal methods. (jakobrunge/tigramite contributors, 2026; Causal banking
31.27. Python discovery across clocks, contexts and interventions                             639


proposal, 2026ak)


31.27.3     CausalAI, VARLiNGAM and DYNOTEARS as contrasting base-
            lines

Salesforce CausalAI’s inspected PC and Granger paths enumerate candidate parents at strictly
negative lags. Its VARLiNGAM wrapper separately exposes lag-zero coefficients, preserving
the dependency’s target-row convention. The time-series data helper forms lagged observations
inside each supplied array and then concatenates those slices, which avoids simply linking
the last row of one array to the first of another. However, the selected interface has no
physical timestamp argument: a missing business day and a regular one-step transition can
look identical after the caller has formed the arrays. Its optional complete-case deletion also
does not establish an ignorable missingness law. (salesforce/causalai contributors, 2025)
  The uncertainty interface deserves particular caution. The inspected Granger routine fits
LassoCV coefficients and then evaluates a t-tail expression using a residual sum of squares
and inverse design cross-product. The source does not establish the additional justification
needed after selection and under dependent observations. When the cross-product is rank-
deficient, that routine substitutes a vector of p-values equal to one; the VARLiNGAM wrapper
has a similar branch. An operational refusal is then numerically indistinguishable from a
valid large p-value if the wrapper discards the diagnostic. The proposal should preserve a
separate uncertainty unavailable status, effective sample/design rank and the selected model.
A successful coefficient fit is insufficient evidence for a calibrated interval or a causal graph.
These are static-source findings, with no claimed runtime failure frequency. (salesforce/causalai
contributors, 2025)
   The inherited direct LiNGAM inspection provides a clearer starting point for a declared
linear non-Gaussian structural model: fit the lag process, discover contemporaneous structure in
its residuals, and preserve B[target, predictor]. Its residual bootstrap reconstructs a sequence,
unlike the generic row bootstrap, but the inspected bootstrap loop fixes the lag-selection
criterion to None. Consequently its existence does not establish uncertainty including lag-order
selection. Before an adapter is enabled, the proposed generated study must include Gaussian
innovations, hidden common causes and persistent residuals as explicit scope violations,
alongside the eligible non-Gaussian innovation cases. (LiNGAM project, 2026a; cdt15/lingam,
2026; Causal banking proposal, 2026ak)
   DYNOTEARS supplies a simultaneous optimization comparator. The inspected CausalNex
path minimizes a penalized residual loss based on X(I − W ) − Xlags A and constrains the
within-slice matrix W to be acyclic. Its dataframe transformer checks numeric columns and
sorted integer indices, splits gaps larger than one, and constructs lags separately for each
resulting realisation. This is more specific than assuming that every row is adjacent. It still
admits a nondecreasing sequence with duplicate indices: the authored sequence (1, 2, 2, 3, 6, 7)
creates two segments and four retained one-lag pairs, only three of which have a strictly positive
unit step. The proposed adapter must reject duplicates, define the calendar and record every
exclusion. It should also preserve raw weights, threshold choices and optimization diagnostics.
(mckinsey/causalnex contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal, 2026al; Pamfil et al., 2020)
   The inherited maintenance review records CausalNex’s discontinuation notice. That supports
retaining DYNOTEARS as a methodological and conversion reference, while deferring default
dependency adoption. A port would require an explicit maintenance owner and equivalence
tests; it is not a free substitute for a maintained upstream package. CausalAI’s inspected
BSD terms and LiNGAM’s inspected MIT terms likewise do not certify their entire resolved
dependency environments. (mckinsey/causalnex, 2026b; salesforce/causalai contributors, 2025;
640                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


cdt15/lingam, 2026; Causal banking proposal, 2026ak)


31.27.4    Intervention data need a mechanism contract

An intervention label must include the target set, mechanism type and assignment context.
To see why, let H, U, W be independent standard normal innovations, define A = H + U ,
Y = 2A + H + W , and observe (H, A, Y ). A perfect stochastic intervention replaces the action
equation with A = δ + Z, where Z ∼ N (0, 2) is independent of the other innovations. A soft
intervention instead sets A = H + U + δ. In both cases E(A) = δ, var(A) = 2, and E(Y ) = 2δ.
Nevertheless, cov(H, A) is zero under replacement and one under the soft change; cov(A, Y ) is
respectively four and five. The action margin and its label alone cannot tell the library which
graph truncation is justified. If H is hidden, the same example additionally violates a causally
sufficient observed-variable model. (Causal banking proposal, 2026al)
   Python GIES is a useful known-perfect-intervention baseline. The original paper defines
stochastic interventions by replacing targeted mechanisms and requires a conservative target
family: every variable remains unintervened in at least one environment. Observational data
satisfy this particular requirement, although they do not supply all other assumptions. The
paper’s interventional equivalence theory concerns graph classes under the stated intervention
family. Independent observations from several environments are not automatically the same
sampling model as repeatedly observed banks on a shared calendar. (Hauser and Bühlmann,
2012)
   The inspected Python Gaussian score centres data within each environment, forms co-
variances from observations in which the target variable was not intervened on, and checks
conservative target coverage. Its output is an estimated I-essential graph: reciprocal nonzero
matrix entries denote an undirected edge, not a two-cycle. A proposed adapter should validate
unique target indices, dataset/target alignment, environment sizes and the effective score before
preserving these endpoints. It should refuse to present the score as an effect or confidence
interval. This candidate is attractive for a transparent generated perfect-intervention compari-
son; soft targets and dependent panels need their own justified treatment. (juangamella/gies
contributors, 2025; Causal banking proposal, 2026ak)
   Unknown-target IGSP offers another route when intervention targets are partially known.
Its primary paper requires observational data and an I-faithfulness condition relating invariance
to separation; its theorem identifies an interventional equivalence class and targets under those
conditions. The algorithm needs both a conditional-independence tester and a conditional-
invariance tester. An unknown target is therefore not recovered merely by dropping a target
column from a known-target method. (Squires et al., 2020)
   The pinned CausalDAG facade reexports external graph and learning packages, while its
older tutorial points to an implementation path absent from the selected tree. The recovered
graphical-model-learning implementation defaults to depth four, five starts, and tuple scoring.
Its default score orders edge count and variant count lexicographically, whereas the inspected
paper defines their sum. The distinction can matter: candidate counts (3, 5) and (4, 0) are
ordered in opposite ways by these rules. This arithmetic example does not claim those
two candidates are reachable in a particular search. It identifies a precise theory-to-code
question that must be resolved before transferring the theorem to a wrapper’s default. A
public prototype should pin all three facade dependencies, retain score mode and search
restrictions, and compare oracle-level and finite-test behaviour separately. (uhlerlab/causaldag
contributors, 2022; uhlerlab/graphical_model_learning contributors, 2022; Squires et al., 2020;
Causal banking proposal, 2026al)
31.27. Python discovery across clocks, contexts and interventions                             641


31.27.5     Differentiable discovery: optimization and evidence remain separate

DCDI’s primary score theorem concerns a global population optimum with a sufficient density
class, positivity, finite entropy and I-faithfulness. Its finite nonconvex optimization is not
guaranteed to attain that optimum. The inspected constructor implements perfect interven-
tions with known or unknown targets and imperfect interventions with known targets; the
combination of imperfect interventions and unknown targets explicitly raises an unimplemented
error. Known perfect targets are removed from the mechanism likelihood using a retention
mask, while the other implemented branches use regime-specific parameters. These distinctions
should be visible service variants, with the original masks, regime identities and optimizer
diagnostics returned in the evidence bundle. They should not be compressed into one boolean
intervention option. (Brouillard et al., 2020; slachapelle/dcdi contributors, 2022)
   ENCO provides a contrasting parameterization of edge existence and orientation. Its
documented array format indexes intervention samples by the single targeted variable. The
inspected gradient path suppresses incoming-edge updates at that variable and treats orientation
updates separately. The primary theorem and supporting argument require informative
interventions, sufficiently accurate conditional models, suitable regularization and the stated
data conditions. The paper itself distinguishes the extension to fewer intervention targets, for
which the same convergence guarantee is unavailable. A comparison should report actual target
coverage and cycle handling instead of treating the method’s title or learned edge probabilities
as a finite-sample confidence guarantee. (phlippe/ENCO contributors, 2022; Lippe et al., 2022)
  SDCD is worth considering for numerical stability and its two-stage structure. The primary
paper’s stability result concerns the acyclicity constraint; its first-stage screening argument
uses exact population optimization and explicit model, faithfulness and positivity conditions.
Neither result establishes that every finite training run retains every true parent. The inspected
output helper sorts weighted edges and omits those that would form cycles. A caller receiving
only that DAG loses the distinction between a learned low-weight edge and an edge removed to
impose acyclicity. The proposal should return raw adjacency, the retained graph, the threshold
and a record of the removed edges. (Nazaret et al., 2024; azizilab/sdcd contributors, 2024)
   There is also a concrete input risk. SDCD’s inspected dataset helper maps unmatched
perturbation labels to a sentinel, drops those entries, and turns an empty target list into an
all-ones retention mask. In the authored two-variable example, the label rate gives mask
(0, 1) but the misspelling raet gives (1, 1). This traces the selected transformation; it is not
an observed frequency in user data. The proposed wrapper must distinguish an explicitly
observational record from an unresolved target, validate all labels before conversion, and
refuse unknown or duplicate targets with the original input preserved. Successful optimization
after an unintended input reinterpretation would not resolve the mistake. (azizilab/sdcd
contributors, 2024; Causal banking proposal, 2026al)


31.27.6     A bounded reuse portfolio and the next evidence

The immediate portfolio has distinct roles. Tigramite supports proposed endpoint-preserving
temporal/context adapters; LiNGAM and DYNOTEARS supply declared linear structural
comparators; CausalAI provides an additional interface and benchmark reference with explicit
uncertainty restrictions. Python GIES supplies a transparent known-perfect intervention
baseline. UT-IGSP adds an invariance-based unknown-target comparison once its scoring and
dependencies are reconciled. DCDI, ENCO and SDCD provide complementary neural research
comparators, each restricted to its reviewed data and intervention contract. Direct adoption is
deferred; no port is selected merely because source terms permit modification. A port must
justify its maintenance and numerical-equivalence cost against a versioned adapter. (Causal
642                                                         Causal analysis for a universal bank


banking proposal, 2026ak)
   The first prototype can use generated structural laws with known graphs, observed inter-
vention assignments and saved observation clocks. Separate strata should vary lag order,
contemporaneous links, hidden common causes, shared calendars, regime persistence, regular
versus coarsened sampling, target knowledge and perfect versus soft intervention. Eligible and
deliberately ineligible cases must be reported separately. Software acceptance cases should
include duplicate clocks, unknown target spelling, rank failure, an unsupported RPCMCI
mask, an unsupported DCDI combination, raw-to-DAG conversion and the UT-IGSP score
switch. These cases test whether the adapter preserves or refuses meaning; they cannot by
themselves establish statistical recovery. (Causal banking proposal, 2026ak,al)
   A matched scientific comparison must then keep each method’s assumptions, search budgets
and target objects explicit. A selected DAG cannot be ranked against a PAG as though
every unresolved endpoint were an error. Report coverage of eligible requests, refusals, graph
and intervention-target errors, downstream identified effects or ambiguity, runtime and full
preparation costs. For dependent series, use a design justified for that process rather than
an independent-row bootstrap by default. Public datasets can test ingestion and observable
diagnostics; unless they supply independently credible intervention truth, they cannot award
causal correctness by agreement between algorithms. (Causal banking proposal, 2026ak)
   This is a developed comparison, not a complete census. The bounded search retains
unresolved families including amortized discovery, subsampled proxy methods, periodic/nonsta-
tionary discovery, Bayesian unknown-intervention methods and event-process methods. CUTS
and CD-NOD aliases still need primary identity and embedded implementation resolution.
Their unresolved status is an evidence gap, not evidence that the capability is absent. Further
work should acquire the original methods and implementation paths, classify their clock and
intervention assumptions, and compare their marginal contribution against this portfolio.
These follow-ups can proceed independently of prototype qualification and whole-manuscript
acceptance. (Causal banking proposal, 2026ak)


31.28      Tigramite as a temporal reference: preserving the mean-
           ing of the result
A bank comparing deposit rates and subsequent balances needs to distinguish a conditional-
dependence statistic, an unresolved endpoint, a fitted intervention response and uncertainty
about that response. Tigramite offers explicitly differentiated methods for these stages. The
selected January 2026 source declares version 5.2.10.1. PCMCI, PCMCI+, LPCMCI, RPCMCI
and J-PCMCI+ differ in contemporaneous-link, hidden-variable, stationarity and context
assumptions. The conditional-independence test adds its own restrictions: ParCorr uses linear
residual correlation, whereas other tests require their own treatment. These are distinct
scientific choices within one package, not interchangeable routes to a monetary effect.Jakob
Runge and Tigramite contributors (2026); jakobrunge/tigramite contributors (2026)
   The proposal selects Tigramite as a method-specific reference, with a conditional route to
an isolated Python worker. Prior installed-version operations remain relevant within their
recorded scope, including the finite-DAG oracle comparison. A matching version string does
not establish byte identity with the selected repository tree, and those operations do not
qualify every delegate considered here.tigramite contributors (2026); NetworkX and Tigramite
contributors (2026) The additional evidence below is static source inspection and independent
exact examples, not another native trial.
31.28. Tigramite as a temporal reference: preserving the meaning of the result                643


31.28.1     A statistic, a graph and a dollar response

Let Xt denote a centered rate intervention in specified rate units, Yt+1 a balance response in
dollars and Zt the chosen history. Consider a stipulated linear population,

   Yt+1 = 100 + 20Xt + γ ⊤ Zt + ϵt+1 ,       Var(Xt | Zt ) = 1,   Var(ϵt+1 | Zt ) = 225.   (31.17)

Assume independent residualized exposure and error, an intervention-invariant mechanism, a
history sufficient for adjustment, and intervention support. The residual covariance is 20 and
the residual variance of Y is 625. Thus the partial correlation is 20/25 = 4/5, whereas the
stipulated causal slope is 20 dollars per rate unit. A one-unit change with stipulated cost 12
dollars has net value 8 dollars. Reading 4/5 as a dollar gain instead gives −56/5 dollars. These
are authored population values, not observed bank returns; their disagreement demonstrates
the units lost in an invalid conversion.Causal banking proposal project (2026co)
   PCMCI labels its val_matrix as test-statistic values and its optional conf_matrix as
intervals for those values. ParCorr fits ordinary least-squares residuals and returns their
Pearson correlation. Its analytic test uses T − d degrees of freedom for d array rows and T
usable observations, returning a nonfinite p-value when degrees of freedom are insufficient. The
CI base also supplies a constant-variable shortcut. An adapter must report degeneracy and
invalid arithmetic rather than interpret every returned entry as scientific evidence of absence.
The run_pcmci signature defaults FDR to none, although the parameter prose says fdr_bh; a
profile must set this argument explicitly. The correction helper distinguishes lagged-only and
contemporaneous-inclusive test families. A corrected edge p-value is not a portfolio-response
interval.Jakob Runge and Tigramite contributors (2026)


31.28.2     Endpoint ambiguity is a substantive output

PCMCI+ can return contemporaneous ambiguity and conflict marks; LPCMCI returns a
temporal partial ancestral graph. The selected effect class accepts DAG and ADMG variants,
including temporal and stationary forms, but does not enable its commented-out PAG graph
types. A wrapper cannot bridge these interfaces by replacing circles or conflicts with arbitrary
arrows. It must retain the compatible graph family, justify additional scientific restrictions
where possible, and determine identification or set identification under those restrictions. A
graph-conditioned adjustment fit does not solve that preceding problem.Jakob Runge and
Tigramite contributors (2026)
   Even a summary frequency requires its exact definition. The default graph-summary routine
chooses a modal endpoint string but, in a tie, reports the sum of tied modal counts divided by
the resample count. Five resamples with one direction and five with the reverse can produce
a conflict mark with reported frequency one, although none of the ten inputs contains that
conflict mark. In a second stipulated ensemble, four absent links and three of each direction
make absence the most frequent individual string, while adjacency has total frequency 6/10.
The alternative adjacency-first aggregation answers the latter question. These finite examples
do not establish discovery failure; they show why the counts, aggregation rule and emitted
mark must accompany the summary. Such frequency is neither the posterior probability of an
arrow nor a calibrated graph confidence level.Jakob Runge and Tigramite contributors (2026);
Causal banking proposal project (2026co)
644                                                            Causal analysis for a universal bank


31.28.3     An intervention prediction still needs a contrast

For a supplied admissible graph and valid adjustment set Z, the unconditional adjusted
response is
                   Z
          µ(x) =       E[Y | X = x, Z = z]p(z) dz,     ∆(x, x0 ) = µ(x) − µ(x0 ).          (31.18)

This requires identifying graph and sampling assumptions; fitting regression does not supply
them. The inspected prediction delegate aggregates predictions over stored adjustment
observations. For an illustrative zero-mean adjusted history in the linear population, predictions
at zero and one are 100 and 120 dollars; the contrast is 20 dollars. Calling 120 the gain
includes the baseline. A caller must preserve that baseline, adjustment distribution, units,
transforms and conditioning target. The effect class checks adjustment validity by default
but exposes a bypass for a user-supplied set. An accepted product profile should not silently
enable that bypass.Jakob Runge and Tigramite contributors (2026); Causal banking proposal
project (2026co)
  The hard intervention sets an exposure value; the source’s soft option adds an amount
to each observed exposure. For nonlinear responses these policies differ. If Y = X 2 and
the stipulated reference population places equal mass at zero and two, the hard zero-to-one
contrast is 1, whereas adding one to everyone’s observed exposure gives
                               E[(X + 1)2 − X 2 ] = 2E[X] + 1 = 3.                         (31.19)
Here soft denotes that additive implementation, not every stochastic intervention in causal
inference. Conditional nested regression and alternative estimators need separate review.Jakob
Runge and Tigramite contributors (2026); Causal banking proposal project (2026co)
   The effect bootstrap refits the selected effect procedure and takes percentiles of intervention
predictions, retaining the supplied graph. Discovery bootstrap summaries instead concern
graphs and statistics. Neither bootstrap code nor a nonempty interval establishes joint validity
after graph discovery, graph or policy selection, or under arbitrary dependence. Specify the
uncertainty target and sampling law before choosing which stages to resample.Jakob Runge
and Tigramite contributors (2026)

31.28.4     Calendars, masks and resampling belong in the scientific contract

The data layer constructs lagged arrays from integer reference positions, dataset offsets and a
cutoff. Its ordinary twice-maximum-lag cutoff and the effect fitter’s maximum-lag cutoff can
retain different observations. Masks apply to selected variable roles, separately from missing-
value handling. Calendar gaps, reporting delays and multiple panels require explicit time-grid
conversion and effective-sample records. The earlier inspected RPCMCI implementation
replaces a supplied mask, requiring a distinct admission rule.Jakob Runge and Tigramite
contributors (2026)
  Several static edge cases warrant native oracle tests. The selected data-layer bootstrap
draws starts from arange(n-L) for n retained positions and block length L. For n = 6, L = 2,
these are 0, 1, 2, 3; the complete nonwrapping set includes start 4. Position 5 is absent from
the first expression’s reachable indices. This enumeration describes the inspected expression,
not an executed failure or quantified inference bias. Nonconsecutive retained positions also
need not be adjacent calendar times.Jakob Runge and Tigramite contributors (2026); Causal
banking proposal project (2026co)
  The missing-value extension constructs later position indices without clipping before assign-
ment. Missing position 5 in a six-position array, extended through lag two, yields 5, 6, 7; the
31.29. Java temporal discovery: clocks, regimes and the meaning of a learned network           645


last two exceed the bounds. The source writes the used-indices attribute after its dataset loop
while concatenating samples from all datasets. A multi-panel adapter must verify complete
panel provenance rather than assume this attribute records every panel. These observations
motivate narrow replay cases and separately reviewed patches; they do not establish that all
package analyses fail.Jakob Runge and Tigramite contributors (2026); Causal banking proposal
project (2026co)


31.28.5     The reuse choice and the work needed to change it

Whole-package adoption is premature because method assumptions, graph conversion, un-
certainty and these edge cases require distinct contracts. Porting to R, Java or C++ is not
justified by a measured benefit here: orientation rules, tests and resampling would acquire a
second maintenance burden. A selected Python worker is the candidate to test, preserving
endpoints and counts, effective observations and transforms, warnings and failures, and refusing
unsupported graph-to-effect requests. These requirements describe proposed capabilities.
   The repository declares GPL version 3 or later and contains GPLv3 text. Setup specifies
minimum dependencies rather than a locked environment; optional algorithms add packages.
This records licensing evidence, not clearance of a future distribution. Process isolation alone
does not settle rights. A maintainer must bind artifacts and versions; a scientific owner must
choose the sampling law, target and tests; an operator must address custody, failure budgets
and distribution. Comparison should include installation, search, ambiguous and failed queries,
resampling, serialization, upgrade regression and human review. Reconsider integration when a
permissible pinned profile passes the exact oracles and registered public or synthetic trial. Later
bank experiments should be justified by prototype merit rather than required to finish this
proposal decision.Jakob Runge and Tigramite contributors (2026); Causal banking proposal
project (2026co)


31.29      Java temporal discovery: clocks, regimes and the mean-
           ing of a learned network
A treasury analyst may have thousands of branch observations but only a few distinct funding-
shock dates. A package can turn these observations into a lagged network without answering
whether changing a deposit offer improves next-day net funding. A Java backend must preserve
three different objects: the observation clock, the statistical model fitted to the observations,
and the intervention whose consequence matters. Confusing them can produce a plausible
diagram with an incorrect economic interpretation.
   The comparison develops six repository routes: Tetrad, a modified BANJO distribution,
Weka’s forecasting package, learnDBN, learnDBM and BayesNetBuilder. The two learn-
ing repositories share substantial code; these are not six independent algorithm families.
Selected historical revisions through 7 October 2026 support the discussion, without estab-
lishing a complete Java census. Tetrad offers a candidate for a restricted graph adapter.
Discrete dynamic-network learners provide another modeling route, while Weka supplies a
forecasting and preprocessing comparison. Their scientific acceptance conditions differ. (cmu-
phil/tetrad, 2026d; daniel-315/slingshot-modified-banjo, 2026b; Waikato/weka-3.8, 2022b;
SSamDav/learnDBN, 2020; SSamDav/learnDBM, 2020; selrach/BayesNetBuilder, 2011)
646                                                              Causal analysis for a universal bank


31.29.1     The observation clock and the population

Let i index a branch or customer series, t a physical event date, Ait the action available at
that date, and Yi,t+h the funding outcome at horizon h. An effect for a typical customer, an
effect for a typical branch, and a bank-wide monetary total require different weights. The
information set must contain only values available when the decision is taken. A later-revised
balance cannot silently become a decision-time covariate. A lag of one row also needs a declared
relationship to the physical horizon.
   Tetrad’s inspected TsUtils.createLagData creates a matrix with n − L rows and p(L + 1)
columns from n rows, p variables and maximum lag L. Output row r at lag ℓ takes its value
from input row r + L − ℓ. Temporal tiers order the lagged variables. This method has no
physical timestamp or subject-boundary argument and reserves the colon in variable names for
lag notation. An external clock and identity validator is therefore necessary: the constructed
tiers do not establish the meaning of the original row order. (cmu-phil/tetrad, 2026d)
  For dates (0, 1, 4, 5), positional lagging yields (0, 1), (1, 4), (4, 5). Only two pairs represent a
one-day transition. The middle pair includes a three-day gap. Two independent series (1, 2, 3)
and (10, 20, 30) likewise provide four within-series transitions. Concatenating first adds 3 → 10,
which corresponds to no observed history. These are exact bookkeeping examples, not findings
about a bank dataset. (Causal banking proposal, 2026aw)
  The adapter should construct admissible windows before dispatch or refuse a clock it
cannot represent. It should retain event time, availability time, series identity, gap policy
and aggregation rule. An inserted missing row is different from an observed zero; carrying
a balance forward is a modeling choice. Resampling or aggregating to regular dates changes
the information supplied to discovery and needs justification. For branches sharing a market
shock, protecting series boundaries does not establish independence. (Causal banking proposal,
2026av)


31.29.2     Tetrad: temporal infrastructure and its limits

The inspected September 2026 Tetrad snapshot’s FCI wrapper constructs lagged data, supplies
the selected conditional-independence test, and passes knowledge, replication and other settings
to the FCI core. IMaGES lags each dataset separately, constructs component scores and
invokes BOSS permutation search. A lag parameter does not transfer every temporal-discovery
theorem to every test, sampling law and graph class. (cmu-phil/tetrad, 2026d)
   A saved SvarFCI help page describes time order, homologous edge removal under a repeated
structure, and contemporaneous connections unless forbidden by knowledge. It distinguishes
that contemporaneous allowance from assumptions of the research it references. The current
wrapper inspected here invokes the FCI core. The help page and wrapper cannot serve
interchangeably as proof of a specialized algorithm. The earlier static FCI review’s possible-
DSEP and orientation findings remain relevant; adding lag columns does not repair them.
Qualification must match the algorithm, test, representation and assumptions. (cmu-phil/tetrad,
2026d,c)
   Graph storage requires equal care. The inspected TimeLagGraph.addEdge accepts directed
edges, checks selected temporal conditions and propagates repeated edges over lags. The
separate addDirectedEdge delegates directly to the underlying graph without using that
validation path. A container’s name therefore cannot guarantee that every mutation enforces
the same conditions. A directed time-lag container also cannot losslessly represent an arbitrary
PAG: circles, latent confounding marks and unresolved orientations have meanings that a
directed completion would remove. Validate the actual entry point and preserve a typed graph
31.29. Java temporal discovery: clocks, regimes and the meaning of a learned network       647


before creating a simplified display. (cmu-phil/tetrad, 2026d; Causal banking proposal, 2026av)
   The bootstrap path contains a useful, limited repair. For tabular data and a wrapper
accepting knowledge, BootstrapTimeLag constructs lagged tuples before resampling, resets
the core’s lag parameter to avoid lagging twice, and restores knowledge afterward. The base
class uses this preparation on inspected single- and multiple-dataset paths. If knowledge
cannot be accepted, the helper leaves the inputs unchanged and logs a warning. This does not
guarantee the repair for every wrapper. (cmu-phil/tetrad, 2026d)
   Original observations (10, 20, 30) contain transitions 10 → 20 and 20 → 30. Resampling raw
indices (2, 0, 1) before lagging fabricates 30 → 10. Resampling already formed tuples prevents
this particular error, but does not make tuples independent or establish bootstrap coverage.
The helper’s comment acknowledges residual dependence and the absence of a block bootstrap
in that path. Dependence conditions need justification for the actual statistic, rather than
acceptance from a comment. (cmu-phil/tetrad, 2026d; Causal banking proposal, 2026aw)
  For a concrete law, set Zt = εt + εt−1 with independent, centered unit-variance innovations.
The variance of Zt is two and adjacent covariance is one. For four observations,
                                4·2+2·3·1  7                            2  1
                    Var(Z̄) =             = ,           Varind (Z̄) =     = .
                                    42     8                            4  2
Enumeration of the 32 equally likely configurations of five Rademacher innovations reproduces
the first value. This discrepancy is a property of the law, independent of faithful lag-column
storage. For four branches and five dates, suppose outcomes contain independent common
date shocks of variance four plus independent branch-date shocks of variance one. The grand
mean has variance 4/5 + 1/20 = 17/20. Treating the 20 rows as independent gives 5/20 = 1/4.
Separate within-branch bootstraps do not automatically restore the missing cross-branch
covariance. (Causal banking proposal, 2026aw)


31.29.3     Multiple datasets, intervention regimes and weights

IMaGES needs more than a list of matrices. The inspected one-argument ImagesScore con-
structor is documented as selecting SAMPLE_UNIFORM, but its body selects DATASET_WEIGHTED.
With component sizes Nk , their mean N̄ , and positive user weights uk , the latter normalizes

                                             uk N̄ /Nk
                                       wk = P             .
                                              j uj N̄ /Nj

The alternative uses 1/K on the component scores. Since scores can scale with sample size, the
two modes have different objectives. IMaGES uses the one-argument constructor. A nonfinite
component makes the aggregate undefined rather than being silently dropped; the sample-size
accessor returns the rounded mean size, not total rows. (cmu-phil/tetrad, 2026d)
   For component differences 100 and −20 with sizes 1000 and 100, the plain average is 40.
The actual equal-uk default uses weights 1/11, 10/11, giving −100/11. The sign changes.
This is arithmetic for stipulated component differences, not a claim about a particular search
trajectory. The sample-size accessor gives 550 while total rows are 1100. Calling 550 the
pooled count, or putting 1100 into an uncertainty formula without a dependence argument,
each misstates the evidence. (Causal banking proposal, 2026aw)
   Economic targets can change sign too. Suppose branch effects are 1 and −2 outcome units
per action, with 1000 and 100 eligible customers. The customer-weighted effect is 8/11; the
equal-branch effect is −1/2. At a stipulated USD 20 per outcome unit and USD 8 per action,
net values are USD 72/11 and USD −18. No action has value zero here. These are different
targets, not estimators of an unspecified common target. Score weights are not automatically
648                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


causal target-population weights; the request must declare both and their relationship. (Causal
banking proposal, 2026aw)
   Intervention information is another distinction. The inspected InterventionalColumn
holds value/status column metadata. That class alone does not show that a discovery
score recognizes perfect versus soft interventions, excludes intervened mechanisms or handles
unknown targets. Branches can differ through selection, hidden conditions or measurement.
Intervention interpretation requires regime identity, targets and types, assignment evidence,
and assumptions about unchanged mechanisms. The selected inspection supports no universal
absence claim about Java interventional algorithms. (cmu-phil/tetrad, 2026d; Causal banking
proposal, 2026av)


31.29.4     BANJO: discrete longitudinal search and a reuse boundary

The modified BANJO repository applies network search to gene expression ordered by pseudo-
time. Its sample configuration chooses lag one, discretization policy i2, mandatory identity
edges at lag one, up to five parents and a five-minute search budget. These are application
choices. An edge at pseudotime lag one does not mean a bank intervention acts over one
calendar day. Mandatory autoregressive edges also cannot be presented as discoveries made
without prior restrictions. (daniel-315/slingshot-modified-banjo, 2026b)
   The observation code demonstrates a useful series boundary rule. Usable rows subtract the
maximum lag separately for each input file. The window loop reads only within the current file,
preserving independent series. The inspected BDe evaluator uses discrete parent-configuration
counts and equivalent-sample- size parameters. That model differs from continuous funding
dynamics. Discretization can discard magnitudes essential to a monetary decision; category
definitions, fitted cutpoints and outcome-to-money conversion need joint review. Transforma-
tions for prospective prediction also need to be learned using permitted training data. Using
all dates to fit cutpoints would require a different information claim. (daniel-315/slingshot-
modified-banjo, 2026b)
   Commercial reuse is not settled by a public mirror. Source headers state Duke ownership, a
possible noncommercial license and a need to contact the owner for commercial use. They
do not establish a permissive commercial grant for this derivative. The proposed decision is
reference-only use while official version and rights remain unresolved; direct adoption and source
porting are deferred. Independently specifying series-safe windows and explicit lag constraints
remains useful without declaring this code cleared for incorporation. (daniel-315/slingshot-
modified-banjo, 2026b; Causal banking proposal, 2026av)


31.29.5     learnDBN and learnDBM: combinations of options matter

learnDBN declares tDBN, cDBN and bcDBN structure learning for multivariate longitudinal
observations, missing-value handling and a dynamic multinet clustering route. The inspected
revision includes an Apache2 license. The CLI defaults to a stationary network, with an option
for a separate network at each transition, a maximum Markov lag and a likelihood or MDL
score. Its observation format places subjects in rows and time-indexed attributes in columns.
This differs materially from concatenating panel rows into one series. (SSamDav/learnDBN,
2020)
   The missing-data path does not consistently honor the stationarity option. The CLI passes
literal true to parameter EM, missing-value filling and scoring, even when the requested
flag is false. With two nonstationary transition networks, the filling routine therefore selects
network zero across transitions. If parameter learning is reached, its stationary branch throws
31.29. Java temporal discovery: clocks, regimes and the meaning of a learned network          649


an exception because multiple transition networks exist. This is a finding from the caller
and callee, not an executed Java failure or a claim that no earlier error could occur. The
complete-data path instead passes the actual flag to parameter learning. Support for an option
and support for missing values separately do not establish support for their combination.
(SSamDav/learnDBN, 2020; Causal banking proposal, 2026aw)
   Malformed time headers can call System.exit(1), which is unsuitable inside a shared
host process. The inspected parameter-EM method and outer structural loop continue while
scores strictly improve, without an explicit iteration cap in those loops. Missing-value filling
enumerates category combinations and allocates arrays from their counts. Resource budgets
and overflow/allocation checks are therefore part of the prototype contract. Finally, the
compact graph option explicitly omits intra-slice edges. That display cannot be the canonical
scientific graph. (SSamDav/learnDBN, 2020)
   The engineering repair route is concrete: propagate the declared stationarity flag through
all relevant calls, or refuse the unsupported combination; isolate process-level failures; impose
termination and memory budgets; and export the full graph with lag and intra-slice information.
Native tests should cover complete and incomplete data under stationary and nonstationary
settings. These repairs do not justify the missingness mechanism, guarantee a global optimum,
or turn a score-selected graph into a causal confidence set. (Causal banking proposal, 2026av)
   learnDBM is a related implementation. At the selected revisions, 15 of the 17 shared
paths in the repositories’ dynamic-network source directory have identical Git blobs. Their
observation classes and CLI entry points differ: learnDBM accepts a cluster count and
invokes MultiNet.clust with the requested stationarity flag. The inner clustering path is
not inspected here. The learnDBN CLI finding cannot automatically be attributed to this
different caller. Nor do learned clusters necessarily represent externally assigned intervention
regimes; that interpretation needs another identification argument. (SSamDav/learnDBN,
2020; SSamDav/learnDBM, 2020)


31.29.6     Weka and BayesNetBuilder: alternatives with different outputs

Weka’s declared forecasting package version 1.0.27 dates to October 2019 and uses GPL3 in
the inspected mirror. It creates lagged and date-derived features for regression, with CLI and
graphical interfaces. The actual TSLagMaker import is forecasting-core TimeSeriesTranslate;
the similarly named generic filter is a different class. The caller copies an attribute and
applies a negative instance shift. The core translator copies selected historical values; its base
maintains a queue with offsets counted in instances. The selected history method receives
neither physical timestamps nor subject identities. Calendar preprocessing elsewhere does not
remove the need for adapter-level clock and series validation. (Waikato/weka-3.8, 2022b)
   Weka is therefore useful as a forecasting or feature-construction comparator with explicit
transformations and information availability. This does not qualify it as a causal-effect
estimator. Consider a fair binary hidden risk indicator U , an independent E equal to one
with probability 1/4, and A = U xor E, Y = U . All four observed (A, Y ) cells have positive
probability. The conditional means are E[Y | A = 1] = 3/4 and E[Y | A = 0] = 1/4. Yet
setting A changes no outcome equation, so the intervention contrast is zero. With USD 20
per outcome and USD 8 per action, the conditional proxy for net benefit is USD 2, while the
actual intervention net value is USD −8 in this stipulated law. Perfectly fitting its conditional
distribution would not resolve that distinction. (Causal banking proposal, 2026aw)
   BayesNetBuilder offers parameter learning in a supplied dynamic model. Its inspected
EM entry point defaults to 1000 steps and tolerance 0.0001, computes expected sufficient
statistics and maximizes parameters, and logs when the limit is reached without convergence.
650                                                          Causal analysis for a universal bank


Its author’s README describes graduate research code requiring major refactoring and
documentation. No root license was identified in the selected complete-tree review; rights
remain unresolved. These observations justify a reference candidate for model-supplied
EM. They do not establish structural discovery, intervention identification or a dependable
production service. (selrach/BayesNetBuilder, 2011)


31.29.7    A public and generated prototype to resolve the known issues

The immediate proposal should fund a restricted prototype. A first comparison would retain
Tetrad behind a typed adapter, consider a repaired learnDBN path for discrete longitudinal
data, and use Weka for forecasting comparison. An exact small oracle and a conservative
no-discovery decision provide further baselines. BANJO and BayesNetBuilder remain reference-
only pending rights and version clarification. learnDBM needs an inspected clustering path
before becoming an enabled backend. Porting is a later option where rights, numerical
equivalence and maintenance advantages are established. Wrapping software does not remove
its rights or scientific conditions. (Causal banking proposal, 2026av)
   Generated mechanisms can vary clock regularity, series boundaries, shared shocks, regime
changes, missingness and hidden causes while retaining known interventions. Public observa-
tions supply realistic calendars and measurement patterns. Documented public assignments
may supply stronger causal evidence for their stated populations and interventions. The com-
parison should report window and graph fidelity, unsupported/refused requests, graph-family
retention where truth is known, justified effect-set coverage and width, decision loss and full
workflow cost. Whole mechanisms or trajectories form evaluation units, with common-calendar
clusters retained. Sources, settings, evaluation units, replications and stopping rules must be
frozen before a final study. This is a prospective design, not an executed Java experiment.
(Causal banking proposal, 2026av)
   Remaining uncertainty has distinct remedies. Broader candidate searches, missing originals,
release matching, rights review and native option- combination trials are concrete acquisition
and engineering work. Useful graph and effect uncertainty under hidden causes, dependence
and potentially invalid regime assumptions remains a research problem. Where two models
fit the observations but disagree about an action, the product must report an identified set,
obtain justified additional information, or decline the point- effect claim. Another package
name, larger panel or successful EM termination does not supply that missing premise. (Causal
banking proposal, 2026av)


31.30      Native temporal and interventional engines: preserving
           the scientific request
A bank considering a native discovery engine first needs to specify what is to be learned. A
graph of relationships among funding rates, balances and market conditions is different from
the response of balances to a controlled rate change. A transition model for delinquency
is different again: it can predict the next recorded state without identifying the effect of a
servicing action. The R, Python and Java comparisons above make these distinctions at their
language boundaries. The same distinctions govern a C++ implementation, even when its
numerical kernel is fast and its graph output looks familiar.
  Five families illuminate different parts of this choice. The C++ kernel in pcalg implements
search using known intervention targets through an R interface. aGrUM supplies a native
probabilistic-model engine, while the inspected dynamic network helper is Python. Mocapy++
31.30. Native temporal and interventional engines: preserving the scientific request        651


supplies dynamic-model inference and parameter learning for structures supplied by the user.
sDBN contains native temporal structure-training paths. BayesNetty contributes a constrained
genetic-network search reference. Their capabilities overlap in representation and numerical
work, but their statistical experiments and result meanings differ. The comparison uses
cutoff-compatible source revisions and the technical content of the original GIES paper; it
does not treat repository search metadata as evidence of implemented capability. (cran/pcalg,
2024; agrumery/aGrUM, 2026b; juliusHuelsmann/MocapyPP, 2019; JBSants/sDBN, 2021;
NewcastleRSE/BayesNetty, 2025; Hauser and Bühlmann, 2012)


31.30.1     A common banking question and two indistinguishable observed
            laws

Let X be a centered, standardized funding-rate decision variable and Y a centered retained-
balance index. Consider two deliberately small causal models:

                                 W1 : X = UX , Y = 21 X + εY ,
                                 W2 : Y = UY , X = 12 Y + εX .

In each world the root variable is standard normal, the error has variance 3/4, and root and
error are independent. Both observational distributions are centered Gaussian with covariance
                                                         !
                                                1 1/2
                                        Σ=            .
                                               1/2 1

Consequently a better fit to this observational law cannot distinguish the two directions.
Temporal labels alone do not repair this example if both variables describe the same decision
interval and their within-interval order has not been justified.
   Now replace the equation for X by an independently randomized draw with variance four.
In W1 , the intervention yields Var(Y ) = 7/4 and Cov(X, Y ) = 2; in W2 , it yields variance one
and covariance zero. This is an information change, not merely an extra argument supplied
to an optimizer. The known intervention must actually replace the appropriate structural
mechanism while preserving the other stipulated mechanisms.
  For a finite increase from do(X = 0) to do(X = 1), suppose that one unit of Y is worth
USD 20 and the action costs USD 4. The net effects are

                        V1 = 20(1/2) − 4 = 6,        V2 = 20(0) − 4 = −4.

These are exact authored examples, not bank measurements. Their purpose is to show why
a representative graph cannot silently become the bank’s selected causal truth: the same
observational fit permits opposite action decisions. Acquiring useful intervention information
may be worth considering, but its value depends on the decision and acquisition cost, not the
number of arrows that a search happens to orient. (Causal banking proposal, 2026bd)


31.30.2     pcalg: a native interventional kernel with an R contract

The selected pcalg version is 2.7-12, represented by its September 2024 CRAN source revision.
Hauser and Bühlmann formulate independent observations with known intervention targets;
the data need not be identically distributed across targets. Their conservative-target condition
leaves each variable unmanipulated in at least one regime. These conditions explain the local
score: observations from regimes that intervene on node j do not estimate that node’s original
conditional mechanism. In the paper’s DREAM4 application, uncertain-target perturbations
652                                                                 Causal analysis for a universal bank


are excluded. This establishes a limit of that application and formulation, not a finding that
all later methods fail with unknown targets. The paper also leaves consistency of its GIES
procedure as a question; that statement must not be turned into a claim about all subsequent
consistency literature. (Hauser and Bühlmann, 2012)
  The implementation preserves this experiment through several layers. The R constructor
validates target membership and row counts, sorts rows by target index, and constructs a
nonintervened-row index for each node. The C++ entry converts one-based R vertex and row
indices to zero-based indices. The score factory distinguishes raw Gaussian, scatter-matrix
Gaussian and R callback paths. A proposed bridge must therefore preserve row identities,
target families, labels and score configuration together. Copying a numerical matrix and an
adjacency list into a nominally equivalent native routine is not a complete port. (cran/pcalg,
2024)
   For node j, write Nj = {i : j ∈
                                 / Ii }, where Ii is the known intervention target for row i, and
let nj = |Nj |. Up to constants that do not affect the relevant search comparison, the inspected
Gaussian local score has the form
                                     "          (            )#
                                   nj               RSSj,P
                       sj (P ) = −    1 + log                     − λ(1 + |P |).
                                   2                 nj
Here P is the candidate parent set and RSS is the residual sum of squares on the nonintervened
rows, with the configured intercept. The default penalty uses half the logarithm of the total row
count. The likelihood expression is not a dependent-panel uncertainty correction. Overlapping
time windows and shared calendar shocks need their own statistical justification before this
independent-row experiment is claimed.
   Configuration identity matters even before any temporal extension. The manual constructor
lists intercept=FALSE, while the inspected R constructor defaults to TRUE. For a parentless
response (8, 10, 10, 12), fitting its mean gives RSS 8, whereas fixing its mean at zero gives
RSS 408. Holding the penalty fixed, the score difference is 2 log(51), approximately 7.86365.
This is an independent calculation from the displayed score, not an observed pcalg execution.
The remedy is to set and report the intercept explicitly and test both documented and actual
defaults in a future bridge. The same contract must reject fractional identifiers before the
wrapper’s integer coercion, reject zero effective row counts and nonfinite scores, and retain
diagnostics for failed factorizations. The native Cholesky and QR paths can return NaN on
failure; that must not become a valid zero effect. (cran/pcalg, 2024; Causal banking proposal,
2026bd)
   GIES returns an estimated interventional essential graph and a representative DAG. Those
are different objects. Its symmetric fixedGaps represents forbidden adjacency, and adaptive
modes can revise the set of gaps. A banking constraint such as “an earlier decision cannot
be caused by a later balance” is directional; representing it as forbidden adjacency would
also delete a permitted forward relationship. A bridge should require an explicit constraint
type and validate the returned graph against the requested hard constraints. The proposed
reuse route is a versioned R bridge around the existing native kernel. A standalone C++
port remains a separate effort because the inspected interfaces include Rcpp objects, callback
support, R preprocessing and RcppArmadillo/BH dependencies. The GPL-at-least-2 package
declaration also requires a distribution-specific rights review; a language bridge alone does not
settle that question. (cran/pcalg, 2024)

31.30.3    aGrUM: unrolling a model while preserving state meaning

The inspected aGrUM dynamic helper, at its 6 October 2026 revision, checks time-slice suffixes
and selected domain sizes, creates time-indexed variables, reconstructs parent order, and copies
31.30. Native temporal and interventional engines: preserving the scientific request           653


conditional-probability arrays into the unrolled model. This is valuable model-construction
support. It is a Python helper over the native engine, and the inspected path does not itself
learn a causal temporal structure. An inference engine can answer questions about a supplied
model without establishing that the supplied arrows are causal. (agrumery/aGrUM, 2026b)
   Equal cardinality is weaker than equal state identity. Suppose the initial slice lists states as
(current, delinquent), while the repeated slice lists them as (delinquent, current). The intended
transition has

                 P (Dt+1 = 1 | Dt = 0) = 0.1,        P (Dt+1 = 1 | Dt = 1) = 0.8.

Starting current, the correct two-step delinquency probability is 0.9(0.1) + 0.1(0.8) = 0.17. If
a conversion blindly reuses the numeric parent-state positions after the ordering changes, it
instead computes 0.9(0.8) + 0.1(0.1) = 0.73. For a stipulated value 100 − 40p, this changes
USD 93.2 into USD 70.8, a USD 22.4 error. This is an authored conversion counterexample
motivated by the source path; it is not an observed pyagrum runtime result. (Causal banking
proposal, 2026bd)
   The helper’s is2TBN checks cardinality without checking identity of the ordered state
labels. The unrolling function’s particular invalid-slice guard combines two conditions with
conjunction, so some incomplete slice sets evade that guard. This is a static control-flow
observation; it does not establish which later operation fails for every malformed model. A
proposed adapter should validate complete slice pairing, ordered state identities, physical
period, dimensions and permitted arrows before unrolling. A deliberate relabeling needs
a probability-preserving permutation of every affected tensor axis, followed by comparison
with a small independently enumerated model. The inspected file permits LGPL-3-or-later
or MIT, supported by the same-revision license texts; dependency and distribution closure
still need checking. Conditional adoption of supplied-model unrolling is reasonable. Calling
that adoption a newly qualified discovery method is unsupported. (agrumery/aGrUM, 2026b;
Causal banking proposal, 2026bc)


31.30.4     Mocapy++: latent-state modeling is a different investment

Mocapy++ can serve a supplied dynamic model in which an unobserved borrower state emits
recorded behavior. The inspected manual, version 1.05 from January 2010, explicitly states
in Section 3.7 that structure learning is absent. Its worked source example adds within-slice
and between-slice edges before performing expectation and maximization steps. The sequence
masks distinguish observed, hidden and missing entries. A hidden entry is not an intervention,
and an EM fit of a hidden-state model does not establish that changing a recorded action would
change the hidden state according to the fitted model. The bounded decision is therefore to
reject this version as the proposed structure-discovery backend while retaining it as a reference
for supplied DBN inference and parameter learning. (juliusHuelsmann/MocapyPP, 2019)
   An engineering evaluation would need to justify the legacy environment and source custody.
The inspected mirror is dated February 2019; its build uses C, C++ and Fortran, and its
instructions discuss compiler-matched Boost and LAPACK. Moreover, the root license contains
LGPL2.1 text while the inspected DBN, EM engine and example headers specify LGPL3-or-
later. These observations require per-file clarification and cannot honestly be compressed into
one unqualified package-license label. Modernizing this code may cost more than using another
permitted inference engine with the same supplied model. The comparison should measure the
cost of preserving the model, masks, numerical behavior and diagnostics, rather than reward
a port merely because its output has the same shape. (juliusHuelsmann/MocapyPP, 2019;
Causal banking proposal, 2026bc)
654                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


31.30.5     sDBN: temporal training, dependent rows and output interpretation

The inspected September 2021 sDBN revision contains a C++14 dynamic-network training
program with stationary, nonstationary and already-rolled input paths. Lag zero means all
available time steps. The stationary loader turns m wide subject records with T time points
and lag L into (T − L)m overlapping transition rows. The node-training code excludes future
parents and parents outside the specified lag, while allowing contemporaneous candidates.
These are concrete temporal mechanisms; they do not by themselves identify intervention
effects or validate a stationary law for irregular bank records. (JBSants/sDBN, 2021)
   For example, three independent subjects with four observations and lag one produce nine
transition rows. Suppose each subject has one independent, mean-zero, variance-one shock
repeated through its three transition rows. The mean of all nine rows is the mean of three
shocks. Its true variance is 1/3, whereas an independence calculation using nine rows gives
1/9. An exact enumeration of eight equiprobable sign-shock worlds reproduces the first result.
Overlap can increase numerical work without increasing the independent information count
by the same factor. Likewise, dates (0, 1, 4, 5) have adjacent gaps (1, 3, 1): a row lag of one
does not specify a constant physical interval. Preserving original subject and calendar labels is
necessary for splitting, uncertainty and transport to a future decision. Shared calendar shocks
create an additional dependence problem even when subjects have distinct identifiers. (Causal
banking proposal, 2026bd)
   The output path also deserves a literal reading. The regularization stage produces allowed
directed pairs. The serializer calls this array a skeleton; it adds a separate directed structure
and likelihood only when a directed-search result is supplied. With –no-hill, the caller passes
no such result. That array should therefore retain its candidate-edge meaning, rather than be
advertised as an acyclic causal graph, an essential graph or a partial ancestral graph. With
directed search enabled, the called header checks paths before adding edges and restricts
reversals to equal-time nodes with a cycle check. The inspected reversal branch does not
explicitly check membership of the reversed pair in the allowed list. A future prototype must
test and enforce the intended meaning of those restrictions, especially when starting from a
supplied graph. (JBSants/sDBN, 2021)
   There is a further transport issue. The CLI uses standard output for its result when no
output file is supplied. The directed-search routine also prints diagnostics to standard output
inside the result-producing call. Static tracing therefore predicts a mixed diagnostic/result
stream for that path; no native execution was performed here. A proposed CLI bridge
should use a dedicated result file or separate channel, validate the entire result, and return a
transport failure when parsing fails. It should not silently remove arbitrary text until something
resembling JSON remains. The existing binary hot-start serialization also motivates an explicit
version and platform contract before checkpoints cross environments. (JBSants/sDBN, 2021;
Causal banking proposal, 2026bc)
    Reuse remains conditional. The complete inspected tree contains no README or license
file, so public access does not establish permission to copy or redistribute the implementation.
The build depends on Eigen, LBFGS, FlatBuffers and OpenSSL, with optional MPI/MKL
paths; its release configuration enables fast-math and contains a host-specific include directory.
Resolve terms, replace that path, freeze dependencies and compare numerical behavior with
conservative compiler settings before considering a bridge. Until then, sDBN is a source
reference and prototype candidate, not an adopted backend. Independent generated temporal
examples remain possible without copying its implementation. (JBSants/sDBN, 2021)
31.30. Native temporal and interventional engines: preserving the scientific request         655


31.30.6     BayesNetty: constraints and failure values need precise translation

BayesNetty’s selected June 2025 source documents genetic-network modeling, greedy search
and random or jittered restarts. Its score documentation assumes multinomial discrete nodes
and normal continuous nodes. These sources make it a useful constrained-network reference,
but do not qualify a temporal or interventional banking estimator. The input documentation
gives ordered blacklist edges. If both directions appear in a whitelist, an adjacency is required
while either orientation is allowed. A whitelist/blacklist conflict is documented as an error.
(NewcastleRSE/BayesNetty, 2025)
   These conventions differ from pcalg’s symmetric gaps. In a two-node DAG universe, a
forbidden adjacency permits only the empty graph; banning only A → B also permits B → A;
requiring adjacency permits either one-edge orientation. Two whitelist lines do not represent an
unmeasured common cause with a bidirected edge. The proposed conversion must preserve the
predicate being asserted, with endpoint semantics carried separately from input-file conventions.
(NewcastleRSE/BayesNetty, 2025; cran/pcalg, 2024; Causal banking proposal, 2026bd)
  Failure values must also retain their meaning. The inspected serial search method returns
numeric zero when its initial network has a loop. Its caller has not been traced in this
comparison, so this does not establish the final CLI behavior. It does establish why a wrapper
cannot assume that every numeric return is a successful score. The prospective contract
needs an independent acyclicity check and an explicit failure status. The GPL3 source and
documented compiler route support a conditional reference decision, with dependency, licensing
and target semantics checked before a wider integration is enabled. (NewcastleRSE/BayesNetty,
2025; Causal banking proposal, 2026bc)


31.30.7     Reuse choices and the next affordable experiment

The resulting choices are complementary. Their common prerequisite is an explicit scientific
request, not a universal adjacency-matrix interface.

  aGrUM            Adopt supplied-model construc- Validate slice/state identity and tensor
                   tion conditionally             conversion; distinguish inference from dis-

  Mocapy++         Reference supplied DBN infer- Resolve mirror, file licenses and legacy
                   ence; reject as this structure numerical environment.
                   learner

  BayesNetty       Reference constrained search   Preserve constraint predicates and fail-
