held-out interactions? Either can be valuable without identifying the effect of deploying a new
servicing policy. The commercial feature matrix should retain the target, source of mechanisms,
sampling unit and uncertainty claim for each quantity.

32.18.2     A final-action adjustment can reverse a servicing decision

Consider a generated two-stage law with γ = 1. The first action A0 is a fair binary draw; the
next observed state is L1 = A0 . The logger chooses A1 = 1 with probability 9/10 after A0 = 0
and 1/10 after A0 = 1. Define a terminal net reward, in stipulated dollars, by
                         R = 20A0 + 100A1 − 120A0 A1 − 5(A0 + A1 ).
This law deliberately models an adverse interaction between repeated actions; it is not an
estimated banking mechanism. Its four paths are
                              (A0 , A1 ) (0, 0) (0, 1) (1, 0) (1, 1)
                                Pb        1/20 9/20 9/20 1/20
                                 R            0    95     15 −10
For the policy setting both actions to one, direct substitution gives V = −10. The full trajectory
weight is twenty on path (1, 1) and zero otherwise, hence Eb [W R] = (1/20)(20)(−10) = −10.
(Causal banking proposal, 2026az)
  Using only the history-conditional last-action ratio answers another question:
                                  1{A1 = 1}

evaluates the two-action target whose value is negative. The example specifies exactly what a
static-policy comparator can and cannot replace. More observations of the same law would
estimate the wrong target more precisely. (Causal banking proposal, 2026az)
   There is also a precision cost even when the weighting is correct. Here Eb W = 1 and
Eb W 2 = 20, so the population ratio (Eb W )2 /Eb W 2 is 1/20. Only one twentieth of trajectories

finite-sample coverage guarantee or a universal effective sample size. The number of logged
events alone cannot settle whether a policy comparison is precise enough for an investment
decision. (Causal banking proposal, 2026az)

32.18.3     Azure Personalizer is a historical workflow reference

The acquired Microsoft pages describe Rank requests containing available actions, action
features, context and an event identifier, followed by a Reward call. The inspected overview
uses a reward between zero and one and permits delayed feedback. It describes learning
across users and expressly says that the service does not maintain individual user histories.
These are useful workflow features, but a sequence of event-level calls is not itself a specified
customer-trajectory causal model. A monetary servicing objective also needs an explicit reward
transformation, treatment costs and horizon; a click score cannot be silently substituted for
discounted net recovery. (Microsoft, 2026a)
   The offline-evaluation pages compare the current online learning policy, the application’s
default action, a random-action policy, uploaded alternatives and policies found by optimization
discovery. They display estimated average rewards and confidence intervals, allow a policy to
be downloaded or applied, and recommend representative traffic and at least 50,000 events
as a practical starting point. The conceptual description replays chronological events with a
blank model for each learning policy and retains observed rewards when the chosen action
matches. A learning-policy configuration in this description controls a changing learner; it is
not necessarily a single fixed action rule. (Microsoft, 2026a)
   That conceptual account is insufficient to reconstruct a general estimator or its uncertainty
theorem. For an exact illustration, suppose two contexts are equally common, a target
always chooses action one, and its mean rewards are 10 and 100. Let the logger’s action-one
probabilities be 0.9 and 0.1. The target value is 55, but the mean among matching logged
actions is
                                   0.9(10) + 0.1(100)
                                                       = 19.
                                         0.9 + 0.1
Weighting by the correct context-specific assignment probabilities recovers 55 in this population.
This is a counterexample to matching alone under nonuniform logging, not a claim that
Microsoft’s actual implementation uses that incomplete estimator. The inspected pages do
not supply all the algorithmic and confidence-bound details needed to make such a runtime
claim. A successor comparison must acquire those details and verify the logging distribution,
retained-event denominator, replay updates and policy-selection rule. (Microsoft, 2026a; Causal
banking proposal, 2026az)
   Availability changes the acquisition recommendation. The official pages state that new
resources became unavailable on 20 September 2023 and that the service would retire on
25 August 2026. That retirement date precedes the proposal’s 7 October 2026 cutoff. The
pages recommend the open-source microsoft/learning-loop project. Thus Personalizer is a
historical workflow comparator rather than a proposed new hosted dependency. The named
successor needs its own pinned code, rights and estimator review; the migration link does not
establish feature or statistical parity. The pages were acquired after the cutoff and are labeled
as archived documentation, with their displayed update dates and source metadata retained.
(Microsoft, 2026a)


32.18.4     Recommendation quality, incremental value and capacity

Amazon Personalize’s inspected technical page defines train/test constructions, metrics
such as precision, recall and normalized discounted cumulative gain, and a metric named
average_rewards_at_k. The latter normalizes rewards from interactions with selected rec-
ommendations relative to rewards from interactions with recommendations. Its name does
not make it an estimate of the population intervention contrast. The page also warns against
comparing solution metrics across different training data, and provides CLI and SDK routes
704                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


to retrieve metrics. Those are meaningful operational capabilities to compare, while their
documented target remains distinct from a causal policy effect. This mutable page has no
independently authenticated cutoff byte identity; the source limitation is retained. (Amazon
Web Services, 2026a)
  A generated capacity example makes the distinction operational. Suppose 80% of customers
have baseline recovery probability 0.9 and a contact effect 0.02, while 20% have baseline
probability 0.1 and effect 0.2. At USD 100 per recovery and USD 5 per contact, incremental
net values are −3 and 15. Treating everyone gives only 0.8(−3) + 0.2(15) = 0.6 dollars
per customer; contacting the high-increment group gives 0.2(15) = 3. If capacity permits
contacting 10% of all customers, randomly selecting half of that group yields 1.5 dollars per
customer. Ranking by treated response probability instead favors the low-increment group,
whose response probability is 0.92 rather than 0.3, and gives 0.1(−3) = −0.3 dollars per
customer at the same capacity. (Causal banking proposal, 2026az)
   The values are stipulated, but the comparison identifies a product requirement: retain the
baseline outcome, incremental effect, cost, assignment probability and capacity separately.
JMP’s inspected uplift platform explicitly chooses partition splits to emphasize treatment
differences, using treatment-by-split interactions for continuous or categorical responses. It is
consequently a relevant targeting comparator. Its older guide’s validation and treatment-level
details are scoped to that guide; the current overview cannot establish that every edition
implements the same procedure. Stata’s prespecified policy-value target provides another
relevant comparison once the net outcome and population are aligned. Neither source licenses
an automatic inference from a fitted ranking to an independently validated policy gain. (JMP,
2025; StataCorp, 2025)


32.18.5     Selecting a policy is an additional experiment

Suppose m candidate policies all have true incremental value zero, and each evaluation has
an independent error equal to −4 or 4 with equal probability. Every individual estimate is
unbiased. Reporting the largest estimate gives
                                             
                                  E max Vbj = 4{1 − 21−m }.
                                        j≤m

The maximum is −4 only when all errors are negative and is 4 otherwise. Its expectation is
zero for one candidate, two for two candidates, and 127/32, approximately 3.969, for eight.
A fresh independent mean-zero evaluation of the selected index has expectation zero. This
exact finite example explains the role of an independent final evaluation; it is not a proposed
universal subtraction rule for a commercial optimizer. (Causal banking proposal, 2026az)
   The candidate list, training and tuning records, validation sample and final policy identity
should therefore be part of the comparison. If a product supports repeated online adaptation,
the evaluation must reproduce that adaptation under an appropriate experiment rather than
call it a frozen-policy test. The best policy among a declared finite list also differs from an
unknown optimum over all feasible strategies. The proposed reporting should state which value
is being estimated and preserve the selection uncertainty or the independence that justifies its
exclusion. (Jiang and Li, 2016; Causal banking proposal, 2026ba)


32.18.6     Influence diagrams support a different reuse decision

SMILE’s inspected manual represents controllable decisions as nodes with available states,
value nodes with utility tables, and multi-attribute utility nodes with weights or expressions. It
32.18. Commercial policy evaluation: what an offline score permits                             705


exposes indexing parents, including earlier decisions and chance observations relevant before a
decision. After inference, its matrices contain policy-indexed probabilities or expected utilities,
depending on node type. GeNIe supplies the associated decision framing, preference elicitation
and value-of-information workflow. These capabilities are relevant to a bank that can supply a
credible finite decision model. (BayesFusion, LLC, 2024n)
   The proposed reuse choice is a licensed supplied-model comparator. A bridge must preserve
which observations precede which actions, decision-state order, utility units, the interpretation
of indexing parents, and the distinction between evaluating a supplied policy and optimizing
within the model. Maximizing a supplied utility table cannot validate its transition probabilities
against a selectively logged bank history. Nor does the presence of hidden chance nodes identify
a partially observed causal system from arbitrary data. The inherited SMILE licensing
documentation remains relevant; public manuals do not grant embedding rights or establish
a current price. Porting the vendor engine is not the proposed route. (BayesFusion, LLC,
2024n,k)


32.18.7     What the proposed product still needs

The current common local service exposes six bounded scientific operations; its declared
operation schema and estimator dispatch do not provide a general policy-evaluation service.
Three actual local requests naming fixed-history, learned-policy validation and static-assignment
value methods returned unsupported with no result. This observation is restricted to that
service. The repository also contains separate history-evaluation and controlled-model research
modules; their existence and selected demonstrations are not equivalent to a qualified common
library/CLI/MCP policy interface. (Causal banking proposal, 2026bb)
   The concrete proposal gap is therefore larger than adding another estimator identifier. A
policy request must bind its initial population, physical and availability clocks, full history
variables, action probabilities, observation and censoring process, discounting, net-reward
map, selection/training identity and final evaluation units. Its response should distinguish a
static rule, a fixed sequence policy, an adapting learner and a supplied-model optimum. It
must retain support failures and uncertainty limits. The documented commercial workflow
features—policy comparison, model export, diagnostics and decision-model inspection—are
useful requirements for this design, while the scientific meaning is checked independently.
(Causal banking proposal, 2026ba)
   The bounded portfolio covers eleven named families. Stata and JMP support docu-
mented static alternatives; Azure supplies a retired workflow reference; Amazon supplies
a recommendation-evaluation comparator; and BayesFusion supplies model-based decision
analysis. MATLAB’s selected official routes were inaccessible. SAS reinforcement-learning
routes and HUGIN’s selected routes did not yield technical originals. The inherited SAS
survival, IBM regression, Mplus dynamic-model and Bayesia causal-model sources cannot settle
their policy-specific capabilities. These entries remain unresolved with concrete manual/version
acquisition routes. No absence of a policy capability is inferred from an unavailable page.
Exact editions, entitlements, prices and runtime behavior remain open across the prospective
commercial trials. (Causal banking proposal, 2026ba)
   An economical prototype can begin with the exact mechanisms above and the existing
open-source reference comparisons. Public data can supply realistic covariates, event clocks
and missingness patterns, while generated assignments and outcomes provide declared causal
truth. Compare one static policy, one history policy and one supplied-model decision on
matched eligible questions; retain a predictive recommendation baseline as an explicitly
different alternative. Freeze final trajectories, candidate policies, metrics, cost accounting
706                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


and stopping rules before evaluation. Native commercial execution follows only for a selected
edition with available rights. Bank experiments become relevant when the prototype identifies
a consequential logging, support, hidden-state or transport uncertainty that public/generated
evidence cannot settle. This route makes the proposal executable while leaving the unresolved
general research questions visible. (Causal banking proposal, 2026ba)


32.19      CausalPy at a lending threshold: what a reusable exper-
           iment must preserve
A credit policy often turns a continuous score into a discrete action. A borrower just above a
threshold might receive a different offer, servicing contact or review requirement. The useful
software question is therefore not simply whether a package can fit two curves. It is whether
the resulting contrast answers the bank’s intervention question, whether its uncertainty refers
to that contrast, and whether the interface preserves the design when observations, units or
models change. CausalPy offers an instructive candidate because its experiment interface can
expose a Bayesian regression or a point-estimation backend. The source revision considered
here declares version 1.0.0rc1 and is dated 6 October 2026; the earlier distribution-metadata
observation of 0.9.0 is a different artifact. The following analysis concerns the selected
sharp regression-discontinuity path, not automatic approval of its other designs.(pymc-labs
contributors, 2026)


32.19.1     The local question precedes the fitted contrast

Let X be the score available at the decision time, c the cutoff and T = 1{X ≥ c} the
stipulated sharp assignment rule. Define Y (t) as the fixed-horizon outcome under action t. If
observed outcomes obey consistency, the conditional potential-outcome means are continuous
at c, and score support approaches the cutoff from both sides, the limiting observed jump
identifies the local mean effect. To see the dependence on these assumptions explicitly, write
µt (x) = E[Y (t) | X = x]. Sharp assignment and consistency imply E[Y | X = x] = µ0 (x)
below the cutoff and µ1 (x) above it. Continuity then gives

                  τc = µ1 (c) − µ0 (c) = lim E[Y | X = x] − lim E[Y | X = x].
                                        x↓c                 x↑c

This derivation is conditional on the stipulated design. It does not establish that a real
score cannot be manipulated, that a simultaneous pricing change is absent, or that the effect
transports to all borrowers. A servicing outcome also requires a stable measurement horizon
and a declared treatment of censoring. Those are parts of the question, not properties acquired
by importing a regression class.(Causal banking proposal, 2026d,c)
   The inspected CausalPy experiment builds design matrices and later obtains predictions at
two rows: (c − ϵ, T = 0) and (c + ϵ, T = 1). Its result subtracts the first prediction from the
second. The default separation is ϵ = 0.001 in the running variable’s units. Consequently the
returned quantity is a finite-separation model contrast,

                                ∆ϵ = m(c + ϵ, 1) − m(c − ϵ, 0),

which approaches a model’s threshold jump only under the relevant limiting behavior. The
implementation’s name does not make a finite separation identical to that limit. The inspected
treatment rule assumes treatment above the cutoff; the selected validation method requires a
dummy-coded treated column but does not itself demonstrate that every observed treatment
matches this rule. An eligibility cutoff with imperfect take-up is a different design. Relabeling
32.19. CausalPy at a lending threshold: what a reusable experiment must preserve            707


actual receipt as deterministic eligibility would hide the first-stage question. (pymc-labs
contributors, 2026)
  Consider the exact, stipulated conditional mean with the score centered at zero,

                               m(x, t) = 100 + 20x + 5t + 10xt.

Its threshold jump is 5. At ϵ = 1/1000, however, ∆ϵ = 5 + (2 · 20 + 10)/1000 = 5.05. More
generally, for m(x, t) = α + βx + τ t + γxt centered at the cutoff, the difference is (2β + γ)ϵ.
This is an exact contrast identity, not an observed software bias estimate or an assertion about
a fitted sample. Shrinking the separation reduces this particular deterministic difference but
does not repair a misspecified regression, weak support or an invalid design. (Causal banking
proposal, 2026d)
   Units make the distinction operational. Expressing the same score as Z = 100X changes the
coefficients to 0.2 and 0.1 for the score and its interaction. Keeping the numeric separation at
0.001 now produces 5.0005; preserving the physical separation requires ϵZ = 0.1, which restores
5.05. The cutoff, bandwidth and donut exclusion must also transform. A unit conversion
that leaves all numeric tuning inputs untouched therefore changes the question asked of an
otherwise equivalent model. A proposed adapter should return the two physical prediction
locations and their units alongside the contrast. (Causal banking proposal, 2026d,c)


32.19.2     What fit quality cannot resolve

The need for a design restriction can be demonstrated without simulated noise. In world A let
Y (t) = 100 + 20X + 5t; in world B let Y (t) = 100 + 20X + 51{X ≥ 0} for both treatment
values. Retain T = 1{X ≥ 0} in each world. Both worlds have exactly the same observed
outcome function, including the jump of 5, but their treatment effects are respectively 5 and
0. World B violates the continuity restriction. No estimator that sees only this observed
law can use fit quality to decide which counterfactual extension is true. For an illustrative
outcome measured in dollars and an action cost of USD 3 per borrower near the cutoff, the
stipulated net effect is USD 2 in world A and minus USD 3 in world B. These are alternative
local mechanisms, not a bank-wide return estimate.(Causal banking proposal, 2026d)
  This ambiguity suggests a useful public-data prototype. Generate known mechanisms with
and without baseline discontinuities, retain the same observed law where possible, and require
the workflow to state which assumption separates them. Public lending or policy datasets can
exercise data preparation and diagnostics, but their public availability alone does not reveal
the missing counterfactual truth. Density or covariate checks can contribute design evidence;
neither should be represented as a proof of every identifying restriction. The evaluation
should score appropriate qualification and refusal as well as numerical recovery. The proposed
prototype can therefore demonstrate whether the interface preserves the question before an
expensive institution-specific study is justified. (Causal banking proposal, 2026c)


32.19.3     Uncertainty is a semantic type, not an array dimension

The inspected Bayesian linear model places Normal priors with scale 50 on coefficients and uses
a Normal likelihood whose noise scale has a HalfNormal prior with scale 1. Its deterministic
mean is the design matrix times the coefficient vector. The experiment adapter extracts
these expected-outcome means; the response-predictive variable has a different interpretation.
The selected RD plotting path uses equal-tail posterior quantiles. Such quantiles condition
on the model and prior: they are not automatically highest-density intervals, robust bias-
corrected frequentist intervals, or uncertainty about the truth of the causal design. The
708                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


sampling path merges stored settings and call-time overrides before invoking the sampler. A
reproducible request consequently needs the actual runtime and sampler configuration, not
just the experiment class name. (pymc-labs contributors, 2026)
   A point-estimation backend introduces a subtler conversion hazard. Its adapter places point
predictions into arrays with singleton chain and draw dimensions. Those dimensions provide
a common representation; they do not manufacture posterior variation. An interval routine
applied mechanically to a singleton would return equal endpoints, but that degeneracy is not
evidence of statistical certainty. The proposed result contract must distinguish a point estimate
from posterior expected outcomes, response-predictive draws and prior draws. Requests for
unsupported uncertainty should return an explicit unavailable result, never a zero-width
confidence claim.(pymc-labs contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal, 2026c)
   Prior scales must follow units as well. In the coordinate change Z = 100X, a coefficient
distributed as Normal with scale 50 in the old score units has scale 0.5 in the new units if
the prior is to describe the same model. Resetting both to the same default numeric scale
changes prior beliefs. Outcome transformations likewise affect coefficient and noise priors.
These observations do not condemn the default model: they explain why a reusable banking
operation must record and review its units, likelihood and prior rather than silently rebuilding
them. (pymc-labs contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal, 2026d)


32.19.4    Support, lifecycle and the choice of an alternative

The selected implementation filters a symmetric bandwidth and optionally removes a donut
around the threshold. At ten or fewer retained observations it warns; the warning is not a
scientifically sufficient qualification rule. A positive donut leaves no observations arbitrarily
close to the cutoff in that selected sample, so threshold predictions rely on the model’s
extrapolation across the excluded region. The default infinite bandwidth also does not
constitute a data-driven local bandwidth choice. A bank wrapper needs left and right support,
row-selection records and an explicit extrapolation flag alongside fitted output. It should
separately check invalid tuning inputs and reversed treatment coding. These are proposed
boundary obligations; the selected source has not been run against those cases here.(pymc-labs
contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal, 2026c)
   Lifecycle is equally consequential for an agent or a long-running service. The source warns
that its frozen design fingerprint does not detect later edits to the experiment’s data and
recommends constructing a new experiment for changed data. Assigning a fresh model resets
result state. Therefore a request should bind an immutable data identity and a formula/design
identity, create a fresh experiment when either changes, and keep configured, built and
fitted states distinguishable. The selected test sources cover RD smoke paths, treatment
normalization and donut masks. Reading those tests is evidence of intended cases, not evidence
that this proposal executed them or obtained calibrated RD intervals. (pymc-labs contributors,
2026)
   For a different uncertainty objective, the inspected R documentation for rdrobust describes
local-polynomial estimators and robust bias-corrected confidence intervals, with separate fitting
and bias bandwidths, polynomial orders, kernels and sharp/fuzzy/kink options. This supplies
a concrete comparison to a Bayesian model contrast. The choice depends on the design, target
and uncertainty statement; the packages should not be interchanged by a generic causal-effect
endpoint. The R source snapshot used for this comparison precedes the stated literature
cutoff. Documentation of an algorithm is not a qualification result for the bank’s sampling
law.(rdrobust contributors, 2026)
32.19. CausalPy at a lending threshold: what a reusable experiment must preserve               709


32.19.5     A scoped reuse decision and the work it creates

The proposal retains CausalPy as a pinned reference and a candidate for a narrow future
integration. Direct production adoption is deferred until the conversion and failure contract
has been implemented and exercised. Porting the model or sampler is not presently justified:
it transfers numerical and maintenance ownership without an established benefit. Rejecting
the entire package is also unsupported by this review. Its root source license is Apache 2.0, its
packaging requires Python 3.12 or later, and its declared direct dependencies include broad
PyMC and PyTensor major-version ranges. These declarations establish neither a resolved
environment nor complete dependency rights. The pinned pre-release version and dated activity
are observable facts; they are not promises of future support.(pymc-labs contributors, 2026;
Causal banking proposal, 2026c)
   The next prototype should exercise cutoff equality, direction reversals, physical unit transfor-
mations, bandwidth and donut masks, changed-data reconstruction, point/posterior/predictive
distinctions and failure retention. A scientific owner must specify the local estimand, continuity
restrictions and the uncertainty claim. An integration owner must preserve data, formula
and prediction identities. A runtime owner must resolve dependencies, retain notices, fix
sampler settings and define diagnostic failures. An evaluation owner must predeclare generated
mechanisms, public-data uses and appropriate recovery and refusal criteria. DiD, synthetic
control, IV and longitudinal uses remain separate design decisions. (Causal banking proposal,
2026c)
   Costs should include environment resolution, model and prior review, sampling time,
failed fits, diagnostic inspection, conversion maintenance and comparison against a simpler
alternative. These costs can be measured on public or generated cases before committing to
bank experiments. The immediate deliverable is a reviewable product choice with an explicit
path to a prototype. Integration remains disabled until executed upstream behavior supports
the proposed contract; the exact examples in this section establish mathematical distinctions,
not a working external adapter.(Causal banking proposal, 2026c)

Functional discovery, symbolic
identification and estimating
equations

33.1      An operation is defined by its mathematical output
A bank may ask a single software team to discover a graph, identify an effect and estimate
the value of an offer. Those requests have different outputs. Discovery can return a selected
directed graph, an equivalence class or a set of candidates. Identification can return an
expression in the observed law or a nonidentification result. Estimation can return a number
with a sampling uncertainty claim. A shared product becomes misleading when it places all
three behind a field named “causal effect” without preserving these types.
  Consider a renewal offer A, retained balance Y and customer characteristics X available
before the offer. A point-treatment question might be

                                       θ = E{Y (1) − Y (0)}.

Here the expectation is over a declared eligible population, not automatically over the customers
who accepted an offer. A discovery algorithm can help propose relationships among X, A, Y ,
but a graph proposal does not by itself establish that Y (a) is identified. Even after identification,
numerical uncertainty depends on how customers were sampled and whether branch, household
or calendar dependence matters. Software comparison must preserve each stage.
   The selected source paths considered here make these differences concrete. DirectLiNGAM
exposes a functional discovery construction; y0 exposes symbolic identification; delicatessen
exposes estimating equations; and statsmodels exposes fitted treatment-effect operations with a
joint GMM representation. These are useful components of a workflow, with different scientific
contracts. The source inspections establish the specific interfaces and branches described below.
They do not establish execution speed, numerical agreement or empirical coverage for this
bank.LiNGAM project (2026b); y0 project (2026b); delicatessen project (2026b); statsmodels
project (2026b)




                                                710
33.2. DirectLiNGAM: a selected order and the meaning of prior knowledge                        711


33.2      DirectLiNGAM: a selected order and the meaning of prior
          knowledge
The inspected DirectLiNGAM class accepts a prior-knowledge matrix, an option to apply it
softly, a measure named pwling, kernel or pwling_fast, and a choice about adaptive-Lasso
pruning. Its fit method checks the prior matrix shape, selects variables sequentially, residualizes
remaining variables, stores a causal order and calls a separate adjacency estimation routine.
The fast branch refers to an additional GPU implementation; the inspected dispatch is not a
performance measurement.LiNGAM project (2026b)
  The motivating functional family can be written
                                            X
                                    Xj =             bjk Xk + εj ,
                                           k∈pa(j)

with an acyclic order and assumptions on the disturbances that distinguish this family from
unrestricted latent-confounded systems. A selected order narrows the model much more than
a CPDAG. That narrowing can be appropriate when its functional assumptions are defensible;
it cannot be justified by comparing only the number of directed edges with a constraint-based
method that deliberately retains ambiguity. The present interface inspection does not verify
the base adjacency estimator or provide a finite confidence statement for the selected order.
   Prior knowledge is particularly consequential. The source describes zero as no directed path,
one as a directed path, and minus one as unspecified knowledge. A bank statement that “offer
acceptance occurs after invitation” is a temporal constraint. It is not necessarily a statement
that a directed path must exist. Likewise, a field absent from the available dataset is not a
justified absent cause. An adapter should retain the original proposition, its variable order, its
path-versus-edge meaning and the evidence supporting it. Transposing an array or treating an
unknown entry as zero can change the scientific problem without causing a matrix-shape error.
  For funding analysis, useful adverse cases include a latent common market shock, near-
Gaussian disturbances and aggregation that mixes several decision times. A comparison should
ask whether the supplied functional model is valid in each case, what output the package
produces when it is not, and whether downstream reporting preserves that limitation. It should
not credit a plausible-looking order as proof of an identified funding response. Constraint-based
CPDAG/PAG methods, alternative functional models and additional experimental information
are substantive alternatives, each requiring its own declared assumptions.
   The appropriate first reuse candidate is an adapter around a reviewed operation. A port
would also require inspection of the inherited base class, total-effect calculations, dependency
terms and behavioral references. The observed MIT license is useful evidence for that in-
vestigation; it is not a completed dependency or maintenance assessment.LiNGAM project
(2026b)


33.3      y0: an expression can fail to exist before estimation begins
The inspected identify_outcomes function accepts an acyclic directed mixed graph, treatment
and outcome variables, optional conditions and an optional ordering. With no conditions it dis-
patches to an ID routine; otherwise it dispatches to IDC. It catches a dedicated Unidentifiable
exception, returning None by default and re-raising when strict=True. This is a useful explicit
boundary between a symbolic expression and a failure to identify the requested query. It is
only the dispatcher: the recursive algorithms and graph validation need their own correctness
review.y0 project (2026b)
712                                                             Causal analysis for a universal bank


  For example, suppose the graph justifies adjustment for pre-offer X. The corresponding
functional, under the relevant causal assumptions, is
                  Z
             θ=       {m1 (x) − m0 (x)} dPX (x),     ma (x) = E(Y | A = a, X = x).

The expression states what must be estimated. It supplies neither fitted regressions nor a
sampling distribution. If instead the graph contains an unblocked latent common cause of A
and Y and no identifying information, another optimizer cannot manufacture this adjustment
functional.
   A product therefore needs separate outcomes for an identified expression, a scientifically
nonidentified query, an unsupported query language and an execution error. Mapping all of
them to a numeric missing value loses essential information. Conversely, turning None into
zero would state that the effect is zero, which is a different scientific claim. The adapter should
bind the graph, query, conditioning variables and expression identities, and retain the original
failure type and diagnostic context.
   Counterfactual coverage also needs care. The existence of an ID/IDC entry point does
not establish support for every nested counterfactual, path-specific effect or transport query.
The proper comparison has a query matrix: adjustment, general intervention identification,
conditional interventions and other counterfactual families. Each cell should be tied to an
inspected algorithm and an independent small-graph reference. Package branding is not
evidence for every cell. A proposed symbolic adapter is justified as a candidate by this source;
general algorithmic correctness and comprehensive query support remain open.


33.4      Stacked equations preserve the nuisance contribution
Delicatessen’s inspected ee_aipw function returns an array of estimating equations rather than
a fitted effect object. Its parameter vector contains the effect, two potential-outcome means
and propensity/outcome coefficients. The documentation and source identify a (3 + b + c) × n
array, where b and c are the numbers of propensity and outcome coefficients. The source
selects logistic or linear outcome regression from the outcome values unless the user forces a
continuous treatment of the outcome. It clips estimated propensity probabilities only when
bounds are supplied.delicatessen project (2026b)
  Writing e(x) = P (A = 1 | X = x) and ma (x) = E(Y | A = a, X = x), the familiar
augmented mean contribution has the form

                                  1{A = a}
             ϕa (O) = ma (X) +             {Y − ma (X)},         p1 = e,   p0 = 1 − e.
                                   pa (X)

This display describes the target contribution; its causal interpretation still requires consistency,
exchangeability and positivity for the declared target. Stacking nuisance equations alongside
equations for the two means makes their joint role explicit. To obtain an estimator one must
solve the system; to obtain uncertainty one must review its Jacobian, covariance construction
and sampling unit. An array of equations is not an already qualified sandwich estimator.
  This distinction matters when borrowers are clustered. If ψi (η) is an estimating-function
contribution, an independent-customer covariance uses individual outer products. A group
                                         P
construction instead uses sums Ψg (η) = i∈g ψi (η) and outer products of those group sums,
under an appropriate group sampling law. Neither replacing a variable name nor using a
generic robust standard error proves the required result for shared calendars or persistent
audit errors. The solver and covariance paths must be inspected and qualified separately.
33.5. statsmodels: population and covariance must survive the interface                       713


   Truncation is also part of the method. Replacing eb by max(ϵ, min(1 − ϵ, eb)) controls
numerical weights but changes the estimating equation. For a bank with almost no offers
in a risk stratum, clipping cannot create the missing counterfactual support. An adapter
must record the requested and applied bounds, how many observations were affected, and the
sensitivity of the answer. A stable answer after clipping is not evidence that positivity held
before clipping.
   The same module exposes instrumental-variable and two-stage least-squares estimating-
equation entries. Their presence identifies a useful review route; it does not establish weak-
instrument inference, longitudinal g-estimation or arbitrary dependent-data support. Reusing
a selected equation as an independent numerical reference may be valuable even when a
complete estimator is not yet an adoption candidate.delicatessen project (2026b)


33.5      statsmodels: population and covariance must survive the
          interface
The inspected TreatmentEffect class describes five methods: IPW, regression adjustment,
AIPW, AIPW with weighted least squares and IPW with regression adjustment. It states that
inference uses a joint GMM representation of the selection model, outcome model and effect
functions. Its current outcome model is documented as linear OLS. The result class exposes
contrasts for an effect and two potential-outcome means.statsmodels project (2026b)
   The population option distinguishes all, treated and untreated observations. These cor-
respond to different questions. With treatment propensity e(X), the all-population target
averages over PX , whereas an effect among treated customers averages over PX|A=1 . Matching
point estimates across packages requires matching this measure as well as the outcome and
treatment coding. An apparent disagreement can be a population mismatch rather than a
numerical defect; apparent agreement in one synthetic sample can conceal the mismatch.
  The class also exposes ps_bounds, defaulting to (0.001, 0.999), and validates strictly interior,
ordered bounds. The selected source says the same bounds apply to point estimates and GMM
moment conditions. That is part of a reproducible comparison, including a comparison with
delicatessen’s optional truncation. Omitting these settings from a bridge specification means
the two programs need not be solving the same estimating equations.
   One especially important detail is the internal _cov_type argument. The inspected class
states that it affects preliminary estimators but that final GMM results correspond to HC0. A
caller cannot infer clustered or calendar-robust final inference merely from passing a covariance-
related keyword. The early module header also contains older prose about unavailable
standard errors, while the class and result implementation contain joint-GMM inference.
Reviewing the current operation resolves more than searching for one favorable or unfavorable
sentence.statsmodels project (2026b)
   For a banking baseline, this makes the candidate scope concrete: a declared point-treatment
population, linear outcome model, explicit propensity bounds and a reviewed sampling law.
Panel or time-series capabilities elsewhere in statsmodels require separate inspection; they
are not established by this one module. The correct reuse decision is provisional numerical
integration and matched equation review, with refusal of unsupported dependence claims.

33.6     A matched comparison must keep the question fixed
A useful comparison first fixes the eligible population, intervention, observed history and
identification assumptions. It then asks each tool for its actual output type: an order, symbolic
expression, equation array or fitted estimate. Small independent references can test the
transitions. For discovery they check order/edge conventions and unresolved alternatives. For
identification they check graph-query expression and failure semantics. For estimation they
check the target measure, nuisance fits, truncation and covariance construction.
   Numerical disagreements should be classified by cause before they are ranked. A different
estimand is a semantic mismatch. A failed root solve is a numerical failure. Nonidentification is
a scientific outcome. An unsupported covariance law is a scope limitation. Timing a successful
branch while discarding the others rewards a system for silently avoiding difficult requests. The
full comparison must retain them and distinguish source inspection from executed behavior.
These distinctions make the software survey useful for design and investment even when it
concludes that a component should be deferred.
Chapter 34

Longitudinal regimes, heterogeneous
effects and continuous doses

34.1      A sequence of decisions changes the software contract
Servicing involves repeated decisions. A customer may receive a reminder, a repayment plan
and later a restructuring offer, with delinquency and contact history changing between actions.
An operation for a single binary treatment does not become a longitudinal estimator by adding
a time column. The target must state which histories the policy observes, when actions occur,
what ends follow-up and how default or account closure changes the outcome.
   Let Lt be information available before action At , and let Ht = (L̄t , Āt−1 ) denote the observed
history. A deterministic regime d supplies At = dt (Ht ). For a terminal outcome Y , its value
is V (d) = E(Y d ). Under the required consistency, sequential exchangeability and positivity
conditions, a g-computation construction can integrate an outcome regression against the
covariate transition laws induced by the intervention. Schematically,
                                     Z                   T
                                         m(¯lT , d¯T )         p(lt | ¯lt−1 , d¯t−1 ) d¯lT .
                                                         Y
                           V (d) =
                                                         t=0

The notation suppresses censoring and competing events, which must be specified in an actual
application. The product follows the intervention history; it is not the factual joint distribution
with treatment columns overwritten afterward.
  The software comparison should therefore examine covariate transitions, intervention call-
backs, history updates, horizon conventions, simulation error and sampling uncertainty. It
should also compare parametric g-computation with weighting and longitudinal targeted esti-
mation on the same policy and population. Disagreement over a default horizon or competing
event can dominate any difference in optimization speed.


34.2      pygformula exposes the history and event choices
The inspected ParametricGformula class accepts individual and time identifiers, time-varying
covariate names/types/models, custom histories, custom fit/prediction functions and inter-
vention descriptions. Its outcome options include survival, continuous end-of-follow-up and
binary end-of-follow-up. Separate arguments address competing events, whether to treat them
as censoring, and a censoring model used for natural-course comparisons.pygformula project
(2026b)

                                                     715
716                                                               Causal analysis for a universal bank


   For servicing, default and account closure should not be casually interchanged. If default
prevents later repayment, a default-free survival probability and a cumulative incidence of
repayment are different targets. If closing an account merely hides future payment information,
a censoring argument is needed. Asking software to treat a competing event as censoring
changes the scientific experiment; the decision requires substantive justification and must
survive the library, CLI and agent interfaces.
   The class documentation sets the number of bootstrap samples to zero by default. The
selected fit path invokes separate bootstrap work when samples are requested. Thus the
presence of bootstrap support does not imply that a particular invocation produced sampling
intervals. Nor does inspection of the caller verify whether the bootstrap resamples individual
histories, calendar blocks or another unit. Those details require inspection of the helper and
qualification under the declared sampling law.pygformula project (2026b)
   Simulation size and bootstrap size address different uncertainties. Conditional on fitted
transition laws, additional simulated trajectories reduce numerical integration error. They
do not provide new bank observations or reduce the uncertainty in estimated transition
parameters. A report should distinguish the number of observed independent sampling units,
simulated histories and bootstrap replications. Treating simulated histories as additional
observed customers would greatly overstate precision.
   The first useful adapter contract therefore preserves customer identity, event and availability
clocks, action timing, history definitions, horizon, competing events and intervention semantics.
It records whether uncertainty was requested and actually obtained. Natural-course reproduc-
tion is a diagnostic: matching factual outcomes does not prove that intervention predictions
are valid. Unsupported actions, missing positivity and impossible history combinations should
remain explicit, even if simulation can generate a numeric outcome.
   The inspected MIT license supports considering reuse. Adoption still needs the complete
simulation and bootstrap paths, environment and dependency terms, and matched comparisons
with R implementations and other longitudinal estimators. Evaluating supplied regimes also
does not establish that an optimal regime has been learned. Policy selection and its evaluation
are additional operations.


34.3     grf: binary heterogeneity and continuous slopes are dif-
         ferent targets
The inspected causal_forest documentation defines a binary-treatment conditional effect
and, for continuous treatment, describes the conditional covariance ratio

                                            Cov(Y, A | X = x)
                                  τ (x) =                     .
                                             Var(A | X = x)
The interface accepts nuisance predictions, clusters and equal cluster weighting, honesty,
subsampling, tuning, grouped trees for uncertainty and a seed for its native random-number
generator. Defaults include 2,000 trees, honesty enabled and no tuning. These options define
a specific statistical and computational operation; they are not optional metadata for a
reproducible comparison.grf project (2026b)
   For binary treatment, an effect conditional on X = x differs from a population average unless
it is integrated over the desired population. For continuous treatment, a slope-like summary
differs from a finite contrast µ(a1 , x) − µ(a0 , x). Calling both outputs “uplift” obscures the
decision. A bank deciding whether to increase an incentive from one specified amount to
another needs the latter contrast, or a justified approximation to it.
34.4. A generalized propensity score is a density component                                    717


  An exact project example makes the discrepancy visible. Suppose the stipulated mean
outcome, in CNY, is
                        µ(a) = 20a − 3a2 ,    A ∼ Unif[0, 2].
This is a synthetic response curve, not a fitted bank relationship. Its covariance slope is

                        Cov(A, 20A − 3A2 )          Cov(A, A2 )
                                           = 20 − 3             = 14.
                             Var(A)                  Var(A)

The finite change from dose one to dose two is instead

                                  µ(2) − µ(1) = 28 − 17 = 11.

Exact moments of the uniform distribution verify both calculations. The difference is a target
difference, not a forest error. Multiplying the slope by a unit change would overstate this
stipulated finite benefit by three CNY. Neither number includes incentive cost unless that cost
is already part of the outcome definition.Causal banking research project (2026bk)
   Cluster options require a similar question about the averaging measure. Giving each branch
equal total weight is different from giving each customer equal weight when branch sizes differ.
The chosen measure affects both the target and the interpretation of heterogeneity. An adapter
should require an explicit population-weight policy and record the effective cluster structure;
it should not silently translate a customer population into an equal-branch population.
   The R wrapper’s seed, threading and native interface make an R/native adapter a nat-
ural candidate. This inspection does not qualify the C++ training, prediction or variance
implementation. The observed repository GPL text also requires a complete licensing and

preferable to a well-specified boundary around the original implementation.grf project (2026b)


34.4      A generalized propensity score is a density component
CausalGPS’s inspected estimate_gps function accepts continuous exposure and covariates, a
formula, normal or kernel density mode and a SuperLearner library selection. In its normal
branch, the fitted exposure mean and a residual standard deviation enter a normal density. Its
kernel branch fits exposure and residual scaling and calls a separate density helper. Returned
fields include identity, exposure, generalized propensity score, fitted mean and scale, and
residuals.CausalGPS project (2026b)
  For continuous A, a generalized propensity score is a conditional density r(a, x) = fA|X (a | x),
not a probability in [0, 1]. Its units depend on the treatment scale. If B = cA for c > 0, then
                                                1
                                  fB|X (b | x) = fA|X (b/c | x).
                                                c
Thus converting an incentive from CNY to hundreds of CNY changes the density numerically.
A bridge that normalizes every “propensity” into a binary probability can corrupt continuous-
treatment calculations. Exposure units and the exact density evaluation points belong in the
contract.
  The observed-density function alone does not provide a dose-response estimator. To
compare feasible doses one needs densities or another identified construction at the relevant
counterfactual doses, an outcome model or weighting/matching procedure, support diagnostics
and an uncertainty argument. Inspecting compute_density, transformation factors and
downstream usage is necessary before concluding that a specific GPS output can be inserted
718                                                             Causal analysis for a universal bank


into another package. The selected source establishes a component and an inspection route; it
does not establish the complete causal workflow.
  A useful banking support diagnostic asks whether both proposed incentive levels occur
with adequate conditional support among the intended customers. The normal model can
assign positive density far beyond observed incentive choices; mathematical positivity of a
parametric density is not evidence of practical overlap. Reporting density values together
with observed range, local support and model sensitivity is more informative than presenting
a successful fit as permission to extrapolate. The observed package declaration is GPL-3;
complete dependency and redistribution choices remain part of adoption review.

The inspected hi_est documentation describes fitting a treatment model, a GPS-adjusted

a documented response-surface comparison; it is not an execution result or a review of every

   The choice of dose grid also matters for decision support. If a business constraint permits

34.6     A common servicing and incentive benchmark
These components should be compared through a small set of declared banking queries. One
query fixes a two-period servicing regime and a terminal repayment outcome. Another fixes a
binary offer and asks for heterogeneity. A third fixes two continuous incentive levels and asks
34.6. A common servicing and incentive benchmark                                           719


for their net financial difference. Each query has its own sampling unit, support requirements,
feasible actions and reference functional. A tool may be appropriate for one and unsupported
for another; that is useful information for architecture.
   The comparison should retain a model that fits factual outcomes but fails an intervention
assumption, a weak-support population, a changed event definition and a changed treatment
unit. It should separately measure statistical error, simulation error, numerical failure and
computation. For longitudinal work, the complete cost includes fitting transitions and histo-
ries, simulating interventions, obtaining uncertainty and reporting diagnostics. Timing one
prediction call omits most of the workflow the bank would operate.
  An eventual selection can combine components: symbolic identification, a longitudinal
engine, a heterogeneous-effect estimator and a dose-response component can coexist behind
one semantic contract. The common contract must preserve their distinct assumptions and
outputs. It should make unsupported requests explicit rather than coercing every query into
the nearest available estimator.
Chapter 35

Interference, allocation policies and
software adoption

35.1     The unit receiving treatment need not be the independent
         unit
A household member’s offer can influence another member’s borrowing, and an outreach
campaign can affect connected firms. In such settings a potential outcome depends on more
than the individual’s own action. Writing only Yi (ai ) hides the policy being evaluated. A
more explicit representation is Yi (ai , a−i ), often restricted through an exposure mapping of
other units’ actions. The mapping and the network are scientific inputs; neither is established
merely by finding matching customer identifiers.
  Two broad software constructions appear in the inspected sources. MossSpider uses a
network and exposure summaries in a network-targeted estimation workflow. Inferference
uses grouped formulas, allocation probabilities and inverse-probability weighting. These
constructions have different observation laws and potentially different targets. Their package
names do not establish interchangeability.MossSpider project (2026); inferference project (2026)
   An allocation policy illustrates the target. Suppose two linked borrowers have binary
outreach actions A1 , A2 , independently assigned with probability p under the proposed policy.
Stipulate the synthetic financial outcome
                              Yi (ai , aj ) = 100ai + 40aj − 30ai aj
in CNY. The first term represents the own-action contribution, the second a spillover and
the last diminishing combined benefit. These are hypothetical structural values, not bank
estimates. Averaging under the allocation gives
                                     V (p) = 140p − 30p2 .
For p = 0.2 the mean is 26.8 CNY; for p = 0.8 it is 92.8 CNY. The allocation contrast is 66
CNY per borrower. Exact enumeration of the four assignments checks the formula.Causal
banking research project (2026bk)
  The direct effect of changing only the individual’s own action is instead 100 − 30aj , or
100 − 30p when the neighbor is independently treated with probability p. This differs from the
total allocation contrast. Reporting one as the other can misprice the campaign even when
every arithmetic calculation is correct. The bank must specify whether it changes one action,
the neighborhood’s allocation or an entire branch policy, and which costs are included in the
outcome.

                                               720
35.2. MossSpider: network semantics are part of the estimand                                 721


35.2     MossSpider: network semantics are part of the estimand
The inspected NetworkTMLE documentation describes expected incidence under a treatment
plan, with Monte Carlo integration over allocations for stochastic plans. It states a direct-
contact interference assumption. The constructor rejects self-loops, noninteger node identities
and nonbinary exposure, creates a relabeled network while retaining original identities, and
constructs an unweighted adjacency matrix.MossSpider project (2026)
   These details matter for bank graphs. A weighted guarantee network is not the same as
an unweighted adjacency graph. Removing weights can turn a small guarantee into the same
exposure contribution as a large one. Relabeling nodes is harmless only when results can
be mapped back to the correct identities. A linkage error can attach the correct numerical
estimate to the wrong firm. Semantic conformance therefore needs an identity roundtrip and
an explicit policy for unsupported weighted relationships.
   Direction requires particular review. The documentation initially describes an undirected
graph but also explains a directed influence convention opposite the graph arrow, and the
selected constructor includes directed handling. This combination requires a concrete test with
an asymmetric small graph. One should not infer direction from a diagram’s appearance or
assume that every library uses source-to-target influence. A two-node one-way example with
distinguishable covariates can determine which neighbor contributes to each exposure summary.
Until the full mapping and fit paths are inspected and exercised, directed bank-network
adoption remains a proposed use.MossSpider project (2026)
  Degree restrictions also change the target. The documentation treats nodes outside a
requested degree range as background, with their exposures unchanged by the intervention.
This can be scientifically useful, but it is not the same as deleting those nodes from the
graph or intervening on all customers. The response must state which nodes are in the target
population, which remain background and how their factual exposure affects the intervention
outcome.
   The source disclaims a missing-data procedure. Missing node attributes, uncertain links and
omitted customers are common in banking, but the existence of an exposure-mapping function
does not solve those observation problems. One must either supply defensible complete data in
the declared regime or develop a separate missingness/linkage construction. Network-targeted
estimation does not automatically qualify ownership or inclusion truth.
  The observed MIT text makes a restricted adapter worth considering. Full adoption requires
the exposure-model and mapping code, targeting step, Monte Carlo integration and variance
calculation, together with actual dependency/runtime checks. A claim of general contagion,
dynamic financial-network equilibrium or arbitrary spillovers would go beyond the selected
implementation evidence.


35.3     Inferference: grouped allocation and numerical integra-
         tion
The inspected interference function uses a formula that identifies outcome, exposure, optional
participation, propensity covariates and a grouping variable. It accepts allocation probabilities
and propensity-model choices including glm, glmer, HLfit and an oracle route. Its documented
causal-estimation path is IPW with naive or robust variance options. The selected code sorts
records by group and checks group count, allocation range and the variance option.inferference
project (2026)
722                                                          Causal analysis for a universal bank


   A group-based model can be appropriate when the scientific design justifies within-group
interference and the required between-group sampling assumptions. It does not become a model
of arbitrary connected borrowers by assigning everyone a group label. Cross-group guarantees
or shared market shocks can violate the intended observation law. The grouping decision
needs domain evidence and should be subjected to sensitivity analysis where boundaries are
uncertain.
   The default logit integrand is restricted to a single random effect in the documented
implementation. The code rejects more than one when that integrand is selected. Thus a
proposal with household and branch random effects needs a different justified integration path;
silently dropping one random effect is a model change. An oracle propensity option is useful for
synthetic reference calculations, but supplied true parameters cannot be counted as evidence
that an estimated-propensity workflow is calibrated.
   There is also a reproducibility issue visible directly in the source. The prose describes
integrate_allocation as defaulting to false, while the inspected function signature sets it
to true. The proper response is to specify and record the argument explicitly, then inspect the
downstream numerical meaning. It is not appropriate to select whichever default gives a more
favorable result after comparing outputs.inferference project (2026)
   For large groups, multiplying many probabilities can create numerical problems. The
documentation discusses an allocation-integration option in this context. Qualification should
include large and uneven groups, boundary allocation probabilities, integration tolerances and
variance derivatives. A successful floating-point result does not prove adequate support; an
underflow error does not prove nonidentification. These are different failure modes and need
different diagnostics.
   The observed DESCRIPTION declares GPL version 2 or later and a dated version. That
informs a dependency review but does not establish the license status of every linked component
or distribution arrangement. A candidate grouped-policy reference should remain distinct
from a decision to embed or port it.


35.4     A common comparison must distinguish network and
         group assumptions
The two packages can be compared on a common small allocation problem only after their
target, exposure mapping and sampling assumptions are aligned. For the two-borrower example,
the exact four-assignment enumeration supplies a transparent functional reference. A larger
benchmark should vary degree, group size, allocation probability, support, observation errors
and dependence. It should include examples where a direct-contact or group restriction is
false.
   Metrics should separate the target mean, direct and spillover contrasts, coverage, finite
availability, Monte Carlo integration error and total cost. Increasing simulated allocations
reduces integration error conditional on a fitted model. It does not create independent groups
or validate the graph. Uncertainty must follow the actual sampling unit; counting nodes as
independent merely because the graph is stored in a table can produce misleading precision.
  The implementation contract should retain the original graph, its direction and weights,
the identity map, intervention population, allocation rule, background nodes and exposure
mapping. A result should be rejected as semantically incompatible if a proposed bridge silently
changes any of these. This requirement is shared by library calls, command-line jobs and agent
tools. An interface can make a scientific restriction visible; it cannot make it true.

  An integration decision is stronger than identifying a promising function. Direct adoption
needs a stable, compatible dependency and scientific contract. An adapter needs semantic
parity and error preservation. A port needs the right to reuse the implementation, an
upstream behavioral oracle, independent references, numerical/statistical equivalence criteria
and a maintenance owner. A research reference can be valuable without becoming a product
dependency. Deferral is justified when these prerequisites are missing; rejection should state a
concrete incompatibility and a revisit condition.
   Commercial comparison must apply the same discipline. Vendor documentation can establish
a dated documented feature, but not measured agreement or operating cost without an executed
comparison. An inaccessible manual cannot support a claim that the vendor lacks an operation.
724                                                         Causal analysis for a universal bank


Our proposed graph-to-effect or banking workflow is likewise not a delivered competitive
advantage. A sound build/buy/partner decision compares the vendor’s documented and
measured state with our implemented, conditional, proposed or absent state, and makes the
missing evidence explicit.

text and package license declarations provide traceable starting points. Dependencies, bundled
data, separate notices, native libraries and the intended distribution arrangement still need
review. A subprocess boundary does not automatically settle licensing obligations, just as a
Python wrapper does not establish that a native operation has been qualified.
   The software survey can therefore guide implementation immediately without claiming
premature adoption. It identifies precise operations, preserves their mathematical meaning and
specifies the evidence needed for the next decision. Runtime, bank validation and independent
scientific acceptance remain separate from these source-grounded provisional choices.
Chapter 36

Graph meaning and uncertainty
through the computational path

36.1      A graph representation carries a scientific commitment
A funding analyst may represent the offer rate, customer response and retained balance by
three columns in a matrix. The columns are measurements; the graph and structural equations
give those measurements causal meaning. An adapter must preserve both. A correctly sized
matrix can still encode every arrow in the wrong direction, and a software object called a mixed
graph can still contain a directed cycle that is inadmissible for the requested identification
algorithm. These errors arise before questions of estimation accuracy.
  The inspected LiNGAM base class stores a coefficient in Btarget,predictor . It fits each variable
against eligible variables earlier in its selected causal order, optionally removing predictors
excluded by the prior-knowledge matrix. The adaptive-Lasso branch and ordinary regression
branch therefore share an orientation convention. A conversion to an edge list must interpret
a nonzero Bjk as k → j. LiNGAM project (2026a)
  For a stipulated banking example, let F denote a funding change, A an offer adjustment
and Y the balance response, in declared normalized units:
                           A = 0.4F + εA ,      Y = 0.1F + 2A + εY .
Holding the disturbance law fixed, a one-unit intervention on F changes A by 0.4 and Y by
0.1+2(0.4) = 0.9. The latter consists of the direct path and the mediated path. Transposing this
coefficient matrix produces a different acyclic graph with no path from F to Y ; its corresponding
total effect is zero. Shape checks and acyclicity checks both pass. An asymmetric intervention
example, rather than a symmetric matrix fixture, detects the semantic error. The arithmetic
is an original project example, not a fit to a bank dataset. Causal banking research project
(2026bj)
   LiNGAM’s inspected estimate_total_effect method regresses the target on the source
and the source’s estimated parents. If the requested target is earlier than the source in the
selected causal order, the method warns and continues. The numerical coefficient remains an
output; the warning records a reason its causal interpretation may be inappropriate. A service
that records only the returned floating-point number would lose that distinction. It should
carry the order, adjustment variables, warning and fitted graph together, and state whether
the request falls within the admitted functional model. LiNGAM project (2026a)
  An alternative based on a CPDAG or PAG has different obligations. Its uncertain arrowheads
cannot be collapsed to LiNGAM’s selected directed order solely to make a common schema

                                               725
726                                                         Causal analysis for a universal bank


convenient. An output union or equivalence-class type is necessary when the method retains
several causal possibilities. The common operation contract should make the statistical and
scientific scope visible without suggesting that one representation is intrinsically superior.


36.2     Recursive identification and the reasons for refusal
y0’s inspected ID implementation first handles the absence of interventions, restricts to
outcome ancestors, adds irrelevant variables to the intervention set and decomposes the graph
remaining after treatment removal into districts. Districts represent connected components of
the graph’s bidirected component. The implementation multiplies and marginalizes expressions
across the relevant recursive subproblems. In the connected-district failure branch it raises
Unidentifiable; separate invariant failures raise RuntimeError. These paths support different
service responses.y0 project (2026a)
   For a mixed graph with A → Y and a latent common cause represented by A ↔ Y ,
observational data alone generally cannot distinguish the intervention response from the
common-cause association. The absence of an identifying functional is a scientific conclusion
within that model class. It is distinct from a malformed graph, an unsupported query or a
failed computation. Treating all four as the same missing value would conceal whether the
analyst needs another measurement, another algorithm or a software repair.
   The inspected IDC routine examines whether a conditioning variable can be exchanged
for an intervention using a rule-2 condition. Its helper removes incoming edges to existing
interventions and outgoing edges from the candidate variable, then delegates a separation test.
If the exchange is allowed, IDC recurses; otherwise it identifies the unconditioned joint query
and normalizes the resulting expression. This establishes the inspected control flow. The
separation routine, expression normalization and all graph-mutilation behavior still require
their own correctness evidence. A claim about the whole algorithm cannot be based solely on
recognizing the names of its steps. y0 project (2026a)
   Graph construction deserves explicit validation at the library boundary. y0’s inspected
constructor sets graph metadata, while directed-edge insertion adds edges and corresponding
nodes to both graph components. These methods do not themselves enforce acyclicity. The
identification wrapper should therefore validate the admitted graph class, query membership,
permissible overlap of treatment/outcome/conditioning sets and any supplied ordering before
invoking the algorithm. The required checks depend on the query language; counterfactual
variables need more than the rules for ordinary intervention queries. y0 project (2026a)
   A useful qualification set should contain an adjustment example, a front-door example, a
genuinely nonidentified example and malformed inputs with known failure types. Variable
renaming should change names while preserving the mathematical expression. Adding an
irrelevant measured variable should preserve the effect after valid marginalization. These are
proposed behavioral checks; they have not been run against the newly acquired source here. A
symbolic expression still needs a numerical estimator and a sampling argument before a bank
can use it to choose an offer.
