39.12.1     Dataiku: the trigger denominator precedes the run denominator

The authenticated Dataiku client identifies version 14.7.3. Its scenario interface explicitly
distinguishes a trigger firing from a scenario run. A manual firing may be cancelled because a
scenario is already running or another trigger fires. The firing’s run identifier is the trigger-run
identifier; it is not automatically the eventual scenario-run identifier. The proposed adapter
should retain both identities and their relation, including the legitimate outcome that no
scenario run is created. This historical client cannot authenticate the separately requested
DSS 15.0.2 server behavior or a complete supported client/server matrix. (Dataiku SAS, 2026)
   The distinction matters even in convenience methods. The inspected trigger-wait method
with no_fail=True returns None when a trigger is cancelled. The surrounding run_and_wait
method passes that option into the trigger wait, then constructs a waiter without checking
whether a run exists. The waiter’s next loop dereferences scenario_run.run. Under the
documented cancelled-trigger condition, this composition therefore has an unguarded None
path. This is a conditional static finding; no native execution, deployment prevalence or
observed customer failure is claimed. A wrapper should handle a cancelled-before-start event
explicitly instead of promising that the permissive flag suppresses every exception. It can do
so without porting the whole scenario engine.(Dataiku SAS, 2026)
   Once a run exists, the client treats the presence of its result as the end of running. It
exposes SUCCESS, WARNING, FAILED and ABORTED outcomes. The strict completion
path accepts only SUCCESS; WARNING is not silently equivalent to it. A permissive return
still needs an explicit consumer decision about outcome and artifact validity. Backoff begins
at 200 milliseconds, grows by a factor of 1.1 and caps each sleep at 15 seconds. This per-sleep
766                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


ceiling does not bound the number or duration of requests. The inspected DSS HTTP delegate
does not pass a timeout argument. These facts motivate a separate observation deadline and
transport policy; they do not establish that every customized client session behaves identically.
(Dataiku SAS, 2026)
  For an authored example, suppose four requested triggers produce one cancellation before a
run, one successful accepted result, one warning result outside the acceptance contract, and
one failed run. There are four requests, three actual runs and one acceptable artifact. If A is
the number accepted, N the number requested and R the number started,

                       pbrequest = A/N = 1/4,      pbstarted = A/R = 1/3.                 (39.12)

Both rates are legitimate when labelled, but only the first retains the cancelled request. With
stipulated costs of USD 2, 4, 3 and 3, total cost is USD 12: USD 4 per started run and USD
12 per accepted artifact. These invented amounts demonstrate a denominator effect, not
vendor prices or bank economics. Three stipulated backoff sleeps total 331/500 seconds. With
three two-second requests, observation takes 3331/500 seconds before other overhead. A sleep
schedule is not a whole-workflow time guarantee. (Causal banking proposal project, 2026ew)
   The same distinction protects statistical evidence. Public-data evaluations that retain only
successful runs describe performance conditional on execution and acceptance. They cannot
represent all requested cases without accounting for exclusions. The proposed CLI/MCP result
should expose request, trigger and run identities, whether execution began, native outcome,
exception and acceptance decision. A caller can then require strict success or inspect a warning
while retaining the original denominator.


39.12.2     SAS: an execution example is not a supported server schema

The pinned SAS repository describes its contents as preview REST examples. Its Job

from failed and directs the consumer to an error member on failure. Artifacts occupy a
provider-specific results map; the log location is separate. Without a supplied expiration, the
example assigns cleanup to the client. A workflow-origin submission can identify its submitting
application. These details support an adapter that follows resource links and preserves provider
identity, execution state, artifacts and lifecycle actions separately. (SAS Institute, 2026j)
  The page identifies document version 5 and an update date of 26 November 2019, not
a SAS server release. A cutoff repository revision authenticates the bytes without making

normative technical originals. (SAS Institute, 2026j)
   For the proposal, a narrow worker can bind the scientific target and data revision to the

39.12.3     Domino: method and failure class govern retry behavior

The earlier Domino HTTP manager supplies a retry policy without overriding its allowed-
method set. Package setup permits Requests at least 2.4.2 and urllib3 at least 1.26.19 but
below 3; the requirements file narrows Requests to the 2.31 line. A selected historical profile
of Requests 2.31.0 and urllib3 1.26.20 fits these inspected ranges, including Requests’ own
range. It is a source-review profile, not a solved environment or deployment lock. A separately
acquired cutoff development revision cannot replace this declared-range distinction.(Domino
Data Lab and HTTP library contributors, 2026)
   Requests retains the supplied Retry object and passes it to the connection pool. In the
selected urllib3 profile, default allowed methods are HEAD, GET, PUT, DELETE, OPTIONS
and TRACE. POST and PATCH are absent. The response retry predicate checks the method
before its status list; the read-error path also applies a method gate. Thus a retryable status list
alone does not imply that a submission POST is retried on those statuses. The connection-error
branch differs: it does not apply that gate. The source classifies connection failures as cases in
which the server is thought not to have received the request, whereas read errors can follow
processing. A blanket claim that POST can never be retried would also be too broad. (Domino
Data Lab and HTTP library contributors, 2026)
   A transport retry, authentication refresh, restart of a known remote job and new scientific
attempt must therefore remain distinct. After an ambiguous submission, the proposed worker
retains the unresolved remote identity and reconciles it under an actual server idempotency
contract. HTTP defaults and response codes do not prove exactly-once execution. The
pinned public api-docs repository does not close this gap: its original README and index
redirect to a mutable latest guide rather than storing a versioned v4/jobs schema. Complete
terminal/error semantics and the meaning of every conflict response remain unresolved.
(Domino Data Lab and HTTP library contributors, 2026)
   The open client remains a plausible integration boundary because it already exposes
identities and job actions. A wholesale port would create a second implementation with the
same unresolved server assumptions. A prototype should first lock full dependencies and
register response-status, connection, read, credential and reconciliation cases. No native trial
or claim that an installation duplicates or loses requests is made here.


39.12.4     Posit: preserve a concrete backend’s unsupported actions

The C++ SDK’s sample Local backend supplies a concrete execution contract. It launches an
asynchronous child, stores its process identifier and publishes Pending. On exit it records the
process exit code, then changes every non-killed job to Finished without requiring zero. A
quickly exiting Pending job can first receive a Running notification. This backend explicitly
does not support cancellation. Kill, stop, suspend and resume use separate signals and state
paths. A proposed adapter must report unsupported Cancel explicitly instead of turning it
into a successful or merely skipped test. (Posit PBC, 2026d)
   Two stipulated records can both say Finished while one has exit zero and a valid artifact and
the other has exit seven and no acceptable artifact. Acceptance needs the appropriate native
state, an allowed exit code where the contract uses one, a request-bound artifact and scientific
validation. A valid refusal may itself be an acceptable scientific answer if the contract declares
that possibility. The example describes invented records, not observed bank jobs.(Causal
banking proposal project, 2026ew)
  Historical documentation limits remain material. The prerequisite guide mentions Work-
bench 1.4, later says 1.4 or greater, and requires a launcher-enabled license and test scheduler.
768                                                            Causal analysis for a universal bank


That statement is not a current support matrix. The build specifies C++11, default Boost
1.83.0 and OpenSSL 1.1.1, which need reconciliation with the older prerequisite table before
building an environment. The Local three-second setting concerns inter-node connections,
not a global causal-job deadline. The SDK notice distinguishes public permissive terms from
software received under a commercial agreement; it does not license Workbench itself.(Posit
PBC, 2026d)
  The smoke-test guide explicitly says its utility does not replace integration testing with
Launcher and the consuming product. It varies privilege and configuration and requires manual
verification of printed responses. Its informal description of Finished as without failure must
not erase the executable exit-code distinction. A future profile should name exact product and
Launcher builds, SDK revision, backend, privilege mode, network/output switches and allowed
exit codes. Unsupported Cancel, races, missing artifacts and failures each retain their own
accounting. This is a testable prototype plan, not completed conformance.(Posit PBC, 2026d)
  These comparisons favor small typed workers around existing execution contracts. The
causal library owns the intervention target, assumptions, observation clock, artifact validation
and failure accounting; platforms retain their native execution vocabulary. Public evidence
now supports a more precise trigger/run distinction, retry classification and exit-code contract.
Historical server manuals, complete schemas, supported product profiles, rights and measured
costs still need their stated evidence. These limits guide the next prototype without claiming
complete commercial-workflow coverage.


39.13      Dataiku as a workflow reference with explicit scientific
           acceptance
Dataiku supplies a concrete orchestration reference for the proposed causal library. The

data and schema digests, method configuration and output identity. An output from the

the causal library, not a claim that the orchestration product lacks a particular undocumented

39.13.1     Trigger, run and result are separate objects

The selected client distinguishes firing a trigger from obtaining a scenario run. Its run method
returns a trigger-fire object; the waiting path polls for the run or cancellation. Cancellation
39.13. Dataiku as a workflow reference with explicit scientific acceptance                     769


can return None when no_fail=True. In the inspected run_and_wait composition, that result
is passed to a waiter without a local None guard, and the waiter dereferences the scenario-run
object. This identifies a conditional static path to qualify and handle in an adapter; no native
cancellation trial or observed server failure is claimed. The proposed adapter should keep
trigger cancelled before run creation distinct from run aborted and from request completed with
a scientific refusal.(Dataiku SAS, 2026)
   Completion and outcome also differ. One inspected path regards the presence of a result as
completion, while its strict outcome check accepts SUCCESS and raises for other outcomes. The
documented outcome set includes WARNING, FAILED and ABORTED; the selected waiter can return
non-success when no_fail is enabled. Official DSS 14 step-control documentation permits
selected failures to be downgraded to warnings and provides conditional steps, including steps
that run regardless of earlier failure. A proposed causal adapter must retain both the original
outcome and the configured exception policy. A warning permitted by workflow configuration
may still be scientifically disqualifying, while a deliberately completed refusal can be a valid
service response. Neither should be silently recoded to a successful effect estimate.(Dataiku
SAS, 2026; Dataiku, 2026b)
   The orchestration boundary must therefore expose a logical request identifier, trigger identity,
run identity and attempt identity separately. Consider an authored example with requests
A, B and C: A has two attempts and two created runs, B has one attempt cancelled before
a run, and C has one attempt and one run. There are three logical requests, four attempts
and three runs. The same run count as request count is accidental; reporting only that count
hides both A’s duplicate execution and B’s cancellation. No idempotence guarantee is inferred
from the selected client. The proposed replay contract reconciles existing run identities and
accepted artifacts before retrying, and records a new execution attempt without creating a
second scientific request.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026fj)


39.13.2     A bounded observer does not prove a stopped computation

The selected backoff helper starts at 200 milliseconds, multiplies by 1.1 and caps each sleep at
15 seconds. A cap on an individual polling delay does not bound the sum of delays. Once the
cap is reached, n further waits consume 15n seconds before any HTTP or server time is added.
The inspected HTTP call does not supply a timeout argument, so this source path does not
establish a whole-operation deadline either. These observations are restricted to the selected
source; they are not an assertion about all server or deployment controls.(Dataiku SAS, 2026;
Causal banking proposal project, 2026fj)
   The proposed contract distinguishes a caller’s observation deadline from a confirmed server
cancellation. In a stipulated timeline, a trigger fires at second 0, a run is created at second
3, observation stops at second 10 and the run completes at second 12. At second 10 the
honest state is completion unknown. An automatic retry could overlap the original run unless
the adapter reconciles its identity and effects. Conversely, a server acknowledgement of a
cancellation request is not accepted as proof that every side effect has been rolled back. The
candidate integration needs bounded client calls, monotonic total budgets, authenticated
terminal-state reconciliation and an explicit policy for late results. The library must be able
to decline a stale artifact while preserving the costs incurred by the original attempt.(Causal
banking proposal project, 2026fj)

   For the banking proposal, the corresponding question might concern whether an account

39.14.1     What the inspected notebook actually does

The selected workflow creates a DataRobot project, models the medication-status target, waits
for the modeling process and retrieves a top model. It inspects predictive metrics including
AUC and log loss, then requests predictions on the feature rows from the study. Original
explanatory text explicitly calls these in-sample predictions and mentions a separate training-
predictions API as an alternative. That statement is preserved as the author’s description; it is
not adopted as a general justification of inference with fitted propensity scores. The correct use
of sample splitting, cross-fitting or another finite-sample/asymptotic argument depends on the
estimator and sampling law. Neither a high AUC nor low log loss alone establishes covariate
balance, positivity, causal identification or calibrated uncertainty.(DataRobot community
contributors, 2025; Causal banking proposal project, 2026fk)
   The notebook selects the predicted class_Yes column, indexes it by row_id, and joins it
to input rows numbered from zero. A proposed adapter must verify class meaning, unique row
identity, ordering, completeness and finite probability range before constructing weights. A
missing row after a left join must not disappear from the denominator. The artifact contract
must identify the project, model, prediction job, feature schema and exact input rows; a generic
prediction table is insufficient to recover the assignment probability for a different treatment
or data version. These are proposed conditions for reuse, not claims of a demonstrated
upstream mismatch. (DataRobot community contributors, 2025; Causal banking proposal
project, 2026fk)
   The selected weight function computes, for binary treatment Ti and fitted propensity ebi ,
the expression

where pb is the empirical treated fraction. Its non-stabilized option replaces the two numerators

39.14.2     Stabilization does not remove a normalized arm’s extreme weights

The notebook’s categorical comparison sums weights by treatment and category, then normalizes
within the treatment arm. Multiplying every weight in one arm by the same positive factor
772                                                            Causal analysis for a universal bank


cancels from this normalized percentage. For an exact authored treated-arm example, let
propensities be 1/4 and 3/4, and outcomes be one and zero. Unstabilized weights are 4 and
4/3. With treated fraction 1/2, stabilized weights are 2 and 2/3. Both normalized means are

                             4 · 1 + (4/3) · 0   2 · 1 + (2/3) · 0  3
                                               =                   = .                     (39.14)
                                  4 + 4/3             2 + 2/3       4

The commonly used weight-concentration diagnostic ESS = ( i wi )2 / i wi2 is likewise un-
                                                                  P         P

changed at 8/5 in this two-row example. Stabilization changes absolute weights; it does
not improve their relative concentration within a normalized arm by itself. This calculation
concerns that displayed normalized functional, not every possible weighting estimator or

   With the same stabilization numerator and a propensity of 1/100, a treated row receives
weight 50. Replacing that propensity by 1/10 would reduce the weight to five, but this is
an explicitly authored hypothetical clipping example, not notebook behavior or a justified
scientific correction. In a servicing study, such an account may represent a rarely treated
stratum whose counterfactual outcome is weakly supported by the data. A useful product

39.15.1     Graph modes and conversions are scientific contracts

The selected Python viewer accepts a causal-graph object, skeleton, dictionary or variable
containing graph data. Its local validator returns variables unchanged and checks the declared
input type for other inputs. The same class changes a non-default editor mode to DEFAULT
when a planar layout is selected, with a warning. The source describes DEFAULT as a
DAG-oriented viewer, PAG mode as displaying additional endpoint types, and RESOLVER as
supporting edge acceptance. A proposed adapter must make such mode changes visible and
verify that the declared graph class and unresolved marks survive conversion. A type check
on a dictionary is not a full proof of causal-graph validity or of the assumptions behind the
displayed graph.(Dara contributors, 2026)
   The inspected editor types distinguish directed, bidirected, undirected and partially marked
edges, including an internal backwards-directed form. These symbols can carry materially
different scientific meanings. A latent-variable analysis that returns unresolved endpoint marks
must not be displayed as one fully directed intervention graph simply because a layout or
editing mode expects it. A round-trip oracle should compare identifiers, endpoint marks,
lag or time information where admitted, graph class, metadata provenance and the target
query, not just whether the picture contains the same number of edges. Unsupported graph
classes should produce an explicit refusal or a clearly labeled visualization-only view.(Dara
contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026fi)
  One selected serialization composition illustrates the need for that oracle. The edge serializer
converts a backwards-directed representation to a directed edge and exchanges its embedded
source and destination. The enclosing graph serializer again exchanges those embedded
endpoints while placing the edge under reversed dictionary keys. For a stipulated internal pair
(A, B), the first exchange yields embedded (B, A); the second yields (A, B), while the outer
keys are (B, A). This is an exact symbolic trace of the selected source branches, not a claim that
an installed frontend has produced a reachable failure. It identifies a concrete consistency test:
the endpoint identifiers inside every serialized edge must agree with its enclosing source/target
keys under the declared convention. Both direct and backwards representations must pass the
same canonicalization test.(Dara contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026fi)


39.15.2     Editing, acyclicity and evidence authority

The default-mode edge-add path checks whether the proposed addition creates a cycle. In the
selected reverse-edge path, the original edge is removed from a graph copy and the original
selected tuple is supplied to the cycle helper; the eventual reducer exchanges the edge direction.
That argument sequence requires a targeted test against the intended reversed graph. An
authored example starts from A → B, A → C, C → B, which is acyclic. Reversing A → B
creates B → A → C → B. Checking the original direction does not certify the reversed one.
The source trace and exact graph calculation motivate a qualification fixture; no upstream
code or native failure was executed. The test must also respect mode-specific semantics: DAG
acyclicity is not an all-purpose validity criterion for every partial ancestral graph. (Dara
contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026fi)
   The selected reducer records edge acceptance in rendering metadata. The Python/JavaScript
wrapper updates its graph variable and invokes the update action, while the editor coalesces
outgoing updates with a trailing 150-millisecond debounce. These mechanisms support
interaction, but a coalesced callback does not by itself provide an authenticated record of
every scientific edit or a transaction approved by a causal backend. The proposed integration
should distinguish a local draft, a submitted change and an accepted model version. A change
prepared for graph version g1 must be reconciled or refused if the current graph is g2 ; it must
39.15. Dara graph applications and the authority to change a causal model                       775


not silently apply to a different model.(Dara contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal
project, 2026fi)
   For the servicing example, an edit that removes a mediator from a proposed adjustment
set changes the analysis contract even if the screen still shows the same nodes. The accepted
record should identify the author or authorized role, evidence, old and new graph digests,
question version, restriction type, reason and resulting identification status. An LLM can draft
the explanation or propose alternatives, while the service preserves unknown versus absent
edges and conditional versus identified effects. Rendering acceptance, authority to edit and
scientific justification are three separate fields. (Causal banking proposal project, 2026fi)

39.16.1     Evidence propagation and intervention are different requests

Consider a bank studying whether a servicing call prevents delinquency. The observed fact
that a customer received a call may reveal prior financial distress. Forcing the call policy
is a different operation. The selected DataSet methods install hard evidence or weighted
observations in a scenario, and the model calculation delegates propagation to the core. The
inspected observation path checks model membership and state/type compatibility. It does
not itself replace the treatment mechanism or remove incoming causal arrows. This describes
the selected method, not a universal claim that another vendor interface cannot represent
interventions.(AgenaRisk contributors, 2026)
   An exact authored example makes the distinction testable. Let latent distress U have
probability one half, let Y = U denote subsequent delinquency, and let the treatment indicator
satisfy P (A = 1 | U = 1) = 4/5 and P (A = 1 | U = 0) = 1/5. Here the call has no effect on Y .
Conditioning gives E[Y | A = 1] = 4/5 and E[Y | A = 0] = 1/5, an observed contrast of 3/5.
Replacing the assignment mechanism by either fixed action leaves E[Y | do(A = a)] = 1/2 for
both actions, giving zero effect. The calculation enumerates the finite law with exact fractions;
it is not an AgenaRisk output. A proposed adapter must distinguish evidence, intervention
and counterfactual requests and refuse a causal interpretation when only an observational
calculation has been justified.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026ex)
   The selected calculation flags also deserve explicit exposure. They request ancestor-network
calculation, retention of tails and zero-mass regions, or the log probability of evidence. The
wrapper maps them to corresponding core flags. Retaining numerical tails is not a proof of
treatment positivity, and the probability of evidence is not the value of a policy. The model,
parameter tables, variable states, observation schema, selected flags and target query must
travel together in the analysis record. Numerical agreement should be checked against an
independent finite-network oracle before a result is interpreted as scientific support.(AgenaRisk
39.16. AgenaRisk: a public wrapper around a licensed causal-modeling workflow                    777


contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026ex)

comparison groups, baseline periods, aggregation weights and uncertainty calculation. The
inspected set includes the Julia DiffinDiffs suite and its interaction-weighted implementation,
DiDInt, and two independent MATLAB repositories. Forty original files are authenticated to
selected pre-cutoff Git trees. Repository searches identify additional candidates, but do not
provide exhaustive coverage of all archives, commercial offerings or languages. No downloaded
package was executed. (Causal banking proposal project, 2026fx)


39.17.1    Resolve suite names, archived aliases and dependencies

The selected DiffinDiffs repository is a suite: its short entry module reexports DiffinDiffsBase
and InteractionWeightedDIDs. The older standalone InteractionWeightedDIDs repository
explicitly points to the suite’s monorepo and says that development moved there. It should
not count as a second independent estimator. At the selected 10 April 2024 monorepo commit,
the suite declares version 0.2.0 and its interaction-weighted component declares 0.3.2. The
latter names FixedEffectModels, FixedEffects and Vcov dependencies with version ranges. The
previously inspected FixedEffectModels 2.1.0 IV/FE source is a useful separate comparator,
but cannot silently replace this component’s declared 1.10 compatibility line. A resolved
environment must identify the actual delegates before native comparisons. The inspected Julia
notices are MIT-style grants; downstream data and dependency rights remain separate.(Selected
repository contributors, 2026b; FixedEffects/FixedEffectModels.jl contributors, 2026)
  The treatment type declares absorbing binary treatment, allowing effects to evolve over
time. Its excluded relative periods define an omitted baseline or other sample restriction.
Separate parallel-trend types specify never-treated or not-yet-treated comparison relations;
an unspecified type suppresses trend-specific sample alterations. These declarations organize
39.17. Julia and MATLAB panel estimators: matching the decision before the interface         779


an analysis under assumptions. They do not prove parallel untreated trends, absence of
anticipation or absence of spillovers between branches. A service must preserve which relation
was requested and distinguish an asserted restriction from one contradicted by the recorded
treatment history. (Selected repository contributors, 2026b; Causal banking proposal project,
2026fx)
   For example, a servicing regime with history (0, 1, 0) has first adoption in period two, but
reconstructing treatment from that date as an absorbing policy produces (0, 1, 1). The last
observation changes meaning. The adapter must refuse that conversion or select a method
that explicitly models reversals; it cannot quietly reinterpret the policy. Similarly, dropping
the period immediately before adoption is not by itself a justification for an anticipation
restriction. The interval during which staff or customers can respond must be part of the
banking question.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026fx)


39.17.2     Aggregation and fixed effects are substantive choices

The Julia interaction-weighted source constructs cohort/relative-time cells, records their counts
and sample-weight totals, estimates coefficients and retains their covariance. Its aggregation
routine constructs a weight matrix W and returns W ′ βb with covariance W ′ Vb W . The inspected
code normalizes cohort weights within each relative-time group. Consequently the grouping
variables, retained coefficient subset and returned weight matrix are part of the estimand, not
formatting details. The source offers optional cell-level least-squares weights, which can help
reconcile why specifications disagree.(Selected repository contributors, 2026b)
  If two cohort effects are one and four units of prevented loss, equal cohort weights give 5/2,
while weights (3/4, 1/4) give 7/4. A bank allocating equal attention to regions and a bank
weighting every treated account equally may reasonably choose different targets. Their results
should not be labeled inconsistent until the targets agree. The proposed output therefore
carries the cohort-time cells, weight basis, missing-cell exclusions, aggregation matrix and
monetary conversion alongside the estimate.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026fx)
   An exact six-cell example also prevents a generic two-way fixed-effects regression from being
treated as a universal staggered-adoption estimator. Two cohorts have treatment histories
(0, 1, 1) and (0, 0, 1), untreated outcomes zero, and observed outcomes (0, 1, 4) and (0, 0, 1).
Every realized treated effect is positive, with average two. Residualizing treatment against
cohort and period effects gives a regression coefficient of −1/2. The independent fraction
calculation establishes the algebraic example, not package performance. There is also no
untreated comparison group left in the final period, so a modern cohort estimator must not
invent support for that cell. Scientific identification and numerical regression output are
separate acceptance questions.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026fx)
   The inspected Julia default covariance is heteroskedasticity-robust; cluster covariance is
a separately selected option. Fixed-effect singleton removal and missing cluster identifiers
can change the estimation sample. The residualization helper warns on nonconvergence and
records convergence information. The proposed wrapper should expose that state and enforce
its declared acceptance rule, rather than interpreting every returned coefficient as a qualified
solution. Cluster unit, small-cluster treatment, dependence assumptions and the full sample
mask must be retained.(Selected repository contributors, 2026b)


39.17.3     DiDInt separates covariate adjustment and inference choices

The selected DiDInt revision of 7 June 2026 declares version 0.9.6 and Julia 1.10 compatibility.
Its interface accepts treatment dates or a cohort variable, covariates, aggregation and weighting
780                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


choices, a not-yet-treated control option, heteroskedasticity corrections, jackknife settings and
randomization repetitions. The inspected implementation constructs state-time differences
after covariate adjustment. Missing outcomes, group identifiers, times or selected covariates
are dropped with warnings. Such filtering needs an exported sample ledger because eligibility
can differ across effects and inference procedures.(Selected repository contributors, 2026a)
   The selected least-squares helper catches solve failures and returns missing, while the covari-
ance helper explicitly inverts the cross-product matrix and implements HC0–HC4 corrections.
Those are distinct paths with distinct rank and leverage conditions; a successful mean estimate
does not establish valid covariance. Randomization inference checks the availability of required
state/difference pairs, limits requested permutations to the number of unique assignments,
and permutes state and treatment-time assignments. Exchangeability of those assignments
must be justified by the design; permutation machinery alone does not randomize a historical
banking rollout. (Selected repository contributors, 2026a; Causal banking proposal project,
2026fx)
   One conditional source detail warrants a focused test. In the branch for an edge-case
calculation combined with the additive covariate setting, the code warns that the option is
unavailable and evaluates edgecase == false, an equality expression, rather than assigning
false. Other branches can change the flag separately. This is a static branch-level finding, not
an observed native failure. Qualification must test the actual option combination and resulting
status before deciding whether the surrounding conditions make it reachable or consequential.
(Selected repository contributors, 2026a)


39.17.4     MATLAB implementations need their own algorithm and rights
            audit

The selected DiDToolbox source declares MATLAB 2021+ and the Statistics and Machine

loadable toolbox or public Git repository does not establish rights to adopt or redistribute it.
It is also an independent repository, not evidence that its estimators are native MathWorks
capabilities or available in GNU Octave.(Selected repository contributors, 2026c)
   The method named IW delegates to the CS engine, selects its unconditional path and
packages the returned cohort-time/event-time aggregates. The source labels a cohort-share
option as its intended IW weighting. This is a concrete implementation route that must
be compared with the target specification; the name alone does not establish finite-sample
equivalence to the Julia regression estimator. The selected CS path defines a baseline g − ∆ − 1,
uses not-yet-treated controls satisfying G > t + ∆ while excluding the target cohort, and skips
cells without the necessary baseline, treated observations, comparison observations or positive

   The selected first-treatment helper takes the earliest observed treatment indicator. That
date alone cannot establish irreversibility, and its mapping back to rows needs an ordering
fixture. The basic panel validator checks columns and types, rather than supplying a full
causal-design audit. A separate sensitivity helper solves linear programs over smoothness or
relative-magnitude restrictions using pre-period coefficients, marginal standard errors and
an optional target standard error. Its interface does not take a full coefficient covariance
matrix. Its deterministic extrema, pointwise intervals and selected numeric solver must not be
presented as the same inferential object as a separately qualified joint-uncertainty procedure.
39.18. Comparing R synthetic controls: donor information, uncertainty and failure denominators 781


Failed solver cells remain missing in its initialized output. (Selected repository contributors,
2026c)
   The second MATLAB candidate, FDiD, has a GPLv3 notice and a selected factorial
interaction implementation. Its direct within transformation subtracts unit and time means
and adds the overall mean once. On the unbalanced rows (A, 1, 1), (A, 2, 2) and (B, 1, 3),
that formula produces residuals (−1/2, 1/2, 0), whose time-group sums are nonzero. Thus
the formula is not a general two-way projection for arbitrary unbalanced panels. This exact

   There is also a conditional coefficient-label issue with two covariates. The inspected design
concatenates all Xj Z columns before all GXj Z columns, while its name loop alternates those
two names for each covariate. For two covariates, positions four and five consequently receive
the other term’s name in the selected construction. A pseudoinverse can address a numerical
linear system without correcting such semantic labeling or establishing identification. The
qualification suite must compare every coefficient’s column identity, rank status, finite-cluster
correction and target meaning. The paper linked by the repository is not newly admitted as
an inspected scholarly source in this software-only review. (Selected repository contributors,

39.18      Comparing R synthetic controls: donor information,
           uncertainty and failure denominators
A regional banking policy leaves a fundamental comparison problem: what would the treated
portfolio have earned without the intervention? Choosing an R package does not answer
that question. The proposal needs to distinguish the counterfactual restriction, the numerical
782                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


construction, the source of uncertainty and the unit over which success is counted. The
preceding reviews of Synth, augsynth, scpi, fect, gsynth and synthdid supply complementary
reference implementations. This comparison adds inspected inference paths, the selected Synth

into permission to integrate a package. (Jens Hainmueller and Alexis Diamond, 2026; Eli

39.18.1     One banking target, several distinct constructions

Let Y1t (0) denote untreated revenue for the intervention region, Yjt the observed donor
outcomes and wj weights chosen from the declared information available before treatment.
                                  P
A fitted comparison is Yb1t (0) = j wj Yjt , possibly augmented by a prediction model. The
reported gap Y1t − Yb1t (0) is a causal effect only under restrictions that connect the fitted
comparison to the untreated potential outcome. Donor eligibility, measurement revisions,
anticipation and interference therefore belong in the request, rather than being inferred from a
successful optimization.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026gj)
   The constrained Synth fit and ridge augmentation solve different problems: nonnegative
weights summing to one restrict extrapolation, whereas an augmentation can alter weights
beyond that set. The selected gsynth version delegates estimation to fect, so their appearance
in a catalog does not create two independent numerical engines. Factor or matrix-completion
restrictions and target aggregation differ from a single constrained donor portfolio. The original
synthdid implementation assumes its declared block-adoption layout; it cannot be renamed as
a general staggered estimator. scpi separates uncertainty in fitted coefficients from uncertainty
in a future untreated outcome. None of these distinctions can be resolved by choosing the
smallest pretreatment residual.(Jens Hainmueller and Alexis Diamond, 2026; Eli Ben-Michael,
2026; Yiqing Xu and package contributors, 2026b; Yiqing Xu and Licheng Liu and Ziyi Liu and
Ye Wang and Tianzhu Qin and Shiyun Hu and Rivka Lipkovitz, 2026; synthdid contributors,
2024; Matias D. Cattaneo and Yingjie Feng and Filippo Palomba and Rocio Titiunik, 2026)
   An exact authored example makes donor contamination visible. Equal weights on donor
revenues 80 and 120 thousand USD give an untreated prediction of 100. Observed treated
revenue of 120 gives a gap of 20. If the intervention also increases the second donor’s observed
revenue to 140, the same weights give 110 and a gap of 10. Weight fitting has not discovered
or corrected the spillover. The scientific role must justify the donor exclusions or introduce a
model of the exposure mechanism. These numbers are a stipulated example, not an observed
banking experiment.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026gj)


39.18.2     Numerical termination is information that the adapter must retain

The newly inspected kernlab 0.9-33 source is pinned to its August 2024 CRAN mirror revision.
Its description declares GPL-2 and compilation requirements; the retained copyright file
distinguishes R and native-code authorship. This is a selected possible delegate, not proof of
the runtime resolved by every Synth installation. The ipop loop computes primal and dual
infeasibility, objective values and a significant-figure measure. It breaks when the latter is at
least the requested value, while its final converged label requires a strict inequality and an
iteration count below the limit. Thus an exact equality is a conditional distinction between
two source predicates. No native equality event or package failure was observed.(cran/kernlab
39.18. Comparing R synthetic controls: donor information, uncertainty and failure denominators 783


contributors, 2024)
   The delegate returns primal and dual variables and a status field. Earlier Synth wrapper
observations about extracting the primal solution therefore must not be generalized into a claim
that the underlying solver has no diagnostics. The proposed adapter retains requested and
resolved tolerances, termination status, feasibility residuals and the objective before admitting
an output. It also verifies the original donor and feature order. Neither a status label nor a
small objective proves counterfactual identification. Complete optimx, rgenoud, linear-algebra
and installed-artifact qualification remain separate work.(cran/kernlab contributors, 2024; Jens
Hainmueller and Alexis Diamond, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026gj)


39.18.3     Tidy preparation does not make placebo ranks exchangeable

The selected tidysynth 0.2.0 revision is from May 2023. Its MIT notice is retained, together
with the declared kernlab, optimx and rgenoud dependencies. The source constructs treated
and placebo data configurations, classifies dates at or before the supplied intervention time
as pretreatment, and uses the first fitted predictor weights for later placebo configurations
when no custom weights were supplied. Predictor weights and donor weights are different
objects: sharing the former is an algorithmic choice that must be retained in a compari-
son.(edunford/tidysynth contributors, 2023)
   The internal fitting file explicitly credits a Synth implementation as its origin. The package-
level MIT notice must therefore be reviewed alongside the provenance and applicable terms of
reused code; it cannot by itself settle distribution rights for that file or its dependencies. This
source observation is a rights-review task, not a finding of infringement. (edunford/tidysynth
contributors, 2023; Jens Hainmueller and Alexis Diamond, 2026)
   The inspected significance routine computes post/pre mean-squared-error ratios, sorts them
in descending order, assigns sequential row numbers and reports rank divided by the number of
rows. Its returned column name does not establish a valid assignment distribution. For ratios
(4, 4, 1), sequential ranks give (1/3, 2/3, 1); the inclusive upper-tail frequencies are (2/3, 2/3, 1).
A tied treated observation can therefore receive different sequential ranks depending on its
ordering. This is an authored arithmetic witness for a qualification test, not a native benchmark
or a universal prescription for inference. Zero pretreatment error, failed fits and post-outcome
donor selection also require explicit policies. (edunford/tidysynth contributors, 2023; Causal
banking proposal project, 2026gj)
   The proposal retains tidysynth as a preparation and comparison candidate. Adoption or a
port would first need matched intervention-date conventions, predictor sharing, nested-data
identities, failure handling and a justified placebo law. The current source comparison does
not grant that admission. (Causal banking proposal project, 2026gj)


39.18.4     Time resampling and unit resampling answer different questions

The selected scinference development version 0.0.0.9000 is pinned to May 2021. Its description
contains the literal license declaration use_gpl3_license(), while the repository contains
genuine GPL-v3 text. Both are retained rather than silently normalizing the metadata. Its
estimator delegates constrained fitting to limSolve or CVXR and also offers a difference-in-
differences residual construction. Numerical status and rights for those delegates are not
settled by the wrapper inspection. (kwuthrich/scinference contributors, 2021)
   The conformal branch adjusts the post-treatment observations by a proposed null effect,
refits the selected model and compares residual statistics. One route cycles contiguous windows
through a doubled residual vector; another uses random permutations and the correction
784                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


(1 + E)/(B + 1) for E exceedances among B draws. With B = 19 and no exceedances,
that expression is 1/20, whereas a raw frequency is zero. In a five-shift example whose
observed statistic is the unique maximum, including its own shift gives 1/5. These support
calculations do not prove exchangeability under common regional shocks or serial depen-
dence.(kwuthrich/scinference contributors, 2021; Causal banking proposal project, 2026gj)
   The pointwise interval routine inverts a supplied finite grid and returns its accepted mini-
mum and maximum. If only 0 and 2 are accepted, the interval hull also contains the rejected
value 1. If no grid value is accepted, no finite interval is certified. The contract should
retain the accepted set, grid range, empty-set condition and truncation warning. A point-
wise hull is not automatically a joint statement about an entire revenue trajectory. The
alternative cross-fit t procedure partitions pretreatment dates and uses a stated degrees-of-
freedom calculation; its source comment is not a theorem validating every banking dependence
law.(kwuthrich/scinference contributors, 2021; Causal banking proposal project, 2026gj)
   Further inspection of the retained augsynth source shows why resampling labels alone are
insufficient. Its time jackknife removes pretreatment dates, refits and forms prediction-error
bounds before shifting back to the treatment-effect scale. Its single-estimate unit jackknife
selects controls using weights rounded to three decimals and, with multiple treated units,
includes those treated units. The variance multiplier uses the full row count, which differs from
the number of selected leave-one-out fits. For two replicate effects 0 and 2, the sum of squared
centered values is 2; a full count of four gives 3/2 under the displayed multiplier, whereas
the two-replicate multiplier gives 1. Neither calculation proves which sampling experiment
is appropriate.(ebenmichael/augsynth contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project,
2026gj)


39.18.5    Microdata matching and missing permutations need separate
           records

The selected microsynth 2.0.50 source is pinned to April 2025. Its description declares GPL-
3 and imports survey, kernlab and LowRankQP among other packages. Unlike treating
every region as a single donor column, it supports matching aggregates from more granular
data. The inspected weighting routine selects LowRankQP when available and otherwise
ipop, can change among backup matching models, and returns model choices, mean-squared
errors and retained-group indicators. An adapter must preserve those changes rather than
reporting only a final weight vector. Full delegated calibration and solver rights remain
unqualified.(ssdavenport/microsynth contributors, 2025)
   The selected routine filters permutation groups by a matching-error rule. Its permutation
helper replaces infinite statistics with missing values, counts missing entries, and averages a
comparison over finite entries; callers then apply lower-, upper- or two-sided transformations. A
result must therefore retain both the requested draws and the finite denominator, the filter and
the tail convention. Consider 19 requested draws, ten finite statistics, nine unknown results and
two finite exceedances. The retained frequency is 2/10, but the all-request exceedance fraction
could lie between 2/19 and 11/19 depending on the unknown results. These are bounds on
an incomplete frequency, not calibrated p-values. Silent deletion cannot establish the missing
classifications.(ssdavenport/microsynth contributors, 2025; Causal banking proposal project,
2026gj)

39.18.6     A public qualification program with explicit unresolved coverage

The source evidence supports distinct reference roles: constrained donor fitting, augmentation,
factor reconstruction, block-adoption estimation, prediction uncertainty, preparation, null-
based time inference and granular matching. None deserves blanket rejection solely because
it uses another target. A proposed adapter should select only a declared regime and report
the reason for refusing incompatible requests. Direct adoption remains conditional on rights,
complete delegates, source-to-artifact identity and native conformance. A broad port lacks a
demonstrated benefit until those comparisons are measured.(Causal banking proposal project,
2026gj)
   Public or generated experiments can first test stable donor identities, spillovers, pretreatment
missingness, tied ranks, empty grids, failed draws, solver boundaries, backup-model changes
and dependence-sensitive uncertainty. The scientific role owns the target and observation law;
the adapter role owns conversion and refusal; the environment and rights role owns the actual
distribution; the evaluation role freezes the tests and all denominators. An illustrative 9,000
USD cost for 300 attempted, 240 conformant and 150 useful requests yields 30, 37.5 and 60
USD respectively. These are planning inputs, not software quotations, measured performance
or bank returns. (Causal banking proposal project, 2026gj)
   The bounded complementary search returned 40 unique repository leads across three queries,
with additional pages uninspected for two searches. Candidates such as GeoLift, penalized and
distributional approaches remain discovery leads until their primary texts and dependencies
are reviewed. The selected coverage is therefore inconclusive. Unknown counterfactual stability,
valid assignment laws and arbitrary serial dependence have no universal repair through a
package choice. The remaining source, native, visual and independent acceptance obligations
remain explicit.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026gj)


39.19       Python synthetic controls: aligning time, targets and
            uncertainty before integration
A bank comparing a regional intervention across Python implementations must first agree on
which observation is treated, which donors remain eligible, and what uncertainty the reported
interval describes. Similar package names and similar fitted curves can conceal different
answers. This comparison extends the inherited CausalPy review to its synthetic-control
path and inspects selected pysyncon, SparseSC and SyntheticControlMethods originals. The
evidence establishes bounded source contracts and proposed public tests; it does not establish
native parity, calibrated inference or adoption rights. (Causal banking proposal project, 2026gi)


39.19.1     One intervention date needs one explicit observation clock

The pinned CausalPy 1.0.0rc1 source divides observations into dates strictly before treatment
and dates on or after treatment. It builds labeled control and treated matrices, checks
observation-index equality when subtracting predictions, and forms cumulative impact by
summing rows. The treatment-date validator checks missingness, broad index type and
timezone-awareness compatibility. These guards do not by themselves define a business
exposure, prove that the donors are untreated or convert irregular observations into equal-
duration economic quantities.(pymc-labs/CausalPy contributors, 2026b)
  The selected pysyncon 1.7.0 placebo helper uses label slices ending and beginning at the
supplied treatment time. On a monotonically indexed series whose cutoff label exists, the
786                                                            Causal analysis for a universal bank


displayed formulas include that label in both sums, while the post denominator is total rows
minus the inclusive pretreatment count. This is a conditional source-level boundary issue for
qualification, not an observed run. With gaps (1, 1, 4, 2) at dates one to four and cutoff three,
the literal overlapping formula gives 10/3. An inclusive-pre/exclusive-post split gives 2/3; a
strict-pre/inclusive-post split gives 10. An adapter must map the bank’s event clock into an
explicit partition rather than forwarding an ambiguous date unchanged. (sdfordham/pysyncon
contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026gi)
   Calendar aggregation is equally substantive. Two observed effects of two units sum to
four. If they are rates covering durations one and three, the duration-weighted total is eight.
Neither quantity follows from a date index alone. For a cumulative uncertainty statement,
covariance also matters: two effects with variances one and covariance one have sum variance
four, whereas an independence shortcut gives two. These exact authored examples specify
target and dependence questions; they do not diagnose a bank dataset. (Causal banking
proposal project, 2026gi)


39.19.2     CausalPy distinguishes conditional expectations from future obser-
            vations

The selected experiment supports a Bayesian weighted-sum model and a scikit-learn route.
Its constructor prepares and checks data; fitting is an explicit later lifecycle operation. The
Bayesian model declares Dirichlet simplex weights and can scale a stock noise prior from
pretreatment data unless the user supplies a prior. The inspected adapter extracts draws
of the conditional expectation mu; impact subtracts those expected outcomes from observed
treated outcomes. The scikit-learn weighted-proportion delegate instead uses a constrained
numerical point fit. These are different uncertainty objects even if their point estimates are
close.(pymc-labs/CausalPy contributors, 2026b)
   Suppose observed revenue is 120, conditional-mean draws are 90 and 110, and separately
stipulated predictive draws are 70 and 130. The corresponding effect draws are (30, 10) and
(50, −10). The second includes a different source of variation. Neither is automatically an
identified causal effect distribution or a frequentist confidence interval. A result must identify
the backend, likelihood, priors, conditioning set, draw diagnostics, observation clock and
whether the target is a mean or a future realized outcome. A donor-correlation or convex-hull
warning is diagnostic evidence, not proof of the counterfactual restrictions.(pymc-labs/CausalPy
contributors, 2026b; Causal banking proposal project, 2026gi)
   The proposed CausalPy use is a labeled Bayesian/point-estimation reference with explicit
lifecycle and target contracts. Integration remains conditional on complete installed depen-
dencies, model diagnostics, public conformance and refusal behavior. Retaining coordinate
assertions is useful, but those assertions cannot supply the bank’s intervention and spillover
truth. (Causal banking proposal project, 2026gi)


39.19.3     pysyncon provides several estimators, with distinct validation obli-
            gations

The September 2026 pysyncon revision retains an MIT notice and declares version 1.7.0. Its
constrained Synth path scales predictors across treated and donor columns, chooses predictor
weights through an outer optimization, and solves a bounded sum-to-one donor problem. The
selected inner and outer paths extract optimized values without a local success-status gate. This
does not imply that SciPy has no diagnostics; the proposed adapter must retain termination
and feasibility evidence from the exact resolved solver. Custom predictor metrics, degenerate
39.19. Python synthetic controls: aligning time, targets and uncertainty before integration   787


scales and row/column identities need separate tests.(sdfordham/pysyncon contributors, 2026)
   Its augmented path requires the selected pretreatment periods to be exactly the dates
before the first post period. The robust path applies a singular value decomposition to donor
outcomes over the supplied full date range before fitting weights using the pretreatment segment.
Post-intervention donor information can be appropriate for retrospective reconstruction under
declared assumptions; it is not available for a prospectively frozen decision. Its penalized
donor problem adds a pairwise discrepancy term. These alternatives deserve comparison
at matched targets and clocks, not interchangeable labels or a generic robustness claim.
(sdfordham/pysyncon contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026gi)
   The conformal interval route adjusts an outcome under a candidate effect, refits and compares
absolute residuals. A numerical search returns lower and upper endpoints when its step shrinks
sufficiently, and raises after the maximum iteration count. This is a numerical search around a
discrete test, not proof that every possible accepted effect forms a connected set. The interval
routine refits the supplied estimator during its calculations; the visible wrapper does not
restore the original fitted state. A public test should therefore check both reported intervals
and subsequent calls to the same estimator, along with failed searches, insufficient pre-periods
and exact solver status.(sdfordham/pysyncon contributors, 2026)
   The placebo helper excludes the treated unit from its exceedance numerator but retains
it in the denominator. With two donor ratios and a treated ratio strictly above both, that
formula is zero, while including the observed assignment gives 1/3. This arithmetic identifies
the convention that must be declared; it does not establish the appropriate assignment law.
The source’s method label cannot replace a justification of which assignments are exchange-
able.(sdfordham/pysyncon contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026gi)
   The plotting helper can filter poor-fit placebo curves, whereas the inspected p-value helper
uses the stored gaps without that display filter. A plot and a test can therefore use different
populations unless an adapter makes the distinction explicit. This requires denominator
reconciliation, not an assumption that a visually excluded donor was removed from inference.
(sdfordham/pysyncon contributors, 2026)


39.19.4     SparseSC separates matching, retrospective fitting and placebo
            aggregation

The selected SparseSC revision is from March 2024 and its retained version file declares
0.2.0. The repository contains an MIT license; packaging also contains a BSD classifier. Both
declarations remain in the record and require reconciliation with the actual distribution. The
selected effect routine distinguishes retrospective and prospective designs, converts treatment
times, and forms local samples. Its finite donor-time rule requires a donor to be treated strictly
after treatment time plus the supplied horizon; never-treated encodings follow a separate
branch. Thus at time five and horizon three, a cohort treated at eight is excluded while
one treated at nine is eligible under that source rule.(microsoft/SparseSC contributors, 2024;
Causal banking proposal project, 2026gi)
   The date-conversion helper returns a missing index when a supplied treatment date is absent
from the outcome calendar. The sample-mask helper classifies nonfinite treatment indices as
controls. A conditional conversion path can therefore collapse an unmatched date into the
same encoding as never-treated status. The proposed adapter refuses unmatched intervention
dates before constructing donors; native reproduction and complete caller validation remain
open.(microsoft/SparseSC contributors, 2024)
  The routine can use held-out control folds to form placebo predictions. That algorith-
mic separation does not establish exchangeable assignments, donor stability or absence of
788                                                            Causal analysis for a universal bank


common shocks. The source also scales some effects by pretreatment root-mean-square er-
ror and optionally treatment size. Zero scaling denominators, changing target weights and
nonfinite requests require declared refusal and counting rules. The reference contract retains
requested and realized samples, treatment horizons, folds, random state and every scaling
factor.(microsoft/SparseSC contributors, 2024)
   The placebo helper averages treated effect vectors, separately averages unit-level root-mean-
square effects, and compares analogous control combinations. These are different targets: two
unit trajectories (1, −1) and (−1, 1) have average unit RMS one but RMS of their average
trajectory zero. If combinations exceed a cap, the helper samples subsets; distinct draws
can repeat a subset. Its default p-value helper adds one to both the exceedance count and
the denominator. Confidence interval order statistics depend on the available combination
count. A result should preserve Monte Carlo versus exhaustive enumeration, duplicate subsets,
finite counts and target identity rather than reporting a bare p-value. (microsoft/SparseSC
contributors, 2024; Causal banking proposal project, 2026gi)


39.19.5     SyntheticControlMethods exposes another optimization and prove-
            nance contract

The pinned October 2021 source declares version 1.1.17. Its license file and source
headers specify Apache 2.0 while packaging has an MIT field and an Apache classifier.

a pairwise discrepancy penalty; outer optimization can start from multiple predictor
weights.(OscarEngelbrektson/SyntheticControlMethods contributors, 2021)
   The selected optimizer prints a success flag only when verbose and separately checks
for a result attribute. Existence of that attribute is not a successful termination certifi-
cate. The inner solve maps caught exceptions to infinite loss, and the original fit updates
a stored best loss. The in-space placebo path stores the donor weights from its objective
calls and requests an automatic penalty. Qualification must inspect whether the final placebo
represents the intended optimum under the same penalty and initialization policy as the

   Direct adoption of this version is deferred until result identity, status, placebo equivalence,
artifact terms and maintenance choices are resolved. Its constrained and penalized objectives
remain useful references. Porting the entire implementation is not justified merely to avoid
a packaging question; a limited independent oracle can instead verify a declared quadratic

39.20       Synthetic controls across language boundaries: solver,
            interface and inference contracts
A regional lending policy can be evaluated through an R worker, a Julia estimator, a C++
numerical component or a Java service, but these choices do not represent the same scientific or
operational commitment. A repository’s dominant language may describe its generated code or
service layer rather than an exposed synthetic-control estimator. The bank must preserve the
donor population, intervention clock, fitted target, uncertainty population and failed requests
across every boundary. This comparison supplements the R and Python analyses with selected
original implementations and an explicit decision about what each source supports.(Causal
banking proposal project, 2026gh)


39.20.1     Choose an interface after specifying the banking contrast

Let y1t be revenue in the treated region and let yjt denote revenue in eligible donor regions. A
                                         P
simple synthetic trajectory is yb1t (0) = j wj yjt , with nonnegative weights summing to one.
The observed gap y1t − yb1t (0) becomes a causal contrast only under additional counterfactual
and interference restrictions. Numerical optimality of a pretreatment loss does not supply those
restrictions. Even numerical agreement needs a target beyond the objective value. (Causal
banking proposal project, 2026gh)
   Consider two donors both equal to 100 before intervention, with later values 100 and 200,
while the treated region has later revenue 150. Every convex weight has zero pretreatment
loss. Weights (1, 0), (1/2, 1/2) and (0, 1) give later counterfactuals 100, 150 and 200 and
gaps 50, zero and −50. These are exact stipulated values, not package outputs. An adapter
comparison must therefore specify whether it requires weight equality, fitted-value equality,
objective agreement or an admissible set of solutions. A sparse solution and a dense solution
can satisfy the same numerical optimization while leading to different extrapolations.(Causal
banking proposal project, 2026gh)
  For the proposal, direct adoption means retaining a supported public interface and its
declared runtime. A worker bridge preserves that interface behind a typed request and a
versioned result. A port entails responsibility for the algorithm, dependency substitutions,
numerical criteria and inference semantics. Reimplementing a quadratic subproblem does not
reproduce the entire estimator. These distinctions govern the choices below. (Causal banking
proposal project, 2026gh)


39.20.2     Julia: explicit quadratic status and less explicit inference population

The pinned SynthControl.jl revision declares version 0.4.4 and an MIT notice. Its module
exports SimpleSCM and SyntheticDiD, reexports TreatmentPanels, and includes the simple
estimator, synthetic differences in differences and a matrix-completion file. The retained
790                                                             Causal analysis for a universal bank


ADH development file is not included by this module; its existence is not evidence of an
available exported estimator. The resolved TreatmentPanels, JuMP and HiGHS artifacts
remain separate dependencies requiring inspection and qualification. (nilshg/SynthControl.jl
contributors, 2025)
   The SimpleSCM path accepts a balanced panel with one continuously treated unit. It fits
nonnegative simplex weights to pretreatment outcomes using a quadratic objective, requires a
JuMP termination status of OPTIMAL, and then extracts weights and the post-treatment gap.
Its optional donor-placebo loop also requires that status. This explicit gate contrasts with
wrappers that extract a numerical vector without carrying its termination evidence. However,
an optimum status still needs feasibility and tolerance interpretation for the resolved optimizer;
it proves neither donor eligibility nor exchangeability. (nilshg/SynthControl.jl contributors,
2025; Causal banking proposal project, 2026gh)
   The synthetic differences-in-differences path permits placebo standard errors and rejects
other requested standard-error modes in the inspected method. It may reorder the panel’s
outcome and treatment matrices in place to put the treated unit last. A bridge must preserve
or deliberately copy unit identities and reconcile later consumers of the same panel object. The
fitted-state predicate tests for nonzero effect or standard-error entries. A zero-effect result with
no requested standard error can therefore fail that predicate under its literal values, although
zero is a valid effect value. This is a conditional source concern and a proposed lifecycle test,
not a native failure observed here.(nilshg/SynthControl.jl contributors, 2025)
   The placebo helper also merits an explicit population oracle. With J untreated rows, the
inspected code sets its fitting-control count to J − 1, allocates that many effect entries, swaps
rows for the first J − 2 iterations, and performs one final swap. In an independent label-only
replay with four donors initially ordered A, B, C, D, the held-out labels are A, B and D; C
is not selected. If stipulated effects for A, B, C, D are 2, 4, 6, 10, the sample variance of
the selected three is 52/3, while that of all four is 35/3. Neither number is a certified causal
variance. The example shows why the realized placebo identities must be checked rather
than inferred from a method name.(nilshg/SynthControl.jl contributors, 2025; Causal banking
proposal project, 2026gh)
   Its weight routine returns weights and an objective-history array after either limited objective
improvement or the maximum iteration count. The selected estimator extracts weights from
that result. A qualification fixture should distinguish the stopping reason, finite history, a
valid zero effect, panel mutation, and complete placebo population. The proposed role is a
version-pinned Julia reference and conditional worker bridge; direct adoption awaits those
tests and resolved dependencies. Other Julia leads remain uninspected, so this is not closure of
the entire language cell. (nilshg/SynthControl.jl contributors, 2025; Causal banking proposal
project, 2026gh)


39.20.3     C++ inside an R package is a component contract

The selected coresynth 1.0.0 source exposes an R formula workflow with RcppArmadillo
numerical components and an MIT notice. Its inner synthetic control routine forms a factored
quadratic problem and returns a donor-weight vector. The implementation tries active-set and
related numerical routes, then an accelerated projected-gradient fallback with a weight-change
tolerance and iteration cap. A later exact-solve attempt may succeed; otherwise the path can
return the current iterate. The returned vector alone does not identify which route succeeded
or provide a universal optimality certificate. The source’s conditional KKT statements must
remain conditional on the route that actually established them.(yo5uke/coresynth contributors,
2026)
39.20. Synthetic controls across language boundaries: solver, interface and inference contracts   791


   This matters in a bank comparison with nearly collinear donors. A worker should report
solver route, convergence reason, feasibility, objective and donor identity. A direct C++
port would need to expose those quantities and qualify the Armadillo and linear-algebra
environment, as well as preserve the R-side construction of predictors, windows, filters and
estimands. The proposal therefore retains coresynth as an R-facing reference with inspectable
C++ kernels, while deferring a standalone C++ service claim. (yo5uke/coresynth contributors,
2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026gh)
   Its placebo inference contains useful safeguards and further denominator obligations. The R
wrapper rejects the single-donor MSPE-ratio comparison for unsupported pooled or staggered
settings, carries the original optimizer/window choices into selected refits, and can exclude
poorly fitting placebo runs. The C++ covariate-placebo route marks failed refits with nonfinite
results; the R wrapper forms a surviving population and reports the number used. Its rank
calculation includes the treated statistic when it is valid. These source-level features are
preferable to silently asserting that every requested donor yielded a comparable statistic,
but they do not justify ignoring the probability of failure or selection. (yo5uke/coresynth
contributors, 2026)
  For an authored counting example, suppose four donor requests yield two usable statistics
below the treated statistic and two unresolved failures. Including the treated assignment among
the three observed statistics gives 1/3. If all five requested assignments were the intended
population, the unresolved rankings allow counts from 1/5 to 3/5. These are arithmetic
bounds on possible rankings, not calibrated p-values. The adapter must report attempts,
successful refits, pruning, invalid ratios and usable statistics separately, and justify any inference
conditional on retention. (Causal banking proposal project, 2026gh)
   SynthHelpers provides a smaller but instructive boundary. Its dated development version
declares GPL-2 and links Rcpp and RcppArmadillo. The retained C++ routine constructs
nonnegative simplex weights through an interior-point call. That call returns primal, dual
and convergence fields, but the exported weight wrapper extracts the primal vector while
its convergence extraction is commented out. This is not evidence that the solver fails; it is
evidence that the public wrapper does not return all inspected diagnostics. Reusing the kernel
requires preserving its provenance and terms, specifying a diagnostic response, and qualifying
the resolved runtime. A whole-package port is deferred until that work is justified against an
existing worker bridge.(ChandlerLutz/SynthHelpers contributors, 2016)


39.20.4     Bayesian and network-aware candidates need different evidence

The selected nasc metadata describes an R package with Stan/Rcpp components, not a general

A lending rule based on a credit-score cutoff and an encouragement that changes take-up

39.21.1     Preserve the IV target before improving computation

The earlier linearmodels review distinguishes design and instrument rank checks from rank of
the projected design, instrument strength and exclusion. It also distinguishes heteroskedastic
covariance from a declared cluster or calendar-dependence model. The retained pyfixest review
follows weighted two-stage regression, response-scale residuals and diagnostic distributions.
A first-stage relevance test or an overidentification test does not become a coefficient-null
confidence-set inversion because all are called IV diagnostics. Those distinctions remain pre-
requisites for a bank adapter. (Kevin Sheppard and contributors, 2026c; pyfixest contributors,
2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026bj)
  The newly inspected pyfixest delegate solves normal equations using a selected NumPy or
SciPy route. Least-squares and LSQR branches extract the solution component, while the
SciPy dense route declares a positive matrix assumption. Thus a returned coefficient vector
does not preserve every available rank or iterative-termination diagnostic. The Rust collinearity
delegate uses an ordered Cholesky-style residual-diagonal test on a Gram matrix. Column
ordering and the absolute tolerance affect which columns survive.(py-econometrics/pyfixest
contributors, 2026)
   For an exact scaling example, a one-column Gram entry 10−8 lies below a tolerance 10−6 .
Multiplying that column by 100 changes the entry to 10−4 , which exceeds the same tolerance
although the algebraic rank has not changed. Qualification must preserve units, ordering,
removed columns and tolerance. The inspected Rust error text mentions a positive finite
tolerance, but its local guard tests only whether the tolerance is nonpositive. Nonfinite inputs
therefore need an explicit boundary test and complete caller review; this observation does not
establish an observed package failure.(py-econometrics/pyfixest contributors, 2026; Causal
banking proposal project, 2026gc)
   The same source header says a reimplementation of fixest code has written permission for
MIT redistribution and names a permissions document. That document is absent from the
retained complete tree at this pin. The source assertion remains recorded, but authentic
permission bytes are not supplied by repeating the assertion. File-level provenance is unresolved,
without a legal conclusion. The proposal keeps the numerical component as a reference and
defers new distribution or porting until the artifact-specific record and native numerical contract
are established. (py-econometrics/pyfixest contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project,
2026gc)
