39.21.2     CausalPy’s Bayesian IV route adds a model and prior contract

The inherited CausalPy 1.0.0rc1 revision constructs separate outcome and instrument formula
matrices, computes deterministic OLS and two-stage reference fits, and can use those fits to
center default priors. Its IV constructor does not sample; explicit build and fit steps construct
the model and sample the posterior. The inspected continuous-treatment backend uses a joint
multivariate-normal likelihood with an LKJ covariance construction. Its binary-treatment
branch uses a logistic latent variable, a Bernoulli treatment likelihood and a conditional normal
outcome model with a clipped coupling parameter. These are additional modeling choices, not
a model-free repair for weak or invalid instruments. (pymc-labs/CausalPy contributors, 2026a)
   A bank request must identify the coefficient associated with the instrumented treatment,
the structural interpretation, instrument and outcome populations, row identities, priors
and sampling diagnostics. Formula construction and treatment-name checks cannot prove
exclusion, monotonicity, truthful encouragement or a stable target population. Data-centered
priors should be distinguished from externally fixed priors when interpreting sensitivity and
uncertainty. Variable selection is another model operation requiring its own contract, rather
than evidence that automatically discovered instruments are valid. (pymc-labs/CausalPy
contributors, 2026a; Causal banking proposal project, 2026gc)
   The proposed use is a version-pinned model-based reference and conditional Python worker.
Public tests should check formula alignment, transformed treatments, repeated fitting, finite
inputs, weak first-stage scenarios, prior sensitivity and posterior diagnostics before native
admission. None of those tests can manufacture the banking facts that make an instrument
credible.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026gc)


39.21.3     A finite cutoff prediction is not automatically the limiting jump

The selected CausalPy RD implementation fits a sharp-design regression after optional band-
width and donut-hole filtering. It predicts at the threshold minus and plus a user-supplied
epsilon, with treatment flags zero and one, and subtracts the two conditional expectations. Its
input checks require a dummy-coded treatment column and a formula treatment term; the
inspected checks do not establish that the observed assignments match the declared cutoff
direction. The adapter must validate that relationship and preserve the actual prediction
rows.(pymc-labs/CausalPy contributors, 2026a)
   Let a local mean below the cutoff have slope 2 and the mean above it have slope 6, with a
limiting jump of 10. Comparing symmetric points at distance ϵ gives 10 + 8ϵ. The contrast
is 14 at ϵ = 1/2 and 10.008 at ϵ = 0.001. These authored values show a target difference,
not numerical error in a package. The units and transformation of a credit score affect the
meaning of epsilon. A donut design adds extrapolation across an excluded region; its target
and assumptions must remain explicit. (Causal banking proposal project, 2026gc)
   The small rdd 0.0.3 package provides a different contract. Its helper can truncate data
around a cutoff and another function creates a treatment indicator and a statsmodels weighted-
least-squares model. The default formula includes the treatment indicator and the running
variable with a common slope; the function returns the model before fitting. It does not
automatically perform the separate truncation step or turn the default formula into a slope-
interacted local polynomial. Users can supply a different equation and weights, but those
choices and the fitted covariance must be recorded.(evan-magnusson/rdd contributors, 2019)
  For the proposal, rdd is a compact instructional/reference route. Direct adoption for a bank
RD workflow is deferred until a wrapper fixes window, kernel, formula, fitted state, covariance
and diagnostics. Its MIT notice does not qualify the complete statsmodels environment, and a
39.21. Python instruments and discontinuities: align the null, cutoff and returned set           795


coefficient labeled as an effect still needs the design’s causal assumptions. (evan-magnusson/rdd
contributors, 2019; Causal banking proposal project, 2026gc)


39.21.4     rdrobust keeps bias correction and its uncertainty in separate rows

The pinned rdrobust Python source declares version 2.1.1 and GPL-3 terms. Its interface
distinguishes sharp and fuzzy designs, polynomial and bias orders, derivative targets, kernels,
bandwidths, covariates, weights and variance options. The inspected guards require the bias
order to exceed the estimation order, reject negative or all-zero weights, validate a finite interior
cutoff and require enough distinct running-variable values for the polynomial. The treatment-
side partition places values at the cutoff on the right. Repeated-score handling and numerical
refusal are useful operational checks, not proofs of the continuity design. (rdpackages/rdrobust
contributors, 2026)
   The returned rows pair conventional and bias-corrected estimates with different standard
errors. Specifically, the selected construction uses the conventional estimate with the conven-
tional standard error, the bias-corrected estimate with that conventional standard error, and
the bias-corrected estimate with its robust standard error. A consumer must preserve the row
identity; extracting the corrected coefficient from one row and a standard error from another
changes the reported test. (rdpackages/rdrobust contributors, 2026)
   Suppose an authored example has conventional estimate 10, corrected estimate 8, conven-
tional standard error 2 and robust standard error 3. The three reported ratios are 5, 4 and
8/3. With a stipulated normal multiplier 1.96, the corresponding interval half-widths are 3.92,
3.92 and 5.88. No coverage claim follows from this arithmetic. It provides a deterministic
serialization oracle that prevents a bridge from silently mixing rows.(Causal banking proposal
project, 2026gc)
   For fuzzy designs the inspected formulas divide an outcome discontinuity by a treatment
discontinuity and propagate the ratio through bias and variance calculations. A guard rejects
a fully degenerate treatment variable with no variation and no jump. That guard does not
establish a strong first stage. An outcome jump of two divided by treatment jumps 0.2 and
0.02 yields 10 and 100 respectively. A narrow conventional interval cannot be assumed reliable
merely because division returned a finite number. Weak-first-stage behavior and the intended
local population need separate scientific evaluation.(rdpackages/rdrobust contributors, 2026;
Causal banking proposal project, 2026gc)
   The proposal favors a supported rdrobust Python worker as a reference candidate for declared
local-polynomial tasks, conditional on exact artifact identity, complete bandwidth/covariance
delegates, license and dependency review, and matched native public fixtures. It does not
port the method solely to avoid process isolation, nor claim general serial-dependence or
weak-instrument coverage from an option label. (Causal banking proposal project, 2026gc)


39.21.5     ivmodels makes confidence-set shape part of the API

The selected ivmodels 0.10.0 source offers coefficient-null Anderson–Rubin tests and inversions.
Its inspected path residualizes controls, projects null residuals onto instruments, constructs
a statistic and selects an explicit chi-square, F or supported subvector critical-value route.
The inversion forms a quadratic inequality and projects it onto requested coefficient coor-
dinates. This is distinct from the earlier relevance and overidentification diagnostics. No
general covariance-robust guarantee is inferred from the method name or source comments.
(mlondschien/ivmodels contributors, 2026)
  The confidence-set class represents unions of intervals, including empty, bounded and
796                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


unbounded sets. That representation is substantively important. The authored inequality
1 − β 2 ≤ 0 accepts (−∞, −1] ∪ [1, ∞) and excludes zero. Replacing it by the interval spanning
its extremes would add excluded parameter values. A banking result schema must represent
disconnected, empty and unbounded sets, together with the null, nuisance treatment, critical-
value option, degrees of freedom and numerical tolerance.(mlondschien/ivmodels contributors,
2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026gc)
   The numerical boundaries still require work. The inspected projection delegate uses SciPy
least squares while the quadratic constructor obtains its center with a direct linear solve.
Singular or nearly singular quadratic boundaries, numerical rank, root search and complete
caller validation need explicit fixtures. An algebraic acceptance region can exist when a
particular center parameterization is singular. Native qualification must distinguish a scientific
empty set from a numerical failure. The proposed role is a weak-IV inference reference
and conditional worker integration preserving set geometry, not automatic admission of all
instrument laws or dependence regimes.(mlondschien/ivmodels contributors, 2026; Causal
banking proposal project, 2026gc)


39.21.6     Public qualification before costly banking experiments

The public package should test exact cutoff inclusion, assignment direction, epsilon and score
scaling, donut filtering, formula slopes, duplicate rows, finite weights, rank tolerance, solver
status, weak first stages, robust-row serialization and disconnected confidence sets. It should
distinguish simulation under a declared valid law from deliberate violations of exclusion,
continuity or dependence assumptions. Costs include refusals, failed requests and human
review, not only returned estimates. (Causal banking proposal project, 2026gc)
   A hypothetical 18,000 USD total over 600 attempts, 450 conformant results and 300 useful
results gives 30, 40 and 60 USD respectively. These are planning denominators, not observed
prices or banking value. Repository search tails, nonlinear IV alternatives, complete dependence
and bandwidth delegates, artifact rights and native evidence remain open. The Python IV/RD
cell therefore receives an inconclusive coverage outcome. No native, visual or final acceptance
is claimed. (Causal banking proposal project, 2026gc)


39.22      Java and the JVM: separating a latent coefficient, a
           numerical primitive and an instrumental-effect service
A bank that already operates Java services might prefer to estimate a lending-policy effect in
the same runtime. That preference does not determine the scientific target. An encouragement
to contact a customer, a credit-score eligibility threshold and a latent repayment-propensity
measurement model ask different questions. The first requires an instrument and a stated
population of affected customers; the second requires a cutoff, assignment direction and local
comparison; the third gives coefficients meanings only after its latent scale and measurement
restrictions are fixed. The JVM comparison therefore begins with the actual callable calculation
and its information contract, rather than inferring a common capability from the names
regression, causal forest or two-stage least squares. The earlier four-original Tetrad inspection
remains part of this argument. The present followup resolves selected concrete data and
numerical delegates and screens complementary candidates; it does not establish ecosystem
saturation.(Ricardo Silva and Tetrad contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project,
2026fm)
39.22. Java and JVM IV/RD contracts                                                           797


39.22.1     Tetrad: follow the observation axis and the parameter lifecycle

At the retained Tetrad revision, Tsls.estimate() constructs a new SemIm, calls its coefficient
procedure and returns that object. The default fixed measurement is chosen by lexicographic
name order unless an explicit loading list is supplied. A loading normalized to one defines
a coordinate for the latent variable. To see the consequence without making a package-
performance claim, write an authored structural relation as Y = 2L + ε. Under the coordinate
L∗ = 4L, the same relation is Y = 12 L∗ + ε. The numeric coefficient changes while the
represented relation does not. A banking adapter must carry the fixed indicator, units
and scaling with the coefficient; a renamed or rescaled indicator must not silently turn a
measurement normalization into a new economic claim.(Ricardo Silva and Tetrad contributors,
2026; cmu-phil/tetrad contributors, 2026a; Causal banking proposal project, 2026fm)
   The earlier source finding concerns a specific measurement-stage loop, not every Tetrad esti-
mator. Its intended vector is the fixed indicator’s column, but it calls getDouble(colIndex,i)
while iterating over cases. The concrete BoxDataSet forwards its first argument as row and
second as column to its data box. DoubleDataBox indexes a row-major array accordingly;
VerticalDoubleDataBox uses column-major storage while retaining the same public row/-
column contract. Thus storage orientation does not repair the call. An exact authored
5 × 3 table Dij = 100i + j, with zero-based indices and fixed column one, has the intended
vector (1, 101, 201, 301, 401). Swapping indices first reads (100, 101, 102) and then requests
columns three and four, outside this table. This is a source-level reachability condition and an
independently reproduced indexing witness. No installed Tetrad invocation was performed. A
useful native qualification must reach this branch on nonsquare data, preserve case identities,
and distinguish a repaired call from a wrapper that simply avoids the branch.(cmu-phil/tetrad
contributors, 2026a; Causal banking proposal project, 2026fm)
   Parameter lifecycle is a separate issue. SemIm initializes fixed and free mappings before the
coefficient procedure runs. Its initialization selects either configured starting values or random
values, depending on the parameter flag. The inspected Tsls procedure skips a measurement
when no auxiliary measurement remains. It also restricts work when a node name is supplied.
Consequently, a returned object needs a per-parameter fitted mask: untouched initial values
must not be represented as estimated coefficients. The separate SemEstimator path attaches
a covariance matrix, invokes its optimizer and sets an estimated flag; those actions cannot be
assumed for the distinct Tsls path. The latter’s local asymptotic covariance helper still has
no outward assignment in the inspected method. The broader SemIm class does have standard-
error methods, including a missing-sample-covariance guard. This distinction prevents the
overly broad conclusion that the entire library has no uncertainty interface. Caller search in
the selected estimator, optimizer and latent-search files did not establish an internal invocation
of Tsls; its public constructor and estimate method remain the concrete entry under review.
Whole-repository caller coverage is open.(cmu-phil/tetrad contributors, 2026a; Ricardo Silva
and Tetrad contributors, 2026)


39.22.2     The matrix inverse is a boundary, not a statistical guarantee

The pinned Tetrad build declares EJML 0.44.0. Its matrix wrapper checks that an input is

results for singular or nearly singular inputs. For dimensions up to five it uses an unrolled
inverse (with a scalar reciprocal for dimension one); larger matrices use an LU path. The

predicate exists. The inspected path does not turn that predicate into a general conditioning

39.23.1     The calendar is part of a dynamic-panel moment condition

For a schematic panel relation yit = αyi,t−1 + x′it β + ai + uit , the interpretation of a lag is
part of the model. Conditions on a two-period-old value and a differenced disturbance refer to
declared calendar periods, not automatically to the second most recent observed record. This
is consequential for branches with missing reporting months. In an authored table with times
(2000, 2002, 2003) and values (10, 20, 30), the previous-observation lag is (NA, 10, 20), whereas
a one-calendar-period lag is (NA, NA, 20). Treating the middle row as if its lag were observed
changes the usable moment rows before any GMM solver runs. This arithmetic illustrates a
contract difference; it is not a native benchmark.(pydynpd contributors, 2025; Causal banking
proposal project, 2026ga)
   At the inspected dynapanel revision, the data object documents and implements positional
lags, and its instrument assembly independently indexes positions when constructing regressors
and instrument columns. The assembly also stores calendar times, but calendar labels do
not change the positional arithmetic. Its input validation checks duplicate identifiers before
a noninteger time column may be cast to an integer type; the selected path has no second
duplicate check after that cast. Exact installed-library conversion semantics require a native
fixture. The proposal should demand a declared calendar grid or a restricted consecutive-period
use, with refusals for unsupported gaps, rather than infer calendar-valid moments from a sorted
table. The package’s experimental status and version metadata are retained as provenance,
not as an automatic rejection of every calculation.(Leotaby/dynapanel contributors, 2026)
   The inspected PyXtabond2 helper makes a materially different choice: it forms absolute
time offsets and uses an exact offset match for gapped groups. A contiguous group has a
positional fast path justified by the offset condition. Its instrument builder scatters values onto
a dense calendar grid before selecting lagged columns. The selected constructor still requires
separate input qualification: time offsets are converted to integers, while complete duplicate,
fractional-time and caller validation remains open. A source helper supporting calendar lags is
a useful comparison; it is not proof that every model option, covariance correction or exported
result is equivalent to Stata. The README’s parity claims remain unverified claims in this
review.(Kahindo048/pyxtabond2 contributors, 2026)
   Numerical diagnostics should remain separate from moment validity. Dynapanel warns when
instrument counts are large relative to the number of units, and its inverse helper falls back to
a pseudoinverse only after a numerical exception. Its square-root helper clips negative inputs
to zero. PyXtabond2’s inspected rank path operates on the instrument Gram matrix; when
that check is disabled, it substitutes the instrument count. The selected estimation paths also
use pseudoinverses. None of these source choices establishes that the instruments are excluded,
strong or valid under shared calendar shocks. The adapter must retain the rank rule and scale,
fallback route, requested instrument count, effective rows, covariance law and any clipped
variance state. A finite standard error is not an exogeneity certificate.(Leotaby/dynapanel
contributors, 2026; Kahindo048/pyxtabond2 contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal
project, 2026ga)

structural impact matrix P obeys P P ′ = Σu under the chosen normalization. This equation
alone does not select the intervention. For the authored case Σu = I2 , both P = I2 and

have the same reduced-form covariance, while the first shock moves different combinations

the contemporaneous, long-run, sign or instrument restrictions that attach an economic

   The inspected statsmodels SVAR constructor encodes unknown entries through masks in
matrices A and B. Its solve path can check an order/rank matrix at the supplied starting

39.23.3     Proxy alignment, shock normalization and attempted resamples

The retained macroshock revision offers short-run, long-run, sign and proxy-IV branches. The
source contains substantive identification calculations, but a callable branch still needs an
observation-identity contract. In its proxy helper, missing instrument entries are filtered
and the resulting instrument vector is paired with a suffix of residual observations of the
same length. An interior missing instrument can therefore change row correspondence. In
an authored three-row example, instrument values (1, NA, 2) aligned to residuals (10, 20, 30)
produce the matched inner product 1 · 10 + 2 · 30 = 70. Pairing retained instruments with the
last two residuals instead gives 1 · 20 + 2 · 30 = 80. The inspected public model path passes
the arrays to this helper. This witness isolates alignment; it does not assert a package run or
validate exclusion.(patricioariaslpz/macroshock contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal
project, 2026ga)
   The same helper resets the full impact matrix inside the loop over instruments, then
populates the current column. A corresponding reset appears in the selected bootstrap proxy
branch. The authored two-column reset trace ends with only the second identity column
retained. Thus a multi-instrument use needs explicit native qualification before earlier columns
are advertised as jointly fitted. The impulse-response helper additionally scales the requested
shock by the reciprocal of its own-variable impact coefficient. If that coefficient is two,
a requested own-variable movement of one uses structural-shock amplitude one-half. The
response is not automatically a one-standard-deviation shock, and a zero diagonal is a distinct
refusal case.(patricioariaslpz/macroshock contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project,
2026ga)
  The resampling paths have different stopping and state contracts. The normal bootstrap
samples residual rows; the wild path aliases the model residual array and changes its entries in
802                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


place. Its loop counts accepted output draws and the inspected loop has no separate attempt
cap. A progress expression uses an integer step derived from one tenth of the requested
replications, creating a small-request boundary to test. The sign-restriction routine is separate:
it does have a rejection-count cap and can return zero-filled summary arrays on that stopping
path. A zero-filled unavailable response must not be reported as an estimated zero policy effect.
The proposal should preserve requested attempts, accepted draws, abort reason, seed and
input-state hashes. No general dependent-time-series calibration follows from implementing
either resampling mechanism.(patricioariaslpz/macroshock contributors, 2026)

39.23.4     A state forecast is conditional on its innovation law

PyDLM provides a Bayesian dynamic linear-model computation whose retained setup describes
an alpha-stage package. In the inspected filtering path, the first prediction after an observation
adds innovation according to the discount rule. Consecutive missing observations advance a
different prediction branch without another innovation addition. That is a model convention
with an uncertainty consequence, not an automatic causal remedy for missing bank observations.
With an authored scalar identity transition, initial variance one and discount one-half, the
first prediction has variance two. The inspected branch convention retains variance two at the
next missing step, whereas a separately stipulated fixed process innovation of one would give
variance three. The two numbers answer different model specifications. A banking request
must state the missingness and innovation convention and must not label either variance as
uncertainty about an intervention without a causal model.(wwrechard/pydlm contributors,
2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026ga)
   The local discount guard compares values with zero and one, while initialization forms
reciprocal square roots of the discounts. Its inclusive endpoints and nonfinite inputs therefore
deserve explicit tests; documentation phrasing alone is not a runtime validation contract.
Forecasting features supplied to a dynamic component likewise need an availability clock. A
future feature can be a forecast input under a scenario without being an identified intervention
variable.(wwrechard/pydlm contributors, 2026)

39.23.5     Conditional reuse and a public qualification program

references, with calendar conventions made explicit. Use statsmodels VAR as a reduced-
form baseline and admit a structural path only for a declared restriction family whose
numerical objective and diagnostics have been checked. Macroshock is a candidate for further
source repair and matched public trials; the selected proxy alignment, multi-column reset,
normalization and bootstrap-state concerns should precede integration. PyDLM is an adjacent
forecast/state engine under a declared innovation law. None should be promoted to a general
causal service by a common Python API. Source licenses and build declarations are retained,
while wheel equivalence, dependencies, support and redistribution terms remain separate
qualifications.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026ga)
   Known-law public experiments can test these contracts before an expensive bank prototype
evaluation. Freeze calendar gaps and ordering, valid and invalid moment regimes, known
structural rotations and restrictions, weak and missing proxies, multiple instruments, solver
failures, repeated calls after resampling and consecutive missing-state horizons. Keep all
requested tasks and failures in the evaluation denominator. Match an independent arithmetic
reference to each permitted target; then separately assess coverage, width, stability and refusal
under the declared sampling law. Authentic bank assignment truth and useful precision remain
later inputs.

   For a hypothetical 24,000 USD trial, 600 requests imply 40 USD per request, 400 completed

39.24      R dynamic panels, volatility restrictions and nonlinear

A bank comparing branch interventions with aggregate funding shocks needs a common

39.24.1     A panel index must preserve the moment’s calendar

Consider yit = ai + αyi,t−1 + x′it β + uit for branch i in reporting period t. A proposed moment
such as E[yi,t−2 (uit − ui,t−1 )] = 0 requires both a substantive instrument restriction and
an unambiguous meaning for a period. For observations at (2000, 2002, 2003) with values
(10, 20, 30), a row lag returns (NA, 10, 20), while a one-year lag returns (NA, NA, 20). Balancing
across the union of observed labels cannot insert a year absent from every branch. An analyst
must supply the intended grid, retain missingness and decide which moments survive. These
are exact authored indexing examples, not results from running the packages.(Causal banking
proposal project, 2026gd)
   The selected plm estimator first obtains a panel index. Its unbalanced-data branch expands
the observed individual and time labels. The GMM builder then selects instrument entries
by positions and differences extracted matrices by adjacent rows. In the same package, the
ordinary pseries lag API distinguishes time shifts from row shifts; its inspected time-based
helper matches numerical time offsets, with a separate fallback for nonnumeric levels and an
optional faster delegate. These facts must be read together. The existence of a calendar-aware
public lag does not by itself qualify every internal GMM transformation on globally missing
periods. The proposed adapter therefore records both the declared grid and the realized
estimator rows, and tests the complete formula-to-instrument path. It should not simply
relabel sorted rows as consecutive months.(cran/plm contributors, 2025)
  The selected panelvar preparation similarly constructs the Cartesian product of observed
categories and period labels, merges the data, sorts it and converts the period to a factor. Its
actual panel lag helper shifts rows; the difference helper differences adjacent rows. Its forward
orthogonal-deviation helper instead subtracts the mean of available future observations and
uses a factor depending on how many future entries remain. That transformation has a different
availability contract from a simple first difference. Missing periods, duplicate category-period
rows, short histories and the minimum number of future observations belong in the public
804                                                              Causal analysis for a universal bank


test design. The selected source paths alone do not settle every input validation or covariance
property.(cran/panelvar contributors, 2024)
   Numerical fallbacks do not create valid moments. Plm checks the smallest eigenvalue
of selected first- and second-step weight matrices against 10−9 and warns before using a
generalized inverse; its coefficient matrix still uses a direct solve. Its robust covariance routine
has its own inverse decision and an additional two-step correction expression. Panelvar also
uses inverse fallbacks, a generalized inverse for selected coefficient calculations and direct solves
in a variance path. The public tolerance is used in an eigenvalue predicate, while the inspected
calls to MASS::ginv do not explicitly pass that tolerance. Consequently the adapter must
retain the actual solver, scale and tolerance at each stage, rather than treat one user parameter
as a guarantee about all inversions. Neither a finite coefficient nor a corrected covariance
formula establishes exclusion, valid cross-branch dependence or useful precision.(cran/plm
contributors, 2025; cran/panelvar contributors, 2024)


39.24.2     Restricted shocks and optimizer custody

For a reduced-form innovation ut , a structural representation Aut = Bεt implies Σu =
A−1 BB ′ A−T under unit structural covariance. The selected vars direct objective uses
log{det(B)2 }, and retains its optim object in the returned estimate. This differs materi-
ally from discarding the optimizer diagnostics. For a two-dimensional matrix with unit
diagonal and off-diagonal entries 1/2, the squared determinant is 9/16; this supplies an exact
cross-language objective witness without asserting numerical parity. The ordinary VAR orthog-
onalization uses a Cholesky factor. A bank must still justify the ordering or other restrictions
that label a funding shock.(cran/vars contributors, 2024; Causal banking proposal project,
2026gd)
   The vars scoring branch warns when its iteration bound is reached and then continues
to construct an estimate; that branch returns a null optimizer object. Warnings and the
stopping state must therefore cross an API or MCP boundary with the estimate. The
inspected routine also normalizes selected signs and reports Sigma.U multiplied by 100.
Reconstructing A−1 BB ′ A−T from the returned matrices and explicitly declaring units is a
proposed conformance check. It would be unsafe to compare a field named covariance across
implementations solely by its name. The source review identifies the required checks; it does
not claim that an installed package failed them.(cran/vars contributors, 2024)
   Identification from changing volatility adds a different restriction. In the schematic system
Σ1 = BB ′ and Σ2 = BΛB ′ , the diagonal regime matrix Λ must help distinguish shock
directions, while the impact matrix remains stable across the declared break. If Σ1 = I2 and
Σ2 = 2I2 , both B = I2 and the rotation with rows (3/5, −4/5) and (4/5, 3/5) reproduce both
covariances. Thus a volatility change alone need not name the intervention. This is an authored
algebraic counterexample, not an imported identification theorem. Unknown break selection,
changing transmission and weakly separated variances require separate treatment.(Causal
banking proposal project, 2026gd)
   The selected svars id.cv frontend rejects a restricted input varest model, while separately
accepting a matrix of impact restrictions. Those are distinct restrictions and should not be
conflated in the service contract. The frontend passes a fractional default crit of 0.001 into
a registered native bridge that declares an integer argument; both the generated bridge and
the C++ implementation retain that integer type. The exact installed conversion remains a
native qualification item. An authored conditional witness illustrates why this matters: an
improvement of 1/2000 is below 1/1000 but above an integer surrogate of zero. A transport
test must verify the received value and stopping predicate, not assume that the displayed R
39.24. R dynamic panels and structural shocks                                                 805


argument survives unchanged.(cran/svars contributors, 2025; Causal banking proposal project,
2026gd)
   The inspected volatility backend calls an inner optimizer with an iteration limit, runs a
bounded outer loop and returns the chosen matrices, likelihood and iteration count. Its
selected return does not retain the inner optimizer’s full convergence object. It also flips whole
columns of an inverse-Hessian matrix when their diagonal entry is negative before taking
square roots. The inspected non-Gaussian path contains a similar column operation. For
the authored symmetric matrix with rows (−1, 1/2) and (1/2, 2), flipping its first column
gives rows (1, 1/2) and (−1/2, 2), which are no longer symmetric. This algebra demonstrates
why positive displayed diagonal entries cannot certify a valid covariance. It is a diagnostic
contract and proposed test, not a package-wide rejection or a native failure report.(cran/svars
contributors, 2025; Causal banking proposal project, 2026gd)


39.24.3     A resampling distribution must retain failures and shock meaning

The selected svars moving-block bootstrap constructs overlapping residual blocks, draws blocks
and refits a declared structural method. Some method-specific errors are converted to null
results; failed results are subsequently removed before surviving estimates form the covariance
summary. Other branches have different error handling. A service must retain requested,
attempted, failed and retained counts, the block length, design and failure causes. A successful
conditional summary is not automatically an unconditional statement about every requested
fit. Sign and permutation alignment, shared calendar shocks and weak identification remain
substantive qualification questions.(cran/svars contributors, 2025)
   TsDyn provides a complementary nonlinear experiment. Its inspected GIRF path conditions
on histories and shocks, then averages paired simulated paths. The low-level helper with
shock_both set to false replaces the first innovation in one path with the requested shock;
with shock_both true, it adds the shock to that path’s baseline innovation. The averaging
helper used by the public GIRF path defaults to the additive setting. Both paths share the
history and subsequent innovations. If the baseline innovation is one and the specified shock
is two, replacement gives an immediate difference of one, whereas addition gives two. These
are different experimental targets. A natural-language request for a two-unit funding shock
must resolve that distinction before an agent constructs a call.(cran/tsDyn contributors, 2024;
Causal banking proposal project, 2026gd)
   The selected routine samples future residual innovations without replacement and samples
histories and shocks without replacement when they are not supplied. A horizon longer than
the available residual pool therefore needs an explicit input policy and fixture. The public
routine passes the supplied seed separately for each history–shock combination. Its averaging
helper resets that seed once per combination and then repeats the low-level calls without
passing a seed, allowing the random stream to advance within that combination. This can
couple innovation draws across combinations; it does not establish that all repetitions within a
combination are identical. The joint simulation law and Monte Carlo uncertainty must retain
that distinction. The TVAR delegate preserves the supplied starting matrix and innovations,
chooses a threshold regime and rounds selected threshold comparisons and paths. Threshold
proximity, history selection, seed ownership and paired-path construction all belong in the
result provenance. This source reading does not quantify Monte Carlo error for an installed
build.(cran/tsDyn contributors, 2024)
  History dependence also changes the economic question. In an authored recursion with
drift f (x) = x/2 for x ≤ 0 and f (x) = 3x/2 for x > 0, adding one to the first innovation
produces a first-period response of one from either initial state −1 or 1. With zero subsequent
806                                                            Causal analysis for a universal bank


innovations, the next response is respectively one or 3/2. Pooling histories therefore changes
the estimand even when paired innovations are controlled. The bank should report which stress
or ordinary histories are weighted, distinguish a residual perturbation from an identified policy
intervention, and evaluate uncertainty under the selected fitting and simulation law.(Causal
banking proposal project, 2026gd)


39.24.4     Conditional adoption and a public qualification route

Plm and panelvar are conditional references for declared panel calendars and moments; vars is
a candidate restricted structural reference with explicit optimizer and unit custody. Svars is
a candidate for justified volatility or distributional restrictions only after bridge, curvature,
identification and resampling diagnostics are qualified. TsDyn supplies conditional nonlinear
simulation contrasts, not an automatic business-to-intervention translation. The inspected
declarations are GPL version 2 or later for plm, vars, panelvar and tsDyn; svars declares
MIT plus a named license file whose genuine holder notice is retained. These are provenance
facts, not complete legal clearance. Installed artifacts, native dependencies and any intended
distribution or port still require a separate rights decision. No blanket adoption of the ecosystem
follows.(cran/plm contributors, 2025; cran/vars contributors, 2024; cran/svars contributors,
2025; cran/panelvar contributors, 2024; cran/tsDyn contributors, 2024)
   The proposed public evaluation freezes the package artifacts and data schema, constructs
known-calendar panels, contrasts valid and violated moments, varies structural restrictions
and volatility separation, and records every numerical and refusal state. It includes duplicate
and globally missing periods, covariance-unit reconstruction, fractional tolerance transport,
indefinite curvature, rejected resamples, threshold histories and seeded replication. The
comparison must count all requests and full workflow cost. An illustrative budget of 18,000
USD over 600 requests costs 30 USD per request; 400 completed fits imply 45 USD per

39.25      JVM temporal models: lag identity, forecast contracts
           and intervention meaning
A funding team may need a Java service to discover temporal relations, forecast deposit
balances or propagate a conditional state distribution. These are distinct tasks. The se-
lected comparison covers Tetrad temporal utilities, Smile AR/ARMA/ARIMA, ScalaTion
VAR/VARX and JDemetra+ state-space and regression-ARIMA paths. Each has useful
computational structure, but a name such as structural VAR or exogenous predictor does
not itself identify a bank intervention. The comparison therefore follows the actual lag trans-
formation, solver, forecast return and failure boundary before proposing integration. Dated
source revisions are retained separately from installed binary equivalence or current supported
commercial editions.(cmu-phil/tetrad contributors, 2026b; haifengl/smile contributors, 2026a;
scalation/scalation2 contributors, 2026b; jdemetra/jdplus-main contributors, 2026; Causal
banking proposal project, 2026fn)
39.25. JVM temporal models and inference                                                       807


39.25.1     Temporal discovery needs stable variable identity

Tetrad’s inspected lag constructor rejects colons in original names, uses the original name at lag
zero and appends a colon and lag number at positive lags. It creates knowledge tiers and copies
observations using row offsets. For data at years (2000, 2002, 2003) with values (10, 20, 30) and
one lag, the authored reconstruction gives rows (20, 10) and (30, 20) in current/lagged order.
The first pair spans two calendar years. A calling service must declare a regular observation
grid or an appropriate irregular-time model before interpreting these row shifts as one-period
causal parents. The helper’s name validation is a real safeguard, but it does not supply the
calendar.(cmu-phil/tetrad contributors, 2026b; Causal banking proposal project, 2026fn)
   The selected structuralVar utility calls that constructor, forbids edges within each tier
and chooses a discrete score or a continuous covariance-based score before running FGES. It
then collapses the learned graph and regresses contemporaneous targets on selected parents.
Its collapse step extracts the base name by searching for a period, whereas the inspected
constructor creates colon-delimited names. For plain names funding and funding:1, an authored
character-index check returns minus one for the period search. A graph edge whose endpoint
enters that parsing path therefore needs a native naming fixture before this method is exposed.
This is a specific source-path incompatibility; it does not imply that every Tetrad temporal
algorithm uses the same utility or fails.(cmu-phil/tetrad contributors, 2026b; Causal banking
proposal project, 2026fn)
   The selected regression delegate forms a normal-equation inverse and residuals. The
continuous score can return NaN on a caught singularity or nonfinite score. Such numerical
states, graph endpoints and tier restrictions must survive a CLI or MCP response. A collapsed
graph plus residuals is not automatically a structural impact matrix or a calibrated policy-
effect interval. Latent confounding, score assumptions, dependent sampling and post-discovery
uncertainty remain separate scientific obligations. Conditional adoption should start with
the lag/knowledge representation and named utility tests while retaining the earlier Tetrad
comparisons.(cmu-phil/tetrad contributors, 2026b)


39.25.2     Point forecasts and uncertainty are different output contracts

The inspected Smile ARMA fit rejects inadmissible orders and short series, estimates an
auxiliary autoregression and fits lagged observations and residuals by SVD. Its SVD delegate
uses an effective-rank threshold and solves on retained singular vectors. The ARMA routine
subsequently forms a Cholesky factor of the design Gram matrix for coefficient standard errors.
These are different numerical requirements: a finite rank-truncated coefficient calculation need
not imply that the later covariance calculation completes. A proposed test must retain both
outcomes and the installed tensor/LAPACK delegate, rather than infer a universal failure or
success from the initial solve.(haifengl/smile contributors, 2026a)
   The selected multistep forecast copies recent observations and residuals, recursively produces
future values and leaves future residual entries at zero. It returns a point-forecast array. Its
residual variance and coefficient tests are separate objects; the selected return is not a horizon-
specific prediction band. In an authored AR(1) example with coefficient 1/2 and unit innovation
variance, conditional forecast-error variances at horizons one and two are 1 and 1 + 1/4 = 5/4
even with known parameters. A single residual-variance field cannot be silently reused as
both. Estimated parameters, model selection and dependent innovations would add their
own qualification requirements.(haifengl/smile contributors, 2026a; Causal banking proposal
project, 2026fn)
  Smile’s inspected ARIMA fit differences by adjacent observations and selects the ARMA,
808                                                             Causal analysis for a universal bank


pure AR or pure MA route. Forecasts are restored to the original scale one differencing
layer at a time using saved terminal values. With observed levels (10, 13, 17) and stipulated
second-difference forecasts (1, 1), the first-difference forecasts are (5, 6) and the level forecasts
are (22, 28). This exact authored calculation gives a useful conformance target. It does not
establish stationarity, valid uncertainty or the intervention meaning of a deposit forecast. The
information clock must also distinguish genuinely future external inputs from values learned
after the prediction origin.(haifengl/smile contributors, 2026a; Causal banking proposal project,
2026fn)


39.25.3     A vector autoregression interface must preserve its regressor layout

ScalaTion’s selected VAR delegates to a multivariate regression forecaster and forges future
regressor vectors from actual lags and earlier predictions. Its VARX builder concatenates trend
columns, endogenous lags and exogenous lags. The inspected forging routine allocates columns
from the number of endogenous response columns and their lag order, without appending the
separately constructed exogenous block. In an authored layout with two endogenous series,
two endogenous lags, one exogenous series, three exogenous lags and no trend, the constructor
expects seven columns while the selected forge allocation has four. That width contract needs
a native fixture and an explicit future-exogenous scenario before the VARX name becomes an
integration promise.(scalation/scalation2 contributors, 2026b; Causal banking proposal project,
2026fn)
   The inspected common forecaster has an unfinished forecast-at-origin entry point, while
a separate forecastAt route has an implemented body using forged vectors and recursive
predictions. It is therefore inaccurate both to advertise every entry point as complete and
to reject all forecasting code. The regression delegate selects among QR, SVD and normal-
equation factorizations; those choices and their dependencies need qualification. The lag builder
clamps unavailable early lag positions to the start of the series. Its exogenous helper also
backfills a zero prefix using a weighted backcast. The backcast delegate uses a slice of supplied
observations and a configurable weighting rule. A real zero and a missing historical value are
not interchangeable in a banking record. The proposed adapter must declare the treatment
of initial lags, zeros and future information, with fixtures for each path.(scalation/scalation2
contributors, 2026b)


39.25.4     State propagation through missing observations

JDemetra+ provides a distinct conditional state-space reference. Its inspected observation
wrapper treats nonfinite entries as missing. The ordinary filter skips the measurement update
for such a row but still advances the state. The concrete state delegate applies the transition
to the mean and covariance and adds the process-noise covariance at every advance. Under a
stipulated scalar transition of one, initial variance one and process variance one, two missing
steps therefore produce variances two and three. That is an exact authored model calculation,
not a benchmark result or proof that a filtered state is a causal variable. The state law and
observation clock must be part of the API contract.(jdemetra/jdplus-main contributors, 2026;
Causal banking proposal project, 2026fn)
   The ordinary filter uses numerical variance thresholds and raises an inconsistency exception
for a nonzero innovation with effectively zero variance. The selected diffuse initializer has a sep-
arate lifecycle and throws if diffuse initialization cannot be completed within the available data.
These are informative refusal states, not interchangeable missing forecasts. An agent should
preserve the initialization choice, effective observations, constraints and final-state timing, then
39.25. JVM temporal models and inference                                                      809


explain whether failure arose from the model, information or numerics.(jdemetra/jdplus-main
contributors, 2026)
   The regression-ARIMA forecast path extends the series with missing future observations
and runs the diffuse/ordinary filtering route. It returns forecasts and standard deviations,
scales the state variances and, when regressors are supplied, adds a quadratic term using their
coefficient covariance. In an authored scalar example with baseline variance one, adjusted
future regressor two and coefficient variance 1/4, that term adds one and the total becomes
two. The selected calculation conditions on the supplied ARIMA model and regressor scenario;
it does not by itself establish uncertainty from every model-selection or policy-design step.
Its public horizon convention also interprets a negative request in multiples of the annual
frequency, unlike a generic invalid-horizon refusal. The separate exact-forecast helper has
an unsupported numeric-mean overload. These details must be resolved at the wrapper
boundary.(jdemetra/jdplus-main contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026fn)

The candidate decisions are deliberately distinct. Tetrad is a conditional temporal-discovery

Source availability alone supplies neither a bank support contract nor a price.(cmu-phil/tetrad
contributors, 2026b; haifengl/smile contributors, 2026a; scalation/scalation2 contributors,

39.26       C++ temporal engines: row identity, shock meaning
            and uncertainty
A funding desk asks how a one-unit tightening of its funding spread changes lending and
liquidity over the next eight quarters. A matrix of forecasts answers that question only after
the unit, ordering, information clock and intervention have been fixed. A posterior distribution
over autoregressive coefficients does not itself identify the policy shock. A fast native kernel
also cannot recover an entity or date that its wrapper has assigned to the wrong row. The
useful comparison therefore begins with the complete request: entities and calendar, observed
variables, target shock, identifying restrictions, forecast origin, horizon, output type and
uncertainty law. C++ is an implementation language in this comparison; several candidates
expose their supported workflows through R or Python.
   Four authentic source collections provide distinct alternatives. BMR bundles BM++ kernels
for Bayesian VAR and time-varying parameters. The inspected BMR description says version
0.11.0, dated 24 June 2018, while its selected repository revision is dated 20 November
2018. The bsvars revision of 29 September 2026 carries development version 4.0.0.9000 and a
description dated 24 August 2026. The bssm revision of 24 September 2025 identifies version
2.0.3. Dazhong Wu’s panelvar revision of 24 March 2023 has a Python version module reporting
5.2.0 and a CMake project reporting 0.1.0; those identifiers must not be silently equated.
All selected revisions precede the client cutoff of 7 October 2026. The discussion concerns
inspected paths in these revisions, not current release guarantees.(kthohr/BMR contributors,

contributors, 2023)


39.26.1     Panel identity precedes the GMM calculation

For bank i at calendar date t, consider

                                  yit = ρyi,t−1 + x′it β + ai + uit .

Lagged-level and differenced instruments require explicit moment restrictions on uit , the
regressors and initial conditions. A pseudoinverse supplies a numerical choice for a singular
matrix; it does not supply those restrictions. The selected panelvar core constructs first-
and second-step GMM results. Its inverse helper unconditionally calls an Eigen complete-
orthogonal-decomposition pseudoinverse. The requested coefficient and covariance step is
separate from the inspected Hansen calculation, which uses the second-step weighting matrix
and moment vector. These are separate fields that an adapter must preserve.(dazhwu/panelvar
contributors, 2023)
   The wrapper deserves equal scrutiny. It converts observed entity and time labels to
categorical codes and uses the number of observed time categories as the panel width. It
calls a sorting method without retaining the returned object, then assigns incoming values
into a dense array selected by a membership mask. The mask selects destination rows in
destination order; it does not itself join incoming values by key. An authored example makes the
distinction explicit. Incoming row keys (1, 0, 3, 2) with values (20, 10, 40, 30) require key-ordered
values (10, 20, 30, 40). Positional assignment into the selected dense rows instead preserves
(20, 10, 40, 30). This is a source-path risk for unsorted inputs, not a reported execution failure
of an installed package. Duplicate keys and missing entity/date combinations need separate
tests.(dazhwu/panelvar contributors, 2023; Causal banking proposal project, 2026fc)
   Calendar identity is another condition. With dates (2000, 2002, 2003) and values (10, 20, 30),
a positional lag is (NA, 10, 20), whereas a one-year lag is (NA, NA, 20). Creating the Cartesian
39.26. C++ temporal engines: row identity, shock meaning and uncertainty                  811


product of observed labels does not invent the omitted year 2001. The native lag-table
constructor also initializes output to missing and copies a lagged value only when the current
value of the same variable is nonmissing. Thus instrument availability can depend on a
current-value guard as well as the lagged observation. The proposal must specify whether the
desired instrument can exist at a date whose current measurement is absent, then compare that
rule with the selected implementation.(dazhwu/panelvar contributors, 2023; Causal banking
proposal project, 2026fc)
  A second exact witness uses the repeated-moment matrix
                              !                           !
                         1 1                  +     1 1 1
                  W =        ,            W       =       ,     W W + W = W.
                         1 1                        4 1 1

There are two raw columns but rank one. The identity verifies the authored pseudoinverse
arithmetic, not a package-specific rank threshold or a distributional theorem. A public
qualification fixture must report moment rank, effective parameter rank, requested covariance
and diagnostic denominator together. In the inspected Hansen helper, the p-value uses the
chi-square CDF, but the field named critical value is populated by a density evaluated at
0.95 rather than a quantile. That field must not be presented as a 95% cutoff without repair
and a native regression test. The surrounding wrapper’s stability and p-value screening is a
model-selection rule, not independent confirmation of exclusion restrictions.(dazhwu/panelvar
contributors, 2023; Causal banking proposal project, 2026fc)
  This candidate is useful as a direct C++/Python comparison and a potential narrowly
repaired adapter target. Direct adoption is deferred until keyed alignment, calendar gaps,
moment rank, requested-step diagnostics and complete output status have been qualified.
Reimplementation of its equations would require an independent mathematical specification
and numerical reference; copying a solver alone would preserve none of these contracts.


39.26.2    BMR separates posterior draws, shocks and frozen-time responses

Write a reduced-form VAR as
                                 p
                                 X
                      yt = c +         Aℓ yt−ℓ + Dxt + εt ,   Var(εt ) = Σ.
                                 ℓ=1

BMR’s embedding helper stacks matrix row offsets. Its selected conjugate VAR path joins
exogenous regressors separately. The impulse response uses a lower Cholesky factor of Σ, or a
different construction when long-run restrictions are selected. For C = I − ℓ Aℓ , that latter
                                                                           P

path constructs C chol(C −1 ΣC −T ). Invertibility and the chosen ordering are numerical and
substantive conditions that must be stated. Neither factorization independently proves that
the first innovation is a bank funding intervention.(kthohr/BMR contributors, 2018)
   The optional stationary-draw rule rejects coefficient draws until the maximum modulus
of the companion eigenvalues is less than one. The inspected loop has no explicit iteration
cap. A service contract therefore needs an external work budget, cancellation and a retained
attempted/accepted draw count. Those controls change operational behavior; a truncated
sampler cannot be described as an unmodified posterior sample without further justification.
Compiler, BLAS and random-number implementations remain part of the artifact contract.
   Forecasting has two branches. One propagates coefficient draws and sampled future innova-
tions; the other suppresses future innovations. Both advance the endogenous lag slots while
leaving the supplied external entries fixed in the inspected routine. A request containing a
changing future macroeconomic path cannot be treated as equivalent to the fixed external
812                                                          Causal analysis for a universal bank


vector. The distinction also explains why a distribution of conditional means can be narrower
than a predictive distribution for future observations. The adapter must label which object it
returns.(kthohr/BMR contributors, 2018)
   In the time-varying-parameter IRF routine, one coefficient time slice is selected and then
held across response horizons. A frozen local response is useful, but differs from a response
propagated through a changing future coefficient path. In an authored scalar example, a
current coefficient 1/2 gives a frozen two-step response 1/4; coefficients 1/2 and 3/4 along
successive transitions give 3/8. No native BMR run supplies these numbers: they are exact
calculations showing why the proposed API needs a frozen-time versus evolving-path tag.
BMR is retained as a reference and possible bounded integration candidate. A port should
follow a separately reviewed specification of these choices, not expose every output under
a generic causal-response name.(kthohr/BMR contributors, 2018; Causal banking proposal

39.26.3    bsvars: conditioning, recursive regressors and failure denominators

The inspected bsvars structural convention can be represented as

                 B (yt − Axt ) = ut ,    Var(ut ) = Λt ,    Σt = B −1 Λt B −T .

Its response helper starts with B −1 , includes horizon zero and optionally scales each impact
column by its own diagonal entry. Sign normalization separately searches sign combinations
relative to a benchmark matrix. Scaling, sign normalization and substantive identification
solve different problems. A zero diagonal impact makes that particular scaling unsuitable; a
benchmark sign convention is not additional evidence about the true policy shock. Public
fixtures should retain the unscaled response and the transformation applied to it.(bsvars/bsvars
contributors, 2026)
  The conditional-forecast helper partitions fixed and free coordinates and uses the Gaussian
conditional mean and Schur complement. With unit marginal variances, covariance 1/2 and
the first coordinate fixed at two, the second coordinate has conditional mean one and variance
3/4. In an authored common-cause model with the same observational covariance and no
causal arrow between the coordinates, intervening on the first coordinate leaves the second
mean zero and variance one. The observational covariance alone cannot choose between these
semantics. A funding stress scenario described as a conditioning event must not be relabeled
an intervention by the CLI or an LLM agent.(bsvars/bsvars contributors, 2026; Causal banking
proposal project, 2026fc)
  A concrete wrapper-to-kernel contract concerns recursive lag shifts. The R wrapper prepares
a next-origin vector with the latest dependent values, previous lags, a constant and optional
exogenous columns. The selected C++ update prepends the simulated next observation
and appends the old vector beginning at index N , where N is the number of dependent
variables. For two variables and two lags, an authored old vector (10, 20, 7, 8, 1) and new
observation (11, 21) give (11, 21, 7, 8, 1) under that expression; ordinary lag advancement
requires (11, 21, 10, 20, 1). The one-lag case does not expose this particular mismatch. This
scoped source finding requires a native fixture with the exact wrapper and artifact before
any claim about released runtime behavior.(bsvars/bsvars contributors, 2026; Causal banking
proposal project, 2026fc)
  Output uncertainty also needs a precise name. The stored covariance slices are the per-step
innovation matrices B −1 Λt B −T along a draw, while recursive sample paths can accumulate
earlier innovations. Even with fixed parameters, an AR(1) coefficient 1/2 and unit innovation
variance have two-step forecast-error variance 5/4, not one. A conditional-mean field calculated
39.26. C++ temporal engines: row identity, shock meaning and uncertainty                        813


before imposing a fixed observation need not equal the conditional mean after that restriction.
These distinctions must survive serialization.(bsvars/bsvars contributors, 2026; Causal banking
proposal project, 2026fc)
  The inspected forecasting function catches selected sampling exceptions by breaking the
horizon loop, then returns its output containers without an explicit failure mask. A wrapper
cannot infer successful completion from the container shape alone. Qualification must inject a
controlled failing draw, inspect every horizon and record attempted draws, complete draws,
partial draws and refusals. The proposal retains bsvars as a strong structural-model comparison
and a candidate for a version-specific adapter after these contracts are verified. It rejects a
generic forecast-to-intervention conversion. No installed artifact or upstream test has been
executed for this review.


39.26.4     bssm: missing observations, singular covariance and prediction
            types

For a scalar observation of a latent state, write

                     yt = Dt + Zt′ αt + Ht et ,     αt+1 = Ct + Tt αt + Rt ηt .

In the inspected bssm univariate Gaussian filter, a nonfinite observation skips the measurement
update, while the transition still adds Rt Rt′ . With unit initial variance, identity transition and
unit process variance, two missing observations leave predicted state variances two and three.
Dropping the missing rows would change the model clock and the uncertainty. The same
selected branch is taken when the innovation variance fails the default threshold 10−12 . An
adapter must distinguish an absent observation from a finite observation judged numerically
degenerate.(helske/bssm contributors, 2025; Causal banking proposal project, 2026fc)
   A small positive variance is not always negligible evidence. For residual one and innovation
variance 1/(2 · 1012 ), the residual quadratic is 2 · 1012 , yet the inspected update predicate
is false at the default threshold. This authored boundary example motivates an explicit
exact-observation or numerical-refusal rule; it does not establish the behavior of every bssm
model. The likelihood also has an initial noise-factor guard, which must be exercised separately.
Tests should vary the observation scale and tolerance without silently replacing an impossible
observation by missingness.(helske/bssm contributors, 2025; Causal banking proposal project,
2026fc)
   The helper named for positive-semidefinite Cholesky removes directions with effectively
zero diagonal and Cholesky-factors the retained principal block. That handles a particular
degeneracy. The rank-one matrix with all entries equal to one has positive diagonal, so it
retains both directions and reaches an ordinary factorization of a singular block. This is a
different case from a zero-variance coordinate. The inspected R initial-covariance validator
checks numeric type and dimensions; it does not establish positive semidefiniteness. A qualified
adapter needs a declared admissible covariance class, explicit failure behavior and a reference
for singular positive-diagonal cases.(helske/bssm contributors, 2025; Causal banking proposal
project, 2026fc)
   Prediction types are substantive. The selected kernel simulates state transitions for state
and conditional-mean outputs; response output adds measurement noise. Thus a sampled
conditional mean still varies through state uncertainty. A unit state variance and measurement
variance four produce response variance five in the authored scalar witness. Reproducibility
also spans two random-number systems: the R wrapper samples posterior indices and passes a
separate seed to the C++ engine. Freezing only the latter does not freeze the whole request.
bssm is retained as a state-space integration candidate within a frozen model family; it is not
814                                                          Causal analysis for a universal bank


admitted as a general causal identification service.(helske/bssm contributors, 2025; Causal
banking proposal project, 2026fc)


39.26.5    From source comparisons to an executable public qualification plan

The practical choices are conditional. For panelvar, first qualify keyed preprocessing and
diagnostic fields, then consider a narrow repaired C++/Python adapter. For BMR, preserve its
posterior, recursive identification, exogenous-path and frozen-time conventions in a reference
implementation before choosing integration or a port. For bsvars, qualify lag recursion,
conditional semantics, normalization and failure accounting on the exact artifact before
structural-workflow integration. For bssm, bind a declared state family, covariance class,
missing-step rule and two-stage RNG identity. None of these routes is blanket approval of a
package, all its dependencies or redistribution rights.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026fc)
   The recorded source declarations are GPL version 2 or later for BMR and bssm, GPL
version 3 or later for bsvars, and MIT for the inspected panelvar root. BMR and bssm use
RcppArmadillo with selected debug checks disabled; bsvars specifies Armadillo and native linear-
algebra settings; the panelvar build contains architecture-specific flags and fixed Python/Eigen
paths. Those observations establish declared source and build conditions, not a complete
legal or binary-equivalence review. A service boundary is an engineering choice and does
not by itself settle distribution obligations.(kthohr/BMR contributors, 2018; bsvars/bsvars
contributors, 2026; helske/bssm contributors, 2025; dazhwu/panelvar contributors, 2023)
   Before expensive bank experiments, freeze public known-law fixtures for sorted and unsorted
panels, duplicate keys, missing dates, repeated instruments, VAR lag orders one and two,
correlated shocks, normalized responses, missing-state steps and singular covariance. The
proposal library, CLI and MCP must carry the same entity/date digest, origin, lag convention,
shock scale, restriction set, prediction type, parameter/draw identity, failure status and cost
denominator. A schema-valid response must not promote conditioning into intervention or
source inspection into native qualification. Package wrappers, native kernels and a project-
authored reference should be compared separately so that a discrepancy has a traceable
location.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026fc)
   The present rational witnesses run only project-authored code. They establish comparison
targets and failure hypotheses, not native performance. As a hypothetical cost illustration,
USD24,000 divided by 800 attempted, 600 completed or 400 accepted requests is USD30,
USD40 or USD60 respectively. Real costs and accepted utility remain unmeasured. The source
search also remains bounded: broad C++ panel queries contain many solar-panel projects,
precise queries can return no hits, and relevant projects may be classified by their wrapper
language. Retain those denominators and uninspected leads; a zero-result query is not an
absence proof. Complete remaining delegates, native artifact qualification, dependence-sensitive
uncertainty and actual banking restrictions before claiming full temporal coverage.(Causal
banking proposal project, 2026fc)


39.27      Julia and gretl temporal workflows: a common clock is
           part of the model
A funding analyst comparing a panel estimator, a local projection and a state-space forecast
needs more than the same variable names. The bank must decide whether one lag means
one calendar period or one observed row, whether a shock has unit variance or unit impact,
whether a covariance conditions on estimated parameters, and whether missing components
39.27. Julia and gretl temporal workflows: a common clock is part of the model                815


remove an entire observation. These choices determine the scientific target before the imple-
mentation language matters. The present comparison examines four Julia projects and gretl’s
C implementation and command environment. It complements the R, Python, JVM and C++
reviews without claiming that a finite set of packages exhausts the remaining ecosystems.
   The selected authentic revisions precede 7 October 2026. DynamicPanelModels.jl reports
version 0.4.0 at a 1 October 2026 revision; LocalProjections.jl reports 0.2.1 at 26 April 2024;
MacroEconometricTools.jl reports 0.1.1 at 22 September 2026; StateSpaceModels.jl reports 0.8.0
at 24 August 2026. The gretl source version is 2026c-git at 7 October 2026. A repository date
and version string identify the reviewed bytes; they do not establish a tested installed artifact.
In particular, source-level findings below are conditional descriptions and proposed native tests,
not measured failures of published binaries.(MichalS16/DynamicPanelModels.jl contributors,
2026; junyuan-chen/LocalProjections.jl contributors, 2024; gragusa/MacroEconometricTools.jl
contributors, 2026; LAMPSPUC/StateSpaceModels.jl contributors, 2026; gretl-project/gretl
