39.27.1     DynamicPanelModels: sorting, differencing and instrument clocks

The Julia panel constructor explicitly rejects duplicate entity/time pairs and groups a sorted
table by entity. Those are valuable safeguards for a bank panel. They do not by themselves
establish one calendar convention throughout the estimation path. In the inspected trans-
formation, lagged regressor values are shifted by row position. A separate first-difference
check admits a row only if its current and previous time labels differ by one. Instrument
construction then indexes earlier positions in the globally observed time-label vector and looks
up the selected value for the entity. These three operations must be compared as a composed
contract.(MichalS16/DynamicPanelModels.jl contributors, 2026)
   An authored example uses dates (1, 3, 4) and levels (10, 30, 40). At date four, the current
and previous dates are adjacent, so the current first-difference gate passes. A row-shifted
lagged regressor contains values 30 and 10 at the two relevant rows, yielding a difference of
20. A one-calendar-period lagged difference would require the level at date two, which is
absent. The same globally observed label sequence can make a nominal second-lag instrument
select date one rather than date two. This does not show that all requests are wrong: regular
complete calendars avoid this particular discrepancy. It shows why the adapter must declare
the integer calendar grid and test a gap followed by adjacent dates, not merely a gap at the
current pair.(MichalS16/DynamicPanelModels.jl contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal
project, 2026fr)
   The forward-orthogonal-deviation path subtracts future observed-row means and applies the
corresponding count-based scaling. Its suffix sums propagate missing values. A calendar-grid
transformation, an observed-row transformation and a transformation using only finite future
values are different conventions. The admissible sample and instrument matrix must be
recorded with the result. The moment conditions also need the usual substantive restrictions
on errors, initial values and the roles of regressors; a label such as system GMM does not
verify those restrictions for bank data.
   The numerical path distinguishes regressors from instruments. Collinear regressors are
rejected; optional instrument pruning uses pivoted QR, a relative diagonal tolerance and
the selected pivot columns returned in original order. The actual pivot selection is more
precise than an informal promise to retain the earliest member of each collinear set. The
subsequent count comparison is useful but is not a proof of identification or valid uncertainty.
For example, with QR diagonal magnitudes (1, 10−10 ), a relative tolerance 10−9 retains one
direction, including after scaling both magnitudes by 104 . A different absolute cutoff can change
816                                                             Causal analysis for a universal bank


the retained count under that rescaling. This authored witness defines an interoperability test,
not a Julia linear-algebra benchmark.(MichalS16/DynamicPanelModels.jl contributors, 2026;
Causal banking proposal project, 2026fr)
   The proposal retains DynamicPanelModels as a bounded Julia adapter candidate after calen-
dar, instrument-identity and covariance tests. Direct adoption requires the exact transformed
row keys, retained instrument columns, covariance choice and refusal reason. A port must
reproduce those decisions from a reviewed specification, including any deliberate repair, rather
than copy only a coefficient solve.


39.27.2     Local projections: horizon samples and dependence are explicit
            choices

A local projection estimates a separate relationship for each horizon, schematically

                                yt+h = ah + βh st + Γ′h wt + ut,h ,

where st is the proposed shock and wt contains the declared controls. Identification depends on
the shock and information set, not the availability of a regression routine. Even before identifi-
cation, horizon h changes which observations are available. The inspected LocalProjections.jl
path constructs row-position slices for regressors and outcomes, filters finite numeric values, and
stores a separate sample count for each horizon. Options also determine whether IV first stages
and weak-instrument diagnostics are recomputed by horizon.(junyuan-chen/LocalProjections.jl
contributors, 2024)
   With 12 dates and two presample lags, horizon zero can use origins three through twelve.
If the outcome at date five is missing and the illustrative regressors remain complete, nine
origins survive. At horizon two, eligible origins three through ten lose origin three because
its outcome is date five, leaving seven. The missing observation removes different origins at
different horizons. A curve of estimated responses can therefore combine different populations
and information sets. A common-sample comparison may be appropriate, but it is an
additional design decision with its own loss of observations; it must not be silently imposed
or silently assumed.(junyuan-chen/LocalProjections.jl contributors, 2024; Causal banking
proposal project, 2026fr)
   The covariance alternatives are substantive. The inspected heteroskedasticity-and-
autocorrelation-robust path supplies a cosine-transform long-run covariance, a bandwidth rule
and corresponding critical-value and p-value functions. The cluster path instead delegates
to Vcov.jl. These names do not imply equivalent uncertainty for shared calendar shocks,
few periods or few banks. A qualification request must freeze the estimator, score ordering,
bandwidth or clustering key, effective sample, degrees of freedom and interval construction.
Complete Vcov and fixed-effect delegates, numerical tolerances and installed dependencies
remain separate work. References mentioned in package comments do not import their
scholarly theorems into this comparison.
  LocalProjections is retained as a conditional integration candidate for explicit horizon and
dependence contracts. A generic replacement of all temporal estimators by one projection
API is rejected. Where native comparison later succeeds, the library, CLI and MCP should
expose the horizon-specific row digest and uncertainty method so that a downstream agent
cannot mistake different sample composition for a changing causal mechanism.(junyuan-
chen/LocalProjections.jl contributors, 2024; Causal banking proposal project, 2026fr)
39.27. Julia and gretl temporal workflows: a common clock is part of the model                  817


39.27.3     Proxy VARs: unit impact and unit shock variance are different

MacroEconometricTools provides a recursive covariance-factor route and a selected proxy-VAR
route. The recursive path factors a covariance under the chosen ordering and restores original
indexing. The proxy path fits a first stage with an intercept, derives impact ratios and sets
the target-variable coefficient to one. Its instrument helper accepts an array with the same
residual-row count, or keeps the last required number of rows from a longer array. That is
positional alignment, not a join on dates or an audit of the proxy’s information clock. The
displayed first-stage threshold is a relevance diagnostic convention; it cannot establish exclusion,
timing or stability.(gragusa/MacroEconometricTools.jl contributors, 2026)
   Let b be an impact vector normalized so that its target coordinate is one. A unit-variance
                                 √
shock impact is generally q = ω b, with a scale ω that must be justified. The inspected
completion routine places b in the target column, subtracts bb′ from the reduced-form covariance
Σ, clips negative eigenvalues of the remaining principal block, and fills other columns and
cross terms. The equality P P ′ = Σ must therefore be checked rather than inferred from the
returned matrix shape.(gragusa/MacroEconometricTools.jl contributors, 2026)
  An exact witness takes                       !               !
                                        1/4 0                1
                                 Σ=           ,        b=      .
                                         0 1                 0
The selected completion algebra yields a first-column contribution of one to the first variance,
whereas the reduced-form variance is 1/4. Filling the other coordinate cannot repair that 3/4
discrepancy. This is an authored scale counterexample to conflating unit effect with unit shock
variance; it is not a theorem about all proxy estimators or an execution of this package. The
appropriate next test includes the exact normalization, reconstructed covariance, identified
column and arbitrary completion columns separately. Only the instrument-identified response
should receive the corresponding causal interpretation.(gragusa/MacroEconometricTools.jl
contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026fr)
   The proposed decision is reference use pending version-specific normalization and alignment
qualification. Direct admission of a full returned impact matrix as independently identified is
rejected. A repair may require an explicit shock-variance scale, a bounded partial-identification
output or refusal; additional scientific restrictions, not eigenvalue clipping alone, determine
which route is justified.


39.27.4     StateSpaceModels: partial missingness and covariance time indices

The state-space alternative addresses a different target: a latent state and future observation law
conditional on model parameters. In the selected time-invariant multivariate filter, a predicate
that finds any NaN in the observation vector sends the entire vector through the missing-
observation branch. The state transition and process covariance still advance, but observed
coordinates do not receive a measurement update on that branch. The time-varying multivariate
path has a separately structured likelihood update, including an update after its missingness
branch, so behavior must be qualified per dispatch path.(LAMPSPUC/StateSpaceModels.jl
contributors, 2026)
  A simple authored witness starts with a scalar state having mean zero and variance one.
Of two potential measurements, suppose one is absent and the other equals two with unit
measurement variance. Using the observed measurement gives gain 1/2, posterior mean one
and posterior variance 1/2. Skipping the entire observation vector preserves mean zero and
variance one before the transition. Both behaviors are expressible in an API, but they do not
deliver the same inference service. A bank feed with asynchronous measurements needs an
818                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


explicit partial-observation contract.(LAMPSPUC/StateSpaceModels.jl contributors, 2026;
Causal banking proposal project, 2026fr)
   Forecast indexing also deserves a known-law test. The output storage records innovation
covariance at index t and the next predictive state at t + 1. The no-exogenous forecast selects
future covariance using an index ending in +i, while the inspected exogenous forecast uses
the corresponding expression ending in +i − 1. For a stored sequence containing the last
observed variance seven followed by future variances eleven and seventeen, the desired two
future entries are (11, 17); selecting one entry earlier produces (7, 11). Constant covariance
can hide this discrepancy, so the fixture must vary observation or state uncertainty over time.
This is a source-index finding for the selected generic path; specialized methods require their
own review.(LAMPSPUC/StateSpaceModels.jl contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal
project, 2026fr)
   The forecasting routines copy fitted hyperparameters into the new model and propagate the
state-space law. That is not automatically integration over parameter-estimation uncertainty.
The fitting path also maps selected numerical failures to a fixed optimizer penalty and can retain
NaN standard errors after Hessian failure. An adapter must preserve optimizer diagnostics,
covariance status and the distinction between conditional prediction and uncertainty over fitted
parameters. A finite forecast is not evidence that the parameter uncertainty was successfully
quantified.
   StateSpaceModels is retained for bounded state-family comparison and possible integration
after partial-missingness, covariance-index, optimizer and parameter-uncertainty tests. A
universal causal state-space interface remains unsupported without a causal model and its
identifying information.(LAMPSPUC/StateSpaceModels.jl contributors, 2026; Causal banking
proposal project, 2026fr)


39.27.5     gretl: public command contracts and numerical repair must agree

The gretl dynamic-panel implementation offers distinct option paths for two-step estimation,
covariance correction and collapsed instruments. Its first weighting-matrix inversion can fail,
compute a rank mask, reduce the instrument system and retry, with error codes retained.
The inspected rank-mask delegate uses QR diagonal magnitudes and an absolute threshold
of 10−8 . This is a different contract from the relative pivoted-QR rule described above.
Under the authored diagonal witness (1, 10−10 ), the absolute rule retains one direction; after
multiplication by 104 , it retains two. This comparison motivates scale-aware parity tests
and records the effective instrument set; it does not imply that either method universally
dominates.(gretl-project/gretl contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026fr)
   The native panel routine uses the declared dataset layout to find entity-specific usable
positions and dependent-variable lags. It records those positions for residual placement.
Upstream dataset construction, period frequency and padding therefore belong in the command-
level qualification. A row layout that merely has the right dimensions is insufficient. Full
serial-correlation, covariance-correction and command-to-native paths still need matched
runtime fixtures and exact dependency review.
   The VAR response API distinguishes a point response from a bootstrap result. Without
a data matrix, or when the interval parameter is zero, the inspected route returns the point
estimate; otherwise it calls a separate bootstrap delegate. An adapter must expose that
branch and cannot label a point-only response as an interval service. Likewise, the selected
Kalman missing-step helper advances the state and adds process covariance while recording
zero measurement contribution. A scalar unit-variance witness evolves through variances two
and three after two missing steps, preserving the elapsed model clock. Other Kalman variants
39.28. R network workflows: the exposure, assignment and population must travel together       819


and partial-observation paths remain separately scoped.(gretl-project/gretl contributors, 2026;
Causal banking proposal project, 2026fr)
   The proposal treats gretl as a potential command-process and C-library integration candidate.
The command-process choice can make complete input and output records easier to retain,
but does not establish binary compatibility, permissions or legal clearance. Its selected sources
declare GPL version 3 or later; the four Julia project roots carry named MIT declarations.
Complete dependency rights, compiled artifacts, interface stability and operating costs remain
unqualified. No downloaded code was executed for this review.(gretl-project/gretl contributors,
2026; MichalS16/DynamicPanelModels.jl contributors, 2026; junyuan-chen/LocalProjections.jl
contributors, 2024; gragusa/MacroEconometricTools.jl contributors, 2026; LAMPSPUC/S-

39.27.6     An ordered public test program across independent candidates

The first test group concerns representation: unique entity/date keys, gaps followed by adjacent
dates, absent periods, lagged instruments and horizon-specific rows. The second concerns
scientific semantics: recursive versus proxy restrictions, unit impact versus unit variance,
identified versus completed response columns, and conditioning versus intervention. The
third concerns uncertainty: rank thresholds under rescaling, cluster and long-run covariance,
partial missingness, forecast time indices, parameter uncertainty and numerical failure. The
fourth concerns reproducibility and operation: artifact hashes, dependencies, request/response
equivalence across library, CLI and MCP, complete failure denominators and measured costs.
Independent candidates can advance through their own tests without waiting for an unrelated
source-access problem.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026fr)
   Every comparison requires a project-authored reference and a frozen target law before native
experiments. For example, a hypothetical USD27,000 study costs USD30 per 900 attempts,
USD45 per 600 completions and USD60 per 450 accepted outputs. Those arithmetic facts do
not establish measured efficiency or bank value. Public data and known-law generators can
justify further expenditure, while bank assignment truth, exclusions and operating acceptance
remain later evidence. The bounded searches retain irrelevant solar-panel projects, repository-
language limitations, uninspected leads and an incomplete gretl search tail. Octave-specific
coverage and additional temporal ecosystems remain open. Do not interpret the selected
originals as ecosystem saturation or complete temporal qualification.(Causal banking proposal
project, 2026fr)


39.28      R network workflows: the exposure, assignment and
           population must travel together
A bank choosing which branches receive a retention intervention faces several different network
questions. It may ask for an exposure-specific response under a randomized allocation, an
effect among customers whose treatment changes with an encouragement, a test of a sharp
exposure null, or the value of a policy selected from a constrained class. These are different
targets. A common software interface must preserve their distinctions instead of treating every
object called a spillover effect as an interchangeable number. The network itself is part of the
observation contract: borrower identifiers, direction, weights, missing relationships and the
time at which an edge became available determine which exposure is being measured.
   The present comparison extends the earlier inferference review with eight R implementations
at authentic pre-cutoff revisions. The selected versions are interference 0.1.0, latenetwork 1.0.1,
820                                                                  Causal analysis for a universal bank


BicliqueRT 1.0.0, NetworkTargeting 0.0.0.9000, NetworkCausalTree 1.0.0, MisspecifiedInterfer-
ence 1.2, autognet 0.0.3 and clusteredinterference 1.0.1. Their inspected revisions range from
2019 through June 2026 and precede the client cutoff of 7 October 2026. Repository dates and
declarations identify source bytes; none of these selected packages or their tests was executed
in this comparison. The findings below concern inspected expressions, composed call paths
and project-authored exact witnesses. They are not installed-package benchmarks or imported
proofs from papers named in source comments.(Bradley Saul, 2026; szonszein/interference
contributors, 2022; cran/latenetwork contributors, 2023; dpuelz/BicliqueRT contributors, 2026;
dviviano/NetworkTargeting contributors, 2024; fbargaglistoffi/NetworkCausalTree contrib-
utors, 2026; barwein/Misspecified_Interference contributors, 2025; isabelfulcher/autognet
contributors, 2020; BarkleyBG/clusteredinterference contributors, 2019)


39.28.1     Design-based exposures: a label is a mathematical contract

Let Z = (Z1 , . . . , Zn ) denote the assignment vector, A the declared adjacency matrix, and
ei (Z, A) a specified exposure map for customer i. A mean under exposure c requires an
identifying relationship between the potential response and that map, as well as support under
the assignment law. The notation πi (c) = Pr{ei (Z, A) = c} concerns that law; it is not an
ordinary propensity inferred merely from the presence of a network field. Joint probabilities
πij (c, d) also matter for uncertainty. A command must retain the design or simulator, the
map, and the precise population along with the resulting estimates.
   The interference package constructs first-degree categories from own assignment and a
positive peer-exposure indicator. Its selected expression multiplies the assignment row vector
by the adjacency matrix. Thus an asymmetric adjacency convention must be checked against
the bank’s arrow convention. Its two-hop option uses a thresholded matrix square with a
zeroed diagonal. A two-step path is not necessarily a neighbor at shortest-path distance exactly
two: triangles can create overlap with direct neighbors. A translation layer must describe that
convention rather than silently replace it with a different graph operator.(szonszein/interference
contributors, 2022)
   One inspected full-neighborhood helper is particularly useful as a qualification target. Its
documentation names two conditions: the focal unit and all neighbors treated, or the focal
unit and all neighbors controlled. The selected implementation instead defines the second
indicator by exposure count less than neighborhood size. In a two-node connected graph with
assignment (1, 0), neither closed neighborhood is all controlled, yet both are not all treated.
The authored witness therefore produces two true selected control indicators and two false
literal all-control indicators. The distinction is substantive: a comparison with a mixture of
partially treated neighborhoods answers a different question from comparison with universal
local control. Admission should wait for an explicit choice of contract and a version-specific
native test.(szonszein/interference contributors, 2022; Causal banking proposal project, 2026gf)
  The probability builder also makes an explicit approximation. With R simulated assignments
and exposure-indicator matrix Ic , the same-exposure matrix is
                                   Ic Ic′ + In              Ic Id′
                          Pbcc =               ,   Pbcd =            (c ̸= d).
                                     R+1                     R
The additive diagonal correction is not the exact enumerated design probability. If four
assignments exhaust a two-person Bernoulli design and each of four categories occurs once
for a focal person, the four corrected marginals are 2/5 and sum to 8/5, whereas the exact
probabilities are 1/4. This does not by itself invalidate every use of a deliberate Monte Carlo
correction. It requires the adapter to distinguish corrected finite-simulation quantities from
an exact probability distribution and to assess their effect on estimates and uncertainty. A
39.28. R network workflows: the exposure, assignment and population must travel together    821


positive correction for an unseen event does not establish that the scientific design supports
that event.(szonszein/interference contributors, 2022; Causal banking proposal project, 2026gf)
   The selected permutation generator rounds np to a fixed treated count, samples assign-
ments and rejects duplicates unless repetition is allowed. That is a fixed-count design, not
independent Bernoulli assignment. The estimator then distinguishes a Horvitz–Thompson
total from a Hájek normalized total, and marks an exposure with no observed contributors as
unavailable. The proposed reuse is a restricted design-based adapter with explicit mapping
and probability modes. Direct adoption of a generic exposure label without these choices
is rejected. Complete covariance helpers, random-state behavior and dependencies remain
qualification work.(szonszein/interference contributors, 2022; Causal banking proposal project,
2026gf)


39.28.2    Instrumented network responses: support and the variance law
           remain separate

The latenetwork direct path forms empirical joint strata of an instrument Zi and an instrumental
exposure Ti . It compares conditional outcome and treatment means across instrument values,
then returns their ratio. Schematically the ratio is

                              E[Y
                              b   | Z = 1, T = t] − E[Y
                                                    b   | Z = 0, T = t]
                      θ(t)
                      b =                                                 .
                             E[D
                             b   | Z = 1, T = t] − E[D
                                                   b   | Z = 0, T = t]

For a bank encouragement, assignment validity, exclusion, treatment-response restrictions and
the interpretation of the exposure stratum are substantive requirements. An empty empirical
stratum or near-zero denominator is a separate numerical and inferential problem. Neither is
resolved by a function returning a local-effect label.(cran/latenetwork contributors, 2023)
   The selected validator rejects missing inputs, nonbinary assignments, asymmetric adjacency
and nonzero diagonal entries. In particular, its symmetry test counts unequal transpose entries;
it does not sum signed differences that would cancel. The direct routine constructs undirected
graph distances on the original population before restricting to the requested subpopulation.
Paths through customers outside that subpopulation can therefore remain in the distance
matrix. This differs from computing distances on the induced subgraph and must be carried
into the uncertainty contract.(cran/latenetwork contributors, 2023)
  The inspected HAC branch uses Kij = 1{d(i, j) ≤ b} in a score quadratic, followed by a
square root. A distance cutoff matrix need not be positive semidefinite. For the three-node

39.28.3    Conditional randomization tests need typed failure and tie semantics

BicliqueRT accepts a design function, an exposure function and a null-equivalence relation.
The inspected preparation places the observed assignment in the first column, simulates other
assignments from the supplied design, and builds a null-exposure graph. The selected test
computes a statistic on the focal units and assignments of the chosen biclique. The native
bimax route has its own compiled call and bounded result capacity. These are useful building
blocks for a declared conditional test; the package title does not establish validity for an
arbitrary assignment sampler or an incorrectly specified null.(dpuelz/BicliqueRT contributors,
2026)
   The return contract needs special attention. Missing statistics are returned with a numerical
p-value field equal to three; a degenerate randomization distribution can return two. These
values represent exceptional states, not probabilities. A CLI or MCP wrapper must translate
them into explicit unavailable-test statuses while retaining the original diagnostic. A down-
stream agent that merely compares the field with 0.05 could otherwise describe a failed test as
evidence of no effect.(dpuelz/BicliqueRT contributors, 2026)
  The selected randomized-tail helper counts approximate ties with |tr − t0 | < 10−14 , but
separately counts all strict exceedances tr > t0 . Those two sets can overlap. Its expression is

                             #{r : tr > t0 } + U (1 + #{r : |tr − t0 | < ε})
                      pU =                                                   .
                                                 R+1

Take t0 = 0, simulated values (10−15 , 10−15 , 1), ε = 10−14 and the stipulated draw U = 3/4.
There are three strict exceedances and two approximate ties, giving pU = 21/16. The two-sided
expression 2 min(pU , 1 − pU ) then gives −5/8. The nondegeneracy condition is satisfied in
this authored example. This is a counterexample for the selected arithmetic contract, not a
native package run. A proposed repair must partition ties and strict tails consistently and
then prove or test the intended randomization law; clipping a number into [0, 1] is not a
validity argument. Random-state identity, tolerance scaling and refusal behavior belong in the
qualification suite.(dpuelz/BicliqueRT contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project,
2026gf)


39.28.4    Policy targeting: numerical optimization does not restore missing
           graph truth

NetworkTargeting proposes welfare-maximizing allocations under network features and treat-
ment constraints. Its selected wrapper refuses missing treatment or primary features, but
handles other missing inputs by changing the focal population and imputing values. Missing
contextual covariates receive column means; missing entries of selected network matrices
receive zero; affected rows become nonfocal. A zero is an asserted absence of a relationship,
whereas an unknown edge is an observation problem. The resulting policy objective therefore
needs its own explicit population and missingness interpretation.(dviviano/NetworkTargeting
contributors, 2024)
   The inspected MILP wrapper forwards the first constraint-tolerance parameter to both
tolerance arguments. The solver helper has explicit feasibility settings and a time limit when
it constructs its own parameters, then returns the Gurobi result. The selected caller consumes
the solution vector and objective in subsequent checks before an explicit termination-status
guard in that path. An admissible policy response must distinguish a feasible incumbent,
an optimal solution within tolerance, an infeasible request, a time-limited result and missing
solution fields. It must also preserve focal population, budget and out-of-sample policy value.
39.28. R network workflows: the exposure, assignment and population must travel together     823


A finite assignment vector alone certifies none of those properties.(dviviano/NetworkTargeting
contributors, 2024)
   Source rights also need a concrete resolution. A root GPL version-three text is present, while
DESCRIPTION still contains a license placeholder; the selected dependencies include Gurobi.
Those observations are not a complete distribution or entitlement decision. The proposal keeps
this candidate as a policy-optimization reference pending coherent rights, solver and scientific
contracts. Direct embedding or porting is deferred. The known route is to fix the target, trace
the complete optimization and score paths, test explicit termination states, and compare a
frozen public allocation problem against an exact small reference.(dviviano/NetworkTargeting
contributors, 2024; Causal banking proposal project, 2026gf)


39.28.5    Heterogeneous network effects: cluster splitting does not justify
           changing exposure

NetworkCausalTree builds a discovery tree from sampled clusters and estimates effects on
the remaining clusters. Its estimation path constructs the induced adjacency matrix of the
retained units and recomputes neighborhood exposure there. When clusters are disconnected
components, this can preserve the relevant relationships. If treatment across a discarded cross-
cluster tie affects a retained unit, the induced graph changes the exposure definition. Honest
sample splitting and scientifically correct exposure construction are separate requirements.
The bank must supply a defensible cluster boundary or retain the appropriate background
exposure.(fbargaglistoffi/NetworkCausalTree contributors, 2026)
   The public argument describes assignment probability as a unit-specific vector. The inspected
marginal helper nevertheless computes the chance of at least one treated neighbor using the
focal unit’s probability raised to its degree. For a focal probability 1/5 and one neighbor
probability 4/5, independent assignments give

                        Pr(Wi = 0, Gi = 1) = (1 − 1/5)(4/5) = 16/25,

while the selected expression uses (1 − 1/5)(1/5) = 4/25. Equal assignment probabili-
ties avoid this particular discrepancy. The adapter must therefore qualify heterogeneous
assignment probabilities explicitly rather than infer support from a vector-shaped argu-
ment.(fbargaglistoffi/NetworkCausalTree contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project,
2026gf)
   There is a separate adjacent-pair issue to test. In a two-node connected graph with
independent probability-one-half assignments, both units having own treatment one and a
treated neighbor occurs exactly when both are treated, with probability 1/4. The selected
joint helper expression evaluates to 1/16 when the shared-neighbor count is zero. The
inspected variance path, however, calls its pair correction only when that count is positive:
adjacent nodes with no common third neighbor are a separate dependency case. The authored
helper witness and the actual pair-selection branch must both be tested; they should not be
conflated into an assertion about a completed native interval. The proposal defers native
admission pending exposure, marginal, joint-probability, pair-selection and tree-selection
qualification.(fbargaglistoffi/NetworkCausalTree contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal
project, 2026gf)
824                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


39.28.6     Candidate graphs and auto-g-computation answer different uncer-
            tainty questions

MisspecifiedInterference takes a list of candidate graphs and forms an exposure indicator that
requires the same condition under every graph in that list. Its simulated probability matrices
use an additive diagonal correction, and its mean routines expose both fixed-population
and estimated-denominator forms. This construction makes the candidate list scientifically
consequential. If one candidate leaves the focal unit isolated, an indirect-exposure condition
can be impossible under that candidate. Requiring agreement with a one-edge alternative can
then have probability zero. A diagonal correction of 1/(R + 1) after zero observed occurrences
cannot make that target identifiable. At R = 9 it is numerically 1/10, while structural support
remains zero.(barwein/Misspecified_Interference contributors, 2025; Causal banking proposal
project, 2026gf)
   The route forward is to separate known design probabilities, simulation error, candidate-
graph restrictions and substantive guarantees that the true exposure model is represented.
An empty common event requires refusal, a changed target or justified information; it is
not a numerical smoothing problem. The selected DESCRIPTION contains an unevaluated
license-helper placeholder and the inspected complete repository tree has no license original.
This candidate is retained for reference study, with copying or distribution deferred until
rights and native behavior are resolved. No general repair for unknown bank relationships is
inferred.(barwein/Misspecified_Interference contributors, 2025)
   autognet instead evaluates network response models through parameter draws and nested
Gibbs simulations. The inspected R method selects parameter iterations by burn-in and thin-
ning, converts adjacency identities for native calls, and constructs average, direct and spillover
contrasts from distinct simulated targets. The native individual-intervention path runs a sepa-
rate chain for each selected person. Its averaging mode retains sampled binary outcomes after
burn-in; the nonaveraging mode returns the final conditional response probability. These are
different Monte Carlo outputs even when they concern the same model.(isabelfulcher/autognet
contributors, 2020)
   The number of parameter draws, number of within-network simulation sweeps, initial
states, retained iterations and individual intervention population all belong in the result
record. More sweeps may reduce simulation error conditional on a model, but do not validate
that model or certify chain mixing. The inspected source provides a bounded integration
candidate after index, allocation, convergence, Monte Carlo error and dependency tests.
An exact small-network enumeration can serve as the first reference before larger public
comparisons.(isabelfulcher/autognet contributors, 2020; Causal banking proposal project,
2026gf)


39.28.7     Clustered policies: an available-group mean is not an unchanged
            population

clusteredinterference supplies a group-based policy workflow with estimated nuisance param-
eters, treatment-vector evaluation and a sandwich variance. Its selected allocation helper
samples distinct vectors with a prescribed treated count and carries a multiplicity factor into
the probability integrand. Asking for all vectors sets the target number to the combinatorial
support size, but still collects them through random proposals and duplicate rejection. For six
equiprobable vectors the expected number of proposals to collect all six is 6 6j=1 1/j = 147/10.
                                                                             P

There is no deterministic upper bound on draws from that loop. A complete public test
should report proposal count and incomplete work, not only the requested number of distinct
vectors.(BarkleyBG/clusteredinterference contributors, 2019; Causal banking proposal project,
39.28. R network workflows: the exposure, assignment and population must travel together      825


2026gf)
   The quadrature helper integrates a single random effect over five standard deviations on either
side of zero. A caught integration error or a missing integral returns numeric zero. Numerical
failure and a scientifically zero assignment probability are different states and must remain
distinct in the adapter. The selected target routine takes the mean of group contributions
with missing values removed. For contributions (2, missing, 8), the available-group mean is five;
summing available contributions over the original three-group denominator gives 10/3. Neither
calculation supplies the unknown contribution. The distinction matters particularly because
earlier inferference paths retain a different denominator convention. Group omissions must be
visible before any cross-package comparison.(BarkleyBG/clusteredinterference contributors,
2019; Bradley Saul, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026gf)
   The sandwich routine solves an assembled bread matrix and sums group-score outer products.
Its inputs, derivative choices, singularity behavior and relation to the actual number of
usable groups must be reviewed together. The proposal retains a conditional group-policy
reference, with numerical-failure typing and population accounting as explicit admission
requirements. Cluster labels cannot establish absence of cross-group interference or shared
calendar shocks.(BarkleyBG/clusteredinterference contributors, 2019)


39.28.8     A public qualification portfolio with independent candidate deci-
            sions

The first public fixtures should enumerate tiny assignment spaces and verify exposure categories,
support, marginals and joint probabilities exactly. They should include asymmetric graphs, a
triangle, adjacent nodes without common neighbors, heterogeneous assignment probabilities,
isolated nodes and cross-cluster ties. The second group should test numerical and output
contracts: empty exposures, weak instrument denominators, indefinite score kernels, near ties,
failed randomization statistics, missing group contributions, quadrature errors, time-limited
optimization and nested simulation retention. Every request must retain the scientific target
and a typed failure state across library, CLI and MCP.(Causal banking proposal project,
2026gf)
  The third group concerns evidence beyond arithmetic. Match the assignment and sampling
law, compare uncertainty over fresh public or generated studies, retain complete failure
denominators, and measure total adapter, compute and review costs. An illustrative USD30,000
program costs USD30 per 1,000 attempts, USD50 per 600 completions and USD75 per 400
accepted outputs. These exact arithmetic comparisons are hypothetical and do not establish
bank returns. A useful public result can justify later bank experiments; it cannot supply
missing assignment truth or graph ownership.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026gf)
   The eight candidates remain separate reuse decisions. Bounded searches contain irrelevant
interference applications, discovery-only repositories and uninspected tails. Other observational,
simulation, spatial and experiment-design families remain open; the selected originals do not
establish exhaustive R coverage. Complete delegates, native artifacts, dependency rights and

an inconclusive coverage outcome while specifying executable next tests, without claiming
complete network qualification.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026gf)

39.29      Python network inference: preserving the assignment
           law through learning and policy evaluation
A bank allocating interventions across connected borrowers needs more than a graph attached
to an estimator. A household relationship can make an apparently untreated customer indi-
rectly exposed; a shared employer can create common shocks; a branch allocation can induce
correlated assignments; a recommendation policy can select a different population from the one
used to train a model. These distinctions determine both the target and the uncertainty. The
Python comparison therefore extends the existing MossSpider review with six source collections
addressing different parts of the problem: ANI, GraphDML, targeted interference, CausalMotifs,
CausalGraphCut and Causal-PIE. None is treated as a universal network-causal engine.(Paul
Zivich, 2026; mpleung/ANI contributors, 2025; Samrdreyfuss/graphdml contributors, 2026;
WeilinChen507/targeted_interference contributors, 2026; facebookresearch/CausalMotifs con-
tributors, 2021; Mamba413/CausalGraphCut contributors, 2025; RunpengDai/Causal-PIE
contributors, 2025)
   The selected originals are pinned to commits dated 8 June 2025, 7 October 2026, 10 August
2026, 8 February 2021, 26 May 2025 and 21 March 2025 respectively. GraphDML declares
version 0.1.0. Its selected commit is at 15:30 UTC on the cutoff day, or 23:30 in Asia/Shanghai,
within the client cutoff. Forty-eight saved files, complete selected repository trees and inspected
technical anchors support the comparison. Repository search supplies a bounded candidate
list with 54 unique leads; uninspected leads and search truncation remain omissions. The
calculations below are project-authored checks of specified expressions. No acquired package,
upstream test, neural training routine or graph simulator was executed, and papers mentioned
in source comments are not silently adopted as theorem evidence.(Causal banking proposal
project, 2026fy)


39.29.1     A common interface must preserve distinct network targets

Write Di for the treatment assigned to node i, A for the declared network, and ei (D, A) for
its exposure. The response may be represented as Yi (d, e) only under a substantive restriction
connecting the full assignment vector to the chosen exposure. A graph feature learned for
prediction does not establish that restriction. A design-based contrast requires assignment
probabilities for exposure events; a partially linear model instead imposes a response structure;
a policy evaluator needs the law of the proposed assignments and the relevant time horizon.
These objects should not be collapsed into a generic effect field.
   For banking use, the request should therefore bind the observation time, node identifiers,
arrow direction, edge weights, treatment assignment law, exposure operator, analysis population,
target policy and uncertainty law. A sum of neighbors’ treatments measures a different
intervention from their mean, especially when degree varies. An isolated borrower needs
an explicit exposure convention. A missing relationship is not automatically an absent
relationship. The proposed CLI and MCP result must carry these decisions and any refusal,
so downstream agents cannot interpret an output number without its scientific contract. The
package comparisons provide concrete tests of this proposed interface; they do not establish
that the interface is implemented.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026fy)
39.29. Python network inference                                                                827


39.29.2     ANI: uncertainty must not depend on the order of requested con-
            trasts

ANI constructs an inverse-probability exposure contrast from supplied indicators and proba-
bilities. Its population mask selects the contributors, while excluded score entries receive a
sentinel that is not intended for estimation. The standard-error routine computes distances
in the full undirected, unweighted graph and assumes nodes are numbered consistently with
score positions. Thus subsetting outcomes does not silently mean recomputing distances on an
induced graph. The explicit zero-bandwidth branch uses the population-standard-deviation
convention divided by the square root of the selected count.(mpleung/ANI contributors, 2025)
   For a positive bandwidth, let z be the centered score vector over the selected population of
size n and let Kij = 1{dA (i, j) ≤ b}. The selected variance of the mean is z ′ Kz/n2 . When
the intermediate quadratic is nonpositive, the code constructs a replacement from overlapping
neighborhoods. If Bij = 1{dA (i, j) ≤ b} and ri = j Bij , that replacement is P = B

39.29.3     GraphDML: useful graph-aware construction with population and
            covariance gates

GraphDML makes several interface distinctions explicit. The data container checks covariate
finiteness and graph dimensions, warns when dropping self-loops, rejects a nonsymmetric
graph unless direction is declared, and checks node identifiers. Its exposure operators dis-
tinguish unweighted sums, unweighted means, weighted sums and means, and shortest-path
distance exactly two. The two-hop implementation removes self and direct-neighbor en-
tries from the thresholded matrix product. The mean operator leaves isolated rows at zero.
Those conventions are valuable adapter contracts, provided the bank accepts their causal
meaning.(Samrdreyfuss/graphdml contributors, 2026)
828                                                                Causal analysis for a universal bank


  The estimation path forms dependency sets from own and exposure-row support. For a
held-out focal set, buffered nuisance training excludes treatment observations in the union of its
dependency sets and excludes outcome observations whose own dependency sets overlap that
union. The default final covariance is an empirical sandwich without a supplied group vector.
This is not evidence that the package lacks a cluster option: a separate cluster-summary method
aggregates scores by a supplied group and explicitly requires one repetition. Disjoint graph
supports alone do not verify conditional independence of primitive disturbances. A common
employer shock can violate that interpretation despite distant graph nodes; the scientific model
and a justified cluster law remain necessary.(Samrdreyfuss/graphdml contributors, 2026)
   The population contract also needs attention. When the focal set is a named selection rule,
the declared estimation nodes are supplied as candidates. When explicit focal indices are
supplied, the selected branch checks index range and disjoint dependency supports but returns
the indices without intersecting them with the declared estimation population. Total-effect
weights subsequently use that declared population. An adapter should reject incompatible
index sets or explicitly justify transport of the fitted coefficients; it should not silently describe
coefficients from one population as estimated in another. This is a branch-level finding, not a
claim that every fit takes the incompatible path.(Samrdreyfuss/graphdml contributors, 2026)
  The total effect has a precise model interpretation. For the proposed partially linear response

39.29.4     Targeted interference and CausalMotifs: learning the representation
            is not the entire inference problem

The targeted-interference implementation combines a graph encoder, separate outcome heads, a
treatment-probability head, a neighborhood-density head and spline fluctuations. The selected
neighborhood mean is AD/(A1) with no isolate guard in that expression. The treatment head
is trained with binary cross-entropy, while the fluctuation correction uses the product of its
output and the neighborhood-density output plus a small numerical stabilizer. The treatment
of control targets and the meaning of that factorization need a method-specific derivation and
known-law comparison. The inspected expression alone does not justify declaring the entire
method incorrect.(WeilinChen507/targeted_interference contributors, 2026)
   The selected code also includes CUDA-specific allocations and evaluates supplied test
potential-outcome truths during training methods. The inspected top-level loop uses configured
epoch counts; it does not establish that the optimizer selects a checkpoint using test truth.
Nevertheless, a proposed public experiment should keep final evaluation oracles inaccessible until
the model and hyperparameters are frozen. Synthetic potential outcomes can supply that oracle,
whereas observed bank data generally cannot. The conditional recommendation is to study the
architecture as a research reference and defer direct adoption until the target derivation, isolate
handling, device portability, held-out evaluation and distribution rights are resolved. No license-
named original appears in the selected complete tree.(WeilinChen507/targeted_interference
contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026fy)
   CausalMotifs learns partitions using network-motif features and simulated exposure probabil-
ities. Its constructor randomly divides rows into training and estimation subsets. That split is
useful for separating partition selection from estimation on rows, but does not itself make their
network disturbances independent. The nonseparate validation branch removes rows with zero
empirical probabilities and fits weighted least squares using the default fit covariance. The sepa-
rate Hájek helper contains individual variance and covariance terms rather than explicit pairwise
exposure covariances. Appropriate uncertainty therefore needs a declared assignment/depen-
dence law and a target population that records the filtering.(facebookresearch/CausalMotifs
contributors, 2021)
   Two selected support checks make small, deterministic tests especially valuable. The branch
without an own-treatment restriction reads the stored probability collection rather than the
passed collection. The own-treatment branch adds a list of rule arrays to the treatment array
before comparing with the target value; it does not append a parenthesized treatment-condition
array to the rule list. In the scalar arithmetic analogue, a true rule and treatment one produce
(1 + 1) == 1, which is false although their conjunction is true. Separately, the caller computes
left-control and right-control support checks but repeats the right-control term in its rejection
predicate. Array shapes and the exact caller path must be qualified in native tests before
interpreting the practical effect.(facebookresearch/CausalMotifs contributors, 2021; Causal
banking proposal project, 2026fy)
   The example generator requires equal care. It uses a very large synthetic graph, clustered
labels, and an index-distance shortcut to judge selected neighbor-neighbor relationships. Its
subsequent probability simulation rotates cluster alignment, unlike the initial assignment
expression. A bank should not port those illustrative shortcuts as general graph or assignment
semantics. The MIT source is a conditional research/adapter candidate after explicit Boolean-
rule tests, assignment-law reconciliation, support accounting and dependent uncertainty. Native
qualification remains open.(facebookresearch/CausalMotifs contributors, 2021; Causal banking
proposal project, 2026fy)

39.29.5     CausalGraphCut: inspect the custom delegate before judging the
            interface

CausalGraphCut addresses experimental allocation rather than simply estimating an effect
after assignments have been made. It constructs a covariance-weighted graph objective and
delegates spectral partitioning to a local class. That class directly eigendecomposes its input for
the selected discretization path. It would therefore be wrong to infer a standard-library affinity-
interface error merely from the public class name: the actual delegate has different semantics.
The proposed reuse is an allocation-design research reference whose objective must match the
bank’s assignment probability, network and outcome dependence.(Mamba413/CausalGraphCut
contributors, 2025)
   The inspected source exposes separate implementation gates. The default maximum cluster
count is a rounded power of the node count cast to a signed eight-bit integer. For 4,096
nodes the unwrapped value is 256, whose eight-bit wrapping representation is zero. This is an
authored arithmetic witness; installed NumPy conversion behavior remains a native test. The
online routine resets batch size to five, uses complete batches only, and depends on a graph
variable populated by the main example rather than an explicit graph argument. With seven
requested samples, its batch arithmetic schedules five and omits two. With only one complete
batch, the returned cluster variable is not assigned in the initial branch. Larger studies
also need to retain the full allocation and adaptation history.(Mamba413/CausalGraphCut
contributors, 2025; Causal banking proposal project, 2026fy)
   The objective list is sorted in descending order and the online caller selects its last element,
which correctly corresponds to the smallest listed objective; this is not a sorting defect.
Other scope distinctions remain: the selected objective helpers use half-probability constants,
while design classes accept a probability parameter and use different neighborhood or cluster
probability exponents. Generalizing the objective to arbitrary assignment probabilities requires
a derivation, not just changing a parameter. Direct adoption is deferred pending explicit
graph arguments, safe integer handling, sample accounting, typed return paths, adaptive-
design validation and rights. No license-named original appears in the selected complete
tree.(Mamba413/CausalGraphCut contributors, 2025; Causal banking proposal project, 2026fy)


39.29.6     Causal-PIE: an embedding match is not the assignment probability

Causal-PIE connects learned neighborhood representations to policy evaluation. In its one-
stage path, records are selected when own action matches the target and a learned embedding
is sufficiently close. The relative criterion uses a strict inequality between root-mean-square
distance and a threshold times the root-mean-square reference embedding. Identical zero
embeddings fail this test because 0 < 0 is false. Moreover, filtering and probability calculation
reverse which embedding supplies the reference scale. An adapter must specify a symmetric or
intentionally asymmetric equivalence rule, zero-scale behavior and the scientific adequacy of
the learned exposure representation.(RunpengDai/Causal-PIE contributors, 2025)
   The probability calculation offers Monte Carlo and traversal modes. Monte Carlo draws
independent neighbor actions using the supplied Bernoulli probability p. Traversal enumerates
binary configurations but its active expression weights them uniformly. After clipping the
neighborhood result, the code multiplies by p regardless of whether the target own action is
zero or one. These choices coincide with some balanced designs, but not arbitrary assignment
laws.(RunpengDai/Causal-PIE contributors, 2025)
  For a transparent authored example, suppose one neighbor is treated independently with
p = 1/5, the target own action is zero, and the target neighbor action is one. Assume a
39.29. Python network inference                                                              831


nonzero injective embedding, no added noise and an inactive clipping bound. The correct joint
assignment probability is (1 − p)p = 4/25. Uniform traversal followed by multiplication by
p gives 1/10; the Monte Carlo neighborhood limit followed by that same own-action factor
gives 1/25. The experiment should test both probability modes at balanced and unbalanced
assignments and for both own actions. A floor on the estimated probability cannot repair the
wrong assignment law.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026fy)
   A second composed-path witness concerns empty support. When no record passes the filter,
the selected routine returns record index zero with probability one. The caller then computes
a weighted residual correction using the returned record and divides by the full number of
node-time observations. If that first residual were six and the full count ten, the correction
would be 3/5 rather than the zero sum over an empty selection. This is hypothetical arithmetic,
not a measured dataset. The appropriate product response should report empty selected
support, and either return the explicitly defined plugin-only quantity with its limitations or
refuse the requested correction. A numerical sentinel must not become an observed policy
match.(RunpengDai/Causal-PIE contributors, 2025; Causal banking proposal project, 2026fy)
   The multi-stage implementation poses different questions. It combines a fitted value function,
an RKHS-trained density ratio, discounted next values and an initial-value plugin normalized
by 1 − γ. Its selected constructor assigns the same trajectory indices to training and test
collections. The residual uses the node, trajectory and T − 1 transition count, so finite-horizon
terminal handling and stationary-policy interpretation need separate qualification. The RKHS
bandwidth is a median embedding distance, creating a zero-bandwidth gate when embeddings
collapse. These are concrete proposed tests; neither the source’s double-robust naming nor an
accurate fitted reward model establishes valid policy uncertainty.(RunpengDai/Causal-PIE
contributors, 2025)
   The candidate is retained as a policy-evaluation research reference, with direct adoption
deferred until probability-law weighting, empty support, matching scale, trajectory separation,
horizon semantics, collapsed representations and rights are resolved. The selected complete
tree contains no license-named original. Public synthetic trajectories with known intervention
values can test these contracts before any expensive bank study. Unknown confounding and
an inadequate exposure map still require scientific restrictions or more information.(Causal
banking proposal project, 2026fy)


39.29.7    Integration decisions and a bounded public qualification sequence

The six decisions are independent. ANI and GraphDML supply concrete adapter candidates
after uncertainty and population repairs; CausalMotifs supplies a conditional partition-learning
reference after support and dependence checks. The neural targeted, allocation-design and
policy-evaluation repositories supply useful architecture and experiment references, with direct

sentinel or change the population silently. Direct reuse is preferred only when the actual
artifact, license and scientific regime meet that contract.(Causal banking proposal project,
2026fy)
  The first public qualification stage should enumerate tiny assignment spaces and test
exposure orientation, isolate behavior, exact joint support, own-action probabilities and policy
denominators. The second should examine covariance aggregation, batch-order invariance,
common shocks and graph-aware splitting on frozen known-law data. The third should freeze
model selection and evaluate all requests, including failures, empty support and nonfinite
outputs, on held-out graph and trajectory families. A comparison records identification
832                                                          Causal analysis for a universal bank


assumptions, sampling and Monte Carlo uncertainty, runtime, complete costs, refusal accuracy
and target-population coverage separately. It cannot manufacture missing bank assignment
truth or prove universal validity under arbitrary hidden network dependence.(Causal banking
proposal project, 2026fy)
   For scale, a hypothetical USD30,000 study costs USD30 per 1,000 attempted requests,
USD50 per 600 completed requests or USD75 per 400 scientifically accepted outputs. These
are three distinct denominators, not observed return on investment. Bounded search tails,
