39.30      JVM network and simulation components: making ex-
           posure and intervention clocks explicit
A bank constructing borrower-network experiments on the JVM must separate the graph
representation from the causal experiment. The graph can encode households, suppliers,
branches or common employers; its edges may mean influence, contractual exposure or merely
similarity. A simulator can generate outcomes after an intervention has been specified, but
its output does not identify that intervention from observed bank data. This comparison
evaluates JGraphT, GraphStream, MASON and Repast Simphony as components for graph
construction and public experiments. Admission as a component is separate from qualification
of a causal estimator.(jgrapht/jgrapht contributors, 2026; graphstream/gs-core contributors,
2021; eclab/mason contributors, 2026; Repast/repast.simphony contributors, 2026)
   The inspected revisions precede the 7 October 2026 client cutoff. JGraphT’s selected tree
declares 1.6.0-SNAPSHOT and Java 21; the release snippet in its README is not the selected
build. GraphStream declares 2.1.0-SNAPSHOT in the selected November 2021 tree. The
MASON review binds the July 2026 source revision, while the Repast core manifest identifies
2.12.0 at a September 2026 revision. Fifty technical, license and configuration originals plus
two candidate-screening originals were saved and authenticated. Eight bounded repository
queries return 71 distinct leads. Some query results have uninspected tails, and the returned
hits include computing, radio, genetics and distributed-system meanings of interference or
causality. These results cannot establish absence of Java network-causal software.(Causal
banking proposal project, 2026fp)
   One seemingly relevant partial-interference repository describes colocated server workloads,
resource metrics and an SLA scheduler in its original README. It is not selected as evidence
of a borrower-spillover estimator. A solar-innovation search lead has an empty root README
and remains unresolved without technical inspection. The distinction prevents a search label
from becoming a capability claim. No downloaded code, native JVM artifact, upstream test
or simulator was executed; no theorem or benchmark is imported from papers mentioned in
source comments.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026fp)


39.30.1    JGraphT: neighbor lists, graph distances and live subgraphs

JGraphT provides distinct operations that a causal adapter should preserve. Its neighbor
list traverses all incident edges and can include a vertex more than once in a multigraph;
its neighbor set removes duplicate vertices. Predecessor and successor lists instead traverse
incoming and outgoing edges. These are useful alternatives, not interchangeable encodings of a
39.30. JVM network contracts                                                                   833


bank exposure. Whether repeated transactions count as repeated influence, summed exposure
weight or a single relationship is a scientific decision.(jgrapht/jgrapht contributors, 2026)
   Consider the authored directed multigraph with two edges a → b and one edge b → c, with
treatment vector (Da , Db , Dc ) = (1, 0, 0). For node b, the mean treatment over the incoming
list is one. Over the full incident-neighbor list it is 2/3, because a appears twice and c once.
Over the unique adjacent-vertex set it is 1/2. A downstream model that sees only a field named
neighbor exposure cannot distinguish these quantities. The proposed adapter should record
direction, multiplicity, weighting, self-edge handling and normalization with the exposure
operator.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026fp)
   The breadth-first shortest-path implementation traverses outgoing edges and increments
distance by one. It therefore computes hops, regardless of stored edge weight. Its returned
single-source object retains those hop distances; when reconstructing a path, the delegate
sums the actual weights of selected edges. In an authored triangle with weights wab = 10,
wac = wcb = 1, the direct path has one hop and reconstructed weight ten, while the minimum-
weight route has two edges and total weight two. The hop-distance query, the weight of
the hop-selected path and the minimum-weight distance are three different quantities. An
unreachable target has an infinite stored distance and no reconstructed path; it must not
be silently converted to a zero-distance neighbor.(jgrapht/jgrapht contributors, 2026; Causal
banking proposal project, 2026fp)
   Subsetting also changes the question. In the path a → b → c, the full-graph distance from a
to c is two. The induced graph on {a, c} has no such path. Filtering the analysis population
while retaining background network paths is therefore different from filtering the graph itself.
This distinction matters when a bank observes outcomes only for a subset of borrowers but
influence passes through other entities.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026fp)
  The selected subgraph class is a view over a backing graph. Its documentation and
implementation distinguish listener-aware topology updates from a non-listenable base. Its
edge-weight setter explicitly delegates to the backing graph. General wording that subgraph
modifications do not affect the base must consequently be read as a topology statement,
not a guarantee that all attributes are isolated. A scenario that changes edge weights in a
subgraph can change the backing graph used by another scenario. The proposed contract uses
immutable input identifiers and a deliberate deep-copy or versioned-view policy, with tests of
both topology and attributes.(jgrapht/jgrapht contributors, 2026)
   JGraphT is a conditional direct-integration candidate for graph operators. The source
supports explicit seeds or a supplied generator for its selected preferential-attachment generator,
but repeatable generation still depends on vertex construction, iteration order, algorithm version
and the graph’s admissible edges. Synthetic topology is not authentic bank structure. The dual
LGPL 2.1-or-later or EPL 2.0 declaration and complete local license texts support a concrete
distribution review, while the selected snapshot, Java requirement and transitive components
still need artifact-specific qualification. Porting should be considered only where the target
runtime or numerical contract justifies the additional maintenance burden.(jgrapht/jgrapht
contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026fp)


39.30.2     GraphStream: ingestion policy changes the observed population

GraphStream provides a different component: a graph that evolves through events. Its default
edge-addition overload creates an undirected edge, while an explicit directed addition uses the
specified source-to-target orientation. The DGS parser maps forward and reverse arrow tokens
to corresponding directed events, and a step token becomes a numerical graph-step event.
That step is not, by itself, the bank’s event time, ingestion time or availability time. Those
834                                                            Causal analysis for a universal bank


clocks require explicit fields and a documented conversion.(graphstream/gs-core contributors,
2021)
   Error behavior is controlled by strict checking and automatic creation. A duplicate identifier
may throw, return an existing compatible edge, or return null for incompatible endpoints.
Missing endpoints may throw, produce null, or be created automatically. Edge rejection by a
node similarly can throw or return null, with rollback of the first endpoint when necessary.
These paths affect the observation contract: automatic creation can enlarge the population,
while a discarded null can remove a relationship without telling the analyst. A causal
ingestion adapter should return a receipt for each requested node or edge, including accepted,
deduplicated, created, rejected and unresolved outcomes.(graphstream/gs-core contributors,
2021)
   SingleGraph and MultiGraph differ at their node delegates. The selected SingleNode stores
incoming and outgoing slots per opposite node and rejects conflicting additions; MultiNode
retains a list of parallel edges. A read-only collection wrapper over that list does not freeze the
underlying edge objects. A bank replay should therefore bind both the ordered event sequence
and the resulting immutable graph snapshot, rather than retain a mutable collection reference
as historical evidence. It should test repeated identifiers, reverse arrows, parallel obligations,
unknown nodes and late-arriving attributes.(graphstream/gs-core contributors, 2021)
   The proposed decision is conditional integration for dynamic ingestion and visualization,
with causal exposure construction in a separately specified layer. The source’s dual CeCILL-C
or LGPL 3-or-later declaration requires a distribution choice and dependency review; it is not
an unrestricted artifact clearance. No benefit follows from porting event handling unless the
destination must preserve the same failure, ordering and time semantics. An agent choosing a
permissive ingestion mode should not silently change the target population.(graphstream/gs-
core contributors, 2021; Causal banking proposal project, 2026fp)


39.30.3     MASON: simulation state, update order and checkpoint identity

MASON’s network stores arbitrary node objects and edge information. Incoming and outgoing
edge bags are internal mutable structures, and adjacency structures must be regenerated after
topology changes. Its simple adjacency matrix is indexed from source to target and stores a
single selected edge for a pair; a separate multigraph method is available when all parallel edges
are needed. The selected weight getter returns a numeric or Valuable information object’s
value, and otherwise returns one. Its weight setter replaces the information object with a
numeric value. A bank adapter should reject an unexplained unit-weight fallback where an
edge actually represents a missing monetary amount or an uncertain relationship.(eclab/mason
contributors, 2026)
   Copying the network does not automatically isolate a counterfactual scenario. The selected
copy routine reuses node objects and passes the same edge-information references into new edge
wrappers. A mutable customer state or edge-information object can therefore be shared across
copies. The proposed scenario runner must define which state is copied, which is immutable,
and which exogenous draws are intentionally coupled. It should test that changing a treatment
or attribute in one scenario does not unintentionally mutate another. A full-state serialization
checkpoint and a graph-wrapper copy solve different problems.(eclab/mason contributors,
2026)
  The scheduler gives equally consequential semantics. Lower integer orderings run first;
equal-time, equal-order substeps are shuffled and then invoked sequentially. A newly scheduled
event at the current time advances to the next representable time step. Thus a group of events
with the same nominal timestamp is not necessarily a simultaneous update from the previous
39.30. JVM network contracts                                                                   835


state. A simulator needs an explicit read-old/write-new protocol when that is the intended
causal mechanism.(eclab/mason contributors, 2026)
   An authored two-node example isolates this point. Start from (x1 , x2 ) = (1, 0) and define
each update as copying the other node’s current value. A simultaneous update from the old
state gives (0, 1), with mean 1/2. Sequential order (1, 2) gives (0, 0); order (2, 1) gives (1, 1).
If the two sequential orders are equally likely, the mean is still 1/2, but the variance of the
resulting network mean is 1/4, compared with zero for the deterministic simultaneous update.
Agreement in an average therefore does not establish agreement in the transition law or its
uncertainty. These are calculations for authored updates, not native MASON output.(Causal
banking proposal project, 2026fp)
   Random-state identity must also be explicit. The selected seed setter narrows the supplied
long integer to 32 bits, so seeds seven and 7 + 232 become the same effective seed. Starting a
simulation primes the generator and resets the schedule. Restoring a serialized state instead
invokes a wake-from-checkpoint hook. The stream checkpoint API throws on failure, whereas
convenience file wrappers print exceptions and return null. A runner should distinguish restart-
from-seed from continuation-from-state and type checkpoint failure rather than interpret null
as a successful empty result.(eclab/mason contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project,
2026fp)
  The parallel-sequence documentation assigns synchronization of model data and the shared
random generator to the caller. The selected RandomSequence has a switch for synchronized
draws, and the fast random generator itself is unsynchronized. Locking can prevent a data race
without fixing which thread consumes which random draw. Reproducible coupled experiments
therefore need task-specific random streams or a deterministic allocation of draws, together
with a declared update schedule and thread model. No native replay or throughput claim is
made here.(eclab/mason contributors, 2026)
   MASON is a conditional simulation reference for public known-law studies. Its principal
license is AFL 3.0 with named component exceptions, including the random generator’s BSD
terms. A proposed integration should isolate the headless simulation subset, inspect its
actual distribution and test copied state, seeded starts, checkpoints, interrupted runs and
independent replicates. A simulated policy result is conditional on the authored mechanism,
not validation of a bank mechanism.(eclab/mason contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal
project, 2026fp)


39.30.4     Repast Simphony: network direction, priority conventions and
            named streams

Repast’s network builder chooses directed or undirected implementations backed by ordered
sparse multigraphs. Its generic adjacency method takes the union of predecessors and successors
in a set, removing duplicate adjacent vertices. Separate in-edge and out-edge accessors preserve
the directional distinction. Edge objects carry a mutable weight, defaulting to one. The same
exposure questions therefore recur: a generic adjacent-node average cannot silently replace an
incoming, weighted or transaction-multiplicity exposure.(Repast/repast.simphony contributors,
2026)
   The scheduler uses a priority convention that differs from MASON’s integer ordering:
larger numeric priorities execute earlier. It has explicit first, last and random-priority tokens.
The inspected group delegate first establishes an order-index sequence and then intersperses
random-priority actions using the random registry, or shuffles them when there are no numeric-
priority actions. A port that copies numeric order values from one framework into another
can reverse the intended chronology. The proposed conversion should map semantic phases,
836                                                          Causal analysis for a universal bank


such as intervention assignment, response update and observation, before mapping numeric
priorities.(Repast/repast.simphony contributors, 2026)
   The default random registry begins with a timestamp-derived integer seed. Named generators
can be registered with explicit seeds. The inspected set-seed implementation invalidates default
distributions, while the broader reset clears named distributions and generators and recreates
the default from the clock. These distinctions are more specific than a generic statement
that resetting randomness makes an experiment reproducible. A recorded seed alone also
cannot establish independence of replicates or equivalence of conditional assignment laws.
The runner must bind the effective generator state, name, version, draw allocation and reset
path.(Repast/repast.simphony contributors, 2026)
   Repast is a conditional alternative for a richer agent-based experiment environment. The
core source has BSD-style redistribution conditions and names separately licensed dependencies.
The selected core manifest identifies version 2.12.0, but that does not qualify every plugin or
installed runtime. The proposed choice between Repast and MASON should compare required
scheduling, context, data-output and deployment features on the same public experiment,
including failed requests and restart costs. A clean API response is not an identified network
effect.(Repast/repast.simphony contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026fp)


39.30.5    From simulation components to a defensible causal experiment

To connect these components to the proposal, let A denote a frozen graph, U exogenous draws,
D an assignment and F a specified state-transition system. A public simulator evaluates
the consequences of (A, U, D, F ) under declared scheduling and observation clocks. It does
not discover F or establish that the observed bank assignment is independent of latent risk.
Such public experiments can nevertheless test software semantics and uncertainty in regimes
where the truth is known. That is the appropriate inexpensive precursor to an authentic bank
study.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026fp)
   For two connected borrowers, independent Bernoulli assignment with probability p supports
all four assignments with probabilities (1 − p)2 , p(1 − p), (1 − p)p and p2 . Assigning them
together as one cluster supports only (0, 0) and (1, 1), with probabilities 1 − p and p. At
p = 1/5, the mixed assignments have probability 4/25 each under the independent design
and zero under the single-cluster design. Neither a shared seed nor a common graph object
can make those laws interchangeable. Exposure-probability and refusal tests should therefore
begin with exact enumeration.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026fp)
   The integration plan has four independent component decisions. JGraphT supplies con-
ditional graph operators; GraphStream supplies conditional event ingestion; MASON and
Repast supply alternative public experiment environments. Direct use should preserve source
contracts where they meet the scientific specification. A language port is justified only after
the graph, clock, random-stream and failure contracts have an executable reference and the
target runtime offers a concrete benefit. Components unsuitable for a particular target should
be rejected for that use with the target-specific reason, rather than described as universally
deficient.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026fp)
  The proposed CLI and MCP request should bind source revision and artifact, graph identity
and node ordering, edge orientation and multiplicity, event and availability clocks, target
population, assignment law, exposure function, update phases, effective random streams
and checkpoint provenance. Its result should retain scientific assumptions, typed failures
and complete costs. Small public tests can then compare directed versus incident exposure,
weighted versus hop paths, induced versus background graphs, live-view versus copied state,
synchronous versus sequential updates, seed collisions, restart semantics and assignment
39.31. C++ network experiments                                                                837


support. Native tests, full dependency rights and causal estimator qualification remain
separate obligations.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026fp)
  Using the same hypothetical USD30,000 study budget, cost per 1,000 attempted requests is
USD30, per 600 completions USD50, and per 400 accepted outputs USD75. These denominators
expose the economic consequence of failure and refusal without claiming measured returns.
The source review identifies concrete routes to public qualification while retaining search tails,
unknown bank structure and unrestricted dependence as unresolved. It does not establish
complete JVM network qualification.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026fp)


39.31      C++ network experiments: assignment probabilities,
           graph identity and distributed state
A bank evaluating interventions across connected borrowers needs more than a fast graph
engine. Its experiment must distinguish the assignment law, the exposure event that makes
an observed outcome informative about a policy, and the numerical representation used
to compute that event. A program may preserve adjacency while changing weights, reuse
a random stream across workers, or return a number when one exposure arm is empty.
Each change can alter the scientific result. This comparison examines the RGCR research
implementation alongside NetworKit, SNAP, Repast HPC and the C-native igraph library as an
interoperability alternative. The first supplies a specific experimental-design implementation;
the others supply components whose scientific role must be declared.(hyin-stanford/RGCR-code
contributors, 2022; networkit/networkit contributors, 2026; snap-stanford/snap contributors,
2023; Repast/repast.hpc contributors, 2022; igraph/igraph contributors, 2026)
   The comparison binds 64 selected software, license and configuration originals at revisions
before the 7 October 2026 cutoff. Six bounded repository queries produce 52 distinct leads,
with unreturned search tails and uninspected candidates. They cannot establish complete C++
coverage or absence of other causal software. NetworKit’s selected metadata says 11.2.1, but
its source build sets C++20 and CMake 3.14; those exact requirements take precedence over a
less demanding README snippet for this revision. RGCR’s build instead references C++11
and a user-specific SNAP 4.1 installation. The independently inspected SNAP revision is not
evidence that this older dependency has been reproduced.(Causal banking proposal project,
2026fe; networkit/networkit contributors, 2026; hyin-stanford/RGCR-code contributors, 2022)
   The methodological discussion uses the genuine 59-page arXiv version of Ugander and Yin,
submitted on 4 September 2020, whose title page bears 7 September 2020. The later publisher
edition was not inspected. Version identity matters: the argument here cites the selected
author text and distinguishes its statements from the project’s finite calculations and the
implementation’s conventions. No acquired program, simulator, native library or upstream
test was executed.(Ugander and Yin, 2020; Causal banking proposal project, 2026fe)


39.31.1     Randomized clustering changes both design and analysis

Let G = (V, E) be a fixed undirected, unweighted interference graph with n = |V | borrowers.
For binary assignment vector Z, let Yi (Z) be borrower i’s potential outcome and define the
global average treatment effect
                                           n
                                        1X
                                   τ=         {Yi (1) − Yi (0)}.

The full-neighborhood exposure event Eia occurs when borrower i and every neighbor receive
assignment a ∈ {0, 1}. Using the observed outcome on that event requires the substantive
assumption that it equals Yi (a). An adjacency file cannot establish this exposure model. A
graph of transactions, for example, need not include all shared employers, household obligations
or unobserved channels relevant to a servicing response.(Ugander and Yin, 2020; Causal banking
proposal project, 2026fe)
   In randomized graph cluster randomization, a partition C is sampled from a declared
distribution P , followed by treatment assignment at the cluster level. The analysis uses the
marginal exposure probability
                                                                 (                                 )
                       X                                   1X        1{Ei1 }Yi (1) 1{Ei0 }Yi (0)

The selected paper derives this marginalization explicitly. Conditioning only on the realized
partition gives a different weighting scheme. Likewise, averaging inverse conditional proba-
bilities does not compute the inverse marginal probability. If two equally likely partitions
give exposure probabilities 1/4 and 1/2, the marginal probability is 3/8 and its inverse is 8/3,
whereas the average of the two inverse probabilities is three. The adapter should bind the
partition generator and its distribution alongside the realized partition.(Ugander and Yin,
2020; Causal banking proposal project, 2026fe)
   The source implements several partition rules, including neighborhood maxima and random-
ized nets. For independent cluster assignment it constructs each borrower’s set of adjacent
clusters, including its own, and evaluates exposure probability as 2−ki , where ki is that set’s
size. It also accumulates same-arm and opposite-arm joint exposure probabilities. This is
substantive support for interference-aware design analysis. It is specifically tied to the in-
spected half-probability assignment: the treatment simulator uses a Bernoulli distribution
with parameter 1/2. Changing only a user-facing field to p = 1/5 would not change these
expressions. For a neighborhood touching two independently assigned clusters, treatment
and control exposure probabilities would be 1/25 and 16/25, respectively, rather than 1/4 for
each.(hyin-stanford/RGCR-code contributors, 2022; Causal banking proposal project, 2026fe)
   The implementation’s complete-randomization mode is also specific. It orders clusters
by decreasing size, pairs them, and gives each pair opposite assignments; an unpaired final
cluster receives its own assignment. If a borrower’s neighborhood intersects both members
of a pair, full exposure is impossible under that partition. The helper returns zero for this
conflict, and the analysis records excluded target contributions. This does not restore positivity.
Equal-size clusters have no explicit secondary key in the selected comparator, so the realized
pairing and its provenance should be saved instead of reconstructed from sizes alone. The
declared law is not arbitrary complete randomization or a general bank budget-constrained
design.(hyin-stanford/RGCR-code contributors, 2022; Causal banking proposal project, 2026fe)
   The paper offers a route to controlling rare exposure under its selected random partitions.
For its randomized 3-net or 1-hop-max constructions, the reported treatment-exposure lower
bound is p/|B2 (i)|, where B2 (i) is the set of vertices within two hops, including i. Its Monte
Carlo probability estimator averages conditional probabilities over sampled partitions; the
stated relative mean-square error bound is |B2 (i)|/(Kp) for K samples. The paper also
describes stratifying the random rankings so every node is favored, preventing zero estimated
exposure in that construction. These statements concern the specified graph and randomization
model. They do not validate an unknown bank interference graph or make reciprocal estimated
probabilities unbiased. Probability approximation and its contribution to downstream error
remain explicit qualification tasks.(Ugander and Yin, 2020; Causal banking proposal project,
2026fe)
39.31. C++ network experiments                                                                 839


  For 1-hop-max and bounded nonnegative responses, the selected text further bounds mean-
outcome HT variance using |B4 (i)| and πi1 ; under a restricted-growth condition it obtains a
bound proportional to n−1 (dmax + 1)2 κ4 /p. Here dmax is maximum degree and κ controls
neighborhood growth. A bank cannot claim decreasing uncertainty merely by increasing its
row count: degree, growth, exposure probabilities and outcome bounds matter. The text
expressly distinguishes the available 1-hop-max variance proof from the randomized 3-net case.
No unrestricted network-uncertainty guarantee is imported.(Ugander and Yin, 2020)


39.31.2     An empty realized exposure arm is different from positive design
            support

Positive πia for every borrower does not guarantee that both exposure arms contain observed
borrowers in each experiment. This distinction matters for the ratio form of the Hájek
estimator,
                                           1{E a }Yi (a)/πia
                                        P
                                  ba = iP i a
                                  µ H
                                                        a    .
                                             i 1{Ei }/πi
The selected implementation initializes each arm mean to zero and updates it only when its
denominator is positive. This defines a numerical extension for an empty arm. It is not the
same expression as an everywhere-defined ratio, and zero is not an observed control outcome.
The proposed result type should retain both exposed counts, both denominators and the
convention or refusal applied.(hyin-stanford/RGCR-code contributors, 2022; Causal banking
proposal project, 2026fe)
   Consider three borrowers in one cluster, with potential outcomes Y (0) = (1, 2, 3) and
Y (1) = (2, 3, 4) in a hypothetical monetary unit. The true average effect is one. Assigning the
whole cluster with probability 1/2 gives HT effect estimates −4 and 6, each with probability
1/2, so their mean is one. The source-style zero extension of Hájek gives −2 when everyone
is controlled and 3 when everyone is treated, yielding mean 1/2. Every node has positive
exposure probability in both arms, yet one realized arm is always empty. This exact example
concerns the stated convention, not a native software run.(Causal banking proposal project,
2026fe)
   The same issue occurs in a small nontrivial randomized partition example. On the path
1 − 2 − 3, enumerate the six strict orderings of independent continuous node scores and
assign each node to its largest one-hop score. Across the induced partitions and independent
half-probability cluster assignments, there are 20 weighted cases. The marginal full-exposure
probabilities in each arm are (5/12, 1/3, 5/12). With the preceding potential outcomes, exact
enumeration gives HT mean one and variance 2242/75; an independent joint-probability
covariance expansion gives the same variance. The zero-extended Hájek mean is again 1/2.
These calculations both verify the intended exposure law and expose the effect of the empty-arm
convention.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026fe)
   The selected 2020 text states a constant-effect unbiasedness result for Hájek and proves it
by separating a constant treatment effect from each realized ratio. That algebra requires a
nonzero realized denominator. The proof does not establish the source code’s zero-extension
guarantee on the assignments just enumerated. The proposal therefore retains this as a precise
qualification boundary. Possible routes include a typed unavailable result, an explicitly redefined
estimand or estimator, or an assignment design that guarantees the required denominators.
Conditioning on successful experiments would itself change the sampling law and cannot be
introduced without analysis. The later publisher version remains a separate source-review
obligation.(Ugander and Yin, 2020; Causal banking proposal project, 2026fe)
840                                                            Causal analysis for a universal bank


39.31.3     RGCR integration requires more than recompilation

The RGCR loader first looks for a binary graph cache and otherwise reads an edge list and
writes that cache. It removes self-edges and requires consecutive node identifiers, connectivity
and a loopless graph. These are explicit, useful restrictions, but they exclude some banking
populations unless an adapter makes a justified transformation. A disconnected borrower
network should not be made connected by inventing edges. A cached graph should not silently
survive a changed source edge list. Stable borrower-to-node mappings, graph hashes and
transformation receipts belong in the request.(hyin-stanford/RGCR-code contributors, 2022;
Causal banking proposal project, 2026fe)
   Randomness and input validation are additional gates. The inspected utility seeds the C
generator from the clock; clustering and assignment use draws from that generator, while
parallel simulation loops create work across threads. A safe analysis distinguishes reproducible
seed input, draw allocation, thread scheduling and statistical independence. The build disables
assertions, so an assertion in a parser or weight check is not a production rejection path.
The weighted-score helper evaluates a logarithm of a draw that can be zero and divides by
supplied weights; positive finite weights, endpoint handling and finite-score ties require explicit
tests. A mixing-count helper also accesses the last element of a vector that can be empty for
requests below ten. A proposed wrapper should reject unsupported counts before entering
that path.(hyin-stanford/RGCR-code contributors, 2022)
   The simulation compares complementary assignments using the same partition. That
pairing can reduce or change variability, but it means the two outputs are not automatically
independent observations. The reported standard-error arithmetic needs a comparison against
replicate-level or pair-level uncertainty on frozen small problems. Analytic variance routines
also use supplied potential responses and joint exposure probabilities: this is valuable for
known-law public evaluation, not an immediately available variance oracle for observed bank
outcomes.(hyin-stanford/RGCR-code contributors, 2022; Causal banking proposal project,
2026fe)
   The proposed decision is conditional algorithmic reference and controlled integration after
these contracts are tested. No license-named file appears in the complete selected RGCR tree,
so public availability is not treated as a redistribution grant. The old SNAP dependency,
full artifacts and rights must be resolved before adoption. An independent reimplementation
would need its own rights review and semantic tests; changing language does not remove the
assignment, exposure or statistical obligations.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026fe)


39.31.4     NetworKit and SNAP: preserve identities, multiplicity and weights

NetworKit’s selected graph API supports optional weights and directed graphs but warns
that multiple edges are not handled consistently. Its duplicate check is optional and disabled
by default. The implementation confirms that enabling the check rejects a repeated edge;
otherwise it appends adjacency entries. A borrower graph derived from repeated transactions
must therefore choose an aggregation rule before admission. Counting transactions, summing
monetary weights and deduplicating relationships define different exposure operators. The
adapter should never rely on an unsupported duplicate representation merely because insertion
succeeds.(networkit/networkit contributors, 2026)
   Deleting a NetworKit node leaves a hole in its identifier space; the actual node count and
the upper identifier bound are separate values. SNAP likewise maintains a maximum assigned
identifier bound independently of the number of remaining nodes. In an authored example
with surviving IDs zero and two, there are two units, not three. If each has outcome one,
39.31. C++ network experiments                                                                   841


dividing a zero-filled three-slot vector by its length produces 2/3 instead of one. Compacting is
a valid representation change only when outcomes, assignments, graph structure and returned
results all use the saved forward and inverse maps.(networkit/networkit contributors, 2026;
snap-stanford/snap contributors, 2023; Causal banking proposal project, 2026fe)
   NetworKit’s selected induced-subgraph and remapping constructions carry edge weights
explicitly. Its restoration helper, however, traverses neighbors and calls edge insertion without
the weight argument, whose default is one. Thus a node-ID restoration is not a guaranteed
weighted-graph round trip in this selected path. If two incoming relationships have weights
nine and one and neighbor treatments one and zero, the normalized weighted exposure is 9/10;
replacing both weights by one changes it to 1/2. A public round-trip test should check node
IDs, edge direction, multiplicity, weights and attributes separately. The finding is tied to this
helper and revision, not asserted for every graph operation.(networkit/networkit contributors,
2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026fe)
   SNAP offers simple undirected and directed graph types and a separate directed multigraph.
In the selected simple graph, duplicate insertion returns −2, while a successful insertion
without an edge ID returns −1. Treating every negative return as failure would therefore
misclassify successful operations. Its breadth-first traversal takes explicit incoming and outgoing
direction flags and increments hops. The proposed wrapper should translate these API-specific
conventions into typed outcomes and a declared distance definition. A weighted credit-exposure
distance cannot be inferred from a hop traversal.(snap-stanford/snap contributors, 2023)
   The libraries also expose different random-state contracts. SNAP’s selected random generator
treats zero as a request for timing-derived state; a positive supplied seed follows a separate
path. NetworKit uses a thread-local engine seeded either identically across threads or with the
thread identifier added, according to its explicit option. Equal seeds and equal-position draws
can produce copied streams, while changing thread count or work scheduling changes how
draws are assigned. In a hypothetical two-draw Bernoulli experiment, the variance of their
mean is 1/8 for independent draws but 1/4 for identical draws. Thread safety alone does not
settle this scientific distinction.(snap-stanford/snap contributors, 2023; networkit/networkit
contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026fe)
   Both remain conditional direct-integration candidates for specified graph services. Net-
worKit’s MIT declaration and SNAP’s BSD-style conditions support concrete artifact review,
while dependency rights and installed behavior remain open. A port should be justified by
a required runtime or representation constraint and tested against the same graph receipts.
There is no reason to rewrite these graph algorithms merely to claim an internally owned
causal library.(networkit/networkit contributors, 2026; snap-stanford/snap contributors, 2023;
Causal banking proposal project, 2026fe)


39.31.5     Repast HPC: distributed copies are not independent borrowers

Repast HPC represents a shared network through local agents, nonlocal copies and complemen-
tary edges across processes. Its agent identity consists of original identifier, starting process and
type; the current process is excluded from equality. That supports migration without changing
identity, but it also means a bank evaluation must count scientific units independently of
process-local copies. The selected graph stores one edge per ordered endpoint pair; a duplicate
replaces the edge when allowed or marks the existing edge as conflicted. This behavior is
different from a transaction multigraph and needs an explicit receipt.(Repast/repast.hpc
contributors, 2022)
  The directed-neighbor delegate appends incoming and outgoing neighbors into the output
vector. A reciprocal neighbor can appear twice, because the shared item helper does not
842                                                            Causal analysis for a universal bank


deduplicate. This differs from the set-based generic adjacency inspected in Repast Simphony.
Porting a model between the two frameworks therefore requires a semantic comparison rather
than matching method names. Directional, unique-neighbor and incident-edge exposure should
be separate adapter operations.(Repast/repast.hpc contributors, 2022; Causal banking proposal
project, 2026fe)
   The schedule comparator orders events by tick only, and the execution loop invokes same-
tick callbacks sequentially. There is no explicit secondary phase key in that comparator. A
repeating event with zero interval can re-enter the same tick indefinitely under the inspected
loop, so positive finite intervals and future-time progress should be enforced at the boundary.
Across processes, the runner selects the global minimum next tick. That synchronization
does not itself refresh agent attributes or network projections. The source provides separate
synchronization operations and expressly notes that synchronizing agent state does not update
projection information.(Repast/repast.hpc contributors, 2022)
   Seed initialization is equally specific. A global-seed property can intentionally give processes
the same seed, while the local-seed path derives rank-dependent state from the configured seed
and records the effective value. These options serve different coupling purposes. Migration,
rank count and assignment of draws to agents must be recorded if a public experiment is
expected to replay. Agent ownership, graph-projection freshness and random-state ownership
together define the simulated transition law. A valid MPI exchange is not evidence of causal
or statistical independence.(Repast/repast.hpc contributors, 2022; Causal banking proposal
project, 2026fe)
   The decision is conditional use for distributed known-law experiments when scale justifies
MPI, serialization and synchronization costs. Its BSD-style core terms do not clear every
Boost, NetCDF or other installed dependency. Qualification should compare one-process and
multi-process scientific outputs under a deliberately fixed coupling, exercise migration and
stale-projection faults, and record refused or stalled requests. Small graph enumeration should
precede expensive distributed runs.(Repast/repast.hpc contributors, 2022; Causal banking
proposal project, 2026fe)


39.31.6     igraph’s C interface is a distinct interoperability option

igraph is included explicitly as a C library usable from a C++ system. The selected neighbor
API exposes direction, loop treatment and parallel-edge multiplicity, including a choice to
collapse multiple edges. These are positive capabilities for a causal exposure adapter. The
exact signature belongs to the pinned revision; a wrapper must not assume that an older
installed version has the same interface. Vertex deletion reindexes IDs and invalidates iterators,
and the induced-subgraph APIs expose mappings. Borrower identity should therefore live
outside transient integer positions and be restored through the recorded maps.(igraph/igraph
contributors, 2026)
  Its selected Dijkstra implementation validates weights, rejects negative values and NaNs, and
documents explicit unreachable distances. That is useful failure behavior, but a caller must still
decide whether a monetary relationship weight is a distance, a strength or an inverse cost. The
proposed request includes units and transformation rules. A strong exposure relationship is not
automatically a long path, and changing this interpretation can reverse which borrowers are
considered close.(igraph/igraph contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026fe)
   Random ownership requires attention even where a variable is thread-local. The selected
default-pointer declaration is thread-local, but it initially points to a shared default generator
object and backing state. Setting a custom default changes the pointer and requires that object
to remain alive. A caller cannot infer private generator ownership merely from the pointer’s
39.32. Shared-state and remaining-language networks                                          843


storage class. The proposed native fixture should install and retain task-owned generators,
check concurrent use and restore prior defaults deliberately. This is a source-based ownership
finding, not a reported concurrency benchmark.(igraph/igraph contributors, 2026)
   The C interface can be adopted directly where its representation and failure contracts fit.
Its GPL 2-or-later source declaration requires a distribution review for the intended product;
porting or placing a process boundary around it is not declared an automatic rights solution.
Complete intended artifacts, dependencies and native interface behavior remain qualification
gates.(igraph/igraph contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026fe)


39.31.7    A common public experiment contract

The CLI and MCP surface should bind the scientific target, exposure model, graph and
node-map hashes, edge units and multiplicity, event and availability clocks, partition generator,
realized partition, conditional or marginal probabilities, random streams, worker layout
and numerical tolerances. The response should preserve exposed-arm counts, probability
uncertainty, graph transformations, typed failures, unsupported targets and complete cost
denominators. An LLM may help propose this specification, but an unreviewed tool choice
must not convert a graph service into a causal estimator or silently choose the empty-arm
convention.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026fe)
   The public qualification sequence is concrete. First enumerate tiny graphs and all assignment
cases, comparing marginal and joint exposure probabilities, HT moments and ratio failure
behavior. Next test representation changes: duplicated transactions, removed nodes, compacted
identifiers, weighted restoration and directed paths. Then freeze random-state and scheduling
rules across threads or ranks, including stale graph caches and stale distributed projections.
Finally compare matched native implementations with all attempts, failures, refusals and
accepted outputs recorded. These tasks can proceed independently of unavailable bank truth,
while expensive bank trials remain conditional on demonstrated public merit.(Causal banking
proposal project, 2026fe)
   With a hypothetical USD30,000 study budget, cost is USD30 per 1,000 attempts, USD50
per 600 completions and USD75 per 400 accepted outputs. None is a measured return or
a price quote. They illustrate why a fast executable with frequent invalid exposure results
can be economically inferior to a slower method with an appropriate scientific contract. The
known repair routes are exact-law testing, explicit graph and random-state custody, typed
refusal, rights review and matched native evaluation. Unknown bank interference, unsupported
assignment truth and unrestricted dependent-data inference still require information or justified
restrictions; this review does not establish complete C++ network qualification.(Causal banking
proposal project, 2026fe)


39.32      Shared-state inference and network contracts in Julia,
           Rust and JavaScript
A bank sharing servicing capacity across arriving borrowers faces a different interference
problem from a bank observing a fixed borrower graph. One offer may change the queue,
available specialist time or a public price, affecting later borrowers. A graph representation
does not identify this mechanism, and an accurate queue simulator does not establish the
effect of changing policy. Julia supplies direct research code for shared-state inference and
components for graph and dynamical simulation. Rust supplies graph representations with
explicit mutation contracts. JavaScript can carry a graph into an analyst interface, but object
844                                                                     Causal analysis for a universal bank


and serialization semantics must preserve scientific identity. We compare these roles before
specifying public qualification.
   The selected originals are pinned before the 7 October 2026 Shanghai cutoff: Graphs.jl,
Agents.jl, NetworkDynamics.jl, petgraph, Graphology and dml4ssi. A second direct search lead
is screened as a cost-to-equilibrium replication package rather than accepted merely because
its name contains spillovers. Five successful bounded repository searches return six unique
leads; three additional searches fail with rate limits. Those failures leave coverage open; they
do not establish absence of Rust or JavaScript causal estimators. The computations below
are authored finite examples, not executions of acquired packages.(Causal banking proposal
project, 2026ft)


39.32.1     Immediate treatment and changed shared state are different targets

Write Xt for pre-treatment borrower characteristics, Dt ∈ {0, 1} for a servicing offer, Ht for
the shared state available before that offer, and Yt for an outcome on a declared monetary
and temporal scale. A direct effect changes Dt while retaining others’ assignment law and
the natural shared-state distribution. A global effect changes the assignment history. Hays
and Raghavan’s selected 2025 author version formalizes these distinct targets. The relevant
dependence must be mediated by the state. Their general theory requires a homogeneous
Markov structure with geometric ergodicity and detailed balance, or a known finite dependence
bound, alongside orthogonality, moment and nuisance-rate conditions. A queue measured
after the offer, an omitted common liquidity shock or unrestricted persistence does not acquire
these properties by being entered as a feature.(Hays and Raghavan, 2025)
  For the average direct effect, let f (d, x, h) estimate the conditional outcome and e(x) the
propensity in the selected model. The score is

The state is held fixed in each counterfactual prediction but marginalized over in the target.
This is not the effect of treating every borrower when that policy changes capacity. The
paper requires true and estimated assignment probabilities bounded away from zero and
sufficiently small nuisance errors. Clipping a fitted propensity does not prove overlap of the
bank mechanism. (Hays and Raghavan, 2025)
   The paper uses independent auxiliary training data, explaining why ordinary folds from a
dependent sequence need not provide independence. Independently generated trajectories offer
a transparent first public experiment. A later blocked temporal split needs its own dependence
argument and cost accounting. Declare the auxiliary population, outcome clock and measured
state together; neither a flexible forest nor prediction accuracy supplies causal restrictions.
(Hays and Raghavan, 2025; Causal banking proposal project, 2026ft)
   For switchback memory m, the global score reconstructs states under all-one and all-zero

text uses Dt−m:t : the preceding m treatments and the current treatment. Path positivity and
state reconstruction are parts of identification. An individual propensity or an observed-state

not certify every switching calendar or general network. (Hays and Raghavan, 2025)

39.32.2    Reconcile the direct implementation with its equations

dml4ssi exposes the simulated law, scores and comparisons, making it a useful direct candidate.
Its manifest identifies Julia 1.11.4. The selected nine-file tree has no license-named original;
reuse rights and complete installed dependencies remain unresolved. Figure scripts establish
globals and include the inspected delegates. Some scalar convenience wrappers have signature or
return-shape concerns, but active simulation paths call vector-score helpers. An unused wrapper
concern must not be presented as evidence that every figure fails.(johnchrishays/dml4ssi
contributors, 2025)
   Several active expressions need reconciliation before adoption. The IPW comparator av-
erages weighted outcomes within each realized arm, whereas the paper’s Horvitz–Thompson
comparator averages the signed score over all T observations. For (D, Y ) = ((1, 2), (0, 1))
and e = 1/2, these expressions return 2 and 1. This exact witness establishes a normaliza-
tion difference for the selected input, not a package-wide failure rate or a refutation of the
paper. Preserve both expressions under distinct names and determine the intended compar-
ison.(johnchrishays/dml4ssi contributors, 2025; Hays and Raghavan, 2025; Causal banking
proposal project, 2026ft)
  The switchback source checks Dmax(t−m+1,1):t and uses

   A dependence horizon also needs one meaning in the state, assignment and variance.

zero before taking its square root, producing a zero-width interval for this particular witness.

exceeding (1 + δ/2)−1 for its moment parameter δ. An exponent of 1/2 needs a compatible
stronger moment choice; δ > 0 alone is insufficient. Finite-size qualification must also require
enough complete blocks and state how unused tail observations are handled. A selected
public law can meet such conditions without implying that every persistent bank sequence
does.(johnchrishays/dml4ssi contributors, 2025; Hays and Raghavan, 2025)

   The IPW variance helper already divides by T , and the active caller divides again. For
four centered scores (−2, 2, 2, −2), once- and twice-scaled variances are 1 and 1/4, with
standard errors 1 and 1/2. One ADE comparator selects its first score before averaging;
(1, 3, 5) distinguishes that value from the full mean. One switchback comparator gives a
within-trajectory variance helper an across-replication array. The DGP divides noise by
sd_error, so an argument of two means standard deviation 1/2 in that expression. Global-
arm reconstructions draw separate initial states, while observed trajectories follow their own
initialization. Freeze the full experiment definition, truth estimation, random streams and

acquired code has been executed here.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026ft)


39.32.3     Graph positions and simulated agents are different scientific units

Graphs.jl’s selected simple graphs reject duplicate edge insertion but permit self-loops. Adja-
cency access may return internal lists; copying duplicates adjacency storage. Vertex removal
swaps the last vertex into the removed position, while induced subgraphs return new-to-old
maps. Removing b from borrowers (a, b, c) leaves positions (a, c); a stale treatment array can
attribute b’s treatment to c. Persistent keys and explicit maps must travel with transformations.
The selected BFS takes the incoming-neighbor branch for any direction token other than :out;
validate direction tokens. Weighted distances use a separate distance matrix that must follow
the same mapping.(JuliaGraphs/Graphs.jl contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project,
2026ft)
   Agents.jl’s GraphSpace puts potentially many agents at a graph position. Its documentation
distinguishes that model from one-node-per-agent social networks. A position query includes
co-located agents; its agent-specific form removes the focal agent. Two borrowers at one branch
are therefore not two adjacent borrower nodes. Choose the scientific unit before defining
an exposure denominator. Vertex removal deletes agents at that position and swaps stored
position lists. The selected body does not explicitly rewrite moved agents’ position fields. A
native invariant check must compare membership, stored location and identity after mutation;
this is a scoped static observation, not an observed runtime failure.(JuliaDynamics/Agents.jl
contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026ft)
   StandardABM updates scheduled agents sequentially and places the model step before or
after them by configuration. Fastest, ID-sorted and randomized orders are distinct. For two
initially zero states and the authored rule xi ← xj + 1, forward order gives (1, 2), reverse order
gives (2, 1) and simultaneous old-state updates give (1, 1). A port that changes this order
changes the experiment. Bind schedule, RNG ownership and read/write timing as scientific
inputs.(JuliaDynamics/Agents.jl contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026ft)
   The selected checkpoint fields contain agents, space, properties, RNG and maximum ID, but
not stepping functions or elapsed model time. Deserialization constructs StandardABM with
a default scheduler unless supplied. Documentation also explicitly excludes functions. RNG
restoration alone cannot certify experimental restart. Bind code, scheduler, clock, model class,
outstanding events and external data, then compare interrupted and uninterrupted trajectories.
Agents.jl is a conditional public simulation substrate here, not an admitted general recovery
or causal capability. (JuliaDynamics/Agents.jl contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal
39.32. Shared-state and remaining-language networks                                            847


project, 2026ft)


39.32.4     Network dynamics needs topology and state ownership

NetworkDynamics.jl distinguishes simple graphs from ComponentGraph, which preserves
directed parallel edges and supplied order. Degree counts edges with multiplicity; neighbor lists
contain unique vertices. Edge-count and unique-borrower exposures differ even on the same
object. Component order must match graph iterators; graphless construction can reorder legacy
components or select ComponentGraph when multiplicity requires it. Retain edge identity, end-
points, units, component function and aggregation rule. (JuliaDynamics/NetworkDynamics.jl
contributors, 2026)
  Repeated component objects alias by default unless de-aliasing is requested. Component
copies de-alias metadata but share other fields; network copies share topology. Captured
mutable function state does not become independent counterfactual state through that copy.
Comparing capacity policies needs explicit parameter, random-input and buffer ownership.
Buffered, threaded and accelerator execution, and sequential or threaded reducers, describe
numerical mechanisms; they do not establish the bank law, tolerance or uncertainty. (JuliaDy-
namics/NetworkDynamics.jl contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026ft)
   Direct Julia integration is a conditional route for a prototype using explicit dynamical
components. A process interface can instead exchange immutable topology, state and results.
Both need small exact network oracles, units and sign checks, solver and event settings,
state-isolation tests and full costs. Compare parallel execution only after these semantics agree.
(Causal banking proposal project, 2026ft)


39.32.5     Rust representations can preserve or collapse exposure

petgraph Graph uses compact indices and moves the last node on removal. StableGraph
preserves unrelated indices but can reuse a freed slot. Neither makes an integer a permanent
borrower identity. Graph allows parallel edges; GraphMap identifies nodes by value and
updates an existing endpoint pair. Conversion to GraphMap explicitly merges equal node
weights and retains only the last parallel edge. Use it only under established uniqueness and
multiplicity conditions.(petgraph/petgraph contributors, 2026)
   Suppose a has two channels to treated b with weights nine and one and a channel of weight
one to untreated c. Channel-weighted exposure is 10/11. Keeping only the last a–b edge
changes it to 1/2. Summing parallel weights could preserve this exposure but still lose channel
attributes. Summation, last-edge retention and duplicate refusal are distinct product decisions.
A port must not choose implicitly. (petgraph/petgraph contributors, 2026; Causal banking
proposal project, 2026ft)
   The workspace declares Rust edition 2024, minimum Rust 1.91 and MIT-or-Apache-2.0
licensing. These source declarations do not qualify an installed binary or all dependencies.
Dijkstra requires nonnegative costs from a caller closure; valid exposure weights are not
necessarily distances. A conditional backend should expose typed failure, persistent external
keys, multiedge policy and validated costs. Prefer direct use or a narrow interface when justified;
any port still needs semantic and artifact qualification. (petgraph/petgraph contributors, 2026;
Causal banking proposal project, 2026ft)
848                                                         Causal analysis for a universal bank


39.32.6    A JavaScript interface must preserve keys and immutable evidence

Graphology’s selected default is mixed, permits loops and disallows parallel edges. Keys are
coerced to strings: a numeric identifier and its string rendering are not independent keys.
Node data retains the supplied attributes object. Export shallow-copies attributes, so nested
objects remain shared. In an authored example, changing an exported nested limit from 100 to
200 also changes the original nested object. Export is not automatically an immutable audit
snapshot.(graphology/graphology contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026ft)
   Use canonical namespaced keys, validated attributes, immutable serialized snapshots and
explicit graph options on every roundtrip. A displayed edge must retain direction, type,
evidence, availability clock and whether it is a causal assertion or an observed interaction.
An LLM-proposed edge belongs in a separate editable layer until reviewed. A CLI or MCP
request should bind snapshot hash, target, exposure map, assignment law and method version,
then return a typed result or refusal. This comparison specifies those contracts; it does
not establish an implemented interface. (graphology/graphology contributors, 2026; Causal
banking proposal project, 2026ft)


39.32.7    One public qualification sequence connects the components

Start with a small known-law servicing system and explicit state and assignment calendar.
Independent auxiliary trajectories train nuisances. Exact enumeration checks treatment
paths and support before larger simulations measure bias, coverage, precision and refusal. A
second fixture represents identical borrower interactions in each graph backend and checks
keys, direction, weights, multiplicity and attributes through mutation and serialization. A
third checks sequential updates, counterfactual isolation and restart. Each answers a different
question; numeric agreement on one fixture cannot certify the others. (Causal banking proposal
project, 2026ft)
   Count all attempted, failed, refused and admissible requests. At an explicitly hypothetical
USD30,000 cost, 1,000 attempts, 600 returned results and 400 admissible results imply
USD30, USD50 and USD75 respectively. Include acquisition, conversion, auxiliary training,
initialization, debugging, review and recovery. Public/generated evidence can justify later
bank experiments without supplying authentic assignment truth or bank economics.(Causal
banking proposal project, 2026ft)
   Retain dml4ssi as a conditional method reference pending equation reconciliation, rights and
native tests. Consider Graphs.jl and petgraph as substrates, Agents.jl for explicitly scheduled
agents, NetworkDynamics.jl for declared dynamics and Graphology for a reviewed interface.
Reject silent graph collapse, unverified state copying and automatic causal admission. Finish
bounded search tails and failed queries through distinct permitted routes. Unknown state
sufficiency, hidden confounding and general dependent-data uncertainty require information or
justified restrictions. These originals do not establish complete remaining-language network
qualification.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026ft)


39.33      OpenLineage: execution history without automatic sci-
           entific acceptance
A bank comparing collections policies needs to know which data, model, assumptions and
decision rule produced each result. That need makes a common lineage vocabulary useful,
but also creates a risk: a completed job can be mistaken for a justified causal answer.
39.33. OpenLineage: execution history without automatic scientific acceptance                 849


OpenLineage supplies run, job and dataset events with extensible facets. At the selected
7 October 2026 commit, the inspected core schema identifies itself as version 2.0.2 and the
Python package declares version 1.54.0. These pinned sources support a concrete reference
choice for the proposal. They do not establish that an existing server preserves every facet,
that another workspace has adopted the contract, or that any emitted claim is scientifically
true. (OpenLineage contributors, 2026)


39.33.1     A valid event is not a complete analysis history

The core schema requires event time, producer URI and schema URI. A run event additionally
requires run and job objects; the run requires a UUID, and the job requires namespace and
name. The description of event type calls for a START and one terminal COMPLETE,
ABORT or FAIL per run, but event type is not in that object’s required-field list. Input and
output datasets are optional too. These are distinct facts: descriptive protocol requirements
are not all enforced by single-document JSON validation. (OpenLineage contributors, 2026)
   Local authored fixtures validate the acquired declarative schema using an installed JSON
Schema validator with format checking and only internal references. A run record without
event type passes; a COMPLETE record without inputs or outputs passes; an invalid UUID
fails. Two identical COMPLETE records each pass although the pair has no START. These
results concern the schema, not native client construction, server ingestion or stream validation.
The document validator cannot establish a unique, complete lifecycle by examining one event
at a time. A product adapter therefore needs a separate history rule with attempt identity,
permitted state transitions, duplicate handling and reconciliation of missing terminal records.
(Causal banking proposal project, 2026dw)
   Dataset namespace and name identify a dataset, but the selected base schema does not require
a content hash or immutable snapshot. Two authored payloads with the same namespace/name
and different hashes show why this matters. The proposed causal facet should bind the exact
data snapshot, availability clock, eligible population, event dictionary, target, graph or model,
identification assumptions, nuisance fits, split assignment and uncertainty method. Large
or restricted artifacts should be referenced by authorized identifiers and digests, not copied
indiscriminately into every event. (OpenLineage contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal
project, 2026dw)
   The base facet requires producer and schema URIs and permits additional properties. An
authored facet asserting that a result is identified passes the selected base schema despite also
declaring an unsupported claim. The test does not dereference its custom URI: that URI is a
field, not proof that an additional schema or its scientific claims were checked. A production
consumer must validate an approved custom-facet schema and separately review the evidence
supporting the assertion. Serialization, schema conformance, causal identification and bank
acceptance are separate states. (OpenLineage contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal
project, 2026dw)


39.33.2     Delivery guarantees depend on the concrete client and transport

The Java client documents a normal return after emission regardless of backend exceptions.
The inspected implementation delegates through a metric timer without an exception guard.
Its concrete HTTP transport performs a synchronous POST and raises on response codes from
400 through 599; its response exception is a client exception. The comment is therefore not
a sufficient universal no-throw contract. The circuit-breaker branch can also return without
emitting. Even an incremented emission-complete counter is not a scientific acceptance receipt.
850                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


The wrapper must distinguish suppression, attempted delivery, acknowledged delivery, persisted
lineage and accepted analysis. (OpenLineage contributors, 2026)
   The Java duration overload introduces another boundary. The abstract transport’s default
implementation accepts a duration but simply calls the ordinary emit method. The inspected
HTTP transport does not override that overload; it configures connection, socket and response
timeouts separately, defaulting to five seconds when no millisecond option is supplied. Thus a
caller’s requested duration is not automatically an end-to-end delivery deadline on this path.
Other transports may provide stronger behavior; they require their own source and runtime
review. Do not describe every transport as asynchronous or assume that a generic timeout
parameter bounds all work. (OpenLineage contributors, 2026)
   The Python client adds environment, tags and source-location facets, can reduce dataset
identifiers before filtering, and can return early for absent transport, disabled emission or
a filtered event. Its HTTP transport posts, checks response status and returns a response,
while the public client emit method returns no response object. The selected retry defaults
allow HEAD and POST and declare total/read/connect counts of five, a backoff factor of
0.3, and status codes 500, 502, 503 and 504. The transport passes this configuration to
urllib3 through Requests. Declared package bounds are not a solved environment; the effective
dependency behavior still needs a locked profile. A retryable POST and a run UUID do not
prove server-side idempotency or durable exactly-once ingestion. (OpenLineage contributors,
2026)
   These distinctions motivate a proposed adapter contract, not an assertion that it has
already been implemented. Preserve a durable local request and artifact record; emit lineage
with a stable logical run identity and explicit attempt identity; and reconcile the receiver’s
acknowledgement with the local record. A response lost after the receiver commits creates
ambiguity: blind repetition can duplicate work unless the receiver’s deduplication rule is
known. Cancellation, transport timeout and scientific refusal need separate fields. Sensitive
custom facets also require a logging review because the inspected clients contain debug event-
serialization paths. No actual leakage or deployment failure is inferred from that observation.
(OpenLineage contributors, 2026)


39.33.3    A causal result facet and a request-complete denominator

Suppose three authored analysis jobs finish their computation, but two correctly abstain
because their identification requirements are unmet. With a stipulated total cost of USD 45,
cost per completed job is USD 15, whereas cost per accepted causal artifact is USD 45.
Reporting only a job COMPLETE count conceals that distinction. Correct abstention may be
valuable; it should remain explicit rather than disappear from cost or success denominators.
This is a designed accounting example, not a measured service price or empirical adoption
case. (Causal banking proposal project, 2026dw)
   The proposed facet should therefore state whether the output is an estimate, identified set,
sensitivity analysis, diagnostic, or structured refusal. It should retain the target and horizon,
assumptions and their evidence, sampling/dependence unit, conditioning population, resolved
estimator, uncertainty object, numerical status, and exact reviewed artifact. An agent can draft
a causal question or graph, but its proposal is not promoted to verified identification by being
placed in an extensible JSON field. The method owner, artifact reviewer and institutional
approver retain their separate responsibilities.
