39.33.4    Reference choice, integration alternatives and closure route

The direct repository license is Apache 2.0. The Java build declares Java 8 source/target
with a Java 17 toolchain and a concrete set of library versions; the Python build declares
Python 3.10 or later, bounded build tooling and minimum runtime dependencies. These
declarations support an environment plan, not transitive rights clearance, a complete lock or a
platform support promise. The preferred conditional route is an original Java or Python client
with a reviewed causal facet and explicit acknowledgement protocol. Direct schema-compatible
emission is an alternative for another language, but it transfers validation, transport and
compatibility maintenance to this project. A port of every integration is unjustified without a
measured requirement. (OpenLineage contributors, 2026)
   For the present product proposal, retain OpenLineage as a versioned protocol and client
reference. Defer native admission until the method owner agrees the causal vocabulary, the
adapter owner freezes clients and receiver, the rights owner reviews the complete distribution,
and the evaluation owner registers public/generated conformance trials. Trials should cover
omitted states, duplicated terminals, reordered events, suppressed emission, custom facet
rejection, receiver persistence, acknowledgement loss, retry/cancel behavior and end-to-end
costs. A local file lineage backend is an explicit comparator for small prototypes. Integration
with sibling repositories is a future consumer-specific contract and test, not implied by their
presence on the machine. No sibling repository is modified by this proposal review.
  This choice completes a bounded reuse argument while leaving delivery, native adoption,
causal truth and receiver-specific qualification open.


39.34      OpenMetadata: catalog evidence and causal acceptance
OpenMetadata can organize evidence about a causal workflow without deciding whether
its causal conclusion is correct. A bank may already use a catalog to locate loan snap-
shots, trace transformations, assign ownership and document quality expectations. The
product proposal should connect to that chosen catalog when justified, rather than re-
quire a second institutional source of ownership. The selected OpenMetadata commit is
278e4abf6fb0c3027d5f1878bac92839995ef75c, dated 7 October 2026. Its platform declares
2.0.0-SNAPSHOT and its Python ingestion project declares 2.0.0.0.dev0 with Python at least
3.10. These identify inspected development artifacts, not a qualified supported server release.
The root license declares Apache-2.0; the ingestion dependencies are separately maintained in
setup metadata. A usable bank distribution still needs a frozen environment, connector scope
and complete rights review. No server, client, connector or upstream test was executed for
this comparison.(OpenMetadata contributors, 2026)


39.34.1    Identity, lineage and the meaning of an edge

The inspected add-lineage schema requires an edge with source and destination entity references.
Each reference requires an identifier and type; its name and fully qualified name are optional.
The reference is not an immutable data-snapshot hash. An authored example binds one
entity identifier to two different payload hashes. That is not a catalog fault: the identity of
a table and the identity of its contents at an information cutoff are different. The proposed
causal artifact must retain both the catalog reference and the exact snapshot, extraction query,
availability cutoff and exclusion manifest.(OpenMetadata contributors, 2026; Causal banking
proposal project, 2026dx)
  Lineage details can carry a query, column relationships, pipeline, source class and timestamps.
852                                                            Causal analysis for a universal bank


Such relationships describe transformations and provenance. For example, a collections
score may depend computationally on delinquency, previous contacts and a repayment table.
This does not decide whether contacts cause repayment, whether distress confounds contact
assignment, or whether a post-contact field was improperly used at time zero. A proposed
agent can use the catalog to retrieve candidate variables and their declared clocks, but scientific
edge proposals need a separate causal diagram and reviewed assumptions. An LLM-generated
description must retain its status as a proposal. (OpenMetadata contributors, 2026)
   Authored local schema fixtures accept a minimal edge with no lineage details. They also
accept unregistered causal-assertion fields inside the selected lineage-details object, while
rejecting an invalid UUID and an extra top-level request field. Two opposite-direction edges
each pass the individual request schema. These findings concern declarative validation only:
they do not prove that a Java model retains unknown fields, that a server accepts a cycle,
or that any custom assertion is true. A single request schema is not a graph-acyclicity or
identification test. The complete basic schema also contains a Java-specific regular-expression
extension that fails Python’s metaschema format check in the local validator. The original
bytes are retained; the successful fixtures are restricted to exercised definitions with local
reference resolution and UUID format checking. Full cross-language schema compatibility
remains unqualified. (OpenMetadata contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project,
2026dx)


39.34.2     Authorization and read-back are part of the result

The selected lineage PUT endpoint authorizes editing on both endpoint entities and calls the
repository before returning an empty HTTP 200 response. The repository resolves nondeleted
entity references and an optional pipeline, processes timestamps, validates details and inserts
a relationship. It then updates search, cache, events and optionally RDF. Inspection of this
sequence does not establish a common transaction or complete delivery semantics across all
those stores. The proposed adapter must distinguish an acknowledged request, a persisted
relationship, a search-visible edge and a reconciled causal artifact. (OpenMetadata contributors,
2026)
   The inspected column validator filters invalid destination columns and removes unrecognized
source columns; it retains a column mapping only when valid source columns remain. Conse-
quently, successful completion does not by itself prove that every submitted column relationship
survived. In an authored abstract trace, a request mapping sources balance and ghost to
score retains only balance; a second mapping to a missing destination is discarded. This
trace follows the selected filtering rule and is not a native server result. A consumer requiring
complete lineage should compare a read-back representation with the submitted, versioned
manifest and return a structured mismatch when necessary. Silently treating partial retention
as complete evidence would undermine the scientific audit.(OpenMetadata contributors, 2026;
Causal banking proposal project, 2026dx)
   Catalog update time also differs from observation availability. The inspected timestamp
helpers choose among incoming, prior and server times; creation time can retain the earlier value
and update time the later value. These fields are useful provenance, but do not establish when
a business record became available to a decision maker. The proposed request therefore binds
the event clock, observation clock, extraction clock and catalog update separately. A monthly
repayment table backfilled after a treatment cannot be made pre-treatment information merely
by associating it with an older catalog entity. (OpenMetadata contributors, 2026)
39.34. OpenMetadata: catalog evidence and causal acceptance                                   853


39.34.3     Retries, contracts and separate acceptance states

The inspected Python client declares three retries, a base wait of thirty seconds, retry status
codes 503 and 504, and a 429 feature-limit branch. Its default timeout is a connect/read
pair of ten and three hundred seconds. The retry loop uses increasing waits; an authored
sequence of three retryable responses followed by success incurs waits of thirty, sixty and
ninety seconds, or 180 seconds before request durations. This is an abstract configuration
calculation, not measured latency or a universal total deadline. Selected transport exceptions
are raised explicitly, whereas some unexpected exceptions on a nonraw path are logged and
can return null. An empty successful body also returns null. The adapter therefore needs
an explicit status and response contract; a null value cannot serve simultaneously as failure
and successful persistence evidence. Retries require a separate duplicate and reconciliation
policy.(OpenMetadata contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026dx)
   The data-contract schema includes a latest-result object with timestamp, status, message
and result identifier, and an extension field. These support a place to describe quality outcomes;
the schema alone does not establish how those outcomes are computed or what a particular pass
means. The selected OpenLineage endpoint additionally checks enablement and authorization,
invokes a mapper and constructs an explicit response. This is a promising connection to the
preceding OpenLineage proposal. Its mapper, custom-facet retention, transaction behavior
and failure responses still require their own pinned qualification. Neither the existence of a
contract nor a successful lineage operation supplies a proof of causal identification, uncertainty
calibration or bank acceptance. (OpenMetadata contributors, 2026)
   The proposed causal extension keeps distinct states for metadata conformance, snapshot
identity, identification review, numerical qualification, artifact acceptance and institutional
approval. It binds the estimand, population, treatment regime, graph and assumptions,
evidence hashes, sampling law, uncertainty procedure, refusal reasons and reviewer provenance.
Generic catalog status may summarize these fields for navigation but must not replace them.
For an agent translating a business question, a catalog match is a candidate data source; it
becomes eligible only after clocks, semantics and scientific assumptions have been checked.


39.34.4     A reference decision with a concrete prototype route

The present decision is reference use. Integration remains disabled. The preferred conditional
route uses the bank’s existing OpenMetadata service and its original pinned ingestion/API
interfaces, with a small typed causal-artifact adapter and explicit read-back reconciliation.
Direct REST emission is an alternative when the worker language and deployment constraints
justify owning schema compatibility and transport behavior. An OpenLineage route is another
conditional alternative after its mapping preserves the required fields. Immutable local evidence
files remain a useful public-data prototype comparator. A whole-catalog port or a mandatory
second catalog is rejected for the current proposal because the additional maintenance and
migration cost lacks a demonstrated requirement. These are proposal choices, not installed
integrations. (OpenMetadata contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026dx)
   Costs must retain their denominators. With an authored USD 60 total for four submitted
edges, three assumed persisted edges and one assumed accepted causal artifact, costs are USD 15
per submission, USD 20 per persisted edge and USD 60 per accepted artifact. These stipulated
counts and costs are not observed OpenMetadata prices or bank returns. A real comparison
includes schema and connector maintenance, permissions, artifact storage, reconciliation, failed
requests, operator time and scientific review. The method owner specifies causal acceptance;
the catalog/adapter owner freezes the server and mapping; the rights owner resolves the
distribution; the evaluation owner preregisters generated or public fixtures for malformed
854                                                            Causal analysis for a universal bank


references, filtered columns, stale snapshots, permission denial, retries, partial persistence and
full costs. These steps are known, while the future native and institutional outcomes remain
unknown. (Causal banking proposal project, 2026dx)
  Source-level schema compatibility, complete dependency resolution, remaining server dele-
gates and chosen-consumer semantics remain explicit follow-ups. They do not block indepen-
dent proposal obligations. This reference decision preserves a useful catalog option without
promoting catalog lineage to causal acceptance.


39.35      Polars as a data worker: population, information time
           and execution meaning
A banking analysis can preserve every numerical formula and still change its question when
it joins customer records to events. A customer with three contacts can acquire three times
the weight of a customer with one contact; an apparently historical measurement can have
arrived after the decision; and an overlapping time window can be mistaken for an independent
observation. A dataframe engine is valuable because it makes these transformations explicit
and executable. It cannot decide which transformation represents the banking experiment.
   Polars is therefore considered here as a conditional data-worker reference. Twenty-one
selected files authenticate to revision bf2152618c7123836a825f8566f4d98585b6ff5b, dated
7 October 2026 before the Asia/Shanghai cutoff. The Python project declares version 2.0.0,
Python at least 3.10 and the matching polars-runtime-32 dependency; the Rust workspace
separately declares 0.55.1 and edition 2024. These are source declarations, not authenticated
distributed releases. Runtime-64, compatibility, Arrow, pandas, database, cloud and GPU
routes have distinct dependencies. The selected root contains MIT terms, including notice
retention, but this is not clearance of every dependency or commercial service. No downloaded
implementation or test is executed in this review. (Polars Contributors, 2026)


39.35.1     A join changes weights unless the population contract prevents it

The selected Python lazy interface defaults to an inner join and validate="m:m"; the latter
performs no uniqueness check. It offers one-to-one, one-to-many and many-to-one validation,
and forwards validation, null equality, coalescing and order choices to its underlying join call.
The guide distinguishes inner, outer, semi, anti, cross and as-of joins. These are substantive
alternatives: a semi join filters membership without adding the right-hand columns, whereas
an ordinary equi join can multiply rows. They must be chosen from the observation design,
not from the fact that a table happens to fit in memory.(Polars Contributors, 2026)
   Let customer i have outcome Yi and mi matching event records. For one group with n
                      P
original customers and i mi > 0, the unweighted mean after an ordinary join is
                                     Pn
                                           mi Yi      Covn (m, Y )
                           Y joined = Pi=1
                                        n        =Y +              ,                       (39.15)
                                         i=1 mi               m
where Covn uses denominator n and customers with no match have mi = 0. The identity follows
by expanding n−1 i (mi − m)(Yi − Y ). Equal multiplicities preserve the mean; dependence
                    P

between outcome and multiplicity generally does not. Neither the identity nor a successful
join establishes a causal effect.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026ca)
   For an exact supplied example, two treated customers have outcomes 10 and 0 and two
controls have outcomes 0 and 0. Their customer-level descriptive contrast is 5. If the first
treated customer has three event records and each other customer has one, the joined treated
39.35. Polars as a data worker: population, information time and execution meaning              855


outcomes are (10, 10, 10, 0) and the contrast becomes 15/2. Against a stipulated cost threshold
of USD 6, the two descriptive calculations imply margins of USD −1 and USD 3/2. That
reversal illustrates a population error; it is not evidence that either contrast is a treatment
effect or that Polars has produced an incorrect join. An event-level target may be appropriate,
but it is a different target.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026ca)
  The proposed worker should carry a sampling-unit key, an expected join cardinality and
pre/post membership counts. A many-to-one join requires a justified unique right-hand key. If
multiple rows are meaningful revisions, aggregation or version selection must be scientifically
specified before joining. Dropping duplicates with an arbitrary first-row rule merely hides the
unresolved choice. Anti joins can expose unmatched IDs for review, while a declared refusal
can preserve an unresolved key rather than silently removing the customer.


39.35.2     Missing values and missing identities are different problems

Polars distinguishes missing null values from floating-point NaN. The selected guide states
that null_count excludes NaN, fill_null does not fill it, and numerical means and sums
skip nulls while NaN typically propagates. These are useful computational contracts. They do
not say that omitted outcomes are missing at random or that a nonfinite number should be
reclassified as an unobserved bank response.(Polars Contributors, 2026)
   Suppose the recorded outcomes are 2, 4 and one missing value. The observed mean is 3.
Filling the missing entry with zero changes the three-person mean to 2. Two possible complete
populations, with hidden values 0 and 8, have the same observed data but full means 2 and
14/3. Thus the computational choice to skip, fill or reject does not identify the full-population
mean. A separate observation model or sensitivity range must justify an estimand involving the
missing response. These are exact authored finite populations, not a claim about a package’s
imputation accuracy.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026ca)
   Join keys require another distinction. The selected interface defaults to not matching null
keys, while nulls_equal=True permits them to match. An inspected unit test describes two
null keys on the left matching a null key on the right; it has not been run here. Equality of
missing tokens is a declared relation on values, not evidence that two unidentified customers
are the same person. The worker must preserve unmatched and ambiguous identities and their
denominators. Treating every missing identifier as one customer would impose a linkage claim
that the engine has no information to establish.(Polars Contributors, 2026)


39.35.3     An as-of key must represent the information available to the decision

The lazy as-of interface documents a backward search selecting the last right-hand key at or
before the left-hand key, a forward search selecting the first key at or after it, and a nearest
search. It defaults to backward, permits exact matches unless told otherwise, and supports
grouping and a tolerance. Both inputs must be ordered within the relevant groups. The same
source qualifies checking: the in-memory engine cannot check grouped sortedness, while the
streaming engine checks the rows it processes. Inspected tests describe these distinctions and
deliberate invalid sortedness declarations; they are intended checks, not observations of this
workspace’s runtime.(Polars Contributors, 2026)
   Let t be the decision time, ej a measurement’s event time and aj its availability time.
A possible historical feature contract chooses the largest ej among records satisfying both
ej ≤ t and aj ≤ t, within the correct customer and permitted revision lineage. Backward
matching on event time alone imposes only the first condition. At a supplied decision time
100, consider records (e, a, x) = (90, 105, 0), (80, 85, 4), (101, 101, 10). Backward event matching
856                                                            Causal analysis for a universal bank


selects value 0, although it arrived too late; nearest matching selects the future value 10. The
stated availability-aware contract selects value 4. The exact example demonstrates information
leakage from the wrong clock, not a defect in nearest or backward matching themselves.
(Causal banking proposal project, 2026ca)
   Equal timestamps need a declared ordering convention: a value logged at the decision
timestamp may have been recorded just after the action. Disabling exact matches can express
strict inequality but cannot recover an unrecorded within-timestamp order. Tolerances likewise
need units and meaning. The selected source distinguishes calendar-day tolerances from
fixed 24-hour durations under daylight saving. Its time-zone guide distinguishes converting
a zone from replacing one. A wrapper should bind the zone, precision, strictness, revision
and availability clock instead of allowing a serialization round trip to choose them implicitly.
(Polars Contributors, 2026)
   Window construction also enters uncertainty. The guide permits the window period to differ
from its start interval, allowing overlap or gaps. For independent mean-zero, variance-one signs
X1 , X2 , X3 , define W1 = (X1 +X2 )/2 and W2 = (X2 +X3 )/2. Then Var(W1 ) = Var(W2 ) = 1/2
and Cov(W1 , W2 ) = 1/4, so
                                            W1 + W2        3
                                                     
                                       Var              = .                              (39.16)
                                                2          8
Treating the two windows as independent gives 1/4, understating variance by a factor of 3/2.
Enumeration of the eight sign triples reproduces these moments. A correct window aggregation
therefore still requires a dependence-aware uncertainty calculation for the resulting panel or
time series.(Polars Contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026ca)


39.35.4     Streaming is a plan property, not a memory or recovery certificate

The lazy interface exposes optimized and unoptimized plans. The guide describes predicate,
projection and slice pushdown, common-subplan elimination, join ordering and type coercion.
These can preserve the declared relational query while reducing work; they do not determine
whether that query matches the experiment. The appropriate audit binds the logical request
and input identities as well as the selected physical plan, engine and environment. An optimized
graph is useful evidence of execution choices, not evidence that a selected sample is causally
valid. (Polars Contributors, 2026)
  The selected collect documentation says that auto selection uses configured engine affinity,
otherwise streaming, and that unsupported work can fall back to in-memory execution. GPU
and background modes carry explicit instability qualifications. The engine delegate forwards
the selected engine name to the underlying collect call; source comments about relative
performance are not measurements on this banking workload. The streaming guide itself
contains an editorial exclusion comment, so its presence in the repository does not establish
publication of that page in the hosted manual.(Polars Contributors, 2026)
   A documentation tension is more informative when followed into code. The eager join
docstring says validation is not supported by the streaming engine; the lazy docstring lists
validation and streaming support without that same note. In the inspected Rust lowering path,
the specialized streaming join branch requires !args.validation.needs_checks(). Other
cases produce an InMemoryJoin node while retaining the join arguments. needs_checks is
false only for many-to-many validation. The inspected in-memory node waits for both input
sinks, invokes its join closure and classifies its sink state as accumulating memory. This
supports a precise source-level interpretation: requesting checked join cardinality can introduce
an in-memory join within a streaming plan. It does not support saying that validation is
silently discarded, that all such queries fail, or that native execution has been verified. (Polars
39.36. Longitudinal R workers: preserve the regime, event and sampling unit                  857


Contributors, 2026)
   This tradeoff matters to a proposal’s cost model. Removing a key check to retain streaming
changes the accepted-input contract. Moving that check to a separate prepass adds I/O and
requires the checked snapshot to be the one subsequently joined. The future trial must measure
complete validation, scans, conversion, spilling, fallback, output and restart costs against an
identical accepted-output definition. Neither a runtime flag nor a successful small fixture
supplies a bank memory bound or a durable recovery guarantee.


39.35.5     A narrow reuse choice with substantive alternatives

The present choice is reference, with a Python process worker as a candidate prototype route
and direct Rust use as a separate engineering alternative. Reusing a pinned engine can preserve
its rich join and expression semantics. Porting that engine into R, Java or C++ would add
compiler, null, ordering and dependency obligations without demonstrated benefit. Consumers
in those languages can instead exchange explicitly typed artifacts through the common CLI or
MCP contract; that bridge is proposed and still needs conformance evidence.
   A relational database or another dataframe engine remains a substantive alternative when
its snapshot, key and query contracts are better suited to the chosen workload. No speed
ranking is assigned without a matched trial. Small project-owned enumerations remain the
independent oracle for population, clock and dependence examples. The scientific owner
specifies units, population, assignment and information law; the adapter maintainer binds
schema, null/NaN, keys, ordering and runtime versions; the operator measures full resource
and recovery behavior.
  Before native integration, freeze actual Python and Rust runtime artifacts, optional engines,
dependency notices, input snapshots, plans and output validation. Register edge cases for
duplicate and missing keys, nonfinite responses, late revisions, ties, grouped sortedness,
overlapping windows and checked-join fallback. Preserve failures and refusals and compare full
accepted-output costs. Source review supports the reuse decision; native execution, causal
qualification and bank adoption remain open.


39.36      Longitudinal R workers: preserve the regime, event and
           sampling unit
A repeated collections decision is not a baseline treatment comparison with extra rows. At each
visit a bank observes an eligible history, chooses an action, and subsequently sees repayment,
default, prepayment or loss of observation. The order matters: an alert generated after the
action cannot become its baseline confounder. Nor may prepayment become censoring merely
because both terminate the collection record. The relevant software comparison therefore
begins with the regime and the event law, then follows each candidate through its actual
source interfaces. Six inherited lineages are reconciled here: grf, lmtp, ltmle, gfoRmula, stremr
and survtmle. This is a bounded comparison, not a complete census or a finding of native
numerical parity.
  Let Ht denote information available immediately before action At ; let gt (a | Ht ) be the
proposed intervention distribution. A cumulative incidence target is FDg (K) = Pr(T g ≤
K, J g = D), where D denotes default, J the first terminal event, and K a specified horizon.
Identification from observations additionally needs consistency, appropriate exchangeability,
support and a justified observation mechanism. A software argument for g, a fitted survival
curve or a finite influence vector does not establish these premises. Dynamic treatment, a
858                                                             Causal analysis for a universal bank


modified natural action, baseline treatment and intervention on monitoring are different inputs,
even if their final output is a probability.


39.36.1     Six lineages and their qualified roles

The existing grf decision is deliberately narrow: an all-population AIPW contrast under a
binary, independent-customer profile. It excludes survival, repeated decisions and general
calendar dependence. Its inclusion in an inherited candidate register must not transfer that
initial profile’s acceptance to this survival question. A separate survival-source and qualification
study remains necessary. (grf contributors, 2026b)
   The lmtp source revision declares 1.5.4. Its policy interface makes natural and shifted
treatment histories and the reference policy central to the target. Its reviewed controls also
separate outer folds, learner folds and influence-function identifiers. The existing finding about
defaults followed actual TMLE and SDR forwarding; it was not an observed failure at a
fictitious parameter value. The remaining survival delegates, the variance dependency and
the effect of identifier conventions require their own inspection and registered native cases.
AGPL terms and direct source inspection do not constitute complete distribution clearance.
(Nicholas Williams, Ivan Diaz and contributors, 2026)
   The pinned ltmle 1.3-0 route supplies a different longitudinal interface, including binary
treatment regimes. Requested variance, effective variance and warnings must be preserved
separately; choosing a cluster field is not proof of an arbitrary dependence theorem. A future
worker should return its node order, intervention matrix, actual variance route and warning
record along with estimates. The previous source and exact-reference review remains the basis
for this scoped comparison. (Joshua Schwab and ltmle contributors, 2023; Causal banking
proposal authors, 2026)
   The gfoRmula source declares 1.1.2 while its NEWS date remains to be determined. Its
covariate simulation order, intervention functions, competing-event convention and empirical-
range truncation all affect the generated law. Observed sample size, simulation size and
bootstrap count are three different precision controls. Resampling whole people preserves
repeated measurements inside a person; it does not reproduce arbitrary common branch or
calendar shocks. Failed bootstrap replicates and their omission from interval aggregation must
remain visible. These findings favor a narrowly specified original R worker over a premature
rewrite. (CausalInference gfoRmula contributors, 2025; Causal banking proposal project,
2026ao)
   The two additional source inspections sharpen the choice. stremr 0.4 has separate treatment
and monitoring intervention probabilities and sequential regression machinery. Its TMLE and
iterative-TMLE flags cannot both be set. Internally generated inverse weights pass through
stabilization and truncation branches; user-supplied inverse weights take a different path after
intervention attribute checks. An adapter must record which path was used and the effective
weights, rather than treating a requested truncation value as evidence that every supplied
weight was truncated. Optional weights are rejected inside the TMLE/iterative branch; this
does not establish the same restriction for every g-computation route. Documentation’s
warning about Qstratify and an existing source branch are a qualification question, not proof
of a universal runtime failure. (stremr package contributors, 2017)
   The survtmle 1.1.1 public wrapper accepts one treatment vector, failure times, event
labels and baseline adjustment variables. It dispatches to hazard or iterated-mean estimators
and forwards maxIter to the hazard route, not to the mean call. That interface must not
silently become a sequence of repeated interventions. Missing inputs, nonpositive times and
more than two observed treatment values are rejected by the inspected checks. Requested
39.36. Longitudinal R workers: preserve the regime, event and sampling unit                   859


treatment/event combinations require observed endpoints. Requesting hazard g-computation
produces a warning and proceeds with TMLE, so requested and effective methods can differ.
The event-subset guard compares an expression with itself; ordinary nonmissing values cannot
activate that intended check. This motivates a worker-side contract and native subset cases,
not an unobserved package-failure claim. (survtmle package contributors, 2019)


39.36.2     Competing events change the monetary question

Consider a supplied two-period law with mutually exclusive default and prepayment hazards
d = 1/10 and p = 2/5 at each period while still at risk. The first-event default risk is

                               FD (2) = d + (1 − d − p)d = 3/20.

A different, stipulated law eliminates prepayment while holding the default hazard fixed; its
risk is
                               FDelim (2) = d + (1 − d)d = 19/100.
The second law does not follow from relabeling a prepayment field as censored. It is an
extra counterfactual model whose unchanged default mechanism needs justification. Under
a supplied USD 10,000 loss and a USD 1,700 contract paying that loss on default, expected
payout less price is minus USD 200 under the first law and plus USD 200 under the second.
The sign reversal comes from changing the target, not improving an estimator. These are exact
authored calculations, not observed banking economics or package output. (Causal banking
proposal project, 2026bu)
   For this reason, a prospective comparison must state whether it estimates cumulative
incidence with competing events, survival from all terminal events, a cause-specific hazard, or a
risk under an elimination intervention. It must also specify within-period event ordering. The
existing gfoRmula inspection records its same-period competing-survival convention, whereas
the survtmle source builds cause-specific quantities from event labels. A numerical match is
meaningful only after these targets and clocks agree. (CausalInference gfoRmula contributors,
2025; survtmle package contributors, 2019)


39.36.3     Stopping, warnings and residual custody

A maximum-iteration option is not a convergence certificate. The inspected stremr iterative
path loops over 1, . . . , m + 1. Its cap check is the else if of the condition that the iteration
exceeds one. For integer m ≥ 1, persistent failure of its stopping test can therefore permit
m + 1 updates. The influence contribution is evaluated before an update and stored after the
loop. At an exhausted cap, a worker must verify its relation to the final predictions, rather
than assume it was recomputed. Initial success flags and failure counts are assembled before
the optional iterative fit; the later prediction update does not recompute those flags in that
block. (stremr package contributors, 2017)
   The survtmle hazard loop checks c ≤ m and increments c inside the body. Persistent residuals
can likewise permit m + 1 updates, with an exhaustion warning. Its fluctuation delegate has
a separate optimizer cap. On nonzero optimizer convergence it warns and substitutes zero
coefficients before continuing; the outer residual and the inner convergence status must both
remain visible. Other convergence checks in the hazard route can return character sentinels,
whereas the public wrapper subsequently expects list fields. This source-level mismatch is a
failure path to exercise; it is not evidence that a specified native input has already reached it.
(survtmle package contributors, 2019)
860                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


   An abstract loop witness with failed stopping and cap two produces three updates for
both control structures. A deliberately simple state marker changes from two to three in the
final update while a pre-update marker remains two. This demonstrates the ordering issue
only; it does not estimate the magnitude of a TMLE error. A future worker should return
requested cap, actual updates, stop reason, final independently recomputed score and every
inner-optimizer warning. Changing upstream source would create a separately pinned fork
requiring a new audit. (Causal banking proposal project, 2026bu)
   The hazard influence code adds one column per requested treatment/event pair. Its
first extraction distinguishes numeric vectors from matrices, but its post-update branch
unconditionally calls colMeans. A single selected column in an ordinary data frame is therefore
a shape-sensitive path to qualify. Initial identifiers are sequential; the long-data constructor
expands rows by subject, and influence contributions are summed by identifier. This trace does
not establish a row-permutation failure. Bounds joins, reused models and later transformations
still require explicit identity checks. (survtmle package contributors, 2019)


39.36.4     The unit of uncertainty survives reshaping
                                           P
Let Dit be a visit contribution and Di = t Dit a subject contribution. A common influence
variance expression is
                                    Vbsubj = n−2   Di Di⊤ .
                                                 X

                                                  i

The inspected stremr and survtmle routes aggregate contributions within subjects before
outer products; their precise helpers and estimator branches remain distinct. This supports
preserving subject identity through the interface. It does not justify deleting cross-subject
covariance when subjects share a branch shock. (stremr package contributors, 2017; survtmle
package contributors, 2019)
   An exact law makes the distinction visible. Let independent signs Z1 , Z2 take values −1, 1
with equal probability. There are two subjects per branch and two visits per subject, each
visit contributing its branch sign. Dividing the sum of the eight visit contributions by four
subjects gives θb = Z1 + Z2 , with variance two. Treating eight visits as independent while
retaining that denominator gives 8/16 = 1/2; aggregating by subject but treating four subjects
as independent gives 16/16 = 1. Correct within-person aggregation repairs one error while
leaving common-branch covariance missing. These values are exact under the supplied law,
not empirical coverage results. (Causal banking proposal project, 2026bu)
   Residual centering is another separate issue. With scalar contributions D1 = 3, D2 = −1,
the uncentered sum divided by n2 is 5/2; the centered version with the same denominator is
two. Their difference is D̄2 /n = 1/2. More generally the matrix difference is D̄D̄⊤ /n. This
identity neither endorses an unbiased finite-sample estimator nor repairs a failed estimating
equation. It explains why returning meanIC, final residuals and the exact covariance convention
is more informative than returning a standard error alone. (Causal banking proposal project,
2026bu)
    The inspected survtmle long-data constructor also deserves a clock contract. Its observed
expansion uses ranked unique failure times; its prediction expansion uses the integer grid
1, . . . , t0 . With observed times two and five, a late subject has two observed event-grid rows
while the prediction frame has five horizon rows. This is a difference in constructions, not a
demonstrated estimator error. Mapping irregular banking timestamps to time indices, handling
gaps and specifying the horizon must precede a parity trial. The no-observed-censoring branch
sets a censoring factor to one; absence of a censoring label in an extract does not establish
complete follow-up. (survtmle package contributors, 2019; Causal banking proposal project,
