2026bu)


39.36.5     Integration choice and a bounded qualification program

Retain the original R workers as candidate engines for their declared regimes. A port to Python,
Java or C++ would inherit the event ordering, nuisance fits, weighting, failure behavior and
uncertainty obligations; a shared API cannot remove them. The initial preference is therefore
isolated, pinned R workers behind typed artifacts and the common CLI/MCP contract. A
native port becomes reasonable only when measured constraints justify it and an independent
reference covers the intended regime. The exact examples here serve as semantic oracles, not
as substitutes for upstream numerical conformance.
   A request must bind the eligible cohort, time zero, subject and dependence identifiers,
available histories, intervention policy, competing events, censoring, horizon and monetary
units. It must additionally bind actual fold membership, learner and dependency versions,
weights, truncation, seeds, variance method and resource limits. Responses preserve requested
and effective methods, row masks, effective weights, convergence status, failed bootstrap counts
and covariance. Unsupported regimes and unavailable engines must return explicit refusals;
an agent must not reinterpret them as lack of causal identification or silently try a different
estimand.
   Qualification begins with a declared finite law containing treatment-confounder feedback,
monitoring, censoring and competing events, with target values computed independently.
Subsequent cases vary support, event subsets, single output shapes, warnings, exhausted caps,
duplicate identities, irregular clocks and clustered shocks. A held-out simulation study should
freeze replications, seeds, acceptance thresholds and failure denominators before running a
locked environment. End-to-end costs include conversion, fitting, bootstrap failures, validation,
cancellation and restart. None has been measured merely by inspecting source.
   Rights and coverage are independent prerequisites. stremr declares GPL version two or
later and compilation through Rcpp; survtmle declares MIT plus a license file containing
year and copyright-holder fields. Those observations do not clear the complete dependency
distribution. Nor do the old selected CRAN mirror dates prove abandonment. The saved
discovery search counted 151 results and returned ten; its unreturned tail and the named
continuous-time lead remain explicit survey follow-ups. Original scholarly texts must be
acquired and inspected before their technical results enter this comparison. The bounded
source comparison is ready for proposal use; exhaustive coverage, native execution, calibrated
uncertainty and bank adoption remain open. (stremr package contributors, 2017; survtmle
package contributors, 2019)


39.37       Sensitivity and uncertainty are diagnostics, not a causal
            certificate
An agent translating a banking request should notice when harmless rephrasing changes its
proposed variables, graph or estimand. Stability nevertheless does not establish that a graph is
correct. A consistently wrong interpretation can survive every sampled paraphrase. Conversely,
a genuinely different instruction should sometimes change the output. A diagnostic must
specify which perturbations preserve the business decision and what error it detects.
   Hiremath and Hiremath propose sensitivity–uncertainty alignment (SUA) as a combined
diagnostic and training objective. Their version-one preprint defines an expected divergence
between output distributions under perturbation, subtracts a multiple of predictive entropy,
862                                                             Causal analysis for a universal bank


and proposes abstention when the score is high. It also claims risk and calibration guarantees
and reports experimental tables. Its diagnostic idea does not make those guarantees or
comparisons established premises for this proposal. (Hiremath and Hiremath, 2026)


39.37.1     What the score measures

Write qx (y) for the model distribution, px (y) for the true label law, and Π(· | x) for a declared
perturbation distribution. The operational quantities are

           S(x) = Ex′ ∼Π(·|x) D(qx ∥qx′ ),   U (x) = H(qx ),   Aλ (x) = S(x) − λU (x).

The supremum S∞ (x) = supx′ ∈∆(x) D(qx ∥qx′ ) is different. Generally S(x) ≤ S∞ (x); full
support does not reverse this direction. The source acknowledges it in Remark 3.3 but later
substitutes the expectation into an upper bound involving the supremum. Its entropy-gap
quantity |H(qx ) − H(px )| also differs from probability calibration and accuracy. (Hiremath
and Hiremath, 2026)
   Let true binary label probabilities be (9/10, 1/10) and model probabilities (1/10, 9/10).
Entropies agree, but the model’s modal prediction has true error 9/10 and total-variation
distance from truth is 4/5. If its probabilities remain unchanged across paraphrases, sensitivity
is zero too. This is an authored mathematical example, not a measured LLM failure. (Causal
banking proposal project, 2026cm)
   Latent interpretation needs equal care. Two equally likely interpretations can determinis-
tically map to the same output label. Interpretation entropy is then log 2 while true label
entropy is zero. The source’s slack η = |H(Y | x) − H(Z | x)| is log 2 and can remove any
positive conclusion. Deterministic mapping alone does not imply zero slack: the output must
also distinguish interpretations. The source’s triangle-inequality bound can remain formally
valid but uninformative. (Hiremath and Hiremath, 2026; Causal banking proposal project,
2026cm)


39.37.2     Counterexamples to the stated risk guarantees

The source initially evaluates risk under the model’s own distribution at its modal prediction.
That differs from true banking error. Even at this level, the claimed entropy subtraction fails.
Take binary labels, zero–one loss, total variation and a constant fair model equal to the true
law. A singleton latent interpretation makes the model exactly equal its interpretation law;
the collapse gap is zero. Choose the allowed concave nondecreasing function ψ(h) = 0, LD = 1
and λ = 1. The assumptions and condition λH ≥ ψ(H) hold, but equation (11) would imply
                   1                                       1
                     = Rrob (x) ≤ R(x) + LD Aλ (x) + κ(x) = − log 2 < 0.
                   2                                       2
This refutes the stated general bound without a rare adversarial input. (Hiremath and
Hiremath, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026cm)
   Equation (10) also fails in its stated class of bounded losses. Set ℓ(y, a) = 1/2 for every
label and action, retain the fair model and true law, and use ψ(h) = (1 − exp(−h))/2. This
function is nondecreasing, concave, zero at zero and never exceeds the constant expected loss.
The global entropy–risk assumption therefore holds. The total-variation Lipschitz assumption
holds with LD = 1, although its minimal constant is zero. Sensitivity and collapse gap are zero,
H = log 2, and λ = 1 satisfies the condition. The claimed upper bound is 1/4, while actual
self-risk is 1/2. This is a counterexample to the general bounded-loss claim, not a proposed
banking loss. (Causal banking proposal project, 2026cm)
39.37. Sensitivity and uncertainty are diagnostics, not a causal certificate                 863


   The proof text reveals the algebraic difficulties. Adding and subtracting ψ(H) does not
permit dropping the positive addend from an upper bound. The condition λH ≥ ψ(H) gives
−λH ≤ −ψ(H), opposite to the direction used to justify a larger right-hand side. Replacing a
supremum by a smaller expectation also tightens an upper bound without justification. Its first
step compares the original distribution’s loss at a different modal action with loss at its own
modal action in the wrong direction for zero–one loss. A valid narrow statement is possible,
but these steps do not prove the entropy improvement. (Hiremath and Hiremath, 2026)
   A second finite example isolates expected versus worst perturbations. At the reference
input the model is a point mass; at one adverse perturbation it is fair. Give that perturbation
probability 1/100 and the reference 99/100, so the two-point law has full support. Expected
total variation is 1/200, whereas its supremum and worst self-risk are 1/2. Small average
sensitivity need not certify worst-case behavior. (Causal banking proposal project, 2026cm)
  Boundedness alone also does not supply the asserted linear constant for any f -divergence.
For a binary comparison near equality, a fixed-action zero–one loss difference is ϵ, but

                      DKL ((1/2, 1/2)∥(1/2 + ϵ, 1/2 − ϵ)) = − 12 log(1 − 4ϵ2 )

is of order ϵ2 . Their ratio diverges. The chosen divergence and its actual modulus belong in
the assumptions. (Causal banking proposal project, 2026cm)


39.37.3     A narrow valid statement and the selection denominator

For finite labels and zero–one self-risk define r(q) = 1 − maxy q(y). Each singleton probability
differs by at most total variation; hence

                                     |r(q) − r(q ′ )| ≤ DTV (q, q ′ ).

Worst self-risk is consequently bounded by r(qx ) + S∞ (x) when sensitivity uses total variation.
Average perturbed self-risk is bounded by r(qx ) + S(x). These are different statements, with
no unproved negative entropy term. Neither equates self-risk with error under px , and neither
identifies an intervention effect. This short derivation is project work. (Causal banking
proposal project, 2026cm)
   Selection introduces another denominator. Proposition 4.8 and Appendix A.5 replace risk
conditional on the accepted set with unconditional risk, requiring that accepted inputs be no
harder on average. A score threshold does not establish that condition. In an exact example,
one tenth of inputs have a stable fair model, score − log 2 and self-risk 1/2. The remainder
have a deterministic reference model, positive perturbation sensitivity and zero baseline self-
risk. Threshold zero accepts only the first group. Coverage is 1/10, conditional self-risk 1/2,
and unconditional baseline self-risk 1/20. The conditional term cannot be replaced by the
unconditional one from the score rule alone. (Hiremath and Hiremath, 2026; Causal banking
proposal project, 2026cm)
  A prospective banking study should freeze task, model, perturbation generator, threshold
and abstention policy, then evaluate accepted answers against independently adjudicated labels.
Threshold selection needs separate data or an explicitly justified simultaneous procedure. Count
accepted and rejected cases, adjudication failures, semantic changes and clarification costs
separately. Dependent labels or labels supplied by the same model require a corresponding
evaluation law, not an unexamined independent-sample interval.
864                                                          Causal analysis for a universal bank


39.37.4     What can be retained from the empirical proposal

The paper reports accuracy, robustness, calibration and selective accuracy for broadly described
QA, NLI and classification tasks. These are source-reported numbers. The inspected text does
not bind them to exact model checkpoints, named dataset releases and splits, sample counts,
seeds or run artifacts. Main and appendix comparisons also need consistent baseline and subset
definitions before adoption. This review neither treats tables as reproduced measurements
nor infers fabrication. Missing empirical identities remain explicit acquisition obligations.
(Hiremath and Hiremath, 2026)
   The source acknowledges perturbation dependence, unobserved latent ambiguity and a
classification focus. Its taxonomy allows meaning-changing inputs with unchanged outputs to
have no SUA signal. For causal work, changing the target from borrowers to applicants, or
default before prepayment to default if prepayment were prevented, can change the estimand.
A semantic reviewer must preserve these distinctions before output stability is meaningful.
(Hiremath and Hiremath, 2026)
   Retain sensitivity and entropy as separate logged diagnostics; a combined score remains
a candidate for held-out comparison. Do not use the inspected generic bounds to certify an
intervention diagram, causal estimate or truth. A matched study can test error detection at
fixed coverage and total cost after fixing perturbation semantics and empirical identities. That
research route is executable; the general certification is rejected as stated.


39.38      Memory benchmarks: distinguish provenance, correct-
           ness and causal meaning
A bank analyst may retract a transaction classification after a later fraud alert, revise a
business definition, or discover that two reports share the same source. An agent should
update conclusions that depend on the changed premise while retaining conclusions supported
independently. Public generated cases can test this behavior before a costly bank prototype.
The benchmark must nevertheless distinguish a correct derivation within its authored world
from truth about a bank and from an identified intervention effect.
   Arya’s RECON preprint provides a relevant case design: 24 long case files, 1,604 questions,
three domains and six tasks involving chains, invalidations, source conflicts, alternative time-
lines, temporal constraints and fact retrieval. A deterministic skeleton establishes provenance
dependencies; LLMs realize its surface narrative under validation constraints. These are
source-described design and performance claims, not executions in this workspace. (Arya,
2026)


39.38.1     An authored dependency graph is a useful but different object

The generator’s edge records that one entry establishes an attribute required by another.
Reachability and invalidation determine answers in that authored world. This can be an
excellent test of evidence custody and revision without being a structural causal model for
an external bank. In particular, changing a timestamp and recomputing reachability is
not automatically an intervention on a data-generating mechanism. The operation and its
counterfactual semantics must be specified. (Arya, 2026)
   A familiar finite distinction can be stated without any learner. Let U be fair binary and
consider two models. In the first, A = U and Y = A; in the second, A = U and Y = U . Both
give observational probability 1/2 to (A, Y ) = (0, 0) and (1, 1). Their intervention contrasts
39.38. Memory benchmarks: distinguish provenance, correctness and causal meaning             865


are respectively one and zero. A record graph can preserve the observed statements in either
world. Perfect retrieval of those records therefore does not identify which intervention contrast
is appropriate. This is an authored example, not a reported RECON defect. (Causal banking
proposal project, 2026cg)
   The source separates structural checks, semantic audits and human review. That separation
is valuable, but a schema check cannot establish that every narrated qualification retains
its intended meaning. A name, identifier and timestamp may all survive while a negation
or exception changes the statement. Human disagreement cannot be assigned exclusively to
reasoning difficulty merely because a structural validator passes. A banking adaptation should
retain the exact skeleton, narration, validation decisions, rejected cases and independently
adjudicated semantic discrepancies. (Arya, 2026)


39.38.2     Scoring changes the apparent comparison

RECON’s main evaluation removes 190 of 1,604 questions after a closed-book rule involving
three solvers, leaving 1,414. That defines a selected test population. A correct closed-book
answer can arise from guessing or task structure; the filter is not direct proof of training
contamination. Selection also uses particular models and abstention behavior. Results should
preserve both population identities and the selection flags before generalization. (Arya, 2026;
Causal banking proposal project, 2026cg)
  For six-option single-answer questions, correct, wrong and abstained answers score 1, −1/5, 0.
Uniform guessing has expected score
                                          1 51
                                           −   = 0,
                                          6 65
but strict accuracy 1/6. Abstention has score and accuracy zero. An agent correct on one
tenth of questions and wrong on the rest has accuracy 1/10 and expected score −2/25, while
an always-abstaining agent has zero for both. The accuracy ranking and score ranking reverse.
This is a designed incentive distinction, not a calculation error. (Causal banking proposal
project, 2026cg)
   The benchmark additionally uses multi-option weighted scores, exact integer matches,
ordering correlation and the average of two binary LLM judgments for free-form responses. A
macro score therefore depends on the fixed task and format mixture, and two cross-family
judges do not create independent truth merely by agreeing. A product comparison should
retain the underlying answers, format scores, strict correctness, abstentions, parser failures
and judge votes. It should price these outcomes using a declared business loss rather than
silently interpreting benchmark points as dollars. (Arya, 2026)


39.38.3     Reported human denominators need reconciliation

The original describes 200 human-validation questions with three annotations per question
and reports majority agreement with gold of 86.3%. For an unweighted binary majority result
over 200 items, percentages move in increments of 100/200 = 0.5 points. No integer success
count rounds to 86.3% at one decimal. A rate of 518/600 does round to that number, but uses
annotation judgments rather than the stated question-majority denominator. It is a possible
explanation to investigate, not a recovered fact. Similar questions apply to several reported
quality percentages. (Arya, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026cg)
  The separate human baseline states 60 questions, ten per task, with final answers determined
by majority vote. An unweighted binary total over 60 cannot round to 63.0% at one decimal;
866                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


ten-item task rates cannot be 78%, 58%, 45% or 37% under strict majority correctness.
These checks do not establish fabricated results. Unreported weights, exclusions, averaging
or annotation-level summaries could explain some values, but they would change the stated
estimand and denominator. Exact item/annotator records, aggregation code and missingness
rules are needed before using the human comparison as quantitative investment evidence.
(Arya, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026cg)
  Human annotators receive question-specific evidence packets, whereas other systems receive
the full narrative, retrieved excerpts or structured records. The paper acknowledges this
asymmetry. The human comparison cannot isolate reasoning ability from evidence selection
and representation. Likewise, the source’s Oracle is an answering LLM given structured truth,
not an algorithm that directly returns the generated answer. Its weaker temporal-fact result
shows why it is not a universal mathematical upper bound on every system. (Arya, 2026)


39.38.4     Retrieval, dependence and full cost

The reported support-recall diagnostic searches for verbatim composite entry headers. The
source records imperfect header uniqueness and excludes two systems whose ingestion para-
phrases away those headers. Header presence does not establish that the full fact, qualification
or independent source reached the answerer; header absence can coexist with a faithful para-
phrase. The observed hit/miss accuracy contrast also conditions on a potentially easier subset.
A paired intervention supplying or withholding matched evidence would be needed to attribute
an accuracy change to retrieval itself. (Arya, 2026)
  The source reports a question-level paired bootstrap. Its appropriateness depends on
whether the target is the fixed question collection or new independent case files. An authored
counterexample has two independent case signs, each repeated in ten question contributions.
The mean over all twenty questions equals (Z1 + Z2 )/2 and has variance 1/2. Treating all
questions as independent gives 1/20, ten times smaller. This does not refute every within-
benchmark summary; it demonstrates why a new-case target needs the case dependence, task
mixture and effective independent units stated. (Causal banking proposal project, 2026cg)
  The reported narrator-family tests have small case counts and include a 13.3-point difference
with a nonsignificant test. Nonrejection does not establish equivalence or rule out a practically
important effect. A prospective adaptation should preregister an equivalence margin or report
uncertainty without promoting a nonsignificant result into absence of bias. (Arya, 2026)
   Finally, prompt/completion tokens per answer are not total workflow cost. Ingestion,
embedding, reranking, query rewriting, indexing, storage, retries, judges and failed runs must
be included. The paper specifies service wait intervals of 30, 60 or 600 seconds for different
routes; elapsed waiting alone is not an observed completion or durable-readiness receipt. The
proposed CLI/MCP worker should bind input and index versions, completion state, retrieval
artifacts and cancellation/restart evidence before declaring a comparison valid. No service has
been exercised by this source review. (Arya, 2026)
  RECON is retained as a public/generated test-design reference for revision, provenance and
compositional reasoning. Its original code, dataset versions, filtered row identities, human
denominators and complete costs remain acquisition and qualification obligations. A future
implementation can compare matched evidence and answerers under a declared loss; it cannot
convert benchmark provenance into bank truth or causal identification by naming the graph
causal. Native performance, bank benefit and general coverage remain open.
39.39. Specialist state, typed interfaces and learned latent collaboration                     867


39.39       Specialist state, typed interfaces and learned latent col-
            laboration
A servicing analyst may ask an assistant to compare repayment policies while a specialist holds
a transition law, uncertainty and diagnostic failures. Returning only a preferred action can
destroy information needed to explain a refusal or change the loss function. Returning every
hidden activation does not establish an identified intervention effect. The question is which
information the decision requires and how its interface preserves it. LLAMIA offers a concrete
hypothesis about specialist–language-model communication. We inspect the latest version
listed before our cutoff, the 46-page v2 of 2 September 2026, while preserving v1. We retain
the architecture as a prospective experiment, with unresolved reporting contracts distinguished
from our own exact examples.(I et al., 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026cz)


39.39.1     Information, representation and a substantive alternative

The paper couples a frozen chess specialist with a language model. A three-layer projector
maps specialist activations to 32 continuous tokens in the language model’s embedding space.
Both principal variants receive verbalized engine outputs; the latent variant additionally
receives projected activations. The first training stage aligns the projector while freezing the
language model; the second jointly trains both with task rewards. Human-move prediction,
puzzle difficulty and interest, move explanation and commentary form the chess suite; Go move
prediction supplies a second setting. These public-data designs expose a specified environment
before expensive bank work. They do not identify intervention effects on repayment or
funding.(I et al., 2026)
  The comparison changes information, representation and a learned interface together. It
does not compare every text interface with every latent interface. Top-move summaries,
complete typed policy/value records and task-specific statistics are different alternatives. The
paper reports probe, template, raw-encoder and shuffled-state controls. Weaknesses of those
implementations cannot prove that sufficient information is inherently inexpressible as text or
that hidden activations suffice for a new bank decision. The paper acknowledges architecture,
specialist-strength and projector-compatibility confounding in one ablation.(I et al., 2026)
  Let H be specialist state, a ∈ A an action, L(a, Y ) a loss, and B = b(H) the interface
object. For finite action sets and integrable losses,
                                                                            
          RH = E min E{L(a, Y ) | H} ,             RB = E min E{L(a, Y ) | B} .            (39.17)
                        a∈A                                     a∈A

Every B-measurable policy is H-measurable, so RH ≤ RB . Equality is available if an optimal
action based on H is measurable with respect to B; a stronger sufficient condition makes every
conditional action loss a function of B. This is an information statement under a stipulated law
and an ideal decision rule, not a learning or causal-validity guarantee. A finite-precision record
can be serialized injectively into text. Existence of that serialization does not establish context
efficiency or learnability. A learned projection can also lose relevant distinctions.(Causal
banking proposal project, 2026cz)
   In an authored example, equally likely states H = −1, +1 have default risks (0.02, 0.04) and
(0.04, 0.02) under actions (0, 1). Loss given default is USD 10,000; the intervention has no
additional cost in this narrow stipulated law. Its advantage over action zero is USD −200
in one state and USD 200 in the other. Full information permits USD 100 expected savings
relative to always choosing zero. A constant summary permits none; a typed one-bit state
identifier permits the same USD 100 as full information. The exact reference enumerates
868                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


this law. It demonstrates one lossy summary and a sufficient textual alternative, without
estimating bank benefit or proving that a hidden vector is necessary.(Causal banking proposal
project, 2026cz)


39.39.2     Reconcile results before using a ranking

The v2 tables disagree. Table 14 gives the 14B latent Wild scores 57, 54, 60, averaging 57,
while headline Table 18 gives 49. Table 15 gives rationale components 44.0, 56.6, averaging
50.3, while Table 18 gives 45.8. Table 17 gives difficulty correlation 0.67, while Table 18 gives
0.71. Layout and raw extraction agree on these entries. Different checkpoints or subsets
might explain them; the inspected original does not supply that mapping. We do not select
a preferred value or silently repair the source. Broad expert-superiority wording also needs
qualification against reported MAIA scores 53 for LLAMIA and 55 for the expert.(I et al.,
2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026cz)
   The data account specifies 100 held-out commentary games and 5,000 puzzles; result captions
instead describe approximately 300 games and 1,000 puzzles. One solved-puzzle entry remains
a placeholder. Exact row identities, runs, exclusions and aggregation rules are needed for each
score and interval. These discrepancies require reconciliation, not an allegation of fabrication.
Ratios of correlations, BLEU scores and judge ratings are not ratios of monetary benefit.(I
et al., 2026)
  The human study illustrates a coherent denominator distinction. Twelve raters evaluate
15 positions, producing 180 crossed judgments. A count of 130 favorable responses yields
130/180 ≃ 72.2% overall and 130/162 ≃ 80.2% after 18 ties are removed. Both can be correct.
A pooled non-tie rate need not equal the average of per-rater rates when ties differ. Neither
denominator creates 180 independent raters. For an authored model Zij = Ui + Vj with
independent mean-zero unit-variance rater and position effects,
                                 1   1  3                           2   1
                     Var(Z) =      +   = ,          Variid (Z) =       = .                (39.18)
                                12 15   20                         180  90
The ratio is 13.5. This does not recalculate the paper’s uncertainty; it shows why new-rater,
new-position and fixed-panel targets need different arguments. Reusing a judge for reward
and evaluation also calls for independent adjudication and reward-overfitting diagnostics.(I
et al., 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026cz)


39.39.3     State refresh, training and cost contracts

Section J.3 refreshes state tokens after board mutations and excludes read-only calls, including
get_policy, from re-encoding. Section J.4.3 says get_policy performs a fresh forward pass
and injects 32 tokens. A consumer cannot infer which rule produced a run. An integration
must bind state and query versions, specialist checkpoint, activation layer and shape, projector
revision, refresh trigger and stale-result policy. Parallel reads need a common snapshot or
tagged versions; sequential writes alone do not bind delayed reads to the correct state.(I et al.,
2026)
   The narrative claims no human-move supervision, while the later training account includes
500,000 positions paired with human moves and a rank reward. No direct supervised fine-tuning
and no human-move information are different claims. Alignment, labels and reinforcement
rewards need separate provenance. Joint projector training also requires a precise old-policy
likelihood: stored rollout features and features recomputed with a changed projector are not
automatically the same conditioning history. Formulas alone do not settle this implementation.
This is a source/code requirement, not an observed failure.(I et al., 2026)
39.40. Agent forgetting as an observable contract                                             869


   Cost neutrality is not established by returned-token counts. Table 2 gives 8B training
costs of 16.8 versus 15.0 GPU-hours: 12% overhead, inconsistent with approximately 6% at
every scale. At 14B, reported calls and return lengths yield 2.9(150) = 435 text tokens versus
1.9(182) = 345.8 latent-plus-text return tokens. These products reproduce narrow return
accounting only. They exclude other prompts, output, repeated attention to history, specialist
computation, projection and training. Continuous embeddings are not automatically executed
or billed like vocabulary tokens. Five million alignment pairs, the multi-GPU configuration
and step counts require elapsed and aggregate GPU-time with explicit inclusion rules.(I et al.,
2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026cz)


39.39.4     A bounded public comparison and integration decision

Freeze public or generated tasks, splits, response laws, specialist/model/projector versions,
loss functions and budgets. Compare top-k prose, complete typed records, a sufficient statis-
tic where available, latent-only access and typed-plus-latent access. Preserve no-specialist,
shuffled/missing-state and stale-result controls; include failures and refusals in the denomina-
tor. Match training resources when attributing interface effects and report cost differences
when matching is impossible. A game demonstration can establish feasibility; a generated
servicing environment tests banking semantics under declared assumptions. Neither supplies
institutional validation.(I et al., 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026cz)
   For CLI/MCP design, the primary deliverable remains a typed auditable result containing
target, units, assumptions, uncertainty and refusal status. A latent extension should reference
immutable artifacts and state identities; a custom model host additionally needs tested
embedding injection and specialist-activation access. A text tool response alone does not
demonstrate that path. The original suppresses refusal and mandates numerical guesses in
task prompts. We reject that rule for bank inference: unidentified effects, unsupported regimes
and stale state require typed refusals. Model, corpus, code and dependency rights also precede
adoption. Retain latent communication as a conditional experiment and complete typed
records as a substantive comparator; defer native integration until reporting and execution
contracts are reconciled. Native performance, bank benefit and general coverage remain open.(I
et al., 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026cz)


39.40      Agent forgetting as an observable contract
A bank that removes an obsolete customer record from an agent’s retrieval store still has to
ask what remains in a cached tool reply, an analyst summary, a prompt, and a fitted model.
These are different information surfaces. A correct answer to an intervention query does
not establish authorized information custody. K-Bench supplies a useful public experimental
design for this distinction. Yu and colleagues observe tool-using agents across parametric,
context, textual retrieval and structured retrieval configurations, measuring disclosure alongside
retained functionality and protocol degeneration. We use the September 14, 2026 v2 original
and the public repository revision available before the October 7 cutoff. Its findings motivate
a prospective evaluation contract; they do not establish that our causal library has acquired a
working unlearning component. (Yu et al., 2026; K-Bench authors, 2026)


What the observer measures. Let q denote a query about a specified entity and field,
vq its target value, and Tc (q) the text emitted on observed channel c. The paper considers
six channels: emitted reasoning or scaffold text, tool arguments, the wider tool observation,
retrieved identifiers, an answer and a separately elicited summary. These observations do not
870                                                             Causal analysis for a universal bank


presume access to an inaccessible internal reasoning state. The summary is a new elicitation,
rather than simply another view of the same ReAct trace. Define the declared matcher d and
observed-channel set Cq explicitly:
                                                                   N
                                                        b = N −1
                                                                   X
                        L(q) = max d(vq , Tc (q)),      R                L(q).               (39.19)
                                 c∈Cq
                                                                   q=1

The fixed observer detects a target present in any single channel. It is not an adaptive sequence
of attacks, a proof of removal from weights, or a universal information-flow guarantee. Its
public matcher canonicalizes text and uses substring containment, with field-specific date and
address variants. Opaque retrieved identifiers are not automatically counted as disclosures
merely because retrieval occurred. The graded metric additionally credits recovered target
tokens and takes the largest channel severity for each query. (Yu et al., 2026; K-Bench authors,
2026)
   Channel denominators require care. The public scorer omits failed summaries from that
channel’s mean and omits an answer only when there is no observed answer evidence. The
aggregate still averages over queries. Thus a conditional answer-channel rate need not be
bounded above by an aggregate with a larger denominator. In an authored four-query example,
two queries carry an answer and one answer discloses the target. The conditional rate is
1/2, while the all-query rate is 1/4 if no other query discloses anything. Apparent numerical
inconsistency must first be examined against these populations. The paper’s discussion of
omitted halted answers and the current raw-answer fallback also make the scorer revision part
of the endpoint. (K-Bench authors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026eu)


A union of detectors is not joint reconstruction. The original explicitly excludes an
attacker who assembles partial values from different channels. A minimal authored text example
has target alpha beta, one channel containing alpha and another containing beta. Complete-
value matching returns zero on both channels; the largest token recall is 1/2; concatenation
recovers the entire stipulated target. The stronger distinction is information-theoretic. Let
S and U be independent fair bits, with Z1 = U and Z2 = S ⊕ U . Enumeration of the four
equally likely states gives

                      H(S | Z1 ) = H(S | Z2 ) = 1,        H(S | Z1 , Z2 ) = 0.               (39.20)

Each isolated channel leaves a full bit of uncertainty; the pair determines S. These are project
derivations, not a reproduction of the benchmark’s matcher or a theorem attributed to its
authors. If a stipulated bank decision must choose the bit correctly and an error costs USD
200, either isolated channel leaves expected loss USD 100, while their combination permits
zero. This is a designed value-of-information illustration, not a measured privacy cost, price or
banking result. An approved reconstruction observer and its allowed side information must
accompany a disclosure claim. (Yu et al., 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026eu)
   Entity coverage is a second dimension. A detector keyed to a request for entity A’s value can
report no leak when the reply instead discloses entity B’s value. If B also belongs to the forget
set, that is a missed forget-set disclosure even though the A-specific endpoint is computed
correctly. The paper acknowledges this limitation and reports that counting other forget
entities changes the retrieval results for its input-corruption reference. A bank evaluation
should report queried-entity, any-authorized-forget-entity, third-party and joint-reconstruction
endpoints separately. The broader endpoints require a declared ground-truth corpus and access
policy. Synthetic linked entities and deliberately split values suffice to test the initial contract.
(Yu et al., 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026eu)
39.40. Agent forgetting as an observable contract                                           871


Reduction, utility and collapse are separate decisions. The binary reduction label,
graded scalar and eligibility gates answer different questions. The paper’s scalar has the form

                     K = (1 − Rf )(1 − |∆r |)+ {1 − max(0, Df − Df,0 )}+ ,              (39.21)

where Rf is graded forget-set severity, ∆r the graded retain-set change, and Df and Df,0
candidate and baseline degeneration. The public CLI separately requires a retain ratio of at
least 0.80, added degeneration at most 0.20, and no candidate split reaching 0.50 absolute
degeneration; the untreated baseline is exempt from the terminal label. A positive scalar
cannot itself establish eligibility. Under the authored values Df,0 = 1/2, Df = 1, zero forget
severity and zero retain shift, the scalar is 1/2 although the terminal gate fails. This makes
the baseline dependence explicit without claiming that an empirical cell has these values. (Yu
et al., 2026; K-Bench authors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026eu)
   Two definition discrepancies remain visible. Equation (3) prints a signed retain difference
below a positive tolerance, whereas the next paragraph requires its absolute value below that
tolerance. A change from 4/5 to 1/5 gives −3/5 < 1/20 but | − 3/5| > 1/20; only the latter
captures the stated retention intent. Separately, page 13 calls a significant reduction below
twofold a measured failure. The inspected public binary classifier returns a reduction label for
such a case. For stipulated baseline 3/5, candidate 2/5 and adjusted p = 1/100, its visible
branch yields a 1.50-fold reduction label, while the printed twofold condition fails. This is a
static-contract finding with an authored input, not execution of downloaded code or proof that
a published empirical row traversed that path. The CLI calls that classifier and also reports
eligibility separately. An adopted evaluator needs one named rule set and explicit migration of
old reports. (Yu et al., 2026; K-Bench authors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026eu)
   Protocol health differs from correct service. The current scorer inspects raw text and the
first answer payload rather than trusting a terminal label alone. An unhealthy trajectory
can still disclose information, so its answer evidence remains relevant. A bare direct reply is
recovered as answer evidence only under specific no-tool/no-thought conditions. Valid answer
formatting does not prove correctness, causal identification, appropriate refusal or customer
benefit. The bank contract needs those outcomes alongside health and disclosure, retaining
failure reasons and permitted trace provenance. (K-Bench authors, 2026)


Experimental units and causal interpretation. The observer tests a declared agent
configuration. It does not identify a customer-intervention effect or establish that storage
location alone caused a cross-configuration difference. The parametric lane uses an injected
adapter or merged target, while nonparametric lanes can use the unmodified base. Protocol
amendments explain this choice through failures of the original adapter-loaded design. That
explanation is valuable feasibility evidence, but model state and storage location then vary
together. A prospective bank study should either cross those factors with viable controls or
describe the contrast as a bundled configuration change. The oracle-gated input-corruption
reference also replaces learned components and retains the secret behind its gate; it is not
evidence of verified weight erasure. (Yu et al., 2026; K-Bench authors, 2026)
   The paper pools paired query outcomes across seeds for exact McNemar tests and separates
forget and retain multiple-testing families. The code samples queries from entity-field records,
pairs baseline and candidate within seed, then adds discordant counts. The public CLI checks
uniqueness and equality of query identifiers within each compared seed and restricts the
baseline to the candidate’s seeds. These are meaningful alignment controls. They do not
establish independent discordant signs when entities, prompts, training data or runs are shared.
The standalone verdict routine pairs intersections of identifiers and deduplicates query IDs
by keeping the last row; that weaker path must not be silently substituted for the CLI’s
872                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


cohort checks. Its topology aggregation averages bootstrap interval endpoints across seeds, an
explicitly approximate construction whose coverage is not proved by the existence of the code.
(Yu et al., 2026; K-Bench authors, 2026)
   For an exact authored dependence witness, take 200 independent fair Bernoulli entity
outcomes and repeat each three times. The mean of 600 rows equals the mean of 200
independent values, so its variance is 1/800, not 1/2400 from treating all rows as independent.
This is not an estimate of K-Bench’s actual variance. It shows what the experiment manifest
must rule out or model. A public prototype should preserve entity, query, seed and run
IDs, distinguish finite-corpus from new-entity targets, and predeclare appropriate uncertainty.
Splitting multiplicity families does not repair an invalid input test; changing gates after
observing results needs a dated amendment and a new evaluation population.(Causal banking
proposal project, 2026eu; K-Bench authors, 2026)


Reuse, provenance and cost. The repository is a useful candidate reference for channel
records, health diagnostics, cohort validation and offline report exchange. Its direct code
license is MIT, whereas the synthetic corpus declares CC BY 4.0 and model and retrieval
assets carry separate terms. Main requirements pin versions but are not the complete original
lock; the compute guide explicitly leaves an OpenUnlearning PEFT version unresolved. The
reproduction guide describes approximately 500 GPU-hours for the whole study and about
18 GPU-hours for selected released targets after preparation, identifying paper-only figures
those targets cannot rebuild. These author estimates cannot become a bank budget without
training, acquisition, storage, inference, failure, review and accepted-output accounting. A
conditional original-Python worker is a prospective evaluation option, with a small typed
transcript boundary for our CLI/MCP. A whole-library port has no demonstrated advantage.
Automatic adoption is withheld pending rule reconciliation, environments, rights review and
registered conformance.(K-Bench authors, 2026)
   Artifact custody is part of that boundary. The inspected local-model fingerprint hashes
configuration bytes and weight filenames and sizes, but not weight contents. Two different
four-byte payloads have the same name and size yet different content hashes, so that fingerprint
cannot establish byte identity. The source separately resolves a hosted repository revision, a
stronger identity than its README’s shorthand main-revision description; API model IDs are
another kind of identifier. Our receipt should bind actual weights or hosted immutable revisions,
tokenizer, prompt, dataset, scorer, dependencies, observation policy and experiment declaration.
A document hash or successful exit cannot stand in for those individual identities.(K-Bench
authors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026eu)
   The ecological-data description remains unresolved. Pages 41–42 describe real names and
birth dates from a converted external dataset, while page 49 says all personally identifiable
information is synthetic. The pinned conversion script calls its input synthetic and the
dataset sheet says the external entities are not redistributed. These support a provenance
question, not a misconduct finding or a license to choose the more convenient account. The
exact external data version, conversion output and source rights are needed before making a
real-data validation claim. Initial bank-facing experiments can use independently generated
synthetic fixtures while preserving that omission. (Yu et al., 2026; K-Bench authors, 2026)
   The first experiment should compare answer filtering, store deletion, cache invalidation and
model-side interventions under the same synthetic entity and access policy. It should include a
corpus-wide observer, split-value reconstruction, retention of authorized tasks, correct refusal,
raw-trace health, fixed-scorer replay and a deliberately changed checkpoint. Public fixtures
make these contracts inspectable before costly bank trials. Success would justify a bounded
claim about declared surfaces and populations; universal forgetting, legal compliance, causal
39.41. ChronoLLM: domain-specific code assistance and the limits of simulation evidence       873


validity and bank adoption remain separate questions.


39.41      ChronoLLM: domain-specific code assistance and the
           limits of simulation evidence
A bank turning a collections question into executable analysis faces two different tasks. It
must express the intended decision, and it must implement that decision in a changing
software environment. Domain-specific code assistance can reduce the second burden without
solving the first. Wang and coauthors study this distinction in an adjacent engineering
setting: ChronoLLM customizes language models to generate PyChrono scripts for mechanical
simulation. The inspected original is the 19 August 2025 arXiv preprint, not the later journal
version identified by the discovery index. It supplies a useful design analogue for causal tools,
rather than evidence that its models identify bank interventions.(Jingquan Wang and Andrew
Negrut and Harry Zhang and Khailanii Slaton and Shu Wang and Radu Serban and Jinlong
Wu and Dan Negrut, 2025)


39.41.1     Version-bound knowledge and expert-curated training

The source describes stale and mixed API knowledge, with examples of renamed vector,
gravity, collision and visualization interfaces. Its proposed training pipeline combines continued
pretraining on domain material with instruction fine-tuning. The instruction collections include
simulation generation, natural-language-to-API mappings, API explanations and reasoning
examples. Expert contributors clean scripts and comments; model-generated descriptions and
transformations supplement that work. The paper also describes filtering, privacy checks,
deduplication and final quality review. These are reported curation procedures, not evidence
that we acquired or independently audited the full training corpus.(Jingquan Wang and Andrew
Negrut and Harry Zhang and Khailanii Slaton and Shu Wang and Radu Serban and Jinlong
Wu and Dan Negrut, 2025)
   For the proposed causal library, this suggests binding every example to an exact package
version, method identifier and input/output contract. A natural-language request for a default-
risk comparison should not silently select an obsolete method, change time zero, collapse
competing events, or replace a requested effect with a prediction. Retrieval and small curated
examples are plausible first prototypes; fine-tuning is a conditional alternative when repeated
version-specific failures justify its preparation and maintenance cost. Porting the whole
simulator or treating its generated code as a causal engine would answer a different question.
  The paper distinguishes in-context learning, which supplies examples without changing model
weights, from supervised fine-tuning and parameter-efficient adaptation. Its broad architecture
and model-selection discussion is not adopted as a universal ranking. Our comparison would
hold the selected backend revision, prompt, package/API version, task family and allowed
repair budget fixed before estimating an improvement. An API spelling correction and a
correction to the scientific target must be separately observable. (Jingquan Wang and Andrew
Negrut and Harry Zhang and Khailanii Slaton and Shu Wang and Radu Serban and Jinlong
Wu and Dan Negrut, 2025)


39.41.2     A score improvement depends on what the score measures

The original distinguishes code similarity, execution tests and a separate LLM judge. Its
Table 7 reports similarity and judge scores under reference code, documentation, or their
874                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


combination. These are different measurements. For the reported GPT-4o-mini profile, the
combined reference/documentation judge score rises from 41.80 to 68.03 after supervised
fine-tuning, a difference of 26.23 score units. The documentation-only score falls from 43.22
to 38.03, a difference of −5.19. For the reported 8B profile, the combined judge score is
39.06 with in-context learning and 38.78 with fine-tuning, a difference of −0.28. Table 8 also
contains lower judge scores for the 70B LoRA profile than for its pretrained comparator. The
exact subtractions reproduce the displayed table entries; they are neither new experiments nor
significance tests.(Jingquan Wang and Andrew Negrut and Harry Zhang and Khailanii Slaton
and Shu Wang and Radu Serban and Jinlong Wu and Dan Negrut, 2025; Causal banking
proposal project, 2026cy)
   Thus the paper’s broad improvement language needs metric-specific reading. Similarity
to reference code does not by itself establish functional or physical correctness. A judge
score is not a probability that the output passes a causal identification contract. The text
discusses pass-at-k and attributes judge-correlation findings to a companion study, but the
inspected Tables 6–8 do not supply a numerical pass-at-k series. The conclusion’s mention of a
Hacked SimBench baseline is not accompanied there by an identified table row or reproducible
comparison definition. These gaps call for the companion original, exact task/split manifests,
scorer revision and run artifacts before borrowing a stronger empirical claim. They do not
justify silently inventing missing results.(Jingquan Wang and Andrew Negrut and Harry Zhang
and Khailanii Slaton and Shu Wang and Radu Serban and Jinlong Wu and Dan Negrut, 2025)
   The two case studies show generated double-pendulum and vehicle scripts. The authors
acknowledge that their tasks may be in distribution relative to training and describe the scripts
as starting points for expert improvement. The double-pendulum discussion distinguishes
API errors from incorrect world construction, axes and units. This is especially relevant to
causal analysis: a script can run while implementing the wrong population, assignment law
or intervention. The source reports example execution, but no acquired script, simulator or
model is executed in this proposal review. (Jingquan Wang and Andrew Negrut and Harry
Zhang and Khailanii Slaton and Shu Wang and Radu Serban and Jinlong Wu and Dan Negrut,
2025)


39.41.3     Executable worlds need not identify the intervention

Consider an authored banking example with binary latent type U , equally likely to be zero
or one, and an observed action A = U . Let Y denote incremental account revenue in dollars.
Two candidate structural worlds are

                         M1 : Y = 10A + 20U,          M2 : Y = 30U.                       (39.22)

Both generate the same observed pairs: (A, Y ) = (0, 0) or (1, 30), each with probability one
half. The observed contrast is therefore USD 30 in either world. Under an intervention that
sets A while preserving the distribution of U , however, the average effect is USD 10 in M1 and
zero in M2 . With a stipulated intervention cost of USD 5, the incremental net value is USD 5
or USD −5. The same observed data support opposite decisions under these two structural
explanations. (Causal banking proposal project, 2026cy)
   Each world can be implemented with perfectly valid code and pass tests of its own algebra.
Execution cannot select which world describes the bank. Conditional treatment overlap
also fails here because action is fixed by type. A useful agent should expose the unresolved
assumption and request appropriate additional information or a justified design. Public or
generated data remain valuable for testing whether the implementation preserves a declared
world and returns the required refusal; they do not turn that world into an empirically verified
39.42. From a general LLM survey to a falsifiable banking assistance proposal                875


bank mechanism. This provides a small exact oracle for the proposed business-question-to-code
workflow without paying for an authentic bank experiment first.


39.41.4     Full costs, repair accounting and conditional reuse

The paper describes a small fine-tuning example taking roughly twenty minutes and costing
roughly USD 3 after the time-consuming data preparation was complete. This is a reported
historical example, not a current API quote, full preparation cost, or measured bank produc-
tivity gain. Its model and task profile must remain attached to the claim.(Jingquan Wang and
Andrew Negrut and Harry Zhang and Khailanii Slaton and Shu Wang and Radu Serban and
Jinlong Wu and Dan Negrut, 2025)
   For an independent stipulated accounting witness, combine an assumed USD 3 API charge
with thirty minutes of expert work at USD 60 per hour. Total cost is USD 33. Suppose
eight requested tasks yield six compilable scripts, four semantically valid simulations and
two causally acceptable outputs. Cost is USD 4.125 per request, USD 5.50 per compilable
script and USD 16.50 per accepted output. These invented inputs show why expert repair,
refusal and failure denominators must be retained; they are not a reconstruction of the paper’s
experiment.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026cy)
   The proposed route is therefore reference use of its version-aware curation and evaluation
ideas, with an independently designed causal test suite. The method owner defines intervention,
units, clocks and admissible refusal; the software owner pins package and interface behavior;
the evaluation owner holds out task families and versions, records all attempts and expert
edits, and compares retrieval, examples and fine-tuning under matched costs. Unlearning
stale APIs and richer tool or multi-agent interaction are future directions in this preprint, not
demonstrated universal remedies. Its supplementary and declaration sections also use different
availability language: models/API access on request, a reported SimBench repository, and
a promised final code/data link. Exact artifacts, rights and reproducibility therefore remain
conditions for adoption.(Jingquan Wang and Andrew Negrut and Harry Zhang and Khailanii
Slaton and Shu Wang and Radu Serban and Jinlong Wu and Dan Negrut, 2025)
   This adjacent study supports a concrete public-prototype design while leaving scientific
identification, native adoption and bank value unestablished.


39.42      From a general LLM survey to a falsifiable banking
           assistance proposal
A bank asking whether a language model can help design a collections intervention needs an
evaluation of a decision process, not merely a fluent answer. The model might translate a
manager’s request, retrieve policy documents, propose variables and arrows, generate analysis
code, and explain a result. Each step can succeed while the final intervention claim remains
unjustified. Kaddour and colleagues’ Challenges and Applications of Large Language Models
supplies a historical organizing framework: design choices, deployed behavior and scientific
evaluation create different limitations. The inspected original is the 72-page 19 July 2023
preprint, which explicitly calls itself an opinionated review of predominantly text models. It
supports that taxonomy and its authors’ assessment, not an exhaustive account of the October
2026 frontier, a causal algorithm, or a reproduction of the many studies it cites.(Jean Kaddour
and Joshua Harris and Maximilian Mozes and Herbie Bradley and Roberta Raileanu and
Robert McHardy, 2023)
  The survey connects prompt sensitivity, hallucination, stale knowledge, brittle evaluation,
876                                                               Causal analysis for a universal bank


missing ablations and reproducibility. Its application discussion distinguishes programming,
reasoning, behavioral simulation and synthetic data. Better code generation does not establish
causal identification; a plausible simulated borrower does not establish a bank population
law. The following construction converts these distinctions into explicit proposal criteria. All
numerical examples are authored exact examples, not observations of an LLM, vendor quotes
or estimates of bank value.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026do)


39.42.1     Translation must preserve the decision and the information clock

Suppose a collections manager asks whether a reminder should be sent before a payment
deadline. A usable translation specifies the eligible accounts, the decision time, the intervention
actually available then, the outcome horizon and the monetary loss function. A variable
called customer engagement must resolve into a measurement, timestamp and missingness
rule. Replies recorded after the reminder cannot silently become pretreatment adjustment
variables. The proposed graph must state which arrows come from dated process evidence,
which reflect scientific assumptions, and which are uncertain alternatives. A well-formed graph
file cannot supply that missing evidence.
   This is a proposed contract for the library, CLI and MCP interfaces. A translation artifact
should bind the request, source snapshots, decision time, variable definitions, candidate graph
and target query. A downstream identification request should name that artifact and return
assumptions and unresolved alternatives with its formula or refusal. The explanation stage
should cite the same artifact identities. A new prompt, retrieved document or graph revision
creates a new candidate, requiring the appropriate checks again. Original model APIs, local
models or a deterministic questionnaire can provide the translation; no language model is
required to be the scientific authority.
   The survey’s prompt discussion reports sensitivity to wording, demonstrations and their
order. Its hallucination discussion distinguishes contradiction of a source from an assertion not
determined by that source. Unsupported, contradicted and supported claims therefore need
different statuses. An unsupported edge may be a reasonable hypothesis, but repeated prompts
cannot promote it into evidence. Underlying method papers require their own inspected
originals before their technical results justify adoption.(Jean Kaddour and Joshua Harris and
Maximilian Mozes and Herbie Bradley and Roberta Raileanu and Robert McHardy, 2023)


39.42.2     Repeated agreement does not remove shared errors

Consider an authored error model for three agents reviewing the same proposed arrow. Let C
denote a shared missing-context event, with P (C) = q = 1/10. Conditional on C, every agent
is wrong. Otherwise, each agent is independently wrong with probability p = 1/10. This is a
declared probability law, not a measured agent ensemble. One agent’s marginal error is

                                                          100
The majority error under the declared law is

                      e3 = q + (1 − q){3p2 (1 − p) + p3 } =        = 0.1252.

The difference is 15309/500000, or 3.0618 percentage points. Majority voting improves on the

ensemble still fails on C, so its error cannot fall below q under this shared-failure rule. (Causal

   For the bank, the shared event could omit the same post-treatment measurement definition
from every retrieved context. More agents do not obtain the omitted timing evidence. The
proposal separates agreement among generators from corroboration by evidence and an
independently specified semantic oracle. An oracle may check a declared clock or known
constructed causal world; it cannot certify an unknown real-world arrow by inspecting strings.
Diverse prompts and providers are candidate controls whose benefit must be measured, not
assumed to imply independence. Human reviewers can share missing context.


39.42.3     Generated people and generated laws answer different questions

The survey reports both favorable and unfavorable results for models used as behavioral
participants, notes contamination and bias, and warns that a generated distribution may not
represent the real distribution. These are survey-level findings. This proposal does not import
an underlying experiment’s percentage or assert that its result generalizes to borrowers. (Jean
Kaddour and Joshua Harris and Maximilian Mozes and Herbie Bradley and Roberta Raileanu
and Robert McHardy, 2023)
   A separate authored example makes the decision consequence explicit. Assume two borrower
types, Z = 0, 1, with incremental gross benefits from a reminder of USD 20 and USD −30,
respectively. Let the reminder cost USD 5 for either type. If the share of type 1 in a target
population is w, its average net benefit is

                      V (w) = (1 − w)(20 − 5) + w(−30 − 5) = 15 − 50w.

A generated population with w = 1/5 implies USD 5 per account, whereas another target
with w = 3/5 implies USD −15. The break-even share is w = 3/10. These populations share
the stipulated type-specific response law; changing only their mixture reverses the decision.
Without information about the target mixture, even perfect evaluation on the generated
population does not identify target value. If only w ∈ [0, 1] is known, the compatible value
interval is [−35, 15] dollars per account.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026do)
   Public records and generated structural worlds remain useful before expensive bank ex-
periments. A public corpus tests retrieval, citation fidelity, variable extraction and version
handling under its own labels and rights. A constructed structural model tests effect formulas,
refusal on unidentified targets and responses to deliberate clock violations against known
answers. An LLM-generated persona explores possible requests and failure cases. These
uses have different oracles. The last supplies neither the true borrower mixture nor truthful
counterfactual outcomes. Begin with these bounded tests and reserve transport, behavioral
fidelity and real monetary value for later evidence.


39.42.4     Ablations must reveal interactions and count failed requests

The survey criticizes missing controlled experiments and discusses one-factor-at-a-time ablations
as an improvement with cost limitations. An authored factorial example shows why a banking
prototype must also consider interactions. Let two binary factors indicate retrieval and a
separately specified semantic check. Stipulate acceptance probabilities of 0.20 with neither,
0.50 with retrieval alone, 0.40 with the check alone and 0.90 with both. Retrieval’s contrast is
878                                                            Causal analysis for a universal bank


0.30 without the check and 0.50 with it; the check’s contrast is 0.20 without retrieval and 0.40
with it. The interaction is

                               0.90 − 0.50 − 0.40 + 0.20 = 0.20.

Adding isolated improvements to the baseline predicts 0.70, missing the stipulated combined
0.90. Isolated comparisons do not identify the combined result without an assumption about
interaction. (Jean Kaddour and Joshua Harris and Maximilian Mozes and Herbie Bradley and
Roberta Raileanu and Robert McHardy, 2023; Causal banking proposal project, 2026do)
  An eligible prototype can compare the four configurations on the same frozen tasks, retain
paired task results and randomize execution order where it matters. Its claim must name
whether it concerns the finite suite or a sampled task population. Caches, persistent agent
memory and adaptive prompt repairs must be isolated or modeled; otherwise earlier runs
change later conditions. Split evaluation by causal task family and relevant document or API
version, not merely random paraphrases of one scenario. Keep test prompts and oracle labels
outside development tuning.
   Now stipulate 100 initiated requests: 20 fail operationally, 20 complete but abstain, and 60
return numbers, of which 36 pass the declared numeric-output audit. Conditional acceptance
is 36/60 = 60%, while accepted numeric delivery per initiated request is 36/100 = 36%. These
answer different questions. A justified abstention can itself be correct on an unidentified task,
so the prototype separately scores refusal correctness and unsafe numeric answers. It must not
call every abstention an error or remove operational failures from the service denominator.
   Stipulate USD 20 for model calls, USD 60 for review and USD 20 for infrastructure. Cost
per completed request is USD 100/80 = 1.25, per numeric result USD 100/60, and per
accepted numeric delivery USD 100/36 = 25/9, approximately USD 2.78. These include all
initiated requests in their numerator and are illustrative allocations, not current prices. Actual
comparisons need the same task policy, acceptance criteria, repair budget, refusal accounting
and cost boundary. (Causal banking proposal project, 2026do)


39.42.5     Versioned assistance is a testable investment option

The survey separates training repeatability from inference through a changing API. It reports
preliminary model-drift claims from other work and suggests open models as a remedy. Those
empirical numbers are not reproduced here. Open weights permit useful control but do not
alone fix data provenance, hardware, precision, sampling or scientific validity. A run record
needs the model or provider revision, prompts, source snapshots, retrieval index, tool schema,
generation settings, oracle version, output and every repair attempt. Where an API does
not expose the needed revision, record that limit. (Jean Kaddour and Joshua Harris and
Maximilian Mozes and Herbie Bradley and Roberta Raileanu and Robert McHardy, 2023)
   Candidate implementations include deterministic templates plus analyst review, retrieval-
assisted generation, external tools, or agents with bounded retries. Fine-tuning adds data,
rights and evaluation obligations; multi-agent review adds dependence and cost obligations.
Begin with the least complex baseline capable of the declared task and admit additional
machinery against measured conditional benefit. A successful prototype supplies a reason
to fund later testing in its declared regime. It does not establish a supported integration,
a complete software survey, a frontier ranking or bank adoption. The survey strengthens
evaluation design while leaving native capability and bank value unestablished.
39.43. Prompt optimization must preserve the question, evidence and authority                    879


39.43       Prompt optimization must preserve the question, evi-
            dence and authority
An analyst can improve a prompt while making a banking answer less defensible. More detailed
instructions may introduce an unstated population assumption; a supplied worked solution
may make a benchmark easier without improving independent problem solving; a tool-using
agent may execute a valid command for an invalid causal question. The relevant product
question is therefore which prompting design improves an explicitly defined service under a
fixed evidence and authority contract. Chen and colleagues’ Unleashing the potential of prompt
engineering for large language models provides a broad taxonomy of instructions, demon-
strations, decomposition, repeated sampling, search, optimization, multimodal prompting,
evaluation and security concerns. (Banghao Chen and Zhaofeng Zhang and Nicolas Langrené
and Shengxin Zhu, 2025)
   The inspected source is the 58-page arXiv revision 6 dated 11 May 2025, the latest revision
listed before the client’s 7 October 2026 cutoff. The initial 23 October 2023 version has 25
pages and a different title; it is not silently substituted for revision 6. The archive also supplies
a journal identity, but the final journal bytes have not been equated with this preprint. We
use the survey as a primary record of its authors’ organization, examples and caveats. Its
references do not themselves qualify the methods, packages or empirical rankings it describes.
No model is run in this review.


39.43.1     Extra context can change the target instead of identifying it

The source’s introductory examples compare a short question with more elaborate prompts
and generated context. In its entrance-width example, later answers consider height, terrain,
weight and access restrictions that were not fixed in the question. Those may be useful
questions to ask, but neither physical possibility nor an expanded list of possibilities defines
a probability law over them. A preferred answer based on presumed prevalence imports an
assumption. The source describes richer answers as more coherent; our narrower conclusion is
that coherence must be evaluated separately from support by the given information. Figure
text was inspected, without fresh visual review. (Banghao Chen and Zhaofeng Zhang and
Nicolas Langrené and Shengxin Zhu, 2025)
   For a banking analogue, let d be the reduction in default probability from an intervention
at a specified horizon, L = 1000 dollars the loss per default and c = 20 dollars the action cost.
Under the stipulated linear loss calculation, net value is V (d) = Ld − c. Suppose the available
information only restricts d ∈ [−0.10, 0.10]. The compatible values are

        V (d) ∈ [−120, 80]   dollars per eligible account,      V (d) > 0 ⇐⇒ d > 0.02.

If an elaborate prompt inserts d = 0.05 as plausible generated knowledge, it returns USD 30.
The arithmetic is correct conditional on that value; the supplied information did not identify
it. The appropriate output retains the range, break-even condition and the need for additional
evidence. A user can explicitly request the five-percentage-point scenario, but a scenario must
be labeled and must not overwrite the identified-set result. (Causal banking proposal project,
2026eh)
   The translation interface should therefore return missing-premise questions alongside its
candidate target and graph. It should distinguish a quoted fact, an analyst-supplied restriction,
an assumed scenario and model-generated context. Retrieval adds a document, not automatic
truth; the document’s population, time and authority still require interpretation. The proposal
prefers a structured questionnaire when that is sufficient. Generated knowledge is suitable for
880                                                                              Causal analysis for a universal bank


proposing hypotheses and sensitivity cases, subject to explicit status, rather than filling causal
evidence gaps invisibly.


39.43.2     A task graph is not a causal graph

The survey discusses chains, trees and graphs of generated intermediate information, and
a decomposed workflow with a controller and subtask handlers. These are descriptions of
computation. An edge from a retrieved statement to a proposed answer records a dependency
of the answer on text; it does not assert that intervening on an economic variable changes
another economic variable. The graph used to schedule computation and the structural
graph used for identification consequently need different types, identifiers and validation rules.
Converting one into the other requires a scientific argument. (Banghao Chen and Zhaofeng
Zhang and Nicolas Langrené and Shengxin Zhu, 2025)
   This distinction guides integration. A deterministic handler can parse a versioned variable
dictionary; an approved estimator can consume a reviewed query; a model can propose an
explanatory draft. Each handler should declare its inputs, outputs, preconditions, failure
statuses and artifact versions. The controller must preserve an unidentified or refused status
instead of translating it into a numerical default. Repeating a subtask must create a traceable
attempt, not erase the earlier refusal. These are proposed CLI/MCP contracts, not a claim
that a native agent framework already enforces them.
  An authored reliability example shows why local component scores do not settle the end-to-
end claim. Let Ei mean that stage i is correct, for five stages, and stipulate P (Ei ) = 19/20 for
every stage. If their correctness events are independent, complete correctness has probability
                             5
                                        !                5
                                                    19            2476099
                             \                  
                         P         Ei       =                 =           ≃ 0.773781.
                             i=1
                                                    20            3200000

With only those marginal probabilities known, the union bound and event containment instead
give
                                                          5
                                                  !
                                                          \
                                        0.75 ≤ P                  Ei   ≤ 0.95.

Disjoint five-percent failure events attain the lower bound; identical failure events attain the
upper bound. Independence is additional information, not a default consequence of modular
code. These are unconditional event assumptions under a declared task law, not measurements
of a five-stage application. (Causal banking proposal project, 2026eh)
   For sequential evaluation, later stages may receive wrong earlier outputs or may never run
after a refusal. Report both attempted-stage denominators and complete-task outcomes under
the real controller policy. In particular, testing each handler only on correct supplied inputs
establishes a different property from testing the composed workflow on manager requests.


39.43.3     Prompt selection is learning and needs held-out evaluation

The survey covers selecting uncertain questions for annotation and optimizing prompts using
feedback, search and learned rewriting. It also reports that different tasks, models and metrics
limit comparisons, and that automated prompting can fail to improve on simple baselines.
These are source-level observations, not reproduced rankings. An optimized prompt is fitted
to information: developer trials and expert edits are part of training even when model weights
stay fixed.(Banghao Chen and Zhaofeng Zhang and Nicolas Langrené and Shengxin Zhu, 2025)
39.43. Prompt optimization must preserve the question, evidence and authority               881


  Consider a constructed null example with K = 20 candidate prompts and n = 4 develop-

independent across prompts and tasks. For prompt j, let Sj be its development successes.
Then Sj ∼ Binomial(4, 1/2). Selecting the largest score gives

                           P {max Sj = 4} = 1 − (15/16)20 ≃ 0.724941.

Nevertheless, a fresh test independent of selection still has expected accuracy 1/2 for the
