probabilities depend on the declared independence law; they are not universal estimates of
prompt overfitting. (Causal banking proposal project, 2026eh)
  The banking protocol should therefore reserve unseen tasks or task families, record the
complete search and repair budget, and separate development examples from scoring evidence.
Frozen model and retrieval versions make a comparison interpretable but do not themselves
guarantee generalization. Where tasks share a template, customer history or policy source,
that clustering affects the unit of evaluation. Repeated paraphrases of one causal problem
must not be counted as independent scientific problems without justification.
   The survey’s discussion of supplied solution chains is particularly relevant: it acknowledges
that supplying ground-truth intermediate solutions limits what a high solve rate demonstrates.
Our evaluation should label an oracle-assisted condition separately from unaided translation
or identification. Likewise, zero-shot describes the declared examples in a prompt, not verified
absence of the problem from a model’s pretraining data. Neither a polished explanation nor
agreement among human judges independently establishes causal correctness. (Banghao Chen
and Zhaofeng Zhang and Nicolas Langrené and Shengxin Zhu, 2025)


39.43.4     Prompt text cannot grant tool authority

The survey includes adversarial inputs, poisoned data, backdoors, prompt injection and leakage.
Some of its language is stronger than a bounded experiment can warrant. This proposal retains
the threat categories without adopting a claim that prompt design ensures secure deployment.
Full source inspection of an attack or defense, its version and threat model would precede
implementation. (Banghao Chen and Zhaofeng Zhang and Nicolas Langrené and Shengxin
Zhu, 2025)
   A proposed tool gate separates three logical conditions: T , a trusted request authorizes
the action; A, the action is allowed by the relevant policy; and H, the request’s artifact
identities match those reviewed. Define admission as T ∧ A ∧ H. Enumerating the eight
Boolean configurations admits one and rejects seven. This exact truth table demonstrates only
the declared predicate. It does not prove authentication, policy completeness, correct hash
binding, parser safety or atomic execution in a real system. (Causal banking proposal project,
2026eh)
   For example, retrieved text may recommend replacing a reviewed causal graph. That text
is evidence to inspect, not an authorized request to overwrite it. A proposed MCP tool should
return a candidate revision with source provenance; an effect-producing action needs the
separate trusted request and relevant policy checks. The same distinction applies to CLI
882                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


flags and shell commands. Read-only retrieval, query construction and execution should have
explicit operation types, with the relevant authority verified at each external action. Textual
role instructions are useful guidance but are not the authority record.


39.43.5     Conditional adoption and complete economic comparisons

The choices are not simply an advanced prompt or no assistance. The proposal compares a
deterministic form, an expert-written template, retrieved examples, bounded decomposition
and adaptive optimization on the same declared tasks. Use a simple template when it meets
the target; add retrieval when source coverage and provenance justify it; use original, qualified
framework interfaces when reusable orchestration earns its cost. A whole-framework port or
compulsory agent layer needs a demonstrated requirement. The survey supplies discovery
leads for these alternatives, not software rights or functioning integrations.
   In one authored cost allocation, ten attempted tasks cost USD 4 in model calls, USD 2
in retrieval and USD 24 in review. If three produce accepted outputs, cost is USD 3 per
attempt but USD 10 per accepted output. Actual pricing, latency, maintenance, failures and
correct-refusal value remain to be measured. A cheap request is not automatically a cheap
decision. Public documents and constructed causal worlds permit this prototype comparison
before authentic bank experiments, while source rights, representation and transfer limits
remain explicit.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026eh)
   The resulting adoption rule is conditional: keep a prompt or agent design only when its
declared target, evidence handling, complete-task behavior and cost justify it against the
simpler alternative. This source broadens the taxonomy and sharpens test requirements; it
leaves native integration, complete frontier coverage and bank acceptance unestablished.


39.44      From scientific assistance to a testable banking research
           loop
An automated research loop needs a scientific question that survives every transformation.
A servicing analyst may ask whether an earlier contact changes ten-day cash receipts, while
a text assistant extracts an eventual repayment flag and an optimizer maximizes that flag.
Each component can operate correctly while the composition answers a different question.
This is the practical value of examining the whole scientific cycle, rather than treating a
better hypothesis generator as a complete causal system. Zhang and colleagues organize their
perspective around observation, hypothesis, experimentation and automation, with human
scientific goals and evaluation as essential constraints. We use their May 2025 preprint as a
primary source for that argument and its caveats. Its descriptions of other systems are leads
to their originals, not independent qualification of those systems.(Zhang, Yanbo and Khan,
Sumeer A. and Mahmud, Adnan and Yang, Huck and Lavin, Alexander and Levin, Michael
and Frey, Jeremy and Dunnmon, Jared and Evans, James and Bundy, Alan and Dzeroski,
Saso and Tegner, Jesper and Zenil, Hector, 2025)
   The source is the 45-page version of Advancing the Scientific Method with Large Language
Models: From Hypothesis to Discovery, arXiv 2505.16477v1, dated 22 May 2025. A later
journal record has a different title and the same thirteen authors. The journal full text was not
available in this inspection; neither exact equivalence nor journal-specific claims are assumed.
This distinction matters because a review may change its qualifications or examples between
versions. The preprint’s account supports a design vocabulary and criticism, not an empirical
estimate of bank productivity or a theorem that autonomous discovery will succeed.
39.44. From scientific assistance to a testable banking research loop                           883


39.44.1     Observation is part of the estimand

The perspective treats observation as a reduction of complex information, including annotation,
classification and extraction. It also acknowledges information loss when domain data are
converted into a representation accepted by a model. In banking the representation is
consequential: a loss of timing, cohort membership or assignment information can make an
otherwise answerable intervention question unanswerable. Let H denote the original account
history and let Z = g(H) be the assistant’s extracted representation. For a target q(H), a
deterministic reconstruction from Z exists on the declared history class only if q is constant
on every fibre of g. Indeed, if g(h1 ) = g(h2 ) but q(h1 ) ̸= q(h2 ), any proposed function f
would have to give two values to f (g(h1 )). Conversely, constancy allows f (z) to be defined
by the common target value on its fibre. This elementary statement concerns information
preservation, not stochastic causal identification.
   Consider two stipulated histories of a USD 10,000 obligation: full repayment on day 5 and
full repayment on day 25. The extraction of eventual repayment is one in both histories, while
the ten-day cash target is USD 10,000 in the first and zero in the second. An accurate eventual-
repayment classifier therefore does not resolve the liquidity target. Keeping raw histories, event
times, availability times and extraction provenance is a substantive alternative to committing
early to a convenient label. It costs more storage and review effort, but allows later questions
to be assessed for information sufficiency. Neither retained detail nor a high extraction score
alone establishes truthful assignment or absence of unmeasured confounding.(Causal banking
proposal project, 2026em)
   A business-to-causal translation should consequently produce a structured question: popu-
lation, intervention and comparator, outcome, horizon, unit, information available at decision
time, and loss function. A generated diagram then proposes mechanisms consistent with
those definitions. Its edges need separate provenance: a substantive restriction, a temporal
impossibility, an inspected empirical result, or an unresolved hypothesis. Textual plausibility
cannot decide between observationally equivalent mechanisms. Where the question changes
after seeing results, that change belongs in a new target and evaluation record, rather than
silently changing the meaning of the original request.


39.44.2     Hypothesis generation and verification have different jobs

The source explicitly discusses a possible creative role for speculative generation, while requiring
reliability in experimental work. This is useful only when an unsupported suggestion remains
visibly hypothetical. A proposed edge from contact to repayment delay is a candidate for
comparison with alternatives, not a fact to insert into every downstream adjustment set.
Competing stories may include selection by latent repayment capacity, contact triggered by
early warning signals, and a genuine contact effect. Their distinguishing implications must be
derived before choosing an observation or intervention that could separate them. Retrieval
can improve access to documented premises; it cannot turn a similar population, treatment or
observation clock into the same one.
  The perspective’s discussion of formal verification contains an especially important qualifi-
cation: translating a generated hypothesis into a formal language can itself introduce error.
For example, the goal of cost strictly below USD 100 is c < 100. An assistant translating it as
c ≤ 100 may produce a perfectly verified solution at c = 100 that violates the original goal. A
proof checker is entitled to accept the weaker formal specification. The missing obligation is
correspondence between business intent and formal premises. Our exact boundary witness does
not test a proof assistant; it explains why a verified artifact must bind the agreed question,
units, inequalities, domain and assumptions as well as the solver output. (Zhang, Yanbo and
884                                                            Causal analysis for a universal bank


Khan, Sumeer A. and Mahmud, Adnan and Yang, Huck and Lavin, Alexander and Levin,
Michael and Frey, Jeremy and Dunnmon, Jared and Evans, James and Bundy, Alan and
Dzeroski, Saso and Tegner, Jesper and Zenil, Hector, 2025; Causal banking proposal project,
2026em)
   There are therefore several distinct checks. A parser can establish syntactic validity; a
type checker can reject a unit or shape mismatch; an exact small oracle can test a proposed
algorithm on a declared family; a proof can establish a theorem under explicit premises; and
an experiment can challenge those premises in a stated population. Failure at any layer is
informative, and passing one layer does not eliminate the others. Generated executable code
can falsify a claim on a witness without proving it for all permitted inputs. A successful formal
derivation also does not make a bank’s observational assignment mechanism exogenous.


39.44.3     Repeated agreement is not calibrated scientific confidence

The preprint surveys repetition, self-correction, debate and external feedback, but also reports
limitations of reasoning, planning and self-explanation. It calls for system-level trust assessment
that includes tasks, tools, workflows and feedback. Its proposed analogy with statistical
confidence is a research direction; it does not supply a generally valid confidence interval
for a causal answer produced by an arbitrary agent. We should retain that question rather
than converting it into a claimed product feature.(Zhang, Yanbo and Khan, Sumeer A. and
Mahmud, Adnan and Yang, Huck and Lavin, Alexander and Levin, Michael and Frey, Jeremy
and Dunnmon, Jared and Evans, James and Bundy, Alan and Dzeroski, Saso and Tegner,
Jesper and Zenil, Hector, 2025)
  An exact calculation illustrates the issue. Suppose five judges each have error probability
p = 0.1 on a stipulated request law. Under independent errors the majority-error probability is
                           5
                                  !
                           X     5 k               107
                                   p (1 − p)5−k =       = 0.00856.
                           k=3
                                 k                12500

If every judge instead shares the same Bernoulli error, each still has marginal error 0.1, but
majority error remains 0.1. The shared failure could arise from the same incorrect source, an
identical omitted confounder or a common mistranslation. The example does not estimate any
real model’s accuracy, nor does it establish a universal worst case over all dependence structures.
It shows that marginal performance and the number of agreeing judges do not determine the
error of their composition. A new model name or a different prompt is insufficient evidence of
independence.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026em)
   The bank-facing output should distinguish process completion, answer acceptance, correct
refusal, and unresolved cases. A confidence statement additionally needs a defined event,
population and task distribution, a sampling design, and a justified construction evaluated
on tasks not used for search or repair. An independent causal oracle for generated models
is one useful early tool. It can check whether an agent preserves ambiguity or refuses
an unidentified request, instead of rewarding a fluent numerical answer. Evaluation on
public observations without intervention truth supports more limited checks of provenance,
reproducibility and assumptions. A model’s own explanation can guide debugging, but the
perspective’s concerns about self-explanation prevent treating it as a faithful account of the
model’s internal mechanism.
39.44. From scientific assistance to a testable banking research loop                          885


39.44.4     What public evidence can establish before bank experiments

The product proposal should earn the expense of bank experiments through a staged public
and generated evidence portfolio. Generated structural models can supply known intervention
answers, nonidentification pairs, deliberate clock errors and controlled measurement loss.
Public empirical data can exercise extraction, missingness, computation and reproducibility
on realistic structures, with the available causal truth stated separately. Open scientific tasks
can test planning and tool use, but their endpoints and safety constraints need not match
banking. This division lets inexpensive evidence test a concrete architectural proposition
without claiming that public data contain unavailable bank truth.
  Transport remains a separate proposition. In a stipulated public environment, contact
and waiting yield net values USD 8 and USD 3 per account. A system can select contact
perfectly. In a second, explicitly different bank environment, their values are USD −4 and
USD 3. Applying the public choice incurs USD 7 regret relative to waiting. These are
constructed utilities, not estimates. The example isolates the need for a transport argument:
good evaluation inside one world does not establish which world the bank inhabits. Shared
mechanisms, covariates and measurement definitions may support a restricted bridge, but
those restrictions require evidence.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026em)
   For a first prototype, compare a fixed human-authored workflow, a retrieval-assisted assistant,
and a bounded planning assistant on the same frozen tasks and evidence. The comparison
should fix the allowed tools, retry budget, development/evaluation split, answer and refusal
rules, and costs before the final run. Include failures to recover a paper, incorrectly interpreted
clocks, ambiguous diagrams, unsupported identification, malformed tool responses and stale
results. A workflow that correctly refuses an unanswerable request has a different achievement
from one that returns an accurate identified effect; both should be reported explicitly. This
is a proposed protocol, not an executed experiment or a claim of independent acceptance.
The number and mix of trials should follow the declared precision and decision requirements,
rather than an arbitrary success threshold.


39.44.5     An auditable loop through the CLI and MCP

The scientific loop motivates a concrete proposed interface. A question artifact should bind
the target, source identities and information clock. A diagram artifact should carry alternative
graphs and the provenance of constraints. An identification request should return an estimand,
an identified set, or a reasoned refusal. An experiment proposal should bind the competing
hypotheses and distinguishing observations; an evaluation result should bind the exact task,
methods and outputs. CLI commands and MCP tools can expose these same typed artifacts,
so that a planner’s change of wording cannot silently change the scientific target.
   Acquisition, extraction, proof or numerical checking, and any execution have different
permissions and evidence duties. The proposal should keep hypothesis content separate from
permission to act. Before a tool invocation the host needs to validate the requested operation,
artifact identity and allowed context; afterwards it needs to preserve the actual result and
failure state. Retries must retain earlier errors and cost, and resumed sessions must bind
the same frozen request. A local exact reference, an external package worker, and a human-
reviewed result are different execution modes. These contracts describe required behavior; this
source review has not implemented or qualified them.
   Directly adopting a perspective as executable infrastructure is inappropriate: it supplies an
organizing argument, not a tested interface or algorithm. A useful adoption is its separation
of observation, hypothesis and experiment, accompanied by the stricter causal and evidential
886                                                          Causal analysis for a universal bank


contracts developed here. Porting an agent framework is not justified by its appearance
in the survey. The relevant package, version, licensing, dependencies, termination and data
boundaries need their own primary review. A small explicit state machine remains a substantive
alternative to a general planner when the workflow is known; a planner may offer flexibility
when the next useful observation is genuinely unresolved. That flexibility must be evaluated
against its additional error, cost and review burden.
   Finally, assume a fully counted exploratory workflow costs USD 240 for 40 attempts, of
which 30 complete their tools and eight deliver accepted scientific answers. Its costs are USD
6 per attempt, USD 8 per tool completion and USD 30 per accepted answer. Six correct
refusals are reported separately; they are not silently added to the answer denominator.
All amounts and counts are stipulated. Recording failed hypotheses and unsuccessful tool
calls, consistent with the perspective’s case for learning from negative results, is necessary
to estimate eventual economics honestly. The contribution here is a testable proposal with
explicit information, translation, dependence and transport limits; native performance, general
algorithmic confidence and bank value remain unestablished. (Zhang, Yanbo and Khan, Sumeer
A. and Mahmud, Adnan and Yang, Huck and Lavin, Alexander and Levin, Michael and Frey,
Jeremy and Dunnmon, Jared and Evans, James and Bundy, Alan and Dzeroski, Saso and
Tegner, Jesper and Zenil, Hector, 2025; Causal banking proposal project, 2026em)


39.45      From language-model knowledge to valid causal observa-
           tions
A bank asking a language model to interpret a complaint is performing measurement before
it performs causal inference. The model might classify financial distress, extract a promised
payment date or propose an explanation for a servicing outcome. Each output has a different
relation to the scientific question. A useful proposal must specify the measured construct, its
time of availability, its error mechanism and the permitted role of the model in subsequent
identification. The computational-social-science study by Ziems and colleagues and the
knowledge-mechanism survey by Wang and colleagues clarify these boundaries. They support
a disciplined assistance workflow while leaving causal validity and operational qualification
to separate evidence.(Ziems et al., 2024; Wang et al., 2024; Causal banking proposal project,
2026da)


39.45.1    What the computational-social-science evaluation establishes

The inspected Ziems text is the genuine 54-page author-uploaded version dated February 2024,
carrying Computational Linguistics volume and publication information. Its evaluation covers
13 historical language models and 25 English benchmarks, including utterance, conversation and
document classification and generation tasks. Test construction uses class-stratified samples
of at most 500 items per task; without an original designated test split, the sample comes
from the available dataset. Classification uses macro F1 averaged over five prompt variants.
Supervised baselines receive task-specific tuning and multiple random seeds. This is a practical
utility comparison rather than a controlled isolation of one modeling ingredient.(Ziems et al.,
2024)
  The paper reports stronger fine-tuned baselines overall for classification, alongside useful
agreement with human labels for some zero-shot tasks. Its error analysis is consequential:
mistakes can coincide across models, performance varies across classes, and few-shot examples
do not improve every task consistently. Generation quality uses different human scoring and
ranking designs. Some assessments use recruited domain experts; the ranking procedure uses
39.45. From language-model knowledge to valid causal observations                                887


blinded author judgments and unanimity. These procedures measure declared judgments, not
interchangeable forms of truth. Favorable explanation ratings do not establish a correct causal
explanation.(Ziems et al., 2024)
   The tasks are not exhaustive, cultural and linguistic coverage is bounded, systematic demo-
graphic performance analysis was not feasible, and training-data overlap remains unresolved.
The paper explicitly separates predictive characterization of text from causal explanations.
Its historical model sizes, architectural descriptions and prices are not current specifications
or independently verified facts in this proposal. We rely on inspected experimental designs,
reported task-specific findings and limitations, without reproducing its model runs or claiming
contemporary superiority.(Ziems et al., 2024)


39.45.2     Translate the business question into a measurement contract

Consider whether a revised servicing message reduces subsequent financial distress. Before
proposing a diagram, define the unit, intervention, horizon, distress construct, observation
source and monetary decision. A complaint-based label is one observation of distress. The
message may change whether a customer complains, how the complaint is phrased or how staff
record it. The diagram should distinguish the underlying outcome Y , treatment A, observed
text T , generated label Ye and the indicator for availability of text. Omitting these nodes
can turn a measurement procedure into an unsupported causal assumption.(Causal banking
proposal project, 2026da)
   A model can propose operational definitions, alternative readings, timestamps and passages
supporting candidate variables. The scientific owner then determines whether those readings
preserve the estimand and whether an edge represents a temporal fact, substantive assumption,
statistical hypothesis or unresolved possibility. Retain graph alternatives when evidence cannot
resolve them. A fluent explanation or majority vote over paraphrases is insufficient to promote
an edge to an identified causal relation.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026da)
  An authored binary example shows why aggregate accuracy is inadequate. Let true distress
prevalence be p1 = p0 = 0.20. Define arm-specific sensitivity sa = P (Ye = 1 | Y = 1, A = a)
and specificity ca = P (Ye = 0 | Y = 0, A = a). Observed label prevalence is

                                   qa = sa pa + (1 − ca )(1 − pa ).

With (s1 , c1 ) = (0.90, 0.90) and (s0 , c0 ) = (0.70, 0.95), both arms have 90 percent accuracy, but
q1 = 0.26 and q0 = 0.18. The labels imply an eight-point contrast when the true prevalence
contrast is zero. A stipulated 1,000 USD loss per distress event converts this to an 80 USD
distortion per customer in the corresponding loss contrast. This is a possible measurement
failure, not an observed model or bank result.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026da)
  If target-population sensitivity and specificity are known and sa + ca ̸= 1, inversion gives
                                                qa + ca − 1
                                         pa =               .
                                                sa + ca − 1
This is a conditional route. An audit must identify the error rates, preserve label-inclusion
weights and uncertainty, and address shifts across treatment, language, time and customer
groups. Near a zero denominator, prevalence is weakly informed; at zero, this equation does
not identify it. Interpreting the repaired prevalence contrast as a treatment effect still requires
assignment and observation assumptions.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026da)

39.45.3     Prompt variation, refusal and dependent evaluation

The Ziems study averages prompt perturbations to examine performance variation. In the
proposed workflow, repeated prompts remain related measurements unless a justified law
establishes independence. If five scalar errors have variance one and pairwise correlation ρ,
then
                                                  1 + 4ρ
                                        Var(E) =         .
                                                     5
At stipulated correlation 0.80, the variance is 0.84 rather than 0.20 under independence. The
equivalent independent count for this variance comparison is 5/(1 + 4ρ) = 25/21, about 1.19.
This exact covariance illustration is not an estimated correlation for the paper’s models.(Ziems
et al., 2024; Causal banking proposal project, 2026da)
  Refusal changes the experiment. Historical constrained-output prompts facilitate fixed-
taxonomy scoring, but a causal product should abstain on underidentified, contradictory or
unauthorized questions. Predeclare when refusal is correct and report answer quality and
availability separately. In an authored fixture with 100 requests, 90 answers and 81 correct
answers, answered-only accuracy and coverage are each 90 percent, while correct answers per
request are 81 percent. Refusals need a reason and correctness disposition; neither dropping
them nor automatically treating them as successful analysis is defensible.(Ziems et al., 2024;
Causal banking proposal project, 2026da)
   Hold out identities and time periods when repeated text or policy regimes could leak across
development and evaluation. Separate prompt/model selection, taxonomy revision and final
assessment. Label disagreement may indicate model error, construct ambiguity or deficient
reference labels. Human adjudication has a cost and an inclusion mechanism; selectively
checking only conspicuous mistakes does not identify a population error rate.(Causal banking
proposal project, 2026da)


39.45.4     Knowledge mechanisms and the target of an intervention

The inspected Wang survey is a genuine 39-page December 2024 author version. Published-
work identity is corroborated by title and author sequence, without asserting publisher-byte
equivalence. It organizes knowledge utilization into memorization, comprehension/application
and creation, and considers individual and group evolution. Observation methods include
probes, logit-based inspection and sparse representations; intervention methods include clean,
corrupted and restored runs to locate components involved in an output. These study the
computational system, not automatically the external world described by its text.(Wang et al.,
2024)
  Let Fθ (x) be a model’s answer to prompt x, with internal activation H. Intervening on H
asks how a computational change affects the answer. A bank’s target instead concerns outcome
Y under business action A. Connecting the two requires evidence about representation,
measurement and the external generating process. Activation restoration alone supplies no
such bridge.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026da)
  For a finite counterexample, let U be Bernoulli with probability one half and X = U . In
world one, Y = X; in world two, Y = U . Both yield observed pairs (0, 0) and (1, 1) with
equal probability. Yet the average effect of setting X from zero to one is one in the first
world and zero in the second. A model given the shared observations can produce identical
answers and internal patterns in both worlds. Stipulated clean, corrupted and restored answer
probabilities 0.90, 0.20, 0.80 give restoration score (0.80 − 0.20)/(0.90 − 0.20) = 6/7 in either
world. Restoring an answer has not selected the external causal law.(Causal banking proposal
project, 2026da)
39.45. From language-model knowledge to valid causal observations                            889


   The survey cautions that mechanistic findings depend on method, metric and implementation.
Its accounts of particular tools and datasets are discovery leads here; their original technical
texts and source code require separate inspection before implementation claims. Mechanistic
analysis may diagnose an explanation pipeline or evidence sensitivity while graph-equivalence,
omitted-variable and intervention-design obligations remain.(Wang et al., 2024; Causal banking
proposal project, 2026da)


39.45.5    Retrieval, memory conflict and agent agreement

The survey distinguishes conflict inside parametric memory from conflict between supplied
context and stored knowledge, and discusses agent knowledge sharing and conformity. These
categories help design tests. Its explanations of fragility and future inaccessible knowledge
remain hypotheses, not general theorems. Limitations include unresolved hypotheses, omitted
time/event domains, incomplete technical coverage and uncertain generalization across model
scales. A survey taxonomy must not become a product guarantee.(Wang et al., 2024)
   Each retrieved banking statement should carry source identity, effective date, institutional
scope and supported claim. A new policy document may not apply to a historical causal
study. The application must resolve scope and time before accepting a proposed supersession.
Conflicting sources should yield a documented alternative, acquisition request or refusal.
Several agents repeating one source do not provide independent corroboration, and editing
model memory does not establish truth.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026da)
   A public experiment can test correct evidence with misleading prompts, stale evidence with
plausible answers, conflicting documents, missing dates, unsupported edges, duplicate sources
and deliberately unidentifiable graphs. These cases have explicit semantic oracles before a
bank purchases costly domain labels. Success establishes the tested contract, with transport
to bank populations still requiring justification.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026da)


39.45.6    Executable proposal boundaries and complete cost

The proposed CLI/MCP workflow separates question interpretation, retrieval, measurement,
diagram proposals, identification and estimation. Each stage consumes immutable named arti-
facts and returns assumptions, alternatives, provenance and unresolved questions. A diagram
needs definitions and clocks; identification needs the graph class and allowed assumptions;
measurement needs the calibration population and abstention rule. The estimator should refuse
a missing identification contract rather than infer one from prose. This is a proposed interface,
not a deployed multi-repository integration.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026da)
   Known next steps are to select versioned models and public tasks, inspect the methods/-
packages actually used, freeze semantics, measure selection/dependence/refusal and compare
complete held-out workflows. Mechanistic analysis can supplement these diagnostics when
supported. Hidden assignment, unrestricted confounding, unjustified transport and absent
institutional truth remain information gaps that more prompts alone cannot close. Authentic
owners and later bank evidence follow a useful prototype.(Causal banking proposal project,
2026da)
   For the 100-request fixture, stipulate 240 USD total cost across model use, retrieval,
adjudication and engineering. Cost is 2.40 USD per request, 8/3 USD per answer and 80/27
USD per correct artifact. These are explanatory denominators, not prices or measured returns.
Compare them with decision loss, uncertainty and correct refusal while distinguishing historical
findings, authored derivations and future implementation evidence.(Causal banking proposal
project, 2026da)

39.46      Causal affordances and executable tests for an agent-
           assisted library
A proposed causal assistant must select useful analytical actions and expose mistakes in the
software that carries them out. These are related but distinct responsibilities. Reasoning about
which familiar object can serve an unfamiliar purpose offers a controlled test of functional
selection; generating programs that expose computational inconsistencies offers a test of
software behavior. Neither alone establishes a banking intervention effect. The affordance
study by Gjerde, Cheung and Lagnado and the TitanFuzz study by Deng and colleagues
motivate a joint design in which agents propose actions and test inputs while explicit scientific
and computational contracts determine what counts as success.(Gjerde et al., 2025; Deng et al.,
2023; Causal banking proposal project, 2026cr)


39.46.1     What an affordance benchmark measures

The inspected affordance text is the 21-page February 2025 author preprint. It studies 20
tasks in which an ordinary tool is unavailable and the respondent selects a substitute. The
four-choice design includes objects associated with the ordinary tool but unsuitable for the task,
a less associated suitable object and a distractor. Experiment one recruits 100 UK participants
and compares their responses with historical model configurations under different prompts
and temperatures. The paper explicitly acknowledges that repeated stochastic model runs are
not independent human participants, although run-level averages are used as comparable data
points.(Gjerde et al., 2025)
   This is a useful challenge to association-based selection: the familiar object can be the wrong
answer. It does not identify an external intervention effect from observational data. Task
authors have specified the intended function and scored the offered alternatives; a bank still
needs evidence about legal eligibility, timing, collateral, assignment and outcome mechanisms
before translating a plausible suggestion into an action. The study’s qualitative examples
illuminate response patterns, but they were selected for notable differences and are not a
separate representative sample of reasoning failures.(Gjerde et al., 2025; Causal banking
proposal project, 2026cr)
   Experiment two retains 296 of 300 recruited UK participants and introduces nine-option
distractor and image conditions. Its ordinary prompt permits longer answers than the
first experiment’s restricted prompt. The authors explicitly discuss this change as a possible
explanation of part of the earlier prompting effect. The separate-option reasoning prompt is not
evaluated in the nine-option condition because the resulting answers would be long. This design
does not support a fully crossed estimate of every prompt-by-difficulty interaction.(Gjerde
et al., 2025)
   The reported results include configuration-specific similarities to human accuracy, perfor-
mance declines with additional distractors, and different responses to images across models. A
nonsignificant difference is not an equivalence result: equivalence requires a justified margin
and an appropriate test. The paper also distinguishes newly written tasks from structurally
new problems and acknowledges incomplete control over training-data overlap. Its behavioral
observations do not determine the internal mechanism or demonstrate real-world tool use.
Historical model names describe the studied conditions, not current product specifications or
a claim of superiority today.(Gjerde et al., 2025; Causal banking proposal project, 2026cr)
39.46. Causal affordances and executable tests for an agent-assisted library                  891


39.46.2     Translate functional selection into a banking contract

Consider a stipulated liquidity problem: obtain eligible funds within one business day. An
action’s required properties are a settlement delay no greater than one day, eligible collateral
and an existing authorization. Four authored choices are a familiar facility settling in two days,
an unfamiliar facility satisfying all three conditions, an immediate facility without eligible
collateral, and an immediate facility lacking authorization. The unfamiliar facility is the unique
feasible choice. Adding five infeasible distractors leaves that answer unchanged. These are
declared fixture properties, not claims about actual facilities or law.(Causal banking proposal
project, 2026cr)
   The assistant can decompose the request into constraints and attach source passages, dates
and unresolved interpretations to each property. It should then distinguish feasibility from
preference. If two choices satisfy the constraints, ranking them requires costs, risk and the
bank’s objective; if collateral eligibility is unknown, the answer must retain that uncertainty.
A familiar label or an explanation that sounds financially plausible cannot supply the missing
fact. In graph construction, the analogous step is to distinguish candidate variables and
functional mechanisms from assumptions needed for causal identification.(Causal banking
proposal project, 2026cr)
   Test representation and substantive meaning separately. Renaming facilities or permuting
choices should preserve this fixture’s answer; changing settlement from one to two days should
not. A unit conversion must preserve the same economic threshold. Changing an observation
timestamp can invalidate a proposed covariate. These transformations create an auditable test
family whose required behavior is defined before a model generates an answer. They do not
establish that the chosen public task distribution represents a bank’s future decisions.(Causal
banking proposal project, 2026cr)
   Choice count also changes a naive accuracy baseline. In an authored comparison, accuracy
0.85 among four choices has chance-normalized score
                                  (0.85 − 1/4)/(1 − 1/4) = 0.80,
whereas accuracy 0.75 among nine choices gives
                           (0.75 − 1/9)/(1 − 1/9) = 23/32 = 0.71875.
Both raw and normalized scores are informative; neither removes changes in task difficulty or
establishes causal competence. The numbers are illustrative and are not the paper’s reported
contrast.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026cr)
   Repeated outputs do not automatically increase the number of independent problems.
Suppose there are 20 independent task clusters, each with 25 unit-variance errors, equicorrelated
at a stipulated 0.60 within task. The mean over 500 outputs has variance
                                   1 + (25 − 1)0.60
                                                    = 0.0308,
                                        20 · 25
compared with 0.002 under independence. The equivalent independent count for this variance
calculation is 2500/77, about 32.47. A different dependence law gives a different answer. This
witness motivates retaining task identity, shared context, prompt selection and model revision
in the evaluation design. It is not an estimate of the study’s correlation or a reanalysis of its
significance tests.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026cr)

39.46.3     Generate difficult programs while preserving the test oracle

TitanFuzz supplies a complementary engineering idea. Its inspected March 2023 author version
combines a generative model for seed programs with an infilling model for mutations. Mutation
892                                                            Causal analysis for a universal bank


operators alter arguments, surrounding code and methods; adaptive operator selection rewards
valid generations, while a structural fitness score favors dataflow depth and unique API calls
and penalizes repetition. The paper uses successful execution with target invocation as a
program-validity criterion. Validity, diverse execution and discovery of a real defect are separate
outcomes.(Deng et al., 2023)
  The paper’s principal oracles compare CPU and GPU computations and identify crashes.
Comparison tolerances address ordinary numerical variation. The experiments cover historical
PyTorch and TensorFlow configurations, with a one-minute per-API budget for the main
comparison and a four-minute budget for bug finding. Reported line coverage concerns the
measured Python code; it does not establish that every lower-level path, relevant banking
contract or possible defect was exercised. The paper reports 65 candidate findings, 53 developer
confirmations and 41 previously unknown bugs at its reporting date, with eight rejected findings.
One rejected example has intentionally implementation-dependent behavior. This distinction
matters: a discrepancy is evidence to investigate, not automatically a valid defect.(Deng et al.,
2023)
   The inspected repository revision is dated September 2023 and reports later totals of 55
confirmations and 44 previously unknown bugs. These dated source statements remain separate;
we have not independently adjudicated the individual reports. The revision’s complete tree
has 88 entries. Its README identifies the research paper, describes supplied historical seed
artifacts and points to a seed-generation entrypoint absent from that tree. The external seed
archive has not been acquired in this review. Thus the repository does not by itself establish
complete reproduction of the paper’s generation process.(TitanFuzz contributors, 2023)
   A version contract is also necessary. The inspected requirements leave several major
dependencies unpinned, while the Docker recipe names TensorFlow 2.11.0rc1, differing from
the paper’s TensorFlow 2.10 experiment. The source includes process recovery, timeout and
skip statuses, but these mechanisms alone do not establish containment, reproducible numerical
behavior or target-platform acceptance. No native model, downloaded program, container or
package is executed in this review.(TitanFuzz contributors, 2023)


39.46.4     A numerical agreement check is not an economic acceptance rule

The inspected comparator declares relative tolerance 0.01 and absolute tolerance 0.001 and
calls library closeness functions with equal-NaN handling. Some unhandled value types fall
through to a true return. These are static source observations whose consequences need
carefully specified native tests. They should not be converted into a claim that a particular
version has been observed to misclassify a banking result.(TitanFuzz contributors, 2023)
  An authored scalar example illustrates the required distinction. Define the comparison rule

                                        |x − y| ≤ a + r|y|,

with a = 0.001 and r = 0.01. If two backends return 1,000,000 USD and 1,005,000 USD, their
difference is 5,000 USD and the tolerance is 10,050.001 USD. This rule accepts agreement even
though the difference exceeds a separately stipulated 1,000 USD business tolerance. The scalar
rule is our explicit witness using the inspected constants; it is not a native execution of either
numerical library.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026cr)
   Absolute tolerances carry units. Comparing zero with 0.0005 dollars passes an absolute
threshold of 0.001 dollars. Expressing the same values in cents while retaining the numerical
threshold 0.001 fails; the threshold must also be converted. A causal API therefore needs units,
estimand and error budgets in its artifact contract, including any conversion performed by a
CLI or MCP consumer.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026cr)
39.46. Causal affordances and executable tests for an agent-assisted library                   893


   Backend agreement can also preserve a shared error. If the exact truth is 100, both backends
return 110 and action occurs above 105, perfect agreement produces the wrong action. In
inference, a shared identification mistake is even less accessible to numerical comparison. Use
independent mathematical references, exact finite models, invariance tests and deliberately
invalid requests alongside differential tests. Refusal on an unidentified effect is part of correct
behavior, not a program-generation failure to discard.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026cr)


39.46.5     Adoption, interfaces and the public prototype

The defensible proposal is to adopt the testing pattern conditionally while treating the available
code as a separately qualified dependency. No license, copying or notice file appears in the
inspected tree, and the conventional license request returns 404. This bounded observation
leaves reuse rights unresolved; it does not establish that no permission exists elsewhere. Direct
code adoption or porting should wait for an applicable grant and review of dependencies,
model artifacts and supplied seeds. A project-owned harness can be designed from the in-
spected scientific ideas without declaring the downloaded implementation accepted.(TitanFuzz
contributors, 2023; Causal banking proposal project, 2026cr)
   A public prototype should freeze a versioned task schema before testing: business objective,
units, clocks, graph and identification contract, permitted operations, expected success or
refusal, and the numerical tolerance. The agent proposes candidate programs or structured
requests. A controlled runner records their source identity, environment, resource limits and
statuses; an independently specified oracle evaluates outputs. The scientific checker must be
allowed to reject a numerically successful calculation when the causal target is unsupported.
Corpus revisions and model changes require a new held-out comparison.(Causal banking
proposal project, 2026cr)
   For CLI and MCP consumers, generation, execution, adjudication and reporting should
exchange separate immutable artifacts. A request identifies its oracle and authority scope;
a response records all attempts, timeouts, duplicates, failures, unresolved discrepancies and
accepted outputs. Sibling repositories are prospective consumers of this protocol, not demon-
strated integrations. Before copying a discovered reproducer into another workspace, review
its permissions, inputs, resource behavior and dependence on the environment. These are
proposed product obligations, with no cross-repository deployment asserted.(Causal banking
proposal project, 2026cr)
   An exact cost fixture starts with 100 attempts, 60 runnable programs and 20 duplicates
among the runnable outputs, leaving 40 unique runnable programs. Ten candidate discrepancies
comprise six confirmed defects, two intended differences and two unresolved cases. At a
stipulated total cost of 600 USD, costs are 6 USD per attempt, 10 USD per runnable program,
15 USD per unique runnable program and 100 USD per confirmed defect. These denominators
include different services. They are not market prices or a measured return on investment. A
future comparison must include generation, hardware, containment, failed runs and human
adjudication, then connect accepted outputs to decision value.(Causal banking proposal project,
2026cr)
  The combined lesson is practical. Functional decomposition can help formulate an analysis
and adversarial program generation can expose implementation errors. The merit of a public
experiment comes from its explicit semantics, independent oracle and complete accounting.
Neither task accuracy nor software coverage supplies missing assignment information, resolves
observationally equivalent causal worlds or substitutes for later institutional acceptance.(Causal
banking proposal project, 2026cr)

39.47      Choosing a pinned statsmodels reference
The earlier Python comparison explains why a bank must distinguish ATE, ATT and ATU,
preserve the population in each moment, expose propensity clipping and follow uncertainty
through the final calculation. These requirements favor an interpretable parametric reference
when its assumptions match. They do not give every model in a broad statistical library an
accepted causal interpretation. Retain the selected statsmodels treatment-effect and GMM
paths as references, with a pinned original Python worker as a conditional prototype route. A
whole-library port has no demonstrated benefit here.(statsmodels contributors, 2026a; Causal

   The identity is commit 8278e2d218cc85bac2c7af02feb9a19a0e499b04 of 6 October 2026.

   Direct BSD terms require applicable notices, conditions and disclaimers in source or binary

39.47.1    Follow uncertainty to the final result

The selected class offers IPW, regression adjustment, augmented IPW, weighted-outcome
augmented IPW and IPW regression adjustment with linear OLS outcome models. Target
population affects weighting and averaging. A preliminary outcome fit’s robust covariance
label does not determine final joint GMM uncertainty. The final moment path and stored
covariance settings need inspection; clustered or HAC inference cannot be inferred from a
preliminary fit option.(statsmodels contributors, 2026a)
  Prior exact examples remain behavioral oracles. Their stipulated population gives ATE 50,
ATT 65 and ATU 35, so relabeling changes a decision. Clipping a propensity can change an
augmented score under an incorrect outcome model; it does not create overlap. The covariance
example distinguishes scalar centering from per-column centering when moment means are
nonzero, while exactly solved zero means remove that difference. These authored examples are
not newly observed native defects.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026au)
   Freeze target, sample keys, treatment coding, nuisance predictions, clipping and dependence
assumptions before native qualification. Compare final moments, Jacobian, residuals, rank
and covariance against an independent small reference. Test row permutations and grouped
control/treated order; preserve singularity, nonconvergence, warnings and unavailable uncer-
tainty. Point availability and justified uncertainty are separate outputs. An unsupported
common branch or calendar law cannot be repaired merely by selecting a familiar robust
label.(statsmodels contributors, 2026a; Causal banking proposal project, 2026au)

39.47.2     Decision, costs and accountable roles

Preserve the original Python engine behind a typed boundary as the preferred conditional
prototype. A whole-library R, Java or C++ port duplicates formula processing, numerical
behavior, uncertainty and maintenance. Explicit estimating equations or an appropriate
DoubleML profile remain comparators according to target and nuisance assumptions. The
method owner must approve the sampling law, the integration maintainer must own conversion
and upgrades, a rights reviewer must resolve distribution, and an evaluation owner must freeze
tests and costs. These are obligations, not external acceptances already obtained.(statsmodels
contributors, 2026a,b)
   Include source and rights review, dependency locking, data and clock conversion, nuisance

39.48       Preserving the causal comparison                                when          reusing
            difference-in-differences software
A bank introducing a collections policy in selected branches needs a statement about whose
outcome changes, over which dates, and under which counterfactual trend. A two-period
comparison and a staggered event study are different contracts even when both return a
coefficient labelled a treatment effect. The earlier software survey establishes the documented
roles of DRDID and did2s. Inspection of the pinned implementations now makes the proposed
reuse choice more precise: retain their original R implementations as conditional references,
with explicit sample and uncertainty contracts. Neither package is admitted as a verified native
capability by this source review. (DRDID contributors, 2026b; did2s contributors, 2026b;
DRDID contributors, 2026a; did2s contributors, 2026a)


39.48.1     The target precedes the computation

Let D indicate membership in the group treated after the baseline date, Yt (d) denote the
outcome at date t under treatment d, and X collect pre-treatment information. The two-period
target is
                               τT = E[Y1 (1) − Y1 (0) | D = 1].
A causal reading requires a suitable consistency and interference regime, no anticipation in the
baseline outcome, support for comparison, and a conditional parallel-trend restriction such as

                  E[Y1 (0) − Y0 (0) | D = 1, X] = E[Y1 (0) − Y0 (0) | D = 0, X].

For an observed panel, writing ∆Y = Y1 −Y0 , this gives the conditional comparison E[∆Y | D =
1, X] − E[∆Y | D = 0, X] then averaged over the treated population. Repeated cross-sections
require an additional account of population composition across dates; replacing matched
changes by independent snapshots is not a storage-only change. The package’s documented
ATT and separate panel/cross-section modes preserve these distinctions; software output does
not certify the identifying restrictions.(DRDID contributors, 2026b,a)
  An authored financial example shows why the target field is mandatory. Suppose two equally
prevalent borrower strata have gains of USD 20 and USD 100, while treatment probabilities
896                                                                Causal analysis for a universal bank


are 4/5 and 1/5. The population ATE is USD 60, but the treated-population effect is
(4/5)20 + (1/5)100 = 36 dollars. With a stipulated cost of USD 40 per treated borrower,
substituting the ATE reports a margin of USD 20 where the intended ATT margin is USD −4.
These are exact consequences of an invented law, not measured collections benefits or native
package estimates. (Causal banking proposal project, 2026dz)

39.48.2     DRDID: modes, retained observations and nuisance contracts

The selected DRDID 1.3.0 source is commit b63f66d7e35bb6940a139a03cb2d38988555986a.
The top-level call dispatches separately to improved and traditional panel and repeated-cross-
section routines. It returns the ATT, uncertainty, bootstrap draws when requested, and an
influence function when requested; the improved path also returns a propensity-fit flag. A
wrapper should retain these diagnostics and the actual resolved options. In the inspected
preprocessor, an unrecognised estimation mode warns and changes to the improved mode, and
an unsupported bootstrap mode can warn and change to the weighted mode. An API that
stores only the user’s requested option would therefore misdescribe the calculation.(DRDID
contributors, 2026a)
   The preprocessor requires numeric time, treatment and supplied identifiers, checks duplicate
identifier–time cells and group constancy, sorts rows, and accepts exactly two dates and
two observed treatment groups. The implementation uses the numeric treatment indicator
algebraically; the proposed adapter must explicitly validate the documented zero/one coding
rather than infer correctness from the count of distinct values. In the panel path it requests a
balanced panel and checks invariant covariates, group membership and weights. It then warns
about missing values, removes incomplete rows and drops collinear covariates using a QR
tolerance of 10−6 . The returned before/after outcome vectors no longer carry the original keys
in this routine. The sample contract must record each exclusion and verify the paired keys
after every filtering step, including asymmetric missing outcomes. Static inspection identifies a
qualification case; it does not establish an observed native misalignment.(DRDID contributors,
2026a)
   The improved panel routine caps fitted propensities at 1 − 10−6 and applies the default
0.995 trimming threshold to controls. It constructs
                               Pn [wi si {1 − (1 − Di )/(1 − pbi )}(∆Yi − m
                                                                          b i )]
                     τbimp =                                                     ,
                                                  Pn [wi Di ]
where Pn is the sample mean, wi is the normalized input weight, si is the retained indicator,
pbi the capped propensity, and m  b i the fitted control change. The traditional panel path
instead normalizes its treated and odds-weighted control components separately and includes
nuisance-estimation terms in its influence calculation. The improved repeated-cross-section
path includes four group/date regressions and extra adjustment terms; it is not the panel
expression with the identifier deleted. (DRDID contributors, 2026a)
   A supplied-nuisance fixture makes the normalization distinction visible. Take two treated
residual changes (10, 14), two control residual changes (2, 4), unit weights, and control propen-
sities (1/2, 999/1000). The control odds are (1, 999). Without trimming, the improved-style
expression is (24 − 2 − 999 · 4)/2 = −1987, whereas the separately normalized expression
is 12 − (2 + 999 · 4)/1000 = 4001/500. Removing the high-propensity control gives 11 and
10 respectively. These nuisance values are supplied to a mathematical fixture; they are not
claimed to satisfy either routine’s fitted calibration equations. The example neither ranks
the estimators nor refutes double robustness. It requires an adapter to preserve the actual
threshold, normalization and nuisance method instead of silently interchanging them. (DRDID
contributors, 2026a; Causal banking proposal project, 2026dz)
39.48. Preserving the causal comparison when reusing difference-in-differences software         897


  The inspected analytic paths compute standard errors from the individual influence vector,
while the multiplier helper draws one multiplier per vector entry. There is no branch-cluster
argument in these inspected signatures. A panel subject is not automatically a branch-
independent sampling unit. A bank using branch assignment must establish the appropriate
uncertainty procedure, or decline to report qualified uncertainty. The traditional path also
warns on propensity nonconvergence and stops on missing coefficients or singular designs.
Native qualification must distinguish a returned point estimate from an accepted fit and from
accepted uncertainty. (DRDID contributors, 2026a)


39.48.3     did2s: generated outcomes retain first-stage uncertainty

The selected did2s 1.2.1 source is commit 31febce3581304c3f6e8a8ef91d07e20175d7c41. It
estimates the first-stage outcome relation on untreated observations, predicts the untreated
outcome for the full data, and regresses the resulting residual outcome on the second-stage
design. Let X be the first-stage matrix, X0 its untreated-row version with treated rows zeroed,
and Z the second-stage matrix. In an illustrative full-rank unweighted case,

                       γb = (X0′ X0 )−1 X0′ Y,   βb = (Z ′ Z)−1 Z ′ (Y − X γb ).

Consequently the response to an outcome perturbation dY contains both (Z ′ Z)−1 Z ′ dY and
the correction −(Z ′ Z)−1 Z ′ X(X0′ X0 )−1 X0′ dY . Treating the generated baseline as fixed deletes
the second term. The inspected analytic path combines first- and second-stage influences,
then sums them within the supplied cluster before forming outer products. Its bootstrap path
resamples clusters and refits both stages. (did2s contributors, 2026a)
   For a minimal authored illustration, estimate a constant untreated baseline from two
independent unit-variance observations and subtract it from the mean of two independent
treated observations. Conditional on a fixed baseline, the variance is 1/2. With the estimated
independent baseline, the variance is 1/2 + 1/2 = 1. This exact variance identity motivates
preserving the first stage; it is not a replication of did2s inference or a universal factor-of-two
correction. Actual clustered event-study inference depends on the design, first-stage support
and sampling law.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026dz)
   The source also exposes conversion and numerical obligations. Rows removed by the
second-stage fit are used to align the data and first-stage residuals; weights enter through
square roots in the analytic covariance. The returned object is a fixest summary with a
replacement covariance, so exporting only coefficients and ordinary regression standard errors
loses the method’s uncertainty. Both fitting calls suppress selected warnings/notes, and the
final summary suppresses warnings; an operator must retain explicit support, rank and failure
diagnostics rather than equate silence with qualification. (did2s contributors, 2026a)
   The helper named robust_solve_XtX is documented as QR based, but its body forms X ′ X,
attempts a direct solve and falls back on an SVD of that cross-product after an error. Its
matrix right-hand side is interpreted by shape: the row-count branch precedes the column-
count branch. If X is a square diagonal matrix with diagonal (2, 3) and an identity matrix is
supplied as an already formed right-hand side, the intended solution has diagonal (1/4, 1/9);
interpreting that matrix as raw responses gives (1/2, 1/3). This algebraic witness motivates an
explicit right-hand-side representation and numerical qualification. Reachability from an actual
full-rank did2s fit has not been established; no native failure is claimed. (did2s contributors,
2026a; Causal banking proposal project, 2026dz)
   The separate event-study convenience function provides a further reason to qualify narrow
entrypoints. Its did2s branch sets the cluster variable to the unit identifier; its neighbouring
estimator branches have their own calls, sample handling and reference periods. An array
898                                                             Causal analysis for a universal bank


of estimates under a common plotting interface is therefore not automatically a matched
comparison. The proposed initial profile uses an explicit did2s call, declared cluster, first-stage
support, omitted periods and event aggregation, with simultaneous path inference separately
justified.(did2s contributors, 2026a)


39.48.4     Reuse choices, distribution and qualification

For both packages, an original R worker is the conditional integration route: it preserves the
inspected calculations and their ecosystem. A direct Python, Java or C++ port would also
inherit responsibility for formula expansion, rank decisions, first-stage support, covariance
and failure propagation. No measured benefit currently justifies that full port. The existing
did, fixest, PyFixest and supplied-equation references remain alternatives selected by target
and assumptions; sharing an estimator label does not establish parity. (DRDID contributors,
2026a; did2s contributors, 2026a; DRDID contributors, 2026b; did2s contributors, 2026b)
   DRDID declares GPL-3, R at least 3.5, and dependencies including trust, BMisc, Rcpp
and fastglm, with compilation required. The GPL text’s source, modification, notice and
corresponding-source provisions are retained as review obligations for any proposed distribution.
did2s declares MIT plus its package notice, R at least 3.5.0 and fixest at least 0.13.2, with further
imports including boot, Matrix, did and other estimators. Its own package metadata says
compilation is unnecessary; that is not a statement about the entire dependency environment.
The package notice and standard MIT text are inspected together. Neither review clears every
transitive artifact or decides the legal status of a future combined distribution. A process
boundary alone is not treated as a rights determination.(DRDID contributors, 2026a; did2s
contributors, 2026a)
   A method owner must approve the target, counterfactual trend, interference and sampling
regime. An integration maintainer must preserve keys, resolved options, diagnostics and
exact environment; a rights reviewer must resolve distribution and dependency obligations;
and an evaluation owner must register matched public/generated trials. Those trials include
duplicate and missing panel cells, nonbinary coding, changing weights, unsupported overlap,
nonconvergence, rank loss, unseen fixed-effect support, cluster resampling, failed replicates
and event-path covariance. Complete costs include source and dependency maintenance, data
conversion, both fitting stages, covariance, resampling, failed attempts and review. No price,
speed advantage or bank ROI is inferred here. The decisions close the proposal’s reference
disposition only; native integration, empirical performance and broad survey completion remain

39.49       Python longitudinal inference: clocks, competing events
            and reproducible refusals
Repeated collections decisions require more than a survival curve. The bank must specify
when eligibility begins, which information is available before each action, whether prepayment
ends exposure to default, and which borrowers remain in the population being averaged.
The Python implementations examined here offer different computational routes through
that problem. zEpid 0.9.1 provides distinct baseline-survival, Monte Carlo longitudinal and
iterative conditional interfaces at its selected cutoff commit. pygformula 1.2.1 provides a
parametric longitudinal simulator with intervention, competing-event and bootstrap machinery.
Their source contracts support a bounded comparison; they do not establish complete Python
coverage or native conformance. (zEpid contributors, 2026; pygformula contributors, 2026)
39.49. Python longitudinal inference: clocks, competing events and reproducible refusals      899


39.49.1     A causal clock and an event ordering

Write Lt for information observed just before decision At , and let Ht = (L̄t , Āt−1 ) denote the
available history. A specified policy sets At = gt (Ht ). Sequential exchangeability, consistency,
suitable support and correctly specified transition models are substantive requirements for a
parametric g-formula interpretation; the simulator’s ability to assign At does not verify them.
Censoring and competing events require their own observation and intervention interpretations.
   For a transparent authored law, suppose each period first permits prepayment with condi-
tional probability qt , then default with probability pt among those who did not prepay. With
constant q = 1/5 and p = 1/10, the probability of surviving both events for one period is
(1 − q)(1 − p) = 18/25. The two-period default cumulative incidence is therefore
                                                                   86
                  FD (2) = (1 − q)p + (1 − q)(1 − p)(1 − q)p =        = 0.1376.
                                                                  625
An intervention eliminating prepayment, while keeping the stipulated default hazard unchanged,
gives instead 1 − (1 − p)2 = 19/100. Under a stipulated loss of USD 10,000 and protection
premium of USD 1,600, the expected avoided-loss minus premium is USD −224 for the first
target and USD 300 for the second. The latter describes a different hypothetical world; it is
not the bank’s observed default risk. These exact invented examples establish neither real
insurance value nor identification from an observed bank panel. (Causal banking proposal
project, 2026ds)
   The inspected pygformula simulator implements a conditional event ordering that must
remain visible. Its competing-event risk sums the default hazard multiplied by survival of
earlier default and competing events and by survival of the current competing event. Without
that branch it sums the ordinary default-hazard increments. The constructor disables the
explicit competing-event branch when the option to treat competing events as censoring
is selected. That switch cannot be presented as an interchangeable numerical option: an
interpretation as elimination requires appropriate extra causal and observation assumptions.
Baseline time zero, pre-baseline histories and lag initialization must also be preserved rather
than inferred from calendar strings.(pygformula contributors, 2026)


39.49.2     zEpid separates three estimation interfaces

At commit 16a0f96f8b2c65df8715085801f21757d1478e1e, the version file identifies zEpid
0.9.1. The source date is a revision observation, not proof of abandonment or a support
guarantee. Its SurvivalGFormula describes a baseline-fixed binary exposure and pooled
logistic outcome model on long person-period data. The fit overwrites exposure under the
requested strategy, predicts one-period survival, takes within-person cumulative products and
averages cumulative risks over the rows present at each time. Its documentation requests an
external bootstrap for confidence intervals. This interface is not automatically a repeated-action
policy estimator merely because its input has repeated rows.(zEpid contributors, 2026)
   The averaging population deserves a separate check. The inspected input helper drops rows
with missing values in any supplied column on this path, including columns irrelevant to a
chosen formula. A baseline-standardized curve can consequently differ from a mean over the
remaining records at a later date. Consider equal baseline strata with supplied constant hazards
1/10 and 2/5. Their two-period risks are 19/100 and 16/25, so the baseline-standardized risk
is 83/200 = 0.415. If only the first stratum has a retained row at the horizon, averaging the
available risk returns 0.19, a change of 9/40 = 0.225 due solely to the averaging population.
This is an exact composition fixture, not an observed output from a fitted zEpid model. A
proposed adapter must declare the standardization population, retain the original identifiers
900                                                             Causal analysis for a universal bank


and exclusions, and either build the justified prediction grid or refuse a baseline-population
label. Merely filling rows does not resolve informative censoring.(zEpid contributors, 2026;
Causal banking proposal project, 2026ds)
   The MonteCarloGFormula interface instead samples initial subject rows and evolves ordered
covariate models, exposure, outcome, censoring and lags. Its source validates binary exposure
and outcome; a competing-event branch is a placeholder unreachable through the inspected
constructor’s nonbinary outcome rejection. The initial sampled rows can be weighted, and the
optional low-memory output retains terminal rows rather than every simulated step. Without
a censoring model the simulation keeps records uncensored until its administrative end. With
a fitted censoring model, it draws the censoring indicator after the outcome draw and sets that
step’s outcome to zero when censoring occurs. These are precise ordering and target questions
for a matched trial, not evidence that every missing-outcome interpretation is supported.(zEpid

   Custom strategies and recodes in these interfaces use expressions evaluated against the data

or MCP workflow, a business-language agent must not send arbitrary strings into those hooks.
The proposal should accept a typed policy with approved variables, operators, time availability
and registered transformations, then use a reviewed worker to construct the permitted call. The
contract must distinguish natural-course simulation from retaining each observed action, bind
random-number state and record all intervention changes. Neither an executable expression
nor an agent’s plausible explanation proves sequential exchangeability or positivity. (zEpid
contributors, 2026)
   The IterativeCondGFormula provides a further, wide-data route with reverse sequential
regressions. It rejects recurrent outcomes under its binary-event check. The inspected two-

three subjects and two decision times, an ordinary 3 × 2 per-subject plan fails the first predicate.

39.49.3     pygformula: simulation is only one uncertainty layer

The selected pygformula commit is e66f787fcef2d6a9092b88135147c6b13785795c. Its con-
structor distinguishes survival, binary end-of-follow-up and continuous end-of-follow-up out-
comes, histories, observation visits and interventions. The source defaults the horizon to the
maximum time index plus one, inserts a natural-course comparator, and constructs simula-
tion and bootstrap seeds. The simulator applies interventions at their specified dates and
updates histories and modeled covariates. Predefined static and threshold interventions and
custom callable paths require different conversion checks; the word policy should not hide their
information clocks or computational behavior. (pygformula contributors, 2026)
   Simulation precision is not fitted-model uncertainty. Under the elementary invented Bernoulli
law with risk r = 86/625, an independent average of M draws has conditional variance
r(1 − r)/M . Increasing M addresses that conditional simulation layer. It does not remove
error in fitted transition models, identify an unsupported counterfactual, or add independent
branches to the observed sample. The inspected bootstrap resamples subject identifiers with
39.49. Python longitudinal inference: clocks, competing events and reproducible refusals     901


replacement and assigns new identifiers to sampled copies before refitting. That preserves
within-subject histories; it does not by itself qualify dependence across borrowers sharing a
branch or calendar shock. (Causal banking proposal project, 2026ds; pygformula contributors,
2026)
   Failure accounting is equally material. The bootstrap helper catches an exception, warns
with the replicate identity and returns missing result fields. The caller first filters missing
results into an accepted-result list, but its subsequent estimate dictionary indexes every
requested replicate without the same guard. A failed replicate therefore needs an explicit
qualification case; it must not be silently turned into zero, counted as a successful draw,
or discarded without recording the denominator. Even a simple designed pair of replicate
values (−1, 1) has mean zero, whereas retaining only 1 has mean one. This example illustrates
possible selection, not the distribution of any package estimator. A production proposal
needs requested, attempted, accepted and failed counts, reasons and a predeclared rule for
withholding uncertainty.(pygformula contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project,
2026ds)
   The source reuses a simulation seed across intervention comparisons, but reuse of an
initial seed alone does not establish a useful common-random-number coupling when paths
consume random draws differently. Native comparisons must record the entire fitting, history,
simulation and bootstrap environment; include serial/parallel agreement and restart behavior;
and distinguish confidence intervals for a single target from simultaneous policy or time-path
claims. Natural-course agreement is a diagnostic for a fitted observational process, not a proof
of counterfactual validity. (pygformula contributors, 2026)


39.49.4     Integration choices and the remaining survey boundary

The conditional route is a narrow original-Python worker for each declared profile. A whole-
