semantic aggregation are different issues. This review does not assert that a native collision
was observed.(BURLAP contributors, 2017)


39.55.3     Least-squares policy iteration and the conditions behind sample
            reuse

The genuine 2003 Lagoudakis–Parr article supplies the mathematical background. For a linear
action-value approximation Qw (s, a) = ϕ(s, a)⊤ w, a fixed target policy and transition samples
(si , ai , ri , s′i ), LSTDQ forms

                             ϕi (ϕi − γϕ′i )⊤ ,
                        X                                X
                 AD =                             bD =       ϕi ri ,        AD w = bD ,
                         i                               i

where ϕ′i = ϕ(s′i , π(s′i )). The paper explains why the same transitions can be reused across
target policies: the policy changes the next-state feature term. It also explicitly describes the
sampling distribution’s role in the projected fixed point. State-action samples must represent
the intended projection weighting, and next states must come from the appropriate conditional
transition law. Uneven coverage and unvisited important states remain problems; the phrase
arbitrary sample collection does not remove them. The finite MDP and linear approximation
assumptions must accompany this result.(Lagoudakis and Parr, 2003)
   The article’s approximate-policy-iteration guarantee is conditional on a uniform bound on
value-function approximation error over iterations. It does not make a small empirical weight
change into an estimated uniform error bound or a bank confidence interval. Its discussion
allows convergence or oscillation within an error-controlled region and identifies basis choice
and sample distribution as central. Its chain examples illustrate selected behavior; they do
not certify the current bank state abstraction. The original code-distribution footnote refers
to noncommercial use of that distribution, which must not be confused with the separately
inspected BURLAP license. No original experiment or original code distribution was executed
here.(Lagoudakis and Parr, 2003)
   BURLAP’s inspected LSTDQ routine builds next features using a greedy policy, initializes
an inverse matrix to a scaled identity, then applies a rank-one inverse update. The default
inverse scale is 100; interpreting it as the same value of a ridge coefficient reverses the matrix
relationship. For B = A−1 , the selected update denominator is

                                       d = 1 + (ϕ − γϕ′ )⊤ Bϕ.

The inspected loop divides by d without a denominator guard in that path. In an exact scalar
witness, B = 100, ϕ = 1, γ = 1/2 and ϕ′ = 101/50 give d = 0. The corresponding updated
regularized scalar matrix is also zero. This is a mathematical input witness for a necessary
diagnostic, not a reported native failure or a claim that every input fails. A wrapper must
detect singularity and conditioning before admitting a value; an SVD fallback would require
an explicit changed-estimator contract.(BURLAP contributors, 2017; Causal banking proposal
project, 2026ef)
    The selected SARS tuple carries state, action, reward and next state, without a separate
terminal flag in that representation. Its LSTDQ loop still constructs next features. The class
documentation itself warns about terminal-state handling and proposes offsetting continuation
through rewards. That workaround is not automatically equivalent to a bank’s absorbing default
or contractual settlement. A correct episodic adapter must therefore bind a terminal feature or
equivalent absorbing-state convention; it must not infer it from an account disappearing from a
file. Greedy ties also matter: the inspected policy randomizes uniformly over exact maximizing
ties, including when constructing next-state actions. A deterministic first-action port changes
39.55. Java policy systems: planning, fitted control and the missing evaluation contract       925


that policy. With equal estimated Q values but true action values 10 and 0 USD, uniform
tie-breaking has value 5 USD while always choosing the first has value 10 USD. These authored
values show target sensitivity, not the relative quality of either implementation.(BURLAP
contributors, 2017; Causal banking proposal project, 2026ef)


39.55.4     Tabular updates, comments and missing terminal information

Chen’s Q-learning update uses the maximum next-state Q value, while its Sarsa update uses
the supplied next action. An inherited comment in the latter mentions a maximum, but the
executable expression reads the specified action’s value. The distinction is substantive. With
old Q equal to 4 USD, reward 2 USD, learning rate 0.1, discount 0.7, maximum next Q equal
to 8 USD and selected next-action Q equal to 1 USD, the updates are 4.36 and 3.87 USD
respectively. Both inspected signatures lack a terminal argument. If the transition is terminal,
the appropriate zero-continuation update in this example is 3.80 USD. An absorbing state with
correctly zeroed values can implement that convention; retaining the model’s generic nonzero
initialization cannot be assumed to do so.(Chen Java reinforcement-learning contributors, 2017;
Causal banking proposal project, 2026ef)
   The actor-update path has another boundary: its literal temporal-difference expression
is r + V (s′ ) − V (s), although the constructor stores a discount parameter. In the same
reward/value example, the literal error is 6 USD; inserting discount 0.7 would give 3.60 USD.
The reviewed path may suit a different convention, but calling it a discounted implementation
without an explicit translation would be unjustified. The method accepts an external value
function; it does not independently establish the critic’s identification or accuracy. The selected
epsilon-greedy strategy also copies its random-generator reference. A clone is therefore not
evidence of independent random streams. Its returned action/value pair does not by itself
preserve the historically realized assignment probability.(Chen Java reinforcement-learning
contributors, 2017; Causal banking proposal project, 2026ef)
   These findings favor using the compact routines as transparent teaching and arithmetic
references until terminal handling, discount convention, action constraints, random streams and
data lineage are qualified. A direct port is not automatically easier: reproducing a comment
instead of the expression changes Sarsa; silently adding a discount changes the actor path.
Any deliberate repair must be named and compared against an independent oracle.


39.55.5     Historical deep learning: targets, clamping and experience identity

The historical RL4J DQN path separates the online and target networks. For nonterminal
transitions, StandardDQN uses the largest next target-network value; DoubleDQN selects an
action using the online network and evaluates that action using the target network. Both
selected methods use the immediate reward alone for a terminal transition before an optional
label clamp. With reward 2 USD, discount 0.9, online next values (9, 8) and target next values
(1, 10), the two targets are 11 and 2.90 USD. These are different learning labels, not two
interchangeable off-policy value estimates.(Eclipse Deeplearning4j contributors, 2022; Causal
banking proposal project, 2026ef)
   The common computation can clamp a label around the current action value. If that value
is 4 USD and the clamp width is 1 USD, the two labels become 5 and 3 USD; even the terminal
reward label 2 becomes 3 USD. This can be an intentional training device, but a clamped
training label must not be returned as an unclamped monetary estimand. The inspected
source defaults the clamp to disabled through a NaN setting. The adapter must bind the
actual configuration rather than infer it from a default in one class.(Eclipse Deeplearning4j
926                                                            Causal analysis for a universal bank


contributors, 2022; Causal banking proposal project, 2026ef)
   The replay handler links a pending transition to its next observation before storing it.
Episode-end processing supplies the final observation; reset drops a pending transition. The
replay buffer samples distinct stored indices within a batch, caps batch size by current
storage size and duplicates selected transitions. None of these operations converts dependent
customer histories into independent evaluation observations or reconstructs missing assignment
probabilities. The target computation builds next-observation features before terminal target
suppression, so a zero-continuation target does not justify omitting the final observation object.
The selected feature builder arranges recurrent observations using the order it receives; a random
replay batch must not be relabelled a customer’s chronology. These are interface constraints for
a future conformance test, not measured native outcomes.(Eclipse Deeplearning4j contributors,
2022)
   The training caller may repeat an action for skipped observations, accumulates rewards
with a configured reward factor, and forwards a done flag. A banking adapter must preserve
physical duration and the meaning of accumulated reward: a single discount multiplication per
emitted transition need not equal daily discounting across a variable gap. The historical MDP
interface offers reset, step, done and new-instance methods; these names do not distinguish
default, cure, administrative truncation and loss to follow-up. The policy delegates its action
choice to an argmax helper. Shape, tie behavior, serialization and native backend identity
remain qualification work. A successful dependency resolver would not close these semantic
questions.(Eclipse Deeplearning4j contributors, 2022)


39.55.6     Information acquisition is not fully observed continuation

BURLAP’s selected QMDP approximation averages fully observed action values over a belief
and assumes the future information advantage of the fully observed problem. Its available
actions are obtained from one sampled underlying state, making common action feasibility a
condition to inspect. A bank may instead be choosing whether to learn something. Consider a
hidden binary affordability state with equal probabilities. Today it can pay 1 USD to reveal
that state or wait for free. Tomorrow it chooses the matching treatment and earns 10 USD
if correct, zero otherwise; γ = 0.9. The true values are 8 USD for revealing and 4.50 USD
for waiting. A fully observed continuation credits waiting with 9 USD, so this approximation
chooses waiting and loses 3.50 USD relative to revealing in the authored finite law.(BURLAP
contributors, 2017; Causal banking proposal project, 2026ef)
   The repair is not to attach a confidence label to that approximation. A full belief-state model
must represent what each action reveals, with justified observation and transition models and
a feasible belief-dependent action set. Exact enumeration of a small supplied model can test
that translation; larger models require declared approximation and numerical error. Whether
the bank’s latent model is identified from logged data is a separate scientific question. No
surveyed planner supplies a universal answer to unrestricted hidden-state identification.


39.55.7     Conditional reuse and the public prototype that would justify
            investment

The proposal disposition is conditional integration of an original BURLAP worker for a
declared finite supplied-model or linear-feature task, with a separate evaluation layer. Chen’s
routines are retained as references, with direct production adoption deferred pending the
demonstrated semantic repairs. The historical RL4J profile is retained as a comparator; native
adoption is deferred until a maintained artifact, backend, tests and operational owner are bound.
39.56. C++ policy systems: logged decisions, supplied models and learned control              927


A wholesale port of any family is rejected absent a measured requirement that outweighs

   A future CLI or MCP request should name its target type, state/history schema, action

39.56      C++ policy systems: logged decisions, supplied models
           and learned control
A banking team choosing a C++ policy engine must first decide which quantity the engine is
expected to compute. Estimating the cost of a fixed servicing policy from logged randomized
actions is different from evaluating that policy inside a supplied transition model. Both differ
from training a controller to maximize rewards in a simulator. Vowpal Wabbit, AI-Toolbox
and mlpack provide concrete implementations relevant to these roles, but their shared policy
vocabulary does not make their outputs interchangeable. The following comparison uses
cutoff-pinned source, three genuine method or software papers and exact authored witnesses.
No downloaded code, native build or bank experiment is run.(Vowpal Wabbit contributors,
2026; AI-Toolbox contributors, 2025; mlpack contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal
project, 2026ee)

39.56.2     Vowpal Wabbit: action-dependent feedback and the logging con-
            tract

The inspected action-dependent-feature reduction includes inverse-propensity, direct-regression
and doubly robust cost transformations. It exposes a probability-clipping option with zero as
its default. The inverse-propensity delegate divides an observed cost by the clipped reported
probability; a separate safety helper warns and substitutes 0.001 for nonpositive inputs. The
label parser also has explicit handling for invalid and test probabilities. These branches
are not a proof that every malformed record reaches the safety helper. They show why a
scientific adapter must validate logging probabilities before it chooses a learning or evaluation
path.(Vowpal Wabbit contributors, 2026)
   Let h(a | x) be the actual logging probability, π(a | x) a fixed target policy and C the
observed cost. Under the required observation and causal assumptions, a single-step target
value can be represented by
                                               π(A | X)
                                                        
                                 VC (π) = Eh            C .
                                               h(A | X)
The logging probability is part of the experiment. Replacing a missing or zero number with
a small positive number cannot establish support or truthful randomization. If an action is
never observed, two worlds that agree on all logged outcomes can assign that action costs of
zero and 100. No arithmetic convention selects the correct world.(Karampatziakis et al., 2021;
Waudby-Smith et al., 2024; Causal banking proposal project, 2026ee)
   An authored two-action example makes clipping concrete. Let h = (0.8, 0.2), π = (0.2, 0.8)
and deterministic costs (20, 100) USD. The target cost is 84 USD. Ordinary inverse weighting
has expectation 84. Replacing each logging denominator by max(h, 0.4) gives 44 USD. With a
regression prediction (10, 80), the ordinary doubly robust expression
                                X                 π(A)
                                     π(a)q(a) +        {C − q(A)}
                                 a                h(A)

also has expectation 84, whereas clipping the correction denominator gives 76. The examples
quantify a target change under stipulated inputs; they are not measured behavior of a native
worker or a claim that clipping can never be justified. A justified bias bound or a different
target must accompany the choice.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026ee)
  The inspected code paths also separate cost-sensitive training labels from reporting estimates.
A declaration that a training option is enabled does not demonstrate that every reporting or
39.56. C++ policy systems: logged decisions, supplied models and learned control                  929


evaluation function applies the same transformation. A proposed CLI response should identify
the estimator, cost sign, clipping rule, regression fit, target-policy bytes and logging probabilities
actually used. It must retain rejected records and reasons instead of silently treating them
as valid observations.(Vowpal Wabbit contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project,
2026ee)


39.56.3     Time-uniform inference has scientific premises

The original off-policy confidence-sequence paper provides a useful baseline: an identified
contextual-bandit value, a target policy supported by the logging policy, bounded rewards and
weights in its central construction, and predictable bets produce a nonnegative martingale.
Inverting the corresponding wealth processes gives confidence sets valid uniformly over time.
The proof permits optional stopping under its premises; it does not authorize changing the
target policy after looking at the same data without further justification.(Karampatziakis
et al., 2021)
   The inspected 2024 author version of the later anytime-valid paper expands the framework
to predictable adaptive logging, settings without a known uniform upper bound on importance
weights, and separately defined time-varying targets. Individual ratios must still be finite. Its
fixed-value theorem requires a constant conditional target mean and bounded rewards; the
time-varying results concern a time average, not automatically the latest value. A two-period
authored example with target means 0.2 and 0.8 has average 0.5 and latest value 0.8. Calling
an interval for one quantity an interval for the other would be a reporting error.(Waudby-Smith
et al., 2024; Causal banking proposal project, 2026ee)
   The paper’s contextual process permits exogenous temporal dependence but distinguishes it
from actions that change later contexts or rewards. Its potential-outcomes appendix states
consistency, exchangeability and positivity requirements for a causal interpretation. A servicing
action can alter later balances, customer contact and eligibility. In that setting, a sequence
of immediate bandit evaluations does not by itself identify the value of replacing the entire
longitudinal policy. A sequential model, appropriate histories and a separate identification
argument are required.(Waudby-Smith et al., 2024; Causal banking proposal project, 2026ee)
   These papers support a mathematical route, not certification of the selected C++ implemen-
tation. The source contains distinct confidence-sequence and robustness classes, numerical root
searches and reward-range handling. One inspected update clips rewards when adjustment
is disabled; another expects rewards in [0, 1]. To use monetary losses, define and justify
any normalization and transform the reported interval back to dollars. Independently test
numerical boundaries, alpha allocation, reward limits, persisted state, dropped observations
and the exact theorem-to-code mapping. An asymptotic empirical-likelihood component and
an anytime-valid construction must not be conflated merely because both produce inter-
vals.(Vowpal Wabbit contributors, 2026; Karampatziakis et al., 2021; Waudby-Smith et al.,
2024; Causal banking proposal project, 2026ee)


39.56.4     AI-Toolbox: evaluation conditional on a supplied world

The AI-Toolbox paper distinguishes planning with a known model from learning through
interactions. It describes MDP, POMDP and factored components and Python bindings. Those
are historical architectural claims. The paper describes C++17, while the inspected later CMake
file requests C++20 and declares Boost, Eigen and LpSolve requirements. The change illustrates
why a paper’s environment cannot stand in for the selected source contract.(Bargiacchi et al.,
2020; AI-Toolbox contributors, 2025)
930                                                             Causal analysis for a universal bank


   The inspected policy-evaluation routine repeatedly computes action values under the supplied
transition/reward model and averages them using the supplied policy. It stops at the configured
horizon or tolerance. With tolerance disabled it returns zero in the variation field, as a reporting
convention; that zero is not a measured infinite-horizon error. In a one-state authored model
with reward 10, discount 0.9 and zero initial value, one iteration returns value 10 while the
infinite-horizon value is 100. The error is 90 and the Bellman residual at the returned value is
nine. In this contraction example the residual bound 9/(1 − 0.9) = 90 is exact.(AI-Toolbox
contributors, 2025; Causal banking proposal project, 2026ee)
   The statistical uncertainty of an estimated model is separate from numerical iteration error.
Even a perfectly solved supplied model can be the wrong banking world. The adapter should
therefore bind transition, reward and observation identities and label values conditional on that
model. For a fixed policy choosing next actions with probabilities (1/4, 3/4) and continuation
values (20, 4), the expected continuation is eight; maximization gives 20 and changes the
target.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026ee)
   ImportanceSamplingEvaluation uses target-to-behavior probability ratios to discount traces.
The surrounding update has no explicit terminal flag, so absorbing-state conventions, values
and trace clearing must be established by the caller. With reward 10, discount 0.9 and an
erroneously retained next value 50 at termination, the update target is 55 rather than ten. The
control variant also deserves a targeted check: its inspected next-state maximization passes
the maximizing action index into the trace-probability expression evaluated at the current
state. When the maximizing action differs between those states, the literal expression need
not equal a current-state epsilon-greedy ratio.(AI-Toolbox contributors, 2025; Causal banking
proposal project, 2026ee)
  For an exact authored witness, current-state action values are (10, 0) and next-state values
are (0, 10), with epsilon 0.1 and behavior probability 0.5 for current action zero. Using
the next-state maximizing index in that expression gives ratio 0.1; using the current-state
maximizing index gives 1.9. This is a static conformance question for the selected branch.
We have not executed the library or established the consequences for an entire learning run.
Preserve the observation and test it against the declared algorithm before admitting that
branch.(AI-Toolbox contributors, 2025; Causal banking proposal project, 2026ee)
   Partial-observation planning needs an equally explicit boundary. QMDP constructs belief-
space action planes from a fully observable MDP solution; the observation-space size participates
in the output representation, not a newly learned observation model. POMCP instead uses a
supplied generative model and sampled beliefs, with the inspected implementation documenting
particle depletion as a concern. Neither solves the inverse problem of identifying a hidden
banking state from an arbitrary observational history. Conditional original-worker reuse
is preferable to an unreviewed whole-library port when model semantics and rights are
accepted.(AI-Toolbox contributors, 2025; Causal banking proposal project, 2026ee)


39.56.5     mlpack: learned control, replay and distributional targets

The inspected mlpack Q-learning code distinguishes online and target networks, supports a
double-Q action selection branch, and suppresses continuation on a stored terminal indicator.
Its ordinary target discounts by γ n using the replay object’s step count. The returned
episode score, however, sums the observed rewards without discounting. These outputs serve
different purposes; the score is not automatically the discounted value being trained.(mlpack
contributors, 2026)
  Random replay draws transition indices from a stored buffer; priority replay uses sampling
weights tied to priority and a training correction. Neither set of weights is the action propensity
39.56. C++ policy systems: logged decisions, supplied models and learned control              931


needed for causal off-policy evaluation. The inspected transition schema stores states, action,
reward, next state and termination, without a logging-probability field. A product requiring
causal evaluation must retain that information elsewhere and prove the join and sampling
semantics. Shuffling dependent transitions does not create independent banking customers
or remove policy-selection bias.(mlpack contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project,
2026ee)
   Two source-level boundary cases need explicit conformance tests. First, the categorical
target branch uses a single discount factor while the ordinary branch uses the replay step
count. With a three-step accumulated reward of three, discount 0.9 and continuation ten,
the corresponding scalar targets are 10.29 and 12. This difference requires a documented
restriction or a reviewed repair when multistep replay is combined with the categorical branch.
Second, the literal projection coefficients are zero when the transformed return falls exactly
on a support atom, unless another step supplies the missing mass. The inspected projection
loop does not show such a step. An authored unit mass at that atom therefore produces zero
under those literal coefficients instead of one. These are reproducible algebraic witnesses, not
an observed native benchmark failure.(mlpack contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal
project, 2026ee)
   The replay implementation waits for a full multistep buffer and truncates reward recursion
at a stored terminal event. How the final short tail is delivered, how multiple episodes are
separated, and whether sampling can occur before enough entries exist are part of the caller
contract to verify. Reward support limits and projection behavior need particular care when
the target is denominated in dollars: clipping a training distribution to chosen bounds is
not evidence that tail losses are absent.(mlpack contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal
project, 2026ee)


39.56.6     Concrete reuse and public qualification decisions

Vowpal Wabbit is a conditional candidate for a fixed-policy contextual-bandit worker with
authenticated propensities and a separately verified inference path. AI-Toolbox is a conditional
candidate for supplied-model planning and selected finite-policy references, with native off-
policy control deferred pending branch and terminal checks. mlpack is a conditional learned-
control or simulator comparator; the inspected categorical/multistep boundaries require

state causal evaluator.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026ee)
   The proposed CLI/MCP contract makes these roles explicit. A request declares whether
its target is logged-policy value, model-conditional value, learned-controller performance or
a policy-selection comparison. It includes action and feature clocks, eligibility, reward units,
discount duration, termination versus truncation, policy identity, logging or generative-model
identity, sampling unit, support, uncertainty method, versioned rights and runtime resources.
A response identifies assumptions, numerical diagnostics, refusal reasons and all failed or
unavailable requests. A consumer may not convert a missing propensity into a default or label
a simulator score as a bank estimate.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026ee)
   Known next work is concrete: choose exact distributions; resolve direct and transitive terms;
freeze finite public models and logged datasets with known assignment; create independent exact
references; test unsupported actions, incorrect propensities, terminal tails, ties, reward units,
clipping, categorical mass and restart behavior; then compare complete held-out workflows.
Tests of a proposed scientific contract do not require authentic bank data at this stage. Evidence
that the prototype is useful motivates the later expense of bank validation.(Causal banking
proposal project, 2026ee)

   Complete cost remains a separate decision input. At a stipulated 900 USD total cost,
100 requests, 75 conformant outputs and 45 useful outputs imply nine, 12 and 20 USD per

39.57      Reusing R bnlearn without losing graph, intervention or
           sampling meaning
A banking team may want one workflow that learns a dependency graph, fits local distributions,
simulates an intervention and reports a customer-level counterfactual. These are different
inferential tasks even when a package exposes them through neighboring functions. R bnlearn
provides a useful concrete case for the proposed library: preserve the package’s graph and
fitted-model semantics, state the extra causal assumptions, and refuse a stronger interpretation
than the supplied information supports. The present decision is to retain the selected release
as a reference and a conditional original-worker candidate. It does not enable a native
adapter.(Marco Scutari and bnlearn contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project,
2026cx)


39.57.1     Identity, maintenance and a bounded reuse choice

The selected CRAN mirror revision is 7d44622a52c29c2d666a8661d048e2b5709a7944, dated 17
July 2026, and declares package version 5.2.1. Its DESCRIPTION names Marco Scutari as
maintainer, requires R at least 4.4.0 and compiled C17 support, declares GPL version 2 or
later, and lists optional packages for graph conversion, inference, precision and regularization.
The mirror is a distribution snapshot; its activity is not the author’s complete development
history or a promise of future support. Installed-library equivalence, transitive terms, build
provenance and an operator remain to be qualified.(Marco Scutari and bnlearn contributors,
2026)
   The Python project with the same name is a distinct repository and distribution. Its pinned
README describes Python workflows and links to another inference ecosystem. It is not an
alias for the R package or evidence that the same functions, licenses, numerical conventions
or objects are interchangeable. A source-identity record must therefore include language,
repository, distribution and revision, rather than just the string bnlearn. The current review
makes no technical or rights admission for that namesake.(Python bnlearn contributors, 2026;
Causal banking proposal project, 2026cx)
   Scutari’s original article explains the historical separation between structure learning, local
parameter estimation, conditional-independence tests and score-based search. Its discrete and
Gaussian examples help motivate an interface that preserves data types and model assumptions.
The locally retained author version is arXiv revision 2, dated 10 July 2010, with placeholder
journal issue fields; it is not silently relabeled as the publisher’s final typesetting. Its 2010
algorithm and computing environment cannot establish the capabilities or behavior of the

39.57. Reusing R bnlearn without losing graph, intervention or sampling meaning             933


39.57.2     An equivalent graph is not an equivalent intervention

The inspected CPDAG documentation distinguishes an equivalence class from one consistent
DAG extension. It also explains that parametric restrictions, such as the permitted direction
between discrete and continuous variables in a conditional Gaussian model, can preserve
directions independently of observational evidence. A returned orientation must therefore
carry its provenance: compelled by the observational class, imposed by background knowledge,
forced by the model family, or selected as an extension.(Marco Scutari and bnlearn contributors,
2026)
   An exact authored example shows why this distinction changes a banking decision. Let A
be a standardized action intensity and Y a standardized response. Both variables have mean
zero, variance one and covariance 1/2. One Gaussian structural model is

                A = UA ,     Y = 12 A + UY ,      Var(UA ) = 1,   Var(UY ) = 34 ,

with independent disturbances. Another is

                Y = VY ,      A = 12 Y + VA ,     Var(VY ) = 1,   Var(VA ) = 34 ,

again with independent disturbances. Both generate exactly the same bivariate Gaussian
observation law. Increasing A by one unit changes expected Y by 1/2 in the first model and by
zero in the second. At a stipulated 100 USD per unit response and a 20 USD action cost, the
corresponding net values are 30 USD and minus 20 USD. More samples from that unchanged
observation law cannot select the correct action. External direction information, a justified
restriction or an intervention is needed.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026cx)
   The package’s causal frontend rejects a partially directed or cyclic graph for the inspected
graph-to-SCM, intervention and counterfactual branches. This is a useful syntactic boundary.
It does not establish that an accepted DAG is the correct causal graph. The proposed interface
retains the CPDAG and the reason for each additional orientation; it never silently turns one
consistent extension into an identified effect.(Marco Scutari and bnlearn contributors, 2026;
Causal banking proposal project, 2026cx)


39.57.3     A twin graph needs a specified cross-world model

The inspected graph conversion creates one exogenous parent per factual node and checks
generated labels for collisions. Twin construction shares exogenous nodes between factual and
counterfactual copies. For a fitted Gaussian network, the implementation constructs fitted
twin components. For other fitted-network classes, the inspected frontend falls back to a graph
construction, which does not retain a full fitted counterfactual distribution. A caller must
inspect the returned class and content before claiming a numerical counterfactual.(Marco
Scutari and bnlearn contributors, 2026)
   Even an interventional response distribution need not identify an individual’s cross-world
outcome. Let A and U be independent fair binary variables. In world one set Y = U for either
action; in world two set Y = U xor A. Both worlds give the same observed joint distribution,
with probability 1/4 for each (A, Y ) pair, and both give P (Y = 1 | do(A = a)) = 1/2 for
either a. For a customer observed with A = 0, Y = 0, however, the counterfactual Y (1) is
zero in world one and one in world two. These are explicitly stipulated structural models; the
second need not satisfy a faithfulness restriction. Their purpose is to show the information a
cross-world claim requires. A convenient twin representation does not supply that information
by itself.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026cx)
934                                                              Causal analysis for a universal bank


  Intervention values also have a distributional meaning. The selected discrete fitted-node
branch gives equal mass to the supplied set of levels. Supplying two levels is therefore not a
declaration of an arbitrary 90/10 stochastic intervention. With losses zero and 100 USD, an
equal mixture has expected loss 50 USD whereas a 90/10 mixture has expected loss ten. A
request for a stochastic policy must carry its probability law and use a qualified path that
preserves it.(Marco Scutari and bnlearn contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project,
2026cx)
   A separate static metadata question concerns Gaussian interventions. The inspected branch
changes the intercept and sets the standard deviation to zero, but assigns the requested fixed
values to the residual field before zeroing that field; it does not assign them to the stored
fitted-values field in those lines. With stored fitted values (1, 2) and a requested fixed value five,
the literal field assignments retain (1, 2) while residuals become zero. This is a targeted cache-
consistency test for a future native worker, not an observed error in its returned intervention
distribution.(Marco Scutari and bnlearn contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project,
2026cx)


39.57.4     Bootstrap strength is a statistic with a sampling law

The selected bootstrap frontend defaults to 200 replicates, a sample size equal to the number
of input rows and conversion to a CPDAG for arc strength. The generic backend samples rows
with replacement. A customer’s repeated visits or a common calendar shock are therefore not
automatically respected as independent sampling units. In an authored mean example with
20 independent customer clusters, 25 visits per customer, unit marginal variance and within-
customer correlation 0.6, the mean variance is 0.0308. Treating all 500 visits as independent
gives 0.002. That arithmetic is not a coverage theorem for graph search; it explains why a
row-resampling option cannot certify the graph’s sampling law.(Marco Scutari and bnlearn
contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026cx)
   The inspected C counter gives half weight in each direction to an undirected arc. It
computes adjacency strength by adding the two directional counts and direction by dividing
one directional count by that adjacency strength. Suppose 100 equally weighted graph
replicates contain 20 A → Y arcs, 40 undirected A − Y arcs and 40 absences. The forward
counter is 0.4, the reverse counter 0.2, adjacency strength 0.6 and reported forward direction
2/3. Only 0.2 of the replicates actually contain the directed arc. None of these quantities is
automatically a posterior probability that a causal orientation is true, or a confidence interval
for its effect.(Marco Scutari and bnlearn contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project,
2026cx)
   Model averaging adds another transformation: the inspected backend retains strengths
strictly above the selected threshold, always retains strength one, filters directions at least
0.5 and invokes a cycle-aware delegate where required. The returned graph and the complete
strength table should both survive conversion. Thresholding must not erase unresolved
orientations, missing edges or the distinction between stability and causal truth.(Marco Scutari
and bnlearn contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026cx)
   The generic bootstrap’s remapping of manipulated observations deserves an independent
test. Its inspected branch applies a first-match operation to each original manipulated row
index. For an original manipulated row two and a bootstrap index vector (2, 2, 3, 1), that
operation returns only position one, whereas the replicate contains manipulated copies at
positions one and two. This exact indexing witness motivates a targeted test of the selected
score and experiment-label path. It does not claim that every bootstrap algorithm takes
that branch or establish an observed end-to-end package failure.(Marco Scutari and bnlearn
39.57. Reusing R bnlearn without losing graph, intervention or sampling meaning              935


contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026cx)


39.57.5     Conditional queries need denominators and retained weights

The query documentation distinguishes logic sampling from likelihood weighting. Logic
sampling retains observations matching the evidence; the number accepted can be much
smaller than the number generated. The inspected probability routine returns zero when no
simulated observations match. That zero conflates a numerical convention with an unresolved
conditional query if an adapter reports it without the accepted-sample denominator. A future
worker should return a distinct insufficient-evidence status, its generated and accepted counts
and a justified Monte Carlo diagnostic.(Marco Scutari and bnlearn contributors, 2026; Causal
banking proposal project, 2026cx)
  Parallel query aggregation also requires an explicit estimator. The inspected dispatcher
takes the mean of worker probability estimates. If one worker has one accepted sample and one
event success while another has nine accepted samples and no success, the mean of ratios is 1/2
but the pooled ratio is 1/10. These are different finite simulation statistics. This witness does
not establish a general bias claim; it requires the product to name the aggregation law rather
than suggesting a pooled denominator it did not use.(Marco Scutari and bnlearn contributors,
2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026cx)
   Likelihood-weighted samples carry a weights attribute. Dropping that attribute while
exporting a table changes the estimate: with outcomes (0, 1) and weights (0.1, 0.9), the
weighted mean is 0.9 and the unweighted mean 0.5. The inspected C distribution sampler
explicitly errors on all-zero or all-missing weights, while the R probability path ends with a
weighted numerator divided by a weighted denominator. These are distinct failure interfaces
to test. The adapter should bind weights, effective information, missingness, random streams
and error status, rather than converting every numerical object into a successful causal
answer.(Marco Scutari and bnlearn contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project,
2026cx)


39.57.6     A concrete proposal decision and public prototype route

Retain bnlearn as a reference for graph-class, fitted-model and query contracts. A future
pinned R worker is a conditional candidate because it preserves native object semantics
more directly than a whole-library port. Defer native admission until exact distribution and
dependency rights, graph/class conversions, sampling units, numerical diagnostics and failure
behavior are qualified. Reject an automatic DAG-extension-to-causal-effect path, silent weight
removal, default zero for an unresolved query and a port justified only by language preference.
Alternatives include an independent small exact enumerator, another separately qualified
graph learner and a distinct symbolic identification stage.(Causal banking proposal project,
2026cx)
   The proposed CLI/MCP request includes graph type and orientation provenance; variable
states and units; population and information clock; model family and noise assumptions; fitted
parameter identity; observational, interventional or counterfactual target; intervention law;
sampling unit; seed, budget and computational limits. The response preserves the source
object class, ambiguity, weights, denominators, convergence and refusal status. A typed query
language should be translated through an allowlisted expression grammar; source examples
that evaluate R expressions do not justify exposing unrestricted expression execution to a
general caller.(Marco Scutari and bnlearn contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project,
2026cx)
936                                                          Causal analysis for a universal bank


   The next experiments can use generated finite networks and public data with documented
permissions. Predeclare graph equivalence, counterfactual-coupling, intervention-mixture,
manipulated-row, rare-evidence, parallel aggregation and weighted-export tests. Compare
independent exact answers and complete workflows before using authentic bank data. The
scientific owner supplies causal and sampling assumptions; the adapter owner supplies conver-
sion and refusal behavior; rights and platform owners bind distributions and dependencies;
the evaluation owner records all attempts and complete costs. At a stipulated 1,200 USD
total, 100 requests, 80 conformant outputs and 50 useful outputs imply 12, 15 and 24 USD per
respective unit. These costs explain denominators; they are not measured prices or adoption
evidence.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026cx)


39.58      Dose-response software: the intervention, the curve and
           the decision
A bank choosing the size of a credit-line increase needs more than a smooth curve relating
historical increases to revenue. Customers given large increases may have been selected because
of income, relationship value, or information held by a manager. Another team may instead
be designing randomized offer amounts; a third may only need to summarize an already
justified experiment. These questions motivate different software contracts. Our selected
comparison distinguishes causaldrf 0.4.2, CausalGPS 0.5.1 and WeightIt 2.1.0 from the
curve-fitting role of drc 4.0-0 and the experiment-analysis role of DoseFinding 1.4-1. Each is
a separately pinned CRAN mirror distribution no later than the source cutoff. The mirror
is not a complete author development history or a support guarantee. These five candidates
resolve part of the umbrella, not the multilingual or commercial market.(causaldrf contributors,
2022; CausalGPS contributors, 2026; WeightIt contributors, 2026; drc contributors, 2026;
DoseFinding contributors, 2025)


39.58.1    Define the causal curve before choosing a fitting routine

Let A be the offer amount in declared units, X the information available before the offer,
and Y (a) the outcome under a specified intervention assigning amount a. The population
response curve is µ(a) = E{Y (a)}. Consistency, conditional exchangeability for each dose,
positive conditional exposure density on the requested population and dose region, and suitable
regularity justify                 Z
                           µ(a) =    E(Y | A = a, X = x) dPX (x).

For a continuous exposure, the generalized propensity score is a conditional density, r(a, x) =
fA|X (a | x), not the probability of an exact dose. Conditional means at a point require an
appropriate version and smoothness; a finite sample does not contain repeated observations at
every amount. The CausalGPS original states the causal assumptions and separates outcome-
blind design from analysis. It limits balancing to measured covariates and refers detailed
theory elsewhere. This software paper cannot alone qualify every estimator or uncertainty
procedure.(Khoshnevis et al., 2023)
   An authored example makes the banking consequence concrete. Suppose X and U are
independent standard Gaussian variables, A = X + U , and Y = 2A + 3X + ε, with independent
centered noise. Then
                     Cov(A, Y )      Cov(A, X)                 dµ(a)
                                =2+3           = 3.5,                = 2.

At a stipulated value of 100 USD per outcome unit and a 220 USD cost for a one-unit increase,
the historical slope suggests 130 USD, while the stipulated causal model gives minus 20

39.58.2     causaldrf: transparent adjustment and transformation contracts

The inspected hi_est routine fits a treatment model, constructs a GPS, fits a user-specified
linear outcome surface, and averages predictions after replacing treatments with a requested
grid value and recomputing its GPS. Accepted families include normal, log-transformed and
square-root transformed normal, count and binary models. This is a useful transparent adjust-
ment reference; accepting several families does not validate covariate sufficiency. (causaldrf
contributors, 2022)
   In the log-normal branch, the expression evaluates a normal density at log(t) without the 1/t
Jacobian of an original-scale
                   √          log-normal density. The square-root branch similarly evaluates a
normal density at t. For t = 4 and transformed-scale density 1/5, the corresponding original-
scale log-normal density is 1/20. At a fixed dose, multiplying all scores by the same positive
dose-only factor preserves the information in the balancing score; transformation alone therefore
does not disprove fixed-dose balancing. However, a specified finite-dimensional outcome surface
in treatment and GPS can change, and an inverse-density or cross-dose consumer needs the
actual measure and units. A port must distinguish an original-scale density, a transformed-scale
score and an arbitrary balancing coordinate. (causaldrf contributors, 2022; Causal banking
proposal project, 2026dc)
   The inspected get_ci helper sorts bootstrap curve values separately at each grid point and
selects the ceiling of 0.975B and floor of 0.025B. It receives coefficient draws; it does not
justify their sampling law. With B = 20 the lower index is zero, an edge condition for future
qualification. This is an index-expression witness, not a native failure report. Separate 95
percent pointwise intervals also do not imply a simultaneous 95 percent band. In 100 equally
likely authored outcomes, disjoint sets of five misses at each of two points give 95 percent
coverage at each point and 90 percent joint coverage. Selecting an offer after searching a curve
needs a stated selection-aware or simultaneous uncertainty argument. (causaldrf contributors,
2022; Causal banking proposal project, 2026dc)


39.58.3     CausalGPS: preserve design diagnostics and population meaning

The 2023 original describes iterative design with hyperparameter search, transformations and
trimming. The inspected 0.5.1 generate_pseudo_pop body instead accepts a counter-weight
object, merges by identifier, computes diagnostics and returns their status. Its header still
describes an adaptive procedure; this inspected body is not itself the historical search loop.
An adapter must follow the pinned interface and record where tuning actually occurs. Unique
observation identifiers, join cardinality and the retained population belong to its contract.
(CausalGPS contributors, 2026; Khoshnevis et al., 2023)

   The normal GPS branch uses predicted exposure means and a common residual standard

the density delegate interpolates an estimated density with constant extrapolation outside its

with residual density g and positive scale s(x), the original-scale density is

The selected weighting routine divides a marginal exposure density by the exported GPS. With

   Units provide another exact check. Changing dollars to cents multiplies the exposure by 100
and divides both densities by 100. The stabilized ratio stays 2 when densities change from 1/5
and 1/10 to 1/500 and 1/1000. The reciprocal conditional density changes from 10 to 1,000.

or the policy numerator.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026dc)
   The balance routine compares a selected mean, median or maximum absolute correlation with
a threshold. Zero correlation is not independence: with equal weights on X ∈ {−2, −1, 1, 2}
and A = X 2 , covariance is zero while exposure depends entirely on X. This deterministic
example also lacks overlap. Adding independent continuous noise with an everywhere positive
density restores conditional density support without independence, while preserving zero
covariance. Nonlinear diagnostics complement causal assumptions. (CausalGPS contributors,
2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026dc)
   The original includes adverse findings. Its first two illustrated matching attempts fail a
maximum-correlation threshold of 0.1, with maxima 0.198 and 0.123. A third reports 0.094
after retaining 464,194 of 580,244 observations; its reported effective sample size is about
7,635, below its displayed recommended 46,419. These are historical reported quantities, not
reproduced results or universal thresholds. The paper omits the detailed interval calculation
and calls the final curve illustrative. (Khoshnevis et al., 2023)
   The current outcome frontend rejects negative weights but replaces an all-zero vector by
equal weights. It computes plotting normalization using the weight range, zero for equal
weights. Our contract treats an empty weighted population as unresolved, not permission
to change the scientific target. Outcomes 0 and 100 with zero weights make the distinction
explicit: replacement yields 50, while the requested weighted mean has no denominator.
In addition, trim_gps accesses dataset, whereas the inspected GPS creator returns .data;

39.58.4    WeightIt: retain history and the actual uncertainty method

WeightIt’s selected primary text distinguishes binary and multicategory estimands, continuous
stabilized density weights and longitudinal products. The continuous GLM delegate returns unit
weights with no covariates and no random effects, otherwise estimates a weighted residual scale,
and constructs estimating-equation components only for supported configurations. Kernel,

specified missing-data and random-effects paths are excluded from that particular M-estimation

   The outcome interface distinguishes M-estimation accounting for estimated weights, fixed-

   The trimming interface distinguishes winsorizing from setting weights to zero and warns that

39.58.5     drc and DoseFinding: useful roles after design justification

The selected drc frontend accepts curve family, outcome type, weights and model structure.
Its effective-dose interface distinguishes relative and absolute response targets, checks the
relative range, and offers no interval, delta, transformed-scale and inverse-regression routes.
These fitting and inverse response tools do not provide the causal identification argument for
a banking assignment. We retain drc as a descriptive or scientifically justified post-design
comparator and reject automatic curve-to-effect admission. (drc contributors, 2026)
   DoseFinding’s inspected MCPMod path tests model-based contrasts, retains significant
shapes, then fits and selects or averages models and computes a target or effective dose.
A nonsignificant result returns no model or target; it is not a zero effect estimate. The
contrast routine accepts either a covariance matrix or compatible allocation weights and
checks exclusivity. The general route requires supplied estimates and covariance with already
valid scientific and sampling meanings; the normal route obtains them from its fitted model.
Multiplicity-adjusted testing of declared contrasts does not automatically validate post-selection
uncertainty for an optimized policy. (DoseFinding contributors, 2025)
   An exact illustration has means (0, 1, 2) at three randomized doses and independent mean
variances 1/100. Contrast (−1, 0, 1) has signal 2, variance 2/100 and squared standardized

39.58.6     Reuse decisions and public qualification before bank experiments

We choose reference use now: causaldrf for transparent GPS adjustment, CausalGPS for design
and balance contracts, WeightIt for point and longitudinal weighting, drc for fitting and inverse
targets, and DoseFinding for experimental contrasts. An original R worker is a conditional
future route when it preserves objects, diagnostics and uncertainty. A whole-library port lacks
a demonstrated benefit. We reject automatic curve-to-causal and balance-to-identification
admission; native admission awaits exact distributions, dependencies, rights and semantic
evidence.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026dc)
   Declarations differ. causaldrf declares MIT plus its copyright file, R at least 3.1.2 and
imported/optional packages; CausalGPS declares GPL-3, R at least 3.5, Rcpp compilation and
learning/smoothing dependencies. WeightIt declares GPL at least version 2, R at least 4.1 and
method-dependent optional dependencies. drc declares GPL-2 and R at least 4; DoseFinding
declares GPL-3 and compiled code. These are declarations, not transitive distribution clearance
or a legal conclusion. Rights, maintenance owners, installed versions and optional paths must
be resolved for the actual worker. (causaldrf contributors, 2022; CausalGPS contributors, 2026;
WeightIt contributors, 2026; drc contributors, 2026; DoseFinding contributors, 2025)
   Public qualification can precede expensive bank access. Freeze version, transformation, in-
tervention density, population and dose region. Generate known-outcome experiments covering
confounding, nonlinear balance, weak overlap, varying scales, dependence and misspecification.
Compare analytical targets with the pinned worker. Test invalid identifiers, empty/extreme
weights, trimming, missing fields, unsupported covariance types, selection, serialization and
process failure. Refit estimated stages under the justified resampling law, retain failed requests,
and distinguish pointwise from simultaneous claims. Tuning and final assessment must not
reuse the same outcomes. (Causal banking proposal project, 2026dc)
   The scientific owner supplies causal assumptions and sampling units; the adapter owner
preserves units, measures, histories, objects and refusal states; the rights/platform owner
qualifies the distribution; the evaluator registers independent targets and complete costs.
Illustratively, 2,400 USD for 100 requests, 80 conformant outputs and 60 useful outputs
gives 24, 30 and 40 USD per respective denominator. These are not measured prices or
adoption returns. Unmeasured confounding, absent support, arbitrary dependence and policy-
selection uncertainty have no automatic software cure. Other languages, commercial systems,
uninspected delegates and dependency closures remain survey work. This bounded reference
decision admits no native capability and does not close the broader proposal standard.(Causal
banking proposal project, 2026dc)


39.59      R mediation: mechanism questions require an explicit
           intervention contract
A servicing intervention may improve repayment partly through customer contact, understand-
ing or a revised payment plan. A sponsor may ask how much of the total benefit follows the
proposed mechanism and whether investing in that mechanism alone would reproduce the
39.59. R mediation: mechanism questions require an explicit intervention contract               941


benefit. These are distinct questions. R mediation 4.5.1 is a useful reference for model-based,
design-based, sensitivity and selected noncompliance analyses, but its fitted effects cannot
supply the scientific meaning of an intervention on understanding or contact. The selected
source is the cutoff-pinned CRAN distribution at commit dated 8 June 2025; its declared
publication is 7 June. We distinguish that mirror identity from the author repository and from
the installed environment. (Tingley,Yamamoto and mediation contributors, 2025)
   The authentic bundled author paper has 40 pages and matches the title and five authors in
the package’s 2014 citation. Its PDF was generated with the selected 2025 distribution; it is not
asserted to be the final 38-page publisher layout. It separates the general model-based approach
from designs with different identification assumptions, and explicitly states that treatment
randomization alone does not identify causal mediation effects. Its historical interface and
examples are read alongside the current pinned source. (Tingley et al., 2014)


39.59.1     Natural components, controlled interventions and a banking deci-
            sion

Write M (t) for the mediator under treatment t and Y (t, m) for the outcome under a joint
treatment and mediator intervention. Natural indirect and direct effects are

        δ(t) = E{Y (t, M (1)) − Y (t, M (0))},      ζ(t) = E{Y (1, M (t)) − Y (0, M (t))}.

The total effect satisfies τ = δ(0) + ζ(1) = δ(1) + ζ(0). The indices pair across treatment
conditions; summing arbitrary same-index components need not recover the total. The
original’s sequential ignorability assumption adds mediator–outcome restrictions and support
conditions beyond treatment randomization. In particular, the standard identification route
excludes the relevant post-treatment confounding, even when a confounder is measured. A
model fit cannot verify this premise. (Tingley et al., 2014)
   In our authored model, let M (t) = 2t + U with E(U ) = 1 and Y (t, m) = t + 3m + 4tm.
The natural indirect effects are (6, 14) and the natural direct effects (5, 13), giving total effect
19 through either correct pairing. The same-index sums are 11 and 27. At a stipulated 100
USD per outcome unit, the indirect component is 600 USD under one treatment setting and
1,400 USD under the other. Neither is automatically the value of a stand-alone mediator
service. A controlled contrast sets m to specified values; a natural effect couples the mediator
that would arise under another treatment to the outcome under the selected treatment. A
stochastic mediator intervention is another target with its own intervention distribution and
identification conditions. (Causal banking proposal project, 2026du)
   The earlier project reference supplies a stronger negative example that we preserve unchanged.
With randomized fair binary A, independent fair U and M (a) = a XOR U , the worlds
Y (a, m) = a and Y (a, m) = m XOR U have the same observed distribution and mediator
overlap. Their natural decomposition differs. Thus even perfect measurement of this observed
law does not settle the mechanism without more restrictions or information. The earlier
controlled-intervention, negative mediated-proportion and residual-sensitivity constructions
remain separate from any claim about a package’s native execution. (Causal banking proposal
project, 2026ar)


39.59.2     Preserve target labels, population and model-object semantics

The inspected mediate frontend accepts fitted mediator and outcome models, explicit treatment
and control values, simulation count, bootstrap choice and uncertainty options. If supplied
categorical treatment values do not match factor levels, it warns and falls back to the first two
942                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


levels. That is an observable source contract, not an acceptable silent conversion for a banking
API. A request for labels none and offer cannot be treated as a request for declined and
offered without a verified mapping. The proposed adapter refuses unmapped labels and
returns the exact values used when a mapping is declared. (Tingley,Yamamoto and mediation
contributors, 2025; Causal banking proposal project, 2026du)
   When dropobs is enabled, the source merges the model frames and refits on shared rows. It
warns about possible cluster alignment problems with missing observations. The observation
population therefore belongs in the result. Mediator identifiers {a, b, c} and outcome identifiers
{b, c, d} intersect at only {b, c}. The common sample represents half the union, not an
unchanged four-customer target. An adapter must retain the original row identities, model-
frame membership, missingness rule and refitted sample, and must not use row counts as
a substitute for matching identities. (Tingley,Yamamoto and mediation contributors, 2025;
Causal banking proposal project, 2026du)
   The source treats prior model weights as sampling weights, warns when a binomial mediator
model could invite a trial-count interpretation, and checks matching weights between the
relevant model frames. Effects (0, 10) with weights (1, 9) average to 9, while equal weights
give 5. Importing binomial trial totals as population weights can therefore change the target,
not just its standard error. Dependency objects and their classes must retain this meaning
through CLI or MCP serialization. (Tingley,Yamamoto and mediation contributors, 2025;
Causal banking proposal project, 2026du)


39.59.3     Simulation, sampling uncertainty and sensitivity are different ob-
            jects

The frontend warns that its cluster and robustSE options are ignored for the ordinary
nonparametric bootstrap path; the inspected call uses boot::boot with an ordinary simulation
setting. Some mixed-model combinations instead require the non-bootstrap path. A cluster
option in a request cannot be assumed to qualify the returned interval. The adapter must
record the executed uncertainty route, warnings and sampling unit and refuse an unsupported
dependent-data claim. In an authored exchangeable example with 20 independent customers,
25 unit-variance visits each and within-customer correlation 0.6, mean variance is 0.0308 rather
than the independent-visit 0.002. This is an analytical warning example, not a native coverage
experiment. (Tingley,Yamamoto and mediation contributors, 2025; Causal banking proposal
project, 2026du)
   The inspected quasi-Bayesian branch summarizes the proportion mediated using the median
of simulated effect ratios, while the bootstrap branch forms a ratio from point effects. These
are distinct summaries. Indirect draws (1, 2, 9) and total draws (1, 4, 10) have median ratio 0.9
and ratio of means 0.8. The bridge should preserve both the field definition and the underlying
draws when needed, not compare unlike summaries as a numerical defect. If an indirect effect
is 1 and a direct effect minus 1, total effect is zero and the proportion is undefined. Negative
or greater-than-one proportions can also have a valid algebraic origin; coercing all outputs to
a percentage in [0, 1] destroys their meaning. (Tingley,Yamamoto and mediation contributors,
2025; Causal banking proposal project, 2026du,ar)
   The selected medsens documentation and branches support specific linear and binary-probit
combinations; binary-outcome interactions and a logit outcome are excluded in the inspected
route. The sensitivity parameter ρ represents a hypothetical association of model errors.
Varying it does not estimate actual hidden confounding or create a confidence interval over all
possible causal worlds. The linear branch solves stacked equations at successive ρ values using
a coefficient-change stopping condition; its inspected loop has no explicit iteration budget. A
39.59. R mediation: mechanism questions require an explicit intervention contract           943


prototype must bound process time, preserve nonconvergence and singular-matrix failures, and
test the requested grid and tolerance. A smaller numerical error cannot cure an unsupported
causal restriction. (Tingley,Yamamoto and mediation contributors, 2025; Tingley et al., 2014;
Causal banking proposal project, 2026ar)


39.59.4     Design and noncompliance routes retain their own assumptions

The single-experiment interface distinguishes a sequential-ignorability point analysis from a
bound calculation. The parallel-design interface distinguishes a no-interaction point route from
its alternative bound route. Binary coding, missing-row removal, experimental assignment
and mediator manipulation must be retained; a bound on a natural effect is not a sampling
confidence interval or proof of a feasible mediator intervention. The original emphasizes that
mediator manipulation needs an interpretation with no unintended direct effect. Its selected
parallel-design page contains differing prose and displayed numerical values; we do not treat
those numbers as reproduced evidence. (Tingley,Yamamoto and mediation contributors, 2025;
Tingley et al., 2014)
  The multiple-mediator documentation describes a varying-coefficient linear structural model,
point effects under homogeneous treatment–mediator interaction, and sensitivity to interaction
heterogeneity. This is a specific route for selected post-treatment confounding, not a general
permission to adjust for any downstream variable. The noncompliance interface targets
complier-local mediation and direct effects, distinct from a full-population effect. Its source
documentation limits model families and notes potentially expensive numerical integration.
The present reference decision does not claim a complete proof or implementation audit of
those delegates. (Tingley,Yamamoto and mediation contributors, 2025)
   Numerical failure can change the averaging population. In the inspected continuous-mediator
path with covariates, non-finite integration values are excluded from each component’s mean
and issue counts are returned. The no-covariate path extracts integration values without
the same per-observation issue accounting. These are branch-specific static observations. If
stipulated complete contributions are (1, 3, 100) but the last is unresolved, averaging the
finite values gives 2 instead of the complete mean 104/3. We do not impute the missing
contribution or call the selected mean the original target. The worker must return counts,
integration status, component-specific retained sets and a declared failure policy. Different
retained sets can also undermine an apparent decomposition identity, even when each scalar
looks finite. (Tingley,Yamamoto and mediation contributors, 2025; Causal banking proposal
project, 2026du)


39.59.5     A bounded reuse decision and public qualification route

We retain mediation 4.5.1 as a reference and comparison candidate. A conditional original
R worker can preserve fitted classes, uncertainty choices and design objects better than
an unmotivated complete port. Direct admission is deferred until the chosen scope has
rights, dependency, scientific and numerical qualification. We reject automatic interpretation
of natural components as stand-alone banking interventions and automatic promotion of
sensitivity scenarios to identified uncertainty. The declared GPL at least version 2, R at
least 2.15.1 and dependencies including MASS, Matrix, mvtnorm, sandwich, lpSolve, Hmisc
and lme4 identify requirements; they do not clear a complete commercial distribution or
establish continuing maintenance support. (Tingley,Yamamoto and mediation contributors,
2025; Causal banking proposal project, 2026du)
  A public/generated study can first replay independent natural-effect identities, observation-
944                                                          Causal analysis for a universal bank


ally equivalent worlds, treatment interactions, weighted populations, model-frame mismatches,
categorical mappings, zero total effects, clustered histories and integration failures. Freeze
models, grids, versions, seeds, warning/refusal policies, all denominators and full workflow
costs before final evaluation. Compare the exact target and the actual uncertainty method,
not merely returned field names. The scientific owner justifies the mechanism and design;
the adapter owner preserves semantics; the rights/platform owner qualifies the environment;
and the evaluator maintains independent oracles and failed-request accounting. Illustrative
cost of 1,800 USD across 100 requests, 75 conformant outputs and 60 useful outputs gives 18,

identification, hidden confounding, arbitrary persistence and institutional acceptance remain

39.60      Julia policy evaluation: a supplied model and logged
           experience answer different questions
A servicing team may want to compare a fixed contact rule with today’s practice, choose a
better rule, or value the best rule available with information that will actually arrive before
each action. Those questions require different experiments. The existing POMDPs.jl review
establishes a root planning interface, not a statistical identification result. We now inspect
its concrete POMDPTools 1.1.0 evaluation and simulation delegates at the same 8 June
2026 revision. Separately, a bounded Julia search identifies Hu and Wager’s partial-history
importance-weighting research code and its genuine May 2023 author original. The first route
evaluates a supplied transition model; the second learns a stationary policy value from logged
trajectories under explicit assignment and mixing restrictions. Neither route alone qualifies a
learned bank policy or an arbitrary latent-state business process. (JuliaPOMDP contributors,
2026; Zachary Sunberg and contributors, 2026; Yuchen Hu and Stefan Wager, 2023; Hu and
Wager, 2023)


39.60.1    A linear solve is conditional on the model and the policy

For a fixed Markov policy π, a finite-state transition matrix Pπ and expected one-step reward
vector rπ , discounted value solves

                         vπ = rπ + γPπ vπ ,     vπ = (I − γPπ )−1 rπ .

A stochastic transition matrix and 0 ≤ γ < 1 supply a standard sufficient condition for
invertibility; a finite-horizon problem instead needs a finite recursion, and an undiscounted
recurrent problem requires a different argument. The inspected evaluate method is an MDP
method. It forms separate policy transition and reward objects and solves the linear system.
Its matrix has current states in rows and successor states in columns; terminal rows and their
subsequent reward are zero. This is source evidence for a concrete computation, not evidence
that bank transition probabilities are causally identified or that the model’s uncertainty is
calibrated. (Zachary Sunberg and contributors, 2026)
   Suppose an unsettled account receives expected reward 6 each step, remains unsettled with
probability one half and otherwise terminates, with discount 0.9. The supplied-model infinite
value is 120/11, while the two-step value is 8.7. A settlement reward of 12 earned on entry
to a terminal state remains 12; zero continuation after settlement does not remove it. These
exact examples distinguish horizon, reward timing and model semantics without claiming a
Julia execution. Transition rows, reward units, terminal flags and the policy information set
belong in the CLI/MCP request and response. (Causal banking proposal project, 2026eg)
39.60. Julia policy evaluation: a supplied model and logged experience answer different questions945


   The inspected matrix and reward builders call action(policy,state) separately. A
deterministic state-to-action policy is straightforward. A policy whose call samples a fresh
action needs an explicit construction of its action mixture before this calculation can be
interpreted as that randomized policy’s value. Consider an action that gives zero and stays,
and another that pays 10 and exits, selected with equal probability at each step. Its value is
100/11. If transition and reward are assembled from independent single action draws, the four
possible scalar solves give 0, 10, 0, 100, whose mean is 55/2. This is an authored warning about
an unqualified stochastic-policy conversion, not a claim that every stochastic policy object
behaves this way. Audit the concrete dispatch or explicitly average over the action law, then
verify against an independent finite oracle. (Zachary Sunberg and contributors, 2026; Causal
banking proposal project, 2026eg)


39.60.2     The simulator’s information and stopping rules are part of the
            target

The partially observed rollout with an explicit updater acts on its initialized belief, generates
a joint next-state/observation/reward event, accumulates reward and updates the belief. The
inspected convenience overload receiving a POMDP and an initial state instead converts to
UnderlyingMDP. A wrapper must therefore bind the method signature, not infer the information
set from the word POMDP in the model type. In a one-step authored example, a fair hidden
binary state and constant observation give value zero when matching the state pays 10 and a
mismatch loses 10. A policy allowed to see the state earns 10. That difference is information
leakage relative to the partially observed target; it is not evidence of a superior deployable
policy. (Zachary Sunberg and contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026eg)
    The rollout stops at terminal state, its explicit maximum number of steps, or a discount-
weight threshold. Its defaults permit a very large horizon and zero threshold. A threshold on
γ t is not a dollar error bound. If |Rt | ≤ Rmax and 0 ≤ γ < 1, truncating after H steps leaves
an absolute tail bounded by
                                                  γH
                                            Rmax      .
                                                 1−γ
At Rmax = 10, γ = 0.9 and H = 5, that bound is 59.049. A wrapper must return the chosen
horizon, residual bound and timeout status; finite output is not sufficient evidence that a
requested infinite-horizon precision was met. The history recorder computes a threshold-related
horizon using logarithms, so zero/one discounts and nonpositive thresholds need explicit input-
domain tests rather than assumptions borrowed from a different method. (Zachary Sunberg
and contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026eg)
   Failure status changes interpretation. With exception capture enabled, HistoryRecorder
returns the accumulated prefix together with the exception and backtrace. The inspected
default batch processor reduces a history to discounted reward, and that reward accessor
sums the recorded rewards without checking the exception field. Thus an adapter using this
composition must preserve exceptions itself. A prefix reward of 5 does not establish full value
5; if a stipulated missing continuation is minus 100, the complete value would be minus 95. In
real failed requests that continuation is unknown and must not be imputed. Return episode
length, stopping reason, exception, partial reward and completion flag, retain all requested
episodes in the denominator, and supply a custom batch processor. No native failure frequency
or performance claim is inferred from static composition. (Zachary Sunberg and contributors,
2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026eg)
