39.60.3     Partial histories can identify a different, stationary value

Hu and Wager study a partially observed Markov process with observed state Xit , hidden state
Hit , action Ait and reward Yit . Their behavior policy π0 (a | Xit ) is known and depends only
on the observed state. It cannot additionally depend on the hidden state after conditioning on
that observed information. The target policy also maps observed state to action probabilities.
Their finite-state stationary target Vi (π) is the mean reward for unit i under the target policy’s
stationary law; the population target averages over independently sampled heterogeneous units.
It is not the discounted finite-initial-belief value in the preceding subsection. (Hu and Wager,
2023)
  For a history length k, their estimator is
                                   n        T    k
                                                 (                          )
                               1   X  1    X    Y   π(Ai,t−s | Xi,t−s )
                   Vb (π; k) =                                                  Yit .
                              n i=1 T − k t=k+1 s=0 π0 (Ai,t−s | Xi,t−s )

The product includes k + 1 actions, including the current action. It is not self-normalized
by the sum of the weights. The inspected simple-example implementation uses this rolling
product and averages the aligned weighted rewards; its k = −1 branch returns the unweighted
mean. For importance ratios (2, 0, 2, 2) and rewards (1, 2, 3, 4), our exact outputs are 4 for
k = 0, 16/3 for k = 1 and zero for k = 2. These finite values are arithmetic witnesses, not a
statement that one window identifies the bank target. (Hu and Wager, 2023; Yuchen Hu and
Stefan Wager, 2023; Causal banking proposal project, 2026eg)
   The paper requires a uniform contraction bound on the joint observed/hidden state law
under the policies considered, a bounded action-density ratio, reward moment restrictions and
stationary initial behavior distributions for its main theorem. Its contraction requirement is
stronger than merely asserting asymptotic mixing. Longer histories reduce the retained-initial-
law bias but increase the weight variability. With fair binary logging and a deterministic
target, a matching window has probability 2−(k+1) , weight 2k+1 and weight second moment
2k+1 . A zero estimate from windows with no matches does not demonstrate zero policy value.
The proposal must include support and weight diagnostics, admissible histories and an honest
refusal or inconclusive result when the data cannot support the target. (Hu and Wager, 2023;
Causal banking proposal project, 2026eg)
   The paper distinguishes the average value of sampled units from population value. Between-
unit heterogeneity adds a sampling term that longer trajectories cannot remove. Its unequal-
length expression averages unit-specific estimates, not all visits equally. Two units with values
10 and zero observed for two and eight visits have equal-unit average 5 and pooled-visit
average 2. For banking, the unit must be an independently justified customer or cluster, and
the population weighting must match the investment question. Common calendar shocks or
cross-customer interference are not covered by labeling visits independent. (Hu and Wager,
2023; Causal banking proposal project, 2026eg)
   The paper’s central limit theorem adds growth and nondegeneracy restrictions and centers
the estimator on its expectation. Its text cautions that an MSE-motivated window need not
satisfy that theorem’s growth condition, while its simulations show less Gaussian behavior
at large windows and small sample sizes. The inspected tuning code uses one estimated
standard-error interval as an overlap rule; the paper also states that its experimental multiplier
is one. Neither observation supplies a nominal 95 percent interval for a bias-affected, adaptively
selected target. Separate fixed-window uncertainty, remaining truncation bias and tuning or
policy-selection effects. An estimated logger and dynamic policy learning are explicit extensions
beyond the original paper’s stated known-logger evaluation setting. (Hu and Wager, 2023;
Yuchen Hu and Stefan Wager, 2023)
39.61. R tmle: preserve the target and audit uncertainty before reuse                         947


39.60.4     Research scripts need a reproducible target before reuse

The cutoff-pinned research repository contains ten files: a README and Julia/R simulation
and aggregation scripts for two simple examples and a synthetic mobile-health example.
Its complete selected tree has no license declaration, Project.toml or Manifest.toml; this
observation does not settle rights outside that tree. The scripts use absolute output paths and
choose a random seed before setting it. The README directs repeated runs with different
seeds, and the aggregator reads available output files without an independent manifest of
expected completed requests. A prototype needs documented rights, an exact environment,
caller-supplied seed schedule, portable paths, run identities and expected/failed/completed
counts before any reproduction claim. (Yuchen Hu and Stefan Wager, 2023)
   The synthetic mobile-health scripts also illustrate why a literature result and its numerical
implementation need separate comparison. The paper’s reward categories include boundary
values 70, 80 and 150; the selected source’s strict comparisons return zero at those three exact
boundaries instead of the paper’s −3, −1, −1. The estimator’s glucose feature uses the stored
previous value, whereas the current value is a distinct field. A previous value of 120 and
current value of 130 produce different decisions at threshold 125. These are source-to-definition
and information-clock questions, not clinical advice or an asserted native benchmark defect.
Resolve the intended indexing and units before transporting a target or comparing a reference
reward. The published example is simulated from a stated model, not authentic bank or
clinical outcome validation, and no numerical study has been rerun here. (Hu and Wager,
2023; Yuchen Hu and Stefan Wager, 2023; Causal banking proposal project, 2026eg)
   The appropriate proposal disposition is a conditional POMDPTools worker for supplied-
model finite or justified discounted evaluation, and a research reference for partial-history
weighting under a justified known logger. Do not inherit the root interface’s rights across
packages, infer a native capability from static review, port an entire ecosystem without
a demonstrated benefit, or translate stationary mean rewards into discounted bank cash
flows without an explicit horizon model. POMDPTools declares its own MIT license and
Julia/dependency compatibility; its complete installed dependency closure, solver choices and
operating costs still require review. (Zachary Sunberg and contributors, 2026; Causal banking
proposal project, 2026eg)
   A public/generated qualification can freeze model and policy identities, information clock,
discount/horizon, logger and support, window/tuning rule, seed list, exact finite oracles, failure
policy and held-out scenarios. Compare both the ordinary and adverse cases: randomized
policies, state leakage, terminal-entry rewards, threshold/domain limits, captured exceptions,
zero matching windows, unknown logging and nonstationarity. Measure compilation, model
audit, computation, serialization, rights review, recovery and maintenance. Illustrative cost
2,400 USD across 100 requests, 80 conformant outputs and 60 useful outputs gives 24, 30 and
40 USD per denominator; these are not measured prices. The current bounded Julia/Rust
discovery query and selected source reviews do not close every other-language candidate or
establish an absence of Rust software. Search tails, concrete solvers, native experiments and
unsupported scientific regimes remain explicit obligations. (Causal banking proposal project,
2026eg)

39.61.1     Point-treatment meaning, weighting and the population clock

Let W contain information available before the offer, A ∈ {0, 1} its assignment, Y the
later repayment indicator, and ∆ its observation indicator. Under consistency, conditional
exchangeability, treatment positivity and an appropriate outcome-observation assumption, an
identified point-treatment mean may be represented by an average of Qa (W ), where Qa is
the conditional outcome regression at treatment a. These are substantive premises for the
proposal, not conclusions of a successful regression. Sampling weights wi produce the empirical
plug-in targets
                                                                            µ1 /(1 − µ1 )
                 P
                  i wi Qa (Wi )                               µ1
          µa =                    ,   RD = µ1 − µ0 ,   RR =      ,   OR =                 .
                                                                            µ0 /(1 − µ0 )
                     P
                      i wi                                    µ0
The source normalizes observation weights to sum to the number of rows and uses corresponding
weighted means. Its parameter helper calculates these contrasts and distinct influence-function
expressions. The adapter must report the actual target, denominator, observation rule and
weight interpretation. (Gruber,van der Laan and tmle contributors, 2025)
   In an authored two-profile example, weights (1, 3) and regression predictions Q0 = (0.1, 0.4),
Q1 = (0.2, 0.5) give µ0 = 13/40, µ1 = 17/40, RD = 1/10, RR = 17/13 and OR = 459/299.
At a stipulated 200 USD per incremental repayment, the difference gives 20 USD per offer
before costs; the ratio itself is not a dollar benefit. Neither a fitted conditional mean nor an
externally supplied prediction matrix establishes the causal assumptions. A later prototype
must preserve training, fold, prediction and customer identities and qualify the actual nuisance
estimation and uncertainty route. (Causal banking proposal project, 2026et)
   Observation and customer populations also differ. One customer with one row and effect
zero, and another with three rows each having effect ten, give a row-average effect of 7.5 and
an equal-customer average of 5. The inspected helper averages influence-function contributions
within identifiers and divides the variance of those means by the number of identifiers. Whether
that aligns with a weighted row target requires its sampling law and cluster-size argument;
an identifier field alone is insufficient. For row scores (−3, 1, 1, 1) in clusters of sizes one
and three, the cluster means are (−3, 1) and their sample variance divided by two is 4. For
comparison, the cluster-sum contributions scaled by the observed cluster-to-row ratio are
(−1.5, 1.5), whose sample variance divided by two is 9/4. This is exact arithmetic illustrating
different contributions, not a proof of native miscalibration or a universal prescription for
dependent observations. (Gruber,van der Laan and tmle contributors, 2025; Causal banking
proposal project, 2026et)

39.61.2     Intermediate-variable targets and a specific interval discrepancy

When the supplied intermediate variable has more than one observed value, the source con-
structs intervention predictions at its two binary levels and uses joint treatment, intermediate-
variable and outcome-observation probabilities. A controlled intervention on a mediator needs
a defensible action and the corresponding sequential exchangeability and support assumptions.
Conditioning on an observed mediator value is not automatically the same intervention. Trun-
cating a probability of 0.01 to 0.1 changes an inverse contribution from 100 to 10; it does
not create unobserved interventions or prove identification. The source’s explicit bounds and
retained rows belong in the result contract. (Gruber,van der Laan and tmle contributors, 2025;
Causal banking proposal project, 2026et)
   A concrete static discrepancy matters for this route. Its bootstrap matrix is named, in order,
EY0, EY1, ATE, logRR and logOR. The source fills the fourth column with log risk ratios and
uses column four for the risk-ratio variance, but constructs its risk-ratio bootstrap interval by
exponentiating quantiles of column three. The ordinary point-treatment branch uses column
four for this interval. We verified the column definitions, assignments, branch condition and
output statements; this is a mismatch in the selected source, not an observed package execution.
(Gruber,van der Laan and tmle contributors, 2025)
   The difference is visible without running that implementation. If every row of an authored
bootstrap fixture has risks 0.1 and 0.2, its risk difference is 0.1 and its risk ratio is 2. Exponen-
tiating the constant difference gives exp(0.1) ≃ 1.10517 instead of 2. Thus column substitution
changes the scientific quantity even when numerical routines return finite values. The proposed
integration refuses the affected interval pending a separately reviewed correction or qualified
successor. A repair must use named quantities, check both intermediate-variable levels and
all interval fields, and preserve the unmodified original with the evidence. We do not patch
upstream code or silently present our arithmetic as its native output. (Causal banking proposal
project, 2026et)


39.61.3     Bootstrap counts, missing outputs and uncertainty admission

Both inspected branches iterate from one through B. Iterations below B resample identifiers,
while the last uses the original sample so returned fits have the original identities. Quantiles
are calculated over the full matrix. Consequently the inspected loop contains B − 1 resampled
rows and one original row, which must be distinguished from a request for B independent
resamples. For an authored vector (0, 1, 100), where the last value represents the original
sample, linear-interpolated 2.5 and 97.5 percent quantiles are 0.05 and 95.05. Using only the
two stipulated resamples gives 0.025 and 0.975. These numbers isolate a counting convention;
they do not measure empirical coverage. (Gruber,van der Laan and tmle contributors, 2025;
Causal banking proposal project, 2026et)
   The inspected variance call does not remove missing values, while its quantile calls explicitly
do. With the illustrative vector (1, NA, 3) the variance is missing but the finite-only quantile
interval is [1.05, 2.95]. A successful interval field cannot hide its incomplete denominator. The
future worker must return requested, attempted, original-sample, finite and failed counts, and
identify the actual nuisance-fitting and targeting steps repeated. The intermediate-variable
bootstrap samples identifiers separately from the two observed mediator groups and then
includes all rows for each sampled identifier. Identifiers spanning both groups require explicit
scrutiny; disjoint resampling populations cannot be presumed from a row-level mediator label.
(Gruber,van der Laan and tmle contributors, 2025; Causal banking proposal project, 2026et)
  The proposal therefore separates influence-function intervals, targeted bootstrap intervals,
950                                                             Causal analysis for a universal bank


sensitivity scenarios and identification failures. Boundary risks, zero ratio denominators,
unsupported missingness, nuisance failures, truncation, nonconvergence and incomplete repli-
cates need typed outcomes. Neither an interval label nor the documentation’s suggested high
iteration count proves coverage for arbitrary bank panels or adaptive policies. (Causal banking
proposal project, 2026et)


39.61.4     Rights, alternatives and a bounded adoption decision

The DESCRIPTION declares BSD_3_clause + file LICENSE | GPL-2; the selected LI-

describes educational, research and not-for-profit permission and directs commercial inquiries

index. Declared dependencies include glmnet and SuperLearner, with optional learners and
diagnostics; an installed dependency closure, its rights, platform behavior and maintenance
commitments remain to be qualified. (Gruber,van der Laan and tmle contributors, 2025)
   Our current disposition is reference. Conditional integration through the original R worker
is preferable to assuming that a whole-library port preserves fitted objects, weighting and
targeting semantics. A narrow independent finite-population or analytical oracle can establish
target and refusal expectations. A separately qualified longitudinal estimator answers a
different request; it is not an alias for this point-treatment interface. Whole-library porting is
deferred until demonstrated demand and costs justify it. The scientific owner must approve
target, sampling and missingness assumptions; the adapter owner must preserve identities
and typed failure; the rights/platform owner must resolve distribution and environment; and

39.62       EventStudyInteract: cohort support and covariance de-
            fine the rollout claim
A staggered branch-policy rollout creates several clocks: calendar time, initial adoption cohort,
time since adoption, and the time at which the sponsor requests a comparison. An apparent
decline in an event-study path may reflect a change in which cohorts remain observable, rather
than a weakening effect within any branch. The community Stata package EventStudyInteract
is a candidate reference for interaction-weighted estimates in this setting. Its selected repository
revision is dated 30 October 2023; the actual command header is version 0.1 dated 24 January
2022, while the help header and distribution metadata carry earlier version labels. We bind
these separate identities instead of presenting the newest-looking label as a verified installed
version. (Liyang Sun and EventStudyInteract contributors, 2023)
39.62. EventStudyInteract: cohort support and covariance define the rollout claim             951


   The authentic saved Sun–Abraham original is the September 2020 arXiv version of the
work with a 2021 journal bibliographic year. Its contribution is not a universal cure for
observational rollout bias. It develops cohort-specific comparisons and their aggregation
under stated parallel-trend, no-anticipation and sampling conditions. We inspect its estimator
construction and asymptotic assumptions separately from the selected implementation. The
older citation’s limited contamination claim remains preserved; the additional inspected pages
support the more specific comparison here. (Sun and Abraham, 2021; Causal banking proposal
project, 2026df)


39.62.1     Cohort effects, aggregation and a banking decision

Let Ei = e be branch i’s first adoption period, ℓ = t − e its relative time, and δeℓ the
cohort-specific effect at that relative time. For the cohorts supported at ℓ, write peℓ for their
population shares. The interaction-weighted target and its estimator have the forms
                                      X                       X
                               θℓ =       peℓ δeℓ ,   θbℓ =       pbeℓ δbeℓ .
                                      e                       e

The original constructs an interacted regression, estimates cohort shares and aggregates the
corresponding effects. With a never-treated comparison cohort, its proposed specification
may use all periods. With only a last-treated comparison cohort, it excludes periods at or
after that cohort’s adoption. Always-treated cohorts lack a pretreatment comparison and
are excluded from that construction. Validity depends on the chosen comparison population,
parallel trends and no anticipation, not on the existence of coefficient labels. (Causal banking
proposal project, 2026df)
  For an authored example, early and late cohorts have constant effects two and ten repayment
units. Shares (3/4, 1/4) at relative time zero give an aggregate of four. If only the early cohort
supports the next horizon, its aggregate is two, although neither cohort’s effect has changed.
Fixed equal shares would give six where both effects are identified; they cannot reveal an
unobserved late-cohort outcome at the longer horizon. The API must return horizon-specific
cohort support and weights, and distinguish a changing-population path from a fixed-population
decision. At a stipulated 100 USD per repayment unit, the three numbers imply 400, 200 and
600 USD before costs, but answer different population questions. (Causal banking proposal
project, 2026de)
   Suppose the early cohort adopts at time one and the last cohort at time three. The latter
is eligible as untreated comparison only before time three, so the early cohort’s nonnegative
supported lags are zero and one. A lag-two claim using the now-treated comparison is invalid
for that construction. With stipulated early and late effects five and seven and no baseline
trend, the comparison at time three is 5 − 7 = −2, not the early cohort effect five. The package
help assigns the exclusion to the caller; zeroing the comparison cohort’s event indicators does
not remove those calendar periods. (Liyang Sun and EventStudyInteract contributors, 2023;
Causal banking proposal project, 2026de)


39.62.2     Sample membership and returned objects must survive the interface

The inspected command marks an analysis sample, copies relative-time indicators with the

interacted outcome regression. The share calculations precede that outcome regression. The
inspected wrapper does not recompute the shares on the backend’s eventual estimation sample.
If a separately qualified backend drops additional rows, the weight and outcome populations

need to be reconciled explicitly. This is a conditional integration concern; no such native drop
was observed in this review. (Liyang Sun and EventStudyInteract contributors, 2023)
   Counts (3, 1) across the two authored cohorts produce weights (3/4, 1/4) and effect four. If a

example makes the necessary contract concrete: retain the marked sample, actual estimation

39.62.3     Uncertainty: coefficient covariance, estimated shares and joint
            claims

For a fixed horizon, the first-order differential of the aggregate is dθ = pT dδ + δ T dp. Its general
variance contains the coefficient term, the share term and their cross-covariance. Under a
justified zero cross-covariance condition this reduces to
                                         b ≃ pT V p + δ T Vp δ.
                                     Var(θ)      δ

The source computes a transformation of the full interacted covariance and adds a cohort-
share covariance contribution. The original derives its limit under explicit saturated-regression
assumptions, including independent cross-sectional units, finite fourth moments, rank conditions
and within-unit time dependence. These conditions do not assert validity for arbitrary cross-
branch dependence or selected sparse event cells. (Liyang Sun and EventStudyInteract
contributors, 2023; Causal banking proposal project, 2026df)
  With authored weights (3/4, 1/4) and coefficient covariance

39.63.1     Four aggregate answers from the same cohort-time effects

Write τgt for the effect in cohort g at calendar time t and pg for its population share. A
treated-cell average weights every supported post-adoption cell by its cohort share. A group
average first averages within each cohort over selected post periods and then weights cohorts.
A dynamic average first aggregates cohorts at each relative time and then averages the selected
nonnegative relative times. A calendar average first aggregates cohorts at each calendar time
and then averages those calendar effects. The inspected implementation contains separate
branches for all four targets; its public aggregation function defaults to the group target.
Where weights are estimated, their influence contributions accompany the effect estimates.
(Callaway,SantAnna and did contributors, 2026)
   In an authored panel, cohort one has effects two and four at times one and two; cohort two
has effect ten at time two. Their population shares are 3/4 and 1/4. The simple treated-cell
target is
                               (3/4)2 + (3/4)4 + (1/4)10
                                                          = 4.
                                    3/4 + 3/4 + 1/4
The group target is (3/4)(2 + 4)/2 + (1/4)10 = 19/4. Dynamic effects at horizons zero and one
are both four, giving an overall value four. Calendar effects are two and 11/2, averaging to
15/4. At a stipulated 100 USD per outcome unit, these planning quantities are 400, 475, 400
and 375 USD per respective target unit. The differing denominators must be explicit before a
sponsor treats them as comparable returns. (Causal banking proposal project, 2026eb)
   Balancing on one post-adoption lag retains only the early cohort in this example, giving the
path (2, 4) and mean three. That is a supported, restricted population, not an estimate of the
late cohort’s absent longer history. In the selected source, event balancing affects dynamic
aggregation; simple and group aggregation warn that they ignore that option. Calendar
aggregation warns that it ignores the event-window and balancing options. The CLI/MCP
result must report the resolved request and target population, not merely repeat options the
caller supplied. (Callaway,SantAnna and did contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal
project, 2026eb)


39.63.2     Missing cells and changing weights are population choices

The selected cell wrapper catches a two-by-two estimation error, warns, and leaves that cell
unavailable. Aggregation rejects missing effects by default; when removal is requested it filters
cells and, in the group branch, removes groups without retained post-treatment effects in the
requested window. The result therefore describes what remains. It must not be relabeled the
original portfolio without an argument for the missing contributions. (Callaway,SantAnna and
did contributors, 2026)
   If the late cohort’s time-two cell is unavailable in the authored example, the simple and
group averages among remaining cells are both three. The stipulated complete-data targets
were four and 19/4. Those complete values are known only because this is a constructed
example; a production analysis must not impute the missing effect by copying them. Requested,
eligible, attempted, estimated and omitted cohort-time cells belong in separate counts. (Causal
banking proposal project, 2026eb)
  The selected att_gt documentation and cell code also distinguish sampling-weight clocks. A
balanced panel’s default two-period comparison uses earlier-period weights; explicitly varying
39.63. R panel software: compare the target before comparing the estimator                      955


weights switches to a stacked repeated-cross-section route while holding covariates at the earlier
period. Base-period or first-period anchoring on an unbalanced panel can remove units absent
at that anchor. For effects (0, 10), weights (9, 1) give one while weights (1, 9) give nine. If only
the first unit is present at an anchor, the retained target is zero. Neither a constant variable
name nor a successful fit establishes that the population stayed fixed. (Callaway,SantAnna
and did contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026eb)
  The stacked route folds pre- and post-period influence contributions back to the same
unit with a factor of one half. Authored stacked contributions (−2, 2, −4, 4) become (−3, 3);
summing without the half gives (−6, 6), four times the variance and twice the standard error
under the same variance calculation. The selected source includes the half. This is a positive
semantic check and a proposed conversion oracle, not a reported defect. (Callaway,SantAnna
and did contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026eb)


39.63.3     Controls, anticipation and uncertainty are resolved outputs

The preprocessing path validates unit-time uniqueness and constant first adoption within
a unit, and treats the intervention as irreversible. A first-adoption field cannot faithfully
encode repeated switches between policies. The not-yet-treated comparison requires a cohort
to adopt strictly after the comparison period plus anticipation. With time two and one period
of anticipation, a cohort adopting at three is not eligible; a cohort adopting at four is. When
no never-treated group exists, the selected preprocessing can use the last cohort as comparison
and removes unsupported later periods. These transformations and support losses must appear
in the result. (Callaway,SantAnna and did contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project,
2026eb)
   Disabling influence-function computation returns point estimates only and prevents the
documented aggregation and inference paths. With inference retained, the selected mul-
tiplier bootstrap permits the individual sampling unit and at most one additional coarser
clustering variable. Its clustered path aggregates influence contributions to cluster sums, with
corresponding normalization. It also removes degenerate dimensions and nonfinite bootstrap
maxima before forming its simultaneous critical value. A future worker must return the actual
dimensions and denominator used, and qualify sparse or unstable cases rather than calling
every finite critical value calibrated. (Callaway,SantAnna and did contributors, 2026)
   An aggregation request cannot introduce a cluster variable absent from the stored group-time
object. The inspected code warns and removes unsupported extra clustering. Thus a request
for branch clustering on an object retaining only region clustering cannot be reported as
fulfilled. The adapter should refuse or explicitly mark the result nonconformant and request
recomputation from the appropriate first-stage object. A simultaneous-band request has a
similar contract: invalid or unexpectedly small bootstrap critical values trigger a pointwise
fallback, and the returned status must say pointwise. A large critical value triggers a warning
rather than proving useful precision. (Callaway,SantAnna and did contributors, 2026; Causal
banking proposal project, 2026eb)

   fixest supplies a broad projection and covariance engine. Its selected defaults,

39.64.1     Matching the target precedes a parity comparison

   Reuse the authored three-cell rollout: early-cohort effects are two and four, the late-cohort

information clock. (Bernardo Dionisi and differences contributors, 2026; D2CML and csdid
contributors, 2026)
   At comparison time two with anticipation one, cohort three fails the strict not-yet-treated

39.65.1     The donor fit and its causal interpretation

Let x1 be the treated portfolio’s predictor vector, X0 the matrix of donor predictors, and V a
nonnegative diagonal predictor-weight matrix. For fixed V , the intended donor problem is

                    min(x1 − X0 w)′ V (x1 − X0 w),      wj ≥ 0,    1′ w = 1.
                      w

The selected code constructs this constrained quadratic problem, then chooses predictor weights
using outcome fit over the supplied optimization period. It requires one treated column, at
least two donor columns and compatible predictor and outcome dimensions. Predictor rows
without donor variation are rejected. Scaling uses predictor variance across the treated unit
together with donors, a transformation that a comparison must preserve. (Jens Hainmueller
and Alexis Diamond, 2026; Synth contributors, 2026)
   In an authored one-predictor example, donor values zero and two match a treated value one
at weights (1/2, 1/2). Post-intervention donor outcomes of 80 and 120 thousand USD give a
synthetic value 100. An observed treated value 120 gives a gap 20 thousand USD. It is a causal
effect only under the stipulated stable counterfactual relationship, eligible untreated donors
and absence of relevant spillovers or other violations. If the second donor is contaminated
and becomes 160, the apparent gap becomes zero. Choosing the second donor solely after
observing the treated outcome also makes the gap zero. Neither change demonstrates a failed
optimizer; both change the scientific comparison. (Causal banking proposal project, 2026es)
39.65. Synth in R: a comparison reference with explicit preparation and solver contracts     961


   The preparatory function validates supplied dates for type, duplicates and membership
in observed time values. Its inspected interface does not carry an intervention date against
which to enforce the information boundary. The caller must therefore verify that predictor and
weight-selection periods satisfy the predeclared information clock. The manual’s description
of pre-intervention matrices does not itself enforce that condition on arbitrary supplied data.
(Jens Hainmueller and Alexis Diamond, 2026; Synth contributors, 2026)


39.65.2     Panel balance does not establish a common predictor definition

The preparation path checks for one observation per selected unit-time pair. It nevertheless
allows individual predictor values to be missing, reports their removal and rejects all-missing
predictor histories. Structural panel balance therefore does not establish a common measure-
ment window for every predictor. The result should expose retained periods and counts by unit
and predictor, alongside the requested aggregation operator. (Jens Hainmueller and Alexis
Diamond, 2026)
   A specific source discrepancy concerns ordinary predictor aggregation. For the treated unit,
the code dispatches the requested predictors.op; for donors, the inspected path explicitly
uses the mean. With the requested median, treated history (0, 0, 9) becomes zero, while
donor history (0, 0, 12) becomes four under the donor mean. Its median would be zero. The
special-predictor helper, in contrast, dispatches the specified operator on both sides. This
conditional mismatch is a static finding with an authored witness, not an observed native
result. Until repaired and qualified, a proposed adapter must restrict the ordinary route to a
matched mean contract or explicitly refuse the unmet request. It must not silently advertise
the caller’s median option. (Jens Hainmueller and Alexis Diamond, 2026; Causal banking
proposal project, 2026es)


39.65.3     Predictor normalization and solver status need separate checks

Optimized predictor weights are normalized as absolute values divided by their absolute
sum. The supplied custom-weight branch instead divides absolute values by the signed sum
after checking type and length. For (−1, 2) the two formulas yield (1/3, 2/3) and (1, 2)
respectively. For (−2, −1) the custom formula produces negative diagonal values, and for
(−1, 1) the denominator vanishes. These examples establish why the adapter contract needs
finite, nonnegative custom values with a strictly positive sum. They do not claim that the
delegated solver successfully returns for these invalid inputs. The one-predictor branch sets
the custom weight to one separately. (Jens Hainmueller and Alexis Diamond, 2026; Causal
banking proposal project, 2026es)
   The outer optimization tries selected methods and starting values, with local KKT and start
tests disabled in the supplied options. Its collector sorts candidate rows by objective value and
selects the first without a local convergence-code filter. The quadratic wrapper extracts the
delegated primal solution and computes losses; it does not expose a complete status or KKT
certificate in the returned object. These are wrapper observations. They do not establish that
ipop has no internal checks, or that every selected solution is wrong. Full delegated solver
inspection and native numerical qualification remain explicit tasks. (Jens Hainmueller and
Alexis Diamond, 2026)
   Feasibility and optimality differ even in a small public oracle. For min0≤w≤1 (w − 1/2)2 ,
candidate w = 3/4 is feasible but has loss 1/16 and interior gradient 1/2. A successful process
return or weight-sum check alone would not certify the optimum. A prototype should retain
objective values, constraint residuals, stationarity or an appropriate numerical certificate,
962                                                          Causal analysis for a universal bank


termination reason, iterations and requested tolerances. The manual’s argument prose says
seven significant figures while its usage and inspected function default specify five; resolved
defaults belong in the result rather than being inferred from one prose field. (Jens Hainmueller
and Alexis Diamond, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026es)

record is preserved without extending its claims to uninspected paths. (Eli Ben-Michael, 2026;

39.66.1     The dispatcher determines the scientific comparison

More than one finite treatment time selects multisynth, where a supplied progfunc is ignored
with a warning. One treatment time selects the single-outcome or multiple-outcome route
according to the formula. Several treated units at one date are therefore different from several
treatment dates. The inspected single-outcome prediction averages treated outcomes; it is not
automatically an exposure-weighted portfolio effect. The banking request must distinguish
an equally weighted branch, account or region from an exposure-weighted aggregate. (Eli
Ben-Michael, 2026)
   The single-outcome defaults are ridge augmentation, SCM weights and no unit fixed effect.
Preparation splits observations at the intervention date and uses each unit’s maximum treatment
flag. This persistent-treatment representation is not a general treatment-reversal contract. A
proposed adapter must validate unit-time uniqueness, pre/post unit alignment, missingness,
calendar meaning and persistence. A rectangular matrix does not establish those causal
conditions. Covariates are aggregated before treatment, but their measurement availability
still needs an information clock. Full staggered and multiple-outcome engines remain separate
review targets.(Eli Ben-Michael, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026cu)


39.66.2     Negative weights represent extrapolation

For the selected single-treatment ridge route without auxiliary covariates, let X be the n0 × p
donor matrix after centering each feature on its donor mean, and x the centered treated vector.
With simplex weights wsc and penalty λ > 0, the inspected update is

                          waug = wsc + X(X ′ X + λIp )−1 (x − X ′ wsc ).

Since 1′ X = 0, the adjustment sums to zero. Individual weights need not be nonnegative.
This argument concerns the specified centered route; covariates, fixed effects and supplied
feature transformations must have their own matched contracts.(Eli Ben-Michael, 2026; Causal
banking proposal project, 2026cu)
   In an authored example, centered donors are (−1, 1), the treated value is two, wsc = (0, 1)
and λ = 2. The initial imbalance is one and X ′ X + λ = 4. The adjustment (−1/4, 1/4) gives
weights (−1/4, 5/4), remaining imbalance 1/2 and absolute weight sum 3/2. Donor revenues
of 80 and 120 thousand USD produce a counterfactual 130; treated revenue 150 gives a gap 20.
The simplex gap would be 30. Neither gap is identified by arithmetic alone: donor eligibility,
stable extrapolation and absence of relevant interference need justification. Truncating the
negative weight and renormalizing changes the estimator; it is not a formatting adjustment.
(Causal banking proposal project, 2026cu)
   The constrained solver introduces an auxiliary outcome path tied to donor weights by linear
equalities. With a symmetric positive-semidefinite metric, its objective agrees with donor
matching up to a constant and positive scale. The wrapper requests OSQP relative and
absolute tolerances of 10−8 and extracts the donor part of the primal vector. At that boundary,
it does not return a complete certificate or locally gate extraction on termination status. This
does not imply that OSQP lacks internal status information. A proposed adapter must retain
status, constraint residuals and numerical diagnostics. A scaled imbalance also needs an
explicit state when uniform-donor imbalance, its denominator, is zero. (Eli Ben-Michael, 2026)
964                                                             Causal analysis for a universal bank


39.66.3     A tuning calendar is part of the estimator

The actual ridge route calls cv_lambda and then get_lambda_errors; the generic CV file is
not authoritative for this path. The grid contains nλ + 1 candidates including its nominal
maximum and minimum. R’s seq(0:n_lambda) returns indices of its vector argument, so the
subsequent exponents are zero through nλ . Maximum four, ratio 1/16 and two intervals give
(4, 1, 1/4). The default maximum is the squared leading singular value of the donor matrix.
Selection defaults to the largest lambda within one reported standard error of the minimum
mean loss. (Eli Ben-Michael, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026cu)
   For T columns and holdout length h, the inspected loss helper uses starts 1, . . . , T − h,
excluding the last feasible start T − h + 1. With four columns and h = 1, only starts one, two
and three are evaluated. Authored squared losses (0, 0, 0, 100) for candidate A and (4, 4, 4, 4) for
B give selected-window means zero and four, but all-window means 25 and four. These abstract
losses demonstrate a possible ranking change, not observed package output. A comparison
must reproduce or explicitly change that boundary.(Eli Ben-Michael, 2026; Causal banking
proposal project, 2026cu)
   The helper divides the sample standard deviation of holdout losses by the square root of
their count. Overlap or serial dependence does not make this a calibrated sampling standard
error automatically. It can remain a tuning convention while its inferential interpretation
stays qualified. Small calendars, invalid holdout lengths, zero variation, singular covariates
and nonfinite losses require explicit tests and refusal states. Model selection, calendar and
failed-candidate accounting should be frozen before the intervention outcome is inspected. (Eli
Ben-Michael, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026cu)


39.66.4     Finite resampling and confidence-grid boundaries

The inspected conformal path adjusts treated outcomes under each null, refits the model
and computes residuals; the fitted ridge lambda is retained in the extra arguments. Its IID
branch randomly permutes residuals and the other inspected branch uses circular shifts. These
require different scientific resampling justifications. Stationarity alone does not establish every
finite circular-shift test as exact. No theorem is borrowed here from an uninspected package
bibliography. (Eli Ben-Michael, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026cu)
   The tail proportion averages indicators that resampled statistics exceed or equal the
observation. An authored observation three and sampled values zero, one and two yield
zero; a plus-one convention yields 1/4. Neither formula alone proves calibration for an
arbitrary experiment. Identity draws, ties, sampling law and complete denominators must be
retained. Pointwise intervals must remain distinct from simultaneous trajectory uncertainty.
(Eli Ben-Michael, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026cu)
   The interval helper appends zero to its null grid, takes extrema of accepted values, and
returns every p-value whose grid entry is zero. If zero was already present, the returned vector
can exceed the three entries expected by its caller. A zero-width grid is one mathematical
case to qualify. If no value is accepted, the base-language extrema are positive and negative
infinity, respectively. Extrema of a disconnected accepted set give its envelope, not its complete
membership, and a finite grid does not certify tail closure. The proposed contract retains the
full grid and acceptance set, deduplicates nulls under an explicit RNG policy, and distinguishes
empty, truncated and disconnected outcomes. These conditional static findings are not observed
package failures. (Eli Ben-Michael, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026cu)

39.66.5     Donor policy and an accountable reuse decision

The separately inspected staggered donor helper requires donor treatment strictly after cohort
time plus the requested horizon; other helpers restrict missingness and matching. Inspecting
them does not qualify the full staggered solver. A changed horizon can change the donor
population. The donor-table helper can initiate additional placebo inference when RMSPE
is requested and replace tiny displayed weights by zero. Provenance and cost records must
distinguish these computations and displayed weights from the fitted result.(Eli Ben-Michael,
2026)
   The decision is reference use. Direct R adoption is deferred until complete rights, numerical
status, calendar, tuning and uncertainty are qualified on matched public or generated examples.
A full port is deferred because it must reproduce indexing, dispatch, centering, refitting
and failure semantics, not merely the ridge equation. A small independent oracle tests
specific contracts but replaces neither the package nor identification. Constrained synthetic
control, augmentation and factor models are distinct alternatives whose assumptions should
be compared explicitly. (Causal banking proposal project, 2026cu)
   Scientific owners justify donors and uncertainty; adapter owners preserve targets, clocks,
weights, diagnostics and refusals; platform and rights owners qualify the installed distribution;
evaluation owners preregister oracles and count every attempt. An illustrative 3,600 USD
across 180 attempted, 150 completed and 120 usable tasks gives 20, 24 and 30 USD per
respective denominator. These are planning values, not measured prices or bank benefits.
Tuning, null refits, failures, storage, recovery and maintenance belong in the cost record.
Revisit the decision when a justified prototype needs this comparison and those contracts can
be tested. Native capability, full dependency rights, uncertainty and final acceptance remain
open.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026cu)


39.67       scpi: prediction uncertainty, failed optimization and the
            proposed inference contract
A synthetic banking portfolio needs more than a fitted counterfactual curve. The uncertainty
in fitted weights differs from uncertainty about a future untreated outcome. The inspected R
scpi source provides a concrete reference for separating these components, choosing weight
constraints and comparing prediction intervals. Its proposed role is a reference for public
experiments, conditional on numerical and law-specific qualification. A prediction interval
alone does not establish the bank’s counterfactual identification assumptions.(Causal banking
proposal project, 2026en)
   Eight selected originals authenticate to the CRAN-mirror revision of 10 June 2026. Its
description declares version 4.0.1, GPL-3, R at least 4.1.0 and dependencies including CVXR
greater than 1.9 and ECOSolveR. The observed packager field is CodexSandboxOffline. That
field is retained as source metadata, not equated with an independently verified author release
or installed distribution. A bibliography entry dated 2027 does not establish availability before
the 7 October 2026 literature cutoff. No theorem from that entry is used here. The inherited
official manual remains preserved; complete release equivalence, transitive rights and native
behavior are open. (Matias D. Cattaneo and Yingjie Feng and Filippo Palomba and Rocio
Titiunik, 2026; scpi contributors, 2026)
966                                                            Causal analysis for a universal bank


39.67.1     Targets and donor clocks precede optimization

Single-unit preparation validates a distinct treated unit, at least two donors, observed requested
periods and disjoint pre/post period sets. It sorts periods and can move final pretreatment
periods into the post period under an anticipation setting. It expands the panel with missing
entries before forming feature, donor and prediction matrices. Completing a rectangular
index is not imputation or evidence of donor eligibility. The proposed contract retains original
missingness, retained rows, requested and resolved periods, unit identities and the measurement
clock. (Matias D. Cattaneo and Yingjie Feng and Filippo Palomba and Rocio Titiunik, 2026)
   Multiple-unit preparation distinguishes unit-time outcomes, averages within treated units
and time aggregates. The inspected time-aggregate prediction matrix is divided by the
number of treated units, then incomplete rows are omitted. This is not automatically an
exposure-weighted portfolio target. Donors default to units not treated in the relevant supplied
population; a bounded post horizon can admit not-yet-treated donors for unit-time and unit
routes. Horizon, anticipation and aggregation can therefore alter the comparison. Full staggered
identification and simultaneous coverage require separate scientific justification.(Matias D.
Cattaneo and Yingjie Feng and Filippo Palomba and Rocio Titiunik, 2026; Causal banking
proposal project, 2026en)
  Let A stack treated pretreatment features, B donor features and C adjustment covariates.
With Z = [B, C] and b = (w′ , r′ )′ , fitting minimizes (A − Zb)′ V (A − Zb) under the chosen
weight constraints. The default uses nonnegative weights summing to one. Alternatives include
unconstrained least squares, an L1 ball, an L2 ball and a combined sum-to-one, nonnegative
and L2 restriction. Adjustment coefficients are not automatically constrained as donor weights.
Separate and pooled metrics also define different objectives.(Matias D. Cattaneo and Yingjie
Feng and Filippo Palomba and Rocio Titiunik, 2026)
  The constrained path defaults to CLARABEL through CVXR, checks availability and
accepts optimal and optimal_inaccurate statuses. The latter must remain visible in any
adapter. A diagonal-metric unconstrained path first tries weighted least squares before the
general optimizer. Status, rank, metric, active constraints and residuals belong in the output;
successful optimization cannot establish an untreated counterfactual law. (Matias D. Cattaneo
and Yingjie Feng and Filippo Palomba and Rocio Titiunik, 2026; Causal banking proposal
project, 2026en)


39.67.2     Two uncertainty components need two declared guarantees

Write counterfactual prediction error as Ut + Et , with Ut the fitted coefficient component
and Et the future residual component. If valid events separately place these in [lU , uU ] and
[lE , uE ] with error probabilities at most αU and αE , their sum lies in [lU + lE , uU + uE ] with
probability at least 1 − αU − αE by the union bound. This elementary conditional statement
does not prove that estimated component intervals have those probabilities. Two 95 percent
component statements do not automatically give a 95 percent joint claim. (Causal banking
proposal project, 2026en)
   In an authored example, fitted untreated revenue is 100 thousand USD, coefficient error
lies in [−5, 5] and future error in [−10, 10]. The combined counterfactual interval is [85, 115].
Observed treated revenue 120 gives effect interval [5, 35], reversing endpoints on subtraction.
If justified component error rates were each 0.05, the union-bound guarantee would be 0.90.
These values illustrate arithmetic, not package output, bank data or verified coverage.(Causal
banking proposal project, 2026en)
  The source estimates in-sample residual moments with optional misspecification adjustment
39.67. scpi: prediction uncertainty, failed optimization and the proposed inference contract   967


and HC0–HC4 scaling. It can simplify moment designs when observations are too few relative to
parameters, and caps a degrees-of-freedom quantity when it reaches the sample size. Requested
and resolved designs must both be retained. Adding lags as regression features does not itself
establish arbitrary serial-correlation robustness. Out-of-sample alternatives use conditional
sub-Gaussian bounds, a location-scale construction or conditional quantile regression; each
needs its own assumptions and calibration study.(Matias D. Cattaneo and Yingjie Feng and
Filippo Palomba and Rocio Titiunik, 2026)
  The joint-interval dispatcher changes scope with the target: within a unit trajectory, across
unit averages, or within an aggregate trajectory. The label joint must name the indexed set
covered. It cannot imply coverage over every branch, calendar, tuning choice and scientific
hypothesis without another argument.(Matias D. Cattaneo and Yingjie Feng and Filippo
Palomba and Rocio Titiunik, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026en)


39.67.3     Failed simulated optimization can change the tails

The coefficient-error helper simulates Gaussian perturbations and solves lower and upper conic
problems. It accepts optimal or close-to-optimal ECOS messages; other statuses produce
missing simulated bounds. The caller drops rows that failed at all horizons and computes
marginal quantiles with missing entries removed. Failure percentages use the original requested
simulation count. A warning above 20 percent depends on verbose output; an adapter must
inspect those fractions regardless of logging. (Matias D. Cattaneo and Yingjie Feng and Filippo
Palomba and Rocio Titiunik, 2026)
   An authored finite example isolates the selection issue. Nine zero upper bounds and one
upper bound 100 have a type-seven 97.5 percent quantile of 77.5. If the final value is unavailable
after failure, the successful values alone have quantile zero, although the failure fraction is
only 10 percent. The omitted 100 is hypothetical, not recoverable from an actual failed solve.
A small failure percentage alone cannot certify harmless omission. Qualification should retain
every draw, status, horizon and both bounds, predeclare thresholds, and compare numerical
repairs on matched perturbations. Discarding difficult draws is not a coverage proof. (Causal
banking proposal project, 2026en)
   Parallel and serial branches also need bound RNG streams, worker counts, perturbations,
retries and failures. More simulations can improve Monte Carlo resolution under a valid
law; they cannot repair unidentified counterfactuals, misspecified residuals or failure-driven
selection. (Matias D. Cattaneo and Yingjie Feng and Filippo Palomba and Rocio Titiunik,
2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026en)


39.67.4     Asymmetric bounds and degenerate matrices need explicit states

The interface permits supplying one out-of-sample bound while estimating the other. In the
Gaussian and location-scale calls, however, the lower-side estimation flag is forwarded to both
helper parameters. With a supplied lower bound and unsupplied upper bound, intended flags
(false, true) become (false, false), so the helper skips fitting. In the branch with the outcome
among the features, the upper bound remains missing while the supplied lower bound is restored.
Other branches can encounter additional missing-value checks. The quantile-regression call
forwards the flags separately. This conditional static discrepancy has an exact Boolean witness;
it is not an observed native failure. The proposed adapter refuses the affected request until a
tested repair preserves the requested sides.(Matias D. Cattaneo and Yingjie Feng and Filippo
Palomba and Rocio Titiunik, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026en)
  The square-root helper uses singular values and left singular vectors, which has the in-
968                                                             Causal analysis for a universal bank


tended interpretation for a symmetric positive-semidefinite matrix. Applied algebraically to
diag(−1, 4), the construction gives diag(1, 2), whose square is diag(1, 4), not the input. This
does not establish that the estimator normally supplies indefinite covariances. It motivates a
domain check instead of interpreting SVD as an automatic repair. A near-zero regularizer also
returns field names different from its ordinary branch; callers need explicit tests for degenerate
covariance states. (Matias D. Cattaneo and Yingjie Feng and Filippo Palomba and Rocio
Titiunik, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026en)

The proposal retains the selected R source as a comparison reference. Direct adoption awaits

bounds and preregistered public uncertainty tests. A full port is deferred because it must
reproduce local geometry, moment-design fallbacks, constrained simulation, parallel randomness
and failure accounting as well as the point estimator. Independent oracles test specific contracts
but do not replace package qualification. Other language distributions, conformal augmented
control and factor models need separate comparisons at common targets and information
sets.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026en)
   Scientific owners justify donors and probability claims; adapter owners preserve inputs,
statuses and refusals; rights/platform owners resolve the distribution; evaluation owners retain
all trials and costs. Illustrative spending of 4,200 USD across 210 attempted, 175 completed
and 140 usable tasks gives 20, 24 and 30 USD per denominator. These are planning values, not
measured prices or bank benefits. Tuning, failed perturbation solves, retries, storage, recovery
and maintenance count. Revisit the decision when a justified public prototype needs these

39.68      fect: switching interventions, validation clocks and nu-
           merical accountability
A banking servicing policy may start, stop and restart across regional portfolios. A useful
counterfactual analysis must then distinguish the effect during treatment, persistence after
withdrawal, changes in the comparison population and the uncertainty of the fitted untreated
path. The earlier gsynth comparison established a compatibility wrapper and selected engine
behavior. A separate review of fect is needed because its direct interface exposes additional
estimators, treatment reversals, validation choices and sensitivity delegation. The proposed
disposition is reference use with a conditional future R worker; native adoption and a full
port remain deferred.(Yiqing Xu and package contributors, 2026b,a; Causal banking proposal
project, 2026dg)

declaring version 2.4.5. The description declares R at least 4.1.0, native compilation through
Rcpp and RcppArmadillo, and dependencies including fixest, parallel backends and numerical

to a proposed missing-data target therefore requires a matched fixture, not merely a matching

explanations of untreated outcomes. Covariates affected by treatment, unsupported extrapola-

untreated path or a small pretreatment error does not itself identify the policy effect. Public
synthetic experiments can test a chosen law with known truth; they cannot certify the bank’s

39.68.2     Treatment switches and carryover require separate clocks

The direct source distinguishes never-treated and not-yet-treated factor samples, with method-
specific gates. Matrix completion and the combined method reject the never-treated option in
the inspected dispatcher. The gsynth method resolves its default factor sample to never-treated
controls and rejects treatment reversals. Parametric inference requires never-treated controls
and rejects reversal paths. Those checks bound a supported route; they do not prove that
an accepted declaration is true. (Yiqing Xu and Licheng Liu and Ziyi Liu and Ye Wang and
Tianzhu Qin and Shiyun Hu and Rivka Lipkovitz, 2026)
   For a positive carryover.rm, the source marks specified subsequent untreated positions with
status two, retains treatment status one where the two would overlap, and constructs separate
event-time coordinates. On an authored regular six-period clock, treatment (0, 1, 0, 0, 1, 0)
with one subsequent carryover position becomes (0, 1, 2, 0, 1, 2). This coding clarifies which
970                                                             Causal analysis for a universal bank


effect is being discussed. It is not an estimate of how long a servicing intervention actually
persists. The adapter must retain original calendar labels, internal indices, treatment, carryover,
observed outcome and estimation masks as distinct objects. A carryover test and a requested
exclusion interval are separate controls; the full mask behavior needs native fixtures before
admission.(Yiqing Xu and Licheng Liu and Ziyi Liu and Ye Wang and Tianzhu Qin and Shiyun
Hu and Rivka Lipkovitz, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026dg)
   Similarly, group effects and resampling groups are distinct. The inspected modern group.fe
route checks nesting within units and can select the complex-fixed-effects method. A single
group column can supply the default bootstrap cluster, while multiple group columns require an
explicit cluster choice. The code rejects cl=FALSE: even the ordinary case bootstrap resamples
units. Cross-region common shocks need a justified sampling law; a group-name argument
alone cannot provide it. (Yiqing Xu and Licheng Liu and Ziyi Liu and Ye Wang and Tianzhu
Qin and Shiyun Hu and Rivka Lipkovitz, 2026)


39.68.3     Cross-validation answers a declared prediction question

The formula interface defaults to rolling validation, but the selected default method declares
all_units. A small authored base-R dispatch experiment confirms that an omitted generic
default need not override the selected method’s own default. It establishes R dispatch semantics,
not a native fect execution. The proposed worker therefore passes the validation method
explicitly and records both the requested call form and resolved arguments.(Yiqing Xu and
Licheng Liu and Ziyi Liu and Ye Wang and Tianzhu Qin and Shiyun Hu and Rivka Lipkovitz,
2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026dg)
  The rolling mask chooses eligible units and anchors, scores a held-out block, drops a
preceding buffer and removes subsequent eligible outcomes for each sampled unit. Unsampled
units remain available across periods. For example, with six eligible periods, anchor four,
block length two and buffer one, a sampled unit trains on periods one and two, excludes
three, scores four and five, and drops six. An unsampled donor can still provide periods one
through six. This may suit retrospective counterfactual imputation using contemporaneous
donors. It is not automatically a prospective forecasting experiment in which every future
donor outcome is unavailable. The banking decision clock determines the appropriate holdout
construction.(Yiqing Xu and Licheng Liu and Ziyi Liu and Ye Wang and Tianzhu Qin and
Shiyun Hu and Rivka Lipkovitz, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026dg)
   Validation averaging and failed fits are equally material. The standalone rolling wrapper
removes nonfinite squared errors, computes per-fold mean errors and then averages the
retained fold scores. It exposes used-fold and held-out-cell counts. A candidate with fold mean
errors (1, 9) on (100, 1) scored cells has equal-fold score 5 but pooled-cell score 109/101. A
comparator with errors (3, 3) scores 3 under both rules. The preferred candidate reverses
with the aggregation rule. This is an authored denominator example, not evidence that either
rule is always correct. Candidate-specific missing folds need explicit refusal or a predeclared
comparison policy.(Yiqing Xu and Licheng Liu and Ziyi Liu and Ye Wang and Tianzhu Qin
and Shiyun Hu and Rivka Lipkovitz, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026dg)
   The selection helper offers minimum, one-percent and one-standard-error rules. For ordered
ranks (0, 1, 2) with mean scores (1.2, 1, 1.1) and best-rank fold standard error 0.3, the one-
standard-error threshold is 1.3 and chooses rank zero; minimum and one-percent rules choose
rank one. The standard error is computed from available fold values, so dependence between
folds and missing scores remain qualifications. This is a tuning heuristic, not a confidence
interval for a causal effect or a theorem that the smallest retained rank is scientifically correct.
(Yiqing Xu and Licheng Liu and Ziyi Liu and Ye Wang and Tianzhu Qin and Shiyun Hu and
39.68. fect: switching interventions, validation clocks and numerical accountability          971


Rivka Lipkovitz, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026dg)


39.68.4     A numerical result must retain its termination evidence

The matrix-completion helper takes singular values of E/(T N ) and subtracts the regularization
parameter before multiplying the reconstructed matrix by T N . Thus, for an authored two-
by-two diagonal matrix E = diag(12, 4) and λ = 1.5, its soft-thresholding convention yields
diag(6, 0). Porting a library that thresholds the unnormalized singular values with the
same numeric parameter would produce a different problem. Missing entries, fixed effects,
weights and iterative reconstruction add further semantics that this diagonal example does not
qualify.(Yiqing Xu and Licheng Liu and Ziyi Liu and Ye Wang and Tianzhu Qin and Shiyun
Hu and Rivka Lipkovitz, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026dg)
   The inspected interactive helper uses a relative-change criterion, iteration cap and a possible
weighted burn-in restart. It returns an iteration count and fitted quantities but not the final
relative change or an explicit termination category in that selected return path. A distinct
additive helper accepts a maximum-iteration argument but tests against a literal 500 in its
loop. Starting at zero, that guard can allow 501 iterations if convergence never occurs. The
outer diagnostic compares the returned count against the requested maximum. If the request
was 5,000, the conditional 501-iteration path would not trigger that cap warning. This is a
source control-flow witness, not an observed failed fit. A wrapper should require matched
residual, rank, perturbation and termination evidence rather than interpret the absence of a
warning as convergence.(Yiqing Xu and Licheng Liu and Ziyi Liu and Ye Wang and Tianzhu
Qin and Shiyun Hu and Rivka Lipkovitz, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026dg)
  The additive helper also divides a fit-change norm by the old-fit norm without the small
denominator adjustment used in the inspected interactive branch. Zero and nearly zero starts
belong in the public numerical test matrix. A repair must preserve the optimization target
and document numerical policy; blindly adding constants or increasing an iteration limit is
not proof of accuracy.(Yiqing Xu and Licheng Liu and Ziyi Liu and Ye Wang and Tianzhu
Qin and Shiyun Hu and Rivka Lipkovitz, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026dg)


39.68.5     Bootstrap and sensitivity are complete request contracts

The nonparametric parallel branch contains backend retries and local fallbacks. Residual
worker errors can become all-missing replicate objects; later standard deviations and quantiles
omit missing entries. Covariance uses pairwise-complete observations in the inspected path.
Successful replicates can therefore define different effective samples across coordinates, and a
finite covariance is not automatically suitable for a joint sensitivity calculation. An adapter
must retain initial failures, retries, random streams, retained replicate identities, coordinate
counts and total requested simulations. Repeating a selected successful subset does not
establish the intended bootstrap law.(Yiqing Xu and Licheng Liu and Ziyi Liu and Ye Wang
and Tianzhu Qin and Shiyun Hu and Rivka Lipkovitz, 2026)
   The built-in interval choices distinguish a normal interval and a reflected basic interval;
a jackknife fit rejects the basic choice. In the inspected parametric route the basic-interval
helper recenters a null-centered replicate distribution around the point estimate. To isolate
the arithmetic, take estimate 10 and null-centered draws (−2, −1, 0, 1, 2). Their type-seven
quartiles are (−1, 1). At the deliberately illustrative error level α = 1/2, reflecting the
unrecentered quartiles about 10 gives [19, 21]; recentering first gives [9, 11]. This example
explains the location contract. It makes no sampling-coverage claim and does not recommend
that error level for banking decisions. (Yiqing Xu and Licheng Liu and Ziyi Liu and Ye Wang
972                                                            Causal analysis for a universal bank


and Tianzhu Qin and Shiyun Hu and Rivka Lipkovitz, 2026; Causal banking proposal project,
2026dg)
   Sensitivity is delegated to the optional HonestDiDFEct package. The inspected wrapper
matches requested event-time labels, drops unmatched indices, obtains a covariance matrix
or bootstrap fallback, and constructs default post-period weights from counts. Requested
pre/post counts are formed separately, so incomplete label matching requires an explicit shape
and identity check before delegation. Scalar subsetting and pairwise covariance need their
own tests. Optional average and period branches are separate; disabling an average branch
while retaining a period branch can leave the average result name undefined at assembly. The
parallel cleanup path also needs testing when a core count is supplied. These conditional
findings are not executions of the dependency or counterexamples to its underlying statistical
theorems. The dependency’s original implementation, rights and scientific premises remain
separate qualification work.(Yiqing Xu and Licheng Liu and Ziyi Liu and Ye Wang and Tianzhu
Qin and Shiyun Hu and Rivka Lipkovitz, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026dg)


39.68.6     A conditional R worker is more defensible than a premature port

A direct worker could preserve fect’s estimator dispatch and provide a bounded JSON result
through the proposed CLI and MCP interfaces. The request would name the target, original
and internal calendars, missingness and treatment masks, comparison population, estimator,
tuning rule, resampling unit and numerical tolerances. The response would preserve requested
and resolved options, all denominators, fit diagnostics, replicate and retry records, interval
orientation and refusal reasons. Large arrays would be immutable hashed artifacts with explicit
schemas. No such native worker is admitted by this source review. (Causal banking proposal
project, 2026dg)
   Direct adoption is deferred until the exact environment, complete rights, target and diagnos-
tics pass public trials. A full Python or C++ port is also deferred: reproducing missingness,
role-dependent weights, tuning, factor normalization, bootstrap and optional sensitivity is
substantial work with no measured benefit here. A small independent exact oracle is useful for
conversion checks. Simpler additive models, the separately reviewed synthetic-control families
and method-specific difference-in- differences alternatives remain comparators at matched
targets, clocks and uncertainty standards. Their source reviews do not grant blanket permission
to substitute estimates with different scientific meanings. (Causal banking proposal project,
2026dg)
   Scientific ownership must cover counterfactual restrictions and the decision clock; an adapter
owner must preserve semantics and failure states; a platform and rights owner must qualify
the distribution; an evaluation owner must freeze public tasks, splits, oracles and costs. An
illustrative 4,800 USD workflow serving 240 requests, 200 finite outputs and 160 scientifically
accepted outputs costs 20, 24 and 30 USD per corresponding denominator. These are authored
cost examples, not measured prices or ROI. Qualification must count tuning, compilation,
retries, storage, review and maintenance, not only a successful fit. (Causal banking proposal
project, 2026dg)
   The revisit trigger is a justified panel prototype with resolved rights and a frozen native

39.69       linearmodels panels: fixed effects, covariance clocks and

A bank comparing regional responses over time needs separate decisions about fixed effects,
