39.69.1     Within transformation and causal meaning are different steps

For the simple additive panel model

                                      Yit = αi + Xit β + uit ,

demeaning within unit removes αi algebraically. It does not remove time-varying confounding or
establish a policy interpretation for β. Under an appropriate strict-exogeneity condition and a
common linear coefficient, within least squares has a specified statistical target. Heterogeneous
treatment responses, anticipation, feedback from prior outcomes or unobserved common shocks
require a different argument. The proposed product must retain these assumptions rather
than convert a regression coefficient automatically into an intervention effect. (Causal banking
proposal project, 2026dp)
   An authored two-region example makes the transformation auditable. Region A has regressor
values (0, 1) and revenue (10, 13) thousand USD; region B has (0, 2) and (20, 22). With entity
effects, no time effects and no separate intercept, the demeaned vectors are

                      e = (−1/2, 1/2, −1, 1)′ ,
                      x                             ye = (−3/2, 3/2, −1, 1)′ .

The cross product xe′ x
                      e = 5/2 gives βb = 7/5 thousand USD per regressor unit. Residuals are
(−4/5, 4/5, 2/5, −2/5) and scalar score contributions are (2/5, 2/5, −2/5, −2/5). This is a
reproducible regression calculation, not native output, a coverage study or identified banking
treatment evidence. (Causal banking proposal project, 2026dp)
   The inspected input path drops rows with missing outcome, regressors or weights, requires
strictly positive retained weights and normalizes them by their mean. Weight shapes may
represent time, entity or full-panel information, with an explicit ambiguity error when dimen-
sions coincide. These are not interchangeable exposure and sampling weights. The adapter
must preserve original indices, weight roles, removed rows and final analysis dimensions before
reporting a result. (Kevin Sheppard and contributors, 2026d)
   The default singletons=True returns before the singleton-dropping path; setting it false
activates two-core removal. This behavior must be read from the selected implementation
rather than guessed from the option name. Recursive removal can exceed a one-pass deletion.
974                                                            Causal analysis for a universal bank


In an authored entity-time graph with edges (A, 1), (A, 2), (B, 2), removing the first singleton
edges leaves (A, 2), which is then removed too. Absorbed-regressor checking is another distinct
step. With drop_absorbed=True, the fit can change the stored regressor matrix and coefficient
names. A requested treatment variable that disappears must be reported as unidentified in
that specification, not as a zero effect. (Kevin Sheppard and contributors, 2026d; Causal
banking proposal project, 2026dp)


39.69.2      Covariance scaling and reference degrees of freedom need separate
             fields

The inspected PanelOLS fit defaults to unadjusted covariance with debiased=True and
auto_df=True. Fixed effects therefore do not select cluster-robust uncertainty automatically.
For a single effect, the automatic clustered adjustment can suppress counting an effect nested
in the supplied clusters; the multiple-effect route follows a different default. A faithful adapter
records the resolved effect count and scale, the cluster identities, and any separate group-debias
option. (Kevin Sheppard and contributors, 2026d)
     For the authored example, region score sums are (4/5, −4/5). The unscaled cluster sandwich
is
                                         (4/5)2 + (−4/5)2   128
                                 Vcl =              2
                                                          =     ,
                                              (5/2)         625
whereas summing squared individual scores gives 64/625. If the one-effect nested-cluster
route excludes entity effects from the covariance adjustment, the debiased coefficient scale
is 4/(4 − 1) = 4/3, giving 512/1875. The optional group scale [2/(2 − 1)][(4 − 1)/4] = 3/2
gives 256/625. These values have squared slope units. They illustrate the declared formula,
not reliable small-sample inference with only two regions. (Causal banking proposal project,
2026dp)
   The regression itself still counts two entity effects and one slope, leaving one residual degree
of freedom. In the inspected results object, debiased p-values and confidence intervals use that
residual degree of freedom; otherwise they use the normal distribution. The covariance denom-
inator three in this example is not the reference degree of freedom. Neither a clustered label
nor a scalar small-sample correction implies a particular cluster-count reference distribution.
These quantities must remain separate and the validity of the chosen approximation needs a
justified sampling law. (Kevin Sheppard and contributors, 2026d; Causal banking proposal
project, 2026dp)
   The nested-effect helper also iterates over supplied cluster columns. Its single-effect result
is assigned within that loop, so multi-column nesting behavior requires explicit permutation
and nesting fixtures before relying on automatic adjustments. The proposed interface should
prefer explicitly reviewed settings when the scientific resampling unit differs from an entity
or calendar label.(Kevin Sheppard and contributors, 2026d; Causal banking proposal project,
2026dp)


39.69.3      Two-way and temporal covariance retain finite-sample qualifications

The two-way cluster source adds the two group covariance components and subtracts the
intersection component, optionally correcting each component separately. It symmetrizes the
final matrix without a local positive- semidefinite projection. An abstract score witness isolates
the algebra: scores (1, −1, −1, 1) arranged in a two-by-two entity-time grid have zero entity
and time score sums, while intersection meat is one under division by four. The combined
scalar meat is therefore −1. This witness is not claimed to be a fitted PanelOLS dataset. It
39.69. linearmodels panels: fixed effects, covariance clocks and output meaning              975


shows why finite inclusion-exclusion algebra alone cannot guarantee a positive covariance. The
results layer takes square roots of diagonal entries; a proposed worker must test covariance
validity before presenting ordinary intervals. (Kevin Sheppard and contributors, 2026d; Causal
banking proposal project, 2026dp)
   The inspected Driscoll–Kraay route sums scores by time code, sorts observed time groups
and applies a kernel to ordinal row lags. With no supplied bandwidth it uses a count-based
rule. Original elapsed calendar distances are not the lags supplied to the kernel helper. For
authored times (1, 2, 10) and scores (1, 1, −2), a lag-one weight 1/2 produces meat 5/3 using
neighboring observed rows. Using the same weight only for calendar distance one gives 7/3.
Neither is universally correct; they refer to different dependence constructions. A banking
panel with missing months must declare its time scale and preserve gaps rather than silently
interpret observed rows as equally spaced months. (Kevin Sheppard and contributors, 2026d;
Causal banking proposal project, 2026dp)
   Cluster counts, calendar counts, group sizes, bandwidth and score construction therefore
belong in the scientific output. A robust covariance does not repair endogenous treatment,
omitted trends or extrapolation outside the retained population. Few clusters, leverage, shared
shocks and irregular sampling require targeted public experiments and sometimes additional
information or a different design.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026dp)


39.69.4     Numerical pathways need observable termination

Dense least squares selects the SciPy rank-revealing gelsy route with a dimension-and-machine-
precision cutoff. The sparse effects path calls LSMR with specified tolerances but extracts
only its coefficient component in the inspected local calls. This does not mean SciPy lacks
termination diagnostics; it means those diagnostics are not retained by that path. Iterated
general demeaning uses a scaled change tolerance and has no explicit local iteration cap. A
bounded worker needs resource, termination and residual checks around these operations,
together with comparison against explicit dummy-variable or exact small references. (Kevin
Sheppard and contributors, 2026d)
   An adapter must distinguish algebraic rank, numerical rank, absorbed variables and scientific
identification. Tightening a tolerance cannot create missing treatment variation, and dropping
columns changes the question. Comparisons across sparse, dense, weighted and low-memory
routes should retain the resolved design, objective, coefficient mapping and transformed
residuals, not only compare printed coefficients. (Causal banking proposal project, 2026dp)


39.69.5     Scope of reuse and a public qualification route

The direct panel review closes a specific source-inspection gap in the earlier Python comparison.
It does not close the broader search for synthetic-control, reversal and multiple-event packages,
qualify every linearmodels panel estimator, or change the original inconclusive coverage receipt
into a passing exhaustive survey. The inherited PyFixest, differences and csdid comparisons
remain substantive alternatives with distinct estimands and uncertainty contracts. A common
CLI/MCP schema must retain these distinctions. (Causal banking proposal project, 2026dp)
   For a bounded fixed-effects prototype, a Python worker is a reasonable candidate after
environment, rights and public trials are qualified. The request should name the causal
target, formula, effects, weights, index clock, missingness policy, singleton and absorption
settings, covariance law and numerical limits. The result should expose removed rows and
columns, retained estimand, coefficients, covariance components, effect and residual degrees of
freedom, group corrections, bandwidth, solver evidence, refusals and costs. Porting the full
976                                                            Causal analysis for a universal bank


stack is deferred until there is a measured need; a small rational oracle remains useful for
transformation and schema tests.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026dp)
   A scientific owner must justify the assignment and dependence laws; the adapter owner must
preserve transformations and result identities; the platform and rights owner must qualify the
distribution; the evaluation owner must freeze tasks and acceptance rules. An illustrative 3,600

39.70      Ananke reuse: graph identification, model oracles and
           effect scales
A bank translating a collections decision into a causal query needs to know whether a program
identifies an intervention distribution, evaluates an already supplied structural model, or
estimates a particular contrast. Ananke offers distinct interfaces for these tasks. Their
proximity within one distribution is useful for research, but does not make their inputs,
guarantees or results interchangeable. The proposed reuse decision is to retain the selected
source as a reference and consider an isolated comparator after explicit scientific and engineering
qualification. (Ananke community, 2023h; Causal banking proposal project, 2026ct)
   The inspected distribution is ananke-causal 0.5.0, uploaded on 5 December 2023. Its
preserved wheel and selected extracted members are authenticated byte for byte. This is
a bounded historical comparison, not a claim about the latest release or current support.
The metadata declares Apache 2.0 and also an Other/Proprietary classifier; two matching
Apache-text files are retained. The conflicting declaration, component notices and dependency
rights remain distribution questions to resolve. Authenticity of bytes does not settle those
questions. (Ananke community, 2023h)


39.70.1     Identification requires a declared graph and information set

For named treatment variables A and outcomes Y , the selected OneLineID implementation
fixes the treatment vertices, constructs the relevant outcome ancestors and checks district
fixability. Its Boolean result concerns the supplied graph and query. A causal graph elicited
by an analyst or an LLM remains an assumption-bearing scientific input; the algorithm does
not validate that graph against banking truth. (Ananke community, 2023h; Causal banking
proposal project, 2026ct)
   The functional interface constructs a display string and prints fixing orders. Some variable
lists are concatenated without separators. As a simple authored encoding example, the
token arrays (A, BC) and (AB, C) both concatenate to ABC. This does not demonstrate
that the algorithm returns the same functional for different valid queries. It shows why a
display representation cannot serve as a lossless interchange contract. The proposed CLI/MCP
boundary needs named-variable arrays and a typed expression tree preserving sums, products,
39.70. Ananke reuse: graph identification, model oracles and effect scales                       977


kernels, fixing order and available distributions. It must not evaluate returned display text.
(Ananke community, 2023h; Causal banking proposal project, 2026ct)
   The experimental extensions have additional input restrictions. The selected ancestral-
experiment and generalized-experiment interfaces can raise NotIdentifiedError when their
experiment preconditions are not satisfied. The same exception class therefore cannot be
translated mechanically into proof of nonidentification. A worker must distinguish invalid
input, unsupported information, scientific nonidentification, resource termination and engine
failure, retaining the original condition. Independent graph preflight also remains required;
a source comment requesting correctness review is not itself an observed package failure.
(Ananke community, 2023h)


39.70.2     A true-model oracle and missing-data query answer different ques-
            tions

The discrete-model oracle explicitly performs interventions in a supplied true model without
considering identification. Conditional results divide an intervened joint distribution by an
intervened conditioning probability. This is useful for public fixtures whose data-generating
model is known. It cannot turn observational ambiguity into knowledge of the correct model,
and normalization requires a nonzero conditioning probability. A banking result must state
which information was supplied and which was inferred. (Ananke community, 2023h; Causal
banking proposal project, 2026ct)
   The missing-data full-law routine uses the naming conventions R_ and X_ and constructs
an associated variable name from a split indicator name. In the selected source, an indicator
called R_credit_score leads that string operation to X_credit, rather than X_credit_score.
This authored naming witness does not establish a native erroneous result. It establishes a
conversion obligation: expose a checked bijection between business field identifiers, missingness
indicators and internal graph names, or refuse an unsupported name. A full-law identification
check also does not itself provide arbitrary individual counterfactual inference. (Ananke
community, 2023h; Causal banking proposal project, 2026ct)


39.70.3     The requested effect scale must match every returned interval

The average-effect interface selects estimators according to a-, p- and nested-fixability conditions.
Its reporting method recognizes variables whose observed values are subsets of zero and one as
binary, adds a column named ones, and obtains fitted means at assignments zero and one.
These choices require an explicit schema for treatment values, missingness, reserved names and
outcome type. They are not a general multi-valued treatment contract.(Ananke community,
2023h)
   For binary outcomes the default point calculation returns a log odds ratio. When
report_log_odds=False, the point calculation instead uses the difference of fitted means.
The inspected bootstrap branch tests binary outcome type without also testing that
reporting flag; it then accumulates log odds ratios before taking quantiles. Thus a specific
binary-outcome call with the flag false has different point and replicate reporting branches.
This is a source-traced conditional inconsistency, not a claim that a native trial was performed
or that all uses are affected. (Ananke community, 2023h)
   An authored finite witness isolates the units. Suppose fitted means are p0 = 1/5 and
p1 = 2/5. The risk difference is
                                       p1 − p0 = 1/5,
978                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


whereas the odds ratio and its logarithm are
                         p1 /(1 − p1 )
                                       = 8/3,     log(8/3) ≃ 0.980829.
                         p0 /(1 − p0 )
If hypothetical replicate means all equal these values, quantiles of the log odds ratios equal
log(8/3), while the requested difference point remains 1/5. Such endpoints cannot be labeled
as a risk-difference interval. The example does not assert that a particular fitted estimator
produces those replicates. It supplies a small reporting oracle for a future corrected adapter or

   The same selected method samples rows with replacement and calls ordinary quantiles. The

39.71      LiNGAM reuse: model assumptions, matrix meaning
           and bootstrap summaries
A bank may ask whether a funding-price change affects retained balances through service
quality as well as directly. A learned directed matrix can organize that question, but only
a declared structural model gives its entries intervention meaning. The selected LiNGAM
source is a useful reference for a bounded linear discovery prototype. Its many static, latent
and temporal interfaces must be qualified separately. (LiNGAM contributors, 2026; Causal
banking proposal project, 2026dn)
   The inspected revision is dated 8 September 2026 and its initializer reports version 1.13.0.
The selected technical files and newly acquired build, requirements and initializer text authen-
ticate to the preserved repository tree. A repository version string does not establish equality
with an installed wheel. The top-level MIT text is retained; transitive distribution rights,
binary dependencies and supported deployment remain unverified. No downloaded package is
imported or executed here. (LiNGAM contributors, 2026)


39.71.1     A discovery model must match the banking information problem

The inherited original LiNGAM model assumes linear acyclic equations, mutually indepen-
dent non-Gaussian disturbances and causal sufficiency, with independent observations of the
variable vector. Those restrictions are substantial for a bank with common calendar shocks,
endogenous customer selection or missing operational causes. The original ICA-based argument
is not a proof for every current DirectLiNGAM option or for the entire proposed banking
workflow.(Shimizu, Shohei and Hoyer, Patrik O. and Hyvärinen, Aapo and Kerminen, Antti,
2006)
   An LLM may help elicit candidate variables, units, clocks and prohibited directions, but
those suggestions require scientific review. They cannot establish independent shocks or the
absence of hidden confounding. The proposed interface must retain the human-approved
assumption set and its source, and return an unsupported or conditional result when that
model does not fit the question. A latent-variable or longitudinal class elsewhere in the package
is a separate candidate, not automatic repair of this model. (Causal banking proposal project,
2026dn)
   The selected DirectLiNGAM path validates the data shape and prior matrix, iteratively
selects a causal order, residualizes other variables and then estimates adjacency. It exposes
hard or soft prior knowledge, several independence measures and optional adaptive-Lasso
pruning. The inspected dispatch has explicit kernel and GPU branches and an alternative
branch for the pairwise routine. A wrapper should whitelist intended options rather than rely
on an unrecognized string reaching that alternative. The GPU branch requires an additional
dependency and separate qualification. (LiNGAM contributors, 2026)


39.71.2     Matrix orientation, path priors and total effects are distinct

The coefficient convention is Bij for the effect of predictor j in the equation for target i, so

                                         X = BX + ε.
980                                                            Causal analysis for a universal bank


For a strictly acyclic three-variable system, B 3 = 0 and (I − B)−1 = I + B + B 2 . An authored
example uses                                           
                                               0 0 0
                                        B =  2 0 0 .
                                                       
                                              −1 3 0
The direct first-to-third coefficient is −1, while the mediated path contributes 2 · 3 = 6, giving
total derivative 5. If the third variable is measured in thousand USD and the stipulated
intervention changes the first by 1/5 unit, the assumed gross response is 1,000 USD. Subtracting
an assumed 800 USD cost gives 200 USD. These calculations condition on the invariant
equations; they are not learned graph evidence or observed bank returns.(Causal banking
proposal project, 2026dn)
    The inspected prior-knowledge utility writes a declared path from i to j into matrix position
(j, i). Path restrictions are not simply a list of direct edges. The model conversion must retain
the node order and the distinction between required paths, forbidden paths and unknown
relations. Round-trip fixtures should use an asymmetric chain and an indirect path, so a
transpose or a path-to-edge substitution cannot pass unnoticed. (LiNGAM contributors, 2026;
Causal banking proposal project, 2026dn)
   The base estimation method fits a destination on the source and its estimated parents. It
warns when the fitted causal order places the destination before the source, but still returns a
regression coefficient. A separate utility sums products over directed paths in a supplied matrix,
with a declared continuity restriction. These two numerical constructions must remain named
separately; agreement in an idealized model is not a guarantee of equality after finite-sample
pruning or model error. (LiNGAM contributors, 2026)
   Adaptive-Lasso selection standardizes the data, derives weights from ordinary regression
and applies a BIC criterion. It then refits retained predictors on original units. The returned
coefficient is therefore not merely the raw penalized coefficient on the standardized design. A
faithful port would need to preserve the selection rule, centering, scaling, retained columns
and final refit. An external worker can preserve that behavior with less reimplementation, but
still needs native fixtures and versioned dependencies.(LiNGAM contributors, 2026; Causal
banking proposal project, 2026dn)

39.71.3     Bootstrap frequencies and selected-effect summaries have different
            denominators

The generic bootstrap resamples rows and refits the model, retaining adjacency matrices,
path-based total effects and resampled indices. Its local resampling call does not receive
the object’s random-state attribute explicitly. Reproducibility therefore needs an inspected
RNG contract, not an assumption based only on a constructor parameter. The loop mutates
the fitted object through successive fits; a worker must declare whether the returned object
represents the initial fit or the last replicate.(LiNGAM contributors, 2026)
   The bootstrap result’s probability method counts coefficients above an absolute threshold.
Its total-effect summary calculates the corresponding threshold frequency, then takes a median
among nonzero effects using a different filter. For authored replicate effects (0, 1/10, 9/10)
and threshold 1/2, the threshold frequency is 1/3. The nonzero-effect median is 1/2, whereas
the median restricted to values above threshold is 9/10. The two summary fields describe
different selections. Neither the frequency nor the conditional median is, by itself, a posterior
probability that an edge is true or a confidence interval for the intervention effect.(LiNGAM
contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026dn)
  The probability method also converts missing matrix entries before thresholding. A proposed
39.71. LiNGAM reuse: model assumptions, matrix meaning and bootstrap summaries                 981


result contract should retain nonfinite entries and their origins as explicit states rather than
silently interpreting them as evidence of edge absence. Failed fits, empty selections, zero effects
and unestimated directions need separate statuses. Every request and replicate belongs in
the availability denominator. (LiNGAM contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project,
2026dn)
   Independent row resampling does not automatically respect common shocks or repeated
servicing histories. Under a stipulated law of four independent unit-variance shocks, their
mean has variance 1/4; under a single shared unit-variance shock observed four times, its
mean has variance 1. The sample count alone cannot select the correct resampling law. These
are authored probability calculations, not package coverage results. (Causal banking proposal
project, 2026dn)
   The selected VAR bootstrap uses a separate residual-resampling and sequence-reconstruction
path. It disables the lag-selection criterion before fitting and restores it after normal com-
pletion. That path does not automatically include lag-selection uncertainty, and its local
restoration is not protected by a surrounding finally block. A bounded worker needs exception
cleanup, original-versus-resolved settings, initialization history and a scientific argument for
the innovation law. Those source observations do not establish a native failed run. (LiNGAM
contributors, 2026)


39.71.4     A reference choice and a conditional worker route

The selected build metadata requires Python at least 3.10, scikit-learn at least 1.6 and SciPy
at most 1.13.1, alongside declared numerical, graphical, statistical and modeling dependencies.

not a replacement discovery algorithm. (Causal banking proposal project, 2026dn)
   The scientific owner must approve variables, clocks, assumptions and intervention meaning.
The adapter owner must preserve orientation, path priors, matrix versus regression effects,
thresholds and refusal states. The platform and rights owner must qualify the full distribution

compute, engineering, validation and maintenance remain unknown. (Causal banking proposal

   Public fixtures can test the proposed worker before costly bank experiments. They cannot

39.72      Delicatessen reuse: estimating equations, numerical

A bank comparing servicing actions needs more than a fitted effect and a standard error.

information, and which failures prevent an uncertainty statement. Delicatessen is a useful

use is a bounded numerical reference and possible future isolated worker, not a general

  Seven selected originals authenticate to the repository revision dated 11 August 2026.

downloaded code. (Paul Zivich and Delicatessen contributors, 2026)

This expression requires a justified expansion, a suitable limit law and an identified target.
The formula itself supplies none of those facts. The selected estimator obtains the unit count
from the contribution array, computes bread and meat scaled by that count, and then divides
the assembled asymptotic covariance by the count once more. (Paul Zivich and Delicatessen
contributors, 2026)
   The default solver is Levenberg–Marquardt, with 5,000 iterations and tolerance 10−9 . The
selected built-in root branches inspect their solver’s success state. A custom callable instead
receives the equations and initial values, and must return a non-null result; the estimator’s
declared iteration and tolerance options are not passed to that callable. A proposed worker
must therefore record the actual solver contract and check a scaled full-equation residual,
feasibility and sensitivity to starting values after the solver returns. A success flag is not an
independent proof that the requested equation has been solved. (Paul Zivich and Delicatessen
contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026db)
  For an authored mean example with observations (0, 0, 2, 2), ψi (θ) = Yi − θ has root θb = 1.
A custom routine returning 0 has average residual 1, even though it has returned a numerical
value. The proposed residual test rejects that candidate before constructing an interval. It
must use declared equation scales because a residual tolerance is otherwise changed by arbitrary
multiplication of one equation.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026db)
   The subset option solves only selected coordinates, holding the others at their supplied
initial values. The covariance calculation still uses the full estimating-equation system. This is
39.72. Delicatessen reuse: estimating equations, numerical roots and the sampling unit        983


appropriate only when the held coordinates have already been solved consistently with the
declared stack, or a separate derivation justifies a different treatment. It is not a switch that
turns estimated nuisance parameters into known constants. The proposed result retains all
residuals and the provenance of every held nuisance value. Arbitrary externally trained learners
and cross-fitting require additional rate and sampling arguments beyond this selected API.
(Paul Zivich and Delicatessen contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026db)


39.72.2     A pseudoinverse does not identify an unconstrained direction

The selected covariance builder defaults to a Moore–Penrose pseudoinverse; disabling that
option requests an ordinary inverse. A NaN bread matrix causes the builder to return no
covariance. Finite output from the pseudoinverse branch must not be relabelled as scientific
identification. (Paul Zivich and Delicatessen contributors, 2026)
  Consider the authored system
                                              !                    !
                                       Yi − θ1                 1 0
                            ψi (θ) =           ,      An =         .
                                          0                    0 0

Every value of θ2 solves the second equation. For the four observations above, the algebraic
pseudoinverse sandwich has diagonal (1/4, 0). The zero in the second position represents
projection onto an unconstrained direction, not exact knowledge of θ2 . A scientific adapter
must distinguish an identified lower-dimensional target, an identified set and an unidentified
request. The latter cannot be repaired by replacing a singular inverse with a finite matrix.
(Causal banking proposal project, 2026db)
   Numerical differentiation also requires its own contract. The selected code offers several
finite-difference choices and a separate automatic differentiation route. The default increment
is 10−9 ; adequacy depends on parameter units, smoothness and numerical precision. A native
qualification should compare derivatives against analytic examples and rescaled parameters,
report rank and condition diagnostics, and retain nonfinite states. Inspecting the dispatch
does not qualify all derivative implementations or nonsmooth user equations.(Paul Zivich and
Delicatessen contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026db)


39.72.3     Individual rows and independent clusters give different covariance

The selected meat calculation multiplies the contribution array by its transpose. It has no
implicit knowledge that multiple account rows share a branch shock or that adjacent months
are dependent. Independence must refer to the columns supplied to the numerical routine,
with a scientific justification for any aggregation or dependence correction. (Paul Zivich and
Delicatessen contributors, 2026)
   For the same four observations, individual mean scores are (−1, −1, 1, 1), the raw bread is 4
and the raw meat is 4, yielding variance 4/42 = 1/4. If the first pair forms one independent
cluster and the second pair another, the cluster-summed scores are (−2, 2). Their raw meat is
8, while the derivative of the full summed equation remains 4, yielding 8/42 = 1/2. This is an
arithmetic witness of the missing cross terms, not evidence that two clusters suffice for reliable
asymptotic coverage.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026db)
   Supplying cluster sums as columns preserves the original full estimating equation. Unequal
cluster sizes require particular care: replacing sums with unweighted cluster means can change
the root and its target. Cross-cluster correlation or serial persistence needs a separately
justified law; aggregation alone does not solve arbitrary dependence. The inspected finite
correction offers HC1, multiplying the meat by n/(n − p) and rejecting n ≤ p. Its count is the
984                                                             Causal analysis for a universal bank


supplied unit count. This correction is not a general small-cluster or HAC justification. (Paul
Zivich and Delicatessen contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026db)

39.72.4    Standalone covariance needs an explicit shape and normalization
           contract

The standalone covariance function documents an asymptotic covariance that the caller divides
by the number of observations. Its selected one-parameter branch takes the first dimension of
the contribution array as that number. Consequently a vector of length n and a one-row array
of shape 1 × n can take different normalization paths, although both represent one equation
with n contributions. The main estimator uses a transposed array to obtain its observation
count. (Paul Zivich and Delicatessen contributors, 2026)
  Following the selected formulas symbolically for the four-value example, a vector supplies
count 4: normalized bread and meat are both 1, so standalone asymptotic variance is 1 and
the documented final division gives 1/4. A one-row array instead supplies count 1: bread
and meat are both 4, so the standalone return is 1/4. Dividing that return by the actual
four observations gives 1/16. The main estimator’s one-row route gives 1/4. Under HC1,
the standalone row branch also reaches n = p = 1 and refuses the correction. These are
conditional static control-flow deductions and independently authored arithmetic, not observed
native runs.(Paul Zivich and Delicatessen contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project,
2026db)
   The proposed worker should use a canonical contribution shape, compare both public routes
against a symbolic oracle, and label asymptotic versus estimator covariance explicitly. It
should qualify one-parameter vectors, one-row arrays, multi-parameter arrays, clusters and
finite corrections before relying on either route. Silently dividing every returned matrix by a
row count would conceal the disagreement. (Causal banking proposal project, 2026db)

39.72.5    AIPW clipping changes the protection offered by the nuisance
           models

For binary action A, outcome Y , propensity e(W ) and outcome functions ma (W ), the selected

chooses a logistic outcome model for all-binary observed outcomes unless the continuous option

establish correct action or interaction coding.(Paul Zivich and Delicatessen contributors, 2026)
  The clipping branch checks endpoint order and applies the clipping operation. That local
branch does not enforce strict endpoints inside (0, 1) or establish positivity. A worker needs
explicit domain and finite-value checks and must record the truncation policy. Conditional

39.72.6     Reference choice and the route to a qualified worker

Direct adoption as a general causal service is deferred. A narrow isolated integration remains a
candidate after equation and sampling-law review, environment locking and public known-law
tests. Porting is also deferred: it transfers responsibility for derivative, solver, shape and
covariance semantics without a measured maintenance benefit. The immediate decision is to
retain these selected sources and independent witnesses as a reference. Unsupported certainty
and automatic dependence correction are rejected claims, not reasons to reject every scoped
use of the package. (Causal banking proposal project, 2026db)
   The scientific owner specifies identification, the target, independent units and nuisance
rates. The adapter owner records shapes, residuals, rank, derivative settings, covariance
normalization and refusal states. The platform and rights owner resolves the complete
environment and redistribution obligations. Evaluation retains every request, including
nonconvergence, singularity, invalid domains, timeout and missing output. For an authored
4,800 USD total over 240 requests, 200 finite results and 160 accepted results, costs are
respectively 20, 24 and 30 USD per result under those different denominators. No measured
package economics is inferred.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026db)
   An agent may help translate a business question into a candidate equation stack and propose
unit, shape and residual checks. Human review must still approve the causal assumptions,
information clock and sampling law. CLI and MCP responses should return the same typed
target and uncertainty status as a library call, including explicit refusal. Current inspected
sources do not establish arbitrary learner rates, unrestricted hidden-state identification or
universal dependent-data calibration. Those questions need additional information or defensible
restrictions. Native, independent, bank, visual and final acceptance remain open. (Causal
banking proposal project, 2026db)

39.73      DoWhy GCM reuse: supplied mechanisms, counterfac-
           tual information and uncertainty
A bank asking how a servicing intervention changes default risk may also ask whether a
particular customer would have avoided default. These are different information requests.
DoWhy’s graphical causal model (GCM) interfaces offer useful ways to represent mechanisms
and propagate interventions, but they require a supplied causal interpretation. They do not
inherit approval from a separate review of DoWhy’s identification API. The proposed decision
retains selected GCM sources as a reference for a narrow future worker.(PyWhy contributors,
2026e; Causal banking proposal project, 2026di)
  Twelve selected original files authenticate to the repository revision of 4 October 2026: ten
GCM and graph files and the retained project and MIT license declarations. The project uses
dynamic versioning; its 0.0.0 placeholder is not a release version. The declarations require
Python at least 3.9 and below 3.14, NumPy above 2.0 and version-dependent SciPy and
NetworkX constraints. A complete distribution, numerical environment, transitive-rights
review and tested import path remain outstanding. No downloaded package or test suite is
executed here. (PyWhy contributors, 2026e)


39.73.1    A supplied graph and fitted mechanisms are separate scientific
           commitments

For a directed acyclic graph, write a proposed structural system as
                                     Xj = fj (Xpa(j) , Nj ).
The parent set, measurement clock, exogenous-noise law and invariance under the proposed
action determine the interpretation. For the selected independently sampled mechanisms, a
scientific model must justify the corresponding factorization and absence of omitted shared
noise. A conditional predictor for Xj is not alone evidence that its inputs are causes or that
its residual is independent of them. Unrecorded branch policy or common calendar shocks
can invalidate that interpretation even when prediction is accurate.(Causal banking proposal
project, 2026di)
   The selected interfaces distinguish stochastic conditional mechanisms, functional mechanisms
and mechanisms invertible with respect to noise. The additive-noise path fits a predictor
and a residual distribution; the post-nonlinear path first inverts an outer transformation, fits
a predictor, and reconstructs residual noise. These steps compute a model under declared
restrictions. They do not demonstrate those restrictions for banking data.(PyWhy contributors,
2026e)
    Parent columns are selected in sorted node order. The fitted model records the ordered
parents and checks them before causal queries, detecting a changed parent set. This is useful
structural consistency checking; it does not establish variable identity, units, observation
timing or causal truth. The proposed worker uses stable typed node identifiers, preserves
the fitted ordering, and tests asymmetric parent permutations and changed graphs. A graph
clone deliberately has untrained cloned mechanisms, so clone and fitted snapshot are different
lifecycle states. (PyWhy contributors, 2026e; Causal banking proposal project, 2026di)
   Fitting filters rows with missing target values for each node. Parent missingness remains a
matter for the chosen predictor. Consequently different mechanisms can be fitted on different
selected rows. The automatic-assignment interface rejects missing data by default and offers an
explicitly experimental numerical-missingness option. A bank workflow needs per-mechanism
row masks, a missingness argument and tests that its joint model still describes the intended
39.73. DoWhy GCM reuse: supplied mechanisms, counterfactual information and uncertainty      987


population. Local deletion is not an identification argument for missing outcomes. (PyWhy
contributors, 2026e; Causal banking proposal project, 2026di)
   Automatic assignment chooses an empirical distribution for a root and selected regression or
classification mechanisms for other nodes. Its selection uses shuffled predictive folds and MSE
or log loss. It assigns mechanisms to the supplied graph; it does not discover the graph or prove
noise independence. The selected scorer suppresses convergence and runtime warnings and
can skip classification folds with one class. A proposed evaluation retains effective fold counts
and diagnostics, and refuses selection when every candidate has a nonfinite score. Calendar
and customer splits need an explicit alternative to shuffled row folds. (PyWhy contributors,
2026e; Causal banking proposal project, 2026di)
   An LLM may propose variables, edges, transformations and mechanism classes from a
business description. Those proposals should carry sources and alternative diagrams, then
receive human approval before fitting. Predictive model selection and an agent’s confidence
cannot replace the intervention, clock or latent-variable assumptions.(Causal banking proposal
project, 2026di)


39.73.2    Intervention sampling does not retain an individual’s noise

The intervention interface accepts either observed baseline rows or a requested generated
sample count, not both. It copies the baseline data, updates affected nodes in topological order
and draws new conditional values for affected non-root nodes before applying the action. An
atomic action replaces a value; a value-dependent transformation acts on the newly generated
pre-intervention value at that node. Unaffected baseline columns can remain observed. This
is a specified population or baseline sampling procedure, not individual abduction.(PyWhy
contributors, 2026e)
  The action evaluator applies the provided function to each scalar and checks the resulting
shape. A proposed CLI or MCP interface should accept a reviewed declarative action grammar,
such as fixed-value replacement or a bounded affine transform, rather than transmitting
arbitrary code. The contract also records domains, units, interventions on descendants and
the model interpretation of each transformation. (PyWhy contributors, 2026e; Causal banking
proposal project, 2026di)
   The counterfactual path instead propagates supplied noise or reconstructs noise from
observed rows using invertible mechanisms. For an authored invariant system Y = 2A + N , an
observed account with A = 1, Y = 5 has reconstructed N = 3. Holding that noise fixed gives
Y (0) = 3. A population intervention under the additional assumption E[N ] = 0 instead has
E[Y (0)] = 0. The two answers are consistent because the targets differ. Neither calculation
validates the supplied equation against the bank’s actual decision process.(Causal banking
proposal project, 2026di)
  Categorical functional mechanisms use a uniform noise coordinate and cumulative class
probabilities. An observed category generally determines an interval of that noise, not a unique
value. The selected abduction helper explicitly rejects a noninvertible mechanism; passing
noise directly is a different information contract. A worker must retain whether noise was
measured, stipulated or inferred and what assumptions justify that inference. Inventing a noise
value to bypass the refusal would manufacture a different counterfactual question. (PyWhy
contributors, 2026e; Causal banking proposal project, 2026di)
  An authored binary example makes the information gap precise. Let U be a fair binary
variable and randomize action independently. Model I has Y (0) = U, Y (1) = U ; Model II
has Y (0) = U, Y (1) = 1 − U . Both have Bernoulli(1/2) outcome distributions under either
action, the same randomized observed law and average effect zero. Yet among accounts with
988                                                              Causal analysis for a universal bank


Y (0) = 0, the probability of Y (1) = 1 is zero in Model I and one in Model II. Population
intervention data alone cannot choose between these cross-world couplings. The proposed
service returns a model-conditional answer or an identified set when the required additional
structure is absent.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026di)


39.73.3     Average-effect event coding and intervention scope must remain
            explicit

The selected average-effect helper restricts the model to ancestors of the requested target, then
validates intervention names in that reduced graph. A request intervening on a disconnected
node can therefore be rejected rather than returned as a model-implied zero. Both are
meaningful states if documented; an adapter must not turn an exception into an estimated
zero.(PyWhy contributors, 2026e; Causal banking proposal project, 2026di)
   For a binary classifier target, the positive class fixes the event whose probability is contrasted.
The selected API permits an explicit class; otherwise the second internal class is positive. An
authored default-risk change from 1/5 to 2/5 is +1/5, while the complementary nondefault
event changes by −1/5. For a stipulated 1,000 accounts and 100 USD loss per default, the
former implies 20,000 USD additional expected loss. Event labels and financial signs must
survive the library, CLI and MCP round trips. These quantities are authored assumptions, not
observed bank effects.(PyWhy contributors, 2026e; Causal banking proposal project, 2026di)
  The alternative and reference interventions share a baseline table but invoke conditional
sampling separately. A shared table does not imply shared downstream noise. A reproducibility
contract should specify seeds, mechanism randomness, concurrency and any deliberate common-
random-number construction; Monte Carlo variance must be separated from uncertainty about
the fitted causal model.(PyWhy contributors, 2026e; Causal banking proposal project, 2026di)


39.73.4     A confidence wrapper inherits the experiment performed by its
            callable

The selected generic confidence wrapper repeats a callable with generated seeds and returns
coordinatewise percentile limits and a geometric-median summary by default. Its default is
20 repetitions. The helper named bootstrap sampling is an alias for partial application: by
itself it does not resample training data or refit mechanisms. Repeating a query on a fixed
fitted model can measure simulation variation while omitting sampling, selection, graph and
misspecification uncertainty. (PyWhy contributors, 2026e)
   The separate fit-and-compute helper clones the model and chooses a fraction of training
rows without replacement, with default fraction 0.75. It refits the mechanisms and optionally
repeats automatic assignment; the graph is still the supplied graph. Without-replacement
subsampling and the ordinary size-n bootstrap are different laws. For authored data (0, 0, 2, 2),
all size-three subsets have means (2/3, 2/3, 4/3, 4/3), whose variance about the empirical mean
is 1/9. The size-four with-replacement empirical bootstrap mean instead has variance 1/4.
These are exact conditional finite-population calculations, not evidence about the coverage
of either interval procedure. (PyWhy contributors, 2026e; Causal banking proposal project,
2026di)
  Subsampling fractions, dependence units, omitted graph uncertainty and estimator-specific
centering or scaling require a justified uncertainty design. A narrow distribution of repeated
simulations cannot settle those questions. Coordinatewise percentile intervals also do not
automatically supply simultaneous coverage for a portfolio of causal queries. (Causal banking
proposal project, 2026di)
39.73. DoWhy GCM reuse: supplied mechanisms, counterfactual information and uncertainty          989


   Dictionary outputs require a further alignment contract. The selected wrapper appends
each returned value to its key’s list, then stacks the lists for the joint summary. It does not
locally require every repetition to return the same key set. An authored sequence returning key
a only in repetitions 0, 2, 4 with values (0, 1, 2) and key b only in repetitions 1, 3, 5 with values
(0, 10, 20) has equal list lengths but no joint repetitions. Stacking produces artificial pairs
(0, 0), (1, 10), (2, 20). A proposed worker must preserve repetition IDs, require a fixed output
schema or explicitly represent missing values, and report requested and valid denominators
per query. This is a conditional source deduction, not an executed package failure. (PyWhy
contributors, 2026e; Causal banking proposal project, 2026di)


39.73.5     Graph falsification is a diagnostic with a defined comparison law

The selected falsification routine compares local-Markov-condition violations with those from
node-permuted graphs and separately assesses whether permutations commonly remain in
the graph’s equivalence class. Its result distinguishes evaluability, falsifiability and rejection.
A zero-test case is not evaluable; data-subset evaluation is allowed by default. These states
and the exact tested subset should be retained instead of compressed into a graph-approved
Boolean. (PyWhy contributors, 2026e)
  This diagnostic does not prove graph truth, rule out all hidden causes or identify an
unrestricted intervention. Its conditional-independence tests, dependence law, permutation
budget and power need their own qualification. The linked scholarly justification has not
been newly reviewed in this selected-source decision and belongs in its follow-up register.
Source comments are not a substitute for that paper’s authentic PDF and inspected technical
argument.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026di)


39.73.6     Reference decision, ownership and public qualification

The immediate choice is reference only. Direct adoption of all GCM paths is deferred. A narrow
isolated integration may follow a frozen model and action contract, full environment and rights
review, and known-law public fixtures. Porting would transfer responsibility for mechanism
fitting, graph lifecycle, randomness, abduction and uncertainty without a demonstrated cost
advantage. Unsupported causal certainty and invented individual noise are rejected claims;
the selected mechanisms remain useful candidates. (Causal banking proposal project, 2026di)
   The scientific owner approves the graph, target, invariance and noise law. The adapter owner
preserves fitted parent identity, action grammar, positive class, noise provenance, repetition
IDs and all refusal states. Platform and rights owners resolve dependencies, resource limits
and distribution obligations. Evaluation records every requested fit and query, including
missingness, failed selection, noninvertibility, timeouts and nonfinite results. An authored
5,400 USD total across 270 requests, 225 finite outputs and 180 accepted outputs yields 20, 24
and 30 USD under the respective denominators. These are illustrative costs. (Causal banking
proposal project, 2026di)
   Public qualification should compare independent structural oracles with the pinned worker,
including asymmetric graphs, parent reordering, changed mechanisms, categorical event coding,
disconnected interventions, missing-data masks, individual-versus-population targets and all
uncertainty routes. It should include deliberately indistinguishable cross-world models to
test appropriate refusal. Hidden banking truth and unrestricted dependent uncertainty have
no universal software repair. Native, independent, bank, visual and final acceptance remain
open.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026di)

39.74      Tetrad across language boundaries: preserving the sci-
           entific object
A bank may want an analyst in Python, a model reviewer in R and an approved Java discovery
engine to discuss the same borrower graph. Calling the same algorithm name does not
ensure that they have supplied the same variables, categories, missingness policy, background
knowledge or statistical test. Nor does a returned graph identify an intervention merely
because a bridge makes it convenient to query. A useful proposal therefore treats the language
boundary as part of the scientific specification. The inherited restricted Java PC/Fisher-Z
candidate remains distinct from the Python and R surfaces considered here.(Causal banking
proposal project, 2026r; Tetrad contributors, 2026d)


The original design and the pinned implementation. Ramsey and Andrews describe
a Python interface through JPype, an R interface through Reticulate and Python, data
conversion, endpoint graphs and examples of background knowledge and resampling. Their
2023 primary paper explains why access to the underlying Java classes is valuable, while its
examples require deliberate column typing. It is evidence for that architecture, not proof of
compatibility of every later distribution. The Python example declares ten repetitions whereas
the displayed edge-frequency table describes one hundred; the paper alone does not establish a
common request denominator for those artifacts. We use neither the displayed frequencies as
bank graph truth nor this textual discrepancy as a measured software defect.(Ramsey and
Andrews, 2023)
   The selected bridge revision is the 7 October 2026 commit recorded in the source audit. Its
setup declares version 0.1.2 and Python at least 3.7, whereas its README asks for Python
at least 3.12 and JDK 21 or later. Its packaged JAR is described as a released version or a
version with adjustments. The tree records a 56,587,560-byte JAR, but the binary has not
been acquired or executed here. Consequently the Java revision previously inspected, the
bridge commit, the package version and the bundled binary are four identities to reconcile.
The bridge’s permissive root license does not settle the inherited Java distribution or embedded
third-party terms. The selected R file separately points to MIT (SEI)-style terms and third-
party software; the referenced license.txt is absent from the selected complete repository
tree. That is a bounded documentary gap, not a legal conclusion. (Tetrad contributors, 2026d;
cmu-phil/tetrad, 2026b)


Types and categories are substantive inputs. The selected Python converter treats
floating columns as continuous and other column types as discrete by default. Its optional
integer-as-continuous switch is not passed by the ordinary search constructor. An integer-
valued account balance can therefore enter a different statistical family from the same values
represented as floating point. A worker must require the scientific type explicitly; storage
dtype is an inadequate substitute for units and measurement meaning.(Tetrad contributors,
2026d)
   For discrete variables, the converter assigns category numbers in first-seen order. Consider
two branch datasets containing the same categories but starting respectively with approve then
decline, and decline then approve. Independently generated codes assign approve zero in the
first and one in the second. This does not show that Java necessarily pools them incorrectly:
the eventual delegate could reconcile labels. It shows why a wrapper cannot presume identical
codes merely from identical column names. The conversion also stringifies labels and column
names. The distinct Python objects integer one and string 1 both become the same string;
a verified bijection must reject or reversibly escape this collision before constructing Java
39.74. Tetrad across language boundaries: preserving the scientific object                 991


variables. (Tetrad contributors, 2026d; Causal banking proposal project, 2026ej)
   Missingness needs a separate representation. Continuous output is reconstructed as floating
columns and discrete missing output as Python None. On the forward path, the selected
converter enumerates unique discrete values without an explicit missing-sentinel branch,
converts mapped codes to integer and stringifies category names. This can turn a missing
token into a named category or encounter a mapping/cast failure, depending on the input and
installed pandas behavior. The audit does not claim one universal runtime outcome. Preserve
a typed category dictionary, a missing mask, ordered row and column identifiers and the
requested imputation or deletion policy. A successful round trip must preserve each of these,
including all-missing and mixed columns. (Tetrad contributors, 2026d)
   The R directory contains more than one interface concept. Its README and the 2023 paper
discuss the Reticulate route, while the selected temporary TetradSearch.R class calls rJava
directly. Its converter tests is.numeric before is.integer, despite a comment recommending
integer columns for discrete data. An independent base-R witness verifies that an ordinary
integer vector satisfies both predicates and therefore takes the first, continuous branch. This
witness executes no Tetrad or rJava code. Factor codes and Java helper behavior still need
their own inspection; the branch observation is not a finding about every R interface. The
accompanying utility refers to Tetrad 7.6.5 and a moving JDK download, which must not be
silently equated with the Python JAR.(Tetrad contributors, 2026d; Causal banking proposal
project, 2026ej)


Endpoint matrices are not binary adjacencies. Let the ordered variables be A, Y , and
suppose a graph contains A → Y . The selected endpoint converter places the endpoint at
node i in entry Mji , using three for a tail and two for an arrowhead. Hence

                                                  3 0

labels.(Tetrad contributors, 2026d; Causal banking proposal project, 2026ej)
  An adapter should expose distinct, validated types for binary adjacency, endpoint graph,
CPDAG, PAG and a deliberately selected DAG. Preserve both endpoint symbols, row and
column names, ordering and graph class. The selected causal-learn converters map named
enum members rather than relying solely on the numeric comments; their target library must
nevertheless be versioned. A CPDAG-to-DAG convenience call selects an extension. It does
not resolve observational equivalence or authorize a point causal effect. (Tetrad contributors,

  The monetary importance can be demonstrated without fitting software. In one authored
Gaussian model, A = UA and Y = 12 A + UY , with independent zero-mean noises of variances

                                               1/2 1

The causal derivative of the mean of Y with respect to an intervention on A is one half in
the first model and zero in the second. An analyst cannot choose between them from this
observed distribution alone. If an action increases A by one unit for 200 accounts, each unit of
Y is stipulated to be worth 100 USD, and implementation costs 4,000 USD, the net values are
6,000 USD and minus 4,000 USD respectively. These are exact illustrative calculations, not an
empirical return estimate. A reversed edge or arbitrary DAG extension can therefore change
an investment recommendation while leaving observational fit unchanged.(Causal banking
proposal project, 2026ej)


Failure, knowledge and process identity. The selected search object retains mutable
parameters, graph results, background knowledge and pooled datasets. The PC and FCI
methods assign self.java only after a search returns. A later failed search can therefore
leave the prior graph accessible through an ordinary getter; set_data itself does not invalidate
that graph. This follows from the assignment order and is illustrated by an independent
state witness, not an induced failure in downloaded software. New data also do not by
themselves empty the separately stored pooled datasets. A proposed worker must bind every
successful result to its own immutable request, input hashes, parameter snapshot, knowledge
and execution generation. It must never publish a previous graph as the result of a failed new
request. (Tetrad contributors, 2026d; Causal banking proposal project, 2026ej)
   Several smaller source observations reinforce the need for interface fixtures. The mixed-

value. Several explicit-graph getter branches invoke converters without returning their result;
the explicit graph-to-matrix branch also drops custom endpoint codes. A bootstrap index
check permits an index equal to the number of stored graphs before indexing. These are
selected source-level mismatches, not a claim that every wrapper method fails. Test default and
explicit arguments separately, compare echoed effective parameters, and make missing, stale,
nonfinite, cancelled and unsupported results distinct. The R knowledge-tier helper catches and
prints errors; a worker needs a machine-readable failure and a check of the effective constraints.
(Tetrad contributors, 2026d)
   JVM startup introduces a further shared-state boundary. The translation and missing-data
modules start a JVM at import when needed, and otherwise reuse the already running process
without a local equality check of the loaded JAR. The G-regression module has its own
startup path with different flags. A caught startup exception followed by imports is not a

and flags are fixed before importing the bridge; fail closed if they cannot be attested. The
setup declares NumPy, pandas and JPype but the main search module also imports NetworkX.
Inspecting that fact and the G-regression delegate does not complete the native dependency
closure.(Tetrad contributors, 2026d)
   The missing-data helper delegates auditing, imputation and pooling by edge frequency
to Java. Checking for a class name does not establish the delegate’s scientific assumptions,
calibration or identity. Likewise the G-regression wrapper passes a supplied graph into an
effect and bootstrap delegate; its source comments about identification and prior parity tests
are not new verified results in this proposal. Preserve graph selection, missingness, resampling
units and all failures as separate uncertainty dimensions. A pooled edge frequency is not
automatically a posterior probability of a bank cause, and fixed-graph effect uncertainty need
39.75. Weka Bayesian networks as predictive references and causal comparators                  993


not cover graph selection. (Tetrad contributors, 2026d)


A bounded reuse choice and qualification route. Retain the bridge and original paper

39.75      Weka Bayesian networks as predictive references and
           causal comparators
A bank can use a Bayesian-network classifier to predict a borrower’s observed repayment while
still lacking an answer about what a servicing intervention would change. Both tasks may display
a directed graph and probability tables, yet they condition on different information and impose
different scientific requirements. Weka is consequently useful to the proposal as a concrete
predictive comparator and software reference. Its selected classifier must not inherit causal-
discovery or intervention guarantees merely from the words Bayesian network. The earlier Java
and temporal surveys remain distinct evidence, with their original limitations.(Waikato/weka-
3.8, 2022a,b; University of Waikato contributors, 2022)


A historical source identity rather than an invented current release. The inspected
GitHub mirror ends at a pinned 10 August 2022 revision. Its README explicitly directs users
to the official Waikato Git service and says the mirror is no longer updated. The source resource
says 3-8-7-snapshot, and the build descriptor says 3.8.7-SNAPSHOT. These declarations
agree on a development identity; they do not establish a published 2026 distribution. The
official successor’s cutoff identity is unresolved in the present source collection. The build
declares GPL terms and Java profiles alongside numerical, parser and runtime dependencies.
Actual binary identity, complete notices, support and distribution arrangements need separate
994                                                                     Causal analysis for a universal bank


review; neither a historical snapshot nor process isolation clears those obligations. (University
of Waikato contributors, 2022)


What the default classifier actually learns. The selected BayesNet source initializes
K2 structure search and a simple conditional-probability estimator. Its training path removes
rows whose class is missing, applies supervised discretization to non-nominal predictors and
fits a replacement filter for missing predictors. The structure-search base class initializes
a naive-Bayes graph by default, with arrows from the class to every other variable and a
one-parent limit. K2 puts the class first in its ordering and searches only earlier candidate
parents. With these defaults, the initial class parent already fills the one-parent budget for
each other variable. This is a source-level description of a classifier configuration; it cannot be
interpreted as a finding that future default status causes a borrower’s previously measured
characteristics.(University of Waikato contributors, 2022)
  Changing the initialization, parent bound, search family or class column changes the
procedure. The selected conditional-independence search compares local scores with and
without a parent; it is not the Fisher-Z test with a declared significance level used by the
earlier restricted Tetrad candidate. An optional classifier correction can add arrows to connect
variables to the class’s Markov blanket. The randomized K2 order also constructs a new random
generator in its selected path without a locally supplied seed argument. Consequently an
adapter needs an explicit algorithm, effective settings, ordering, randomization and output-class
contract. An algorithm label is insufficient for either scientific comparison or reproducibility.
(University of Waikato contributors, 2022)


Conditioning does not perform an intervention. For a discrete network with parents
pa(j), the selected estimator forms a joint factorization
                                              Y
                                    pb(x) =       pbj (xj | xpa(j) ).
                                              j

Its class-probability routine evaluates that product for each candidate class value and normalizes
across classes. With observed predictors X = x, the result represents a fitted pb(Y = y | X = x).
It does not delete the treatment-assignment factor or justify invariance of the remaining
mechanisms. For a causal DAG under appropriate structural assumptions, an intervention
would instead replace the action mechanism and use the corresponding truncated factorization.
Those assumptions and the identification step are additional inputs, not consequences of
conditional-probability normalization. (University of Waikato contributors, 2022; Causal
banking proposal project, 2026ev)
  An exact authored example makes the distinction operational. Let an unobserved binary
borrower type U have probability one half. Let success be Y = U , and let action A be assigned
with probabilities 4/5 when U = 1 and 1/5 when U = 0. There is no arrow from action to
outcome. Bayes’ rule gives

                    P (Y = 1 | A = 1) = 4/5,           P (Y = 1 | A = 0) = 1/5,

whereas replacing the action assignment leaves

                    P (Y = 1 | do(A = 1)) = P (Y = 1 | do(A = 0)) = 1/2.

All treatment levels have positive probability in both type strata; the failure is uncontrolled
confounding, not zero exposure probability. If 1,000 accounts are each worth 100 USD per
incremental success and the action costs 10,000 USD, misreading the conditional difference as
39.75. Weka Bayesian networks as predictive references and causal comparators                995


a causal effect gives a net 50,000 USD. The stipulated true causal value is minus 10,000 USD.
A well-fitted classifier can reproduce the observational conditionals perfectly and still give no
justification for the first investment calculation.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026ev)


Smoothing and weights change the statistical object. The selected estimator initializes
each category count to α, defaulting to one half, and then adds instance weights. If a parent
configuration j has weighted counts njk for K categories, its fitted table is
                                               njk + α
                                    pbjk = PK             .
                                             ℓ=1 njℓ + Kα

For binary counts (0, 1) the result is (1/4, 3/4). Multiplying the data weights by ten while
retaining the same prior gives (1/22, 21/22). An unobserved binary row returns (1/2, 1/2)
under the default positive prior. Finite probabilities in such a row do not create observed
treatment support or validate a transport assumption. The worker must retain prior strength,
category dictionary, support counts and the meaning of weights. (University of Waikato
contributors, 2022; Causal banking proposal project, 2026ev)
   The inspected plain local-score path increments integer counts once per row, whereas the
simple CPT estimator uses each instance’s weight. Two category observations with weights
one and nine therefore contribute counts (1, 1) to that selected search-score path and (1, 9)
to CPT estimation. With the same half-count smoothing, the corresponding probability
illustrations are (1/2, 1/2) and (3/22, 19/22). The first is an illustration of the score’s row-
count sufficient statistics, not a claim that this score outputs a probability vector. The
mismatch requires an explicit weight contract and a native fixture; it is not resolved by the
classifier declaring a weighted-data interface. Other search and ADTree paths need separate
qualification. (University of Waikato contributors, 2022; Causal banking proposal project,
2026ev)


Preprocessing defines the target population and information clock. The supervised
discretizer chooses cut points using class counts and entropy. Fit it only within the permitted
training split and retain its boundaries when processing a held-out borrower. Choosing cut
points with evaluation labels would leak outcome information. Even when correctly split,
a category produced by this procedure is a data-dependent measurement transformation;
its meaning must be reconciled with any causal estimand stated for the original continuous
quantity. A predictive cut point does not supply a bank intervention rule. (University of
Waikato contributors, 2022)
   Removal of missing-class rows can also change the population. In an authored example,
success has population probability one half, success labels are always observed, and failure
labels are observed with probability one quarter. Among observed labels, success then has
probability
                                      (1/2) · 1
                                                        = 4/5.
                              (1/2) · 1 + (1/2) · (1/4)
This is a selected sample, not a newly discovered improvement in borrower quality. The source
does not by itself correct the selection mechanism. A proposal must state the label clock,
selection probabilities or assumptions, target population and necessary sensitivity analysis
before extrapolation. (Causal banking proposal project, 2026ev)
   The replacement delegate computes weighted modes and means from its fitted batch,
excludes the class from replacement, and reuses the fitted values on later instances. In its
standalone numeric branch, a column without observed weight retains the initialized zero
996                                                            Causal analysis for a universal bank


replacement; in a nominal column with declared categories and no observations, all-zero counts
select the first category through the maximum-index helper. The full BayesNet pipeline
discretizes non-nominal predictors before this delegate, so these primitive branches must not
be conflated with every end-to-end outcome. Missing masks and all-missing warnings remain
necessary. Single replacement values neither integrate missing-value uncertainty nor establish
a missing-at-random law. (University of Waikato contributors, 2022)


Graph import and output validation. The selected initial-BIF path matches a node by
name but bounds its parent loop using the original dataset index rather than that matched
source index. For a source ordering [A, B] with A → B and a dataset ordering [B, A], the
first node’s requested parent count is zero although B has one parent; the second uses a count
of one for a node with no parents. This is an exact index witness for the selected source
statements. It does not assert the exception type or runtime outcome of a compiled import.
Require permutation-equivariant node and category mappings and compare the complete
imported parent sets and tables. The warning that an unknown parent is ignored must become
an explicit rejected or incomplete request when graph preservation is required. (University of
Waikato contributors, 2022; Causal banking proposal project, 2026ev)
   The class-probability routine computes in log space and subtracts the largest log score
before exponentiating. This improves ordinary numerical scaling, but it is not a guarantee
that every input yields a valid probability vector. Its normalization helper rejects a zero or
NaN sum, and the selected caller catches that exception and returns an all-zero vector as a
missing prediction. Such a vector sums to zero, not one. A downstream decision rule must not
read it as zero risk or a confident class. Validate dimensions, labels, finiteness, nonnegativity
and unit sum; retain the distinct failure state and its cost. The generic inherited classifier test
does not establish any causal calibration or these complete integration conditions.(University
of Waikato contributors, 2022; Causal banking proposal project, 2026ev)


Disposition and a concrete public qualification. Retain the pinned classifier and
source as a historical reference and a conditional predictive comparator. Defer unrestricted
adoption until a permitted official successor identity, selected scientific task, full rights and
reproducible environment are established. An isolated Java integration could be economical
when it preserves typed inputs, preprocessing, ordering, weights and complete failure semantics.
Porting a Bayesian-network engine creates new search, probability and maintenance obligations
without a measured benefit here. Reject using this classifier graph as an automatically identified
causal model; retain separately specified causal and predictive alternatives. (Causal banking
proposal project, 2026ev)
  The scientific owner defines prediction versus intervention, observed-label selection, support
and temporal split. The adapter owner validates imports, preprocessing state, output simplex

node-permutation and numerical-refusal fixtures. A 7,200 USD authored trial with 360

   Known routes exist for official source access, artifact and license inspection, typed native
public fixtures and fair predictive comparison. Unknown bank assignment, missing-label
truth and causal sufficiency require new information or defensible restrictions; a software
wrapper cannot manufacture them. The reference decision gives no native, causal or economic
qualification. Independent, visual and final acceptance remain open.

39.76      Banjo: temporal network search, observation clocks and
           a bounded reference choice
A bank may seek a temporal graph linking servicing actions, balances and later repayment.
The useful question is whether changing an action changes repayment, not merely whether
yesterday’s recorded action predicts tomorrow’s label. Banjo supplies a concrete reference
for discrete Bayesian-network search with lag restrictions. The acquired implementation is
a gene-network application derivative, however, and its inferred cellular pseudotime is not
a bank’s physical decision clock. Its selected source can inform a proposed worker contract
without establishing an operational banking implementation. This comparison preserves
the earlier Java and temporal surveys and extends their analysis of identity, preprocessing,
search and graph output daniel-315/slingshot-modified-banjo (2026a,b); Duke University Banjo
authors and application derivative contributors (2026).


39.76.1     Which artifact, which permission, which proposed use?

The selected repository is daniel-315/slingshot-modified-banjo, pinned to its 13 August
2026 commit. Twenty-one selected original files authenticate against the complete pinned
tree through Git blob identity and full-byte SHA-256. They include application settings, the
score and observation implementations, graph management, search, proposal and cycle checks,
discretization, and the graph comparator. Source constants identify Banjo 2.2.0 with the
date 15 April 2008; that declaration does not authenticate an official distribution, describe
all derivative changes or establish current maintenance. The selected compile script targets
Java 8 bytecode; the script has been inspected but not executed. Neither successful native
compilation nor the identity of a distributed binary is claimed Duke University Banjo authors
and application derivative contributors (2026).
  The source notice reserves rights to Duke University and Alexander Hartemink. It says that
noncommercial use may be licensed and directs commercial users to contact the rights holder.
A possible license is not a granted license. The official-source identity attempt was refused
by the fixed collector’s host policy before an HTTP response, so the evidence does not show

reuse permission from public source visibility Duke University Banjo authors and application
