   Reference use is therefore the present proposal decision. Direct adoption and porting
are deferred pending authentic rights and a measured benefit. A separate Java worker is
a candidate integration route after rights, artifact identity and public fixtures are qualified.
Rewriting the search is an alternative only if its scientific and maintenance costs justify a
separate implementation. Rejecting automatic causal interpretations or silent conversion loss
does not require rejecting every predictive comparison. The source review establishes this

39.76.2     Lag windows, discretization and support must share a clock

Let Xi,t be variable i in an observation file and let L be the maximum lag. Each scored row
pairs current variables with their preceding L rows. For valid file lengths Tf > L, the number
of available windows is                      X
                                       N=       (Tf − L).
                                              f
998                                                                    Causal analysis for a universal bank


The selected observation implementation constructs windows within each file, so it avoids
a transition from the end of one file to the beginning of the next. Two files of lengths four
and three with L = 1 supply five windows. Concatenating them first supplies six and creates
one false cross-file transition. The application setting of 959 observations with lag one yields
958 available windows in one file; the requested count is capped at the available count. A
file boundary is consequently part of the statistical input, not merely a storage optimization.
A proposed bank adapter must retain entity boundaries, calendars, missing intervals and
the meaning of a row Duke University Banjo authors and application derivative contributors
(2026); Causal banking proposal project (2026cw).
   By contrast, the discretization map is fitted to all combined loaded raw observations before
those observations are mapped back to their files. The selected interval discretizer uses the
observed range and a requested number of bins; when the number of distinct values does
not exceed the bin count, it assigns successive category labels. It is not an equal-frequency
rule. In the authored two-bin witness, training values 0, 1, 2 map to 0, 1, 1. Adding a held-out
value of 100 changes their mapping to 0, 0, 0. This is a precise reason to declare the fit split
before preprocessing. It is not evidence that every exploratory use of combined observations
is leakage. A future predictive evaluation requires training-only fit, retained cutpoints and a
declared out-of-range policy. The selected value-lookup path throws when a value has no stored
mapping; an adapter must not assume that an arbitrary new observation is automatically
classified by a frozen threshold model Duke University Banjo authors and application derivative
contributors (2026); Causal banking proposal project (2026cw).
   A second boundary concerns a category present only in the initial lag rows. The selected
cardinality routine scans current slices of usable windows and takes one plus each variable’s
largest code. For a coded sequence (1, 0, 0) with lag one, current slices contain only zero
but the first lagged parent is one. The authored witness compares a current-only cardinality
of one with a lag-inclusive cardinality of two. The score’s parent-configuration count uses
these declared cardinalities, while its indexing reads lagged values. This is a conditional
inconsistency requiring an end-to-end fixture, not an observed Java crash. Earlier validation
or a different runtime path could refuse the input. The product contract should verify every
current and lagged code against its declared domain before search, and preserve a refusal
rather than quietly renumbering the data Duke University Banjo authors and application
derivative contributors (2026); Causal banking proposal project (2026cw).


39.76.3     What the score establishes, and what it does not

For node i, let ri be its number of states, qi the product of its parents’ state counts, Nijk
                                                                     P
the count for parent configuration j and child state k, and Nij = k Nijk . With positive
equivalent sample size α, the inspected evaluator implements the local log score
                          qi
                          X
                   si =         [log Γ(α/qi ) − log Γ(α/qi + Nij )]
                          j=1
                              qi X
                              X  ri
                          +             [log Γ(α/(qi ri ) + Nijk ) − log Γ(α/(qi ri ))] .
                              j=1 k=1

Zero-count terms cancel. The source has compact-array and legacy observation paths, in-
crements integer counts for the selected rows and can precompute log-gamma values. Its
input validation requires a positive equivalent sample size. These facts identify the selected
computation; they do not prove that successive bank windows are independent or that a
chosen discrete model is correct Duke University Banjo authors and application derivative
contributors (2026).
39.76. Banjo: temporal network search, observation clocks and a bounded reference choice        999


   The exact authored oracle evaluates the same finite rising-factorial expression without
executing Banjo. For binary parent and child, counts (2, 0) and (0, 2) and α = 2 give a
conditional marginal factor 9/64. The no-parent counts (2, 2) give 1/30, so their ratio is 135/32.
Repeating each observation twice changes that ratio to 385875/8192. The extra apparent
strength is produced by count duplication; it does not manufacture independent information.
The local ratio conditions on the specified domains, prior and models, with common terms held
fixed. It is not a posterior probability of a causal edge. The oracle also checks the log-gamma
representation numerically against the exact rational results Causal banking proposal project
(2026cw).
   Lag order alone does not resolve this causal distinction. Consider two authored mechanisms
for an action At−1 and outcome Yt . In the first, a hidden fair binary variable Ut−1 determines
both At−1 = Ut−1 and Yt = Ut−1 . In the second, At−1 is fair binary and Yt = At−1 . Both
observational laws place probability one half on (0, 0) and (1, 1), yet their intervention contrasts
are respectively zero and one. Time direction excludes a future-to-past arrow but does not
exclude the hidden common cause. A hypothetical campaign covering 1,000 accounts, valuing
a successful outcome at 50 USD and costing 10,000 USD therefore has net value of either
−10,000 or 40,000 USD under these two mechanisms. Neither number is a bank forecast.
Additional assignment knowledge, measured confounders, interventions or a justified restricted
causal model is needed to decide between them Causal banking proposal project (2026cw).


39.76.4     Constraints and retained graphs are part of the result

The application configuration fixes lag one, mandatory self-lag, at most five parents, two-bin
discretization, greedy search, all local proposals and a five-minute time budget. Those choices
define a constrained search space. Mandatory self-lag consumes a parent slot and cannot
be advertised as a discovered relationship. The inspected proposal implementation respects
addable and deletable parent sets and the parent limit; reversal proposals are restricted to
contemporaneous edges. Cycle checks exempt deletions and positive-lag changes, consistently
with a time-unrolled graph. Two-way lagged feedback is consequently distinct from a forbidden
contemporaneous directed cycle. One cycle-check strategy validates before applying a move;
another applies then undoes a rejected cyclic move. A future worker must test rollback as well
as the accepted output Duke University Banjo authors and application derivative contributors
(2026).
   Greedy acceptance permits equal scores, allowing moves across a score plateau. Search
termination can depend on elapsed time, proposed/visited networks and restart limits. Settings
derive per-thread seeds from a base seed plus a thread index; the base may be supplied or
time based. A fixed seed alone therefore does not specify a run terminated by a machine-
dependent wall-clock limit. Preserve seed, thread configuration, counts, termination reason
and intermediate failures. Compare deterministic work budgets where possible and record
time-budget sensitivity separately Duke University Banjo authors and application derivative
contributors (2026).
   The requested five best networks are configured as nonidentical. This takes the equivalence-
skip branch, whose predicate returns false; it is distinct from the source’s non-equivalent-network
option. Neither option turns the retained list into a calibrated sample from a graph posterior.
Even if four graphs have equal probability and an edge appears in two of them, retaining only
those two makes its retained-list frequency one rather than its full probability of one half. A
graph rank, score, retained-list frequency and intervention probability must therefore have
different output fields Duke University Banjo authors and application derivative contributors
(2026); Causal banking proposal project (2026cw).
1000                                                          Causal analysis for a universal bank


   The selected graph comparator also needs a tied-score fixture. After matching score and
per-node parent counts, it returns zero for identical edge entries and positive one for distinct
entries. For two distinct graphs meeting those conditions, the authored control-flow witness
obtains positive one in both comparison directions. This violates the antisymmetry expected
of an ordered comparison. It does not establish that a particular recorded Banjo run lost or
duplicated a graph. A qualified worker must test insertion permutations, exact identity, ties
and removal against an independent canonical edge set; porting this branch without examining
the contract would preserve the problem Duke University Banjo authors and application
derivative contributors (2026); Causal banking proposal project (2026cw).

   The known route is a small, preregistered fixture family: independent files and irregular

environment can supply native evidence. No downloaded source or compilation script has been
run for this review Causal banking proposal project (2026cw).
   Scientific ownership covers the target, clock, identification and support; adapter ownership
covers domains, windows, graph identity and refusal; rights/platform ownership covers dis-
tribution, dependencies and maintenance; evaluation ownership covers predeclared oracles,
every request and costs. For illustration only, 9,000 USD over 300 submitted, 225 completed
and 150 qualified requests gives respectively 30, 40 and 60 USD per request. Source review,
environment creation, conversions, failures and maintenance belong in that numerator. Prices
and performance remain unmeasured. Authentic official identity and terms, native fixtures,

39.77      libDAI: exact factor meaning before approximate com-
           putation
A bank may need probabilities from an already specified causal model before it compares
interventions. A discrete inference engine can compute those probabilities, but it cannot supply
missing causal assumptions merely by returning normalized beliefs. libDAI is a useful reference
for that boundary: its factor representation, exact enumeration, junction-tree computation
and belief propagation expose different mathematical and operational contracts. The earlier
combined C++ comparison remains intact; this review separates libDAI’s concrete reuse
decision from OpenGM and examines the selected implementation rather than treating a
39.77. libDAI: exact factor meaning before approximate computation                           1001


feature list as qualification libDAI and OpenGM contributors (2026); libDAI authors and
mirror contributors (2012).


39.77.1     A historical paper and a later source revision

Mooij’s five-page JMLR paper describes version 0.2.7, released under GPL v2 or later. Its factor-
graph formulation, available inference tasks and interface scope are primary technical evidence.
Its comparison table is historical, and its performance statements are not measurements of the
proposed banking worker. The genuine publisher PDF is retained and inspected, including
its distinction among marginals, partition functions and maximum-probability configurations.
The paper says that not every method implements every task; it does not promise a general
causal-discovery or identification service Mooij (2010).
   The selected source is the dbtsai/libDAI mirror at its 16 May 2012 revision. Its README
declares version 0.3.0, dated 12 July 2011, and its license grants redistribution under two-clause
BSD conditions. Those later terms must not be projected backwards onto the paper’s version.
Nineteen selected files authenticate against the complete pinned tree, including factor and
probability primitives, indexing, factor-graph operations, exact inference, belief propagation,
junction-tree construction and build settings. The mirror is not authenticated as an official
current distribution. The official-source attempt was rejected by the collector’s fixed host
policy, which is not evidence of an unavailable server libDAI authors and mirror contributors
(2012); Causal banking proposal project (2026dm).
   The Linux template links GMP and GMPXX and names Boost libraries. Its SWIG example
points to Python 2.7 headers. Those are concrete porting questions, not proof that a modern
Python package is unusable or already supported. The platform-independent configuration
enables debug checks, while the makefile permits another configuration. A qualified artifact
must record the actual build options and complete dependency notices. The inspected BSD
notice is evidence about the selected source, not complete clearance of a future binary and
its bindings. No downloaded build script, source or native library has been executed for this
review libDAI authors and mirror contributors (2012).


39.77.2     Factor meaning is a typed conversion contract

Let the finite variables be XV = (Xi : i ∈ V ) and let each nonnegative factor fI depend on
variables XNI . The represented probability law is
                                    Q
                                        I fI (xNI )
                                                               XY
                         p(xV ) =                     ,   Z=            fI (xNI ).
                                           Z                   xV   I

This requires finite nonnegative entries and 0 < Z < ∞. A Bayesian network can be represented
using one conditional-probability factor per variable. That conversion preserves a probability
law only if category meaning, variable identity, dimensions and entry ordering are also preserved
Mooij (2010); libDAI authors and mirror contributors (2012).
   The source orders variables by ascending numeric label and uses the first variable as the
fastest-changing index. With binary X followed by three-state Y , the index is x+2y. Assigning
weights (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6) in that order yields p(X = 1) = 4/7. Reading the same vector as a
row-major table with index 3x + y instead yields 5/7. Both outputs normalize and can look
plausible; a probability-simplex check cannot detect this error. One factor constructor accepts
a variable set and copies entries, whereas the ordered variable-vector constructor explicitly
permutes entries. A proposed adapter must select the correct contract and retain category
1002                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


labels and the permutation as auditable input libDAI authors and mirror contributors (2012);
Causal banking proposal project (2026dm).
   The variable comparison operators use labels for identity; matching labels with different
state counts trigger checks only under the selected debug conditional. The adapter should
always reject conflicting domains before construction, regardless of the native build. The
linear-index routine also defaults unspecified variables to state zero. A missing business
observation must therefore be represented as missing evidence, not passed as an omitted state
that silently becomes the first category. The marginal routine intersects the requested variable
set with the factor’s domain; the caller must verify that every requested variable was actually
represented. These are distinct identity, missingness and query-completeness tests libDAI
authors and mirror contributors (2012).


39.77.3     Clamping evidence does not perform a causal intervention

The inspected factor-graph clamp multiplies neighboring factors by a single-state indicator.
This conditions the original distribution on an observation. In a causally justified Bayesian
network, an intervention instead replaces the factor governing the action by the specified
assignment mechanism, while retaining the other mechanisms. The factor graph alone does not
say which table was an action’s causal mechanism. That provenance must survive compilation
libDAI authors and mirror contributors (2012); Causal banking proposal project (2026dm).
   An exact authored example makes the distinction observable. Let U be fair binary, let
P (A = U | U ) = 4/5, and let Y = U . Then P (Y = 1 | A = 1) = 4/5, while P (Y = 1 | do(A =
1)) = 1/2 and the intervention contrast is zero. The conditioning calculation retains p(A | U );
the intervention calculation replaces it. This example supplies the causal model explicitly. It
does not infer that model from the observed distribution Causal banking proposal project
(2026dm).
   Nor is making a cavity a generic intervention implementation: the selected method replaces
every factor touching a variable with ones, which can erase outcome mechanisms as well as
the assignment mechanism. Backup and restore operations can retain earlier factors, but
the worker must verify recovery under failed or cancelled requests. In the selected clamp,
the initial guard permits an index equal to the number of states, whereas valid indices are
strictly smaller. The subsequent setter has a debug-only bounds check. This is a conditional
source boundary requiring a native fixture, not an observed memory fault. The proposed API
rejects every index outside 0 ≤ x < ri before calling the library libDAI authors and mirror
contributors (2012); Causal banking proposal project (2026dm).


39.77.4     Exact inference has numerical and resource conditions

The selected exact enumerator multiplies factors into a full joint table, computes its sum and
normalizes marginals. Its algorithmic exactness is conditional on the supplied finite model; it
does not imply exact arithmetic. For two singleton factors with entries (10−200 , 2 · 10−200 ), the
mathematically normalized product is (1/5, 4/5), but both binary64 products underflow to zero
in the independent witness. A log-scale calculation with maximum subtraction recovers the
intended normalized ratio. An exactly zero normalizer instead denotes an impossible or invalid
query and must be refused. Scaling factors and tracking their scales can preserve normalized
beliefs, but the scales must also be restored when reporting log Z. The inspected probability
primitive explicitly refuses a zero norm; finite, nonnegative inputs and finite outputs require
additional checks libDAI authors and mirror contributors (2012); Causal banking proposal
project (2026dm).
39.77. libDAI: exact factor meaning before approximate computation                           1003


   Resource use is another part of the result. A full joint table on thirty binary variables
has 230 entries: eight-byte entries alone require 8 GiB, before containers and intermediate
products. Junction-tree inference can exploit structure, but its clique tables may still be large.
The selected constructor chooses an elimination heuristic and applies a memory estimate with
a documented heuristic multiplier. An estimate is not an operating-system resource limit.
A proposed worker needs its own memory, time, cancellation and output limits, and must
report when a requested exact calculation was refused or replaced by an explicitly approved
approximation libDAI authors and mirror contributors (2012); Causal banking proposal project
(2026dm).


39.77.5     A zero convergence residual can coexist with a wrong marginal

Belief propagation iterates messages, with configured update order, damping, log-domain
arithmetic, tolerance and iteration/time bounds. The selected implementation returns the
largest change in beliefs; a nonconvergence warning is conditional on verbosity. It explicitly
omits NaN checks in the iteration loop. A worker must inspect residuals, iteration counts,
finite values and termination conditions independently of textual logs. Even a finite residual
below tolerance does not bound marginal error libDAI authors and mirror contributors (2012).
   Consider an authored triangle of binary variables with edge factor three when neighboring
states agree and one when they disagree. Uniform messages remain uniform after a belief-
propagation update, giving zero residual. The resulting edge belief assigns agreement probability
3/4. Exact enumeration gives two all-equal states of weight 27 each and six other states of
weight three each, hence Z = 72. For a fixed edge, the agreeing weight is 60, so its true
agreement probability is 5/6. The error is 1/12 despite the fixed point. Single-variable
marginals are one half in both calculations, so inspecting only those marginals would miss the
discrepancy Causal banking proposal project (2026dm).
   This is a mathematical witness for the proposed diagnostic, not a native libDAI benchmark.
It distinguishes iterative stability, approximation error and statistical uncertainty. Under a
hypothetical decision coefficient of 120,000 USD, an error of 1/12 translates into 10,000 USD of
value error. A small residual cannot justify that monetary exposure. Public qualification should
compare exact and approximate results on declared finite regimes, measure query-specific
errors and refuse unsupported accuracy claims. Sampling uncertainty and uncertainty about
the causal model remain separate Causal banking proposal project (2026dm).


39.77.6     A reference choice with a concrete integration route

The current decision is to retain libDAI as a historical numerical reference and conditional
candidate for an isolated C++ inference worker. Direct adoption of a general causal platform
is rejected because the selected surface does not supply identification. A port is deferred until
a measured need justifies a new correctness and maintenance burden. Reuse through a rights-
reviewed worker can be preferable to porting when exact artifact identity, factor semantics
and error contracts are demonstrably preserved. Another current inference implementation is
an alternative comparator, but it must face the same typed queries and public oracles; this
review does not confer approval on an uninspected substitute Causal banking proposal project
(2026dm).
   The known route is to preregister finite fixtures for variable permutations, conflicting
cardinalities, unspecified states and absent query variables; conditioning versus intervention
and restoration after faults; zero mass, nonfinite entries and underflow; exact enumeration
versus junction trees; tree and loopy-message fixed points, truncation and resource refusal. The
1004                                                          Causal analysis for a universal bank


numerical owner supplies exact oracles and error budgets; the causal owner supplies mechanism
provenance and identifying assumptions; the adapter owner supplies types and refusal behavior;
the platform/rights owner supplies artifact and dependency qualification. Every submitted
request, including conversion and runtime failures, remains in the cost denominator. A purely
illustrative 12,000 USD over 400 submitted, 300 completed and 200 qualified requests produces
30, 40 and 60 USD respectively. Official provenance, complete rights, native implementation,
independent review, current support, actual costs, visual and final acceptance remain open
Causal banking proposal project (2026dm).

39.78.2     Graph identification and numeric support are different predicates

The selected causal formula tests identification by the presence of an abstract-syntax-tree root.
Its evaluation method refuses a missing root and otherwise evaluates that tree against the
observational Bayesian network. These are useful distinctions, but a present root is not a
certificate of positive observational support for every conditional term. The source also checks
that queried variables are observed and that outcome, intervention and conditioning sets do
not overlap. A caller must preserve those preconditions rather than reducing every failure to
an empty numeric answer aGrUM and pyAgrum contributors (2026).
   The selected division node evaluates its children and invokes tensor division. For dense
arrays, the inspected dispatch reaches ordinary elementwise division; generic dispatch similarly
invokes the registered operator. No support-zero refusal is introduced along those selected
numeric branches. Scalar and empty-tensor branches also divide directly. This is a bounded
source finding: it does not establish that every high-level query reaches a zero denominator,
or that every scalar type and runtime reports the same result. It defines concrete zero-over-
zero, positive-over-zero and nonfinite fixtures for native evaluation aGrUM and pyAgrum
contributors (2026); Causal banking proposal project (2026cs).
   Ordinary tensor normalization leaves a zero-sum tensor unchanged. By contrast, conditional-
probability-table normalization throws for a zero-sum conditioning row. These methods
therefore have different contracts. A returned all-zero vector is not a normalized distribution
and cannot be read as zero risk. A proposed wrapper must check finite nonnegative entries,
required support, dimensional completeness and the appropriate normalizer for its query. It
should return a typed refusal or an explicitly justified identified set; adding a small denominator
is a modeling change, not an innocuous formatting repair aGrUM and pyAgrum contributors
(2026); Causal banking proposal project (2026cs).
   For an exact authored example, let a binary covariate Z have probability one half in each
stratum. Suppose action A = 1 is observed only when Z = 0, where the mean outcome under
that action is one half. Under the specified adjustment model, the supported contribution to
the population mean is 1/2 · 1/2 = 1/4. The unobserved mean for Z = 1 can be any m ∈ [0, 1],
so the compatible intervention means form
                                         1 1    1 3
                                                           
                                   µ(1) = + m ∈ ,   .
                                         4 2    4 4
The formula’s unsupported conditional term corresponds to a zero-over-zero ratio in the
observed distribution. Replacing it by zero selects the lower endpoint; replacing it by one half
selects the midpoint. Neither operation identifies the missing mean. Publicly generated data
can test whether the worker preserves this refusal or set, but recovering the actual missing
bank response requires additional information or a justified restriction Causal banking proposal
project (2026cs).


39.78.3     Counterfactual abduction must preserve a joint posterior

The selected counterfactual builder starts from the observational Bayesian network, identifies
parentless variables excluding intervention and declared latent variables, computes their
individual posteriors given the profile, and fills their separate root tables with those marginals.
This preserves each updated root marginal. It need not preserve dependence induced between
the roots by conditioning on their common descendant. The earlier identification review
already flags this boundary; the present decision retains it as a prerequisite for a native,
query-specific comparison aGrUM authors and contributors (2026); aGrUM and pyAgrum
contributors (2026).
1006                                                            Causal analysis for a universal bank


   Consider independent fair binary roots U, V , an action A, a factual observation E = 1{U =
V }, and deterministic potential outcome W (a) = axorU xorV . After observing E = 1, the joint
posterior places one half on (0, 0) and one half on (1, 1). Both individual root marginals are still
fair binary. Under do(A = 1), preserving the joint posterior gives P (W (1) = 1 | E = 1) = 1.
Replacing it by the product of its marginal posteriors assigns probability one quarter to all four
root pairs and gives one half instead. This is an exact finite structural example, not a claim
that a particular installed aGrUM build returned the latter value Causal banking proposal
project (2026cs).
   The difference has a concrete decision interpretation. For a hypothetical 1,000-account cohort,
80 USD per successful outcome and a 30,000 USD campaign cost, the two calculations give
50,000 and 10,000 USD net value. The 40,000 USD discrepancy comes from discarded posterior
coupling, not from Monte Carlo error. A valid restricted use may prove that the factual profile
leaves relevant roots independent, or may preserve a joint abduction distribution in another
representation. A general counterfactual claim instead requires structural mechanisms and
cross-world coupling that an observational Bayesian network does not supply automatically
Causal banking proposal project (2026cs).
   Graph identity also matters during reconstruction. The constructor from an observational
network differs from the copy constructor of the full causal model. The selected counterfactual
path uses the former, so added latent descriptors and causal annotations need an explicit
preservation test. The output adapter maps variables back to the original network by name
and fills the resulting tensor. Domain labels, order and retained annotations must be checked
together; equal displayed names alone are insufficient aGrUM and pyAgrum contributors
(2026).


39.78.4     Tensor identity and language wrappers are scientific interfaces

The inspected dense and generic binary-operation templates compare shared variables through
stored variable pointers. A native object identity may therefore determine whether two axes
are shared, independently of a user’s displayed name. Higher-level construction may impose
further checks; this review does not claim that every Python object with a repeated name
silently becomes a new axis. It requires a cross-language fixture with shared objects, copied
objects, changed domains and reordered categories aGrUM and pyAgrum contributors (2026).
   An authored probability witness explains why that fixture matters. Two factors on the same
binary variable, (1/4, 3/4) and (4/5, 1/5), multiply and normalize to (4/7, 3/7). If an adapter
instead treats them as distinct variables, it produces an outer-product joint distribution whose
probability that the two states disagree is 13/20. That is a different model, even though both
outputs are normalized. Variable identity, not only numeric values, belongs in the round-trip
contract Causal banking proposal project (2026cs).
    The selected Python convenience method standardizes string queries into sets, invokes its
underlying causal routine, keeps a model reference on the returned tensor and returns None for
an unidentified formula. The inspected SWIG extension also documents special constructor and
lifetime handling. These source observations do not settle every exception, temporary-object,
serialization or cancellation path. A CLI or MCP response should distinguish an unidentified
query, unsupported numeric support, invalid domain, runtime failure and successful qualified
value. Serializing each as a generic null would erase information needed for a safe business
decision aGrUM and pyAgrum contributors (2026); Causal banking proposal project (2026cs).

39.79      OpenGM: preserving the question across optimization
           and inference
A bank allocating a servicing budget may need the least costly joint action, the probability
that a particular account responds, or the effect of changing the assignment policy. These are
different questions even when their data can be represented by the same factor graph. OpenGM
is a useful historical reference for separating model representation, algebra and algorithms. Its
generality makes the adapter’s declaration of the requested operation more important, not less.
A most probable joint configuration is not a vector of marginal probabilities, and neither is
automatically a causal intervention Andres et al. (2012); OpenGM contributors (2019); Causal
banking proposal project (2026dv).


39.79.1     A historical original with a conditional integration route

The selected repository is opengm/opengm, pinned to its 26 July 2019 revision. Its README
explicitly labels the project unmaintained, while the inspected CMake file declares version
2.3.1. The README links manuals for other versions; those labels must not be silently treated
as the selected artifact. This is a bounded historical-source comparison, not a claim that
every later fork or commercial support arrangement has been surveyed. The five-page 2012
library paper is a genuine retained original. Its design argument is inspected directly, while its
historical performance comparisons are not imported as current measurements Andres et al.
(2012); OpenGM contributors (2019).
1008                                                                Causal analysis for a universal bank


   The root license grants MIT-style permissions with notice retention. That does not determine
the complete rights of a binary containing optional solvers. CMake exposes separate switches
for, among others, CPLEX, Gurobi, libDAI, graph-cut libraries, HDF5 and Python bindings.
The inspected defaults disable the command-line build and Python wrapper. A list of
supported interfaces therefore does not establish what an installed artifact contains. The
selected source’s build requirements and declarations are evidence for a proposed artifact
inventory; no downloaded code or build script has been executed OpenGM contributors (2019).
   The proposal retains OpenGM as a reference and leaves a narrowly specified isolated worker
as a conditional integration option. Direct adoption of the whole solver catalogue is deferred
because its algorithms have different domains, rights and result contracts. Porting is deferred
until a measured need justifies maintaining model encodings, numeric behavior and solver
interfaces. The unmaintained declaration increases the importance of an identified maintenance
owner and a supported build, but is not by itself a proof that every bounded use is unsuitable
Causal banking proposal project (2026dv).


39.79.2     The algebra is part of the business query

Let V be finite variables, F factors, x a joint labeling, and ϕf (xN (f ) ) a factor on its ordered
neighborhood. OpenGM separates the operation that combines factors from the operation
that accumulates over labelings. For a probability model, an unnormalized weight is
                         Y                              X
                w(x) =          ϕf (xN (f ) ),   Z=         w(x),      p(x) = w(x)/Z,
                         f ∈F                           x

provided the factors give finite nonnegative weights and 0 < Z < ∞. For an energy model,
        P
E(x) = f ef (xN (f ) ) may instead be minimized. The library paper formalizes these as different
algebraic choices. It also explicitly warns that not every algorithm supports every choice.
Selected source implements separate addition, multiplication, minimization and maximization
operations. A type name or successful generic serialization cannot replace the algorithm-specific
compatibility check Andres et al. (2012); OpenGM contributors (2019).
  An exact authored example makes the distinction operational. Suppose two binary labels
have joint probabilities

                p(0, 0) = 0.35,       p(0, 1) = 0.25,   p(1, 0) = 0,    p(1, 1) = 0.40.

The most probable joint labeling is (1, 1), but P (X = 0) = 0.60. Under unit loss for an
incorrect prediction of X, choosing its marginal mode has expected loss 0.40, whereas taking
the X component of the joint mode has loss 0.60. For 10,000 hypothetical cases at 100 USD
per error, that substitution adds 200,000 USD expected loss. The solver could have correctly
solved its stated joint optimization problem while the business adapter answered the wrong
question Causal banking proposal project (2026dv).
   Even correct probability inference does not identify an intervention. Let an unobserved fair
binary U determine Y = U , and let the assigned action equal U with probability 4/5. Then
P (Y = 1 | A = 1) = 4/5, while both intervention means are 1/2 and the effect of changing A
is zero. Conditioning a factor graph on A = 1 preserves the selection association; it does not
remove the assignment mechanism. A causal worker needs an identified model and a declared
mechanism transformation before numerical inference is meaningful Causal banking proposal
project (2026dv).

39.79.3     A normal return does not certify exhaustive search

The selected brute-force routine enumerates configurations with variable zero changing fastest.
It updates an incumbent through the chosen ordered accumulator, invokes a visitor, and stops
if the visitor requests it. Both visitor stopping and exhaustion reach a final NORMAL return. The
separate visitor protocol distinguishes, for example, a time-limit stop from a bound-based stop,
but that distinction is not preserved in this routine’s return code. Its arg method supports
the first stored labeling and returns UNKNOWN for a requested higher rank. These are concrete
source contracts, not a report from an installed worker OpenGM contributors (2019).
   For a two-variable authored energy table, let the enumeration order (0, 0), (1, 0), (0, 1), (1, 1)
have energies 5, 4, 3, 0. Stopping after two visits produces incumbent 4; complete enumeration
produces 0. The four-unit difference is known because this tiny example has an exact oracle.
In a larger case, NORMAL alone does not supply either an exhaustion certificate or a finite
optimality gap. The proposed response must therefore include the visited/requested state
counts where meaningful, visitor stop reason, incumbent, independently valid bound and
algorithm configuration Causal banking proposal project (2026dv).
   The inherited base inference interface further returns an inverse-neutral value for its default
bound when the accumulator has an ordering, and a not-a-number value when it does not. For
floating-point minimization, the selected inverse neutral is negative infinity. The brute-force
class does not override that bound in the inspected header. Exhaustion may justify an exact
result under valid arithmetic, but merely reading its default bound does not yield a useful
finite certificate. Unsupported marginals return UNKNOWN in the base interface. A uniform
response schema must preserve those distinctions instead of manufacturing a probability or
gap OpenGM contributors (2019).


39.79.4     Hard constraints and shared factors require numerical contracts

A second boundary appears in the concrete move-making delegate. For a multiplicative model
it recomputes the destination objective. For other operators it updates the previous value by
combining a new factor value and removing the old one. With finite exact arithmetic this is a
useful incremental calculation. With infinite penalties it can have a different numeric contract
OpenGM contributors (2019).
   Consider an additive unary energy whose initial label has positive infinite penalty and whose
other label has zero penalty. The exact constrained optimum is the feasible second label.
Along the inspected incremental update, the arithmetic expression is +∞ + 0 − (+∞), which is
not-a-number under the independently tested binary64 arithmetic. This is a conditional source
witness: no native OpenGM failure was observed, and other algorithms or encodings may follow
different paths. It motivates fixtures for initially infeasible states, infinite penalties, NaNs and
finite substitutes. Replacing infinity by an arbitrary large constant is not automatically valid;
the constant must dominate a proved objective range without creating unacceptable numeric
error OpenGM contributors (2019); Causal banking proposal project (2026dv).
   Function sharing saves representation space but does not remove repeated factors. An
authored unary factor with weights (2, 1) gives probability 2/3 to its first label after normaliza-
tion. Adding the same factor twice multiplies its contribution twice and yields 4/5, a change of
2/15. That may be the intended model, or it may double-count one observation. The adapter
must distinguish shared storage identity from independent evidence provenance Andres et al.
(2012); Causal banking proposal project (2026dv).
   Variable order is another semantic input. The inspected factor constructor requires strictly
increasing variable indices using runtime checks that remain active when ordinary debug
1010                                                          Causal analysis for a universal bank


assertions are disabled. Other label checks are assertions, and one direct-evaluation label check
is commented out in the selected source. This does not prove every invalid call lacks validation;
it requires entrypoint-specific tests. Sorting variable indices must also permute factor axes.
For a binary table with weights w(0, 0) = 1, w(0, 1) = 2, w(1, 0) = 3, w(1, 1) = 4, the correct
P (X = 1) is 7/10. Transposing its semantic axes changes the reported event probability to
3/5. Both tables normalize, so a sum-to-one check cannot detect the meaning change OpenGM
contributors (2019); Causal banking proposal project (2026dv).


39.79.5     A bounded public qualification route

The proposed qualification suite starts with tiny fully enumerated models, where energy
optima, partition functions and marginal probabilities have separate exact oracles. It varies
semiring, solver, factor and variable order, shared function identity, numeric type, constraint
encoding and early visitor stops. It tests valid inputs and typed refusals separately. Even 40
binary variables have 240 = 1,099,511,627,776 joint assignments; finite representability is not a
practical exhaustive-search guarantee. Sparse or shared functions can reduce storage while
leaving the search combinatorics difficult Causal banking proposal project (2026dv).
   An isolated CLI or MCP worker should declare its exact artifact, enabled solver dependencies,
model algebra, supported factor class and requested result. Its output distinguishes model
rejection, unsupported algorithm, timeout, incomplete incumbent, numeric failure and qualified
result. A timeout must preserve request identity and partial-result status; a retry must not
duplicate a business action. These are proposed adapter contracts, not verified OpenGM
integrations Causal banking proposal project (2026dv).
   Scientific ownership covers causal meaning and loss; numerical ownership covers algebra,
domain and valid bounds; adapter ownership covers ordering, termination and request recovery;
platform ownership covers maintenance, rights and complete cost. A hypothetical 18,000 USD
over 600 submitted, 450 completed and 300 qualified requests gives 30, 40 and 60 USD per
request under the respective denominators. Actual current support, compatibility, prices and
decision value remain unknown. Public tests can resolve bounded implementation questions
before expensive bank experiments. Hidden assignment, unrestricted causal identification and
arbitrary uncertainty cannot be supplied by a general factor-graph solver. Native qualification,
independent review, visual and final acceptance remain open Causal banking proposal project
(2026dv).


39.80      SMILE and GeNIe: a commercial engine is not a causal
           evidence contract
A banking team can use an interactive graphical-model environment to discuss a lending
or servicing decision, and later wish to run the agreed model in a service. BayesFusion’s
GeNIe and SMILE address related parts of that workflow. They should be compared as a
connected offering without being counted as two independent inference engines. The proposal
makes two reuse choices: one for the compiled SMILE engine and its wrappers, and one for
the GeNIe-centered modeling environment and its route to that engine. Both are reference
decisions with conditional integration routes, not acquired entitlements or verified deployments
BayesFusion, LLC (2024j,k); Causal banking proposal project (2026eo).
39.80. SMILE and GeNIe: a commercial engine is not a causal evidence contract                1011

and acquisition records remain preserved BayesFusion, LLC (2024j,g); Causal banking proposal

One structural model has a fair action A causing Y , with success probabilities 1/5 and 4/5

39.80.3     Structure conversion and parameter estimation are distinct

The PC reference says that conversion of its output to a network produces uniform probability
distributions. The GeNIe pattern editor likewise distinguishes learning parameters from
creating only a structure, whose tables are initially uniform. For a binary outcome, a row
(1/2, 1/2) can therefore be an initialization convention rather than an estimated bank response.
A wrapper must carry a parameter-status field and the data or elicitation provenance for every
table. It must refuse a decision-value claim when a structural scaffold is presented as a fitted
model BayesFusion, LLC (2024m,e); Causal banking proposal project (2026eo).
   This distinction also informs integration with language-model agents. An agent can propose
node labels, information times, candidate edges and elicitation questions, and can help translate
a business objective into a query. The proposed system must keep those suggestions separate
from estimated tables and licensed engine execution. An attractive diagram, syntactically valid
exported network or uniform default table should not be promoted by an automated workflow
into a supported causal answer. Human review of substantive assumptions and an explicit
scientific query contract remain necessary parts of the proposed workflow Causal banking
proposal project (2026eo).


39.80.4     Temporal models require an explicit information clock

The retained SMILE dynamic-model tutorial distinguishes initial and temporal conditional
tables, lag order and slice count. It sets temporal evidence through integer outcome indices
and reads beliefs in slice-major order: the index for slice t and outcome k is tK + k, where K
is the number of outcomes. These details are scientific interfaces because the same numeric
array can express different events under another mapping BayesFusion, LLC (2024c).
  For an authored three-slice binary example, let the flattened array be

                                   (0.8, 0.2, 0.6, 0.4, 0.3, 0.7).

Slice-major decoding gives first-outcome probabilities (0.8, 0.6, 0.3). Treating the first three
entries as one outcome’s trajectory instead gives (0.8, 0.2, 0.6). At the second slice, 1,000
hypothetical accounts worth 100 USD per success differ by 40,000 USD in expected value.
Tests must therefore vary outcome order, slice count, lag, variable identity and evidence time
rather than merely checking that an array has the expected length Causal banking proposal
project (2026eo).
   The retained GeNIe DBN-learning page expressly describes parameter learning for an already
fixed structure and says that its structure-learning algorithms do not learn dynamic-model
structure. It requires time-indexed column naming and variable/state matching; existing
network evidence is ignored in the described parameter-learning process. That statement is
bounded to this inspected manual page. It supports comparison of the documented workflow,
not an exhaustive claim about every vendor product or future release. A proposed longitudinal
39.80. SMILE and GeNIe: a commercial engine is not a causal evidence contract                 1013


causal product still needs an assignment model, censoring and treatment-history rules, support,

39.80.5     Expected utility depends on what was known before the decision

The supplied-model decision-analysis pages document chance, decision, value and multi-
attribute utility nodes. The SMILE matrices have different interpretations by node type
and are indexed by specified parents: probabilities for chance nodes, expected utilities for
alternatives at decision nodes, and expected utility for value nodes. Treating every matrix
entry as a probability would corrupt both units and meaning. The adapter must preserve the
decision’s information set and the utility’s monetary or other declared scale BayesFusion, LLC
(2024n).
   An elementary authored example illustrates the information restriction. Let a fair binary
state determine which of two actions yields 100 USD, with the other yielding zero. Without
observing the state, the best expected payoff is 50 USD. If a perfect observation is genuinely
available before the action, it is 100 USD and the value of that information is 50 USD. Using
an observation recorded after the action as though it were known before it creates an apparent
improvement that was not feasible. This is why a business-to-diagram assistant must record
availability time, not just a column name or predictive relationship Causal banking proposal
project (2026eo).
   The documented utility machinery offers a useful comparator for decision framing and
calculation conditional on a supplied model. It does not, by itself, establish off-policy identifi-
cation from logged bank assignments or sampling-valid uncertainty. The proposed product’s
additional obligations are to explain how the model and query are justified, when they are
not, and what public or later bank evidence would change that judgment BayesFusion, LLC
(2024n); Causal banking proposal project (2026eo).

39.81.2     Intervention agreement does not settle an individual counterfactual

An exact authored example clarifies what the interface must preserve. Let X be randomized
offer assignment and let U be an unobserved binary customer characteristic, independent of X,
with both Bernoulli(1/2). Consider two stipulated response laws, with ⊕ denoting exclusive-or:

                           A : quadY = U,        B : quadY = X ⊕ U.

These are alternative mathematical models, not actual customers or fitted vendor networks.
No faithfulness or monotonicity assumption is imposed. Enumerating the four equally probable
(X, U ) states gives

                 PA (X = x, Y = y) = PB (X = x, Y = y) = 14       (x, y ∈ {0, 1}).

Under either intervention, the marginal response remains one half in both models, so both
average treatment effects are zero:

                        EA (Y | do(X = x)) = EB (Y | do(X = x)) = 12 .

Now consider a customer factually observed with X = 0, Y = 0. In either stipulated model,
those facts imply U = 0. Holding that inferred characteristic fixed and setting X = 1 gives

             PA (Y1 = 1 | X = 0, Y = 0) = 0,       PB (Y1 = 1 | X = 0, Y = 0) = 1.

Thus matching both observational probabilities and all these population intervention means
does not determine this individual counterfactual. The models couple potential responses
differently. Additional structural restrictions could exclude a model; the numerical interface
must record those restrictions rather than silently manufacture them. This example establishes
ambiguity in a class containing both stipulated models, not a general sharp identified set or a
defect in either vendor. (Causal banking proposal project, 2026ez)
   For a banking request, a population offer effect, a contribution calculation and an individual’s
alternative history are therefore separate result types. The inspected Bayesia contribution
material describes factual and intervention contrasts under expert confounder assumptions.
Its title alone does not make every such contrast the particular cross-world quantity in the
example. The Bayes Server abduction workflow provides a concrete reference for retaining
characteristic-variable information, but the truth of its supplied structural coupling remains
1016                                                         Causal analysis for a universal bank


a modeling obligation. A proposed CLI or MCP response should name the target, factual
evidence, intervention, retained exogenous information and the assumptions supporting their
combination. When that information is absent, an explicit unresolved counterfactual is more
defensible than an unqualified number. (Bayesia, 2026e; Bayes Server, 2026a; Causal banking
proposal project, 2026ez)

39.82      Stata: an integration decision must name the command
           and estimand
A universal bank may already use Stata for treatment effects, panel evaluation, survival analysis
and macroeconomic models. That breadth makes it an important commercial comparator,
but the product name does not define a single scientific contract. The same option label can
have different meanings across commands, and a returned estimate may target a population, a
treated subgroup, a cohort-period cell or a supplied structural model. The proposed reuse
route is therefore a command-specific licensed worker, with Stata retained now as a reference.
A blanket adoption decision would conceal the very assumptions that the causal proposal is
meant to expose StataCorp (2026a,n,ae); Causal banking proposal project (2026eq).


39.82.1    The artifact and entitlement are part of the comparison

contracts. It does not present a fresh exhaustive inventory of every Stata extension StataCorp

   The retained license-options page distinguishes single-user, concurrent network and site

users and installation scope do not by themselves establish an entitlement for an agent-facing

39.82.2     Treatment effects and heterogeneous targets

The treatment-effects introduction documents average treatment effects, effects among treated
subjects and potential-outcome means, with regression adjustment, inverse-probability weight-
ing, augmented methods and matching families. The interpretation depends on stated sampling,
conditional independence and support assumptions. A fitted propensity score or successful
command does not verify the absence of omitted confounding. The adapter must preserve the
outcome, treatment levels, target population, covariates and estimation sample as part of the
result StataCorp (2026a).
   The heterogeneous-effects survey distinguishes conditional average effects, prespecified groups
and groups learned from the data. The documented IATE label is a covariate-conditional
average, not direct observation of an individual’s two potential outcomes. Its nuisance learners,
cross-fitting, honesty and policy-evaluation options have specific contracts. Random observation
folds do not automatically preserve a bank’s repeated-customer, branch or time dependence.
A proposed worker must declare the fold and sampling regime separately from the learner
name StataCorp (2025); Causal banking proposal project (2026eq).
   The same discipline applies to panels. The inspected xthdidregress manual distinguishes
panel data from repeated cross-sections, defines treatment-assignment groups, and provides
never-treated or not-yet-treated controls. Its robust variance option is documented as equiva-
lent to clustering on the assignment-group variable. That is a command-specific statement,
not a universal translation rule for an option called robust elsewhere StataCorp (2026n).


39.82.3     Aggregation weights can change the investment decision

Let θgt denote a cohort-period effect and let wgt be its declared aggregation weight. The target
is                              X                            X
                        θ(w) =      wgt θgt ,    wgt ≥ 0,       wgt = 1.
                                 g,t                        g,t

The retained postestimation manual offers overall, dynamic, time and cohort aggregation.
Its default time-cohort weights use the subset for each cohort-period effect, whereas cohort
weights pool subsets across periods. The target and the contributing samples must therefore
travel with an aggregated number. The manual also distinguishes pointwise intervals from an
optional simultaneous construction, with estimator-specific restrictions StataCorp (2026m).
   An exact authored example has two effects, 10 and minus 5 USD per account. Weights
(4/5, 1/5) give 7 USD, while weights (1/5, 4/5) give minus 2 USD. For a hypothetical 10,000-
account target these are 70,000 and minus 20,000 USD before implementation costs. Neither
39.82. Stata: an integration decision must name the command and estimand                    1019


arithmetic result is a software defect: they answer different weighted-population questions.
Dropping weights during export would nevertheless turn a correct estimate into the wrong
investment input. This example does not claim that either weight vector reproduces a particular
native default Causal banking proposal project (2026eq).
   Dependence changes uncertainty independently of those target weights. For an authored
illustration, suppose there are ten independent branches, each with one mean-zero, unit-
variance shock repeated identically for its 100 accounts. The mean of all 1,000 account records
is the mean of ten shocks, with variance 1/10. Treating the records as independent would
give 1/1000, understating the variance by 100 and the standard error by 10. This is an
exact known-covariance example, not evidence that a ten-cluster asymptotic interval is well
calibrated. It explains why assignment level, unit identity and the proposed finite-sample
diagnostic must survive any CLI or MCP conversion Causal banking proposal project (2026eq).

39.82.4    Longitudinal breadth does not remove regime restrictions

The selected survival-treatment documentation provides targets such as potential mean survival
times and ATE/ATET under its stated models. It expressly excludes delayed entry, time-
varying covariates and multiple-record data in the inspected family. Its censoring and overlap
conditions are substantive restrictions. This creates a concrete comparison with a bank’s
repeated servicing and changing-treatment histories: such histories need a separately qualified
longitudinal method, not merely a survival output renamed as sequential causal inference
StataCorp (2026i); Causal banking proposal project (2026eq).
   The dynamic-panel manuals likewise define a particular regime. The Arellano–Bond com-
mand targets many panels and few periods with specified moment and innovation assumptions,
and exposes lag-instrument and one-/two-step variance choices. A command’s serial-correlation
diagnostic must be interpreted on the differenced errors it actually tests. If level innovations
ϵt are independent with variance one, then
                   Var(ϵt − ϵt−1 ) = 2,    Cov(ϵt − ϵt−1 , ϵt−1 − ϵt−2 ) = −1.
The resulting first-lag correlation is minus one half even under those independent level
innovations; the second-lag covariance is zero. A generic rule rejecting any detected first-
order correlation would misread this design. Conversely, non-rejection is not proof of every
instrument moment StataCorp (2026o); Causal banking proposal project (2026eq).
   Related manuals make further distinctions that the product must preserve: Granger re-
strictions concern predictive lag content; structural VARs need declared restrictions or valid
external instruments; system-GMM adds its own moment assumptions. The proposed library
cannot infer causal shock identity, exclusion or validity from the fact that a numerical estimate
converged StataCorp (2026c,e,d,q); Causal banking proposal project (2026eq).

Valid use requires appropriate imputation and completed-data inference; the retained substan-

   With two authored estimates zero and two, each having within variance one, the pooled

39.82.6     Prediction time and posterior error are different quantities

The state-space postestimation manual distinguishes one-step prediction using past information,
filtering using past and contemporaneous data, and smoothing using all sample information.
It also states that the reported prediction RMSE reflects disturbance variability but excludes
parameter estimation error. These distinctions must remain visible when a bank compares
retrospective risk reconstruction with a decision made in real time StataCorp (2026ae).
  In an authored Gaussian example, a static state S has prior N (0, 1). A later measurement
Y = S + η, with independent η ∼ N (0, 1), is observed as two. Before that observation the
conditional mean is zero; after it the posterior mean is one and variance one half. A retrospective
smoothed estimate can be appropriate for reconstruction, but it cannot be substituted into the
earlier decision’s information set. This is a finite information-clock example, not an installed
Stata result Causal banking proposal project (2026eq).
   The Bayesian manual separately documents likelihoods, priors, adaptation and diagnostics,
and cautions that permitted model combinations need not produce a proper posterior. Monte
Carlo error is distinct from posterior uncertainty, which is itself distinct from repeated-sampling
causal uncertainty. Saved frequency-weighted chain representations and parameter names must
survive export. An agent can help construct and explain a model, but cannot turn mixing
diagnostics into a proof of causal identification StataCorp (2026ac); Causal banking proposal
project (2026eq).


39.82.7     A broad comparison with narrow executable contracts

The previous source surveys cover additional relevant routes without granting them com-
mon assumptions. Mediation distinguishes one- and two-mediator commands, variable-type

39.83.2     An average causal effect has a specified target population

The documented Causal Treatment personality is available in JMP Pro and supports binary
or continuous treatment and outcome. For binary treatment, the prose distinguishes average
treatment effect from average treatment effect among the treated. It documents IPWR,
regression adjustment and augmented inverse-probability methods using specified logistic
propensity and linear or logistic response models. For continuous treatment, the reported
targets are mean potential outcomes. These are useful concrete capabilities to compare, but
their interpretation depends on positivity, consistency and conditional exchangeability JMP
(2026).
   The assumption page explicitly distinguishes assumptions about the data-generating process
from empirical checks on a sample. A propensity plot can reveal observed overlap problems;
it cannot establish that every unmeasured cause was included or that a campaign code
corresponds to the same intervention for every account. A business-to-causal assistant should
therefore record treatment versions, assignment information and alternative causal explanations
alongside any generated model specification. A fitted response surface is not a substitute for
that argument JMP (2026); Causal banking proposal project (2026dk).
   Targeting also requires preserving treatment-level coding. The version-16 uplift guide says
that, with more than two treatment levels, the first level is compared with a combination of
all remaining levels. It also documents value-order conventions and validation-column roles.
These are important historical contracts to test in the intended version, not defaults that can
be silently carried forward JMP (2025).
   An authored randomized example has success probabilities 1/5, 3/5 and 9/10 for a baseline
and two distinct offers. If the pooled alternative uses the latter offers with weights (3/4, 1/4),
its contrast with baseline is 19/40. Reversing the mixture weights gives 5/8. For 1,000
hypothetical accounts worth 100 USD per incremental success, the values are 47,500 and
62,500 USD before offer costs. Both are valid mixture contrasts under the stated experiment,
but neither is automatically the effect of a particular offer. The adapter must retain the first
level, pooled levels, their weights and the business action actually proposed Causal banking
proposal project (2026dk).


39.83.3     A selected uplift split needs its own evaluation law

The retained uplift overview describes partition splits based on treatment-by-split interactions,
using linear models for continuous responses and logistic models for categorical responses. It
documents a Monte Carlo adjustment intended to address predictor-selection bias from different
numbers of levels or candidate models. The older guide also describes validation-based split
selection. These features should be acknowledged as documented controls, without inferring a
general post-selection interval or dependent-data guarantee JMP (2025).
  A simple authored selection example explains the unresolved statistical question. Suppose
four independent candidate scores each equal minus one or plus one with equal probability
and have true mean zero. The selected maximum is minus one only when all four scores are
negative, which has probability 1/16. Its expected value is therefore
                                                 15   1  7
                                  E[max Sj ] =      −   = .
                                       j         16 16   8
Selecting the largest score creates optimism even though no candidate has a positive mean.
This calculation does not test JMP’s adjustment or claim that it produces this bias. It specifies
why the proposed comparison needs a held-out or otherwise justified evaluation law for the
39.83. JMP: treatment targets, selected subgroups and competing events                      1023


complete selection process, including predictor search, tree depth and policy choice Causal
banking proposal project (2026dk).
   In a bank, splits may be selected repeatedly across branches, customer histories or calendar
periods. Public fixtures should separate training, selection and evaluation units according
to the declared dependence regime. They should retain all attempted splits and policies,
treatment allocation, costs and failure counts. A language-model agent may explain candidate
segments, but should not convert a selected in-sample difference into a qualified intervention
recommendation without the corresponding evidence Causal banking proposal project (2026dk).


39.83.4    A continuous density model does not create empirical support

The continuous-treatment prose specifies a normal conditional treatment density with parame-
ters estimated through linear regression. It describes a stabilized-weight marginal structural
model and a generalized propensity score response model. These are particular modeling
choices, not evidence of identification for every dose or treatment distribution. A density
model assigning a positive number outside the observed range can conceal an unsupported
policy extrapolation if the wrapper records only that number JMP (2026); Causal banking
proposal project (2026dk).
   For an authored bounded outcome, suppose treatments are observed only on [0, 1]. Two
response laws agree there at µ(a) = a/2. Beyond one, let the first continue to µ1 (2) = 1, while
the second declines according to µ2 (a) = 1 − a/2 and reaches µ2 (2) = 0. Both laws fit the
same observed support but imply opposite responses at the proposed dose two. A parametric
continuation chooses a restriction; it does not reveal the missing response from the observed
sample. Public tests can check that a worker reports the support boundary and the chosen
extrapolation model. Actual off-support bank response requires new information or a justified
restriction Causal banking proposal project (2026dk).


39.83.5    Competing-event displays are not automatically removal interven-
           tions

The inspected competing-causes page describes estimating each cause’s survival distribution
by treating other events as censored, under a stated independent-causes premise. It offers
an Omit Causes display that recalculates survival estimates to illustrate a situation in which
selected causes are no longer hazardous. Those documented operations do not establish what
would happen if a bank changed a prepayment policy or prevented a particular competing
event JMP Statistical Discovery (2024).
  An authored finite example clarifies the distinction. Half of accounts have a competing
event at time one and latent default at time two; the other half default at time two before their
competing event at time three. The observed fraction defaulting before a competing event is
one half. Under a specifically defined intervention that removes the competitor while leaving
each latent default time unchanged, all accounts default by time two. Other intervention
mechanisms could also change default times. The observed competing-event record alone
does not select the unchanged-latent-time intervention. This example is not a native JMP
calculation and does not assume that its display uses this discrete model Causal banking
proposal project (2026dk).
  The proposed product therefore needs distinct labels for observed cumulative incidence,
cause-specific or net survival, and an explicitly defined counterfactual removal target. Event
coding, censoring, risk sets, time units and dependence assumptions must be preserved. A
plotting or simulation option is a useful analytical interface; it does not supply the causal
1024                                                         Causal analysis for a universal bank


intervention mechanism by itself JMP Statistical Discovery (2024); Causal banking proposal
project (2026dk).

   Reference use is retained for the documented analytical workflows. Conditional integration

39.84.2     A fitted structural model preserves its supplied assumptions

The CALIS overview documents observed and latent structural models, measurement error,
path specifications, constraints and reciprocal relations. It distinguishes normal-theory max-
imum likelihood, Satorra–Bentler adjusted inference, and an outlier-downweighting option
that the procedure calls robust. Those alternatives should not be collapsed into one flag.
The documented full-information missing-data route assumes missing at random; a successful
optimizer does not verify that assumption SAS Institute Inc. (2026).
   An authored Gaussian example shows why covariance fit does not settle an intervention
direction. For independent standard-normal disturbances, one model is
                                                          q
                                X = U,       Y = 21 X +       3/4 V.
A second model reverses the direction:
                                                          q
                               Y = U ′,      X = 21 Y +       3/4 V ′ .
Both have zero means, unit variances and covariance one half. Setting X = x in the first
model changes the mean of Y at rate one half; setting it in the second changes that mean at
rate zero. This is an exact model witness, not an executed CALIS comparison. A generated
path diagram must retain the business mechanism and identifying restrictions that distinguish
the two models, rather than accepting whichever orientation gives a convenient story Causal
banking proposal project (2026el).
   The SYSLIN documentation similarly treats instruments as specified inputs: the listed
variables enter first-stage regressions for the relevant estimators. Declaring those variables does
not prove exclusion or their relationship to omitted disturbances. The VARMAX CAUSAL
statement tests specified Granger restrictions; its label does not automatically identify a bank
intervention. The dynamic simultaneous-equations representation is another declared model
representation, not evidence that an unrestricted shock interpretation has been learned SAS
Institute (2015a, 2026a,b).

39.84.3     Event histories require the information available at each time

The PHREG overview provides a concrete strength relative to a generic single-record treatment
interface: time-dependent explanatory variables, counting-process input, recurrent events and
1026                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


left truncation are explicitly discussed. It also discusses clustered failure times and different
methods for tied times. The adapter should preserve entry and exit times, event types, subject
and cluster identity, time units and the selected method SAS Institute (2015b).
   Support for a changing covariate does not establish that the covariate was known when the
bank acted, or that conditioning on it identifies a dynamic treatment strategy. In an authored
four-account example, let the eventual event indicators be zero, zero, one and one. Copying
those future outcomes into an alleged baseline covariate gives perfect prediction by construction.
It provides no feasible baseline decision rule. A public fixture should reject this timestamp
violation even when its numerical fit is excellent. With treatment-dependent intermediate
variables, the proposed scientific contract must additionally specify the longitudinal intervention
and the assumptions supporting its estimator Causal banking proposal project (2026el).
  The selected spatial-regression documentation adds a further target distinction. Dependence
through a supplied spatial matrix, direct and indirect effects, and the banking action that

39.84.4     Missing outcomes remain a scientific sensitivity question

The MI and MIANALYZE manuals distinguish imputation, completed-data analysis and
pooling of estimates with their uncertainty. The assumptions pages state missing at random
and distinguish the data-model parameters from the missingness-model parameters. The
sensitivity discussion treats pattern-mixture and selection-model factorizations separately; the
inspected edition implements the described pattern-mixture route and explicitly says its MI
procedure does not provide the selection-model approach discussed there. These are scoped
edition-specific statements SAS Institute (2026e,f,c,g).
  For an authored bounded outcome, suppose exactly half the population is observed, its
observed mean is 1/5, and every outcome lies between zero and one. If the missing half has
mean m, the population mean is

                                µ = 12 · 51 + 12 m,   0 ≤ m ≤ 1.

The observed information permits means from 1/10 to 3/5. For a hypothetical 10,000 accounts
and 1,000 USD per unit outcome, the associated expected loss ranges from 1,000,000 to 6,000,000
USD. Imputing one value selects a restriction; it does not learn the missing population from
the observations alone. Public sensitivity tests can reproduce these endpoints, while actual
bank missingness needs further information or justified restrictions Causal banking proposal
project (2026el).
  The pooled covariance and transformation scale must also survive export. The retained

overrides and failed fits contributed to a result before narrating a business recommendation

39.84.5     Terminal jobs and bounded polling are different guarantees

39.85      Choosing an agent framework without changing the
           causal question
An agent framework can help a bank turn a loosely specified business request into a sequence of
inspectable analytical tasks. It can retain a conversation, route work, call a causal engine and
recover an interrupted calculation. The scientific question remains separate: what intervention
is proposed, for whom, at what information time, under which assumptions, and with what
uncertainty? The useful comparison is therefore between concrete execution contracts and their
ability to preserve that question. A returned sentence, a completed workflow and a qualified
causal recommendation are distinct outcomes Causal banking proposal project (2026dh).
   Consider a request to increase retention among accounts at risk of leaving. An assistant can
elicit whether the action is a fee waiver, a contact policy or a credit-limit change; identify the
decision date; retrieve a data dictionary; propose competing graphs; and submit an explicit
intervention query. Every step can be useful before a production product exists. Public fixtures
can test whether the assistant preserves treatment versions, account histories, unresolved
confounding and refusal messages. A later bank experiment is justified only after these cheaper
checks demonstrate that the proposed chain addresses the relevant scientific problem Causal
banking proposal project (2026dh).
