39.85.2    LangChain and LangGraph: graph recovery is not side-effect recov-
           ery

The modern LangChain factory constructs a state graph and passes a checkpointer, store and
interrupt boundaries into compilation. This is a concrete route for retaining the business brief,
candidate graphs, assumption decisions and tool results. The factory’s configured recursion
limit is a graph-execution control; it is not a token budget, monetary budget or end-to-end
service deadline langchain project contributors (2026a).
  The retained LangGraph interrupt documentation states that resumption restarts the node
and re-executes its logic. A checkpointer is required for the documented interrupt route. These
properties support recoverable analysis, but preceding external actions need their own replay
contract. If a node creates a paid external job before the interrupt, restored graph state does
not by itself prove that the job can safely be created again langgraph contributors (2026);
Causal banking proposal project (2026dh).
   The inspected modern retry middleware makes a useful further distinction. It counts the
initial attempt plus the configured retries, propagates graph control-flow exceptions, and
treats nonmatching exceptions separately. After exhaustion, the tool middleware can return
a tool message explicitly marked as an error; the model middleware can return an assistant
message containing failure information. Both also permit an error-raising route. A wrapper
that tests only whether a message exists would erase the difference between recovered output
and reported failure langchain project contributors (2026a).
   An authored banking example specifies the resulting public test. Suppose an external service
accepts a 500 USD action, but its acknowledgement is lost. Three submissions without a shared
deduplication key can represent 1,500 USD of actions. Under an explicitly stipulated service
contract that deduplicates the same key, they represent 500 USD. The 1,000 USD difference is
not an observed framework defect; it is the consequence of different external contracts. The
proposed adapter must preserve the logical action key, attempt identity, acknowledgement
state and recovery query. Retrying an unidentified causal request also does not repair its
scientific assumptions Causal banking proposal project (2026dh).
   LangChain and LangGraph are retained as reference orchestration choices, with conditional
integration through typed causal-engine tools. Direct adoption as the scientific product is
deferred. Porting a small source mechanism is an alternative only when its dependency and
notice obligations are understood and its semantics can be maintained. A custom controller may
be simpler for a narrowly bounded workflow; the comparison should measure that alternative
on the same recovery and refusal fixtures Causal banking proposal project (2026dh).


39.85.3    AutoGen: conversational state and scientific state are different

The retained AutoGen AgentChat 0.7.5 source says that its assistant retains state across
calls and should receive new messages rather than the whole conversation again. It warns
against concurrent calls on the same agent instance. The documented tool behavior can involve
concurrent tool calls and an additional model call for reflection. Its save/load methods retain
model context; they do not establish transactional recovery of arbitrary external side effects
autogen contributors (2026).
    For the retention example, separate conversational roles can propose assumptions, challenge
them and explain results. Agreement among those roles is not independent scientific evidence
if they share the same model, data, prompt history or mistaken business premise. Their graph
proposals should enter a comparison set with provenance, not become accepted orientations
because a conversation reached consensus. Scientific state must include the graph object, query,
1030                                                          Causal analysis for a universal bank


assumptions, identification result and uncertainty object independently of the natural-language
history Causal banking proposal project (2026dh).
   The pinned README declares maintenance mode and recommends a successor. That
declaration informs a maintenance decision; the successor’s advertised properties are not
established here by repeating the README. Reference use and an existing-installation adapter
remain possible, while a new deployment decision needs an independently reviewed migration
target and matched fixtures. The proposal therefore defers unconditional adoption, retains a
conditional integration route, and records maintenance and component-specific rights as explicit
revisit conditions autogen contributors (2026); Causal banking proposal project (2026dh).


39.85.4     Semantic Kernel: function filters do not verify scientific claims

The inspected Python function-choice behavior exposes included/excluded plugins and func-
tions, and a maximum automatic-invocation setting. Its kernel checks required and unexpected
argument names, constructs an invocation-filter stack, and can return a termination context.
These are useful controls for exposing only the intended causal tools at a given stage. They do
not verify the truth of a proposed exclusion restriction or the adequacy of an adjustment set
semantic_kernel project contributors (2026).
   The selected automatic-invocation handler catches ordinary function exceptions and places
error text in a function result. A separate guard is therefore needed before a later assistant
message is accepted as a qualified answer. The proposed protocol distinguishes an invalid
request, an unavailable service, a scientific refusal, a partial numerical result and a successful
calculation with stated assumptions. Argument-schema validity is one condition among these,
not their replacement semantic_kernel project contributors (2026); Causal banking proposal
project (2026dh).
   This review covers the selected Python profile. It does not transfer its behavior to .NET,
Java or every provider connector. Conditional integration would expose a narrow tool set,
retain scientific output objects and test filters, failure results and termination using public
fixtures. Reference use is retained; broad cross-language parity and direct adoption as the

maintaining its conversion contract Causal banking proposal project (2026dh).


39.85.5     DSPy: optimizing a program requires a defensible evaluator

The inspected ReAct implementation builds a trajectory, calls selected tools and records
execution exceptions as observations. It may leave the tool loop after an invalid selection
or context-window problem and then run an extraction step. This is a useful mechanism
for explaining partial work, but the extraction step is not proof that the requested causal
calculation succeeded. The result must retain whether identification, estimation and uncertainty
checks actually completed dspy project contributors (2026a).
   The evaluation implementation supplies a particularly relevant positive contract: after
a returned evaluation run, missing per-example results receive the configured failure score,
and the aggregate denominator is the full supplied development set. That guards against
silently reporting only successful examples in that code path. If the executor raises at its error
threshold, however, no completed aggregate should be invented. The task definition, scorer,
allowed failure score and failure threshold must accompany every reported benchmark dspy
project contributors (2026a).
  In an authored example, 1,000 requests produce 800 returned answers and 600 scientifically
qualified answers. The qualified fraction among returns is 600/800 = 3/4, while the fraction

among all requests is 600/1000 = 3/5. These answer different questions. Neither fraction

39.85.6     LlamaIndex: stopping, structured output and runtime delegation

39.85.7     Haystack: preserve explicit stop reasons and hook effects

The selected Haystack agent supports state mappings, ordered hooks, tool-concurrency control
and a maximum number of agent steps. Its documented step consists of a generator call and
the requested tool work. The inspected limit path records a maximum-steps exit reason and
returns the current public state. A tool-based exit checks error information; the selected logic
does not treat an errored exit-condition tool as a successful exit. These are valuable details to
preserve when comparing returned results haystack project contributors (2026a).
   Hooks are scientifically consequential. A before-tool hook can alter the pending request; an
after-tool hook can transform returned messages; an after-run hook can alter the final state.
These facilities can reduce context size or enforce a protocol, but a summary must not silently
discard an unresolved edge, confidence set or refusal. The selected general function-based Tool
class also lacks a formal output-name schema by default, whereas specialized components can
provide one. The proposed adapter must therefore define and validate the causal result itself
haystack project contributors (2026a); Causal banking proposal project (2026dh).
   For an authored example, the uncertainty sets [−1, 1] and [−2, 2] both have midpoint zero.
A hook that keeps only the midpoint makes them indistinguishable and cannot reconstruct
either set from that scalar. Whether a bank action is acceptable can depend on the endpoints
even when the midpoint is identical. Typed results should preserve the original set, units,
assumptions and numerical diagnostics; prose can refer to that object without replacing it
Causal banking proposal project (2026dh).
   Haystack remains a reference and conditional pipeline choice. The release-candidate source

39.85.8     A common public qualification design

The comparisons suggest a shared test design rather than six incompatible demonstrations.
Start with the same business brief, data dictionary, candidate graph set, formal query and
causal-engine oracle. Change one framework or backend factor at a time where attribution
is intended; retain the full factorial design when interactions matter. Test both successful
and deliberately unsupported cases: hidden-confounding ambiguity, off-support interventions,
unknown tool outcomes, malformed schemas, interrupted state, duplicated acknowledgements
and expired deadlines. A persuasive narrative is not the scoring oracle Causal banking proposal
project (2026dh).
   Concurrency requires a testable budget invariant. If two workers each read an unreserved
balance of 100 USD and each accepts a 70 USD task, both local checks pass while the combined
commitment is 140 USD. An atomic reservation rule can prevent that particular overspend;
a language-model instruction to stay within budget cannot establish atomicity. The fixture
must specify the transaction and recovery model, then test reservations, release and repeated
requests under that model Causal banking proposal project (2026dh).
  The common adapter contract should carry immutable task and graph identities, intervention
and target, source citations, assumptions, information timestamps, scientific status, numerical
output, uncertainty, logical action keys, attempts, deadlines and complete costs. It should
preserve uncertainty and refuse unsupported conversions. A CLI and an MCP interface
can transport this same contract; transport success does not change the scientific verdict.
Integrations with other repositories should use their declared interfaces and public fixtures,
39.86. MCP across languages: preserving a causal decision through an executable interface    1033


with changes confined to the proposed library’s adapter until separate work is authorized
Causal banking proposal project (2026dh).
   Scientific ownership belongs to the target and assumptions; statistical ownership to evaluation
and dependence; adapter ownership to types, refusals and replay; platform ownership to exact
environments, rights, budgets and recovery. Under hypothetical expenditure of 24,000 USD,
1,000 submitted, 800 returned and 600 qualified requests cost 24, 30 and 40 USD respectively.
Actual provider prices, latency, native reliability and bank value remain unmeasured Causal
banking proposal project (2026dh).
  The bounded reference choices are now concrete enough to guide a public prototype com-
parison. They do not close the hosted/local backend survey, the remaining framework and
connector delegates, or the frontier literature census. No framework removes unobserved
confounding or recovers discarded information without additional assumptions. Native qualifi-
cation, independent review, visual and final acceptance remain open Causal banking proposal
project (2026dh).


39.86      MCP across languages: preserving a causal decision
           through an executable interface
A causal tool becomes useful to a bank when another application can ask the right question and
interpret its answer without silently changing its meaning. Consider a servicing analyst asking
whether a payment holiday reduces default among eligible accounts. The proposed library must
distinguish the assignment of the holiday from its receipt, define the decision date and eligible
population, identify subsequent default, and retain the assumptions supporting an intervention
contrast. A protocol can carry this information, but successful message exchange cannot
supply missing assignment information or establish that the proposed comparison identifies a
causal effect. This distinction governs the choice among the official Python and TypeScript
SDKs, Java, the separate FastMCP project, R interfaces and concrete C++ implementations.
(Causal banking proposal project, 2026dt)
   The inherited protocol comparison distinguishes the 2025-11-25 initialization handshake
from the 2026-07-28 discovery and per-request model. Those identities remain intact. The
selected new source revisions are bounded by the 7 October 2026 research cutoff. They are
evidence about those source trees, not a claim that a particular distribution has been installed
or that every client can negotiate every server. A software version, a protocol revision, a
transport and an application schema are separate coordinates. Compatibility must name all
four, together with the configuration that determines validation and failure handling.(Model
Context Protocol contributors, 2026c,a,h; Causal banking proposal project, 2026dt)


39.86.1     What the boundary must preserve

Let a scientific request be
                                  q = (P, t0 , A, Y, G, A, ψ, D),
where P is the target population, t0 the information cutoff, A the action, Y the outcome, G
the graph with endpoint marks, A the identifying assumptions, ψ the estimand and D the
immutable data identity. A result requires a scientific status, an estimate or identified set
when justified, uncertainty, diagnostics, units, and the request and artifact identities. Protocol
status and tool execution status are additional fields. A refusal can be a correctly executed
and scientifically appropriate result; a well-formed number can still be an inappropriate
answer.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026dt)
1034                                                          Causal analysis for a universal bank


   This requirement can be expressed without assuming a particular language. If E encodes a
scientific object for transport and D decodes it, an accepted profile should satisfy D(E(q)) ≡ q
on the declared domain. Here equivalence concerns scientific meaning, not byte identity:
reordered JSON keys can be harmless, whereas replacing a circle endpoint by a tail is not. A
graph with X → Y and one with X ◦→ Y collapse to the same ordered pair if the serializer
retains only node names. No decoder of that pair can uniquely recover both originals. The
proposed interface must preserve endpoint marks or refuse the unsupported graph type. (Causal
banking proposal project, 2026dt)
   An equally simple monetary example exposes the limits of type checking. Two objects can
both contain an integer estimate equal to one and a string unit, while one denotes USD and
the other thousands of USD. Both satisfy that elementary shape predicate; their normalized
values are 1 and 1,000 USD. Similarly, a nonidentified result with a missing estimate and
an identified zero effect both become zero under a missing-to-zero fallback. The proposed
scientific schema therefore uses explicit status, units and uncertainty objects, and validates
relationships between fields. These are authored counterexamples to insufficient contracts, not
observed failures in any selected SDK.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026dt)
  Even a complete shape contract cannot establish identification. Let an unobserved fair
binary variable U determine holiday assignment A = U and potential default Y (a) = U for
both actions. The observed difference between A = 1 and A = 0 is one, while

                                     E{Y (1) − Y (0)} = 0.

A typed result containing the observed difference remains noncausal for this construction.
The interface must retain the evidence and assumptions by which the engine distinguishes
association, an identified effect, an identified set and refusal.(Causal banking proposal project,
2026dt)


39.86.2     Official Python and TypeScript: version and validation are explicit
            choices

The selected Python source is an MCP 2.x development tree with dynamic package versioning.

behavior. (python project contributors, 2026)
   The selected TypeScript core and server packages declare version 2.3.1 and Node 20 or

39.86. MCP across languages: preserving a causal decision through an executable interface       1035


schemas before the tool body is invoked. Successful results with an available validator must

39.86.3     FastMCP is a separate, layered candidate

The selected former jlowin/fastmcp repository resolves to PrefectHQ/fastmcp. Its root and

39.87       Evaluating the evaluator: compositional bias and causal
            acceptance
A bank using an agent to translate business questions into causal studies also needs a way to
review the agent’s work. An evaluator may compare a proposed diagram with a narrative,
check whether a report uses the supplied evidence, or judge an explanation of uncertainty.
These are useful tasks, but the evaluator can itself ignore evidence, reward fluent unsupported
answers or react to irrelevant presentation changes. The relevant question is whether the
evaluation changes for the right reason and remains anchored to an independently specified
scientific standard.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026dl)
   Lee et al. (2026) study compositional bias in multimodal language models used as judges.
The inspected original is arXiv 2604.18164v3, dated 23 April 2026, before the research cutoff. Its
title and author order match the inherited conference-work metadata, but the final conference
PDF is not asserted to be byte-identical. The earlier v1 original is retained separately; selected
methods in the later revision, rather than an unlabelled mixture of versions, support the
discussion here. The study concerns pointwise vision-language evaluation. Its empirical results
are not measurements of banking causal identification, diagram validity, or the proposed
library’s performance. (Lee et al., 2026)
39.87. Evaluating the evaluator: compositional bias and causal acceptance                     1039


39.87.1     Two desired responses to two different changes

The paper represents a judging input as a query Q, an image I and a candidate response R,
with a score y = fθ (Q, I, R) on a scale from one to S, taking S = 10 in its experiments. A
perturbation produces (Q′ , I ′ , R′ ) and a second score yb. The distinction between perturbations
is substantive. Removing necessary evidence or mismatching a response with its evidence
should reduce an otherwise favorable score; changing a semantically irrelevant aspect should
preserve it. (Lee et al., 2026)
  For the first type, the paper defines Bias-Deviation as

                                   (y − yb)+
                                                  
                      BD = E                   y>1 ,      (a)+ = max(a, 0).
                                     y−1
The condition excludes an original score of one because there is no room for a further decrease.
For the second type, Bias-Conformity is

                                                    |y − yb|
                                                                
                               BC = E 1 −                         .
                                                max(y − 1, S − y)

The denominator normalizes by the largest available movement from the original score. These
formulas apply to different perturbation families; using a high score from one as an answer
to the other changes the target. The study groups nine bias types into integrality, congruity
and robustness. Its method therefore requires a defensible prior judgment about whether each
perturbation changes the relevant meaning. (Lee et al., 2026)
   This requirement is especially consequential for causal diagrams. Moving a node on the
page while preserving every label and endpoint mark can be irrelevant to the graph’s meaning.
Removing an arrowhead, deleting a variable that blocks a back-door path, or moving a
measurement across the decision time is not. A generic visual transformation that is harmless
in one task can obscure an arrowhead or minus sign in another. The proposed bank evaluation
must validate the transformation against the graph or numerical object before classifying it as
meaning-preserving. (Causal banking proposal project, 2026dl)


39.87.2     What the empirical design establishes

The selected paper reports 1,804 evaluation pairs derived from 29 source benchmarks, with
four core task categories and twelve domains. It synthesizes queries, filters them and uses
human review to enforce requirements including the need to consult the image and consistency
with the specified task. The appendix describes twelve annotators and their selection criteria.
This construction is more informative than a claim that random visual changes automatically
preserve or destroy meaning, but the resulting population is still the curated benchmark
population.(Lee et al., 2026)
   The study describes 26 judge models, including proprietary, open and specialized critic
families, and evaluates reasoning modes where available. The main-result caption reports three
experimental runs and supporting variation across runs and samples. The stated token budget
is 16,384, with specified reasoning settings and other parameters left at model defaults. Those
operational choices are part of the inherited result. Repeated runs help reveal variation for
these cases; they do not manufacture independent new business questions. A new comparison
should preserve task identities and report both within-case variation and variation across
distinct cases. (Lee et al., 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026dl)
   The paper reports differing strengths across the perturbation families and does not reduce
reliability to model size or a single reasoning switch. Its prompt interventions likewise produce
1040                                                             Causal analysis for a universal bank


different trade-offs across models and bias types. The appropriate proposal use is to adopt the
distinction between relevant sensitivity and irrelevant instability as a test-design principle, and
to reference the observed multimodal failure modes. Selecting a banking judge solely from its
aggregate benchmark rank would require a transfer argument and new evidence. (Lee et al.,
2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026dl)


39.87.3     Why stability is not correctness

A constant evaluator illustrates a limitation already acknowledged in the paper’s discussion
of supporting sample variance. If the evaluator always returns seven, then BC = 1 for every
nominally invariant pair. It also has BD = 0 for every semantic disruption whose original
score exceeds one. Neither statistic by itself establishes accuracy against a scientific oracle.
In an authored four-case set containing two valid and two invalid causal claims, accepting all
four gives perfect score stability but two false acceptances.(Lee et al., 2026; Causal banking
proposal project, 2026dl)
   Bias-Deviation has its own denominator that must remain visible. With two authored pairs
(y, yb) = (10, 1) and (1, 1), the reported conditional BD is one, based on only the first pair.
The second pair is not evidence of a successful response to the perturbation; it is outside
the metric’s eligibility set. A bank comparison should publish the total number of pairs, the
number eligible for BD, their task composition and the reasons for exclusion. It should not
convert a conditional metric into an all-request success probability.(Causal banking proposal
project, 2026dl)
   Normalization also means that equal raw score movements can receive different values. A
decrease from ten to eight contributes 2/9 to BD; a decrease from three to one contributes
one. Both are two-point changes. This is a consequence of the stated normalization, not an
arithmetic defect. It shows why base-score distributions and score-scale interpretation matter
when comparing judges. For causal acceptance, the product additionally needs an externally
defined distinction between a valid identified result, a justified identified set, a justified refusal
and an unsupported claim. (Causal banking proposal project, 2026dl)


39.87.4     Abstention requires both conditional quality and coverage

The paper’s abstention-aware variant permits an N/A response, excludes that response from
the numerical metric and reports its proportion separately. This is a clearly different estimand
from a score averaged over every submitted case. Its methodological implication is to preserve
both the quality of retained judgments and the coverage of the evaluator. A scientific refusal is
not automatically an evaluator failure, but removing it from every denominator would obscure
the service’s usefulness. (Lee et al., 2026)
  Let J indicate that an evaluator returns a scored judgment and C indicate that the judgment
agrees with a prespecified oracle. Then

                                    P (C ∩ J) = P (C | J)P (J).

In an authored 100-case example, 50 cases are scored and 45 of those agree with the oracle.
Conditional agreement is 90 percent, while the fraction of all requests receiving a correct
scored judgment is 45 percent. If some unscored cases represent appropriate refusal, their
contribution to utility should be specified separately rather than labelled either correct or
incorrect by an undocumented convention. (Causal banking proposal project, 2026dl)
   An economic loss makes the choice concrete. Suppose the two false acceptances in the
four-case example each expose a stipulated 250,000 USD loss, while expert review costs 1,000
39.88. Named model backends: a scientific contract above the generation interface             1041


USD per case. The false-acceptance loss is 500,000 USD and reviewing all four costs 4,000
USD. These are hypothetical consequences, not measured bank losses. They demonstrate
why a threshold tuned to an average evaluator score need not minimize decision loss. With a
separate hypothetical expenditure of 15,000 USD for the 100-case exercise, cost is 150 USD per
submission, 300 USD per scored case and 1,000/3 USD per correct scored judgment. (Causal
banking proposal project, 2026dl)


39.87.5     A bounded route into the proposed product

The proposed first prototype uses public or generated causal problems with known structural
assumptions and exact refusal oracles. It constructs paired reports and diagrams, verifies
which transformations preserve the underlying scientific object, and keeps a held-out set of
business-to-causal translations. It then evaluates sensitivity, stability, absolute correctness,
appropriate refusal, coverage and full cost together. The unit of analysis is the logical case; for
example, three attempts on each of 100 cases yield 300 attempts but only 100 distinct cases. A
repeated prompt is not a new independent validation sample.(Causal banking proposal project,
2026dl)
  For integration, an evaluator request should carry the causal question, graph artifact,
evidence identities, perturbation class, rubric version, model configuration and independent
oracle where one exists. Its response should preserve the score, explanation, abstention, failure
and cost fields through the library, CLI and MCP boundary. An LLM explanation may
help a reviewer locate a disagreement, but must not overwrite the engine’s identification or
uncertainty status. Scientific owners decide the target and acceptance loss; protocol owners
preserve the evidence and denominator. (Causal banking proposal project, 2026dl)
   The inspected study is a useful reference and a candidate source of test designs. Dataset and
code licensing, model access, exact artifacts and native reproducibility still require separate
inspection before direct adoption. Porting the two explicitly defined metrics is a bounded task,
whereas claiming that a multimodal benchmark qualifies causal reasoning requires evidence
the study does not supply. Its stated limits include vision-language, pointwise scoring and
a focus on multimodal biases rather than every social or domain-specific bias. The selected
preprint inspection therefore advances the frontier survey while retaining final-version, native,
bank, visual and independent acceptance limits. (Lee et al., 2026; Causal banking proposal
project, 2026dl)


39.88      Named model backends: a scientific contract above the
           generation interface
A bank considering an assistant for causal study design must choose both the model service
and the execution environment through which it is used. A useful comparison asks what each
environment preserves when a question becomes a diagram, a tool request and a reviewed
answer. It also asks what happens when the output is partial, a tool fails, the request is retried
or the budget is exhausted. An API-shaped response is only one intermediate artifact. The
scientific object remains the question, information clock, population, intervention, assumptions,
graph and justified inference status. (Causal banking proposal project, 2026cv)
   The selected primary profiles are the official Anthropic Python SDK 1.11.0, Google GenAI
Python SDK 2.28.0, the Ollama Python client, vLLM and llama.cpp. Each repository revision
is pinned no later than 7 October 2026. Ollama’s package version is derived from version-
control metadata; the inspected vLLM tree likewise does not establish a release wheel version.
1042                                                          Causal analysis for a universal bank


The llama.cpp build declares base version 0.6.0 with development mode enabled by default.
These distinctions prevent a commit, a package release, a model name and a deployed service
from being treated as the same identity. (anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python contributors,
2026; googleapis/python-genai contributors, 2026; ollama/ollama-python contributors, 2026;
vllm-project/vllm contributors, 2026; ggml-org/llama.cpp contributors, 2026)
  The comparison is deliberately bounded. Official OpenAI guide originals could not be
acquired through the permitted routes; repeated HTTP 403 responses remain an omission,
not evidence that the service lacks a feature. Hosted-service entitlements, immutable service
revisions, complete model catalogues, regional behavior and actual prices are not established

39.88.1     Separate syntax, object validation and scientific validity

Let x denote a generated representation and let S(x) mean that it satisfies a declared seri-
alization schema. Let G(x) mean that it denotes an admissible graph and I(x) mean that
the intervention query is justified under the declared causal assumptions. These are different
predicates. A conventional edge-list schema can admit the three edges A → B, B → C and
C → A: every endpoint is a valid named variable and every field has the expected type, but the
graph is cyclic. An independent topological check rejects it when the contract requires a DAG.
Even an acyclic graph does not establish that it represents the bank’s assignment process. The
product must therefore preserve separate schema, graph and identification decisions rather
than promoting S(x) directly to I(x). (Causal banking proposal project, 2026cv)
   The Anthropic SDK illustrates another level of this distinction. Its selected output
configuration contains a JSON-schema format field. Separately, the client’s internal
_strict_response_validation option defaults to false. The response-processing routine
invokes a type validator when that option is enabled and otherwise constructs the target
object; a reported validation error is wrapped as an API response-validation error. These are
client object-handling branches, not a causal validity oracle or proof about every service-side
generation path. A proposed adapter keeps the requested schema, returned content and
observed validation status separately. (anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python contributors, 2026)
   Google’s selected response conversion is more explicit about the requested Python repre-
sentation. A Pydantic model invokes its JSON validator; caught JSON or validation errors
leave the parsed result unset. A dictionary or SDK Schema branch instead applies JSON
parsing to the returned text, without an additional local full-schema validator in that branch.
A caller must not interpret a returned response object, or merely successful JSON parsing,
as proof that all requested schema constraints hold. These are inspected client branches, not
measurements of service violation rates. (googleapis/python-genai contributors, 2026)
   For vLLM, the pinned documentation distinguishes schema-derived decoding from structural-
tag parsing. In the latter route, constraining the tool-call envelope and enforcing an individual
tool’s argument schema are separate. The documented per-tool strict flag, server strictness
setting and global enforcement switch affect that route. General named-function prose is
qualified by this later parser-specific explanation; it is unsafe to repeat the broad statement
as an unconditional guarantee across all parsers. The structured-output configuration also
chooses a backend automatically by default and describes that choice as release-dependent. A
prototype must pin the parser and decoding backend as well as the model and server revision.
(vllm-project/vllm contributors, 2026)
39.88. Named model backends: a scientific contract above the generation interface          1043


   llama.cpp exposes grammar and JSON-schema generation controls and directs readers to
supported-feature tests. That is a useful constrained-generation boundary, but neither the
parameter name nor a syntactically valid output establishes full JSON Schema coverage, a
valid causal graph or identification. The proposed common validator runs after every backend
and retains the backend’s original output for diagnosis. Unsupported constraints must be
reported, not silently weakened to make a request run. (ggml-org/llama.cpp contributors,
2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026cv)


39.88.2     Tool requests, tool execution and scientific responsibility

The Google SDK documents automatic function calling when a Python function is supplied
directly. The inspected loop counts remote model calls, retrieves function-call parts and
invokes the registered functions through a helper. At the last permitted remote call it returns
the model’s function calls without executing them, because no remote call remains for their
results. The helper can visit several function-call parts in a single response and can convert a
local exception into an error-bearing function response. Consequently a remote-call limit is
not a limit on the number, duration or economic consequences of local function invocations.
(googleapis/python-genai contributors, 2026)
   In an authored example, two model responses are permitted. The first contains three
executable tool calls; the final response contains two more that remain unexecuted under the
stipulated last-call rule. There are two remote calls, three executed local functions and two
unresolved requests. With hypothetical model costs of 0.20 and 0.30 USD and tool costs of 2,
5 and 3 USD, expenditure is 10.50 USD. Reporting only two calls loses both execution and
cost meaning. For a credit-policy assistant, the adapter should reserve separate budgets for
model attempts, scientific tools, human review, wall time and monetary expenditure before
allowing an action. (Causal banking proposal project, 2026cv)
   The selected Ollama chat path accepts tools, converts their declarations, sends the request
and returns a typed response or a stream of typed chunks. That path does not itself implement
the Google-style local function-execution loop. Applications using the two interfaces therefore
need different orchestration policies even when both accept a tools argument. For the proposed
library, generation may suggest a causal operation, while the controller checks its scientific
context and permission before execution. A model request for estimation cannot create
identification that the causal engine has refused.(ollama/ollama-python contributors, 2026;
Causal banking proposal project, 2026cv)


39.88.3     Completion, refusal and observation deadlines

The Anthropic message type distinguishes a natural end, token limit, specified stop sequence,
tool request, paused turn, refusal and context-window limit. Its documentation says that a
streaming message begins without a final stop reason. Google’s finish-reason type likewise
separates ordinary stopping, token limits, safety filtering, malformed function calls and other
outcomes. Ollama’s response model carries done, done_reason, token counts and durations
expressed in nanoseconds. A common adapter should retain native states before mapping
them to its own completion, partial, refused or failed categories. Provider-policy refusal is
distinct from an engine’s scientific refusal to identify an effect. (anthropics/anthropic-sdk-
python contributors, 2026; googleapis/python-genai contributors, 2026; ollama/ollama-python
contributors, 2026)
  Time budgets need equally explicit units and scope. The Anthropic constants set a ten-
minute default HTTP timeout profile and two retries; the inspected retry routine considers
1044                                                          Causal analysis for a universal bank


selected HTTP errors and server retry hints. Google’s HTTP options describe timeout in
milliseconds and maximum attempts including the initial request. Ollama’s client explicitly
defaults timeout to none. These observations do not establish a whole-business-workflow
deadline. Retries, model generation, local tools, queueing and result review require a separate
end-to-end clock and a declared policy for unresolved remote work. (anthropics/anthropic-sdk-
python contributors, 2026; googleapis/python-genai contributors, 2026; ollama/ollama-python
contributors, 2026)
  The distinction has exact consequences even without calling a provider. Two retries permit
three request attempts; three stipulated four-second attempts and two twelve-second retry
waits total 36 seconds. Calling this a four-second operation because each observed request
took four seconds would omit most elapsed time. This example is accounting under a specified
sequence, not a measured latency or a universal upper bound. (Causal banking proposal
project, 2026cv)
   The selected llama.cpp source makes the prediction-time qualification concrete. The in-
spected stopping branch tests elapsed generation time inside the branch that sends a newline.
Its documented limit concerns prediction, not queueing and prompt processing. With hy-
pothetical queueing of five seconds, prefill of three seconds and the next relevant newline
at eight seconds of generation, a two-second generation setting can be observed at sixteen
seconds end to end, assuming no earlier stop. This is a conditional control-flow witness, not a
benchmark. The inspected Cancel task releases a matching slot; that operation alone does not
reverse a previously executed external tool or establish every transport-disconnection behavior.
(ggml-org/llama.cpp contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026cv)


39.88.4     Compatible endpoints and local deployment are separate choices

vLLM documents several OpenAI-compatible routes while identifying parameter exceptions
and model-dependent tool behavior. Its server can apply sampling defaults from a model
repository’s generation configuration unless configured otherwise. llama.cpp exposes compatible
routes and warns that prompt-cache reuse can yield nonidentical logits across batch sizes on
some backends. Thus matching an endpoint and seed does not establish identical generation
semantics or bitwise reproducibility. A reproducibility record binds model weights, tokenizer,
chat template, quantization, decoding backend, sampling configuration, cache and hardware
conditions. (vllm-project/vllm contributors, 2026; ggml-org/llama.cpp contributors, 2026)
   The direct source notices differ from the rights of those artifacts. Anthropic’s Python SDK,
the Ollama client and llama.cpp carry MIT notices; Google GenAI and vLLM declare Apache
2.0. These observations concern selected source distributions. They do not provide hosted-
service access, model-weight rights, training-data permissions, a redistributable dependency
environment or a bank support agreement. The proposed first comparison references these
implementations, conditionally integrates an original client or local worker after qualification,
and rejects an unmotivated wholesale port. Rewriting a client would preserve the missing service
and scientific evidence while adding a second maintenance burden. (anthropics/anthropic-sdk-
python contributors, 2026; googleapis/python-genai contributors, 2026; ollama/ollama-python
contributors, 2026; vllm-project/vllm contributors, 2026; ggml-org/llama.cpp contributors,
2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026cv)


39.88.5     A public comparison that can justify a prototype

The first experiment should use public or generated business-to-causal questions with explicit
target, graph and refusal oracles. The same logical cases, evidence and rubrics should be paired
39.89. Interference software must preserve the population and the policy                     1045


across backends; repeated attempts measure within-case variation rather than creating new
independent cases. Record all submissions, completed responses, parseable objects, scientifically
acceptable answers, appropriate refusals and unresolved failures. (Causal banking proposal
project, 2026cv)
   For illustration, backend A correctly answers 45 of 50 completed cases from 100 submissions,
while B correctly answers 72 of 90 completed cases from the same number submitted. Condi-
tional agreement favors A, 90 versus 80 percent; correct answers per submitted case favor B,
72 versus 45 percent. At hypothetical total costs of 150 and 180 USD, cost per correct answer
is 10/3 versus 5/2 USD. These invented data show why the evaluation needs both conditional
quality and coverage; they rank no real provider. (Causal banking proposal project, 2026cv)
   The scientific owner specifies the cases, loss and acceptance standard; the adapter owner
preserves state, units and artifacts; the platform owner qualifies resource and rights conditions;

39.89      Interference software must preserve the population and
           the policy
A bank considering outreach to connected borrowers must decide whose outcome it wants to
improve and which assignments it can change. A household contact, a branch allocation and a
directed financial relationship define different interventions. MossSpider 0.0.3 and inferference
1.0.3 provide useful, but different, implementation references. The former exposes a network-
based targeted procedure; the latter constructs grouped allocation inverse-probability weights.
Their selected commits are respectively 62e6bd20364c7ef01b6964fd79f21be84e5ac579 and
b0c785e3f60541b993ff4e7324672b761a5f9723. The comparison below is an inspection of
authentic source, not a native benchmark or an assertion that their unrestricted statistical
ambitions have been qualified. (Paul Zivich, 2026; Bradley Saul, 2026)


39.89.1     A network population is not automatically a population of groups

Let Ai be a binary contact decision and let Gij = 1 mean that borrower j’s treatment
                                                                      P
contributes to the exposure summary for borrower i. Define Si (A) = j Gij Aj . A proposed
network policy specifies a law for the whole assignment vector and a population E of eligible
outcomes. A candidate target is
                                           1 X
                               ψE (π) =           Eπ [Yi (Ai , Si (A))].
                                          |E| i∈E

This notation states a target; it does not identify it. Consistency, the adequacy of the exposure
mapping, measured confounding, support and a justified sampling or network law remain
substantive requirements. An API accepting an adjacency matrix supplies none of them.
   The selected MossSpider constructor requires integer node identifiers, refuses self-loops
and nonbinary treatment, saves an original-identifier mapping and constructs an unweighted
adjacency matrix. Its exposure helper multiplies rows of that matrix by the ordered treatment
vector. For the directed chain 0 → 1 → 2 and treatment vector (1, 0, 0), row-neighbor exposure
is (0, 0, 0); using incoming neighbors gives (0, 1, 0). Both are calculable, but they answer
1046                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


different banking questions. An adapter must declare the meaning of an arrow, preserve node
ordering and test an asymmetric graph. Automatically symmetrizing a relationship network
changes the intervention. (Paul Zivich, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026dj)
  For grouped partial interference, let group g contain ng people and let µg (α) be its average
outcome under allocation α. Two reasonable targets are
                                  M                            P
                               1 X                              g ng µg (α)
                      ψgroup =       µg (α),       ψperson =       P          .
                               M g=1                               g ng

The inspected inferference point-estimate path first constructs group means and then averages
their weighted contributions with denominator M . Consider two groups of sizes two and eight
with stipulated outcome means USD 100 and USD 0. Equal-group averaging gives USD 50,
whereas equal-person averaging gives USD 20. Neither is a software error. Substituting
one for the other would be a product error if a bank’s objective were total borrower benefit.
The treatment- specific group contribution also divides by total group size, rather than the
number treated; its later allocation normalization must remain part of the same estimand. An
integration cannot compare the two packages simply because both return a field called an
effect. (Bradley Saul, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026dj)


39.89.2     Eligibility restrictions change the intervention itself

MossSpider’s degree restriction selects the outcome population and also affects policy simulation.
The inspected generator keeps excluded nodes at their observed treatment while resampling
eligible nodes. This is a mixed policy, not an all-network stochastic intervention. In a star
network, suppose the hub is excluded by a degree threshold, its observed treatment is one,
and each eligible leaf has stipulated outcome 10Ahub . Keeping that hub fixed gives ten per
leaf. Resampling the hub with probability 1/4 gives 5/2. The distinction persists even if only
the leaves’ outcomes are averaged. Eligibility, the treatment of excluded neighbors and the
resulting target population must therefore travel together in the request and response. (Paul
Zivich, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026dj)
   Boundary behavior also requires an explicit contract. The selected fit documentation
describes a one-sample shortcut for deterministic policies, but the selected body rejects uniform
all-zero and all-one plans. It rejects an integer argument even when its mathematical value
could be a probability. A wrapper should expose these selected-version restrictions, rather
than promise the documented shortcut or silently perturb zero into a small positive number.
The source includes tests for several input and model refusals; this inspection does not execute
those tests or claim that every boundary is covered. (Paul Zivich, 2026)


39.89.3     Allocation mass must appear exactly once

For a group assignment a, denote its observed probability by pθ (a) and its proposed policy
probability by pα (a). The desired importance ratio is wθ (a; α) = pα (a)/pθ (a) when both
probabilities refer to the same assignment and conditioning information. The inspected default
inferference integrand already divides the observed Bernoulli factors by the policy factors.
Consequently its integrated value represents a probability ratio under that default construction.
The reciprocal branch and the branch that multiplies by policy mass are not interchangeable.
(Bradley Saul, 2026)
  An exact no-random-effect witness makes the normalization visible. For two treated members
with common observed probability q = 1/2 and proposed probability α = 1/4, observed mass
39.89. Interference software must preserve the population and the policy                       1047


is 1/4 and policy mass is 1/16. The ratio integral is four, so its reciprocal is 1/4. Multiplying
by policy mass again gives 1/64. If q is parameterized by a common logit coefficient β, then

                                        ∂w
                                           = −2(1 − q)w,
                                        ∂β

which equals −1/4 in the first construction and −1/64 in the duplicated-mass construction.
This is an authored algebraic example of two different normalizations, not an observation of
an executed package failure. (Causal banking proposal project, 2026dj)
   The implementation review must follow the entire argument chain. The selected derivative-
array helper passes a false allocation-integration flag to its derivative helper. That helper
consumes the formal argument but does not place it in the constructed gradient arguments; the
downstream weight function then uses its default. Reading only the first call would therefore
misdescribe the executed semantics. In a future native qualification, both flag values, the
default and a custom integrand must be checked against a known integral and an independently
calculated derivative. The selected repository includes numerical weight and derivative tests,
but their existence alone does not settle every flag/default combination. A product should
record the resolved settings and refuse a score/weight mismatch. (Bradley Saul, 2026)


39.89.4     Numerical output does not settle uncertainty or missingness

The grouped weight calculation catches an integration error and returns a missing value. Later
group aggregation uses a sum with missing values removed while retaining the original group
count. If three stipulated group contributions are 10, missing and 30, this expression yields
40/3. The complete-case mean is 20, and a hypothetical complete contribution of 60 for the
missing group would give 100/3. None is a justified replacement for the missing scientific
contribution without further assumptions. The wrapper must report submitted and usable
groups, retain the failure and qualify or refuse the target; it must not reinterpret a finite result
as complete data. (Bradley Saul, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026dj)
   The inspected grouped robust calculation also solves a score crossproduct matrix, and the
returned intervals use normal quantiles. A matrix inverse requires numerical diagnostics; a
label such as robust requires a justified group-sampling law. In the network implementation,
one variance uses squared weighted residuals and another uses their adjacency quadratic
form with the diagonal filled. A symmetric path with residual vector (1, −2, 1) gives residual-
square expression 2/3 and adjacency expression −2/9. This shows that the bare finite-sample
quadratic need not be positive semidefinite. It does not show that these residuals arose from
the fitted procedure or refute any stated population theorem. Negative or undefined variance
is nevertheless a necessary refusal/diagnostic fixture, alongside simulation under a separately
justified network law. Clipping it to zero would conceal the issue. (Paul Zivich, 2026; Bradley
Saul, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026dj)


39.89.5     Separate reuse decisions and a bounded public prototype

The proposal retains both packages as references. An original-language worker is a conditional
prototype route: it avoids an immediate scientific rewrite, but still needs exact identity, default,
missingness, policy and uncertainty conformance. An exact finite-policy oracle supplies a
useful baseline. A whole-library port is not justified by the present evidence. It would add
maintenance and scientific obligations before demonstrating an advantage. The two reference
choices do not approve either as a general contagion or dynamic banking network engine.
(Causal banking proposal project, 2026dj)
1048                                                          Causal analysis for a universal bank


   MossSpider’s inspected MIT notice requires notice preservation and disclaims warranty; its
selected setup lists several dependencies without fixed versions. inferference’s DESCRIPTION
declares GPL version two or later and identifies its R dependencies and maintainer. These
are source facts, not a complete distribution-rights determination. A platform owner must
review the actual installed distribution and transitive dependencies before shipping. Selected
commit and publication dates establish historical identity, not future support. (Paul Zivich,
2026; Bradley Saul, 2026)
   The first public prototype should prespecify asymmetric direction, unequal group
size, excluded-hub, deterministic-boundary, known-integral, derivative, missing-group and
singular/negative-variance fixtures. Scientific owners must define the target and sampling
law; adapter owners preserve identities and failure states; evaluation owners separate native
conformance from uncertainty coverage. Every attempt contributes to cost. For a stipulated
USD 2,400 total, 100 submitted requests and 60 usable outputs imply USD 24 per submission
and USD 40 per usable output. These figures illustrate denominators, not vendor prices or
bank returns. A later expensive bank experiment needs a qualified public prototype and a
credible economic case; neither follows merely from the availability of these two interfaces.
(Causal banking proposal project, 2026dj)


39.90      Clinical graph refinement as a test of business-to-causal
           translation
A bank translating a servicing problem into a causal diagram must distinguish an informed
graph proposal from an identified intervention. The clinical study of Mathur and collaborators
is useful because it combines approximate language-model knowledge, expert constraints and
a small observational dataset in a concrete workflow. Its value for this proposal lies in the
questions it exposes: what is the time of each observation, which edges are forbidden by
substantive knowledge, which graph differences matter for the decision, and what constitutes
independent evidence that refinement helped? The inspected source is the five-page author
original in a dated repository, not an asserted byte-equivalent copy of the six-page publisher
layout. The empirical results below are the authors’ reports; the banking examples and
acceptance requirements are project constructions. (Mathur et al., 2025; Causal banking
proposal project, 2026dd)


39.90.1     What the hybrid procedure contributes

The study uses 71 patients from one center and eight Boolean variables. Seven risk indicators
summarize the first 24 hours of extracorporeal membrane oxygenation, while neurological injury
is determined using tests at the end of the run. Experts select the variables and forbidden
directions; four named language-model families supply approximate initial graph knowledge.
The workflow first deletes edges and then permits full refinement through local score search.
It evaluates proposed graphs against an expert graph using spurious directed edges, structural
Hamming distance (SHD) and structural intervention distance (SID). These are comparisons
with the selected reference graph. They do not turn the reference into observed intervention
truth. The paper itself notes the small single-center sample, possible lack of causal sufficiency
and the need to extend the method across time.(Mathur et al., 2025)
  For a bank, the corresponding task is to translate a question such as whether an early
hardship offer reduces later delinquency into a variable dictionary, an intervention, a population
and a measurement clock. A proposed node must say whether it is a pre-offer condition,
the offer, uptake, a later response or a selection event. The expert’s prohibition against a
39.90. Clinical graph refinement as a test of business-to-causal translation                  1049


later event causing an earlier measurement is useful information. It cannot, by itself, resolve
unmeasured common causes, selection into the dataset or the direction between two events
collapsed into the same interval. We therefore retain the hybrid procedure as a reference for
elicitation and constrained hypothesis generation, with a separate identification decision for
each proposed banking query. (Causal banking proposal project, 2026dd)
   Let the admissible diagram set be G(K), where K records timed expert re-
strictions and their provenance.          A proposed local refinement can be written as
Gb = LocalSearch
                 G∈G(K)  S(D,  G; G 0 ), with data D, initial graph G0 and score S. This notation
describes a search output, not a proof that G    b identifies the effect of an offer. A public test
must hold out both cases and the expert material used for evaluation from the elicitation
step. Otherwise agreement can reflect reused constraints. If several admissible graphs imply
different answers, the interface should retain the ambiguity or refuse the requested point
estimate. The scientific oracle must judge that behavior separately from whether the agent
returns a syntactically valid graph.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026dd)


39.90.2     Refinement does not uniformly improve the reported comparisons

Table 1 of the author original reports the following union-graph means. Lower values represent
fewer disagreements under the stated reference comparison. (Mathur et al., 2025)

                           Stage              Spurious edges SHD SID
                           Initial union                     9      9     5
                           Deletion only                     3    5.4   5.1
                           Full refinement                 4.8    6.6   6.2

Thus full refinement raises the three reported means relative to deletion only by 1.8, 1.2 and
1.1, respectively. Deletion reduces the union’s edge and SHD comparisons but does not reduce
its SID mean from the initial value. For LLaMA in Table 2, SHD is 5 initially, 6.1 after deletion
and 8.1 after full refinement. The authors discuss plausibility of some added edges following
expert inspection. This is a distinct observation from improved reference-graph scores. These
descriptive differences neither establish a paired significance result nor show that every refined
edge is causally wrong. They do rule out presenting the reported table as uniform metric
improvement. (Mathur et al., 2025; Causal banking proposal project, 2026dd)
   The product comparison should therefore expose initial, deletion-only and full outputs with
the same cases, constraints and scorer. The banking choice among them should depend on a
preregistered intervention query and asymmetric costs of an unsupported edge, an omitted
edge and an appropriate refusal. A method that improves one structural distance can still
change a decision-relevant adjustment set adversely. A better in-sample score is evidence
about the search criterion; causal utility requires the separately defined oracle. These are
requirements for the proposed public prototype, not reported clinical or bank experimental
findings.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026dd)


39.90.3     A measurement clock that the diagram cannot recover

Consider two events A and B in the first day of a servicing case. Define A∗ =
1{A occurs within 24 hours} and define B ∗ similarly. One constructed history has A at hour
2 and B at hour 20; a second reverses those times. Both map to (A∗ , B ∗ ) = (1, 1). The map
from histories to summaries is many-to-one, so these indicators alone cannot recover the
within-window ordering. This example establishes an information loss, not an impossibility
1050                                                          Causal analysis for a universal bank


theorem for every causal effect that might be identified with further assumptions or additional
information. (Causal banking proposal project, 2026dd)
   In a bank, an indicator for both a missed payment and a hardship contact during one month
could conceal whether the contact preceded the missed payment. The translator should ask
for event time, observation time, action eligibility and the decision deadline before proposing a
causal ordering. If only summaries exist, it should record which directions depend on external
knowledge and carry that uncertainty into the query. A later outcome cannot be promoted to
a pre-action adjustment variable merely because all columns occupy one table. The clinical
paper’s early-window construction motivates this design question; it does not validate a specific
bank’s event chronology. (Mathur et al., 2025; Causal banking proposal project, 2026dd)


39.90.4     Source semantics and complete experimental denominators

The pinned implementation provides concrete inspection targets. The selected commit contains
deletion-only and full search routes, acyclicity and forbidden edge checks, and a structured
score that compares a tabular score with fitted tree alternatives using the supplied data. The
inspected tree-fitting path does not supply a held-out validation claim. The metric routine
computes directed spurious edges by set difference and calls SHD and SID against the expert
graph; selected score variants and graph conversions must remain part of a reproducible profile.
Root GPLv3 text and declared requirements were inspected, but this does not clear the rights
or compatibility of an entire installed distribution. No acquired code was executed. (Saurabh
Mathur and collaborators, 2025)
    The metrics routine initializes ten slots to zero, fills slots from filenames and later takes
their mean and population standard deviation. The inspected path contains no seen-file
completeness test. A conditional arithmetic example shows why a trial harness needs one: if six
files each have score 8 while four slots retain zero, averaging ten slots gives 48/10 = 4.8, while
averaging the six observed scores gives 48/6 = 8. Neither rule should be silently substituted
for a complete trial. The example does not assert that any actual result file was missing:
the archived result contents were not inspected. A prototype must distinguish absent, failed,
refused and successfully scored cases, report all their counts, and prevent a default zero from
being interpreted as perfect agreement.(Saurabh Mathur and collaborators, 2025; Causal
banking proposal project, 2026dd)
   The filename parser also takes one character from the sample identifier. Constructed names
containing sample IDs 1 and 10 collide under that rule. The source explicitly limits its
supported configuration to ten bootstrap samples; the collision example is a warning against
extending that profile without changing and testing identity handling, not an observed failure
within the stated configuration. A reusable worker should use explicit case and replicate IDs,
reject duplicates, validate the expected inventory and test edge orientation, variable ordering
and empty outputs. Native conversion of FCI endpoint representations and the installed
metric dependencies remain separate test obligations.(Saurabh Mathur and collaborators, 2025;
Causal banking proposal project, 2026dd)


39.90.5     Public qualification and a bounded reuse decision

The next defensible experiment uses public or generated cases with known structural mech-
anisms, timed observations and held-out intervention answers. The case inventory should
vary measured and hidden common causes, selection, measurement aggregation and supported
graph classes. Freeze the model and prompt identities, initial constraints, search settings,
metric definitions and train/test split before comparing expert-only, data-only, LLM-only,
39.91. Java regression components and the missing panel contract                             1051


deletion-only and full-refinement routes. Report graph agreement, identified query correctness,
calibrated uncertainty where justified, refusal behavior and complete execution costs separately.
A public test can assess these proposed behaviors without access to the omitted patient dataset.
It cannot reproduce the clinical findings or establish performance on authentic bank assignment
mechanisms.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026dd)
   For budgeting, an explicitly illustrative total of USD 1,800 across 100 submitted requests is
USD 18 per submission. If only 60 produce scientifically usable results, the same total is USD
30 per usable result. The numerator must include expert work, unsuccessful attempts, model
calls, infrastructure, licensing and adjudication attributable to that experiment. These are
exact cost-denominator witnesses, not observed prices or an investment return. Value requires
a separately specified decision loss and matched comparator. (Causal banking proposal project,
2026dd)
   Our present decision is to use the inspected work as a methodological reference for constrained
graph elicitation and as a source of explicit prototype tests. Direct adoption or a whole-library
port awaits a supported public profile, dependency and rights review, conversion tests and
independent scientific evaluation. The final publisher layout, supplementary prompts and
model versions, and archived result contents remain uninspected. The author original, pinned
source and exact project examples support the limited comparison above; they do not establish
an implemented or accepted banking capability.(Mathur et al., 2025; Saurabh Mathur and
collaborators, 2025; Causal banking proposal project, 2026dd)


39.91      Java regression components and the missing panel con-
           tract
A bank standardizing its services on Java still needs to decide which causal panel problem each
numerical component solves. A branch identifier, a time column and an ordinary regression
interface do not specify a staggered-policy estimand. We compare two dated Java regression
implementations, Haifeng Li’s Statistical Machine Intelligence and Learning Engine (Smile)
and Apache Commons Math, with the distinct econometrics-oriented iMetrica candidate.
Smile here is not BayesFusion’s SMILE Bayesian-network engine. The selected source commits
precede the research cutoff; they are source profiles, not claims that a current binary release
or a bank deployment has been tested. (Haifeng Li and Smile contributors, 2026; Apache
Software Foundation, 2026; iMetrica contributors, 2026)


39.91.1     Useful numerical machinery, different scientific obligations

The selected Smile source declares version 6.3.0. Its ordinary least-squares path expands a
formula into a design matrix and rejects a system with no more rows than columns. It selects
QR or singular-value decomposition (SVD), and the QR path catches a runtime exception
before attempting SVD. If standard errors or recursive updating are requested, the subsequent
path still constructs an inverse through a Cholesky route. Thus an SVD coefficient fallback
should not be advertised as proof that every rank-deficient uncertainty calculation will succeed.
This is a source-path qualification question, not an observed execution failure. The reported
coefficient standard error is the residual scale times the square root of a diagonal inverse-Gram
entry. The linear-model constructor calculates the residual scale using residual sum of squares
divided by n − p. The inspected path does not consume cluster identifiers or calculate a cluster
sandwich.(Haifeng Li and Smile contributors, 2026)
  The Apache profile is a 4.0-SNAPSHOT source tree, not a stable 4.0 release claim. Its
1052                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


legacy-module descriptor explicitly describes code that is unsupported or not yet modularized.
The inspected OLS implementation solves by QR, with an intercept included by default. Its
public parameter-variance method returns the inverse Gram matrix; the standard-error method
separately multiplies its diagonal by the estimated residual variance before taking square roots.
This distinction matters to an adapter that expects a fully scaled covariance matrix. Selected
upstream tests cover numerical examples and residual or standard-error comparisons, but their
presence is not a locally observed test pass. (Apache Software Foundation, 2026)
   For full-rank design matrix X, the conventional formulas can be expressed as B = (X T X)−1
and Vb = σ             b 2 = RSS/(n − p). In an authored one-parameter example, X T X = 2
           b 2 B, with σ
and σb 2 = 9 give B = 1/2 and Vb = 9/2. Treating the unscaled return as covariance loses a
factor of nine. Conversely, multiplying an already scaled matrix again is also wrong. The
integration contract must specify the returned object’s scale, residual degrees of freedom,
intercept convention and rank handling, and test them against an independent oracle. Matching
method names is insufficient. (Causal banking proposal project, 2026fw)
   The inspected iMetrica README describes interactive multivariate time-series modeling,
real-time filtering and signal extraction, with computational libraries written in Fortran or
C and a Java interface. It lists native dependencies and a Linux-oriented build. This makes
it relevant to an econometrics survey, but the inspected README and root license do not
establish a staggered-adoption or cluster-inference implementation. We defer it as a panel
delegate while retaining its stated time-series role. This is a bounded scope decision, not an
ecosystem-wide claim that Java has no panel-data software.(iMetrica contributors, 2026)


39.91.2     An exact staggered-policy counterexample

Let Dgt indicate an absorbing branch policy for group g and period t. Consider two equally
weighted groups over three periods, with treatment rows (0, 1, 1) and (0, 0, 1). Stipulate
untreated outcomes of zero, and positive treatment effects producing observed outcomes
(0, 1, 10) and (0, 0, 1). These are exact constructed outcomes, not bank observations. The
equal-weight average across the three treated cells is (1 + 10 + 1)/3 = 4. (Causal banking
proposal project, 2026fw)
   Now fit a constant treatment coefficient with group and period effects. In this balanced
example, subtracting row and column means and adding the grand mean gives the residualized

  At the last period, both groups are treated. There is no untreated comparison group in these

an analyst of ordinary observational data would need assumptions or additional controls to

and unsupported horizons, rather than insist that every package returns the oracle value 4. It
should retain cohort and event-time heterogeneity, anticipation windows, treatment reversals
and the control rule as explicit input contracts. A routine designed for absorbing treatment
