must refuse or separately model a reversed policy path; an ordinary design matrix does not
decide that rule. (Causal banking proposal project, 2026fw)


39.91.3     Sampling dependence and unidentified trends

Suppose four observed rows consist of two copies from each of two independent groups, with
each group’s shock independently equal to −1 or 1 with probability one half. The mean is
(Z1 + Z2 )/2 and has variance 1/2. Four independent row shocks instead give variance 1/4.
Enumerating the four group-shock assignments and sixteen independent-row assignments
verifies the distinction exactly. The example concerns two different known sampling laws; it is
not an empirical coverage estimate or an endorsement of a two-cluster asymptotic confidence
interval. A worker must preserve cluster identity and the justified sampling law, and disclose
when too few independent units prevent its proposed uncertainty procedure. (Causal banking
proposal project, 2026fw)
   Under an explicitly justified independent-cluster asymptotic regime, a proposed uncorrected
sandwich would use B[ g XgT u       bT
                          P
                                 bg ug Xg ]B, where Xg and u
                                                           bg collect group g’s rows. This is
a different object from σ   2
                          b B. Implementing that expression would still leave finite-cluster
correction, degrees of freedom, resampling, high-dimensional effects and the scientific sampling
assumptions to justify. Neither inspected OLS path establishes those panel guarantees merely
by returning coefficient tests. (Causal banking proposal project, 2026fw; Haifeng Li and Smile
contributors, 2026; Apache Software Foundation, 2026)
   There is a separate identification limit that better covariance code cannot repair. Suppose a
treated branch’s outcome moves from 10 to 15 while a control branch moves from 10 to 12.
The observed difference in differences is 3. One compatible world has untreated treated-branch
outcome 12 and effect 3; another has untreated outcome 15 and effect 0. Both produce the same
four observed cells. A parallel-trends restriction or additional evidence is needed to distinguish
them. More accurate optimization, an agent-generated narrative or a small standard error
cannot supply the missing counterfactual information. (Causal banking proposal project,
2026fw)


39.91.4     Reuse, rights and the public prototype route

For a Java service, our proposed architecture first separates an estimand contract from
numerical execution. A narrow Java numerical delegate could serve a justified regression
subproblem, while a separately reviewed R or Python panel worker retains its own group-time,
control and uncertainty semantics. The earlier differences and csdid inspections provide
concrete comparison routes, with their own unresolved normalization, dependency and failure
concerns. Delegation must preserve row IDs, panel keys, treatment history, weights, missingness,
cohort/time support and the exact returned uncertainty type. A cross-language call is not
evidence of statistical parity. (Bernardo Dionisi and differences contributors, 2026; D2CML
and csdid contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026fw)
   The selected Smile build declares Java 25 with preview features, and its root notice distin-
guishes core-library GPLv3/commercial terms from separate server and studio terms. These
are inspected declarations, not a legal clearance or a quoted commercial price. Apache’s
selected tree declares Apache-2.0 material and third-party notices, a Java 8 compilation tar-
get and multiple component dependencies. iMetrica includes root GPLv3 text and native
library requirements. A final choice needs the exact distribution, transitive dependencies,
intended deployment, rights review, maintenance commitments and measured full costs. We
do not transfer one module’s terms to another or infer a supported runtime from a build file
1054                                                          Causal analysis for a universal bank


alone. (Haifeng Li and Smile contributors, 2026; Apache Software Foundation, 2026; iMetrica
contributors, 2026)
   The immediate proposal decision is to retain Smile and Commons Math as numerical refer-
ences, and to defer direct panel admission and whole-library porting. The public qualification
route is concrete: freeze a source and runtime profile; compare coefficients, covariance scaling,
intercept and rank-failure behavior on known linear problems; then test the declared causal
panel target on staggered, reversed, anticipated, unbalanced and dependent fixtures with
known intervention answers or required refusals. Test data conversion and every error path,
including missing groups and unsupported post-treatment horizons. Keep numerical parity,
scientific correctness and operating acceptance as separate reported outcomes. (Causal banking
proposal project, 2026fw)
   Complete costs also need distinct denominators. An illustrative USD 2,400 experiment
costs USD 24 per submitted case for 100 submissions, or USD 40 per scientifically usable case
if only 60 qualify. Neither ratio is a measured price or an ROI result. Report engineering,
expert adjudication, dependency and entitlement work, failed attempts and runtime in the
numerator. The bounded repository search and selected source paths leave further Java and
JVM panel, synthetic-control and bridge candidates to inspect. This comparison narrows
the implementation route while preserving the remaining coverage and causal-identification
obligations.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026fw)


39.92      C++ panel delegates: preserving the statistical wrapper
A bank moving a panel estimator into a C++ service must preserve more than its coefficient
solver. The R or Python wrapper may select observations, encode time, remove singleton
groups, define comparison cohorts, scale covariances and decide which quantities are unavailable.
We inspect selected fixest C++ kernels together with their already reviewed R callers, and a
dated xhdfe C++ source profile with public interfaces and numerical test definitions. Four
further candidates supply explicit survey leads. This comparison concerns retained source text
and exact project constructions; no downloaded implementation or upstream test was run.
(fixest contributors, 2026; Laurent Berge and fixest contributors, 2026; xhdfe contributors,
2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026fv)


39.92.1     The residualization boundary

The inspected fixest demeaning entry point accepts R objects, weights, fixed-effect IDs and
tables, varying-slope information, iteration limits, tolerances and thread settings. It returns
transformed variables and iteration counts, with optional means and fixed-effect coefficients.
Its headers and generated exports use Rcpp and R objects. Copying the kernel therefore
does not produce an R-independent panel product automatically. The preceding R source
review remains necessary for sample selection, weights, covariance options and treatment-time
semantics. A typed R worker is the narrower initial integration route; a native port must
explicitly replace those responsibilities.(fixest contributors, 2026; Laurent Berge and fixest
contributors, 2026)
   Weighted residualization illustrates the contract. For observations (1, 3) with weights (1, 3),
the weighted mean is 5/2. Subtracting it gives residuals (−3/2, 1/2) with weighted sum zero.
Subtracting the unweighted mean instead gives (−1, 1), whose weighted sum is 2. A port that
silently changes the projection changes the supplied estimating equations. In a bank’s branch
panel, the distinction can arise from exposure or portfolio weights; the interpretation of those
weights must be fixed before execution. An exact arithmetic witness supplies a regression test,
39.92. C++ panel delegates: preserving the statistical wrapper                              1055


not a justification for the statistical weight law.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026fv)
   The inspected Cholesky kernel tests successive diagonal remainders against a tolerance,
returns excluded-column indicators and a minimum-norm diagnostic, and can return an all-
removed status. Its R caller preserves unavailable coefficients and handles the all-removed
case. Consider treatment constant within each of two branches, (0, 0, 1, 1) across their two
observations. Removing branch effects leaves a zero treatment column. The treatment effect is
not identified by that within-branch variation. A native adapter must preserve this unavailable
target rather than report a causal effect of zero. Column ordering, tolerance and scale also
belong to numerical comparison fixtures.(fixest contributors, 2026; Laurent Berge and fixest
contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026fv)


39.92.2     Time ordering is supplied by the caller

The selected panel Newey–West kernel’s comment says to sort by unit then time, but its
implementation forms contiguous time blocks and matches unit IDs across those blocks. The
inspected R caller sorts by time then unit, reorders the score matrix consistently, rejects
duplicate unit–time pairs, and sets the zero-lag weight to one half because the kernel later
adds the transpose. The operative contract is established by the caller and body together;
a port based only on the comment could change it. This inspection does not establish an
observed failure in the original R path. (fixest contributors, 2026; Laurent Berge and fixest
contributors, 2026)
   For scalar scores (1, 3) for branch A and (2, 4) for branch B over two periods, the sum of
squares is 30 and the matched same-branch lag product is 11. A lag-one Bartlett construction
with off-zero weight 1/2 and the kernel’s final symmetrization yields 30 + 11 = 41. Passing
zero-lag weight one instead of one half would yield 60 + 11 = 71 under the same algebra. This
is an authored witness about interface normalization, not a package measurement. In fact,
the selected kernel caps its weight count at T − 1 after dropping a trailing zero. With two
periods this leaves only lag zero, so the lag-one algebra above must not be reported as that
native return. Appending a third, zero-score period retains the same sum of squares and
lag-one product while allowing the lag-one loop under the inspected cap. Both short-panel and
zero-padded cases belong in the public test inventory. (fixest contributors, 2026; Causal banking
proposal project, 2026fv) The proposed tests also distinguish event time from calendar time:
mapping two observed months to consecutive integers can erase a missing month. Whether
such compression is appropriate depends on the declared sampling and lag interpretation, not
on storage convenience. (Causal banking proposal project, 2026fv)


39.92.3     A richer standalone profile still needs a causal target

The inspected xhdfe tree declares a 2.29.3 development candidate, with CMake version
2.29.3.20261007 and C++17. Its public configuration distinguishes homoskedastic, robust and
clustered covariance; several absorption and tolerance modes; singleton removal; frequency-
weight bookkeeping; fixed-effect and cluster degrees-of-freedom adjustments; and intercept
handling. The result structure includes covariance, counts before and after selection, cluster
counts, convergence and a covariance-repair flag. These are useful observability fields for
a proposed delegate. They do not establish a cohort-time causal estimand or a universal
uncertainty guarantee. (xhdfe contributors, 2026)
  The inspected implementation follows cluster scaling, recovered-intercept covariance and
multiway covariance correction paths. It distinguishes unavailable inference for fewer than
two clusters and other unsupported degrees-of-freedom cases. A postcondition checks finite
1056                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


outputs and shapes for the quantities whose inference is available. A separate normal-equation
check can use the supplied Gram system; per-row certification is an additional path, not an
automatic consequence of every default call. Upstream test definitions include empty-slope
cluster cases, missing cluster labels and full covariance comparisons. Their inspected existence
motivates public tests here; it is not a local reproduction of their results. (xhdfe contributors,
2026)
   The earlier constructed staggered-policy example applies equally to a more capable numerical
engine. Positive stipulated effects averaged over treated cells can coexist with a negative
constant two-way-effects coefficient. Faster absorption, more precise arithmetic and cluster
covariance do not change the meaning of that regression target. The request must specify
whether it seeks that coefficient, a cohort-time effect, an event-time aggregation, a synthetic-
control contrast or a nonlinear structural parameter. Unsupported target conversions require
refusal or a separately justified estimator.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026fw,fv)


39.92.4     Checking the complete covariance object

The selected xhdfe multiway path may project a standardized full covariance matrix onto the
positive-semidefinite cone and project the slope block separately, then replace that block in the
full matrix. Its ordinary-precision helper returns false both when no correction is needed and
when its eigensolver reports failure; a wider-precision path instead throws on eigensolver failure.
The inspected output postcondition checks finiteness and dimensions rather than a full-matrix
eigenvalue condition. These specific paths justify adversarial test requirements. They do not
prove that a bad covariance occurred in an upstream experiment. (xhdfe contributors, 2026)

39.92.5     Concrete alternatives and bounded decisions

The survey now records four additional dated leads separately. The elakkis SDID repository
declares an R package with Rcpp/RcppArmadillo and a synthetic-difference-in-differences

declares fixed-effect linear and generalized linear models with clustered standard errors and
cpp4r/armadillo4r dependencies. Its README distinguishes an earlier published implementa-

technical claims from this README alone. (sdid contributors, 2019; capybara contributors,
2026)
  The gfe descriptor declares grouped fixed-effects models, balanced and unbalanced panels
and group-heterogeneous coefficients, but its License field contains an unfilled template
while its root LICENSE contains MIT text. That discrepancy is retained for resolution.
NNRPanel declares nonlinear interactive fixed-effects estimation, tuning and bias-correction
routines, with Rcpp/RcppEigen dependencies and a GPL-3 declaration; its mathematical and

are scoped candidates, not approved substitutes for the current panel profile.(gfe contributors,

   For fixest, the preferred initial route remains the original package behind a typed worker,
preserving its inspected R semantics. For xhdfe, retain the C++ interface as a candidate for a
narrowly qualified public profile, while deferring adoption and porting pending the complete
absorber, covariance, backend and binding review. Its root MIT text does not cover every
dependency by implication: the acquired Eigen notice records MPL2 and additional third-party
terms. Exact installed artifacts, compiler settings, optional CUDA, licensing and maintenance
all need separate qualification. README runtime tables are upstream claims and are not
promoted to this proposal’s measured speed or cost advantage. (Laurent Berge and fixest
contributors, 2026; xhdfe contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026fv)
   The public test program should compare weighted residualization with explicit-dummy
solutions, verify rank and unsupported treatment targets, permute rows while preserving
panel IDs, vary gaps and missing groups, exercise cluster and covariance-repair boundaries,
and test every declared failure and conversion path. It should report requested and resolved
backend and mode, all attempts and complete costs. An illustrative USD 3,600 experiment is
USD 30 per submission for 120 cases, or USD 45 per usable result for 80. These are budget
identities, not measured prices or a claim of economic benefit. Remaining source coverage and
native qualification stay explicit while independent proposal work continues. (Causal banking
proposal project, 2026fv)


39.93      Pandera: validation evidence, population changes, and
           the causal contract
A validation result is useful only when the bank knows what was actually checked. Consider the
monthly servicing table used to choose between an ordinary reminder and a payment holiday.
The table contains an episode key, decision time, information-availability times, treatment,
currency and subsequent repayment. A dataframe validator can detect declared violations
of this representation. It cannot decide whether assignment was confounded, whether the
analyst chose the right population, or whether a seemingly historical variable was available to
the decision maker. Those questions motivate a narrower and more useful role for Pandera:
a candidate implementation of explicit observation contracts, with its configuration and
transformations included in the evidence.
1058                                                                Causal analysis for a universal bank


   The inspected source is the 7 October 2026 commit of the inherited unionai-oss/pandera
repository. Its project metadata points to the pandera-dev/pandera identity, declares Python
at least 3.10 and obtains the version dynamically through setuptools-scm. The root license is
MIT; the selected pandas, Polars and CLI extras have their own dependency declarations. The
earlier PyPI observation of version 0.34.1 is retained as a separate observation, not an assertion
that a built wheel and this source tree are identical. Dependency resolution, transitive rights
and operational support remain properties of a future concrete environment. The findings
below come from primary source inspection and project-authored examples, without running
the package or its tests.(Pandera contributors, 2026)

39.93.1     A Boolean result conceals several different services

Let D denote the immutable input table, S the declared schema, e the selected dataframe
engine and c the effective configuration. A useful validation record is closer to
                         (h(D), h(S), e, c, Crun , Cskipped , W, F, h(D′ ), T )                 (39.29)
than to a single pass flag. Here h is a content digest, W records warnings, F failures, D′ the
returned table and T the transformations between input and output. A digest binds bytes;
it does not certify their scientific truth. This is a proposed product record, not a claim that
Pandera already emits every field.
   In the inspected pandas entrypoint, disabling validation returns the supplied object im-
mediately. The scope decorator returns a passing check result when configuration excludes
that check’s scope. The native pandas backend also turns a failed check configured with
raise_warning into a warning and a passing result. These are explicit modes with legitimate
uses, but absence of an exception does not distinguish them from completed mandatory checks.
A proposed causal worker must record the effective configuration and reject disabled validation,
skipped mandatory checks or warning-only mandatory failures as evidence of full contract
acceptance.(Pandera contributors, 2026)
   Lazy error collection and lazy dataframe evaluation are different concepts. The inspected
error handler aggregates errors when its lazy argument is true; otherwise it raises on collection.
For the inspected native Polars path, an unspecified validation depth defaults to schema-only on
a LazyFrame and to schema-and-data on a DataFrame. An explicit context or global depth can
override those defaults. The native Polars backend rejects declared user-defined parsers, while
the pandas backend runs its parsers. An optional Narwhals flag changes backend registration.
Consequently, a pandas review cannot be silently transferred to Polars, a distributed engine or
the Narwhals implementation. The backend class, eager/lazy input and effective depth belong
in the request and result.(Pandera contributors, 2026)

39.93.2     Sampling checks is not a census of the data

The native pandas container applies parsers before its data-check subsample. Its container
metadata checks and sampled data checks follow different paths. For head, tail or random
sampling, the inspected helper concatenates the selected objects and removes duplicate index
labels. Whole-table claims therefore require more than a successful sampled check. (Pandera
contributors, 2026)
  With N records, K violating records and a uniform sample of n distinct records without
replacement, the probability of missing all violations is
                                                       N −K 
                                                         n
                     Pr(no sampled violation) =         N
                                                              ,      n ≤ N − K.                 (39.30)
                                                         n
39.93. Pandera: validation evidence, population changes, and the causal contract           1059


For N = 100, K = 2 and n = 10, the exact probability is 89/110, approximately 80.9 percent.
This calculation assumes unique observation identities and the specified sampling law. It is
not a confidence statement for an arbitrary head sample, clustered records or the package’s
complete execution. (Causal banking proposal project, 2026dy)
   Index labels introduce a separate issue. In an abstract table with (index, amount) rows
(7, 10), (7, −1) and (9, 20), keeping the first two rows and then the first occurrence of each
index leaves only (7, 10). A negative-amount rule would no longer see the second record.
Conversely, deleting every row with failure label seven removes both records, including the
positive one. These are independently reproduced label operations, motivated by the inspected
subsampling and row-removal code; they are not observed native package failures. The causal
contract should require unique immutable row identifiers and separately validate the banking
episode key. A dataframe index is not automatically either identity. (Pandera contributors,
2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026dy)


39.93.3     Cleaning can change the question being answered

The inspected pandas path supports adding missing columns, filling defaults, coercing types
and filtering columns outside the schema. With row removal enabled, lazy error collection is
required; eligible failures are removed by their index labels, while the inspected string-valued
schema-failure branch still raises. These transformations must be explicit scientific decisions.
For example, integer conversion maps both textual account identifiers 0012 and 12 to twelve.
Filling a missing exposure field with zero asserts something different from recording that
its value is unknown. Filtering an undeclared availability-time column can remove evidence
needed to reject future information.(Pandera contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal
project, 2026dy)
   The statistical effect of row selection can be large even when every retained field has a
permitted type and range. Let treatment A and an unobserved risk bit U be independent fair
binary variables, with potential repayment Y (a) = U for both actions. The causal effect is
zero. Suppose a quality or eligibility rule retains a record only when A = U , perhaps through
a proxy whose relation to treatment has not been examined. Exactly half the population
remains, and

          E[Y | A = 1, R = 1] − E[Y | A = 0, R = 1] = 1,         R = 1{A = U }.         (39.31)

The retained observational contrast is one despite the zero causal effect. The problem is the
selection rule, not a claimed validator defect. A product must bind the selection indicator and
the intended target population, preserve excluded records with reason codes, and require a
justified missingness or selection argument before using the reduced table.(Causal banking
proposal project, 2026dy)
   Null handling also requires a declared policy. The inspected native pandas column-check path
may remove null values before invoking a custom check when ignore_na is true. Dataframe
postprocessing depends on the return shape: the inspected Series-output branch permits
all-null rows, whereas the table-output branch combines results with a cellwise null mask.
The general method description is not sufficient to infer identical behavior for every check
shape. Nullability constraints, the custom-check result and the missingness mechanism are
distinct. Empty or excluded input is not positive evidence of an observed value satisfying the
substantive condition. (Pandera contributors, 2026)
1060                                                            Causal analysis for a universal bank


39.93.4     Chronology and identification need their own evidence

For a baseline feature Xj , distinguish event time tevent
                                                      j    , availability time tavail
                                                                                j     and the action
                                             avail
time tA . The useful condition is generally tj     ≤ tA , with any permitted latency and revision
convention explicitly stated. An event on day one, an action on day two and a record first
available on day three satisfy event chronology but violate availability chronology. A generated
fixture should expose that case before any expensive bank trial. A passing check still depends
on the truth of the supplied timestamps.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026dy)
  Even a complete, correct representation cannot identify every causal effect. Let U be a fair
binary variable. The structural worlds

                        M1 : A = U, Y = A,          M2 : A = U, Y = U                       (39.32)

produce the same observational pairs (0, 0) and (1, 1) with equal probability. Their average
intervention contrasts are one and zero respectively. Every deterministic check of the same
observed table has the same answer in both worlds. Thus a schema-valid table cannot resolve
the causal ambiguity. The appropriate product response retains the competing models or
refuses the unidentified query until justified assumptions or new information are supplied.
(Causal banking proposal project, 2026dy)


39.93.5     Original worker, existing CLI, and proposed MCP service

The preferred prototype candidate is a narrow original Python worker for one frozen dataframe
profile. Its request identifies authorized input and schema artifacts, their hashes, engine
and dependency versions, mandatory checks, availability rules and allowed transformations.
Its response distinguishes execution failure, disabled or partial checking, contract rejection,
transformed output, and a separate scientific disposition. It returns the exact validated artifact
or its immutable binding; the caller must not assume that the original input is the returned
transformed table.
  The inspected CLI already loads YAML or JSON schemas, selects their declared API, loads
data and calls validation with lazy error collection. It rejects selected backend mismatches
and catches validation exceptions with exit code one. Its call does not assign the returned
validated object, and the success report follows a non-raising call. Therefore it is a useful
comparator for validation reporting, but source inspection does not establish an artifact
export contract, serialization of every custom check, or scientific acceptance. Its YAML loader
uses safe loading; the delegated schema deserializers and report-generation internals remain
separately unqualified. We have not run the CLI.(Pandera contributors, 2026)
   A proposed MCP tool should invoke that bounded worker using artifact identifiers and a
preapproved schema, not accept arbitrary agent-authored Python checks as automatically
trusted code. An LLM may draft candidate currency, key and clock rules and explain failures.
The method owner must review their meaning against positive, negative and deliberately
ambiguous public or generated fixtures. The service should retain the schema proposal, review,
actual configuration, failure evidence and all output identities. This is an integration design,
not a claim of an implemented MCP server or a proved protection boundary.
   Direct adoption is conditional on those contracts. A wholesale port into R, Java or C++ is
presently unattractive because dtype, null, index, parser and backend semantics would all need
independent replication and maintenance. An existing bank validator remains a reasonable
alternative if it satisfies the same observation contract. Small project-owned checks can provide
transparent prototype oracles, but should not pretend to replace general dataframe engines.
Reference-only reuse preserves these design lessons while implementation and qualification
39.94. Ray as a conditional execution substrate: preserving the scientific request           1061


remain open. The direct license does not remove the cost of environment maintenance or

   Qualification should compare original-worker and existing-validator paths on the same
immutable fixtures: duplicated row labels and episode keys, missing currency, future availability,
identifier coercion, warning-only failures, disabled or reduced-depth checks, transformed output,
and engine-specific parser rejection. Register expected acceptance or refusal before execution.
Record every attempt and correct refusal, not just successful process exits. In a stipulated
twelve-attempt workflow costing USD 48, eight process successes cost USD 6 each; if only
three yield scientifically accepted artifacts, the cost is USD 16 per accepted artifact. Four
correct refusals are reported separately. These are accounting examples, not measured prices

   The method owner specifies the causal target and admissible transformations; the data
owner supplies trustworthy keys and clocks; the adapter owner freezes the execution profile

39.94       Ray as a conditional execution substrate: preserving the
            scientific request
A bank adopting distributed computation must preserve the scientific request when a worker
is rescheduled, a result is reconstructed or a driver disappears. Ray is a candidate execution
substrate for repeated nuisance fits, simulation replications and score computation. It does not
define the causal estimand, sampling unit, admissible information set or covariance law. Its
usefulness therefore depends on an application contract that survives changes in task placement
and retry history. The appropriate proposal decision is to retain Ray as a source-grounded
reference and conditional prototype option until profiling and conformance evidence justify
distributed adoption.(Ray contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026ek)


39.94.1     Artifact identity and the scope of the proposed use

The inspected repository is pinned to a commit dated 7 October 2026 at 15:33:11 UTC,
before the end of that day in Asia/Shanghai. Its version file declares 3.0.0.dev0 and a commit
placeholder replaced when wheels are built. A source revision is consequently not an installed
release, and the development version must not be presented as evidence that a selected wheel
contains these exact APIs. The setup file declares Python at least 3.10 and lists several
supported minor versions, base packages and optional groups. Those declarations do not
resolve the complete build, native ABI or transitive dependency inventory. The direct license
contains Apache 2.0 terms and additional component notices. Future adoption needs the
selected distribution, its notices, dependency identities and an operational maintainer.(Ray
contributors, 2026)
  The prior mutable README remains historical discovery evidence. The current review uses
authenticated source blobs at the client cutoff. Where an acquired later-commit file has the
same Git blob as the cutoff tree, that equality is recorded; five changed documentation files were
acquired from the corrected cutoff itself. This prevents a convenient newer explanation from
being silently substituted for the selected artifact. The profile focuses on Core tasks, actors,
objects, resource declarations and runtime environments. The separate Train, Tune, Serve,
1062                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


Data and RLlib families are not admitted through Core’s name. A commercial hosted service
likewise requires its own entitlement, security, price and support evidence.(Ray contributors,
2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026ek)


39.94.2     Retries do not establish exactly-once scientific accounting

The task documentation distinguishes worker or machine failure from application exceptions. It
describes three default retries for system failures, with explicit configuration and environment
overrides; application exceptions are not retried by default. The inspected Python submission
code fills defaults, reads the retry environment value and preserves explicitly supplied options.
It serializes the function for export and can re-export it for a new driver context. A recovered
task must therefore bind its input, code, closure, random seed and environment identities, not
merely its display name.(Ray contributors, 2026)
   The object documentation describes reconstruction by rerunning the producer and recur-
sively reconstructing arguments. It requires a live owner, suitable lineage and deterministic,
idempotent tasks; objects created by the selected put interface do not have the same reconstruc-
tion route. The cutoff documentation’s broad phrase about an environment setting disabling
reconstruction must be read alongside the submission code’s explicit-option precedence. This
review makes only that narrower source-supported statement and leaves native reconstruction
behavior under each configuration to conformance testing. A successful first return does not
establish that the producer will never execute again.(Ray contributors, 2026)
   Let a scientific request require four logical contributions zA = 2, zB = 4, zC = −1 and
zD = 3 USD, so its mean is 2 USD. If a retry adds another contribution from B, averaging five
attempts gives 2.40 USD, while keeping the original denominator of four gives 3 USD. Neither
is the requested mean. An authored reducer keyed by immutable contribution identity yields 2
USD for all 120 permutations of the five events. If a duplicate identity carries a different value,
it refuses the conflicting result instead of selecting whichever arrived last. This finite witness
is not a Ray fault experiment; it specifies behavior a future adapter must demonstrate.(Causal
banking proposal project, 2026ek)
   The contribution identity should include the study, dataset snapshot, cluster or fold,
estimator configuration, policy target and code/environment digest. Attempt identity is
separate. An external payment, audit label purchase or model-service call needs its own
idempotency protocol: recording a result after a side effect does not prove the effect occurred
once. If an acknowledgement is lost, the client must represent an unresolved outcome until
reconciliation establishes it. An MCP retry and a runtime retry must not multiply the same
logical request invisibly.


39.94.3     Actor recovery, object ownership and durable state

The selected actor documentation gives no automatic restart by default. Configured restart
reruns the constructor; it does not restore application state automatically. With retries disabled,
an error can still arrive after a method executed. Enabling actor-task retries permits repeated
execution, so an accumulator, optimizer or budget ledger needs an application checkpoint and
recovery protocol. Async and threaded ordering also has distinct caveats. A checkpoint on
an unavailable failed node is not enough when the actor restarts elsewhere.(Ray contributors,
2026)
  Object ownership is separate from the worker that computes a value. The selected docu-
mentation does not promise recovery after object-owner failure. Local object spilling extends
capacity but is not a durable study ledger. At the cluster layer, the GCS stores metadata
39.94. Ray as a conditional execution substrate: preserving the scientific request           1063


in memory by default; the reviewed text distinguishes external Redis support in a specified
KubeRay/Serve setting from an alpha embedded RocksDB alternative and identifies functions
unavailable during recovery. These mechanisms do not restore a bank’s scientific history, actor
application state or external side effects by implication. Full qualification must test driver,
owner, worker, head-node and durable-store failures separately.(Ray contributors, 2026)
   A practical design stores immutable manifests and completed scientific contributions in an
independently recoverable store, with atomic acceptance of a contribution identity. Workers
compute candidates; a coordinator reconciles them against the required manifest. Recovery
restores the manifest, verifies accepted content and reruns only unresolved logical work. A
failed or timed-out request remains in the denominator even when a later retry succeeds. This
design is proposed here; no storage service or Ray cluster has been deployed.(Causal banking
proposal project, 2026ek)


39.94.4     Parallel partitions are not statistical sampling units

A distribution scheme must preserve both the estimator and its uncertainty calculation. For
four row scores (1, 1, −1, −1), suppose the first two rows belong to one household and the other
two to another. The uncorrected cluster-meat quantity normalized by the square of four is

                                     (1 + 1)2 + (−1 − 1)2  1
                                                          = .
                                              42           2
Replacing household sums by row squares gives 1/4. Splitting a household across workers and
summing local squares loses the cross terms. Neither number by itself supplies a calibrated
confidence interval; the example isolates a deterministic aggregation error before any sampling-
law argument. A correct implementation combines fragments by the declared sampling unit
before applying the covariance construction.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026ek)
   Training and evaluation folds similarly attach to stable unit identities and the information
clock, not worker number or arrival order. The authored fold map hashes a fixed study key and
household identity; repeated rows of the household retain their fold under a row permutation.
Assigning alternating rows instead splits each household in the example. Time boundaries
and common calendar shocks need their own restrictions; hashing is not a cure for dependence
or future-information leakage. Retry seeds should derive from the logical task identity, while
deliberately repeated Monte Carlo replications receive distinct registered replication identities.
   Even after identity preservation, floating-point reductions can change with order. In the
authored binary-floating-point example, (1016 − 1016 ) + 1 is 1, while 1016 + (−1016 + 1) is 0. A
stable summation reference gives 1. The adapter should specify deterministic reduction or a
justified numerical tolerance relative to the scientific error budget. Matching row counts and
returning finite numbers is insufficient near a decision threshold. Exact equality can be a useful
small-oracle test without being an appropriate universal requirement for every accelerator
kernel.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026ek)


39.94.5     Runtime environments and resource requests are operational con-
            tracts

The pinned documentation distinguishes a job-submission environment, which applies before
its entrypoint, from an environment supplied in initialization, which applies to child tasks and
actors but not the driver. It describes inheritance, environment-variable merging, replacement
of other fields, conflicts and an explicit override mode. It also warns that communicating
tasks with incompatible package environments can fail during deserialization. A path-based
1064                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


local URI identifies whatever bytes are present when each worker starts, not an immutable
code snapshot. These rules require a complete driver/worker environment manifest and actual
artifact hashes.(Ray contributors, 2026)
   Runtime installation and cache behavior affect both availability and cost. Setup timeouts,
cache misses, cold workers and repeated environment creation belong in the request budget. A
runtime environment is not a security isolation guarantee. The source security model expects
trusted code and external network and workload isolation; developer services can provide broad
code-execution access. The pinned token-authentication documentation supplies an additional
access-control mechanism, with rollout and configuration details that must be checked against
the chosen distribution. Tokens do not replace transport encryption, tenant isolation or a
narrow application authorization policy. No token, credential or live endpoint was accessed in
this review.(Ray contributors, 2026)
   Logical CPU and memory resources govern admission, not physical enforcement. A task
requesting one CPU can still launch multiple threads; GPU visibility and operating-system
limits are separate mechanisms. Zero-copy NumPy access applies to read-only arrays on the
same node, while mutation requires a copy. The selected documentation also warns about
an optional shared-memory tensor path. Neither a resource request nor a zero-copy label
proves a bank memory or isolation service level. The prototype must measure peak physical
memory, serialization, network transfer, spill storage and process/thread behavior under its
actual workload.(Ray contributors, 2026)


39.94.6     A bounded adoption decision and its economics

The retained disposition is reference, with native integration deferred. A single-process or local
worker pool is the baseline. Original Ray Core workers become a candidate only if measured
workload partitioning and data movement justify them; building a new distributed scheduler
or porting Ray wholesale is not justified by this proposal. The scientific owner specifies fold,
target and covariance invariants; the adapter owner handles logical identities, retries and
numerical reductions; the platform owner owns isolation and recovery; and the evaluation
owner measures complete costs and failure denominators.(Causal banking proposal project,
2026ek)
   An authored scaling calculation illustrates the gate. If one fifth of a workload is serial,
four workers give an ideal speedup of 1/(1/5 + (4/5)/4) = 2.5. Adding overhead equal to
three tenths of the original runtime reduces this to 10/7, about 1.43. These are stipulated
proportions, not a Ray benchmark. Likewise, stipulated costs of 180 USD compute, 120
USD engineering and 60 USD storage/operations total 360 USD. Six attempts on four logical
requests, of which three yield accepted artifacts, cost 60 USD per attempt, 90 USD per logical
request and 120 USD per accepted artifact. A cheaper successful attempt is not evidence of
lower full workflow cost.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026ek)
   The proposed CLI/MCP boundary accepts named, approved computations over immutable
artifact references, not arbitrary user-supplied code or unrestricted cluster credentials. It
returns the logical request identity, attempt ledger, accepted contributions, refusals, unresolved
effects, numerical checks and measured cost components. Public/generated fixtures should
freeze household/time partitions, known outputs, duplicate/conflicting-result events, crash
positions, cold environments and timeout budgets before a native study. The acceptance
question is whether the selected implementation preserves scientific meaning and useful
complete cost through these events. Until that evidence exists, distributed runtime support is
a conditional engineering route, not a qualified causal capability or a bank deployment.(Causal
banking proposal project, 2026ek)
