39.95       Splink and the causal cost of uncertain entity identity
A bank linking servicing records to later outcomes must distinguish a plausible record pair from
a trustworthy longitudinal observation. Splink supplies a concrete candidate for probabilistic
linkage, comparison diagnostics and graph-based entity construction. These operations can
support a causal workflow, but a matching score does not identify a treatment effect, certify a
customer identity or supply the joint uncertainty of an entire linkage map. The proposed use
therefore preserves candidate pairs, their selection mechanism and the information clock before
considering any hard entity identifier.(Splink contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal
project, 2026ep)

39.95.1     Selected artifact and the boundary of the evidence

The inspected repository revision is dated 6 October 2026 at 09:43:41 UTC, before the client
cutoff. Its project configuration declares Splink 5.0.0, Python at least 3.10 and below 4, and
direct dependencies on DuckDB, PyArrow and SQLGlot. Separate optional groups cover
plotting, graph operations and additional database engines. The selected license file contains
MIT terms. PyPI metadata independently identifies a 5.0.0 distribution uploaded on 28
September 2026; equality of the version string does not establish that the distribution has
every byte of the later inspected source revision. No package was installed or executed. A
deployment decision still needs an exact distribution, resolved dependencies, notices, supported
database profile and maintenance owner.(Splink contributors, 2026)
   The source review authenticates selected files against the complete cutoff tree. It follows
prediction, parameter training, blocking, threshold clustering, constrained clustering and
evaluation delegates. Historical README and package metadata remain discovery evidence
rather than substitutes for these technical paths. The review does not qualify every comparison
function, database dialect, cache, persistence mechanism, optional extension or advertised
scaling claim. Original execution behind a narrow adapter is a candidate; a wholesale port
would require independently maintaining comparison semantics, SQL generation and graph
algorithms without a demonstrated benefit.(Splink contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal
project, 2026ep)

39.95.2     A posterior score is conditional on a model and population

Write M for the event that two records represent the same entity, γ for their comparison
pattern and λ = P (M ) for the prior over a declared pair population. Under the selected
comparison model, and suppressing term-frequency adjustments, posterior odds take the form
                                 λ Y mj (γj )                          O(M | γ)
                 O(M | γ) =                     ,      P (M | γ) =                .
                               1 − λ j uj (γj )                      1 + O(M | γ)
Here mj and uj describe comparison outcomes among matches and nonmatches. The factor-
ization needs its conditional-dependence assumptions; it is not a consequence of storing fields
in separate columns. The inspected prediction path adds base-two log weights to the prior
log odds, converts the result to a probability with separate positive and negative branches
for numerical stability, and filters by an inclusive weight threshold. The null comparison
level has zero weight. Selected term-frequency adjustments alter the weight using observed
frequencies and configured floors. These numerical conventions must survive conversion to
another interface.(Splink contributors, 2026)
  An authored exact calculation shows why the prior population matters. A likelihood ratio of
100 gives posterior probability 100/199, about 0.503, at prior 0.01, but 100/1099, about 0.091,
1066                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


at prior 0.001. The same observed agreement can therefore cross a decision threshold when
the pair population or prior changes. If two fields are exact duplicates of one underlying signal
with likelihood ratio 10, the correct one-signal calculation at prior 0.01 is 10/109. Treating the
duplicated fields as conditionally independent instead gives 100/199. More agreeing columns
have not created more information. These are specified probability examples, not empirical
calibration measurements for Splink.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026ep)
   The inspected prior-estimation method counts pairs admitted by deterministic rules, divides
by a supplied recall estimate and then divides by the total possible comparisons. Its documen-
tation requests rules with very few false positives, and its code checks the recall range and
some count consistency conditions. Recall remains an external assumption. With 40 admitted
pairs among 10,000 possible pairs, supplied recall one half produces prior 0.008; supplied recall
four fifths produces 0.005. The calculation cannot validate the recall or the rules’ truth from
the admitted count alone. Boundary warnings should not be promoted into evidence that an
extreme prior is scientifically appropriate.(Splink contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal
project, 2026ep)


39.95.3     Training design, stopping rules and unobserved comparisons

The pinned training guide recommends directly estimating the prior and nonmatch probabilities
before training selected match probabilities. Its rationale is explicitly conditional: random
pairs should be overwhelmingly nonmatching, while blocking enriches the match population for
training. The source API samples records and evaluates eligible pairs in chunks; its optional
per-level count stopping rule is described as a heuristic rather than a precision guarantee.
Seeds and database support have their own constraints. Reused records induce shared-pair
dependence, so the number of processed pairs alone is not an independent-sample size for
a confidence statement. A public prototype must preserve sampled record identities, pair
inclusion, seed, chunking, early stopping and effective comparison counts.(Splink contributors,
2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026ep)
   Training blocking also changes which comparisons can be estimated. The selected session
removes comparisons involving blocking columns and adjusts the session prior with factors
associated with the blocking rule. The API defaults to fixed nonmatch probabilities, while the
session prior can change; using a trained session prior to populate the main model is a separate
option that defaults to false. Thus a general recommendation to estimate the population prior
directly must not be misread as a claim that every internal EM prior is held fixed. Different
training blocks can supply complementary estimates, but agreement among them does not
prove independence, correct selection or population calibration.(Splink contributors, 2026)
  The inspected EM loop compares the largest absolute parameter change with a tolerance
and also imposes an iteration limit. Its final logging statement uses convergence language after
the loop, including the path that exhausts that limit. This is a static control-flow observation,
not an observed package failure. A proposed adapter must report whether the criterion was
actually met, retain the parameter history and distinguish iteration exhaustion from successful
convergence. An authored sequence of maximum changes 0.10, 0.05, 0.04 with tolerance 0.01
never meets the criterion, even though three iterations have completed. Small parameter
change, when obtained, is still not proof of global optimum or posterior calibration.(Splink
contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026ep)
39.95. Splink and the causal cost of uncertain entity identity                               1067


39.95.4     Blocking recall and the causal observation mechanism

Prediction uses selected blocking rules or a manually registered blocked-pair table. The latter
has its own chunking restrictions. Chunked prediction processes the designated combinations
and combines outputs; a DuckDB-specific path prunes source inputs to records present in
selected blocked pairs. Such execution paths require matched semantic tests before cross-engine
or chunking equivalence is claimed. A pair excluded before scoring cannot be recovered merely
by lowering a later probability threshold. The evaluated-label path explicitly distinguishes
positives missed by blocking from errors in the scoring model. That distinction should be
mandatory in the product’s result contract.(Splink contributors, 2026)
   Suppose a public fixture contains 100 true links, of which blocking admits 60. The scorer
retains 54 true links and six false links. Its recall among admitted true links is 90 percent and
its precision is 90 percent, but end-to-end recall is only 54 percent. A report that conditions
on scored pairs hides 46 missed true links. Labels sampled only from accepted pairs cannot
identify the omitted recall; the evaluation design must include a justified sample outside
the block, a known public oracle or an explicitly bounded sensitivity analysis. Annotation
effort and unresolved labels belong in the cost denominator.(Causal banking proposal project,
2026ep)
   For a banking illustration, consider two treatment arms, each containing outcomes 100 and
0 USD. Their complete-data contrast is zero. If the linkage mechanism retains only the high
outcome in the treated arm and only the low outcome in the control arm, the observed contrast
becomes 100 USD despite perfect identity for the retained pairs. This is selection bias, not a
false-merge error. The example is a finite construction and supplies no causal identification
claim. It motivates separate diagnostics for treatment-dependent linkage availability, outcome-
dependent blocking and use of post-treatment contact fields. A customer address updated after
a servicing intervention cannot silently become baseline identity evidence.(Causal banking
proposal project, 2026ep)


39.95.5     Pairwise probabilities do not define a joint entity map

The selected threshold-clustering method constructs connected components from retained
edges. It does not require every pair within a component to exceed the threshold. With scores
0.96 for A–B and B–C, but 0.10 for A–C, threshold 0.95 joins all three records in an authored
graph calculation; all six edge orders give the same component. This deterministic behavior is
useful for explaining transitivity, but it cannot make the three scores a coherent joint posterior
over equivalence relations. If the first two numbers were probabilities under one common
posterior, then transitivity and the union bound require

                        P (A ∼ C) ≥ P (A ∼ B) + P (B ∼ C) − 1 = 0.92.

The score 0.10 violates that requirement. The example does not assert that a real dataset
generates those scores; it shows why independent pair labels and a joint identity distribution
are different objects.(Splink contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026ep)
   The reviewed alternative single-best-link routine constrains selected datasets to at most
one member per cluster and exposes distinct tie policies. Such a source-uniqueness constraint
can be valuable, but a local mutual-best rule is not automatically a maximum-total-weight
assignment. In an authored two-by-two score matrix with rows (0.90, 0.80) and (0.85, 0.10),
choosing the mutually highest pair first and then the remaining pair totals 1.00; the alternative
cross assignment totals 1.65. This is an objective comparison, not an execution result or an
assertion that total score is the correct banking loss. One-to-one assumptions themselves fail
1068                                                          Causal analysis for a universal bank


for legitimately repeated records unless their scope is explicitly declared.(Splink contributors,
2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026ep)
   A causal consumer needs either a justified joint distribution over feasible linkage maps, an
identified set with sensitivity bounds, or a refusal when identity information is inadequate. If a
specified joint model assigns probabilities three quarters and one quarter to two maps yielding
contrasts 20 and −20 USD, the model-averaged contrast is 10 USD and the between-map
variance is 300 USD squared. If each conditional analysis has variance 4 USD squared, the law
of total variance gives 304 USD squared. Reporting only 4 discards the identity contribution.
These weights are stipulated joint hypotheses; they cannot be manufactured by independently
drawing the package’s pairwise probabilities. Calibration and causal validity still require the
joint model, observation law and downstream assumptions.(Causal banking proposal project,
2026ep)


39.95.6     Reference disposition and a testable integration route

The completed proposal choice is to retain Splink as a reference and conditional prototype
candidate, without granting native integration. A deterministic exact-key baseline should
establish the value of probabilistic matching. A pinned original worker is preferable to
a wholesale port when it can preserve the selected database and comparison semantics.
Alternative linkage or joint-identity models should be compared on the same known maps,
missingness patterns, causal targets and full loss function. Better pair discrimination alone is
not an adequate selection criterion.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026ep)
   The proposed CLI/MCP request binds immutable input tables, source/record identifiers,
allowed feature clocks, link type, candidate-generation rules, parameter and term-frequency
snapshots, declared seeds, thresholds, tie behavior, engine identity and a resource budget.
The response separates candidate pairs, excluded/unscored status, estimated probabilities,
clustering rule, proposed entity maps, convergence diagnostics and uncertainty limitations.
Failed, refused and unresolved requests stay visible. A result must not label a blocked-out
pair as a calibrated nonmatch or an estimated component as certified identity. Arbitrary SQL
and database credentials require their own scoped execution boundary; this source review has
contacted no live bank or MCP endpoint.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026ep)
   Before admission, a public/generated study should freeze planted entity maps, duplicate fields,
correlated missingness, treatment-dependent linkage, conflicting source identifiers, bridge edges,
tie permutations, blocked-out positives, iteration exhaustion and engine/chunking profiles. It
should compare pair accuracy, entity consistency, causal estimand error, refusal and complete
cost. The scientific owner controls the target and linkage law; the data owner controls clocks
and source truth; the adapter owner preserves conversion and failure semantics; the platform
and rights owners qualify the selected distribution and environment. Authentic bank validation
follows a useful prototype and remains a separate obligation.(Causal banking proposal project,
2026ep)
   An authored cost example stipulates 40 USD computation, 160 USD annotation, 200 USD
engineering and 80 USD storage/review, totaling 480 USD. Six attempts for four logical
requests, three of which produce accepted artifacts, cost 80 USD per attempt, 120 USD per
request and 160 USD per accepted artifact. These are explanatory inputs, not prices or a
Splink benchmark. Revisit the reference decision only after measured need, permissible artifact
identities and predeclared semantic, uncertainty, failure and cost criteria support a bounded
integration. A faster matching engine cannot supply missing identity truth or a universally
calibrated causal analysis.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026ep)
39.96. Dynamic-panel reuse: instruments, calendars, and the cost of searching for a model     1069


39.96      Dynamic-panel reuse: instruments, calendars, and the
           cost of searching for a model
A dynamic-panel coefficient becomes useful to a bank only after its time scale and identifying
moments are justified. Consider monthly account balances following a servicing intervention,
or deposit flows following a change in offered rates. Persistence makes a static regression an
incomplete description. It also makes the distinction between an immediate association, a
structural response and a long-run consequence economically important. The pydynpd package
offers a concrete Python candidate for a bounded linear dynamic-panel service. Its original
paper describes difference and system GMM, several estimation steps, diagnostic tests and
automatic lag-model search. The paper’s historical comparisons motivate inspection; they do
not establish current relative speed, correctness or commercial parity.(Dazhong Wu and Jian
Hua and Feng Xu, 2023)
   The reviewed repository commit predates the 7 October 2026 cutoff. The root license is
MIT. The selected setup file declares Python at least 3.6, version 0.2.1 and dependencies on
NumPy, SciPy, pandas and prettytable, whereas the separate version module declares 5.2.0.
The setup file’s nonempty version takes its own branch. We therefore identify the reviewed
code by its commit and hashes, without pretending that these declarations identify one verified
wheel or supported environment. No package code, benchmark or test was executed. The
following source findings and exact project examples support a reference disposition and a
conditional original-worker design.(pydynpd contributors, 2025)


39.96.1     The equation and the information supplied by instruments

For account i and period t, start with the deliberately restricted model

                                 yit = αyi,t−1 + βait + ηi + εit .                          (39.33)

Here ait is a declared action or exposure, ηi an account effect and εit the remaining disturbance.
Coefficient β is a structural causal response only under a model in which this action and
disturbance have the required intervention meaning. An economic label on a regression column
does not provide that meaning. Differencing removes the fixed account effect but leaves

                                ∆yit = α∆yi,t−1 + β∆ait + ∆εit .                            (39.34)

The lagged dependent regressor generally shares a disturbance with the differenced error.
The classical short-panel argument uses suitable lagged levels as instruments under the
stated moment and serial-correlation restrictions; the original discussion also distinguishes
predetermined from strictly exogenous regressors. The relevant asymptotic regime and cross-
unit sampling conditions are part of that argument. They cannot be replaced by a successful
software call. (Arellano and Bond, 1991)
   Write gi (θ) = Zi′ ui (θ) for account-level moments, where Zi contains the chosen instruments
and ui the transformed residual vector. A GMM calculation minimizes ḡN (θ)′ WN ḡN (θ) for a
declared weight matrix. At least three questions must remain separate: whether the moments
are valid, whether they identify the requested coefficient, and whether the estimated weight
and covariance give useful finite-sample inference. System GMM adds level-equation moments
and hence additional restrictions. For the simple autoregression, the inspected original account
of the method makes the initial-condition restriction E[∆yi2 ηi ] = 0 explicit. High persistence
can make otherwise valid lag instruments weak; adding level moments is justified only when
their extra conditions hold.(Blundell and Bond, 2023)
1070                                                            Causal analysis for a universal bank


  A small exact example shows why a moment solver cannot supply these conditions. Let U
be equally likely to be minus one or one, set x = z = U , and let the structural equation be
y = x + ε with ε = U . The true structural coefficient is one, but

                                      E[z(y − θx)] = 2 − θ.                                  (39.35)

The moment criterion is minimized at two because the proposed instrument is invalid. It is
precisely solved and scientifically wrong for the stated target. In another example, x1 = x2 = z
identifies only β1 + β2 . Coefficients (1, 0), (0, 1) and (1/2, 1/2) generate the same fitted values.
A generalized inverse can choose a numerical representative without identifying the two effects.
These are authored algebraic witnesses, not native pydynpd benchmark results. (Causal
banking proposal project, 2026ei)


39.96.2     The calendar and the instrument ledger

The inspected parser requires a lag-one dependent variable and rejects declared dependent-
variable GMM instruments starting before lag two. It derives a corresponding level-lag entry
and makes regressors not assigned to a GMM or IV list into IV entries. Default options select
two steps, a level equation, first differences and uncollapsed instruments. These defaults are
computational conventions, not evidence that a bank’s rate or servicing action is exogenous or
that level moments are valid. The proposed request must carry an explicit instrument ledger:
variable, treatment of endogeneity, equation block, permitted lags, collapse choice, availability
clock and scientific justification. It should reject an implicit scientific classification. (pydynpd
contributors, 2025)
  The same ledger must specify what one time step means. The inspected panel constructor
encodes observed time values categorically and creates a balanced array over those codes.
Globally absent periods are not automatically supplied as calendar gaps. If observed months
are one, three and four, adjacent categorical codes represent calendar intervals of two months
and one month. Treating both as the same lag changes the equation. The source also calls
sorting without assigning its returned table before a subsequent positional assignment into
occupied balanced-array locations. This creates an ordering contract that must be checked
before reuse.(pydynpd contributors, 2025)
   An independent positional example makes the concern concrete. Suppose encoded key/value
pairs arrive as (2, 30), (0, 10), (1, 20). Writing their value sequence into sorted occupied keys
produces (0, 30), (1, 10), (2, 20), whereas a keyed assignment gives (0, 10), (1, 20), (2, 30). The
abstract result explains the source concern without claiming to have reproduced a native
failure. The proposed adapter must copy the input, verify unique unit-period keys, impose a
declared regular calendar and bind a sorted key-to-row map. A future qualification test must
permute the original rows and demand invariance of that mapping and the estimator. Sorting
alone does not repair duplicate keys or an incorrect time grid.(Causal banking proposal project,
2026ei)
   Instrument proliferation and instrument strength are also different. In a complete six-period
illustrative series, difference equations for periods three through six can have one, two, three
and four lag-level instrument slots, giving ten uncollapsed slots for that variable. Grouping the
same stipulated moments by lag gives four collapsed slots. Other regressors, level equations,
missingness and lag restrictions change these counts. Neither ten nor four is a rank certificate or
a proof of valid moments. The inspected builder has explicit lag-window and collapse branches,
so the worker should return the realized instrument identities, dimensions and numerical rank
diagnostics as well as the requested options.(pydynpd contributors, 2025; Causal banking
proposal project, 2026ei)
39.96. Dynamic-panel reuse: instruments, calendars, and the cost of searching for a model     1071


39.96.3     Weights, covariance and numerical termination

The inspected estimator computes weighted normal equations using a pseudoinverse; the
step-result class also pseudoinverts its weight matrix. It accumulates moment outer products
by account and invokes a covariance helper named for the finite-sample two-step correction.
Its Hansen calculation uses the nominal difference between instrument and regressor counts
as degrees of freedom. These paths must be reported as inspected implementation choices.
They do not establish effective-rank adequacy, an asymptotic approximation under arbitrary
dependence, or numerical reliability near singularity. A finite-sample correction cannot repair
invalid instruments. (pydynpd contributors, 2025; Blundell and Bond, 2023)
   Common bank-wide shocks give an elementary warning about the covariance unit. If
gi = U for all one hundred accounts, with a common mean-zero unit-variance shock, then
Var(N −1 i gi ) = 1. Keeping only the diagonal contributions gives an expected value of 1/100.
          P

Adding more copies of the common shock does not create independent information. This
witness does not assert that every bank panel has this dependence or that time dummies
are ineffective. It shows why the chosen sampling law and any remaining calendar or group
dependence require a separate argument.(Causal banking proposal project, 2026ei)
   Estimation step and diagnostic step also need explicit identities. In the inspected one-step
path, the code computes a second step and uses its weight/residual aggregate for the Hansen
calculation, while the reported coefficient table selects the requested step. This may be an
intentional diagnostic convention; an adapter must preserve it rather than label every output
as coming from the reported estimator. Missing transformed regressor or outcome rows are
zeroed together with the corresponding instrument columns. In system mode, the inspected
observation count follows the differenced block. The proposed service should return eligible
accounts, transformed equation rows, retained observations, instrument columns and each
diagnostic denominator separately. (pydynpd contributors, 2025)
   The iterative routine stops when relative coefficient change falls below a threshold. The
inspected loop has no explicit iteration cap or finite-value guard; its relative criterion divides
by the squared norm of the previous coefficient. A zero denominator, nonfinite iterate or
nonconvergence therefore requires an explicit worker policy. The parser’s large step marker
is not an inspected cap on this loop. A future worker needs an iteration budget, timeout,
convergence record and refusal outcome. If that requires a source repair, retain it as a separately
versioned implementation and qualify the repaired algorithm. A timeout cannot be reported
as an estimated effect. (pydynpd contributors, 2025)


39.96.4     A search survivor is a selected result

The original paper describes an automatic mode that searches lag combinations and returns
models satisfying specification tests. In the inspected source, candidates are generated from
adjustable lag ranges; ordinary exceptions during candidate processing are caught and skipped.
The acceptance predicate requires the last autocorrelation-test probability to exceed 0.05
and the Hansen probability to lie strictly between 0.05 and 0.99999. Ordinary process
errors, diagnostic failures, rejected candidates and returned models are consequently different
denominators. Some parser errors use process exit rather than the ordinary exception path.
An authorized isolated worker must translate every terminal outcome into a typed result and
preserve all attempted candidates.(Dazhong Wu and Jian Hua and Feng Xu, 2023; pydynpd
contributors, 2025)
   Searching changes the interpretation of a surviving test. For a stipulated collection of twenty
invalid candidates, suppose each independently passes a screening rule with probability 0.1.
1072                                                            Causal analysis for a universal bank


The probability that at least one survives is

                                    1 − (1 − 0.1)20 ≃ 0.8784.                               (39.36)

This is not an estimate of the power of Hansen or autocorrelation tests, and real candidate
events need not be independent. It is a finite-law explanation of why a search for nonrejection
is not a certification procedure. Predeclare the economic model and admissible moments
where possible; otherwise retain the full search and address selection in the inferential design.
A held-out or simulation-based check must still be justified for the panel’s dependence and
available information. (Causal banking proposal project, 2026ei)


39.96.5     From coefficients to a proposal for reuse

For a stable scalar linear response with invariant coefficients, the effect of a permanent unit
increase in exposure is β/(1 − α). With a stipulated immediate response of USD 10, persistence
0.8 gives USD 50 and persistence 0.95 gives USD 200. These are model calculations, not
measured bank value. An uncertainty region reaching the pole at one cannot be converted
into a bounded long-run estimate by plugging in the center. Regime changes, intervention
feedback and a general servicing policy lie beyond this calculation.(Causal banking proposal
project, 2026ei)
   The present choice is reference-only reuse, with an original Python worker as a conditional
prototype candidate. Before admission, its typed library/CLI/MCP contract must bind the
equation, estimand, calendar, immutable data, sorted key map, instruments, requested and
diagnostic steps, covariance unit, rank tolerances, search ledger and termination policy. The
response must preserve full covariance, diagnostic identities, excluded rows, errors and scientific
refusal; a printed regression table is insufficient. An agent may propose a lag or exposure
classification, but its proposal cannot silently authorize system moments, model selection or
intervention meaning.
   A targeted repair around input alignment, bounded execution and complete candidate
accounting is more plausible than silently porting the entire estimator into another language.
A wholesale port would require independent checks of transforms, weighting, covariance,
missingness and diagnostics. Existing panel implementations remain comparators under a
frozen common specification; historical author timing claims are not a substitute for matched
fixtures. Qualification should begin with public or generated panels whose moments, calendar,
dependence and failure outcomes are known, then use fresh evaluation under a justified protocol.
Native qualification and expensive bank experiments follow only when the prototype’s merit is
demonstrated.
   The method owner must justify the moments and economic response; the data owner must
certify keys, clocks and panel selection; the numerical owner must resolve rank, covariance and
convergence; the adapter and rights owners must freeze the implementation and dependency
profile. Measure failed attempts and correct refusals alongside accepted artifacts. In a
stipulated twenty-attempt workflow costing USD 100, eight diagnostic survivors cost USD
12.50 each, but two accepted artifacts cost USD 50 each. Four correct refusals remain a
separate outcome. This is not an observed price or performance claim. The decision preserves
the source concerns and a concrete qualification route without granting native execution,
general panel validity or bank acceptance. (Causal banking proposal project, 2026ei)
Chapter 40

What language models contribute to
causal knowledge

40.1     Four different objects called causal reasoning
A banker asking why deposit balances fell can be asking for an explanation of a recorded event,
an estimate of a feasible rate intervention, a prediction of next month’s balance, or a diagnosis
of an observation error. A fluent answer can move between these objects without announcing
the change. The useful starting point for evaluating language assistance is therefore the object
being produced: a proposed scientific question, evidence about a causal model, a formal
calculation conditional on that model, or a recommendation under a specified loss. Success at
one object supplies no automatic guarantee for the others.
   The early frontier argument proposes using language models to organize domain knowledge,
draft graphs, critique assumptions and suggest robustness analyses. It also records the ability
to reproduce recognizable public data and distinguishes transforming known information
from discovering a new causal structure.Kıcıman et al. (2023) This distinction is particularly
consequential in banking. A familiar statement about interest rates can be useful prior
knowledge, but the effect of a particular bank’s deposit offer depends on its population,
competitors, eligibility rules and information clock. A remembered relationship does not
determine that intervention effect.
   Formal benchmarks introduce a second object. CLadder constructs questions from known
causal structures with different verbalizations. Its results concern answers to those generated
questions, including historically specified models and prompting methods.Jin et al. (2023)
Such a benchmark can reveal failures to distinguish observation from intervention. It cannot
establish that a model elicits the right variables from an unfamiliar bank process, measures
them correctly, or returns calibrated uncertainty after fitting to dependent data. These are
additional stages of the proposed product.
   Third, a language model can propose a causal mechanism for numerical analysis. Model
Discovery Agent illustrates a separation between executable mechanism proposals and numerical
fitting, evidence approximation and experiment design. Its finite predictive evaluations
explicitly do not establish causal identification.Murphy (2026) A mechanism may predict well
because several observationally equivalent models predict equally well. The bank must still
justify which intervention the model represents and which new experiment would distinguish
economically different mechanisms.
  Finally, workflow assistance concerns selection and coordination of established operations.
Causal-learn+ describes assistance with diagnosis, assumptions, method selection and inter-

                                             1073
1074                                                          Causal analysis for a universal bank


pretation while retaining algorithm outputs and graph ambiguity.Zheng (2026) This is a useful
architectural direction. It changes the analyst’s interaction with numerical tools; it does not
make a method’s premises true. The following chapters keep these four contributions separate
while studying how they can work together.


40.2      Text supplies a different information channel
Write D for the observed numerical records, K for inspected documentary or expert evidence,
and M(D, K) for the models consistent with the declared interpretation of both. For target
ψ, a set-valued answer is

                             Ψ(D, K) = {ψ(M ) : M ∈ M(D, K)}.

This notation does not assert that finite data identify the population law or that a statistical
confidence procedure has been supplied. It describes which models the analysis intends to
consider. Statistical uncertainty about the law must subsequently be propagated through the
model set.
  Additional reliable knowledge may exclude a model that the observed distribution alone
cannot exclude. A contract establishing that an invitation was randomized, for example,
has a different evidential role from a predictive correlation. But a model-generated sentence
repeating that randomization is common practice does not establish what happened in the
bank’s historical process. The analysis must identify the original source, the relevant population
and dates, the interpretation of its claim, and the person or measurement that supports it.
   This also explains why retrieving more documents need not improve discovery. LACR
combines background knowledge, retrieved documents and optional numerical information,
and includes an UNKNOWN response. Its reported retrieval effects differ across benchmarks,
with adverse as well as favorable outcomes. Zhang et al. (2024b) Retrieval changes K; it does
not certify K. Documents may concern a different treatment definition, contain an association
stated as a cause, or duplicate the same original assertion. Ten repeated documents are not
ten independent confirmations of an edge.
   An appropriate evidence object therefore retains the claim, source passage, date, domain,
units and proposed role. A passage may justify a variable definition without justifying an
arrow. A process document may establish that one action occurs before another without
excluding a common cause. A source about another bank may suggest a hypothesis while
leaving transport assumptions unresolved. These roles determine the strength with which K
can restrict the model class.


40.3     Discovery methods use language judgments in different
         ways
Three broad routes recur in the inspected literature: direct graph or relation prediction,
refinement of numerical discoveries, and priors or constraints used within a search.Wan et al.
(2024) The distinction matters because it locates where a wrong assertion enters the calculation.
   In direct conditional-independence elicitation, chatPC obtains language-model judgments
from descriptions and context. Its statistical calculation concerns the proportion of YES/NO
model responses.Cohrs et al. (2024) Repeated answers can measure response variability under
a prompt. Without a separate argument, they are not repeated draws of the bank variables
40.4. Temporal discovery is not a change of vocabulary                                      1075


and do not yield a sampling test of independence in the bank population. A highly stable
wrong answer can therefore be more dangerous than a visibly variable one.
   Soft guidance provides a different failure boundary. The inspected CD-UCT method
combines language and mutual-information scores to guide graph search without excluding
otherwise valid DAGs. Language-only priors are not uniformly beneficial in its reported
comparisons.Darvariu et al. (2024) Ancestral-path constraints can likewise enter through a
soft log-prior penalty, with reported degradation under inaccurate prior information.Ban et al.
(2023) Softness leaves room for the numerical criterion to resist the suggestion, but it does not
establish that the final graph probabilities are calibrated.
   Hard restrictions can be scientifically appropriate when backed by a genuine design fact.
They are more consequential when inferred from prose: deleting a candidate model deletes
every effect value that only that model permits. Statistical Causal Prompting converts model
outputs into forced, forbidden or unknown prior knowledge using method-specific mappings.
The inspected examples include failures as well as improvements.Takayama et al. (2024) The
interface must expose both the original assertion and the conversion rule, so a reviewer can
determine whether a numerical threshold has quietly become a scientific exclusion.
   Noisy language priors can also guide a sequential allocation of questions over edges while
retaining PAG representations.Verma et al. (2025) This is closer to a budgeted information
problem than to asking for a finished graph in one prompt. Its relevance to a bank still depends
on whether the supplied knowledge applies to the observed regime, whether latent structure is
represented correctly, and whether the retained ambiguity survives into the effect query.


40.4      Temporal discovery is not a change of vocabulary
A statement that collections activity affects arrears omits the action time, available history,
response horizon and possible feedback. Expanding a variable name into a paragraph does not
supply these missing indices. A temporal graph needs explicit time labels and a rule governing
contemporaneous edges, lag limits, hidden histories, stationarity and interventions.
   RealTCD combines a language-derived initial adjacency with numerical score optimization
over temporal graphs and intervention targets. Its setup includes causal sufficiency, a known
observational regime, finite lag and a DAG on unrolled variables; its identification statement
has further stated premises. The inspected real-system assessment lacks a ground-truth DAG
and evaluates selected relationships through expert rules.Li (2024) These qualifications prevent
a graph score from being read as a general guarantee for a bank’s latent, irregularly observed
time series.
   The Large Causal Models work is an adjacent numerical foundation-model route, not
simply a conversational language-model interface. The inspected model assumes additive
noise, stationarity, no latent confounders and no contemporaneous effects, and does not detect
or correct violations of these assumptions.Kougioulis et al. (2026) Distinguishing the two
routes avoids treating the shared word “model” as a common scientific contract. One supplies
semantic proposals; the other learns a temporal mapping under a training distribution and
structural restrictions. Either can be useful within its declared regime.
   For sequential servicing, a credible workflow starts with the decision history and feasible
intervention. It then asks whether the discovery output expresses the required variables and
whether a policy effect is identified over every retained graph. An automatically generated
lagged graph cannot resolve unrecorded private information merely by assigning it a latent-node
name.
1076                                                         Causal analysis for a universal bank


40.5     Interactive systems and agents add a review problem
CausalChat combines graph suggestions, user editing and numerical updates. Its small nonex-
pert study uses a fixed sequence of interfaces. Zhang (2024) Such evidence can motivate better
interfaces, but it does not isolate every learning, ordering or expertise effect. The proposed
bank evaluation needs qualified reviewers, an explicit task distribution and a comparison that
records the time and information supplied by people.
  Debating agents provide another review structure. MAC uses affirmative, negative and
judge roles; its inspected comparisons also report a competitive single-agent route for simpler
graphs at lower cost.Le et al. (2024) Several personas can share the same mistaken premise or
model knowledge. Agreement among them is not automatically independent corroboration.
Their usefulness should be measured through detected errors, retained correct alternatives,
decision consequences and total cost.
   The oci-agent study instead emphasizes an accountable human principal over actor/critic
workflows and deterministic causal libraries. Its critic can decline analyses with poor over-
lap.Chou et al. (2026) The relevant outcome then includes correct refusal and what remains
possible for the requested population. Reporting only completed analyses would hide precisely
the difficult cases in which an agent’s judgment matters most.
   An evidence-auditing agent faces a similar boundary. ARGUS audits reported support
for assumptions rather than adjudicating their truth. Its retrieval and abstention tradeoffs
and small human-label pilot leave substantial generalization questions.Zhang et al. (2026a)
In banking, an omitted document, a contradicted assumption and an assumption whose
truth is unknown require different responses. A documentation score should not become an
identification certificate.


40.6     An evidence standard for the proposed banking product
The synthesis supports a modular research program. Language assistance proposes questions,
variables, graph alternatives and evidence links. Formal operations check declared structures
and calculate identified functionals or sets in supported regimes. Numerical procedures estimate
those objects with their own sampling and approximation arguments. Human and institutional
evidence supply facts about assignment, ownership and feasibility that neither interface can
manufacture.
   Each interface needs an explicit refusal or unknown state. A retrieved passage with the
wrong unit should fail target review. A graph class outside a backend’s domain should return
unsupported. A valid but uninformative effect set should remain visible. A conflict between
textual and numerical evidence should retain both sources for investigation instead of selecting
whichever yields a cleaner answer.
   CausalDS makes narrated mechanisms, observations and private scoring objects separate
parts of a benchmark, and its results distinguish symbolic answers, uncertainty, abstention
and cost.Leban and Sun (2026) The proposed evaluation adopts that separation as a design
principle. It does not borrow a published model score as evidence for the local prototype. The
next chapters develop the translation, diagram, discovery, workflow and economic consequences
of this architecture; its empirical value still requires independent mechanisms and an actual
declared backend.
40.7. From a frontier result to a banking capability                                          1077


40.7      From a frontier result to a banking capability
The inspected literature gives reasons to invest in better assistance, but it does not yield a
single ranking of causal systems. A system that extracts relations from documents, a system
that answers a supplied structural-model question and a system that chooses a treatment
policy may all receive a score called causal accuracy. Their inputs, permissible assumptions
and correct outputs differ. A product proposal must recover these differences before it uses an
experimental result to select software or allocate development effort.
  For this purpose, describe an evaluation claim by

                                      E = (T , I, A, O, B, L),                              (40.1)

where T is the task distribution, I the information supplied to the system, A its scientific
assumptions, O the oracle or adjudication rule, B the tool, repair and human budget, and L
the loss used to score its output. This is a proposed comparison vocabulary, not a theorem
that these quantities are observed without error. It asks a practical question: which parts of
the published experiment would remain the same in the proposed banking use? A change in
any component requires an argument or a new experiment before the original score can carry
the same interpretation.
   For example, a graph provided in the prompt belongs to I. Correctly calculating a back-door
formula from it tests conditional reasoning. Inferring that graph from account and contact
records is a different task with different assumptions. Likewise, a human who repairs a mistaken
join changes the combined workflow’s information and cost. The repaired answer can be
valuable, but attributing its correctness entirely to the model would misdescribe the product
being evaluated. This motivates an explicit comparison of the strongest available alternatives
rather than an agent-only leaderboard.


40.7.1     Favorable and adverse results locate different opportunities

The earliest broad frontier analysis treats language models as a channel for domain knowledge
and a possible aid to graph construction, critique and robustness analysis. It also probes
memorization and prompt sensitivity. These observations motivate assistance with familiar
concepts while warning that a recognizable public dataset can supply information absent
from a fresh bank problem. Neither renaming a variable nor recalling a benchmark answer
establishes a new identification result Kıcıman et al. (2023).
   CLadder gives a more controlled formal task: generated questions from specified causal
structures with alternative verbalizations. That design isolates important distinctions among
association, intervention and counterfactual reasoning. The supplied structure and generator,
however, are part of the experimental information. A bank workflow must also determine
whether its variable, treatment and population definitions support that structure. The paper’s
remaining language-to-formal-tool problem is therefore central to the proposed product, not
an incidental user-interface issue Jin et al. (2023).
   Two comparisons show why the proposal should retain nonagent and smaller-model baselines.
In CausalEval, adding function calls improves the reported GPT-4o CLADDER point score
from 69 to 76 relative to ordinary chain-of-thought, but reduces its e-CARE score from 90 to 73.
These are outcomes from the named historical configurations and samples. They demonstrate
variation across tasks, not a general tool penalty or benefit. In the inspected relation-extraction
study, the DDI F1 values for Single-Prompt C and PubMedBERT are 67.4 and 87.9. The
task concerns binary pairwise relations and the fine-tuned system receives labeled training
examples. The result supports considering supervised extraction where the document domain
1078                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


and annotation budget are suitable; it does not compare whole causal pipelines at equal total
cost Yu et al. (2025a); Susanti and Holsmoelle (2025).
   Retrieval has similarly mixed consequences. LACR combines background knowledge, docu-
ments and optional numerical information. Its ASIA skeleton F1 falls from 1 to approximately
.73 when documents are added, while other reported cases benefit. Documents can add an
applicable mechanism, introduce a conflicting definition or repeat the same unsupported
assertion. The scientific question is which information changed and why it was relevant, rather
than how many documents entered the prompt Zhang et al. (2024b).
   Auditing assumptions is another promising but restricted task. ARGUS assesses the reported
support for difference-in-differences assumptions, uses injected flaws as local ground truth and
explicitly avoids adjudicating causal truth. Its five-paper human-label pilot and in-sample
calibration do not establish the error rate on a new collection of studies. A bank can use such
an assistant to find missing discussion or contradictory passages while keeping assignment,
parallel trends and measurement facts open to scientific assessment Zhang et al. (2026a).
   CausalCollab makes the longitudinal issue concrete. It defines an incremental stylistic effect
in sequential human–model interactions under explicit positivity and sequential exchangeability
premises. Its intervention mixes text versions through a specified functional construction. A
proposed collections-message rewriting policy is not automatically that intervention: it must
define which actual messages are delivered, to whom, and after which history. Model-generated
counterfactual edits or outcome labels in an evaluation remain generated evidence. The
theorem’s premises, the estimator’s approximation and the operational rewriting policy must
be reviewed separately Zhang et al. (2024a).
  These results favor a portfolio of bounded roles. Template-driven formalization, supervised
extraction, retrieved evidence, formal graph algorithms and numerical causal estimators can
each be a baseline or component. A language model is valuable where it reduces a measured
bottleneck while preserving the meaning of the task. Its presence is not a requirement for every
component. The architecture chapter develops how to enforce those boundaries in handoffs;
the question here is what evidence can justify selecting them.


40.7.2    Task composition can reverse a published ranking

Let sak be method a’s success probability on task stratum k and wk the proportion of eligible
                               P
requests in that stratum, with k wk = 1. Under a common success definition, the overall
probability is                                X
                                    Sa (w) =     wk sak .                             (40.2)
                                                 k

Even when every sak is known, ranking methods requires w. A pooled score from one benchmark
mixture is not a mixture-free property of a system. When the strata use incompatible outcomes,
they should first remain separate rather than be forced into this formula.
   As an arithmetic illustration, use the two reported CausalEval point-score pairs just discussed.
Give CLADDER weight w and e-CARE weight 1−w. The FunctionCall-minus-chain-of-thought
difference is
                            ∆(w) = .07w − .17(1 − w) = .24w − .17.                           (40.3)
It changes sign at w = 17/24 ≃ .7083. At equal weights the difference is −.05; at w = .8 it is
.022. This reweighting uses published point scores solely to illustrate composition. It supplies
neither their sampling uncertainty nor a bank’s task mix. The original paired outcomes and
mechanism-level dependence would be needed for an uncertainty calculation Yu et al. (2025a);
Causal banking proposal project (2026i).
40.7. From a frontier result to a banking capability                                             1079


   The same principle applies to missing tasks. If all evaluated requests assume an observed
confounder set, the experiment cannot establish performance on latent-confounding requests,
whatever their future bank frequency. If the support and weights of the intended workload are
unknown, report stratum-level results and plausible planning mixtures. A later public or bank
intake sample can estimate the mix. Changing the weighting after observing which method
wins would instead change the decision rule being evaluated.
  The task family should be the meaningful sampling unit. Paraphrases from the same
mechanism, multiple prompt seeds and repeated tool calls share information. The repeated-call
variance example in the evaluation chapter explains why their count cannot simply replace
the count of independent mechanisms. For a matched comparison, pair methods on the
same held-out mechanisms, preserve all retries and report uncertainty at the level where the
evaluation law supplies independence. No variance estimate can be recovered from a published
average alone.


40.7.3     Component correctness must compose through conditional events

Suppose a request passes five stages: correct formulation E1 , observation construction E2 ,
identification E3 , numerical execution E4 and reporting E5 . By the chain rule,
                                                                             
                                   5
                                   \                    5
                                                        Y               \

This identity does not require independent stages. It does require that each factor refer to the
same workflow and condition on all relevant preceding successes. Marginal accuracies reported
in five unrelated papers are not those conditional probabilities. They may concern different
data, expert information and definitions of success. Multiplying them would manufacture an
end-to-end claim from incompatible experiments.
    For an exact planning example, conditional probabilities (.96, .95, .90, .97, .98) yield .78025248.
If these numbers are instead only marginal success probabilities in a common request population,
the joint success is bounded by
                                                                 

giving .76 to .90. The lower bound follows from the union bound for failures; the upper
follows because joint success implies every individual success. Two authored populations of
100 requests attain the endpoints. In one, failure sets of sizes 4, 5, 10, 3 and 2 are disjoint,
leaving 76 complete successes. In the other the failure sets are nested inside the ten largest
failures, leaving 90. Both have exactly the same stage marginals Causal banking proposal
project (2026i).
   For the proposal, this means stage tests diagnose where to improve, while a separate
composition test measures the completed request. A syntactically valid graph can propagate a
wrong population through every later stage. A correct estimator may precisely calculate the
wrong target. Conversely, several stages can fail on the same small subset, so adding their
failure counts overstates the number of affected requests. Record per-request transitions and
preserve the joint history needed to distinguish these cases.
