   In the inspected fixest path, model extraction explicitly requests iid covariance. A warning
in the corresponding adjustment path identifies this restriction. Consequently, accepting a
clustered model object does not justify claiming that the original clustered uncertainty survives
the sensitivity calculation. The numeric helper’s degrees-of-freedom guard admits zero and
one, while its adjusted-variance expression contains ν − 1 in the denominator. The partial-R2
validator admits the endpoint a = 1, while the bias expression contains 1 − a. These are
static domain observations. The proposed regular profile requires finite inputs, s > 0, ν > 1,
0 ≤ a < 1 and 0 ≤ b < 1; degenerate boundaries receive an explicit separate disposition
instead of being presented as a finite scientific result. No native failure is inferred from source
inspection alone. (Carlos Cinelli and sensemakr contributors, 2026)
   Two further details belong in the qualification protocol. The direct adjusted_ci.numeric
helper uses ν − 1 in its critical-value calculation; the inspected numeric wrapper constructs
intervals with ν. Their uncertainty outputs cannot be promised identical without resolving
the intended convention. The wrapper also passes an estimate to an adjusted-SE helper that
accepts an ellipsis. That extra argument is accepted by the signature; it is not evidence of an
unused-argument error. Observed-covariate benchmarking introduces additional assumptions
through separate treatment and outcome multipliers. Its implementation rejects impossible
treatment bounds and warns before capping an implied outcome bound above one. The adapter
must retain those warnings, raw restrictions and benchmark choices, rather than turning a
benchmark label into evidence that the omitted variable exists or is no stronger than the
chosen observed variable. (Carlos Cinelli and sensemakr contributors, 2026)


50.22.2     Risk-ratio sensitivity requires an explicit effect scale

For the null target and a strictly positive observed risk ratio r, orient its magnitude as
q = max(r, 1/r). The selected threshold calculation reduces to
                                                q
                                       E=q+       q(q − 1).

The package describes this as confounding strength required to shift the observed association
to the specified target. It is not an estimated confounder strength, a corrected treatment effect
or a probability that the causal claim is true. The interface also permits a non-null target,
which must remain an explicit field rather than silently inheriting the null formula. It reports
the relevant near-target confidence limit separately; a supplied interval crossing the target
receives threshold one. That result does not establish that the effect is zero, and the original
interval’s sampling justification remains the caller’s responsibility. (Maya Mathur and EValue
contributors, 2026)
   The reciprocal ratios 9/5 and 5/9 both give threshold 3, while the null ratio 1 gives threshold
1. These exact arithmetic symmetries are useful conversion oracles. They do not test finite-
sample interval coverage. The source rejects negative point ratios and inconsistent interval
ordering, but its zero-inclusive checks and reciprocal operations leave singular boundary
50.23. Goal clarification before causal analysis and tool dispatch                               1339


behavior for native qualification. The proposed worker instead declares a strictly positive
finite ratio and target, compatible bounds, event coding, population and horizon; an infinite or
missing result is not renamed strong causal evidence. (Maya Mathur and EValue contributors,
2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026ci)
  The broader package offers different conversions for odds ratios, hazard ratios, standardized
mean differences and linear-regression coefficients. For example, its nonrare-outcome odds-ratio
conversion uses a square root. This is an approximation, not a universal algebraic identity.
For odds ratio OR = 81/25, that conversion is 9/5. Under a stipulated baseline risk p0 = 1/5,
the exact risk-ratio identity for those two risks is instead
                                               OR          405
                                   RR =                  =     ,
                                          1 − p0 + p0 OR   181
which differs from 9/5. A banking interface that discards event prevalence or the rare-outcome
flag would conceal this distinction. The OLS route needs an exposure contrast and a standard
deviation; its documentation also states that interval conversion treats the supplied standard
deviation as known. The conversion history and its additional assumptions must accompany
the returned sensitivity number. (Maya Mathur and EValue contributors, 2026; Causal banking
proposal project, 2026ci)


50.22.3     Reference decisions and the bounded prototype route

Retain both packages as method-specific proposal references. A future isolated R worker is a
conditional route for a declared regression-sensitivity or risk-ratio profile, after complete artifact
and dependency custody, applicable rights review and native conformance. Direct adoption of
every package family would overextend this inspection. A new Python, Java or C++ port
is not justified without a measured platform or maintenance advantage sufficient to cover
dispatch, numerical, uncertainty and upgrade obligations. Independent arithmetic remains a
matched oracle, not a substitute calibrated inference service. Neither package replaces graph
identification, trend sensitivity, selection-bias analysis or a different confounding model merely
because all are called sensitivity analysis. (Carlos Cinelli and sensemakr contributors, 2026;
Maya Mathur and EValue contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026ci)
   The scientific owner must specify the causal question, adjustment clock, sampling law and
plausibility of sensitivity restrictions. The maintainer must preserve model and row identity,
covariance type, full conversion history, warnings and failures; compare direct helpers with
numeric and model dispatch; and register singular-input and incompatible-interval cases. The
operator must bind an actual delivery, dependencies and resource budget. Qualification then
compares the selected outputs with independent references on public or generated data before
expensive bank experiments. Changes in source, target, covariance law or delivery trigger
re-review. The two reference decisions settle the proposal’s present reuse choice while granting
no native integration capability or general sensitivity guarantee.


50.23       Goal clarification before causal analysis and tool dispatch
A request to improve a distressed-loan portfolio does not yet specify whether the decision
is to change contact frequency, offer a payment holiday, alter collections or merely explain
observed arrears. Dispatching a scientifically valid estimator for the wrong intervention still
answers the wrong business question. GIST-CMTF addresses a related upstream problem:
inferring a symbolic goal before filtering the tools exposed to a language-model agent. Its
June 2026 original develops candidate goals, ambiguity detection and clarification within a
1340                                                             Causal analysis for a universal bank


common precondition–effect vocabulary. The authentic ten-page original and a cutoff-selected
repository revision are useful design evidence, but their workflow use of causal does not by
itself identify a treatment effect or supply a structural causal model for borrowers. (Rahul
Suresh Babu and Rohit Shukla, 2026a,b)


50.23.1     What the state-transition model supplies

Represent a tool by ti = (di , Ri , Ei , ci , ρi ): a description, required state predicates, produced
predicates, optional cost and optional risk label. A state s and goal g are sets of predicates.
A symbolic tool is executable when Ri ⊆ s, and its declared transition adds Ei to the state.
The goal-inference layer maps the user’s request and state to candidate goals and confidence
scores; the paper describes confidence and margin rules that can request clarification instead
of committing to one goal. Clarification is itself represented as a transition, for example from
an ambiguous request to a specified goal. This supplies a concrete place to represent missing
business variables in a CLI or MCP request. (Rahul Suresh Babu and Rohit Shukla, 2026a)
   The proposed banking extension should require an intervention, comparator, population,
outcome, horizon, information clock and decision owner before constructing an effect query.
A lender’s goal predicate such as servicing option selected does not establish exchangeability,
support or a defensible adjustment set. Those are separate scientific obligations. Likewise, a
workflow edge saying a tool produces a graph does not establish that the graph is causally
correct. The useful inheritance is an explicit contract for ambiguity and clarification, with
scientific identification review following goal selection. (Rahul Suresh Babu and Rohit Shukla,
2026a,b)
   The inspected runner implements breadth-first search over monotone symbolic states and
returns the first tool on a shortest path, with ties determined by tool order. Optional cost
and risk labels in the conceptual representation are not thereby optimized. The semantic-goal
comparator uses lexical overlap with candidate descriptions. The model inference prompt
requests one selected goal and its confidence, while the actual clarification rule combines that
output with a fixed confidence threshold, vague-word detection and the benchmark’s annotated
request type. Thus the released implementation is a specific hybrid rule, not an evaluation of
an arbitrary calibrated goal posterior or the complete candidate-margin formulation. (Rahul
Suresh Babu and Rohit Shukla, 2026b)


50.23.2     Reported results and reproducible aggregation

The paper evaluates 120 constructed tasks: 40 explicit goals, 40 ambiguous goals, 30 missing-
variable requests and 10 clarification-required requests. Six methods and seven backends
produce 5,040 saved rows, with deterministic mocked tool effects. Independent data-only
checks confirm 5,040 unique model–method–task keys, 32 tools, positive saved token totals
and the published aggregate tables. GIST-CMTF succeeds in 815 of 840 rows, compared with
673 for top-goal CMTF and 696 for the semantic-goal comparator. Its 21 wrong-goal outcomes
contrast with 163 under top-goal CMTF. These are reaggregations of the released final dataset,
not independently repeated model calls or evidence of general superiority on banking requests.
(Rahul Suresh Babu and Rohit Shukla, 2026a,b; Causal banking proposal project, 2026bt)
   The disaggregated results matter. On explicit-goal tasks the paper reports 94.6% success for
GIST-CMTF versus 98.9% for the semantic-goal comparator, with unnecessary clarification on
16.8% of explicit requests. Its reported advantage is concentrated in ambiguous requests. The
final saved dataset retains 170 labeled errors: 128 precondition failures, 24 tool-parse errors,
14 empty responses, three goal-parse errors and one invalid selection. The authors state that
50.23. Goal clarification before causal analysis and tool dispatch                            1341


infrastructure-corrupted rows were cleaned before the final analysis. The final positive-token
file cannot establish the complete attempt, retry or provider-failure denominator without those
original logs and cleaning records. The paper explicitly leaves latency, monetary cost, user
satisfaction and real multi-turn clarification unmeasured. (Rahul Suresh Babu and Rohit
Shukla, 2026a,b; Causal banking proposal project, 2026bt)

50.23.3     A source-to-result reproducibility gap

The repository revision dated 30 June 2026 is later than the 15 June paper but before the
literature cutoff. Its identity is therefore distinct from proof that it generated the published
results. Eleven authenticated artifacts include the runner, task generator, registry, task file,
final metrics, summary tables, citation metadata, dependency declaration and MIT notice.
The requirements are unpinned, and no raw provider trace appears in the inspected complete
tree. The paper’s documented replacement of a Nova preview backend with Nova Pro is visible
in the saved rows, while the runner’s default list still names the preview profile. An explicit
override could explain the model list; it must be retained in a reproducible execution record.
(Rahul Suresh Babu and Rohit Shukla, 2026b)
   Three further discrepancies prevent direct replay claims. First, the runner forces clarification
for each nonexplicit request type and then assigns the annotated intended goal. Yet 53 of
560 nonexplicit GIST rows in the saved data report zero clarification. Second, the runner
reads a gold_path field to count wrong tools. None of the 120 task objects has that field; all
instead provide gold_chains. With those unmodified inputs, that branch has no expected
next tool against which to increment its count, whereas the saved file contains 3,520 wrong-tool
counts. Third, the runner’s written CSV columns differ from the released metrics columns.
An unreleased producer, transformation or earlier revision could reconcile these artifacts; the
available bytes do not establish which. This is an explicit provenance gap, not an allegation
that the reported observations were fabricated. (Rahul Suresh Babu and Rohit Shukla, 2026b;
Causal banking proposal project, 2026bt)
   Benchmark-assisted clarification also limits transport to real users. The runner consults
annotated request type and resolves a clarification by substituting the intended goal, without
observing a possibly ambiguous user answer. The all-tools and state-aware comparators receive
the intended goal as prompt context. A production assessment must separately test learned
ambiguity detection, actual user responses and the absence of such labels at inference time.
Open-world goals, imperfect state predicates and failed or nondeterministic tools remain explicit
limitations in the original paper. These limitations preserve the value of the design hypothesis
while preventing a claim that workflow goal validation solves general causal reasoning. (Rahul
Suresh Babu and Rohit Shukla, 2026a,b)

50.23.4     A public-evidence qualification route

Retain GIST-CMTF as a goal-contract and evaluation reference. Before proposing direct
integration, reconcile the exact generating revision, task schema, metric definitions, model
overrides and cleaning log. A project-owned prototype can then compare a label-free goal
classifier, a clarification policy, a simple lexical baseline and an explicitly named oracle
on held-out public or generated business requests. Freeze the scenario definitions before
outcome inspection; retain wrong goals, unsupported causal questions, nonresponses, retries
and abstentions in the full denominator. Actual clarification responses and their costs must
be represented, rather than silently replacing them with the correct goal. This protocol is
prospective; no model is invoked or downloaded code executed for this source review. (Rahul
Suresh Babu and Rohit Shukla, 2026a,b)
1342                                                          Causal analysis for a universal bank


   An illustrative cost equation makes the missing economics concrete. Let ∆p be a descriptive
difference in success frequency, ∆T the additional tokens and ∆C the additional clarifications
per task. For stipulated success value v, token price cT and clarification cost cC , define
∆N = v∆p − cT ∆T − cC ∆C. The saved GIST versus top-goal averages give ∆p = 71/420,
∆T = 45979/420 and ∆C = 23/70. With v = 10 dollars and cT = 1/1000 dollar, clarification
cost USD 2 gives ∆N = 388021/420000 dollars, whereas cost USD 6 gives −163979/420000
dollars. These exact stipulated amounts illustrate a decision threshold; they do not estimate
bank ROI or causal performance gains. (Causal banking proposal project, 2026bt)
   The scientific owner remains responsible for translating a clarified business objective into
a causal estimand and diagram. The maintainer owns schema compatibility, raw traces and
versioned provenance; the operator owns the actual endpoint, authentication and measured
resource costs. A verified workflow predicate should record what evidence established it. It
must not transform a language model’s declaration that a goal or graph is correct into an
accepted scientific premise. The route is sufficiently concrete to justify a bounded prototype
proposal, while native capability, independent acceptance and broader frontier coverage remain
open.


50.24      Natural-effect models need an expansion and uncertainty
           contract
In a servicing proposal, a repayment holiday may change both immediate cash availability and
later contact engagement. An analyst may want to separate those pathways. The medflex
package offers natural-effect models using either predictions from an outcome working model
or ratio-of-mediator probability weights. Its inspected 0.6-11 sources provide a concrete
R implementation reference. The proposed boundary must retain the exposure, mediator,
baseline covariates, original subject identity and nested-outcome scale. Expanding a dataset
creates computational rows; it supplies neither new independent customers nor the scientific
assumptions needed to interpret a mediation contrast. (Johan Steen and medflex contributors,
2026)


50.24.1     A decomposition whose components depend on their definition

Write M (x) for a mediator under exposure x and Y (x, m) for an outcome under jointly
specified exposure and mediator. Define µ(x, a) = E{Y (x, M (a))}. A pure direct contrast is
µ(1, 0)−µ(0, 0), and its complementary total indirect contrast is µ(1, 1)−µ(1, 0). Another valid
algebraic decomposition uses µ(0, 1)−µ(0, 0) and µ(1, 1)−µ(0, 1). Both sum to µ(1, 1)−µ(0, 0),
but their individual terms need not coincide. These definitions are project notation; interpreting
them through observed data requires separate justification for the nested counterfactual law.
    For an explicit constructed example, let M (x) be binary with probabilities p0 = 1/5 and
p1 = 3/5, and stipulate Y (x, m) = 10 + 2x + 5m + 4xm. Direct enumeration gives µ(0, 0) = 11,
µ(1, 0) = 69/5, µ(0, 1) = 13 and µ(1, 1) = 87/5. The first decomposition is 14/5 + 18/5; the
second is 2 + 22/5. Their common total is 32/5. With stipulated value USD 10 per outcome
unit and total-policy cost USD 50, the total net is USD 14. Substituting the pure direct
component gives USD −22 and answers a different question. A natural-effect component is
not automatically a feasible intervention with the same implementation cost. The example
illustrates target discipline, not measured bank economics or an identification theorem. (Causal
banking proposal project, 2026bv)
50.24. Natural-effect models need an expansion and uncertainty contract                       1343


50.24.2     What the inspected expansion actually preserves

The imputation interface expects exposure and mediator variables in a prespecified formula
order; its second predictor is the first mediator. The weighting interface similarly interprets the
first predictor as the exposure. A wrapper must inspect the resulting variable-type pointers,
factor levels and contrasts instead of relying on a reordered display formula. The expansion
implementation creates an identifier from original row names and joins hypothetical exposure
values to that identifier. Categorical exposures expand over their factor levels. Continuous
exposures use a specified replication count and either sampled values or conditional normal
quantiles, by default between the fifth and ninety-fifth percentiles. Those finite nodes do not
cover an unbounded distribution’s entire support. (Johan Steen and medflex contributors,
2026)
   The two paths are semantically distinct. Imputation predicts nested outcomes and assigns the
impData class. Weighting forms mediator probability or density ratios and assigns weightData.
The inspected expData help text reverses those class descriptions and describes row count
using length(data). The constructor paths and explicit subject-count checks should govern a
prospective adapter; the textual discrepancies do not establish an observed numerical failure.
The weighting path restricts the joint mediator request to one mediator with a warning, while
imputation has a distinct multiple-mediator path. One generic method label must not erase
that difference. (Johan Steen and medflex contributors, 2026)
   An exact probability example makes the denominator contract visible. If the binary mediator
probabilities are 1/5 and 3/5, the event ratio is 3 and the nonevent ratio is 1/2. Reversing the
ratio changes the weighting target. At zero denominator probability the ratio is undefined; a
production profile must specify overlap diagnostics and refusal rather than silently changing
the estimand through clipping. Optional exposure weights introduce another denominator
and another model. The inspected helper verifies exposure and covariate pointers, and
suppresses warnings around its final GLM call. Consequently, proposed validation must inspect
convergence, finite outputs, weights and model objects; the absence of a displayed warning is
insufficient. (Johan Steen and medflex contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project,
2026bv)


50.24.3     Full refitting and original-subject covariance

The default natural-effect fit requests 1,000 bootstrap replicates. Its bootstrap callback
resamples original data indices, refits the working model, maps each original index to its
expanded rows, refreshes the expansion’s predictions or weights, refits an optional exposure
model and refits the natural-effect model. This source path supports a full-refitting design; it
does not authorize freezing all first-stage fitted values in a wrapper. Its index arithmetic also
makes original ordering and constant replication count a contract to verify, especially after
missing-value handling, slicing or serialization. The helper recovers data by evaluating the
stored model call in the global environment, so a portable job needs explicit data custody and
reconstructed call bindings. (Johan Steen and medflex contributors, 2026)
   The robust branch accepts only GLM working models and restricts selected weighting/ex-
posure families to Gaussian, binomial or Poisson. It aggregates the expanded natural-effect
scores by original identifier, combines them with nuisance scores and includes off-diagonal
derivative blocks in the sandwich calculation. This is not the covariance from treating every
expanded row as an independent borrower. It also does not, by itself, justify arbitrary branch,
household or calendar dependence beyond the original-subject unit. The original mediator is
excluded from the final natural-effect formula; an imputation model that does not reflect the
final model structure generates an explicit warning. (Johan Steen and medflex contributors,
1344                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


2026)
  Two independent score examples show why these distinctions matter. Original subject scores
(−1, 1) give the empirical mean-score variance i s2i /n2 = 1/2. Duplicating each subject

50.24.4     Reference decision and a bounded integration route

Retain the inspected package as a reference for natural-effect semantics, subject expansion and
full uncertainty propagation. An isolated R worker is a plausible future prototype route once
the complete artifact, environment, dependency notices and actual delivery rights are bound.
The GPL-2 declaration and a separately identified local license text do not clear transitive
rights. Direct adoption of every supported learner and mediator family is premature; a port
to Python, Java or C++ would also inherit dispatch, formula, missingness, bootstrap and
covariance maintenance obligations without a measured advantage. (Johan Steen and medflex
contributors, 2026)
   The initial qualification matrix should use binary exposure and one mediator, compare
weighting and imputation on an independently specified law, preserve the nested target and
link scale, and test subject permutation, duplicated rows, missingness and fresh-process data
binding. Compare bootstrap refitting against the robust branch only within their shared model
restrictions, retain seed and backend choices, and reject unsupported or nonfinite results with
complete diagnostics. More general mediation identification, clustered or longitudinal sampling
and empirical utility require separate evidence. This reference decision approves no native
adapter and establishes no implemented banking capability.


50.25      Controlled model writes preserve a conditional proof
           boundary
A credit agent may correctly execute a rule after incorrectly reading its premise. For example,
an admitted statement that an account is in arrears may trigger a valid collection rule even when
the underlying record does not support that statement. CPUNeSy addresses the admission
boundary between language-model proposals and a symbolic executor. Its inspected September
2026 arXiv original separates source checking, restricted predicate writes, derivation verification
and selective serving. The paper’s running header claims a 2027 conference publication; that
self-description is not independently verified acceptance as of the literature cutoff. The evidence
here is the versioned original and its explicit assumptions and reported observations. (Zeyan
Li and Siyuan Qiu and Shuai Zhao and Jianfeng Xu, 2026)


50.25.1     What can be certified, and what remains a premise

Let St be admitted source units, Γt = At ∪ Rt the active facts and rules, and Cn(Γt ) their
closure in a declared decidable Horn fragment. The source mode of the proposed gate checks
type and source support before admitting a unit. Its derived mode requires a complete acyclic
witness rooted at the claimed conclusion, checks every edge and refuses a witness exceeding a
50.25. Controlled model writes preserve a conditional proof boundary                        1345


declared depth budget. Certificates retain dependencies and checker versions; a source erasure
requires eviction or revalidation of affected cached consequences. The paper’s state-soundness
result assumes a sound source checker and a sound fragment verifier. Its induction establishes
the stated invariant under those assumptions. It explicitly says that source soundness has not
been established for the experimental natural-language checkers. (Zeyan Li and Siyuan Qiu
and Shuai Zhao and Jianfeng Xu, 2026)
   A narrower invariant is available without statistical independence. If the allowed source
vocabulary Ω excludes every rule-head predicate, a direct write of an intermediate or target
predicate is rejected. It does not follow that every admitted leaf is true. In an independently
authored toy rule, arrears ⇒ deny, admit only arrears as a writable source predicate.
Directly writing deny is then impossible, but a false admitted arrears premise still derives
it. The proposed banking contract should therefore record both derivation status and source-
support status. Neither status establishes an intervention estimand, an adjustment set or the
truth of a borrower causal diagram. (Zeyan Li and Siyuan Qiu and Shuai Zhao and Jianfeng
Xu, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026bq)
   The voting argument likewise retains its sampling assumptions. It separates a shared-error
query mass β from a regime with independent slips. Conditional independence across traces is
required for its concentration bounds, including within the shared-error regime. Two agreeing
calls do not estimate β or establish those assumptions. A stipulated example with β = 1/5, a
common wrong answer on that mass and independent slip probability 1/10 elsewhere gives
two-vote wrong, correct and abstained probabilities 26/125, 81/125 and 18/125. Answered risk
is 26/107. Three-vote majority error is 139/625; arbitrarily many independent votes within
each regime still leave error floor 1/5. More calls can reduce random slips while preserving a
shared semantic mistake. (Zeyan Li and Siyuan Qiu and Shuai Zhao and Jianfeng Xu, 2026;
Causal banking proposal project, 2026bq)


50.25.2     Execution, checking and fallback are different comparisons

The reported L1-HARD ablation gives 98.8% full-pool accuracy for a one-vote uncertified solver
and 97.1% for the restricted two-vote policy. The paper reports no statistically significant
paired difference and correctly avoids claiming equivalence. Much of the improvement over
neural controls is attributed to deterministic execution, while certification changes the error–
abstention tradeoff. These observations do not isolate checking when the number of grounding
calls changes. A separate fixed-trace comparison on ContractNLI supplies the more relevant
check-versus-agreement evidence. (Zeyan Li and Siyuan Qiu and Shuai Zhao and Jianfeng Xu,
2026)
   For the reported DeepSeek pool of 2,091 items, agreement yields 1,533 correct, 252 wrong
and 306 abstained results. Source rechecking yields 1,482 correct, 189 wrong and 420 abstained.
It removes 63 wrong answers but also withholds 51 correct answers, adding 114 abstentions.
The corresponding answered risks are 12/85 and 63/557, while full-pool accuracy falls by
51/2091. These arithmetic checks reproduce printed counts; they do not rerun raw records
or demonstrate a population guarantee. The Seed pool has a different denominator, so the
two columns are not a paired model contest. (Zeyan Li and Siyuan Qiu and Shuai Zhao and
Jianfeng Xu, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026bq)
   Fallback is a further policy. The paper’s MedCalc native channel has high answered
accuracy but substantial abstention; routing withheld requests to an uncertified same-model
fallback increases full-pool accuracy. The fallback outputs must retain their uncertified status.
A CLI/MCP result should expose which channel served each answer, the full attempted
denominator, source checker identity and uncertainty about semantic support. A single success
1346                                                          Causal analysis for a universal bank


flag would hide the tradeoff that motivates the design. (Zeyan Li and Siyuan Qiu and Shuai
Zhao and Jianfeng Xu, 2026)
   There is also a material comparator qualification inside the original. The main public-
benchmark table includes Logic-LM, DetermLR, LINC, SymbCoT, LINA, HBLR and MenTaL
rows. The appendix repeats those rows as historical adapter summaries whose per-row split
identifiers, model profiles and exact denominators are unspecified, explicitly excluding them
from primary comparative claims. Thus the main table and its broad ranking prose cannot
support a matched superiority claim over those systems. Very low historical scores also lack a
breakdown of parsing, solver and executable-answer errors. The comparison here retains the
reported rows with this limit and draws no ranking from their apparently common columns.
(Zeyan Li and Siyuan Qiu and Shuai Zhao and Jianfeng Xu, 2026)


50.25.3    A prospective banking protocol and its cost boundary

The internal hypothesis protocol has no independently verified preregistration timestamp.
Complete per-query certificate archival was not instrumented in every adapter; model caches
lack consistent sampling dates and immutable revisions. The paper describes an offline audit
package, but the inspected PDF does not establish custody of that package in this project. Its
coverage bound is not empirically instantiated from step-level channel rates, and independence
remains unverified. Candidate-pool restriction and token savings must also be separated from
physical storage compression: reported bounded redundancy is 37.1% in the mathematical
corpus and 0.60% in the legal corpus, below the internal 50% target. Physical index-byte
savings and the scheduler-specific crossover remain unmeasured. (Zeyan Li and Siyuan Qiu
and Shuai Zhao and Jianfeng Xu, 2026)
   A bounded prototype can nevertheless test a concrete question. Freeze a public or generated
banking rule corpus with explicit leaf facts, source spans, admissible predicates and known
interventions before held-out queries. Compare an unrestricted translator plus solver, restricted
writes, fixed-trace source rechecking and a separately labeled fallback. Inject both prohibited
target writes and false but well-typed leaves. Test dependency deletion, changed-source cache
invalidation, missing evidence, contradictory records, abstention and full failure reporting.
Independent labels must judge source faithfulness separately from formal derivability. This is
a prospective proposal, not an implemented source checker or live-model trial. (Zeyan Li and
Siyuan Qiu and Shuai Zhao and Jianfeng Xu, 2026)
   For a transparent economic decision, let cW price a wrong served answer, cA an abstention
and C the additional total checking cost. Using the printed DeepSeek changes, loss savings
are 63cW − 114cA − C. Stipulating cW = 10 dollars and C = 100 dollars gives USD 302 at
cA = 2 and USD −154 at cA = 6. The change of sign illustrates why accepted-answer precision
alone is not an investment criterion. The costs are invented inputs for the displayed example,
explicitly editable in the independent reference; no bank value or causal performance gain is
estimated. (Causal banking proposal project, 2026bq)


50.26      Policy evaluation software must preserve the decision
           and its uncertainty
A servicing team may use an offline policy evaluation library to compare a sequence of
reminders, forbearance offers and escalations. The useful output is the value of a specified
feasible policy under an information clock, together with defensible uncertainty. A function
returning a ranking is only one part of that task. SCOPE-RL provides a particularly useful
50.26. Policy evaluation software must preserve the decision and its uncertainty                       1347


proposal comparator because its selected discrete estimators, interval helpers and policy-
selection paths make several boundaries explicit. This review concerns version 0.2.1 at the
immutable 1 December 2023 revision returned by the cutoff query. Eleven authenticated source
and declaration files support the following observations; the continuous-action, distributional
and density-learning families have not received equivalent inspection. No upstream program
was executed. Haruka Kiyohara and SCOPE-RL contributors (2023)

the action, At the action, and Rt the subsequent monetary reward. Write bt (a | Ht ) for the
actual logging probability and πt (a | Ht ) for the policy being evaluated. For a declared initial
population and discount 0 < γ ≤ 1, the proposed target is

50.26.2     Terminal rewards and uncertainty cannot be inferred from names

The high-level evaluator defaults to disabling rewards after a done flag. The actual mask is the
cumulative product of 1 − dt , including the current row. If a dataset defines dt as indicating
that the transition just produced the terminal reward, this removes that terminal reward as
well. A different pre-transition convention could justify the mask; the adapter must state
and test the convention. With undiscounted rewards (2, 8) and flags (0, 1), the literal mask
leaves value 2, whereas retaining the terminal receipt gives 10. At a stipulated servicing cost
of six dollars, the margins are −4 and 4. These are authored examples, not measured bank
returns or observed package outputs. The dataset documentation separately describes episode
end and maximum-step termination, while the fitted-Q dataset call passes the done array
as its terminal argument. A conversion must resolve both meanings. Haruka Kiyohara and
SCOPE-RL contributors (2023); Causal banking proposal project (2026ch)
   The basic estimator’s interval method first calculates one score per trajectory and delegates

50.26.3     A selection benchmark is not an offline safety certificate

The inspected lower-bound selector obtains on-policy selection results before ranking candidate
interval endpoints, even when the requested output omits evaluation metrics. The called
routine rejects a missing on-policy return array. This is a concrete benchmark-data requirement:
a logged-only banking request generally cannot furnish those counterfactual returns. Missing
truth must lead to a refusal or a separately designed selection path, never fabricated on-
policy values. The selected call forwards the same alpha to each candidate and estimator; no
multiplicity adjustment appears in this path. Even twenty independent tests with individual
false-admission probability 0.05 have probability 1 − 0.9520 , approximately 0.642, of at least
one false admission. That hypothetical example is not a measured SCOPE-RL error rate. A

design.Haruka Kiyohara and SCOPE-RL contributors (2023); Causal banking proposal project

   The ground-truth lower-quartile output also needs a name/value fixture. The source sorts

50.27       Contextual bandit reuse requires a different contract
            from sequential servicing
A one-time offer allocation and a sequence of collection decisions are different causal products.
Open Bandit Pipeline (OBP) is a useful comparator for the former: the inspected core orga-
nizes logged contextual-bandit observations, target action distributions, propensity-weighted
estimators, response regressions and evaluation wrappers. It does not convert repeated cus-
tomer histories into a qualified longitudinal policy analysis merely because each history can be
flattened into rows. The selected revision is dated 5 November 2022, declares version 0.5.5 and
is the revision returned by the cutoff query. Eleven authentic source/declaration files support
this profile; slate, continuous-action, multiple-logger and action-embedding estimators need
separate review. Yuta Saito and Open Bandit Pipeline contributors (2022)

   Consider two equally common customer types. For type zero, the logging probability of
offer one is 1/4 and rewards under offers zero and one are (0, 2). For type one, the logging

7/2, and exact weighting recovers that value. Clipping the importance ratio at two gives 3;
substituting a uniform logging probability gives 17/4. At ten dollars per reward unit and
a stipulated offer cost of 32 dollars, the respective margins are 3, −2 and 10.50. An exact

guarantee or an observed package benchmark.Causal banking proposal project (2026by)

target probability equals exactly one and normalizes by the sample match rate. Under unequal
contextual logging, the matched contexts have different frequencies from the target population.

randomization or another justified replay design is therefore substantive. For a fully stochastic
target with both action probabilities 1/2, no exact-one match exists; the selected source leaves
an all-zero score vector when there are no matches. A product must expose unavailable replay
evidence rather than reporting a zero policy value as a scientific result. Yuta Saito and Open

50.27.2     A validated array is not a validated causal request

The core expects target probabilities with dimensions round, action and position. The inspected
validator checks the action-axis sum and position/action indices, and rejects nonpositive
supplied propensity values. Its array helper checks array type and dimension, not general
finiteness. The target-distribution check does not separately impose nonnegative entries: the
row (−1/10, 11/10) sums to one but is not a probability law. A nonfinite propensity also needs
an explicit finite-value check; a comparison with zero is not a complete validator. These are
scoped source findings. The proposed adapter must independently verify common row identities,
action/position vocabulary, finite values, valid probabilities and their scientific provenance.
Yuta Saito and Open Bandit Pipeline contributors (2022); Causal banking proposal project
(2026by)
   The regression wrapper defaults to one fold, fitting and predicting on the same contexts.
Its multi-fold branch uses shuffled row K-fold splits. Such splits do not preserve customer
groups or forward calendar separation by construction. Missing propensities are replaced
with a uniform distribution inside this regression-preparation path. That fallback does not
authenticate a bank logging policy, especially for importance-weighted or MRDR fitting. The
adapter must bind whether the quantities are true logs, estimates or explicit design inputs,
and justify both the fitting loss and the evaluation law. An out-of-fold prediction flag alone is
not an uncertainty theorem. Yuta Saito and Open Bandit Pipeline contributors (2022)
  Basic estimator intervals first calculate round-level scores and then bootstrap those fixed

scores. The common helper takes percentile endpoints and reports the mean of bootstrap

   One apparent defect illustrates why complete argument tracing matters. The tuned interval

50.28      A hidden-state planner consumes a model; it does not
           identify one
Servicing decisions may depend on financial distress that is only partially observed through

Let St be the latent state, At the chosen action, Ot+1 the subsequent observation and bt (s)

laws T (s′ | s, a) and L(o | s′ , a), Bayes’ rule gives

The denominator is the probability of the new observation under the supplied model. It
must be positive for this conditional update. A service cannot replace a zero denominator
with an arbitrary posterior and claim the same information experiment. Model estimation,
hidden-state identification, distributional uncertainty and approximation error are separate
from this conditional algebra.
   An exact banking example shows what is at stake. Suppose distress has prior probability
1/4. A diagnostic signal is positive with probability 3/4 under distress and 1/4 otherwise. The
positive-signal probability is 3/8, and posterior distress probabilities are 1/2 after a positive
signal and 1/10 after a negative one. A rescue action pays a net 35 dollars in distress and loses
15 otherwise; declining has value zero. Acting without information has value −5/2. Under the
supplied sensor, acting only after a positive signal gives expected value 15/4 before a two-dollar
diagnostic cost, hence net 7/4. If the actual signal instead has probability 1/2 in either state,
1354                                                         Causal analysis for a universal bank


the same proposed rule has net −13/4. A more accurate search of the wrong sensor model
cannot repair this gap. All values are stipulated, exactly enumerated project examples rather
than measured bank or package results. Causal banking proposal project (2026cc)
   The histogram update follows the displayed transition-observation product and allows a
static-transition shortcut or a supplied next-state set. It normalizes only when total mass
is positive; an impossible observation therefore leaves an all-zero histogram. The histogram
constructor checks for a dictionary, not a positive normalized probability law. Restricting the
next-state set also changes what is normalized: if the predicted masses are 1/5 on distress and
4/5 on healthy but only healthy is enumerated, the returned normalized belief places mass
one on healthy. Such restriction is valid only if the discarded mass is truly impossible or the
changed conditioning target is intended. The adapter must report unsupported observations
and omitted support explicitly. Kaiyu Zheng and POMDP-Py contributors (2025); Causal
banking proposal project (2026cc)
   Particle updating has different failure semantics. The explicit updater samples a transition
and observation from each current particle, retains exact observation matches, and reinvigo-
rates the survivors. An empty set raises particle deprivation; otherwise resampling and an
optional state transform restore the requested count. Repeating survivors does not create
new independent evidence, and a transform changes the approximation law unless justified.
Exact observation equality also needs a declared discrete or otherwise appropriate observation
representation. The source marks the explicit updater as untested. POMCP performs a related
tree-based update and raises deprivation when an anticipated observation child is absent.
History, tree and belief updates must be coordinated, with no double update or invented
recovery posterior.Kaiyu Zheng and POMDP-Py contributors (2025)
   The weighted representation needs its own identity fixture. Its probability query averages
weights among repeated equal values before normalization, whereas its sampling method
weights every entry. For entries (D, 1), (D, 1), (H, 1), the query gives probability 1/2 to D,
while entry-weighted sampling gives 2/3. This is a documented average-weight convention in
one path and a different sampling construction in the other; an adapter must not silently treat
them as a single empirical measure. Ordinary unweighted Particles overrides the histogram
and sampling methods and gives frequency 2/3 in this example. The defect must therefore not
be attributed indiscriminately to all particle classes.Kaiyu Zheng and POMDP-Py contributors
(2025); Causal banking proposal project (2026cc)


50.28.2    Planning budgets and reward clocks need native qualification

POUCT samples belief states, explores action-observation branches, and returns the action
with the highest current tree value. A positive simulation count takes precedence over the time
budget in the inspected stopping rule; when both defaults are negative, a one-second planning
duration is selected. Elapsed-time and completed-simulation fields are useful observations, not
accuracy certificates. The stop test runs between simulations. It cannot interrupt a single
nonterminating model or rollout call. The adapter therefore needs an independently enforced
execution deadline and a durable refusal result. Random sources, model delegates, action
ordering, initial values and planning history must be recorded for replay.Kaiyu Zheng and
POMDP-Py contributors (2025)
  A concrete progress edge appears with options that consume no primitive steps. The model
sampler returns duration zero when an option is not initiable. The tree simulation branch
explicitly handles zero duration, but the selected rollout loop only adds duration to depth and
repeats while depth is below its limit. Repeatedly selecting such an option can leave depth
unchanged forever. This is a static control-flow witness, not an executed hang. Similarly,
50.28. A hidden-state planner consumes a model; it does not identify one                     1355


the tree recursion stops at depth greater than the limit while rollout uses depth strictly less
than the limit. Horizon-zero, horizon-one, terminal and option fixtures must establish the
actual reward count rather than infer it from a parameter name.Kaiyu Zheng and POMDP-Py
contributors (2025); Causal banking proposal project (2026cc)
   Option rewards introduce a second clock. The general sampler accepts an internal discount
argument defaulting to one; the selected POUCT calls omit that argument, then discount
the continuation by γ duration . For a two-step option with rewards two and eight dollars,
continuation value twenty and γ = 1/2, the resulting expression is 2 + 8 + (1/2)2 20 = 15.
Applying the primitive-step discount throughout gives 2 + (1/2)8 + (1/2)2 20 = 11. Either a
macro-action reward convention or a primitive-step convention can be declared, but they are
different targets. The adapter must bind the chosen convention and test model delegates, rather
than silently adjusting rewards after planning. Kaiyu Zheng and POMDP-Py contributors
(2025); Causal banking proposal project (2026cc)
  The source black-box interface documents a three-component sample, while the general
sampler’s contract and selected planner unpack four components, including duration. That
boundary needs an explicit adapter and conformance test. The reward model permits stochastic
sampling; a call to its sample method is not automatically the expected reward needed by an
exact dynamic program. The small-state value routine explicitly describes deterministic rewards,
and its qualification must preserve that restriction or supply justified reward expectations.Kaiyu
Zheng and POMDP-Py contributors (2025)

50.29      A Julia planning interface must preserve a single decision

A bank considering Julia for sequential servicing needs to decide which part of a planning
system it is buying into. POMDPs.jl supplies a common vocabulary for a model, solver, policy,
belief updater and simulator. These interfaces are valuable because the same declared problem
can be presented to different algorithms, but the interface itself neither identifies that problem
from observations nor proves the returned policy optimal. The root package at the selected

other packages in the organization can have different licenses. POMDPTools and individual
solvers therefore need their own source, rights and numerical reviews; the organizational name
cannot stand in for a concrete adoption decision. (JuliaPOMDP contributors, 2026)
  The model contracts distinguish a state space, an action space, a transition distribution, an
observation distribution, reward and discount. Let St be the account state before decision At ,
St+1 the resulting state, Ot+1 the information released after that decision and Rt its reward.

50.29.1     Joint generation is an event, not three independent API calls

POMDPs.jl permits explicit distributions as well as a joint generator returning a named tuple
with next state, observation and reward. The documented caller uses the @gen interface. Its
inspected implementation invokes the joint generator once for that invocation, takes supplied
fields and fills missing fields using transition, observation and reward methods in dependency
order. A POMDP observation can depend on both the old and new state, and the reward
fallback can depend on the observation as well. An adapter that calls the generator separately
for each output can change the joint experiment even if every output retains the correct
marginal distribution. (JuliaPOMDP contributors, 2026)
50.29. A Julia planning interface must preserve a single decision experiment                  1357


   Consider a stipulated one-step distress event U ∼ Bernoulli(1/4). Set St+1 = U , release
alert Ot+1 = U , and return reward −40 in distress or 8 otherwise. A coherent event has
expected reward −4, always agrees between state and alert, and has probability 1/4 of an
alert accompanying a loss. If a wrapper independently regenerates the state, alert and reward,
the marginals survive, but state and alert agree with probability only 5/8 and alert with loss
occurs with probability 1/16. The difference is material to a policy: a subsequent rescue
worth 35 in distress and −15 otherwise, taken only on an alert, has expected incremental
value 35/4 under the coherent law and −5/8 under the split law. These are exact authored
counterexamples to a conversion strategy, not observed failures of the Julia package. (Causal
banking proposal project, 2026cd)
   The proposed boundary therefore transports one event identifier and one joint transition
result, with model revision, state/action identifiers, observation release time and reward
units. A random seed alone does not define equivalence across wrappers: the requested
fields and invocation order also determine how a joint generator consumes its random stream.
Reproducibility requires the concrete random-number implementation, serialized state or seed
protocol, call schedule and worker environment. The source exposes an explicit random-number
argument and a default when omitted; it does not provide the bank’s complete replay protocol.
(JuliaPOMDP contributors, 2026)


50.29.2     Observation, reward and termination need compatible signatures

An observation method depending only on action and next state automatically supports the
fuller old-state signature through fallback. The reverse need not hold. Suppose two accounts
both reach state zero after the same action, but an alert reports whether the previous state
was one. Then the two histories require alert probabilities zero and one, although action and
next state are identical. A solver requesting only those latter arguments cannot represent
both laws. The documentation explicitly acknowledges that some solvers require the narrower
signature. The repair is to select a compatible solver, augment the modeled state with a
justified sufficient history, or refuse the conversion; silently dropping the old state changes the
model. (JuliaPOMDP contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026cd)
  Reward conversion has a similar obligation. A solver asking for r̄(s, a) needs the appropriate
conditional expectation of a transition reward, including the observation when relevant:
                                              T (s′ | s, a)Z(o | s, a, s′ )r(s, a, s′ , o)
                                      X
                         r̄(s, a) =
                                      s′ ,o

in a finite explicit model. A joint generator can instead define the joint law directly, in
which case the expectation must follow that law. The inspected documentation requires
consistency between reward signatures. For the two-outcome example, weighting by the
declared probabilities gives −4; averaging the two reward values uniformly gives −16. Returning
a convenient number from the narrower method is not enough. (JuliaPOMDP contributors,
2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026cd)
   Terminal value is zero after termination in the model contract. That does not erase the
reward on the transition into the terminal state. A settlement paying 12 on entry has value 12
with zero subsequent continuation; a wrapper that masks the transition reward by destination
terminal status reports zero. This parallels the episode-clock issue in other sequential packages,
without asserting that the inspected Julia simulator implements that erroneous mask. The root
default marks no state terminal. A concrete bank model and simulator must therefore bind
terminal behavior, horizon, per-step discount and any variable-duration convention explicitly.
The inspected standard generator fields do not by themselves establish a semi-Markov discount
contract. (JuliaPOMDP contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026cd)
1358                                                          Causal analysis for a universal bank


50.29.3     Belief meaning and a conditional Julia worker route

The library deliberately uses belief broadly: it can be a posterior, particles, a partial history
or another policy information state. Its initialization contract allows lossy conversion and
has a pass-through default; the history contract permits a partial suffix, and the default
current observation reads the last history item. Thus a successful initialization call does not
certify posterior normalization, sufficiency, nonempty history or an independent snapshot. A
wrapper must identify the representation and supported operations, copy or serialize mutable
state when isolation is required, and refuse claims that exceed the retained information.
State/action/observation objects also require stable equality and identity: the model guide
warns against mutating objects used as dictionary keys or retained in histories. (JuliaPOMDP
contributors, 2026)
   The present disposition is a reference for interface design, with a conditional future Julia
worker. Full adoption is premature because an abstract solve or simulate declaration is not
an audited solver or an executed experiment. A blanket port to R, Python, Java or C++ is
also unjustified: it would duplicate dispatch, distribution and stochastic-event semantics before
demonstrating a benefit. An independent finite-state oracle remains useful precisely because it
checks the intended experiment separately from the chosen implementation. (JuliaPOMDP
contributors, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026cd)
   A prototype can proceed once it pins Julia and all dependency artifacts, selects and reviews
one concrete solver/updater/simulator combination, and registers conformance cases for joint
outputs, asymmetric transitions, old-state observations, reward expectation, terminal entry,
history loss, state mutation and randomness. Measure offline preparation and online action
latency separately, along with compilation, serialization, memory, recovery and numerical error
at the required accuracy. The same target, information clock, diagnostics and refusal must
survive library, CLI and MCP use. An LLM may help draft a model or map a business question
into these contracts, but a plausible generated method cannot authenticate a latent state or its
intervention law. Native integration, scientific qualification and institutional adoption remain
open. (JuliaPOMDP contributors, 2026)


50.30      Bayesian model surgery needs a separate prediction con-
           tract
PyMC is a plausible worker for bank-specific probabilistic models, including hierarchical
likelihoods and explicitly modeled latent quantities. The proposed product, however, needs to
distinguish three questions: which model is being conditioned on data, which mechanism is
replaced by an intervention, and which variables are subsequently regenerated. The inspected
repository revision is dated 7 October 2026 and is identified by its immutable commit and
twelve authenticated source, documentation and test files. Its version is dynamically resolved;
this review does not assert that the selected development revision is a named stable release. Its
metadata requires Python at least 3.12 and below 3.15, and a specified PyTensor compatibility
range. Those requirements, the root Apache license and the actual dependency artifacts must
be part of a future worker contract rather than inferred from an older installed environment.
(PyMC Developers, 2026)


50.30.1     Conditioning does not replace a treatment mechanism

The inspected observe transformation converts selected random or deterministic variables into
observed variables, with compatible shape and type. The do transformation instead replaces
50.30. Bayesian model surgery needs a separate prediction contract                          1359


named model variables by intervention expressions in a cloned graph. An expression depending
on random variables is represented as a deterministic; a constant intervention is shared data by
default. These operations provide useful model construction machinery. They do not establish
that the supplied graph correctly represents assignment, latent common causes, information
timing or a bank’s feasible interventions. (PyMC Developers, 2026)
  For an exact example, let hidden borrower type U be Bernoulli with probability 1/2, let
observed treatment A agree with U with probability 3/4, and let the outcome be Y = 2A + 4U .
Then

   E[Y | A = 1] = 5,       E[Y | A = 0] = 1,      E[Y | do(A = 1)] − E[Y | do(A = 0)] = 2.

The association is four, while the intervention effect is two because changing A leaves the
population law of U unchanged. At a stipulated value of USD 100 per outcome unit and action
cost USD 250, the association-based decision reports net USD 150 but the causal calculation
gives USD −50. The numerical example is an authored finite-law calculation; it is neither a
package benchmark nor estimated bank economics. (Causal banking proposal project, 2026cf)
  Even a perfect posterior computation cannot resolve every causal ambiguity. The structural
models A = U, Y = A and A = U, Y = U , with a fair binary U , induce the same observed
law for (A, Y ) but treatment effects one and zero. Under equal observational likelihoods,
posterior odds between these models remain their prior odds. A narrower posterior obtained by
choosing one model is conditional on that choice, not evidence that observations distinguished
the models. A useful separate computational oracle is the conjugate update from a uniform
beta prior after six successes and four failures: the posterior is beta(7, 5) with mean 7/12 and
variance 35/1872. Agreement with this oracle checks a declared probability calculation; it
does not validate a causal interpretation of those successes. (Causal banking proposal project,
2026cf)
   The transformation API also allows interventions that reference the original variable. The
inspected code warns and gives the replacement a new name with a do_ prefix. Such an
expression needs an explicit scientific interpretation, for example a declared shift policy; it
must not be silently described as a fixed assignment. Optional pruning removes variables
detached from observed variables, and its helper explicitly refuses models containing Potentials
because their prior-versus-likelihood role is ambiguous. Therefore pruning cannot substitute
for reviewing the target and retained information. (PyMC Developers, 2026)
   Graph cloning has concrete limits. The inspected conversion refuses nondefault initial values
and nested submodels, and warns that reusing old Gaussian-process objects can reintroduce
variables from the original model. It copies shared random generators, data and symbolic
dimension lengths. A worker must therefore bind the original and transformed model identities,
coordinates and initialization choices, and inspect rejected conversions. These source operations
are a basis for a future isolation test; source inspection alone does not certify a concurrent
service or a complete snapshot. (PyMC Developers, 2026)


50.30.2     Stored draws, regenerated variables and changed expressions

The selected forward-sampling implementation separates output selection from regeneration.
var_names controls what is returned; it does not request a fresh draw. sample_vars identifies
variables to regenerate, while freeze_vars preserves trace values. Random variables present in
the trace and not explicitly selected for regeneration are automatically frozen. Missing random
variables, including ordinary observed outcomes absent from the trace, are regenerated. The
code detects some changed-ancestor cases and issues an implicit-freeze warning, but warning
1360                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


availability does not establish that the chosen predictive experiment is appropriate. (PyMC
Developers, 2026)
   Suppose a stored draw contains X = 1, Y = 1 from a model with Y | X ∼ N (X, 1). After
changing X to three, retaining the stored Y returns one, whereas regenerating Y from the
changed model has conditional mean three. Both operations can be intentional, but they
answer different questions. A policy simulation must identify which parameter draws remain
conditioned on the original evidence and which post-intervention variables are generated anew.
Otherwise an apparently successful transformation can leave precisely the outcome of interest
tied to the old experiment. (PyMC Developers, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026cf)
   Changed deterministic expressions require their own attention. The inspected documentation
explicitly describes replacing a deterministic expression without changing any random variable
or data value: the predictive machinery can then reuse its stored value unless regeneration is
requested. For two illustrative trace points X = 1, 2, replacing X 2 by X 3 changes the desired
values from (1, 4) to (1, 8) and their mean from 5/2 to 9/2. A model digest must therefore
identify expressions, not just variable names and current data. Name-based trace matching
with compatible shapes and coordinates is a software matching rule, not proof of causal or
semantic equivalence between models. (PyMC Developers, 2026; Causal banking proposal
project, 2026cf)
   Predictive handling of Potentials adds another boundary. The inspected prior and posterior
predictive routines warn that their direct effect on other parameters is ignored during forward
sampling. A fair binary generator with a hard weight excluding zero has weighted probability
one of a positive value, whereas the unconstrained forward generator still has probability 1/2.
This witness explains why a density factor cannot automatically be treated as a generative
rule. It does not imply that all effects of a Potential vanish: posterior ancestors supplied by
the trace may already reflect that factor. The worker must identify the factor’s role, whether
it enters the inferential posterior, and how the requested predictive law is constructed. (PyMC
Developers, 2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026cf)
  The selected upstream tests include intervention, self-reference, dimensional and predictive
cases, as well as a constant-intervention predictive case marked as an expected failure. These
are useful conformance leads, not executed results in this project. The proposed fixture set
must exercise both shared and constant interventions and inspect the actual result and warning,
without converting an upstream test marker into a claim that failure was reproduced here.
(PyMC Developers, 2026)


50.30.3     Computation and diagnostics must remain visible to the caller

Sampler identity cannot safely be left implicit. At the selected revision, the default dispatch can
choose nutpie when the installed environment, model, compilation mode and arguments permit
it, otherwise the PyMC sampler. The external paths impose restrictions on variable types
and supplied steps, and reject custom trace backends and per-draw callbacks. Consequently,
partial-trace persistence described for a PyMC trace backend cannot be advertised for every
sampler choice. Persisting draws also does not by itself establish resumable chain state,
independent restarts or distributed recovery. (PyMC Developers, 2026)
   The inspected convergence routine reports missing posterior data, too few draws, a single
chain and fewer than four chains separately. It checks reported divergences and tree-depth
statistics; missing statistics return no corresponding warning. Its inspected thresholds include
an Rb warning above 1.01 and an effective-sample-size warning below 100 per chain. These are
the package’s conditional diagnostics, not a theorem of convergence or a guarantee that an
intervention model is correct. NUTS source documentation also describes energy, trajectory-
50.31. NumPyro: preserving the experiment through handlers and compiled inference             1361


depth and timing statistics and distinguishes CPU from wall time. The product must preserve
missing, unavailable, adverse and satisfactory diagnostics as different states, rather than flatten
them into a single successful API status. (PyMC Developers, 2026)
   A posterior credible interval is conditional on the declared prior, likelihood and model class.
Its numerical stability does not establish frequentist coverage across a bank’s data-generating
processes, nor account automatically for selecting a model or policy after examining the
same outcomes. Those uncertainty questions need their own assumptions and evaluation law,
including sensitivity to the indistinguishable models above. (Causal banking proposal project,
2026cf)
   The current disposition is a source-qualified reference with a conditional native Python
worker route. A blanket port to other languages would reproduce graph rewriting and
predictive rules at considerable maintenance cost without a demonstrated advantage. A
concrete prototype should instead pin the release or commit, Python, PyTensor, compiler,
sampler and dependencies; register exact conjugate and finite latent-model oracles; exercise
intervention/freeze/sample semantics, Potentials, dimensions and warnings; and measure
compilation, effective samples, memory, predictive cost and recovery together. Scientific owners
must justify model and intervention meaning, while maintainers own conversion conformance
and operators own budgets and persistence. Library, CLI and MCP should expose the
same target and refusal conditions. LLM-generated models can be proposed for review, but
cannot certify their own causal graph, identification assumptions or scientific validity. Native
qualification, general causal identification and bank adoption remain open. (PyMC Developers,
2026; Causal banking proposal project, 2026cf)


50.31      NumPyro: preserving the experiment through handlers
           and compiled inference
NumPyro is a plausible Python worker when a bank can state a probabilistic model and wants
to explore a JAX-based computational route. Its role begins with that supplied model. It does
not determine whether a servicing action is manipulable, whether an unrecorded customer state
confounds treatment, or whether a financial reporting field was available when the decision
was made. These scientific choices must enter the model contract before a sampler can answer
the intended question. The pinned source examined here declares version 0.22.0 at revision
033f7e2e57bd0396fba8493ae246debe52f2c973, committed on 5 October 2026. This is a
source declaration at a revision within the literature cutoff, rather than an assertion that an
independently acquired release artifact has identical contents. The root license is Apache-2.0,
the Python requirement is at least 3.11, and the direct numerical requirements include JAX
and jaxlib at least 0.7.0. Device-specific extras and the additional Funsor inference route
require their own artifact and rights review.NumPyro Contributors (2026)
   The comparison with PyMC is therefore a comparison of proposed worker contracts.
PyMC’s inspected route transforms a graph and controls predictive freezing and regener-
ation; NumPyro’s inspected route applies handlers to executions of a stochastic function and
passes arrays through compiled inference. Neither representation supplies missing assignment
information. Both need the same banking estimand, information clock, outcome units and
refusal semantics. Their different defaults make a transparent adapter more useful than a
wrapper that merely gives identically named commands.PyMC Developers (2026); NumPyro
Contributors (2026)
1362                                                          Causal analysis for a universal bank


50.31.1     Conditioning, intervention and the meaning of an execution trace

In the inspected handler implementation, condition sets a matched sample value and marks
the site observed. substitute can replace several kinds of primitive, including deterministic
values, without making the same observation declaration. replay takes matched sampled
values from an execution trace, checks the sampled-versus-observed role and leaves already
observed target sites alone. Thus matching a site name is a mechanism for moving values; it is
not evidence that two models describe the same financial experiment. An adapter must bind
the model, data and site roles as well as their array shapes.NumPyro Contributors (2026)
   The do handler makes an especially consequential distinction. It creates a fresh sample
site with the original name whose value does not propagate to descendants, then sends the
supplied intervention value down the original computation. A returned treatment value and a
recorded sample under the original treatment name can consequently differ by design. The
upstream counterfactual tests explicitly distinguish the model’s returned values from the
trace values, including when observation and intervention are composed. Those tests describe
intended behavior; they have not been executed in this proposal. A converter that extracts the
original-name trace entry and calls it the administered action could misreport the experiment
even when the handler follows its own contract. Multiple intervention handlers at the same
site also require attention to the inspected warning and handler order.NumPyro Contributors
(2026)
  The causal distinction can be checked without a numerical backend. Let an unobserved
binary type U have probability 1/2, let a binary action A agree with U with probability 3/4,
and set the response to Y = 2A + 4U . Enumeration gives

       E(Y | A = 0) = 1,       E(Y | A = 1) = 5,       E{Y | do(A = a)} = 2a + 2.          (50.4)

The association is four response units and the intervention contrast is two. This is the same
deliberately confounded law used in the PyMC comparison, recalculated by an independently
authored finite enumeration here. It supplies a common semantic oracle: conditioning an
action and cutting its assignment mechanism have different answers. Neither backend acquires
identification simply by returning one of these numbers.Causal banking proposal project
(2026cf,bx)
   Composing handlers also does not make every customer-specific counterfactual identified.
To see the extra requirement, let Y 0 and Y 1 denote binary responses under two actions.
One structural model has (Y 0 , Y 1 ) = (U, U ) for U ∼ Bernoulli(1/2); another has (Y 0 , Y 1 ) =
(U, 1 − U ). Both have
                               Pr(Y 0 = 1) = Pr(Y 1 = 1) = 21 ,                            (50.5)
but Pr(Y 1 = 1 | Y 0 = 1) is one in the first model and zero in the second. Equal single-
world intervention marginals leave this cross-world quantity undetermined. A shared-noise
construction or another justified restriction can define a model-specific answer, and sensitivity
across these constructions can expose the ambiguity. A model proposed by an LLM must
state that construction explicitly; handler composition cannot verify it. This example is an
authored identification witness, not an upstream software failure.Causal banking proposal
project (2026bx)


50.31.2     Prediction must preserve which latent variables are regenerated

The inspected Predictive implementation substitutes supplied posterior values, then executes
the model. By default it ignores stored deterministic values during substitution and recomputes
them from their parents. Setting condition_deterministic=True instead permits those
50.31. NumPyro: preserving the experiment through handlers and compiled inference          1363


stored values to be substituted. Output selection through return_sites has a separate role.
As a simple arithmetic check, equal-weight parent values (1, 2) give a stored-square mean of 5/2
and a recomputed-cube mean of 9/2. Keeping the old deterministic values after changing the
expression answers a different question from recomputation. NumPyro’s default and PyMC’s
inspected predictive controls should therefore be represented by explicit regeneration choices
in a common interface. One cannot infer equivalence from matching output names.NumPyro
Contributors (2026); PyMC Developers (2026); Causal banking proposal project (2026bx)
   Posterior substitution also fixes supplied stochastic sites. Including such a site among
requested outputs does not ask the model to redraw it. Conversely, an absent latent site is
not automatically inferred from an observed response during ordinary forward execution. The
inspected infer_discrete path invokes additional enumeration and posterior-sampling ma-
chinery; ordinary prediction uses a different masking and execution path. The documentation
further requires clearing an observed response to generate a new realization of that response.
Leaving an old observation attached can preserve that value rather than create a new future
outcome. A bank worker must distinguish parameter draws learned from historical data, histor-
ical customer states, states to infer from new evidence and genuinely new outcomes.NumPyro
Contributors (2026)
  A servicing example shows why this is an economic distinction. Suppose a hidden type
U = 1 has prior probability 1/3, and an alert S = 1 has probabilities 3/4 under type one and
1/4 under type zero. The alert probability and posterior type probability are

                       5                                    (1/3)(3/4)
           Pr(S = 1) = 12 ,     Pr(U = 1 | S = 1) =                           = 35 .     (50.6)
                                                      (1/3)(3/4) + (2/3)(1/4)

Let an additional action have stipulated net payoffs USD 100 for type one and USD −200 for
type zero; taking no additional action pays zero. Averaging over the posterior gives

                          V (1 | S = 1) = 53 (100) + 25 (−200) = −20.                    (50.7)

Replacing the type distribution by its most probable state instead reports USD 100 and selects
the action, with an actual expected loss of USD 20 under the specified posterior law. Ignoring
the alert and drawing the type from its prior gives yet another action value, USD −100.
Posterior averaging, MAP substitution and unconditioned regeneration are three different
procedures. These exact, stipulated amounts motivate the adapter’s uncertainty contract; they
are not measured returns from a bank or observed package behavior.Causal banking proposal
project (2026bx)


50.31.3    Discrete inference and continuous sampling have separate contracts

For enumerable latent sites, the inspected model utilities prepare parallel enumeration, with
plate dimensions controlling the tensor arrangement. The Funsor contribution is an additional
dependency and is labelled experimental by its import path. The inspected discrete handler
accepts temperature one for posterior sampling and temperature zero for MAP-style decoding;
other temperatures are rejected. Its source also warns that inferred-trace log probabilities are
not meaningful. A downstream likelihood audit must not reuse those trace log probabilities as
an ordinary fitted likelihood. Likewise, a MAP path is not a collection of posterior paths and
cannot propagate hidden-state uncertainty in the servicing example. The scan boundary needs
more careful qualification: the handler documentation says the scan primitive is unsupported,
whereas the selected tests include scan hidden-Markov examples of lengths one and two and
mark length ten as expected to fail because of a Markov sum-product adjoint limitation. This
documentation/test tension justifies a registered length- and construction-specific trial, not a
1364                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


blanket assertion of support or a reproduced failure. None of those upstream tests has been
run here.NumPyro Contributors (2026)
   NumPyro also exposes composable Gibbs and HMC-within-Gibbs routes. The inspected
discrete selector distinguishes enumerable sites being updated from sites already marked for
marginalization. The proposal must record that choice, support sizes, block structure and
proposal settings. The inspected composition rejects some configurations, including subsample
plates and value-dependent supports across blocks; the HMC-within-Gibbs entry rejects a
bare potential-function model. These restrictions do not establish that a different kernel
can repair the case. Native qualification should compare a small hidden-state model against
complete enumeration and retain separate acceptance for marginal likelihood, posterior state
probabilities and policy value. A state decoder agreeing with one selected path cannot satisfy
all three.NumPyro Contributors (2026)
   A continuous reference can be equally transparent. With a Beta(2, 3) prior and four successes
plus one failure, the likelihood gives a Beta(6, 4) posterior. Ratios of its normalizing integrals
